rows.original:
Traveling through the terrain of the Foothills, shouting and dull impacts suddenly reach your ears from over a nearby grassy crest — the sound of battle! Hurrying to the top of the hill [party.solo
        |
        |with [party.compNames] on your trail, 
    ]you keep your eyes peeled in the direction it seems to be coming from. You can see what part of the trouble is before you even reach the pinnacle: an angry hill giant!
    
    Gazing down upon the scene below, you observe his ragged state. There's a broken-off spearhead embedded in his shoulder restricting his arm's mobility, and another in his gut. He angrily swings his greatclub around, slamming it into the earth hard enough to create furrows in the ground, but to no apparent avail. Whatever he's fighting, it's too fast for him to hit. You can see flashes of red and gold in the swirling dust cloud around his legs and something that sounds like hooves — a knight, perhaps?
    
    So engrossed in watching the deadly encounter are you that it doesn't even occur that you should take part until the ring of steel rouses you from spectating. By the time you take a step, though, the situation has changed. The massive giant reels, screaming in anger and waving his oversized weapon around like he's trying to swat a fly. The haft of a javelin protrudes from his left eye, his free hand blindly groping at it.
    
    He never gets the opportunity to remove it. With a thundering cry, a long, bronze spear is thrust from below the flailing giant, stabbing him right through the throat before it's withdrawn. His lifeless body slumps to the ground with a massive thud as you approach, [pc.weapon] in hand.
    
    "Ho!" you call into the swirling dust cloud, still watching the giant for any movement. [pc.isBimbo
        |"That was totally crazy!"
        |"Nice fight."
    ]
    
    "Thank you, traveler," a female voice replies, a dark outline of her shape appearing in the dust before it swirls away. "It was hard-fought."
    
    Standing before you is a solemn-looking centaur woman, her black-furred body encased in bronze armor. A thick red plume sprouts from both her ornate helm and from her flanks, golden highlights laid across her plate. The only sign of her femininity at all is a glimpse of her long brown hair falling down her shoulders and a peek of her bare tummy.
    
    She regards you evenly. "What say you? Do you pass through here with purpose?"
    
    She seems a reliable character but you're not about to blurt out your life story. "That I do. [party.som
        |I'm an adventurer, after all.
        |My companion and I are adventurers, after all.
        |My companions and I are adventurers, after all.
    ]"
    
    "Adventurers," she says, seemingly turning the word over in her head. She nods. "I am Alante of Khor'minos."
    
    [party.som
        |"[pc.name]. Nice to meet you, Alante," you say. "What can you tell me of Khor'minos?"
        |"I'm [pc.name], and this is [party.compNames]. Nice to meet you, Alante," you say. "What can you tell us of Khor'minos?"
        |"I'm [pc.name] and these are my friends, [party.compNames]. Nice to meet you, Alante," you say. "What can you tell us of Khor'minos?"
    ]
    
    "The jewel of the Frost Marches," Alante says. "It lies to the east, far underground and past the caves of Undermountain."
    
    "The entire city is underground?" you ask.
    
    Alante nods. "The reigning king is Kelsaz. I am fortunate enough to be the commander of one of his legions, and a vanguard of the expeditionary forces."
    
    "Is that why you're out here on your own?" you say.
    
    "It is," she says. "With the city in quarantine, only the expeditionary forces are allowed re-entry. The rest of the army is standing by in the city."
    
    "So you're someone important," you note.
    
    You think you see the hint of a smile linger on Alante's face for a second. "You flatter me, I am merely lucky to serve. Now, I must go. Fortune to you, [pc.name]. Perhaps we will meet again in your journey."
    
    "I'll see you in Khor'minos," you say.
    
    She looks you up and down and nods. "I am sure you will."
    
    Turning to leave, Alante kicks the ground and propels herself to an impressive speed with her powerful black legs, galloping into the distance. Soon enough all that's left in her wake is a cloud of dust obscuring her form along with you and a dead hill giant. Best get moving before he starts to stink — well, too late for that, but at least before the flies start arriving in larger numbers.

你俯视着下方的景象，观察着它那破烂不堪的样子。有一根断裂的矛头嵌在他的肩膀里，限制了他手臂的活动范围，另一根则刺入了他的腹部。他愤怒地挥舞着那根巨大的棍棒，用力将其砸向地面，甚至在土地上砸出了沟壑，但显然这一切都没有起到任何效果。无论他在与什么战斗，对方的动作都快得让他根本无法击中。你可以看到在他脚边旋转的尘云中闪烁着红光和金光，同时还传来类似马蹄声的声音——或许是一位骑士？

你如此全神贯注地观看着这场致命的交锋，甚至完全没有意识到自己也应该加入战斗，直到那圈钢铁将你从观赏中惊醒。然而，当你迈出那一步时，情况已经发生了变化。那个巨大的怪物怒吼着，挥舞着它那巨大的武器，仿佛在试图拍死一只苍蝇。一支标枪的枪柄从它的左眼处伸出，而它的另一只手则盲目地试图抓住它。
    
    他从未有机会拔出那支长矛。随着一声震天响亮的呐喊，一支长青铜矛从那头巨兽的下方刺了进来，直接刺穿了它的喉咙，然后又被拔了回来。当你靠近时，那具毫无生气的巨兽尸体重重地摔在了地上。 [pc.weapon]吼！”你朝着那片翻腾的尘云喊去，同时仍在注视着那个巨人，看它是否有任何动作。 [pc.isBimbo
        |那简直太疯狂了！
        |打得不错。
    ]
    
    谢谢你，旅人，”一个女性的声音回应道。在她的身影消失在尘埃之中之前，人们只能看到她那模糊的黑色轮廓。“这场战斗确实非常激烈。”

站在你面前的是一位神情肃穆的半人马女性，她那覆盖着黑色毛发的身体被青铜铠甲包裹着。她那华丽的头盔以及身体两侧都长着浓密的红羽毛，铠甲上还点缀着金色的纹路。唯一能体现她女性化程度的，就是那一头垂落在肩头的棕色长发，以及偶尔露出的裸露的小腹。
    
    她平等地对待你，问道：“你怎么看？你经过这里是有特别的目的吗？”

她看起来是个值得信赖的人，但你总不能立刻把自己的身世全部告诉她吧。“是的，我有特别的目的。 [party.som
        |毕竟，我可是个冒险家啊。
        |毕竟，我和我的同伴都是冒险者。
        |毕竟，我和我的同伴们都是冒险者。
    ]冒险者们，”她说，似乎在仔细斟酌这个词的含义。她点了点头，继续说道：“我是科尔米诺斯的阿兰特。
    
    [party.som
        |"[pc.name]很高兴见到你，阿拉恩特，”你说，“你能告诉我关于科尔米诺斯的一些情况吗？
        |我[pc.name]，而这就是[party.compNames]很高兴见到你，阿拉兰特，”你说，“你能告诉我们关于科尔米诺斯的一些情况吗？
        |我[pc.name]这些都是我的朋友们。 [party.compNames]很高兴见到你，阿拉兰特，”你说，“你能告诉我们关于科尔米诺斯的一些情况吗？
    ]
    
    冰霜边境的瑰宝，”阿兰特说道，“它位于东边，深埋地下，就在山腹深域的洞穴之外。”

“整个城市都在地下吗？”你问道。

阿兰特点了点头。“现在的国王是凯尔萨兹。我很幸运能够成为他麾下军团的指挥官，同时也是远征军队的先锋。”

“所以你才会独自来到这里吗？”你问道。

“是的，”她回答，“由于这座城市正处于隔离状态，只有远征军队被允许重新进入。其余的军队都驻扎在城里。”

“这么说，你应该是某个重要人物吧。”

你似乎看到阿拉特脸上闪过一丝微笑。“您过奖了，我只是有幸能够为这样的团队效力而已。现在，我必须离开了。祝你们好运。 [pc.name]也许在我们各自的旅程中，我们会再次相遇。”

“那我们在科尔米诺斯见吧，”你说道。

她上下打量了你一番，然后点了点头：“我相信我们一定会再见面的。”

转身离开时，阿兰特用她那强而有力的黑色双腿踢踏地面，以惊人的速度奔向远方。不久之后，她身后就只剩下一片尘土，这片尘土遮住了她的身影，同时也遮住了你和那只死去的山巨兽。最好赶紧离开这里，免得它开始散发恶臭——嗯，现在已经来不及了，但至少要在苍蝇大量飞来之前离开吧。
rows.raw:
'
    Traveling through the terrain of the Foothills, shouting and dull impacts suddenly reach your ears from over a nearby grassy crest — the sound of battle! Hurrying to the top of the hill [party.solo
        |
        |with [party.compNames] on your trail, 
    ]you keep your eyes peeled in the direction it seems to be coming from. You can see what part of the trouble is before you even reach the pinnacle: an angry hill giant!
    
    Gazing down upon the scene below, you observe his ragged state. There's a broken-off spearhead embedded in his shoulder restricting his arm's mobility, and another in his gut. He angrily swings his greatclub around, slamming it into the earth hard enough to create furrows in the ground, but to no apparent avail. Whatever he's fighting, it's too fast for him to hit. You can see flashes of red and gold in the swirling dust cloud around his legs and something that sounds like hooves — a knight, perhaps?
    
    So engrossed in watching the deadly encounter are you that it doesn't even occur that you should take part until the ring of steel rouses you from spectating. By the time you take a step, though, the situation has changed. The massive giant reels, screaming in anger and waving his oversized weapon around like he's trying to swat a fly. The haft of a javelin protrudes from his left eye, his free hand blindly groping at it.
    
    He never gets the opportunity to remove it. With a thundering cry, a long, bronze spear is thrust from below the flailing giant, stabbing him right through the throat before it's withdrawn. His lifeless body slumps to the ground with a massive thud as you approach, [pc.weapon] in hand.
    
    "Ho!" you call into the swirling dust cloud, still watching the giant for any movement. [pc.isBimbo
        |"That was totally crazy!"
        |"Nice fight."
    ]
    
    "Thank you, traveler," a female voice replies, a dark outline of her shape appearing in the dust before it swirls away. "It was hard-fought."
    
    Standing before you is a solemn-looking centaur woman, her black-furred body encased in bronze armor. A thick red plume sprouts from both her ornate helm and from her flanks, golden highlights laid across her plate. The only sign of her femininity at all is a glimpse of her long brown hair falling down her shoulders and a peek of her bare tummy.
    
    She regards you evenly. "What say you? Do you pass through here with purpose?"
    
    She seems a reliable character but you're not about to blurt out your life story. "That I do. [party.som
        |I'm an adventurer, after all.
        |My companion and I are adventurers, after all.
        |My companions and I are adventurers, after all.
    ]"
    
    "Adventurers," she says, seemingly turning the word over in her head. She nods. "I am Alante of Khor'minos."
    
    [party.som
        |"[pc.name]. Nice to meet you, Alante," you say. "What can you tell me of Khor'minos?"
        |"I'm [pc.name], and this is [party.compNames]. Nice to meet you, Alante," you say. "What can you tell us of Khor'minos?"
        |"I'm [pc.name] and these are my friends, [party.compNames]. Nice to meet you, Alante," you say. "What can you tell us of Khor'minos?"
    ]
    
    "The jewel of the Frost Marches," Alante says. "It lies to the east, far underground and past the caves of Undermountain."
    
    "The entire city is underground?" you ask.
    
    Alante nods. "The reigning king is Kelsaz. I am fortunate enough to be the commander of one of his legions, and a vanguard of the expeditionary forces."
    
    "Is that why you're out here on your own?" you say.
    
    "It is," she says. "With the city in quarantine, only the expeditionary forces are allowed re-entry. The rest of the army is standing by in the city."
    
    "So you're someone important," you note.
    
    You think you see the hint of a smile linger on Alante's face for a second. "You flatter me, I am merely lucky to serve. Now, I must go. Fortune to you, [pc.name]. Perhaps we will meet again in your journey."
    
    "I'll see you in Khor'minos," you say.
    
    She looks you up and down and nods. "I am sure you will."
    
    Turning to leave, Alante kicks the ground and propels herself to an impressive speed with her powerful black legs, galloping into the distance. Soon enough all that's left in her wake is a cloud of dust obscuring her form along with you and a dead hill giant. Best get moving before he starts to stink — well, too late for that, but at least before the flies start arriving in larger numbers.
    '

rows.original: Up ahead is a black-furred centaur wearing bronze armor, idly observing the goings-on up and down the road as she walks along. You'd recognize that outline anywhere — it's Alante, the centaur you ran into in the foothills! She must have returned home from her expeditionary duties. She draws closer, catching your eye and looking away — and then looking back, studying you more closely. "[pc.name]?" "So you do remember me," you say, smiling. "Hi, Alante." "Hello," she says, inclining her head[party.som|.| to you and [party.compNames].| to you and your companions.] "Good to see you again..." She trails off before faintly smiling. "So you did make it here after all. Well done. You must be strong." "The trip through Undermountain was interesting," you say. "It certainly is, isn't it?" Alante agrees. "Your adventure has taken you far and wide, I take it. Are you here to aid us?" [party.solo|"I am," you say.|"We are," you say.] "Excellent. Excellent," she says, looking back up the road. "Do you have your token yet?" "My what?" you say. "I take it that you do not, then," Alante says, a smile flashing across her face again. "No matter. Come, we will see the captain together. I will vouch for you myself." "Thanks, but what is a token?" you ask. "All of the non-citizens that desire to help need tokens to gain access to the city. They're approved either from a list or by their feats," she says. "Without a token, you won't be able to do much." You have a sneaking suspicion you'd be able to get a token on your own but hey, you're not going to turn down some charity on Alante's part. "So what have you been doing since we met?" you ask as you walk. "Mostly suppression in the surrounding lands," Alante says. "Though at this point it doesn't feel like it's had much effect..." "If you've returned recently, you must have seen the imps in the mountain," you say. "Yes," she sighs, lowering her gaze a little. "I know not from whence they came, but they are most vile. I had never seen them prior to my return, neither in the undermountain nor outside of it. Disgusting creatures." [var0 |You're seized for a moment by a vision of Alante naked and screaming, taking several massive imp cocks in her stretching, squirting marecunt, helpless to resist while others land on her rump and fill her asshole with their throbbing dicks. She would make a beautiful breeder for your imps if you corrupted her a little... "Aren't they, though?" you sigh, shaking your head. "Who knows where they come from." |"Agreed," you say. ] "It has only been weeks since I left and already my home is being encroached upon," Alante says, her hand tightening around her spear. "I must be stronger." You approach the guard captain with Alante accompanying you, and he gives the [party.som|two|three|four] of you a nod. "Ay-ah, traveler[party.solo|.|s.] And Captain Alante," he notes with some amusement.
rows.translation: 前方有位披着青铜铠甲、毛发呈黑色的半人马，她正闲散地观察着道路上发生的一切，而你也在沿着道路前行。无论在哪里，你都能认出那道身影——那就是你在山脚下遇到的阿尔兰特！她一定是从远征任务中回到了家中。 她逐渐靠近你，吸引了你的注意，然后又移开了视线，但随后又再次回头，仔细打量着你。[pc.name]所以你确实记得我吧，”你微笑着说，“嗨，阿拉恩特。” “你好，”她微微低头说道。[party.som|。|，也向[party.compNames]问好。|，也向你的同伴们问好。]很高兴再次见到你……” 她的话渐渐停了下来，然后微微一笑：“看来你终究还是来到了这里。做得不错，你一定很坚强吧。” “穿越山腹深域的旅途确实很有趣，”你说。 “确实很有趣，不是吗？”阿兰特同意道，“你的冒险经历一定让你走过了许多地方。你是来帮助我们的吗？ [party.solo|我就是，”你说道。|我们就是，”你说道。] 太好了，太好了，”她说道，同时抬头望向道路的方向。“你拿到代币了吗？” “什么代币？”你问道。 “看来你还没有拿到吧，”阿兰特再次露出微笑，“没关系。来吧，我们一起去见队长。我会亲自为你担保。” “谢谢，但什么是‘代币’呢？”你问道。 “所有希望提供帮助的非公民都需要这些代币才能进入这座城市。他们的申请要么会从名单中获得批准，要么会根据他们的所作所为来决定是否被允许进入。”她解释道。没有令牌，你就什么也做不了。” 你暗自怀疑自己或许能够想办法获得这个令牌，但话说回来，阿尔兰特提供的这份帮助，你总不能拒绝吧。“那么，自从我们见面之后，你都做了些什么呢？你边走边问。 “在周围的土地上，主要是采取了压制措施，”阿兰特说道，“不过现在看来，这些措施似乎并没有起到太大的效果……” “如果你是最近才回来的，那你肯定已经看到山里的那些小妖精了吧？”你问道。 是的，”她叹息道，微微低下视线，“我不知道它们从哪里来，但它们实在太恶心了。在我回来之前，我从未见过它们，无论是在地下山中还是山外。真是令人作呕的生物。 [var0 |有那么一瞬间，你的脑海中浮现出这样的画面：阿拉兰特赤裸着身体，尖叫着，几根粗大的阴茎插入她那紧绷、喷射着液体的阴道里，她根本无力抵抗，而其他的阴茎则顶在她的臀部上，将它们颤抖的阴茎插入她的肛门……她一定会发出美丽如果你稍微“腐蚀”了她，就可以让她成为你的小精灵们的繁殖者了…… “不过，它们不也是这样的吗？”你叹息着，摇了摇头，“谁知道呢在哪里它们就来源于此。 |同意，”你说。 ] 我才离开几周，我的家园就已经开始遭到侵犯了，”阿兰特说道，她紧握着手中的长矛。“我必须变得更强大。” 你在阿兰特的陪同下走向守卫队长，他朝你们[party.som|两人|三人|四人]点了点头。“哎—哈，旅行者[party.solo|！|们！]还有阿兰特队长，”他略带笑意地说道。

rows.original: Alante nods. "Captain. I'm here to vouch for [pc.name]'s entry into Khor'minos." "[pc.name], eh?" the grizzled veteran says, eyeing you. "Well, if Captain Alante's saying it I'll believe it. I s'pose I'll do my due diligence and check the list anyway just to see if you were on there already." He calls for one of his men and sends him to fetch the approval list and a set of tokens for you and [party.som|your potential companions|all of your companions|all of your companions]. "Catching the eye of our centaur-[silly|of-attention|in-command], you must be something special," the captain says, smiling. He looks more like a friendly grandfather than a soldier when he does that. "She's got a very discerning eye." "I'm not[silly|| a commander]..." Alante begins, but the captain of the guard waves her off with a laugh. "Ha ha, I know, I know. Just making jokes," he says, nodding at you. "The expeditionary force is composed of our strongest fighters. She wouldn't have told you that herself, of course." He puts his hands up in defeat as Alante stares daggers at him. "Alright, alright. [pc.HeShe] woulda found out when [pc.heShe] saw you in the colosseum anyway." "The colosseum?" you say, interest piqued. "Aye, host to many an event including gladiatorial combat," the captain says. "The good captain here likes to compete whenever she's around... oh, here we go." "Here's the list, sir," the arriving soldier says. "And the tokens." "Thank you. Return to your post," the captain says. The soldier salutes and turns, heading back to his duty — guarding the gate. The captain turns his attention to the list. "Hmm..." he mutters, rubbing his chin. "Oh. Ha ha, you needn't have bothered, Captain Alante," the guard captain grunts in amusement. "[pc.name]'s a hero through and through. Titled, even. The Champion of Winter City, according to an elven dignitary." Alante recoils like she's been slapped. "The Champion of Winter City?" "Says here [pc.heShe] courageously fought off an invasion of demons in defense of the elven stronghold, tipping the scales single handedly," he says, letting out a low whistle. "High praise. Here's your tokens." "Thanks," you say, taking them from his outstretched hand and [party.som||handing one to [party.compNames] before |handing one to each of [party.compNames] before ]clipping it around your neck. "Have you let many adventurers like me in?" "Ha ha," he grunts. "A fair few. Not all of them are titled like you are, but knights of renown aren't exactly uncommon in Khor'minos. S'pect you'll probably run into more than one of 'em just walkin' round the city. And then there's the ones who aren't like you, and there's dozens. Plenty of people looking for coin and opportunity." You look to Alante. "Shall we go in?" She starts, and looks at you. "Oh, right. Let me escort you inside." "Everything okay? You went quiet there," you say once the captain's waved you through. You walk through a side door, into a route through the walls themselves. It looks like the gates stay closed permanently these days. "Oh, I- well, I didn't know you were that strong. I feel sheepish now for having thought I was doing you a favor," Alante admits. "I have hardly a deed to my name, let alone saving a city single handedly." [pc.dcb|"I am pretty strong," you say, smiling. "Don't worry about it, Alante. I surprise a lot of people." "I can imagine," she says, glancing at you.|"Yeeeaaahh... that report was just a bit exaggerated," you say. "I did save it, but it wasn't exactly singlehanded. I had help." "You are even modest in your heroics," she says, glancing at you. "I am impressed."|"Awww, naaahh," you say, waving her off. "You're totally cute and everything. Don't worry about it!" "I was unaware my appearance mattered," she says, glancing at you.] "So you fight in the colosseum?" you ask. Alante nods. "Whenever I'm home, which isn't very often." "Do you enjoy it?" you say. "Of course. Competition is what makes me stronger," she says. "It's the only chance I have of finding [pc.mf|a husband|my beloved], too." You do a double-take. "Wait, you're trying to find [pc.mf|a husband|a lover] in the colosseum?" "I could hardly call someone who couldn't defeat me in combat my [pc.mf|husband|lover]," Alante says. "And I don't have the time to entertain every duel request. The colosseum is my best chance. No luck yet, however." "Strength is important to you, huh?" you say. "Of course. I won't say it's all that matters," she says. "One needs to know how to wield it properly, too. We're here." Alante indicates a door, and you take the handle. She inclines her head. "Welcome to the city of Khor'minos."

rows.raw: ' Alante nods. "Captain. I'm here to vouch for [pc.name]'s entry into Khor'minos." "[pc.name], eh?" the grizzled veteran says, eyeing you. "Well, if Captain Alante's saying it I'll believe it. I s'pose I'll do my due diligence and check the list anyway just to see if you were on there already." He calls for one of his men and sends him to fetch the approval list and a set of tokens for you and [party.som|your potential companions|all of your companions|all of your companions]. "Catching the eye of our centaur-[silly|of-attention|in-command], you must be something special," the captain says, smiling. He looks more like a friendly grandfather than a soldier when he does that. "She's got a very discerning eye." "I'm not[silly|| a commander]..." Alante begins, but the captain of the guard waves her off with a laugh. "Ha ha, I know, I know. Just making jokes," he says, nodding at you. "The expeditionary force is composed of our strongest fighters. She wouldn't have told you that herself, of course." He puts his hands up in defeat as Alante stares daggers at him. "Alright, alright. [pc.HeShe] woulda found out when [pc.heShe] saw you in the colosseum anyway." "The colosseum?" you say, interest piqued. "Aye, host to many an event including gladiatorial combat," the captain says. "The good captain here likes to compete whenever she's around... oh, here we go." "Here's the list, sir," the arriving soldier says. "And the tokens." "Thank you. Return to your post," the captain says. The soldier salutes and turns, heading back to his duty — guarding the gate. The captain turns his attention to the list. "Hmm..." he mutters, rubbing his chin. "Oh. Ha ha, you needn't have bothered, Captain Alante," the guard captain grunts in amusement. "[pc.name]'s a hero through and through. Titled, even. The Champion of Winter City, according to an elven dignitary." Alante recoils like she's been slapped. "The Champion of Winter City?" "Says here [pc.heShe] courageously fought off an invasion of demons in defense of the elven stronghold, tipping the scales single handedly," he says, letting out a low whistle. "High praise. Here's your tokens." "Thanks," you say, taking them from his outstretched hand and [party.som||handing one to [party.compNames] before |handing one to each of [party.compNames] before ]clipping it around your neck. "Have you let many adventurers like me in?" "Ha ha," he grunts. "A fair few. Not all of them are titled like you are, but knights of renown aren't exactly uncommon in Khor'minos. S'pect you'll probably run into more than one of 'em just walkin' round the city. And then there's the ones who aren't like you, and there's dozens. Plenty of people looking for coin and opportunity." You look to Alante. "Shall we go in?" She starts, and looks at you. "Oh, right. Let me escort you inside." "Everything okay? You went quiet there," you say once the captain's waved you through. You walk through a side door, into a route through the walls themselves. It looks like the gates stay closed permanently these days. "Oh, I- well, I didn't know you were that strong. I feel sheepish now for having thought I was doing you a favor," Alante admits. "I have hardly a deed to my name, let alone saving a city single handedly." [pc.dcb|"I am pretty strong," you say, smiling. "Don't worry about it, Alante. I surprise a lot of people." rows.original:
You open the door into deafening noise and blinding light, your eyes prickling as they adjust after being in the relative darkness of the wall's entryway. The din of people chattering crowds your ears but you can still pick out the sound of a blacksmith's hammer, shouting from a barracks, and a faint roar from across the city that you can only guess is from the colosseum. The city is full of the sounds of life.

            You take a look at your surroundings and the first thing you notice is what was blinding you: out of the roadside footpaths sprout long, elegant poles with shallow golden braziers hanging by thin metallic threads from a bar at the top, the gently-curved depression filled with a magical flame. The main road is filled with armored guards and casual citizens alike, minotaurs and cowgirls walking about in what you guess must be their form of casual clothing — a toga wrapped all around their upper bodies that drapes down their legs.
            
            There are others wearing more familiar clothing but the city's fashion seems to be almost universal even across races — you can see lupines and humans wearing the robes. There's a lot of non-minotaurs roaming the roads, as you'd expect. Lupines, orcs, some goblins, catfolk, even a couple of leothrans along with plenty of humans. You've never seen so many different races together at once.
            
            Buildings line the roads, though where you're standing it's just a military guardpost adjacent to the gate and some kind of barn down the road. Looks like there's an inn just down the way, and it might pay to stop in there to get some rooms for your party — but then there's probably a lot of inns in the city, and maybe you could settle in somewhere else. You'll have to take a look and see.
            
            "I had better return to my duties," Alante says from beside you. "I imagine we'll run into each other again at some point, [pc.name]. Be well."
rows.translation:
你推开门，顿时被震耳欲聋的噪音和刺眼的光芒所包围。在墙壁入口处相对昏暗的环境中待了太久，你的眼睛此刻正努力适应这些强光。人群的喧闹声充斥着你的耳朵，但你仍然能够分辨出铁匠挥动铁锤的声音、军营里传来的喊叫声，以及从城市另一端传来的微弱轰鸣声——你只能猜测那应该是竞技场发出的声音。这座城市，充满了生命的活力与各种声音。

            你环顾四周，首先注意到的是那个曾经让你视线受阻的东西：路边的步道上长出了许多修长而优雅的柱子，这些柱子的顶端装有金属杆，细金属线将浅金色的火盆悬挂在上面，而那些微微弯曲的凹槽里则燃烧着神奇的火焰。主干道上到处都是武装警卫和平民，弥诺陶洛斯以及女牛仔们穿着他们所谓的便装在四处走动——那种上半身裹着托加袍，袍子垂到腿部的装束。
            
            还有其他人穿着更为熟悉的服装，但这座城市的时尚风格似乎在各个种族中都普遍存在——你可以看到狼族和其他人类都穿着同样的长袍。正如你所预料的，道路上有很多非弥诺陶洛斯种族的人在活动。有狼族、兽人、一些哥布林、猫族，甚至还有几只狮人，当然还有大量的人类。你从未见过如此多不同的种族同时出现在一处。
            
            道路两旁排列着建筑物，不过在你现在的位置，只有一座军事哨所紧邻大门，道路尽头还有一座谷仓。看起来不远处有一家客栈，去那里为你的团队预订房间或许是个不错的选择——不过这座城市里应该有很多客栈，也许你也可以在其他地方寻找住处。你得亲自去看看才行。
            
            我最好回去继续我的工作了，”阿兰特在你身旁说道，“我想我们以后还会再见面的。 [pc.name]保重。

rows.original: Oh, you'll run into each other again alright. If Alante's hand in [silly|mare-iage|marriage] is up for grabs, it seems the arena's your next stop!
rows.translation: 哦，你们肯定还会再见面的。如果阿兰特的[silly|马姻|婚姻]还有机会争取的话，看来你的下一站就是竞技场了！
rows.raw: "Oh, you'll run into each other again alright. If Alante's hand in [silly|mare-iage|marriage] is up for grabs, it seems the arena's your next stop!"

rows.translation: 再见，阿拉恩特，”你说道，向她表达了感激之情，并点了点头。“也谢谢你的护送。” “不客气，”她回答道，然后转身，手持长矛快步离去。她与那些卫兵们融为了一体——那些她经过的卫兵都在路上向她敬礼，随后她就消失在了人群之中。 [party.has etheryn |[etheryn.lnhConfidence |呃[pc.name]，伊瑟琳开口说道，吸引了你的注意，‘我……我觉得我们并没有派什么高级官员来这里。’” “哈？你确定吗？”你问道。 “哦，我……我也不确定，”她支支吾吾地回答，“也许我们确实派了……也许我只是忘了而已。对不起。” 你轻轻揉了揉她的头发，然后不再继续追问。是时候去探索这座城市了。 |嘿，呃[pc.name]，伊瑟琳歪着头说道，‘我觉得我们并没有派任何高级官员去科尔米诺斯。你知道那个卫队队长是怎么说的吧？他说那里才是消息的来源。’” “是啊，”你回答道。 嗯……我们所有的贵族都死了，”她指出，“或者更糟。现在就只剩下我和艾尔萨拉了，而她也不会来到这里的。” “那么到底是谁干的？”你问道。 伊瑟琳耸了耸肩：“也许是个路人或者普通市民吧……但我想不通他们是怎么来到这里的。大概只是个谣言传开了吧。有人听到了其中的一些细节，却只了解了一半事情的经过，然后就跟着商队来到了这里。但是这还是无法解释为什么那个人会拥有那样的地位啊。”她再次耸了耸肩，“我也不确定，只是觉得这件事很奇怪。” “谢谢你指出来，”你说道，同时轻轻揉了揉她的头发，“我会再仔细考虑一下的。是时候去探索这座城市了。 |嘿， [pc.name]，伊瑟琳说道，‘那个卫队队长说，关于你英勇事迹的描述是由一位精灵高官提供的，应该就是来自冬城的那位。’” “是啊，”你回答道。 “但我们并没有派任何高官去那里，”她指出，“我们所有的精灵高官都已经死了，或者更糟的是现在只剩下我和艾尔萨拉了，我想如果我们当中有谁之前来过这里，我应该能记起来的。那么，究竟是谁讲述了那个故事？又为什么大家会轻易地相信它呢？” “嗯……”你低声说道。 伊瑟琳耸了耸肩：“如果我不相信在科尔米诺斯真的有某个神秘的帮助者在等着我们，你们应该能理解吧。这种事情听起来太美好了，简直不像是真的。” “没错，我也觉得这种说法不太可信。”你说道。只是我不太明白，为什么就连我们的敌人也会想要他们让我们进来这里，这最多也只能说是适得其反吧。” “也许这里有个陷阱，他们想确保我们进去之后才会触发它？”她猜测道，“其实我也不确定。我只是觉得有必要提醒你一下。嘎！”哈里克尖叫道。 “谢谢你们两个，”你说着，轻抚着伊瑟琳的头发，“我会留意任何可疑的事情的。我们一起去探索这座城市吧？继续前进吧！”你的精灵伙伴说道。 ] |好了，是时候去探索这座城市了。 ]

rows.original: Up ahead is a black-furred centaur wearing bronze armor, idly observing the goings-on up and down the road as she walks along. She briefly regards you before giving you a slight nod of approval, passing you by with her cape rippling behind her. She looks like some kind of officer.
rows.translation: 前方有位披着黑色毛皮、身着青铜护甲的半人马，她一边行走，一边闲散地观察着道路两旁发生的一切。她短暂地看了你一眼，然后微微点了点头表示认可，接着继续前行，她的斗篷在身后飘动。她看起来像是某种军官。
rows.raw: "\n        Up ahead is a black-furred centaur wearing bronze armor, idly observing the goings-on up and down the road as she walks along. She briefly regards you before giving you a slight nod of approval, passing you by with her cape rippling behind her. She looks like some kind of officer."

rows.original: Now that you have a moment to breathe outside of the arena, it's dawning on you. You turn to Alante, and she breaks into a shy smile as she meets your gaze. "My-my [pc.mf |husband |wife ]," she says, trying out the sound of the words. She's clearly a bit nervous, but putting voice to it strengthens her a little. "Would you- would you accompany me through the city?" You [pc.dcb |can't help but smirk at the effort she's putting in. "Sure." |smile [pc.isHeight 90 |at |up at ] her. "I would love to, Alante." |smile wide. "Of course, babe!" ] You offer your hand and she takes it after a moment's surprise, the two of you traveling down the road and into a merchant row. "I pass through this street every day I'm in Khor'minos," Alante says, looking down the road. "It's a community all of its own." You pass by a grocer's shop and Alante ducks inside to greet the owner, an elderly minotaur. Standing at her side, you look over the goods – mostly basic essentials and in-season pickings from fields. "Ah, Alante! Hello," the shop owner greets her, a warm smile lighting up his kindly face. "The children were looking for you earlier." Alante smiles. "I will have to apologize to them later. Are they well?" The owner chuckles. "They're kids. Short of being struck by a carriage, they'll be fine." He gives you a friendly nod. "And who is your friend?" "This is my [pc.mf |husband |wife ]," Alante announces triumphantly. [pc.dcb |You give the shop owner a nod. |You smile and wave. "Hello." |You smile wide, waving. "Hiii!" ] The shop owner's eyes widen before he cracks a grin at Alante. "So you finally met your match. And we all thought it would never happen. Congratulations, Alante. I hope the two of you are happy in the years to come." Alante blushes a little. "Thank you, Marcus. I felt I should stop by and say hello." "Your presence is always appreciated here," he says. "Go and have some fun with your [pc.mf |husband |wife ]. And if you see Julian, tell him he's due inside." You bid your goodbyes and return to the street with your centaur wife's hand in your own, casting a glance at her. "Who's Julian?" you ask. Alante chuckles. "A trouble-making child. Marcus' grandson." Her smile fades a little, recalling the past. "His father died in battle, and his mother passed from sickness. Marcus is all he has left." "No wife in the picture for Marcus?" you ask. She shakes her head. "She passed on a few years back. She was lovely- oh, here they are." A veritable swarm of children runs up to Alante, crowding around her legs. "Captain! It's the Captain!" the children chorus. You stop in the street and Alante bends down to talk to the children, smiling at them and listening to them chatter. She's a natural. One of the little girls looks up at you, eyes wide and curious as she tugs at Alante's leg. "Who's that? Who's that?" she says. Alante straightens up and smiles at you. "This is [pc.name]. [pc.HeShe]'s my [pc.mf |husband |wife ]." One of the boys looks up at you critically. "You're the captain's [pc.mf |husband |wife ]? You don't look that tough." You [pc.dcb |chuckle. Obviously this kid hasn't heard of you. Ah, the ignorance of a child. |laugh. "Alante will keep me safe." |giggle. "Alante's a tough one herself!" ] "[pc.name] is very tough, I assure you," Alante tells him. "And Julian, your grandfather is looking for you." Grumbling, the minotaur child slinks into the shop to find Marcus, and you spend some time with the rest of the kids before they disperse. You can't help but note that most of them don't appear to be particularly well-off. "They are orphans," Alante says in response to your unasked question when they're gone, her eyes following their backs down the road. "Wards of Khor'minos itself. I myself was an orphan when I entered the city. I was fortunate to be adopted and raised as a citizen." "Are there people you want to talk to before we leave?" you ask. She nods. "Yes. Ah... but before that..." Alante stops by a vendor, talking for a moment before she returns. In her hands she has a flower. It's a singular red rose, its thorns carefully removed. "This is... for you." You smile [pc.isHeight 90 |at |up at ] her. "Thank you, Alante." You put it...
rows.translation: 现在你终于有时间在竞技场外喘口气了，这时你终于明白了。你转向阿兰特，而她看到你的目光时，脸上露出了羞涩的微笑。 “我、我[pc.mf |丈夫 |妻子 ]你会……会陪我一起在城里走走吗？”她说道，一边试着调整这些词语的发音。显然，她有些紧张，但把这些话说出来后，她似乎感觉稍微镇定了些。“你会……会陪我一起在城里走走吗？ [pc.dcb |看到她付出的这些努力，我不禁会露出微笑。“当然可以。 |微笑[pc.isHeight 90 |在……时候 |起床了 ]我非常愿意，阿兰特。 |笑得合不拢嘴：“当然啦，宝贝！ ] 你伸出手，她略显惊讶地接过了你的手，随后你们一起沿着街道走，来到了商贩聚集的区域。 “我在科尔米诺斯的时候，每天都会经过这条街，”阿兰特边说边望着前方的街道。这其实是一个独立的社区。” 你路过一家杂货店，阿尔安特走了进去，去问候店主——那位年迈的米诺陶人。站在她身边，你环顾了一下店里的商品：大多是日常所需的物品，还有一些当季从田地里采摘来的新鲜蔬果。 啊，阿拉特！你好啊，”店主热情地笑着向她打招呼，他那和蔼的面容上洋溢着笑容，“刚才那些孩子们还在找你呢。” 阿拉特也笑了起来：“待会儿我得去向他们道歉。他们现在都好吗？ 店主轻笑了一声：“他们都是孩子，除非被马车撞到，否则应该不会有事。”他友好地向你点了点头，然后问道：“那么，你的朋友是谁呢？这个是我的[pc.mf |丈夫 |妻子 ]我们胜利了！”阿兰特兴奋地宣布。 [pc.dcb |你向店主点了点头。 |你微笑着挥手：“你好。 |你咧开嘴，挥手说道：“嗨！ ] 店主的眼睛瞪得大大的，然后他对阿拉特露出了笑容：“所以你终于遇到了能与你匹敌的人。我们大家都以为这种事永远不会发生。恭喜你，阿拉特。希望你们未来能够幸福地生活在一起。” 阿拉特的脸微微一红：“谢谢你，马库斯。我觉得我应该过来打个招呼。” “我们这里一直都很欢迎你的到来，”他说，“和你的[pc.mf |丈夫 |妻子 ]好好去玩吧。如果你见到朱利安，告诉他该进去了。” 你道别后，牵着半人马妻子的手走回街上，不时瞥了她一眼。 “朱利安是谁？”你问道。 阿兰特轻笑了一声。一个爱惹麻烦的孩子……马库斯的孙子。”她的笑容略微黯淡下来，回忆起过去。“他的父亲在战场上牺牲了，母亲也因病去世。马库斯就是他唯一的亲人了。” “马库斯没有妻子吗？你问这个啊…… 她摇了摇头：“她几年前去世了。她人很好……哦，他们来了。” 一大群孩子跑向阿拉特，围在她身边。 “船长！是船长啊！孩子们齐声唱着歌。 你在街上停下脚步，阿兰特弯下腰来和孩子们交谈，微笑着倾听他们的说话声。她真的很擅长和孩子们相处。其中一个小女孩抬起头，睁大好奇的眼睛，拽了拽阿兰特的腿。 那是谁？那是谁？”她问道。 阿兰特挺直身子，对你笑了笑：“这是[pc.name]。 [pc.HeShe]是我的[pc.mf |丈夫 |妻子 ]其中一个男孩抬起头，用批判的目光看着你：“你是队长吧？ [pc.mf |丈夫 |妻子 ]你看起来可没那么厉害啊。 [pc.dcb |轻笑一声。显然这孩子根本没听说过你。啊，真是孩子的无知啊。 |阿拉兰特会保护我的安全的。 |哈哈，阿兰特本身也是一个很难对付的角色呢！ ] "[pc.name]真的非常困难，我向你保证，”阿兰特对他说，“而且朱利安，你的祖父正在找你。” 那个脾气暴躁的弥诺陶洛斯小孩闷闷不乐地溜进了商店去找马库斯，而你在其他孩子们离开之前，还和他们一起待了一段时间。你不禁会注意到，他们中的大多数人似乎都并不富裕。 “他们是孤儿，”当那些人离开后，阿尔兰特在回答你那个没有被问到的问题时说道，她的目光追随着他们的背影，一直望向路的尽头。我是科尔米诺斯城的居民。我刚来到这座城市时，也是一个孤儿。幸运的是，有人收养了我，让我作为公民长大。” “在我们离开之前，还有什么人你想见见吗？”你问道。 她点了点头。是的。啊……但在那之前……” 阿兰特走到一个小贩那里，聊了一会儿后才回来。她手里拿着一朵花——一朵去掉了所有刺的红色玫瑰。 “这是……给你的。你微笑了[pc.isHeight 90 |在……时候 |起床了 ]谢谢你，阿兰特。” 你说得真到位……

rows.original:
"What was it like growing up in your situation?" you ask.

        "My upbringing was a little different from most others in Khor'minos given my race and parentage," Alante says. "A female centaur can be every bit as strong as a male centaur, after all. I learned to fight, though my spear is not the conventional weapon of the legions."
        
        "You wield it like it's a part of you," you say, recalling your fight.
        
        Alante smiles. "Well, I have been training with it since I was a child. Though back then, all my father gave me was a big stick."
        
        You laugh. "The chosen weapon of children."
        
        "Exactly!" she says. "But, yes, the spear is well-suited to a centaur. I attended the same academies the sons of officers do to train in the arts of war, as well as receive an education. The legions don't have what you might call 'cavalry' owing to size, but the worth of having a fast-moving weapon wielder was recognized by my tutors. I was taught field logistics and the ins and outs of commanding."
        
        "Raised to be an officer, then," you say.
        
        She nods. "It is not uncommon – officerhood tends to be hereditary. I did experience a different syllabus than the others – becoming an officer is designed to be very difficult, as the vast majority of men in Khor'minos will join the legions at some point. Not everyone can be an officer."
        
        [pc.bg soldier
            |You grunt in recognition. "I bet at least one sook complained about the 'special treatment'."
            
            Alante chuckles. "Yes. But the 'sooks', as you put it, usually did not last long.
            |"Did anyone complain?" you ask. "Special treatment, and all that?"
            
            Alante smiles. "Yes. But those complaining usually did not last long.
        ] No matter who you are, you earn your spot. And besides, I was undefeated at the academy."

“在你这样的环境中长大，是什么感觉？”你问道。

        “由于我的种族和出身，我的成长经历与科尔米诺斯的大多数人有所不同，”阿兰特回答道，“毕竟，女性半人马也可以和男性半人马一样强壮。我学会了战斗，不过我的长矛并不是军团中常用的武器。”
        
        “你挥舞它的样子，就像它是你身体的一部分一样，”你说道，回想起那场战斗。
        
        阿兰特笑了：“嗯，从我小时候起就开始用它训练了。不过那时候，我父亲给我的只是一根大棍子。”
        
        你笑了：“孩子们最爱的武器。”
        
        “正是这样！”她说道，“不过，没错，长矛确实非常适合半人马使用。我和那些军官的儿子们一起在同样的学院里学习，既接受战争艺术的训练，也接受普通教育。由于规模有限，军团里并没有所谓的‘骑兵’部队，但我的导师们认识到了拥有能够快速移动并使用武器的战士的重要性。我学习了野战后勤以及指挥作战的各种细节。”
        
        “那么，你是被培养来成为军官的，”你说。
        
        她点了点头。“这种情况并不少见——军官职位往往具有世袭性。我的训练内容确实与其他人不同。成为军官本来就被设计成一件非常困难的事情，因为在科尔米诺斯，绝大多数男性最终都会加入军团。并不是每个人都能成为军官。”
        
        [pc.bg soldier

            阿兰特轻笑了一声：“没错。但就像你说的，那些软蛋通常都撑不了多久。”
            |“有人抱怨过吗？”你问道。“那些特殊待遇之类的，有没有人觉得不公平而抱怨？”
            
            阿兰特笑了笑：“有啊。但是那些抱怨的人通常都没坚持太久。
        ]无论你是谁，都得靠自己的实力争取位置。而且，我在学院里从未输过任何比赛。”

rows.original:
"How did you start your military career?" you say.

        "After going through the officer's academy, I was given a small squad to command," Alante says. "Five legionnaires, a scout patrol. It is a sort of meeting in the middle in terms of experience – the officer is fresh, but the legionnaires are veterans. You are expected to be tempered by their experience while leading them. It teaches you about how best to employ those under your command."
        
        "So you're not thrown in the deep end of commanding," you muse.
        
        "Yes," she says. "The scouts themselves have a leader to liaise with the commander. After a year of success, I was promoted to handling an expeditionary company. It was more or less the same duties but with more soldiers and more officers to handle delegation."
        
        "Is a year fast?" you ask.
        
        "Quite," Alante says, nodding. "I could tell my superiors wanted me in the role as soon as possible. I suppose having a centaur to control a forward force is an opportunity you come by very rarely. Before long, I was the vanguard commander."
        
        "What's going to come of you leaving?" you say.
        
        "Officially, I am on leave," Alante says. "Unofficially, I am all but retired since joining you." She smiles. [var0
            |"I do not regret my decision, especially given you yourself ardently defended my homeland. Thank you, [pc.name]." She touches your hand. "I will never forget what you've done for my people."
            |"I do not regret my decision. It seems that by virtue of being by your side, I might in turn aid my homeland in its most dire of hours. A fortunate circumstance, and one I will not forget."
        ]

“你是怎么开始你的军旅生涯的？”你问道。

        “在完成军官学院的培训后，我被分配去指挥一个小队，”阿兰特说，“五名军团士兵，一支侦察巡逻队。从经验上看，这算是一种折中——军官是新人，但军团士兵都是老兵。你应该在带领他们的同时，从他们的经验中得到历练，这能教会你如何最好地运用手下的力量。”
        
        “这么说，不会一上来就把你扔进指挥的深水区，”你沉思道。
        
        “是的，”她说，“侦察队本身也有一个负责人来与指挥官沟通协调。在取得了一年的成功后，我被提升去管理一支远征连队。职责大致相同，只不过要管理更多的士兵和更多的军官来分担事务。”
        
        “一年算快吗？”你问道。
        
        “相当快，”阿兰特点头说道，“我看得出我的上级们希望我尽快担任这个职位。我想，能有一个半人马来指挥一支前线部队，这样的机会实在难得一见。没过多久，我就成了先锋部队的指挥官。”
        
        “你离开之后，会怎么样呢？”你问道。
        
        “官方来说，我只是在休假，”阿兰特说道，“实际上，自从加入你之后，我差不多等于退休了。”她笑了。 [var0
            |“我并不后悔自己的决定，尤其是考虑到你曾如此热忱地捍卫过我的祖国。谢谢你，[pc.name]。”她握住你的手。“我永远不会忘记你为我的人民所做的一切。”
            |“我并不后悔自己的决定。看来，正因为陪伴在你身边，我反而能在祖国最艰难的时刻帮上忙。这是一桩幸运的际遇，我也不会忘记。”
        ]
rows.raw:
'
        "How did you start your military career?" you say.

        "After going through the officer's academy, I was given a small squad to command," Alante says. "Five legionnaires, a scout patrol. It is a sort of meeting in the middle in terms of experience – the officer is fresh, but the legionnaires are veterans. You are expected to be tempered by their experience while leading them. It teaches you about how best to employ those under your command."
        
        "So you're not thrown in the deep end of commanding," you muse.
        
        "Yes," she says. "The scouts themselves have a leader to liaise with the commander. After a year of success, I was promoted to handling an expeditionary company. It was more or less the same duties but with more soldiers and more officers to handle delegation."
        
        "Is a year fast?" you ask.
        
        "Quite," Alante says, nodding. "I could tell my superiors wanted me in the role as soon as possible. I suppose having a centaur to control a forward force is an opportunity you come by very rarely. Before long, I was the vanguard commander."
        
        "What's going to come of you leaving?" you say.
        
        "Officially, I am on leave," Alante says. "Unofficially, I am all but retired since joining you." She smiles. [var0
            |"I do not regret my decision, especially given you yourself ardently defended my homeland. Thank you, [pc.name]." She touches your hand. "I will never forget what you've done for my people."
            |"I do not regret my decision. It seems that by virtue of being by your side, I might in turn aid my homeland in its most dire of hours. A fortunate circumstance, and one I will not forget."
        ]
        '

rows.original: "What drove you to fight in the arena?" you ask. "Well... I did not want to find a lover among the troops," Alante admits. "The men are under my command, or otherwise involved in a hierarchy neither of us can avoid. But I did not want to go my whole life alone... I have seen how much my parents love each other." She smiles shyly. "I thought it would be nice to have something similar..." You lean over and surprise the centaur by kissing her on the tip of her nose. "It takes a long time to achieve that. But we have a lifetime together." Alante blushes. "Thank you, [pc.mf |husband |wife ] mine. It is prudent to remember that." "You know, you could have found someone a little easier if you hadn't made them beat you in a fight," you tease. "Of course, but I thought that mayhap since I am a little exceptional, I wanted my beloved to be exceptional," Alante says, smiling wide. "And it worked, did it not? It delivered you to me. Or perhaps me to you." "It did work," you agree. "And you are exceptional. Don't ever forget it." Alante's cheeks color pink, her pointed ears wiggling.

rows.original: "Do you like children, Alante?" you ask. She blinks in surprise, then smiles. "Yes, very much. Some of my fondest memories in Khor'minos are those of the time I spent with the children of the orphanage. I would often donate a portion of my salary, but I find that spending time with children is more valuable than most things you can buy them." "Khor'minos pays for their care?" you ask. "The king considers it an investment, I am told," Alante says. "It would also be a very poor look not to take care of the children of fallen legionnaires. Ensuring your family is taken care of is one of the most common incentives to join I heard when I asked my men."

rows.original: "You know, we don't have to wait," you say. The pretty centauress falters, an incredible blush rising to her cheeks as she realizes what this conversation implies. She looks down, overwhelmed by shyness, but manages to once again meet your eyes. "I... I would like to have children of my own, [pc.mf |husband |wife ] mine. I had thought you would want to wait until after our journey, but I would be more than eager to get a head start..." You smile. "You're special to me, Alante. I remember you spoke about wanting a love like your parents'. It's not going to be exactly the same – but I want to see that dream come true with you. I want to see you happy, and I want to see our children together. Do you want to walk down that path with me?" "I do," she says, her voice clear and her eyes shining. She smiles softly, warmth suffusing her gaze. "I would like to see where that path leads us, [pc.name]." You take her hand and raise it, leaning down to kiss her fingers. "Then let's walk it together." Alante's eyes shimmer, but she doesn't cry. "Thank you, [pc.mf |husband |wife ] mine. I promise I will be the best wife and mother I can." "You don't have to do anything for me except be yourself," you assure her. She nods solemnly. "Even so. I promise to stand by your side even when the light is lowest, [pc.name]. I do not yet know the challenges of motherhood, but I will meet them head-on." You smile. "Thank you, Alante." Alante can now be made pregnant.

rows.original:
"You mentioned ensuring your family is taken care of is one of the more common incentives to join the legions of Khor'minos. What were the others?" you say.
    
    "There were quite a few reasons," Alante says. "Some wanted to protect their homeland and saw the vanguard company as the best way to do so. Some wanted to test their own skills, climbing as high in the ranks as they could – especially those who had friends in similar situations. Others wanted their families to be taken care of, as I said. Yet more simply did not have many opportunities elsewhere, or did not want a career in an industry. Some of them were even nobles, but second or third sons."
    
    [pc.bg noblescion
        |"I'm familiar enough with that myself," you murmur."
        |"Interesting," you say.
    ]
    
    She nods. "One of my officers was actually a first son. He was the most ambitious, and he had the ability to match. I imagine he will replace me."
    
    "A first son?" you say.
    
    "It is a complicated matter," Alante says. "Being an officer in the army commands respect, and come retirement from your post it holds much weight in the political arena. That matters a lot to nobles, because whether or not their personal projects can be funded by the crown depends on their ability to muster support. Citizens like being assured of a politician's character, and their former service to their homeland does a lot of work there. But you do not want to truly be in danger, of course, so a firstborn son being in the vanguard company is very obviously a deliberate decision." She smiles. "Or so I am told. I am not much for politics, but my men talked about it a lot. It is an important facet of their lives in the kingdom."
    
    "I see. Thanks for the information," you say.
    
    "Of course," she says.
rows.translation:
“你提到，确保家人得到照顾是人们加入科尔米诺斯军团的常见动机之一。那么，还有哪些其他动机呢？”你问道。
    
    “原因其实有很多，”阿兰特回答道，“有些人想要保护自己的家园，而他们认为先锋队正是实现这一目标的最佳途径。有些人想要测试自己的能力，尽可能地提升自己的排名——尤其是那些身边有处于类似情况的朋友的人。还有些人则希望自己的家人能够得到妥善照顾，正如我之前所说。更简单地说，有些人是因为在其他地方没有太多机会，或者并不想从事某个行业的职业发展。其中有些人甚至是贵族，但只是他们的次子或三子而已。”
    
    [pc.bg noblescion
        |“我自己对此也相当熟悉，”你低声说道。
        |“有意思，”你说。
    ]
    
    她点了点头：“我的一位下属其实是个长子。他最有抱负，也具备相应的能力。我想他最终会取代我的位置。”
    
    “长子？”你问道。
    
    “这是个复杂的问题，”阿兰特说道，“在军队中担任军官会赢得人们的尊重，而退休后，这一身份在政治领域也会产生重要影响。对于贵族来说，这一点尤为重要，因为他们的个人计划能否获得王室的资助，完全取决于他们能否获得足够的支持。公民们希望得到对政治人物品行的保障，而他们曾经为祖国做出的贡献也在很大程度上起到了这种作用。当然，人们也不希望真正面临危险，因此让长子加入先锋队显然是一个经过深思熟虑的决定。”她笑了笑，“至少我是这么听说的。我对政治并不太感兴趣，但我的手下们经常谈论这个话题。在他们的生活中，政治确实是非常重要的一部分。”
    
    “我明白了。谢谢你提供的这些信息，”你说。
    
    “当然，”她回答道。

'
    "You mentioned ensuring your family is taken care of is one of the more common incentives to join the legions of Khor'minos. What were the others?" you say.
    
    "There were quite a few reasons," Alante says. "Some wanted to protect their homeland and saw the vanguard company as the best way to do so. Some wanted to test their own skills, climbing as high in the ranks as they could – especially those who had friends in similar situations. Others wanted their families to be taken care of, as I said. Yet more simply did not have many opportunities elsewhere, or did not want a career in an industry. Some of them were even nobles, but second or third sons."
    
    [pc.bg noblescion
        |"I'm familiar enough with that myself," you murmur."
        |"Interesting," you say.
    ]
    
    She nods. "One of my officers was actually a first son. He was the most ambitious, and he had the ability to match. I imagine he will replace me."
    
    "A first son?" you say.
    
    "It is a complicated matter," Alante says. "Being an officer in the army commands respect, and come retirement from your post it holds much weight in the political arena. That matters a lot to nobles, because whether or not their personal projects can be funded by the crown depends on their ability to muster support. Citizens like being assured of a politician's character, and their former service to their homeland does a lot of work there. But you do not want to truly be in danger, of course, so a firstborn son being in the vanguard company is very obviously a deliberate decision." She smiles. "Or so I am told. I am not much for politics, but my men talked about it a lot. It is an important facet of their lives in the kingdom."
    
    "I see. Thanks for the information," you say.
    
    "Of course," she says.
    '

rows.original:
There is one thing you can think of to make Alante more amazing than she already is: an enormous horsecock swinging between her muscled, athletic hindlegs, complete with some heavy nuts hanging between her powerful thighs.
    
    "Alante... have you ever thought to change yourself?" you ask.
    
    She thinks for a moment. "Not particularly. I am not very attached to my form, I must admit. I have always been a function-first person. The way that I look is secondary to what I do with it."
    
    Of course. That does make sense, what with her upbringing and role in the Khor'minos military.
    
    "Why?" Alante asks. "Is there something about me you would change, [pc.mf
        |husband
        |wife
    ] mine? I am all ears."
    
    True to form, her ears prick upwards, her focus intent on you.
    
    "In my travels, I come across a lot of alchemical transformatives," you say. "Some of the most interesting ones are the type that grant you the genitalia of other sexes."
    
    "Truly?" Alante says, surprised. "I did not know alchemy could function in such a manner..."
    
    You nod. "Would you be interested in trying it out?"
    
    Alante smiles. "Since you seem so intrigued with the concept, [pc.name], I would be happy to. Anything that enchants my [pc.mf
        |husband
        |wife
    ] so must be worth trying, I should think."
    
    "I'll look into acquiring some reagents, then. Three blue eggs infused with turgid mushrooms," you say, giving her a kiss on the cheek. "Our bedtimes might get very interesting."
    
    "Oh...?" Alante says, blushing slightly. "I await with bated breath, then."
rows.translation:
你想得到一件能让阿兰特比现在更加迷人的东西：一根硕大的马阳具，在她肌肉健美的后腿之间晃荡，还有一对沉重的睾丸悬在她强壮的大腿之间。
    
    “阿兰特……你有没有想过改变自己的身体？”你问。
    
    她思索片刻。“没有特别想过。必须承认，我对自己的形态并没有很深的执着。我向来是个实用为先的人；我的外表如何，远没有我能用这副身体做什么重要。”
    
    当然。考虑到她的成长经历以及她在科尔米诺斯军队中的职责，这的确说得通。
    
    “为什么这么问？”阿兰特说道。“你觉得我身上有什么需要改变吗，我的[pc.mf
        |丈夫
        |妻子
    ]？我洗耳恭听。”
    
    正如她所说，她的双耳立刻竖起，全神贯注地望着你。
    
    “我在旅途中遇见过很多炼金转化物，”你说道。“其中最有意思的一类，能让人获得其他性别的生殖器。”
    
    “当真？”阿兰特惊讶地说道。“我不知道炼金术还能以这种方式发挥作用……”
    
    你点点头。“有兴趣试试看吗？”
    
    阿兰特笑了。“既然这个想法如此令你着迷，[pc.name]，我很乐意尝试。能让我亲爱的[pc.mf
        |丈夫
        |妻子
    ]如此心动的事，想必值得一试。”
    
    “那我会设法弄到所需的材料。三颗以膨胀蘑菇调制的蓝蛋，”你说道，并在她脸颊上亲了一口。“我们的就寝时间或许会变得非常有趣。”
    
    “哦……？”阿兰特双颊微红。“那我就屏息以待了。”

rows.original: "How are you feeling?" you say. [alante.pregStage 0 2 3 |"Everything okay?" Alante smiles at you. "You need not concern yourself, [pc.mf |husband |wife ] mine. I am still at the peak of my performance." Her belly is still very much growing, rounded and curvy as it is already. She moves with a graceful ease, spear at the ready, still the lithe warrior she was – for now. "That's good," you say, reaching out to rub her black-furred side. "As long as you're comfortable, Alante." She leans against you, her expression warm. "Thank you, [pc.name]. I am very comfortable." The two of you stay like that for a while, your fingers idly stroking through her sleek coat in quiet comfort. |"Do you need anything?" "Perhaps a massage?" Alante says hopefully. "My legs ache slightly..." "Of course," you say. You kneel down next to Alante's big, heavy belly, taking ahold of one of her forelegs and gently rubbing up and down its solid surface. She sighs in happiness, some invisible tension draining from her body. You give her side a fond pat and continue, moving to her other legs in turn and rubbing them. "Thank you," she says. "I can feel the bloodflow improving already." "Perhaps the lady might like a longer massage," you suggest. She smiles. "I would appreciate it." You work your way down her side and to her flanks, scratching her back and fondling her hindquarters. You give her bushy tail a few brushes, straightening it out before returning to your full-bodied massage. As it turns out, a woman with the body of a horse has a lot of body to rub. By the time you're done, you've covered a lot of proverbial ground. Alante flashes you a grateful smile, stretching her legs out. "That feels much better, [pc.name]," she says. "Thank you very much. It is a touch more difficult to move, but not too hard to bear." "As long as you're feeling okay," you say. She leans in to give you a kiss on the cheek. "I am more than okay, [pc.mf |husband |wife ] mine. Worry not." You'll reserve the right to worry a little. |"Are you alright?" "I would be much more alright if our children stopped kicking me during the nights," Alante sighs. "But I am as good as I can hope for, I think. A lifetime of physical work seems to have prepared me well." You smile. "That's good." "Still, I will be glad to give birth," she admits. "I have become quite... ungainly." She's certainly grown a bit – filled out doesn't really cover it. Her equine stomach bulges with pregnancy, some noticeable overspill happening with her armor, which she's had to adjust. You're not sure how much of the growth she'll retain after giving birth, but she certainly cuts an incredibly inviting figure. "As pretty as ever, though," you say. Alante smiles at you. "Thank you. Though some of the growth is... concerning." She glances down. "I may not be able to fit my chestplate, soon." She has gained a few cupsizes, along with widening at the hips. Far be it from you to complain, of course. She might be ungainly at the moment, but it certainly looks good on her. "We'll commission you another new one if it comes to that," you assure her. "In the meantime, don't worry about it." "I may need a full new set of armor at this rate," she sighs. "But as you say, I will worry about it when the time comes. A good policy, I should think." You give her a pat on the side. You'll be here for her no matter how this all turns out. ]

rows.original:
"I wonder what Theo and Sinead are doing," you say.
    
    Alante smiles. "Sleeping, I imagine. Or causing Gwyn trouble. One or the other, to be sure."
    
    You laugh. "Children that can get around so well must present her some real problems."
    
    "Truly. Oh, I miss them," she says, her expression softening. "I hope we can see them again soon."
    
    "After the war we'll be free to raise them," you muse. "Until then, we'll have to content ourselves with being as present as we can be."
    
    "It is a hard thing," Alante says sadly. "For both them and us."
    
    You nod. "Next time we see them, let's spend a little extra time with them." You smile. "Remind them what our faces look like."
    
    Alante chuckles. "When you put it like that, it is not so different from being on campaign. I had not fully understood the suffering my men went through, being away from their families. It is good to know we have a place to return to, at least. With our family, and our friends."
    
    "That's all we can hope for, I think," you say.
rows.translation:
“我想知道西奥和西妮德现在在做什么，”你说道。
    
    阿兰特笑了笑：“应该在睡觉吧。或者是在给格温惹麻烦。肯定是这两样中的一件。”
    
    你笑了：“那些这么能到处乱跑的孩子，肯定给她添了不少麻烦。”
    
    “真的。哦，我好想念他们，”她说道，表情变得柔和起来，“希望我们能尽快再见到他们。”
    
    “等战争结束后，我们就可以自由地抚养他们了，”你沉思道，“但在那之前，我们只能尽量多陪伴在他们身边。”
    
    “这确实是件难事，”阿兰特悲伤地说，“对他们和我们都是如此。”
    
    你点了点头：“下次见到他们时，我们多花点时间陪陪他们。”你笑了笑，“提醒他们我们长什么样。”
    
    阿兰特轻声笑了起来。“你这么一说，这和在军中征战也没什么两样。我以前一直没有真正理解我的士兵们远离家人时所承受的痛苦。至少，知道我们还有一个可以回去的地方，这很好。那里有我们的家人，还有我们的朋友。”
    
    “我想，我们能期望的也只有这些了，”你说。

        你点了点头。“那时你正在和一头山丘巨人战斗。”
        
        “我记得，”阿兰特温柔地笑着说，“我得承认，即便在那时我也能看出你身上的潜力，这一点让我多少有些自豪。”
        
        你轻笑了一声。“我还以为你只是在鼓励一个刚入行的冒险者呢。”
    
        “哦，不，我绝不会去鼓励不适合这一行的人，”她认真地说，“很多人因此丧命。我们光是穿行荒野，就会四面受敌。这个世界比以往任何时候都更加充满敌意。一支有实力的冒险者队伍，对任何定居点来说都无疑是宝贵的财富。要不是有你和你的同伴们，嗯……”
        
        她的声音渐渐低了下去，目光望向远方。“这个地方或许会大不一样。”
        |“我记得不久前在这里和一头山丘巨人交过手。”
    
        “真的吗？”你说，“也许我们只是刚好错过了。”
        
        她点了点头。“有这个可能。身为先锋队长，我被派往各处。真可惜我们没有早点相遇，[pc.name]。但至少现在我在这里陪着你。”
        
        你笑了笑。“有你在身边真好。”
    ]
rows.raw:
'
    "Ah..." Alante utters, looking out over the rolling hills. [flags.ALANTE_MET_FOOT
        |"This is where we first met, was it not?"

        You nod. "You were fighting a hill giant."
        
        "I remember," Alante says, smiling fondly. "I admit, I am somewhat proud of myself for seeing the spark of potential in you even then."
        
        You chuckle. "And here I thought you were just being encouraging to a newer adventurer."
    
        "Oh, no, I would never have encouraged one not suited to the occupation," she says seriously. "Many lose their lives. We are assaulted on all sides simply walking through the wilds. The world is more hostile than ever. A band of capable adventurers is assuredly an asset to any settlement. Were it not for you and your companions, well..."
        
        She trails off, looking into the distance. "This place might look very different."
        |"I remember fighting a hill giant here not long ago."
    
        "Really?" you say. "We might have just missed each other."
        
        She nods. "It is possible. My position as vanguard captain has sent me all over. A pity we had not met earlier, [pc.name]. But at least I am here with you now."
        
        You smile. "It is nice having you here."
    ]'

rows.original:
[var0
        |Alante looks around as you appear in Hawkethorne, turning and taking in the village
        |Alante looks around as you walk through the Hawkethorne gates, turning and taking in the village
    ]. An unfamiliar sight, she's the subject of many a passing curious stare, but she doesn't seem to have noticed.
    
    "It's not the prettiest, [pc.isDK
        |but it works
        |but the people are nice
    ]," you say.
    
    "I think it is nice," Alante replies, giving you a smile. "Quaint, perhaps, but its heart beats the same as that of Khor'minos. [dayNight
        |And the streets being less crowded is enjoyable already.
        |I suppose the streets are always less crowded at night.
    ]"
    
    You've seen Khor'minos. It's true that the streets are constantly bustling, full of races that are between seven and eight feet tall. It must be somewhat of a pain for a centaur to get around sometimes.
    
    "It does get a bit busier sometimes," you say, glancing down the main road. "But not that busy. It's nice enough."
    
    "Where do you stay?" she asks.
    
    "Above the tavern," you say with a nod towards the familiar sight of the Frost Hound. "Well, when I'm not at my fort."
    
    [flags.ALANTE_WAYFORT
        |"The fort is nice," Alante agrees. "Very defensible."
    
        You smile. "Let's go say hi to Garth."
        |"You have a fort?" Alante says, looking at you with surprise.
        
        "Stick around and I'll show you all sorts of things," you say with a smile. "Let's go say hi to Garth."
        
        "Can I see the fort?" she asks as she walks alongside you.
        
        You laugh. "We'll visit later."
    ]
rows.translation:
[var0
        |当你出现在鹰棘镇时，阿兰特转身环顾村庄，将四周景象尽收眼底
        |当你穿过鹰棘镇的大门时，阿兰特转身环顾村庄，将四周景象尽收眼底
    ]。她这副陌生的面孔引来不少路人好奇的注视，不过她似乎并未察觉。
    
    “这里算不上最漂亮，[pc.isDK
        |但还算实用
        |不过居民都很友善
    ]，”你说道。
    
    “我觉得这里很不错，”阿兰特朝你微笑着回答。“或许有些古朴，但它的心脏和科尔米诺斯跳动得一样有力。[dayNight
        |而且街道没那么拥挤，已经让人觉得很惬意了。
        |我想，夜里的街道总归没那么拥挤。
    ]”
    
    你见识过科尔米诺斯。那里的街道确实总是熙熙攘攘，挤满了身高七到八英尺的各种族居民。半人马有时想在城中通行，想必会颇为不便。
    
    “这里偶尔也会热闹一些，”你望向主路说道。“不过不会拥挤到那种程度。这里还是挺不错的。”
    
    “你住在哪里？”她问。
    
    “酒馆楼上，”你朝熟悉的寒霜猎犬酒馆点头示意。“嗯，不住在自己的驿堡时就是如此。”
    
    [flags.ALANTE_WAYFORT
        |“那座驿堡很不错，”阿兰特赞同道。“易守难攻。”
    
        你微微一笑。“我们去向加斯打声招呼吧。”
        |“你有一座驿堡？”阿兰特惊讶地望着你。
        
        “跟在我身边，我会带你见识各种各样的事物，”你微笑着说道。“我们去向加斯打声招呼吧。”
        
        “我能去看看那座驿堡吗？”她与你并肩而行时问道。
        
        你笑了起来。“晚些时候我们会去的。”
    ]

rows.original:
Alante looks around as you enter. "I suppose one bar is the same as any other."

    "Not every bar has Garth in it," you assure her. "He's undoubtedly been the most helpful presence in my adventure save for the people that actually travel with me."
    
    Alante approaches the bar, catching the old wolf's attention as he polishes a mug.
    
    "Thank you for aiding [pc.name]," she says.
    
    "Eh?" Garth says, surprised.
    
    "I said, thank you for aiding [pc.name]," Alante says slightly louder.
    
    "Alright, alright," he growls, rubbing the mug faster. "[pc.HeShe]'s a decent sort is all. Are you one of [pc.hisHer] new friends?"
    
    Alante smiles wide. "I am [pc.hisHer] new wife."
    
    "Hi, Garth," you say from beside her. "This is my wife, Alante. She's a former captain from Khor'minos."
    
    "Khor'minos, eh?" he says, raising an eyebrow. "Haven't seen anyone from around there since [brint.isBrienne
        |Brienne
        |Brint
    ] showed up. Long trip."
    
    "It is not nearly as bad on four legs," Alante says.
    
    "S'pose not," Garth says. "Well, you're welcome to stay. Seems like we get all manner of visitor these days, and most people in the village are a friendly sort. Just don't be surprised when they ask you questions." He nods at her. "You look fancy."
    
    Alante looks down at her armor as if she's just noticing it. "I do seem to be somewhat out of place."
    
    "Well, don't worry about it," he grunts. "Nobody's going to cause a friend of [pc.name] trouble. Anything to drink?"
rows.translation:
当你走进来时，阿兰特环顾四周，说道：“我想，任何一家酒吧都和别家没什么两样。”

    “可不是每家酒吧里都有加斯，”你向她保证，“除了那些真正与我同行的伙伴之外，他无疑是我这趟冒险中最帮上忙的人了。”
    
    阿兰特走向吧台，老狼一边擦着杯子，一边注意到了她。
    
    “谢谢你帮助[pc.name]，”她说道。
    
    “啊？”加斯惊讶地说道。
    
    “我说，谢谢你帮助[pc.name]，”阿兰特稍稍提高了声音说道。
    
    “行了，行了，”他低吼着，擦杯子的手更快了，“[pc.HeShe]不过是个不错的家伙罢了。你是[pc.hisHer]新交的朋友之一吗？”
    
    阿兰特露出灿烂的笑容。“我是[pc.hisHer]新婚妻子。”
    
    “嗨，加斯，”你在她身旁说道，“这是我的妻子，阿兰特。她曾是科尔米诺斯的队长。”
    
    “科尔米诺斯，嗯？”他挑了挑眉毛，“自从[brint.isBrienne
        |布蕾妮
        |布林特
    ]来了以后，我就再没见过那儿来的人了。这一路可不近啊。”
    
    “用四条腿走路的话，可远没有这么难受，”阿兰特说。
    
    “大概吧，”加斯说，“总之，欢迎你留下来。这些天我们这儿什么样的访客都有，村里人大都很友善。他们问你问题的时候，别觉得意外就行。”他朝她点了点头，“你看起来很有气派。”
    
    阿兰特低头看了看自己的盔甲，仿佛这才注意到它。“我确实显得有点格格不入。”
    
    “呃，别放在心上，”他咕哝道，“没人会为难[pc.name]的朋友。要来点什么喝的吗？”

rows.original:
"Amazing," Alante murmurs. "As a child, I wondered if Njorhaalt was even real. It sounded too fantastic to exist – a city of ice, full of elves. I thought it a type of myth."

    [party.has etheryn
        |"You could have asked, you know," Etheryn says.
        
        "Apologies, Etheryn," Alante says. "I am not very good with words, and it occurred to me that asking whether your homeland actually exists might be insulting." She smiles. "A child's thoughts are much less charming coming from the mouth of an adult. It is a wondrous city. You have done well."
        
        Ryn beams. "Thank you."
        |"I can understand that," you say. "It is very real, I assure you."
        
        Alante smiles. "There are only so many ways to interpret your title as 'Champion of Winter City', but I had assumed something less magnificent. If anything... the stories have understated it." She looks around, gazing at the city in amazement, then stops herself. "Apologies. Now that I am not on duty, I often find myself distracted."
        
        "It's okay," you say, patting her side. "A bit of wonder never hurt."
    ]
rows.translation:
“太神奇了，”阿兰特轻声说道，“小时候，我常常怀疑Njorhaalt是否真的存在。这样的故事听起来太不可思议了——一座由冰构成的城市，里面住满了精灵。我还以为那是个神话罢了。”

    [party.has etheryn
        |“你本来可以问我的，你知道的，”伊瑟琳说道。
        
        “抱歉，伊瑟琳，”阿兰特说，“我不太擅长用言语表达，而且我觉得问你故乡是否真的存在，可能会显得很失礼。”她微笑着说，“孩子气的念头从成年人口中说出来，就没那么可爱了。那是一座奇妙的城市，你做得很好。”
        
        小琳露出了灿烂的笑容。“谢谢你。”
        |“我能理解，”你说，“我向你保证，它是真真切切存在的。”
        
        阿兰特微笑着说道：“要把你的头衔解读为‘冬城冠军’，其实也没有几种别的说法，但我原本以为会是没那么了不起的东西。真要说的话……那些故事反而还说轻了。”她环顾四周，惊叹地望着这座城市，随后又收住了自己，“抱歉。如今我不当值了，常常会走神。”
        
        “没关系，”你说着拍了拍她的身侧，“有点惊奇感从来都无妨。”
    ]

rows.original:
"Hmm," Alante murmurs.

    "What's wrong?" you ask.
    
    "Nothing. Only that I am realizing I am Minoan," Alante says, shaking her head. "Do not worry."
    
    You nod, and give her armored side a pat. "Home is where the heart is."
    
    She smiles. "An astute saying."
rows.translation:
“嗯，”阿兰特轻声说道。

    “怎么了？”你问道。
    
    “没什么。只是我意识到自己是米诺斯人，”阿兰特摇着头说，“别担心。”
    
    你点了点头，拍了拍她披甲的身侧。“家就是心之所在。”
    
    她笑了。“说得真有道理。”

rows.original:
Alante approaches you with a hint of nervousness about her. "[pc.name], may we talk?"
    
    "Of course," you say. "What's the problem?"
    
    "I do not think it a problem as such," she says slowly, "but... I believe I may be pregnant, [pc.mf
        |husband
        |wife
    ] mine."
    
    She blushes slightly as you light up, a shy smile appearing on her face.
    
    "Alante!" you say, throwing your arms around her in a hug. "That's amazing!" [pc.heightRange 0 94
        |You smile up at her,
        |You smile down at her,
    ] heart singing with joy. "You'll make an amazing mother."
    
    "I am already nervous," she admits. "There are so many things that could go wrong... but it does not help to think of them. First, I will try to remain healthy."
    
    You rub her back. "Don't worry, it'll be fine. You're as fit and healthy as can be. Our babies are going to be wonderful."
    
    Alante smiles. "I think so too. This will be... a big step, for me. This is truly a miracle. I am glad I will have you at my side for it."
    
    "Of course you will," you say, giving her a kiss. "Do you want to rest somewhere?"
    
    Alante shakes her head. "I am still capable of my duties. Perhaps more than that, I do not know if anywhere is safer than with you, [pc.mf
        |husband
        |wife
    ] mine."
    
    You laugh. "True. I'll keep you closer than ever, then."
    
    Alante lowers her head, her cheeks flushing red. "Thank you, [pc.name]."
    
    She stands alongside you with her spear, the perfect warrior, as ever.

阿兰特带着一丝紧张走近你。“[pc.name]，我们可以谈谈吗？”
    
    “当然可以，”你说道，“有什么问题吗？”
    
    “我觉得这本身不算什么问题，”她缓缓说道，“但是……我怀疑自己可能怀孕了，[pc.mf
        |丈夫
        |妻子
    ]我的。”
    
    当你喜形于色时，她的脸微微一红，脸上浮现出羞涩的微笑。
    
    “阿兰特！”你说道，一把搂住她抱在怀里，“这真是太棒了！”[pc.heightRange 0 94
        |你抬头微笑着看她，
        |你低头微笑着看她，
    ]心里满是欢欣。“你一定会成为一个了不起的母亲。”
    
    “我已经开始紧张了，”她承认道，“有太多事情可能出岔子……但想这些也没用。首先，我会尽量保持健康。”
    
    你轻抚她的背。“别担心，不会有事的。你身体健康、状态极佳。我们的孩子一定会很出色。”
    
    阿兰特微笑着。“我也是这么想的。这对我来说……会是一大步。这真是个奇迹。我很高兴能有你陪在我身边。”
    
    “当然会陪着你，”你说道，给了她一个吻，“你想去哪儿休息一下吗？”
    
    阿兰特摇了摇头。“我仍然能履行职责。而且，我不知道还有哪里比待在你身边更安全，[pc.mf
        |丈夫
        |妻子
    ]我的。”
    
    你笑了。“说得对。那我就把你守得比以往任何时候都紧。”
    
    阿兰特低下头，脸颊涨得通红。“谢谢你，[pc.name]。”
    
    她手持长矛站在你身旁，一如既往，是那位完美的战士。

rows.original: Alante huffs, and you glance over as she appears to murmur something to herself. "Everything okay?" you ask her. "Oh, yes," she says hastily. "It's just- that the babies are moving." You look down and sure enough, you can see movement in Alante's big, pregnancy-swollen stomach. Alante sighs as she looks down at herself. "Why are you moving so much?" she asks. "Are you uncomfortable?" You [pc.mascFem |chuckle |giggle ]. "Maybe they're turning over in bed." "If so, I wish they would pick a side to sleep on sooner... oofh," she mumbles. "They are quite indecisive." You stroke her side, gently rubbing Alante's warm, pregnant stomach. To your mild surprise, you can actually feel the movements from inside through your fingers. "Wow, they are moving around a lot." "Perhaps your touch will calm them," Alante says. "And if not, it does feel nice..." You massage your wife's stomach until the babies are calmed, resuming their restful sleep. You stand, and Alante smiles at you. "Thank you," she says. "It has been harder to get proper sleep, recently. I wonder if I was such a rambunctious baby myself." "It's not hard to imagine little Alante might have been a handful," you tease. You can just about see her in your mind's eye, wielding a stick as a kid. "Maybe it runs in the blood." She laughs. "Perhaps it does. I am starting to get excited to find out." Her tone of voice softens. "I do so want to meet them." "Me too," you say, patting her side. "Don't worry. We've got our whole lives to get to know them." Alante gives you a radiant smile. "Yes."

rows.original:
Your attention drifts towards your pregnant centaur wife. She's been silent a while, not that that's anything out of the ordinary – but you do want to be sure.
    
    "Are you okay, Alante?" you ask her. "The travel isn't bothering you?"
    
    She shakes her head. "I am fine as yet, [pc.mf
        |husband
        |wife
    ] mine. A centaur is very sturdy. We could walk all day and night and still I would not tire." She smiles. "I am not so delicate as to shatter at my first trial, you know."
    
    "I know," you say, patting her side. "I sometimes worry that if you were in trouble, though, that you might not be forthcoming about it."
    
    "I am not so weak as that," Alante says simply. "In becoming a soldier, one of the first things learned is to rely on others. It is that reliance, that reaching out to form links, that makes you as strong as you can be." She smiles. "So do not worry, [pc.mf
        |husband
        |wife
    ] mine. Should I experience difficulty, you will be the first to know."
    
    "Thanks," you say. "I guess I didn't need to worry."
    
    She giggles. "It seems to me you are worrying more than I am. I think the closer I get to birth, the less nervous I am becoming. It is mostly the excitement of finally getting to see them that I feel now."
    
    [pc.heightRange 0 94
        |You smile up at her
        |You smile down at her
    ]. "Our family."
    
    "Our family," Alante murmurs, leaning against you.

    Your attention drifts towards your pregnant centaur wife. She's been silent a while, not that that's anything out of the ordinary – but you do want to be sure.
    
    "Are you okay, Alante?" you ask her. "The travel isn't bothering you?"
    
    She shakes her head. "I am fine as yet, [pc.mf
        |husband
        |wife
    ] mine. A centaur is very sturdy. We could walk all day and night and still I would not tire." She smiles. "I am not so delicate as to shatter at my first trial, you know."
    
    "I know," you say, patting her side. "I sometimes worry that if you were in trouble, though, that you might not be forthcoming about it."
    
    "I am not so weak as that," Alante says simply. "In becoming a soldier, one of the first things learned is to rely on others. It is that reliance, that reaching out to form links, that makes you as strong as you can be." She smiles. "So do not worry, [pc.mf
        |husband
        |wife
    ] mine. Should I experience difficulty, you will be the first to know."
    
    "Thanks," you say. "I guess I didn't need to worry."
    
    She giggles. "It seems to me you are worrying more than I am. I think the closer I get to birth, the less nervous I am becoming. It is mostly the excitement of finally getting to see them that I feel now."
    
    [pc.heightRange 0 94
        |You smile up at her
        |You smile down at her
    ]. "Our family."
    
    "Our family," Alante murmurs, leaning against you.
    '

rows.original:
Alante has been close to giving birth for a while, now, and when it starts to happen you're ready for it. It only takes half an hour for her to go from entering labor to birthing two healthy young centaur children, a boy and a girl. You hold her hands throughout the entire process, calming and reassuring her until it's done.
    
    The children are washed and swaddled in fabrics to keep them warm and you stand alongside Alante who – true to form – is already up and about, standing over the children and looking none the worse for wear.
    
    Alante beams at you. "They are certainly strong and healthy."
    
    You smile at her. "Little miracles."
    
    "Look," Alante says, nodding at them.
    
    Already the boy is eschewing his blanket, shakily trying to rise to his hooves. The girl, upon seeing her brother, does the same. You watch with a smile as they push themselves up.
    
    [pc.heightRange 0 48
        |You lower yourself to their level – it doesn't take much – 
        |You kneel down 
    ]and kiss each of their foreheads.
    
    "Well done!" you say, lifting the blankets up again. "But don't forget these."
    
    You put the blankets back over their equine halves, guarding your children in the soft, comfortable wrappings. Alante giggles.
    
    "They look like little caravaneers," she says, lowering herself onto her knees and reaching out for them. "Don't you? Are you a merchant?"
    
    She gently rubs their heads, stroking her fingers through their tufty hair. Leaning forward, she plants a soft kiss on each of their foreheads, and the way they light up in happiness [pc.isDK
        |has you fighting the urge to choke
        |chokes you up for a moment
    ].
    
    "Have you thought of names?" you ask.
    
    "Theo, for Theophilus, and Sinead," Alante says. "I heard the name once and thought it was beautiful... what do you think, [pc.name]?"
    
    "They're [pc.mascFem
        |good names
        |wonderful
    ]," you say, smiling at them. "Hi, Theo. Hi, Sinead."
    
    You spend the next few hours sitting with your children, making sure they're warm and comfortable. Perhaps surprisingly, they don't cry at all, instead reaching out for their mother's milk with their little hands. After they're fed, cleaned, and clothed, you give them each a kiss before they go to sleep.
    
    "I suppose they are tired," Alante says, laughing softly. "It is the first time they have lived, after all."
    
    "It must be quite the experience," you agree. You look down at them in their oversized cots, curled up in blankets. "We've got so much to show them, still."
    
    Alante nods, her expression kind and warm as she regards them. "I have never been so happy, [pc.name]. For as long as I live, I will always be thankful to you."
    
    You rub her side. "All I ask is that you stay by my side."
    
    She raises her head to smile at you. "Forevermore."
    
    The two of you spend the night looking over Theo and Sinead, eventually falling asleep together with your children. Tomorrow is a new day for all of you.
rows.translation:
阿兰特已经快分娩一段时间了，当真正开始分娩的时候，你已经做好了准备。她仅仅用了半个小时，就从进入分娩阶段到生下两个健康的半人马幼崽，一男一女。在整个过程中，你都握着她的手，不断地安抚她，直到一切结束。

孩子们被洗干净后，用柔软的布料包裹起来以保持温暖，而你则站在阿拉兰特的身边。正如往常一样，她早已起床活动了，正站在孩子们身边，看起来丝毫没有受到任何影响。
    
    阿兰特朝你笑着说道：“它们确实既强壮又健康。”

你微笑着回应她：“真是些小奇迹啊。”

“看，”阿兰特指着那些生物说道。

那个小男孩已经开始试图摆脱毯子，摇摇晃晃地想要站起来。那个女孩看到她的哥哥后，也做了同样的事情。你微笑着看着他们一起努力站起来。
    
    [pc.heightRange 0 48
        |你降低了自己的身份去与他们同层次相处——其实这并不需要太多的努力。 
        |你跪了下来。 
    ]然后亲吻他们每个人的额头。

“干得好！”你说道，再次把毯子盖在他们身上，“不过别忘了这些。”

你把毯子重新盖在他们的身上，用这些柔软舒适的覆盖物保护着你的孩子们。阿兰特轻声笑了起来。

“他们看起来就像一群小小的商队成员呢，”她说着，跪了下来，伸手去抚摸它们。“不是吗？你们也是商人吗？”

她轻轻揉着它们的脑袋，手指在它们浓密的毛发间穿梭。她向前倾身，轻轻地在他们的额头上各吻了一下，看到他们脸上洋溢着的幸福神情，她的心里也充满了喜悦。 [pc.isDK
        |让你忍不住想要掐住对方的脖子……
        |会让你瞬间感到哽咽不已
    ]你考虑过名字吗？”你问道。

“西奥，代表Theophilus，还有西妮德，”阿兰特说，“我曾经听到过这个名字，觉得它很美……你觉得怎么样？ [pc.name]他们是[pc.mascFem
        |好名字
        |太棒了
    ]你们好，”你微笑着对他们说道，“嗨，西奥。嗨，西妮德。”

接下来的几个小时，你一直陪在孩子们身边，确保他们温暖舒适。也许有点出乎意料的是，他们竟然一点都没有哭闹，反而用他们的小手去寻找母亲的乳汁。在它们吃饱、洗干净、穿好衣服之后，你会在它们睡觉前给每一只都亲一下。

“我想它们一定很累了，”阿兰特轻声笑着说，“毕竟这是它们第一次真正地生活。”

“这种经历一定非常特别吧，”你表示同意。你低头看着他们，他们躺在那些过大的婴儿床里，裹着毯子蜷缩着。“我们还有很多东西要给他们看呢。”

阿兰特点了点头，她看着他们，脸上带着温柔而温暖的表情：“我从来没有这么开心过。 [pc.name]只要我活着，我就永远会感激你。”

你轻抚着她的侧脸：“我唯一的要求，就是你能留在我身边。”

她抬起头，对你微笑：“永远都会。”

你们俩一起守护着西奥和西妮德，直到深夜，最终和孩子们一起进入了梦乡。对你们所有人来说，明天都是一个新的开始。

rows.original:
You wash and clean up the next day and Alante nods at you outside, in her armor and holding her spear. Her thoughts are written on her face, like a raincloud hovering over her.
        
        "We can and will visit them often," you reassure her.
        
        "I am loathe to leave them at all. But our efforts to save the Kingdom, and the land at large, are the most important thing we can do for them," she says. "For everyone, for every family." She bows her head. "So we must."
        
        You take her helmeted head in your hands and kiss her gently, wiping away her sullen tears in amiable silence.
        
        "I will mourn the time lost after we are finished," Alante murmurs. "For now, we must harden our hearts."
        
        "Well said," you say. "Don't worry. We'll deliver them a world they can grow up in."
        
        She smiles. "For their future, then."
rows.translation:
第二天，你洗漱干净；阿兰特身穿铠甲、手持长矛，在屋外向你点头。她的心事全写在脸上，如同一片阴云悬在头顶。
        
        “我们可以、也一定会经常来看他们，”你安慰她。
        
        “我根本不愿离开他们。可努力拯救王国、乃至整片大地，才是我们能为他们做的最重要的事，”她说道。“为了所有人，为了每一个家庭。”她垂下头。“所以我们必须离开。”
        
        你用双手捧住她戴着头盔的脑袋，温柔地吻了她，在亲密的沉默中拭去她伤感的泪水。
        
        “等一切结束，我会为失去的时光哀悼，”阿兰特低声说道。“现在，我们必须硬起心肠。”
        
        “说得好，”你说道。“别担心。我们会为他们带来一个能够平安长大的世界。”
        
        她微微一笑。“那么，为了他们的未来。”
