rows.original: As of late, you've felt somewhat nauseous when you move too quickly. A sign of some illness, perhaps, were it not for the fact there's a far likelier explanation given your proclivities. Not to mention your taut, rounding stomach, taking on a curve that speaks to more than something as simple as eating habits. You're certain of it – you're pregnant. And what's more, with a very large race – so large, in fact, that there's only one possible culprit. You glance at Alante, your beautiful and faithful centaur wife. She certainly has been giving it to you recently, and it's no real surprise that her heroic efforts have come to fruition. You catch her gaze and smile, beckoning her closer. She trots over, ears perked. "[pc.name]. Is everything well?" "More than well," you say, leaning in[pc.heightRange 0 90 | [pc.hasToes |and standing on your tiptoes to murmur in her ear ] | to murmur in her ear ]. "I'm pregnant, Alante. And they're your babies." Alante recoils a moment, clear surprise written across her face before she breaks into a huge smile. "[pc.name]! That is wonderful!" She bounds forward, catching you in a firm hug against her chest. "Oh, I am so happy! I can hardly believe it!" You laugh, embracing her in turn and giving her a happy kiss on the cheek. "It's true! [pc.mf |You're going to be a mother. |We're going to be mothers. ]" "This is truly a miracle," Alante says, carefully lowering you to the ground. "I will be at your side every step of the way, [pc.mf |husband |wife ] mine." "Aw, thanks," you say, smiling at her. "I'm lucky to have you around, Alante. Our children will be so happy to meet you." Her expression softens, her eyes growing misty. "Yes... I can hardly wait to meet them, myself. I will endeavor to keep you as safe as possible, [pc.name] – though you are very formidable in your own right." "I appreciate the acknowledgement," you say. "Don't worry, we'll be fine." Alante nods – but you do notice she's sticking closer to you than ever. You hide a smile, walking alongside your wife in her shining armor.
rows.translation: 最近，当你移动得太快时，会感到一阵恶心。这或许是某种疾病的征兆，不过考虑到你的生活习惯，还有更合理的解释。更不用说你那紧绷、逐渐隆起的腹部，其弧度所暗示的可不只是简单的饮食习惯。 你对此十分确信——你怀孕了。而且，孩子来自一个体型极其巨大的种族；事实上，大到只可能有一个元凶。 你瞥了一眼阿兰特，你那美丽而忠诚的半人马妻子。她最近确实一直在宠幸你，也难怪她英勇的努力终于有了成果。你迎上她的目光，微笑着示意她靠近。 她小跑着过来，耳朵竖了起来。“[pc.name]，一切都好吗？” “好得不得了，”你一边说，一边向前倾了倾身子。[pc.heightRange 0 90 | [pc.hasToes |甚至要踮起脚尖，在她耳边低语 ] | 在她耳边低语 ]。“我怀孕了，阿兰特。这些孩子都是你的。” 阿兰特愣了一下，脸上明显写满了惊讶，但很快便绽开了灿烂的笑容。“[pc.name]！这真是太棒了！”她扑上前来，将你紧紧搂在胸前。“哦，我太开心了！简直不敢相信！” 你笑着也回抱了她，在她的脸颊上愉快地亲了一下。“是真的！[pc.mf |你就要当妈妈了。 |我们即将成为母亲了。 ]” “这真是个奇迹，”阿兰特说着，小心地将你放到地上。“我会一路陪伴在你身边，[pc.mf |丈夫 |妻子 ]我的。” “啊，谢谢，”你微笑着对她说，“有你在身边，我真的很幸运。我们的孩子们见到你一定会非常高兴的。” 她的表情变得柔和起来，眼中泛起了泪光。“是啊……我自己也迫不及待想见到他们。我会竭尽全力保证你的安全，[pc.name]——不过你本身就已经非常强大了。” “我很感谢你的认可，”你说，“别担心，我们会没事的。” 阿兰特点了点头——但你注意到，她现在比以往任何时候都更紧贴在你身边。你忍住笑意，与身着闪亮铠甲的妻子并肩前行。

rows.original: "Ooh," you mumble, putting a hand to your stomach. The babies are moving, and they are big. Your belly is distended already, swollen to the point of a human woman at nine months. "Are you getting comfortable?" Alante trots over, concern on her face. "Are you alright, [pc.name]?" "I'm fine," you assure her. "Our children are just indecisive about how to lie down." Alante looks down at your stomach, which ripples for a moment as an errant arm or leg pushes out against your skin. You wince. "May I...?" Alante offers. "Go right ahead," you say, and she extends her arm towards you. "Maybe you touching them will calm them down." Your wife gently massages your stomach until the babies are calmed, and you sigh in happiness at her touch. It does feel nice to be pampered a little. When you open your eyes again, Alante is smiling at you. "Thank you," you say, putting your hand on top of her own. "They've been a little restless lately." "I wonder if I was such a rambunctious baby," she says. "It's not hard to imagine little Alante might have been a handful," you tease. You can just about see her in your mind's eye, wielding a stick as a kid. "Maybe it runs in the blood." She laughs. "Perhaps it does. I am starting to get excited to find out." Her tone of voice softens. "I do so want to meet them." "Me too," you say, gently interlocking your fingers with hers. "Don't worry. We've got our whole lives to get to know them." Alante gives you a radiant smile. "Yes."
rows.translation: “哦，”你喃喃道，同时把手放在肚子上。孩子们正在动来动去，而且他们很大。你的肚子已经鼓了起来，胀得就像一个怀孕九个月的人类女性。“你待得舒服吗？” 阿兰特小跑过来，脸上带着担忧：“你还好吗，[pc.name]？” “我没事，”你向她保证道，“只是我们的孩子们还拿不定主意该怎么躺。” 阿兰特低头看着你的肚子，那里的皮肤因为一条胳膊或腿胡乱顶出而起伏了一下。你皱起了眉头。 “可以吗……？”阿兰特问道。 “请便，”你说着，她向你伸出手臂，“也许你摸摸它们，能让它们安静下来。” 你的妻子轻轻按摩着你的肚子，直到孩子们安静下来；你在她的抚摸下幸福地叹了口气。被宠爱一下的感觉确实不错。当你再次睁开眼睛时，阿兰特正微笑着看着你。 “谢谢你，”你说着，把手覆在她的手上，“它们最近有点闹腾。” “我在想，我小时候是不是也这么闹腾，”她说。 “不难想象，小阿兰特当年肯定也让人头疼，”你逗她。你几乎能在脑海中看见她小时候挥舞着棍子的模样。“也许这是血脉里传下来的。” 她笑了。“也许吧。我开始期待知道答案了。”她的语气柔和下来。“我真的很想见见他们。” “我也是，”你说着，轻轻与她十指相扣，“别担心。我们有一辈子的时间去了解他们。” 阿兰特给了你一个灿烂的笑容。“是的。”

rows.original: Alante speaks to you out of the blue, her voice soft. "Are you okay, [pc.name]? The travel isn't bothering you?" "I am fine," you say, smiling at her. "A little waylaid, admittedly. rows.translation:
[var0
        |在经历了温室里相对较高的温度之后，这个中庭显得格外凉爽宜人。米诺斯人交谈时的喧闹声再次进入你的意识边缘，周围的一切活动也重新充满了热闹的气氛——人们有的坐在长凳上讨论元老院的最新动态，有的在锻炼身体，有的在吃饭，还有的在参加拔河比赛。在这里，几乎唯一没有发生的、还算合乎礼仪的行为就是洗澡了！
        
        那些站在大理石区域后面的服务员都在聊着天，不过这也无所谓——根据你上次遇到的那位男士的说法，这里确实是免费开放的。你可以想象，当选举来临时，那位为所有人支付费用的参议员一定会在选民中受到极大的欢迎。
        
        这个房间有几条出口，但只有其中几条通向浴室…… 你是这么认为的吧。
        |你[party.som
            | 走进去
            |以及[party.compNames]一起走进来
            |， [party.compNames]直接进入
        ]以及[flags.KM_BATHS_VISITED
            |可以看出，虽然人们已经变了，但这里的氛围依然没有改变。人们坐在长凳上讨论参议院的最新动态，有些人在锻炼，有些人在吃饭，还有些人在进行掰手腕比赛。唯一没有在这里发生的、还算比较文明的行为，大概就是洗澡了吧！
            
            那些站在大理石台阶后面的服务员都在聊着天，不过这也无所谓——根据你上次遇到的那位男士的说法，这里确实是免费入场的。你可以想象，那位参议员为所有人支付入场费，那么在选举来临的时候，他肯定会在选民中赢得极大的支持。
            
            这个房间里有几条出口，不过你认为，只有其中几条能通往浴室……
            |环顾四周，尽管你本不该感到惊讶，但这个地方的规模还是让你有些吃惊。中庭非常大，里面到处都是正在交谈或休闲的人们。你原本不确定浴场会是什么样子，但实际情况却与你的想象有所不同。……就是这个。
            
            一些弥诺陶洛斯正利用悬挂的横杆、把手和吊环在墙边锻炼，而其他人则在一旁聊天。到处都是穿着托加袍的人，他们或在谈论自己生活中的种种琐事，或在讨论这座城市的情况；其中有一个小组还在热烈地讨论元老院某位成员的政策。感觉就像你来到了一个根本不提供酒水的酒吧。[party.has brienne
                |
                
                这里真不错，”布蕾妮说着转过头来，“这个地方可是米诺斯社区的支柱啊。”她用指关节轻轻敲了敲那根支撑拱门的柱子。“很多人来这里并不是为了洗澡，或者至少不仅仅是为了这个目的。在这里闲逛聊天其实是很常见的。不过我听说这里的浴场很不错……可能比我以前去过的那些都要好。
                
                “这里就像一个社区中心，”你说。
                
                她点了点头：“这里的沐浴文化非常盛行。很多人每天都会去泡澡，既是为了保持清洁，也是为了放松身心。你应该去那里付款然后进入浴室。”
                
                她指着一个凸起的大理石区域，那里有几名服务员站在那里，他们中的大多数正在和一些弥诺陶洛斯以及一些女牛仔聊天。
            ][party.has brint
                |
                
                真是个不错的地方，”布林特说着转过头来，“浴室其实是米诺斯文明社会的重要组成部分。”他用指关节轻敲着一根支撑拱门的柱子。“有时候人们来这里并不是为了洗澡，只是为了放松一下而已。据我所听，那里的浴场环境相当不错。至少比我去过的其他浴场都要好。”
                
                “它就像一个社区中心，”你说。
                
                他点了点头。这里的沐浴文化非常盛行。很多人每天都会去泡澡，既是为了保持清洁，也是为了放松身心。你应该去那里付款然后进入浴室。”
                
                他指着一个凸起的大理石区域，那里有几名服务员站在后面，他们中的大多数正在和一些弥诺陶洛斯以及一些女牛仔聊天。
            ][party.has brint brienne
                |
                |那里有一块凸起的大理石区域，几名服务员站在那里，其中大多数人正在与一些弥诺陶洛斯以及几名女牛仔交谈。
            ]你走过去，向其中一位工作人员点了点头，引起了他的注意。他对你笑了笑，然后俯身在桌子上说道：
            
            “嘿，欢迎来到公共浴场。入场是免费的，这要感谢Khel'salak的慷慨。
            
            谁？”你问道。
            
            “哈哈！Khel'salak是一位参议员，他非常希望你们知道他的身份，”服务员笑着说，“那个疯狂的kenat为接下来几个月内所有前来这里的人支付了入场费，直到参议院选举结束。他摇了摇头：“真无法想象，他那些葡萄园肯定让他赚了多少钱——没有其他参议员会做出这种事来。”
            
            “我想我也没理由抱怨了，”你说道。我想我无论如何都无法投票吧。”
            
            “嗯，别担心，”他说，“如果你想的话，可以进去。那里是男女混浴的场所。 [party.solo
                |只是想让你知道而已。”他眨了眨眼，“现在可别感到惊讶哦。
                |这样你和你的朋友们就可以一起进去了。
            ]
            
            你注意到这个房间里有多个出口，但似乎只有一个通向浴室。墙壁上到处都是描绘竞技场战斗场景的艺术作品，还有相关的广告。真是有趣。
        ]
    ]

rows.original: Take Arona bathing, and spend some quality time with your beloved orc.
rows.translation: 带着阿罗娜去洗澡，与你心爱的兽人共度一段美好的时光吧。
rows.raw: "Take Arona bathing, and spend some quality time with your beloved orc."

rows.original: You need to bring Arona around again to have fun with her here.
rows.translation: 你得再把阿罗娜带过来，这样你们才能在这里一起开心地玩耍。
rows.raw: "You need to bring Arona around again to have fun with her here."

rows.original: An orc barbarian and the elvenqueen make for strange bedfellows, but you love those two all the same. Spend a little quality time soaking with them both.
rows.translation: 一个兽人野蛮人与一位精灵女王竟结成了奇异同盟，但你依然同样爱着她们两个。不妨花点时间，和她们一起泡个澡，共度一段美好时光。
rows.raw: "An orc barbarian and the elvenqueen make for strange bedfellows, but you love those two all the same. Spend a little quality time soaking with them both."

rows.original: You need to bring Arona and Ryn around together to have fun with them here.
rows.translation: 你需要把阿罗娜和小琳带到这里来，和她们一起享受乐趣。
rows.raw: "You need to bring Arona and Ryn around together to have fun with them here."

rows.original: Get a massage courtesy of the cowgirls.
rows.translation: 由这些女牛仔为您提供按摩服务。
rows.raw: "Get a massage courtesy of the cowgirls."

rows.original: Arona wanted to come to the Bath House with you — spend some quality time with the big orc.
rows.translation: 阿罗娜想和你一起去浴场——去和这个大块头兽人共度一段美好时光吧。
rows.raw: "Arona wanted to come to the Bath House with you — spend some quality time with the big orc."

rows.original: [flags.TARANDRA_MET|Tarandra's on her own again, brushing her hair on a bench.|There's a diminutive wyld elf sitting by herself, grooming her hair. You notice she's wearing a loincloth — not a skirt — which means she must be at least half-sex, if you understood the dress code.]
rows.translation: [flags.TARANDRA_MET|塔兰德拉又独自一人了，她坐在长椅上梳着自己的头发。|有个身材娇小的荒野精灵独自坐着，正在整理自己的头发。你注意到她穿着一条缠腰布——而不是裙子——这意味着，如果你了解这里的着装规范的话，她至少属于半性别的存在。]
rows.raw: "[flags.TARANDRA_MET|Tarandra's on her own again, brushing her hair on a bench.|There's a diminutive wyld elf sitting by herself, grooming her hair. You notice she's wearing a loincloth — not a skirt — which means she must be at least half-sex, if you understood the dress code.]"

rows.original:
The air here is cooler than that of the teyarium, and it's a welcome change. You feel refreshed as you walk inside and take a look around, noting the pools of varying sizes and depths. The construction is fairly impressive – you can't help but wonder how much work went into this.

    It looks like there's a smaller, unaccompanied changing room here so you can put proper swimwear on.
    
    [var1|There's a big, muscular lizardfolk boy swimming laps through one of the lanes. [var0|Looks like he just got here.|Looks like he's been at it for a while.]]
rows.translation:
这里的空气比温室里的要凉爽许多，这种变化真是令人感到愉悦。当你走进去环顾四周时，会注意到那些大小和深度各不相同的泳池。这里的建筑风格相当令人印象深刻——你不禁会想，建造这样一个地方究竟耗费了多少人力和物力。

    看起来这里还设有一个较小的更衣室，你可以在那里换上合适的泳装。
    
    [var1|有一个身材高大、肌肉结实的蜥蜴人男孩正在其中一条泳道里来回游着。 [var0|看起来他刚到这儿。|看起来他已经游了好一会儿了。]]

rows.original:
Steam billows around you from the moment you step foot in the saldarium, the air several degrees hotter than the mild room you just came from and noticeably muggy. It's quite a plain room, the intended purpose obvious. [flags.KM_BATHS_SALDARIUM
        |
        |[party.has brint
            |
            
            "Whew. This'll be the room directly above the furnace," Brint says. "Love spending an hour or two in here on days I didn't do much. Nothing better."
            
            [pc.isBimbo
                |"All I wanna do in here is like, lie back and be a vegetable," you say, happily imagining some broccoli simmering in hot water. "Mmm."
                
                Brint chuckles and pats your head. "That's what it's for, [brint.isDaddy
                    |[pc.mf
                        |babe
                        |babygirl
                    ]
                    |
                    [pc.name]
                ], so enjoy."
                |"Feels like it'd be conducive to lying back and doing absolutely nothing for a while," you say.
                
                Brint chuckles. "Yeah, pretty much."
            ]
        ][party.has brienne
            |
            
            "Woo, that's warm," Brienne says. "I used to spend an hour or two in here on days I didn't get much done. Great for your skin, I hear."
            
            [pc.isBimbo
                |"All I wanna do in here is like, lie back and be a vegetable," you say, happily imagining some broccoli simmering in hot water. "Mmm."
                
                Brienne giggles. "That's what it's for."
                |"Feels like it'd be conducive to lying back and doing absolutely nothing for a while," you say.
                
                "Yup!" Brienne says, smiling. "That's what it's for."
            ]
        ]
    ]
    
    There's a basin here containing what you deem to be cold water, and a chiselled depiction next to it of a minotaur dumping it over his head as he leaves. Looks like it's for cooling yourself off when you've had enough... that's handy.
    
    At the other end of the room is a great four-sided pool with stairs leading down into it. There's people relaxing all over – some with just their legs in, some sitting on the stairs, and others up to their heads. Looks like there's no wrong way to enjoy this place.
    
    [var0
        |[flags.NOIRE_MET
            |You spy Noire in a shallow corner of the pool, soaking in the heat with a towel balanced between her horns with the water up to her neck. With how short she is and how the baths are minotaur-sized, she's content with as much.
            |You spy a sheepgirl in a shallow corner of the pool, soaking in the heat with a towel balanced between her horns with the water up to her neck. Either she's very short in a city of minotaurs, or she's sitting on the bottom.
        ]
        |[flags.NOIRE_MET
            |There's an empty space by the shallow end of the pool where you know Noire ought to be. Mentally, you remind yourself that the sheepgirl only shows up in the evening.
            |You hear some talk about a cute sheepgirl who shows up in the evening for a long soak in the heat, starting about five in the afternoon. Apparently a bath employee who likes making use of the facilities?
        ]
    ]
    
    [var1
        |[flags.ARILLE_MET
            |Arille is here. Between the way she comports herself and the fact everyone avoids being in her space or even looking at her, you get the impression she must be someone important. Right now, though, all she's doing is reclining in the pool.
            |There's a beautiful caramel cowgirl reclined in the pool. Despite her obvious attractiveness she's not getting any attention – in fact it seems like everyone is actively avoiding her, though you can't narrow down the reason. She looks you over, and you get the distinct feeling you're the first person she's even glanced at in a while.
        ]
        |[flags.ARILLE_MET
            |Arille's not here, though the space she usually relaxes in is empty nonetheless. People are staying clear of it in somewhat amusing fashion, leaving a conspicuous space. You're sure she'll be here a few hours before midnight, looking to relax and unwind.
            |There's a conspicuous space in the pool people are avoiding, as though it's reserved for someone – possibly someone important. Maybe if you came back a few hours before midnight you'd meet her.
        ]
    ]
    
    [var2

[brint.isBrienne
            |"... Mom?" Brienne calls as you shut the door behind you. "Mom, I'm back."
            
            "Rina?" a feminine voice calls from deeper in the house. "I thought you were- oh."
            
            You come face to face with what could only be described as an incredibly voluptuous horned woman, a white toga just barely covering her enormous breasts.
            
            "Oh!" she says, surprised. "I wasn't expecting her to have company over. Where's..." she trails off, looking up at Brienne. "Wait..." Reaching up, she places her hands on Brienne's cheeks and gazes at her with faint comprehension. "Are you..."
            
            "Hi mom," Brienne says, smiling. "You have a second daughter now."
            
            "Your eyes," Brienne's mother whispers, her face wrinkling as tears begin to flow. "Is that really you?"
            
            Brienne nods, the two women throwing their arms around each other and embracing fiercely while you smile on. Looks like her family did miss her after all.
            |"Mom?" Brint calls as you shut the door behind you. "Mom, you around?"
            
            "What?" a confused feminine voice calls from deeper in the house, and you hear hooves approaching from a hallway.
            
            You come face to face with what could only be described as an incredibly voluptuous horned woman, a white toga fitted around one of her enormous breasts and leaving the other totally bared, displaying a large golden doorknocker piercing hanging from her dark brown nipple.
            
            "Oh!" she says, surprised. "Hello, I..." she trails off, looking up at your minotaur companion and gasping. "Brint?"
            
            "Hi mom," Brint says, smiling. "I'm back."
            
            "Oh," she whispers, tearing up. "Oh my god, it's really you."
            
            Brint nods, putting his arms around his mother as she throws hers around him, embracing fiercely while you smile on. Looks like his family did miss him after all.
        ]

rows.original:
[brint.isBrienne
                    |You sit down and eat a pleasant meal with Brienne and Cassia, chatting over the food and learning about the people Brienne grew up with. It's a small world in the village, you're gathering. Cassia knows a lot about the lives of the other people living here, right down to their relationships and how things are doing at home.
                    
                    "You're going to be a very popular topic for the next week," she informs the both of you.
                    
                    "Agh," Brienne says, pressing her lips together. "It's okay. They won't even know who I am until after I leave."
                    
                    "Do you have to leave so soon?" Cassia says, reaching her hands out imploringly. "I only just got to catch up with my darling daughter."
                    
                    "We'll be back," Brienne says, smiling as she places her palms in her mother's. "Don't worry, mom. I'll try to keep in touch."
                    
                    "[pc.name]," Cassia says after dinner, catching you while Brienne is elsewhere in the house. "I just want to thank you for bringing her home. Thank you so much." She wraps her arms around you, hugging you tight and pressing her head into your shoulder, carefully avoiding poking you with her horns. "I didn't think I would ever even see her again."
                    
                    "Happy to help," you say, rubbing her back. "I'm glad I brought her here too, Cassia. Thanks for being such a good host."
                    
                    "You are welcome," she replies, pulling back and smiling graciously. "Come back here any time, [pc.name]. Even just to say hello on your lonesome. I'd be happy to have you."
                    
                    With that, you and Brienne leave Cassia behind with some parting hugs and walk back out to the road.
                    
                    "That's a weight off my shoulders I didn't even know I had," Brienne says, laughing a little. "Thanks, [pc.name]... I'm glad you're here with me." She leans closer to kiss you on the cheek, wrapping an affectionate arm around your waist.
                    
                    "No problem," you say, smiling. "We'll have to go back and see her again."
                    
                    "Mmhm," she says, nodding. "It'd be nice if you got closer to mom and Rina..."

rows.original: Go to eat with the family.

[brint.isBrienne |"What's Rina like?" you ask. "Seems like you guys used to be close." She nods. "She was always the little sister I kept out of trouble. She liked playing sports with the boys... and she was really unhappy when puberty happened and they all shot up and she didn't. Suddenly the boys don't want to play because they're afraid of hurting her. She hated that." "Right, I can imagine," you say. "Puts me in an awkward spot..." Brienne trails off, ears drooping. "I doubt there's a woman in the city that can play with the boys as well as you can," you admit. After a moment of thought, you go on. "I don't think she'll resent you for it, though. You're her big sister, and I think she's more wrapped up in how cool you are to her than she is about her own opportunities. Think about it. You're like her idol." "You think so?" she says. "I bet the first thing that happens when we go out there is she asks you about kicking butt with me," you say. "Haha," Brienne chuckles, smiling a little. "I think she's just as interested in you. That'll be fun." "If I get involved with your sister..." you start. "I'm all for it," Brienne says. "I know you, [pc.name]." She grins. "It should be you instead of a boy from the city. Not to mention it would be really hot..." |"What's Rina like?" you ask. "You seem like friends." He nods. "She was always the little sister I kept out of trouble. 'Specially 'cause she liked playing sports with the boys. She was pretty unhappy when puberty happened and they all shot up and she didn't, and suddenly they didn't want to play 'cause they didn't want to hurt her. She hated that." "Yeah... cowgirl playing sports with minotaurs, there's gonna be some differences," you muse. "Right. Well, she hates being condescended to even more than she hates losing, so eventually she stopped," Brint says. "She seems a bit girlier now — probably mom's best efforts — but I'm pretty sure all she wants is to keep playing sports. But hey." He shrugs. "It's been a while." "She's nice," you say. "Really friendly." "Yeah, she's always been like that," he says. "Rina's really good at making friends." Brint winks at you. "Treat my sister right if you get involved with her." "The thought of that doesn't bother you?" you ask. "[pc.mf |Nah, man |No way ]," he laughs. "It'd be real shit of me to show up after a year or two of being gone and pretend like I was 'protecting' her. She's grown, she can do what she wants. 'Sides, I've been with you this whole time. It'll be fine." ] That's as good an endorsement as any.

rows.original: "What's your relationship with your mom like?" you ask. Rina sighs. "It's a little stifling, but she's a good person." "Heh," you say, smiling. "That's pretty much what [brint.isBrienne|Brienne|Brint] said, too." "Yeeeaaahhh... I'm not surprised [brint.heShe] left," she says, grimacing. "Mom's just a bit too involved. I mean, I get it, after dad left we're all she's got, but still. I do need some space and all. Hard to get any here, living with your mom. 'Specially mine." "No suitors knocking on your door to take you away?" you ask with a grin. "Oh no, I've had a bunch of offers," Rina grumbles. "Plenty of boys want to stick it in the runner girl." "Well, you are really pretty, Rina," you say, smiling. "They probably can't help themselves." "Thanks," she says, smiling at you and running a hand through her hair. "I just, I dunno. I don't want to have a baby while I'm still trying so hard to be the best, you know? I want to run in the Olympiad against Orlante..." she trails off, looking at the flowers she's been slacking on watering. "I dunno. I guess the right [pc.mf|guy|guy... or girl? I dunno. I guess the right person] could come along and change my mind." Rina shrugs. "Never really been any good at planning ahead." "Plans don't tend to survive contact with the future," you say, winking at her. "Don't tell your mom I said that. Adventurers are all irresponsible, don't look to us for advice." "Haha!" Rina says, smiling wide. "I'm gonna remember that. Plans don't survive contact with the future. That's clever." "Yeah. Remember me when you're thinking about doing something stupid," you say with a laugh.
rows.translation: “你和你妈妈的关系怎么样？”你问道。 莉娜叹了口气：“有点让人透不过气，不过她是个好人。” “呵呵，”你笑着说，“[brint.isBrienne|布蕾妮|布林特]差不多也是这么说的。” “耶——我一点也不意外[brint.heShe]会离开，”她苦着脸说，“妈妈就是管得太多了。我明白，爸爸走后我们就成了她的全部，可我还是需要一点自己的空间。跟妈妈住在一起，这地方本来就很难有空间，尤其是我妈这种。” “难道没有追求者敲你的门，想把你带走吗？”你咧嘴笑着问道。 “哦，得了吧，我收到过一大堆这样的提议呢，”莉娜嘟囔着说，“好多男孩都想约那个跑步的女孩出去。” “不过你确实很漂亮，莉娜，”你微笑着说，“他们大概是控制不住自己吧。” “谢谢，”她笑着对你说道，顺手捋了捋头发，“我只是……我也不知道。我还在拼命想成为最优秀的那个人，现在还不想生孩子，你明白吗？我想去参加奥林匹亚竞技会，和奥兰特一较高下……”她的声音低了下去，目光落在那些她一直疏于浇水的花上。“我也不确定。也许那个[pc.mf|男人|男人……还是女人？我也不确定，我觉得合适的人]会出现，让我改变主意吧。”莉娜耸了耸肩，“我从来就不擅长提前做计划。” “计划往往一碰到未来就撑不住了，”你对她眨了眨眼说，“别告诉你妈妈这话是我说的。冒险者全都是些不负责任的人，别指望我们能给你什么建议。” “哈哈！”莉娜笑得很开心，“我会记住的——计划一碰到未来就撑不住了。这话真妙。” “没错。以后你想干什么蠢事的时候，记得想想我。”你笑着说。

rows.original: [flags.RINA_TRAIN 1 2 3 4 |"Well, there's two of us," you say. "How about we get some training in together and pull some weeds afterwards?" Rina does a double-take, her eyes growing wider. "Really? You wanna?" "Sure, why not?" you say, giving her a smile. "Might as well do it now instead of being distracted. Get all that energy out before we calm down a bit and get the gardening done." "Aw, yeah!" Rina says, pumping her fist. "Let's go, then. I usually just run down to the fence and back a few times with some breaks in between." You squint across the property. That's a good hundred-something yards — looks decent for a challenge. You line up with Rina and the moment she says "Go!", she shoots off like an arrow through the air. Oh, so that's how she trains — you'd mistakenly thought she might pace herself, but it looks like she's going to be sprinting the whole time. Well, two can play at that game. Breaking into a sprint yourself, you chase after Rina and end up a couple of yards behind her by the time she's touching the fence and doubling back. "What!" she gasps, doing a double-take when she sees you right behind her. "Hmm!" Rina puts her head down and pushes off the fence as you reach it, barreling away back towards the starting point. By the time she's halfway there you've caught up and by the time she reaches the 'line', you've nudged ahead of her. Stopping and returning to the line you and the cowgirl take a seat on the grass, sweaty and breathing hard in the wake of the exercise. "Jeez," Rina pants. "You'd kick all our butts in athletics." "Perks of being an adventurer," you say. "Can't afford not to take training seriously." "Huh," she says, turning that over in her mind. "Guess having something at stake does matter." "Do the other girls compete as hard as you do?" you ask her. "Nah," Rina says, laughing a bit. "But they're nice. They want me to represent the team at the colosseum. Lots of runners from all over the districts compete there. Let's take a break for a couple minutes before we do that again." You break the ice with Rina in between running — working hard together does that, you've found. She's growing more comfortable with you, though she's still bummed out you're as fast as she is despite her training. "Oof," she says, collapsing onto her back and spreadeagling across the grass after your third run. "Maybe I shoulda been an adventurer instead of a runner." "It's not all fun and games," you say, smiling. "Probably fifty percent fun and games and fifty percent fighting for my life. Gets pretty dangerous out there." "Yeah, you're right," Rina sighs. "I'm just romanticizing it in my head, I guess. I'm pretty lucky just to be doing what I am... living at home and helping mom. Speaking of... should probably get to those weeds." "Right," you agree. "Thanks for helping me out, [pc.name]," she says, tugging some deep-rooted weeds out of the dirt and patting it flat again. "You didn't have to bother." "Nah, it's fun spending time with you," you say, picking at some roots. The majority of them aren't even hard to pull out, it's just that there's so many. "Might as well pay your mom back for the privilege. God knows I've eaten enough of her food." "Haha! True," Rina says, smiling. "Thanks." You uproot a bunch of weeds that you toss in a basket, working for an hour or so before Rina stretches out and yawns. "That's enough for tod- wow, that's more than enough," she says, glancing at the contents of the basket. "That side won't need weeding any time soon. You're making me look like a slacker over here!" "Must be the adventuring," you quip. "Snrk! Yeah, I'll bet," Rina says with a grin. "Let's go get rid of this and get something to eat." |"Wanna get some more training in?" you say. "Heck yeah," Rina says, smiling. "Let's run!" You train with Rina, stretching your legs and keeping her close to ensure her pace. You take a little rest afterwards, [brienne.around |patting Brienne on the butt as you pass her by to bring her little sister some water |giving Brint a [brint.fucked|kiss|nod] as you pass him by to bring his little sister some water ]. Settling down next to her, you take a drink from your glass as she gulps down hers and lets out a big sigh. "Whew. You'd be a good athletics trainer, [pc.name]," Rina says, laying down on her back. "I guess I really need the competition to get the most out of myself." "It helps," you say. "Everything's easier with friends." "Yeah," she says. "I haven't seen my club in a while now. Kinda hard to meet up when everything in the city's so hectic... I dunno when things are gonna go back to normal, either." "Well, that's part of why I'm here," you say, smiling down at her. "Hopefully I can help everything get back to normal." "Really?" Rina says. "Wow." She looks at the city in the distance, at the buildings rising above the gleaming walls on mountains of earth and stone. "I guess you really are a big deal, then. I..." she trails off, hesitating, then sighs. "I dunno if I want to be in Khor'minos when it goes back to normal or not." "Thinking about the future?" you say. "Got any ideas?" "Well... I can get married, or find someone who wants an apprentice," Rina says. "There's been a lot of people moving around in the job market and stuff. I guess because of the quarantine, I don't know. I don't know anything about that stuff." She brushes a hand up her face, sighing again. "Growing up sucks." She looks to you. "Did you know what you were gonna do when you were growing up? All my friends just want to find a nice guy and settle down." Get all that energy out before we calm down a bit and get the gardening done." "Aw, yeah!" Rina says, pumping her fist. "Let's go, then. I usually just run down to the fence and back a few times with some breaks in between." You squint across the property. That's a good hundred-something yards — looks decent for a challenge. You line up with Rina and the moment she says "Go!", she shoots off like an arrow through the air. Oh, so that's how she trains — you'd mistakenly thought she might pace herself, but it looks like she's going to be sprinting the whole time. Well, two can play at that game. Breaking into a sprint yourself, you chase after Rina and end up a couple of yards behind her by the time she's touching the fence and doubling back. "What!" she gasps, doing a double-take when she sees you right behind her. "Hmm!" Rina puts her head down and pushes off the fence as you reach it, barreling away back towards the starting point. By the time she's halfway there you've caught up and by the time she reaches the 'line', you've nudged ahead of her. Stopping and returning to the line you and the cowgirl take a seat on the grass, sweaty and breathing hard in the wake of the exercise. "Jeez," Rina pants. "You'd kick all our butts in athletics." "Perks of being an adventurer," you say. "Can't afford not to take training seriously." "Huh," she says, turning that over in her mind. "Guess having something at stake does matter." "Do the other girls compete as hard as you do?" you ask her. "Nah," Rina says, laughing a bit. "But they're nice. They want me to represent the team at the colosseum. Lots of runners from all over the districts compete there. Let's take a break for a couple minutes before we do that again." You break the ice with Rina in between running — working hard together does that, you've found. She's growing more comfortable with you, though she's still bummed out you're as fast as she is despite her training. "Oof," she says, collapsing onto her back and spreadeagling across the grass after your third run. "Maybe I shoulda been an adventurer instead of a runner." "It's not all fun and games," you say, smiling. "Probably fifty percent fun and games and fifty percent fighting for my life. Gets pretty dangerous out there." "Yeah, you're right," Rina sighs. "I'm just romanticizing it in my head, I guess. I'm pretty lucky just to be doing what I am... living at home and helping mom. Speaking of... should probably get to those weeds." "Right," you agree. "Thanks for helping me out, [pc.name]," she says, tugging some deep-rooted weeds out of the dirt and patting it flat again. "You didn't have to bother." "Nah, it's fun spending time with you," you say, picking at some roots. The majority of them aren't even hard to pull out, it's just that there's so many. "Might as well pay your mom back for the privilege. God knows I've eaten enough of her food." "Haha! True," Rina says, smiling. "Thanks." You uproot a bunch of weeds that you toss in a basket, working for an hour or so before Rina stretches out and yawns. "That's enough for tod- wow, that's more than enough," she says, glancing at the contents of the basket. "That side won't need weeding any time soon. You're making me look like a slacker over here!" "Must be the adventuring," you quip. "Snrk! Yeah, I'll bet," Rina says with a grin. "Let's go get rid of this and get something to eat." |"Wanna get some more training in?" you say. rows.original: You shift your hand from her shoulder to rub Rina's ear in a show of affection. "Who says I'm leaving you behind?" "Mmmm- aww, d-don't... don't tease meee," she whines, leaning into the rubbing. "Nnn-n-n-n! This is j-just- making it harderrr..." "Relax," you say. "I'm not gonna up and ditch you, okay? I like you too much for that." "Oohhhh... f-fine," Rina moans. "I believe you!" You run a finger down her ear before letting your hand fall away, watching a little shiver run up Rina's spine. "Wow... I've never had [pc.mf |a guy |anyone ] rub my ears like that," she sighs in happiness. "It's kinda nice..." [pc.ra cowgirl |"Isn't it?" |"Glad you liked it," ] you say, smiling. "Come on. Let's go inside and clean you up a little." You get Rina in the bathroom to wash up a bit while you reflect on how incredible having running water in your home is. Garth'd be thrilled, no doubt... you can't even imagine how much time he must spend mopping up spills of one type or another. You're idly hanging out in the kitchen when Rina walks in, looking much better. You smile at her. "Pretty as ever." "You think so?" she says, blushing a little as she scratches her head. "Thanks." "Want some salami?" you offer. "Oh, sure," Rina mumbles. She takes a piece and absentmindedly nibbles on it, staring out the window. Then she takes a short breath, then a deeper one, and turns to you with a nervous expression. "U-um! [pc.name]-" "Hi, you two!" Cassia says, coming into the kitchen with a smile. "How about a proper meal after you've been outside? Let me cook something up for you." "O-oh, mom," Rina says. Some kind of resolve leaves her, and her shoulders sag a little. "I guess I'm hungry." "I could eat more of your food," you say, giving Cassia a smile. The cow-woman chuckles. "Good! You two go rest with [brint.isBrienne |Brienne |Brint ], I'll handle things here." You glance at Rina as you walk out to the lounge. "Something you wanted to say?" "Well- no, it's okay," she sighs. "We can talk about it some other time..." "Yeah?" you say, smiling. "Well, I'll be here tomorrow. Take your time." You sit down with [brint.name] and Rina, chatting lightheartedly until Cassia shows up with some trays of hot food and salad. "If I'm not careful I'm going to end up coming here to eat every day," you joke. "We'd welcome the company!" Cassia says with a smile. "Wouldn't we, Rina?" "Yeah," Rina says. "You can come over whenever you want, [pc.name]." "Guess I'll just sweep my dusty old bones into a pan, then," [brint.name] sighs theatrically. You give [brint.isBrienne |her |him ] a nudge with your elbow. "Oh, you," Cassia scolds her. "We're your family, [brint.name]. Of course you're welcome here any time you like. I'll keep your room clean for you." "Thanks, mom," [brint.name] says. You're idly hanging out in the kitchen when Rina walks in, looking much better. You smile at her. "Pretty as ever." "You think so?" she says, blushing a little as she scratches her head. "Thanks." rows.translation: 去问问卡茜娅关于她自己的事情吧。

rows.original: Talk about the youngest of her children, Rina.
rows.translation: 谈谈她最小的孩子，莉娜。
rows.raw: "Talk about the youngest of her children, Rina."

rows.original: Does Cassia have anyone else in her life?
rows.translation: 卡茜娅的生活中还有其他人吗？
rows.raw: "Does Cassia have anyone else in her life?"

rows.original: You give her a wave as you step inside the boxy house's interior, heading into the living room.
rows.translation: 当你走进那栋方形的房子，走进客厅时，你向她挥了挥手。
rows.raw: "\n        You give her a wave as you step inside the boxy house's interior, heading into the living room."

rows.original:
"So how's the woman of the house doing?" you ask, smiling. "It must be tough raising Rina on your own."

    "She's a handful," Cassia says, smiling fondly. "So much energy to go around and only so much room in the house. But [brint.isBrienne
        |her and Brienne are my darling daughters
        |her and Brint are my darling children
    ], so it's not a problem. We're lucky enough to have money left over from my marriage... I keep things frugal, and we have a garden. Gods know Rina and I spend enough time maintaining it."
    
    "How have you been dealing with the quarantine stuff?" you ask.

    "We're lucky enough to be living right next to the city," she says with a little shrug. "The guard is right there, after all. I don't think we'd be that much safer inside its walls, not to mention we'd be out of our house. Have you been in there? People are packed into every inn."
    
    [flags.KMINN_ROSE|"Yeah, the inn at the gates is jammed with soldiers," you agree. "It looks pretty rough, though I don't have anything to compare it to."|"That bad, huh?" you say.]
    
    "It's certainly not business as usual," Cassia sighs.
    
    Sounds like she's got a fair amount of [pc.mascFem|shit to deal with|problems on her plate].
rows.translation:
那么，家里那位女士最近怎么样？”你微笑着问道，“独自抚养瑞娜肯定很不容易吧。”

    “她可真是个‘麻烦精’，”卡茜娅满怀爱意地笑着说，“精力充沛得让人措手不及，而家里的空间又有限……不过[brint.isBrienne
        |她和布蕾妮是我亲爱的女儿们。
        |她和布林特是我亲爱的孩子们。
    ]所以这并不是什么问题。幸运的是，我结婚时留下了一些积蓄……我生活得很节俭，而且我们还有个花园。天知道，莉娜和我花了多少时间来打理它。
    
    “你们是怎么应对这些隔离措施的？你问得倒好。”

    “我们很幸运，住在了城市旁边，”她微微耸了耸肩说道，“毕竟守卫就在那里。我觉得就算住在城墙里面，我们的安全也不会有太大保障，更何况那样我们就得离开自己的家了。你进去过里面吗？那里的每家客栈都挤满了人。
    
    [flags.KMINN_ROSE|是啊，城门处的那家客栈里挤满了士兵，”你说道，“看起来情况挺糟糕的，不过我也没有什么可以与之相比的参照。|这么糟糕吗？”你说道。]
    
    情况肯定不再像以前那样了，”卡茜娅叹道。
    
    听起来她遇到了一些相当棘手的问题。 [pc.mascFem|真是烦人的事|她目前面临诸多问题]。

rows.original:
"How's Rina?" you ask.

    "I'm glad she's got her athletics, but I wish she'd take herself more seriously," Cassia sighs, putting a hand to her cheek. "It's impossible to get her to do anything. But that's a teenager, I guess."
    
    "What do you mean?" you say.
    
    "She can't run forever," the cow-woman says. "She'll have to find a husband at some point. I'm not asking her to settle down and give me grandchildren — far from it — but I just don't know if she's thought about her future at all." She sighs. "It's like getting water from a rock with her."
    
    You shrug. "I wouldn't worry too much. [flags.RINA_TALKED|She seems to have a good head on her shoulders.|It's like that, growing up.]"
    
    "I hope you're right," Cassia says.
rows.translation:
“莉娜怎么样了？”你问道。

    “我很高兴她喜欢运动，但真希望她能更认真地对待自己。”卡茜娅一手贴着脸颊，叹了口气，“想让她做点什么简直不可能。不过，青少年大概就是这样。”
    
    “什么意思？”你问道。
    
    “她不能永远逃避下去。”牛女说道，“她迟早得找个丈夫。我不是逼她安定下来、给我生外孙——完全不是——我只是不知道她究竟有没有考虑过未来。”她叹了口气，“想从她嘴里问出来，简直像从石头里挤水。”
    
    你耸耸肩。“我觉得不必太担心。[flags.RINA_TALKED|她看起来很有主见。|成长时就是这样。]”
    
    “希望你是对的。”卡茜娅说道。

You give the spiky-haired cowgirl a friendly hug. "Working hard, huh?" "Yup," Rina says. She looks down. "Sorry about all the sweat, [pc.name]." "Don't worry about it," you say. "Mom's in the kitchen if you wanna say hi," she says. "I'll do that," you say. You give Cassia a smile as you greet her. "Hi, Cassia." "Oh, it is you," Cassia says, putting down her spatula and smiling. "Welcome back, [pc.name]." You give her a hug. "Thanks. Do you want any help with the food?" "No, it's okay. I'm just about done here," she says. "Can you make sure the table's ready to eat at?" "Sure thing," you say. You set the table and put the chairs in place before sitting down to enjoy a meal with the girls, helping Cassia wash the dishes afterwards while Rina stays outside to stretch a bit. "Thanks for the help, [pc.name]," Cassia says at your side. "Any time," you say. She smiles at you. "It makes me feel so much better knowing you're taking care of my daughter." Now that you're finished with domestic tasks, there's any number of ways to spend your time at the house with your wife or her family. |Cassia, smiling wide. "Welcome back," she says, wrapping her arms around you. "Come in." "Thanks, Cassia. Good to see you again," you say. "Do you need anything done around the house?" "You can go keep my little tomboy company," she says, patting your back. "I'll bring you some food when I'm done with the cooking." "Sure thing," you say. "Appreciated." You head outside while Cassia walks into the kitchen. Rina’s out here doing stretches — looks like she just finished with her training. You clear your throat and she looks around, smiling wide when she sees you. "Hey, [pc.name]!" she says. "Visiting again?" "Sure am," you say, sitting down next to her. "How's the fitness going?" "Pretty great," she says. "I'm more motivated these days. You know?" You grin. "Yeah, I getcha. Let's get some food. Need to grow big and strong, right?" Rina laughs. "I think big might not be happening, but we'll see." You sit down to eat with your little family, polishing off the food before washing the dishes for them. Now that you’re done with the domestic checklist, the only thing left is to spend time with the girls. |Rina and Cassia. "Hey girls," you say, smiling as they throw their arms around you. "Welcome back, [pc.name]," Cassia says. "Hi [pc.name]!" Rina chirps. "We saw you coming down the pathway." You give them each a kiss on the cheek before Cassia leads you into the living room with Rina in tow. "I was just making some food," Cassia says. "Take a seat out in the yard, will you [pc.name]? I'll bring it out to you." "You don't want help?" you say. "Thank you, but I'll be teaching my daughter how to cook properly instead," she says, putting her hands on her hips as she looks at Rina. "I don't want to hear any stories of your [pc.mf |husband |wife ] going hungry when I'm old." "Aw c'mon, as if I'd let [pc.himHer]," Rina protests, tail waving as she passes by. "Besides... I've got plenty of milk to give." You [pc.mascFem |chuckle |giggle ] as you hear Cassia sigh from the kitchen. The girls finish cooking up and join you in the yard for a meal after which you wash the dishes, letting them relax in the yard. There's nothing in particular to do after that – just spending time with the women. ]
rows.translation: 你独自沿着小路走去，一边哼着小曲，心中充满了期待。咚咚咚你退后一步，等待门被打开，门缓缓推开，露出了[rand |莉娜，满头大汗，气喘吁吁。 “嘿，莉娜，”你微笑着说道。 “嘿！”她喘着气回答，“我刚进去想喝点水……” 你友好地拥抱了这个留着刺猬头发的牛仔女孩。“工作很辛苦吧？” “是啊，”莉娜低下头说，“抱歉弄得你看到这么多汗[pc.name]别担心，”你说。 “如果你想跟妈妈打个招呼，她现在在厨房里，”她说。 “我会的，”你说。 你微笑着向卡茜娅打招呼：“嗨，卡茜娅。” “哦，原来是你啊，”卡茜娅放下铲子，微笑着说，“欢迎回来。 [pc.name]你拥抱了她一下：“谢谢。需要帮忙准备食物吗？” “不用了，没关系。我差不多已经弄好了，”她说。“你能确保餐桌已经准备好可以用餐了吗？” “当然可以，”你回答道。 你摆好了餐桌，把椅子也放好位置，然后坐下来和女孩们一起吃饭。饭后，你帮忙卡茜娅洗碗，而莉娜则在外面稍微活动了一下。 “谢谢你的帮忙，”她说。 [pc.name]，”随时都可以，”你说道。 她对你笑了笑：“知道你在照顾我的女儿，我感到安心多了。” 现在你已经完成了家务活，有很多方式可以和你的妻子或她的家人一起在家里度过时光。 |卡茜娅露出了灿烂的笑容。 “欢迎回来，”她说着，搂住了你，“进来吧。” “谢谢，卡茜娅。很高兴再次见到你，”你说，“家里需要帮忙做些什么吗？ 你可以去陪陪我的小假小子吧，”她一边说，一边轻拍着你的背。“等我做完饭，会给你带些吃的来。” “好的，”你说，“非常感谢。” 你走出门外，而卡茜娅则走进了厨房。莉娜正在这里做伸展运动，看起来她刚刚训练完。你清了清嗓子，她转过头来，看到你后立刻露出了灿烂的笑容。 “嘿，”她说道。 [pc.name]啊，”她说，“又来看你啦？” “当然，”你边说边坐在她旁边，“最近健身怎么样？” “挺好的，”她说，“这些天我变得更有动力了，你知道吗？” 你笑了笑。嗯，我懂你的意思。我们先去吃点东西吧，得长得壮壮实实的才行，对吧？” 莉娜笑了：“我觉得我们可能长不很高大，不过走着看吧。” 你和你的小家人一起坐下来吃饭，把食物吃得干干净净，然后帮他们洗碗。现在你已经完成了国内的各项安排，接下来要做的就是花时间陪陪那些女孩们了。 |莉娜和卡茜娅。 “嘿，姑娘们，”你微笑着说道，这时她们纷纷抱住了你。 “欢迎回来[pc.name]，卡茜娅说道。 “嗨[pc.name]哇！”莉娜欢快地叫道，“我们看到你沿着小路走下来了。” 你在他们每个人的脸颊上各吻了一下，然后卡茜娅带着莉娜带你走进了客厅。 “我只是在准备一些食物而已，”卡茜娅说道，“你到院子里去坐一会儿吧。 [pc.name]我会把它拿给你看的。” “你不需要帮助吗？”你问道。 “谢谢，但我打算教我的女儿如何正确地做饭，”她双手叉腰，看着莉娜说道，“我可不想听你讲的那些故事。 [pc.mf |丈夫 |妻子 ]等我老了，肯定会挨饿的。” “哎呀，别这么说，我怎么可能让你挨饿呢。 [pc.himHer]哎呀，”莉娜边说边摇着尾巴从旁边走过，“再说……我还有很多牛奶可以给呢。 [pc.mascFem |轻声笑起来 |轻声笑 ]这时，你会听到卡茜娅从厨房里传来叹息声。女孩们完成烹饪后，也来到院子里与你一起用餐。饭后，你负责洗餐具，让她们在院子里休息放松。之后也没有什么特别的事情要做，就是和这些女性们一起度过时光罢了。 ]

rows.original: Hang out with [bri.married|your [party.has brienne|wife|husband] in the family house.|[bri.name].]
rows.translation: 和[bri.married|你在家族宅邸里的[party.has brienne|妻子|丈夫]一起消磨时间。|[bri.name]一起消磨时间。]
rows.raw: "Hang out with [bri.married|your [party.has brienne|wife|husband] in the family house.|[bri.name].]"

rows.original: [bri.name]'s asleep for the night – best leave [bri.himHer] to get [bri.hisHer] beauty sleep.
rows.translation: [bri.name]已经睡下了——最好让[bri.himHer]好好睡[bri.hisHer]美容觉。
rows.raw: "[bri.name]'s asleep for the night – best leave [bri.himHer] to get [bri.hisHer] beauty sleep."

rows.original: You'd have to have brought [bri.name] with you to hang out with [bri.himHer].
rows.translation: 你本来得带上[bri.name]一起，才能跟[bri.himHer]出去玩。
rows.raw: "You'd have to have brought [bri.name] with you to hang out with [bri.himHer]."

rows.original: Go catch Rina while she's getting ready for bed.
rows.translation: 快去把正在准备睡觉的莉娜抓回来吧。
rows.raw: "Go catch Rina while she's getting ready for bed."

rows.original: Slip into Rina's bed with her.
rows.translation: 和她一起躺在莉娜的床上。

rows.original: Rina's around – it's not like she's hard to find. Usually you can just follow the noise.
rows.translation: 莉娜就在附近，她并不难找到。通常你只需要跟着声音走就能找到她。
rows.raw: "Rina's around – it's not like she's hard to find. Usually you can just follow the noise."

rows.original: Rina's sleeping – best not disturb her.
rows.translation: 莉娜正在睡觉——最好不要打扰她。

rows.original: Spend some time with Cassia[cassia.isMarried|, your lovely housewife].
rows.translation: 花些时间与卡茜娅相处吧。[cassia.isMarried|你那位可爱的家庭主妇]。
rows.raw: "Spend some time with Cassia[cassia.isMarried|, your lovely housewife]."

rows.original: Cassia's asleep, and the last thing you want to do is wake her up.
rows.translation: 卡茜娅已经睡着了，而你最不想做的就是把她吵醒。
rows.raw: "Cassia's asleep, and the last thing you want to do is wake her up."

rows.original: Get some quick satisfaction with one of the girls.
rows.translation: 和其中一个女孩发生关系，快速获得满足感吧。
rows.raw: "Get some quick satisfaction with one of the girls."

rows.translation: 快速获得一些满足感吧。

rows.original: Cooking is best done when everyone's awake and ready for food.
rows.translation: 当大家都醒着并且准备吃饭的时候，才是做菜的最佳时机。

rows.original: "Brienne. We will get married," you say, holding her hand. "Okay? We just need time to make it happen." She smiles wide, and you can see she's struggling to hold back tears. "Thanks, [pc.name]... I hope it all goes to plan." "It will," you assure her. "Just be patient and we'll be together until death do us part before you know it. I love you." "I love you too," she murmurs.

rows.original: Cassia finds you before you find her, giving you a smile before realizing something. "Oh, [rina.married |darling |[pc.name] ]," Cassia says. "I wanted to thank you for, well, reuniting the family." "No thanks needed," you say, smiling. "I'm just happy everything's alright." "I know, dear, but you've really done so much for me," she says. "I didn't think I had much to give you in thanks but then I remembered some of... the gear I've kept around. You might find it useful or interesting. Want to take a look?" Your interest is piqued. "Sure." Cassia takes your arm and leads you out into the garden. "Fantastic. I've been wondering what to do for you ever since you brought [bri.name] back and made my house lively again. I don't know if any of this will be useful to you, but it pays to check. Can you help me open this?" There's a cellar door around the side of the house and upon opening it, you find a tunnel leading downwards. It doesn't go very far but there's certainly room for storage. Escorting [rina.married |your wife |Cassia ] down the stairs, you blink a few times as your eyes adjust to the darkness. "Here," Cassia says, walking towards a corner of the room. Rina [brint.isBrienne |and Brienne peek down the stairs |peeks down the stairs, closely followed by Brint ]. "What are you guys doing?" "Digging up some history," Cassia says. "You can come look if you're interested." The four of you gather around, observing what is clearly a wooden mannequin covered in a set of armor. Wait a moment – you've seen this before... "Oh, it's this type of armor," you say. "Like in the murals and statues outside the arena!" Cassia laughs. "Exactly. It's actually made for the arena. It's kind of a cultural thing." Before you is a fully enclosed plated helm with two eyeholes and a fin. Instinct tells you that its somewhat rounded shape keeps it from catching blades, directing blows away from the head. The mannequin has straps across its chest to keep its singular heavy armplate in place, and you can see there's a matching legplate for the opposite leg on the wooden box next to it. "Oh, and this," Cassia says, lifting the legplate off the box and shifting the lid. Reaching inside, she produces a one-handed sword. About as long as her arm, she holds it out experimentally. "Mmm... yep, still good." "You fought with this?" She nods. "The short sword is the perfect weapon for a cowgirl. We can't handle the big things like greataxes, but anyone can use a short sword. The men are trained to use them in the legions too. Not exactly common practice for a girl, but..." The cowgirl moves her wrist a few times, slicing through the air with ease. "Nice and light, not much more than a pound." She sighs. "I used to spend hours practicing with this thing." "I can tell," you say. "You hold it like you know how to use it." [bri.name] looks proud. "That's mom for you." Cassia laughs, putting the sword back down. It still looks well-maintained, you note. "Well, that's old news. I haven't swung this around in a while. So if you want these, [pc.name], they're all yours." [flags.ARENA_ACCOLADES |You pause. "You know, I've been to the arena." Cassia smiles. "Have you, now." You glance at her. "I saw a pretty familiar name on the accolades list..." She's silent for a second before laughing. "It's true. Before my babies, I fought in the arena for a spell. Gods, that was a long time ago. The armor is one of the sets I used to wear when I was a gladiator." "You must have been pretty successful if you're on the list," you note. Cassia waves the claim off. "The fighters get better every year. Really, if you put me in today's arena I'm sure I wouldn't hold a candle to them." "Even so, I'm impressed," you say. "I would have liked to see you fight." [cassia.married |"I'm just your housewife now," she says with a smile. "But I can do a pretty good job of pulling weeds." You laugh, leaning in to give her a kiss. "That's all I need from you. Thanks, Cass." |"I'm just a housekeeper now," she says with a smile. "But I can do a pretty good job of pulling weeds." You laugh. "That's all you need. Thanks, Cassia." ] You collect the storied set of armor and the sword, stashing them away. They're yours now, though you won't forget where they came from. |"Sure, I'd be happy to take them," you say. "Thanks, [cassia.married |babe |[cassia.fucked |Cass |Cassia ] ]." She smiles. "No problem. You're really helping me out again getting rid of this old stuff." It only occurs to you once you've collected it all that you should have asked where she got the armor from, but oh well. It's yours now, along with her sword. ]
rows.translation: 卡茜娅在你找到她之前就先找到了你，她还对你笑了笑，然后才意识到了一些事情。 “哦， [rina.married |亲爱的 |[pc.name] ]我想感谢你，”卡茜娅说道，“谢谢你让我们的家庭重新团聚。” “不用谢，”你微笑着回答，“我只是很高兴一切都好了。” “我知道的，亲爱的，但你确实为我做了很多。”她说道。我本来觉得没什么可以用来感谢你的，但后来我想起了一些……我之前留着的装备。你可能会觉得它们有用或者有趣，想看看吗？” 你被这个提议吸引住了：“当然想。” 卡茜娅牵着你的手，带你走到了花园里。太棒了。自从你提出这个想法后，我就一直在思考该为你做些什么。 [bri.name]我回来了，让我的家重新恢复了生机。不知道这些对您是否有帮助，但试试总没有坏处。您能帮我打开这个吗？” 房子的侧面有一扇地窖门，打开它后，你会看到一条通往地下的隧道。这条隧道并不长，但里面肯定有足够的空间用来储存物品。请陪我一起去吧。 [rina.married |你的妻子 |卡茜娅 ]走下楼梯后，你眨了几下眼睛，让眼睛适应黑暗。 “在这里，”卡茜娅说着，朝房间的一个角落走去。 莉娜[brint.isBrienne |布蕾妮也向下望了望楼梯。 |向下望去，布林特紧随其后。 ]你们在干什么？” “在挖掘一些历史遗迹呢，”卡茜娅说，“如果你感兴趣的话，可以过来看看。” 四个人围了过来，仔细观察那个明显是由木头制成的、覆盖着一套盔甲的人体模型。等等——你们以前见过这个…… “哦，这是这个那种盔甲，”你说，“就像竞技场外那些壁画和雕像上展示的那种！” 卡茜娅笑了：“没错，其实就是那种盔甲。为了竞技场……这其实是一种文化现象。” 你面前是一顶完全封闭的金属头盔，上面有两个眼洞和一片鳍状结构。你的直觉告诉你，这种略带圆润的设计能够有效避免刀刃击中头部，使攻击力量被偏转开来。这个模型在胸部装有绑带，用于固定那块重型的臂甲；在它旁边的木箱上，你可以看到另一条腿上也配有相应的护腿甲。 “哦，还有这个，”卡茜娅说着，从箱子里取出了那块护腿甲，然后掀开了箱盖。她将手伸进怀里，取出一把单手剑。这把剑的长度与她的手臂差不多，她试着重手握住它，然后说道：“嗯……还不错。” “你是用这把剑战斗的？” 她点了点头：“这种短剑对女牛仔来说确实是完美的武器。我们虽然无法使用像长剑这样的重型武器，但任何人都能使用短剑。在军团中，男人们也接受过使用短剑的训练。对于女孩来说，这或许不是常见的做法，但是……” 这位牛仔女孩轻轻转动手腕，短剑便轻松地在空气中划出了几道痕迹。轻巧又方便，重量还不到一磅。”她叹道，“过去我常常花好几个小时练习使用这个东西。” “我看得出来，”你说，“你握它的姿势就说明你很懂怎么使用它。 [bri.name]看起来很自豪：“这就是你的妈妈。” 卡茜娅笑了，把剑放了回去。你注意到，这把剑依然保养得很好。“嗯，这已经是老掉牙的事了。我已经有一段时间没有用这把剑挥动了……所以，如果你想要这些的话[pc.name]，它们全都归你所有了。 [flags.ARENA_ACCOLADES |你停顿了一下，说道：“你知道吗，我曾经去过那个竞技场。” 卡茜娅微笑着回答：“是吗，现在才去啊。” 你瞥了她一眼，继续说道：“在那些获奖名单上，我看到一个非常熟悉的名字……” 她沉默了一会儿，然后突然笑了起来。确实如此。在我生下孩子们之前，我曾在竞技场中为争夺一个法术而战斗。天啊，那真是很久以前的事了。那套盔甲，就是我当年作为角斗士时使用的装备之一。” “如果你能上榜，那肯定说明你曾经取得了相当大的成功吧，”你说道。 卡茜娅轻描淡写地回应道：“这些格斗选手每年都在进步。说实话，如果让我参加今天的比赛，我肯定比不上他们。” “即便如此，我还是觉得你很厉害，”你说，“我真的很想看看你战斗的样子。" [cassia.married |我现在只不过是你的家庭主妇罢了，”她笑着说，“不过拔草这项活儿，我倒是做得挺不错的。” 你笑了起来，凑过去吻了她一下。“这就是我对你所期望的。谢谢你，卡丝。 |我现在只不过是个管家罢了，”她笑着说，“不过拔草这项工作，我倒是做得挺不错的。” 你笑了：“这就够了。谢谢你，卡茜娅。 ] 你收集了那套充满故事的盔甲和那把剑，并将它们藏了起来。它们现在属于你了，不过你永远不会忘记它们的来历。 |当然，我很乐意接受它们，”你说，“谢谢。 [cassia.married |宝贝 |[cassia.fucked |卡丝 |卡茜娅 ] ]她微笑着说道：“没问题。你又一次帮我把这些旧东西处理掉了。” 直到你把所有东西都收集齐全后，你才会突然想到应该问问她这些盔甲是从哪里得到的，不过算了。现在这些东西都是你的了，还有她的剑也是。 ]

rows.raw: "Collect the items from the house later."

rows.original: You collect Cassia's sword and armor and stow them rightly.
rows.translation: 你收集了卡茜娅的剑和盔甲，并将它们妥善存放起来。
rows.raw: "\n    You collect Cassia's sword and armor and stow them rightly."

rows.original: The rumble of fifty pairs of hooves thundering across the paved road behind you is unmistakable, so forceful that stones vibrate around your feet. You quickly peel off to the side of the road, getting small as a column of royal soldiers stomp past in lockstep — fighters returning from the Undermountain, by the battle-tested state of them. Their armor is stained with milky fluids in some places, scorched black from corrupted magics in others. You can see tired eyes and belabored breaths snorted beneath their helms. [party.comp brint brienne |"Hard fighting," Brint muses quietly, watching the men march past. "Never seen the legions coming home in anything less than shiny triumph before." |"Those poor men," Brienne murmurs quietly, watching them march past. "I remember seeing the legions march home all polished and triumphant when I was little. Never like this." ] You're so distracted watching the battered soldiers that you don't notice the woman in their midst until she's clapping a hand on your shoulder, giving you the only smile on the street. "Ah, you made it after all, [pc.name]!" Calise says, resting her axe over a shoulder. "That's good. The depths are only becoming more perilous. Our company hit another swarm of imps today perhaps three hundred strong. Acceptable odds for the soldiers of Khor'minos... but tomorrow may well be five hundred. Next week? A thousand." "Sounds like you're losing hope," you say, taking her hand again when it's offered. For such a grim prognosis, her smile's unabated. Calise shakes her head. "[flags.WC_CLEAR|With you here? Hardly! Between the two of us, this city of bulls and cows has two superb cattle-dogs to keep it safe.|Hope's a funny thing, my friend. I look in the eyes of the city's soldiers and I see its flame waning, but when I behold you, all I see is a pillar of flame reaching for the heavens — and ready to smite down our foes, if only you find the courage to lend the city your [pc.isMage |spells |talents ].]" That right? "You've got a lot of confidence in me." "That's the nature of a paladin," she says. "To see the best in other people. Every hero rises from humble beginnings, and even villains have some shred of good in them to redeem. At least, that's what my knightly mother told me. I have a good feeling about you, [pc.title]. [flags.WC_CLEAR|So much so that I put in a good word for you with the Captain of the Guard. Go talk to him; he'll give you a token to get into the city proper. Those are rare commodities these days. Don't thank me, though: I expect that favor to be paid back with interest once you see what I've been trying to protect: the biggest city in the world! Or at least, that I've ever seen. The world could lose it."|But I can't get you into the city with just a feeling. King Kelsaz rightly fears the demonic incursion is worse than just little hellspawn like these imps, so the inner wards of the city are in total quarantine. Only the most remarkable people, and those in the king's service, and allowed to pass without citizenship." "So just how do I get in?" Calise's smile broadens. "Ah, there's the rub, my dear [pc.title]. The king himself would need good reason to recognize the value you bring to Khor'minos. But I've heard a rumor that, if true, could be just what you need to secure a royal audience." "What?" "There's a city north of the River Ridell — that big floe that cuts through the Marches just north of here. Folk in Khor'minos haven't heard a peep out of it for centuries, but one of the imps we captured early in the war swore up and down that a woman named 'Alissa' there was poised to become some kind of demon queen. That could be the source of all this chaos! Or if not, it's certainly a city that's in incredible danger. I doubt a backwater half buried in a glacier has the kind of army ready to resist invasion that King Kelsaz does. If you can go there and stop Alissa, then I'm sure the king will see you're a [pc.mf |man |woman ] worthy of his city. Understand?" [party.has etheryn |"A-Alissa? A demon queen?" Ryn squeaks, covering her mouth. "Oh, Lumia. No..." Calise quirks a brow. "What's the matter, pumpkin? Somebody you know?" Ryn sighs. "Unfortunately." Seeing the clear anguish spreading on your elven companion's face, Calise immediately steps forward and slings her strong arms around Ryn. "Don't worry. There's still hope for her, if you and your friends hurry there. I'm sure of it!" ] Calise gives you an apologetic look. "I wish I could go myself, but it's difficult holding things together here. The Khor'minoan temples lost most of their clerics and paladins in the first days of the siege; perhaps you saw the ruins of Tira's house on your way in, defiled by corrupted oozes with all its priestesses... turned. I'm the only wielder of white magic of note the city has left; you can imagine how stretched thin that leaves me. Any moment I'm not smiting Velun's foes from the frontlines, I'm laying hands on the sick and injured. I can put up a brave face, [pc.name], but I don't remember the last time I slept more than a couple of hours at once." So, to this city in the far north, then? "Any idea what I could be facing there?" "None. Apparently there's a den of kitsunes and a few powerful witches living up thataway; imps will surely be all over the place by now, too."] "I'll keep that in mind," you tell the paladin, earning an appreciative nod. "Then Velun bless you, [pc.name]! My duties permitting, I'll be in the outskirts whenever I can be if you lack for guidance. Soon we'll have to move against the source of these imps, though. I pray you've secured the right to join the muster inside the city by then!" The crusader hefts her axe back up and gives you an awkward curtsey under all that armor before she turns to rejoin the last of her soldiers trudging past. [party.has cait |"What a woman!" Cait sighs. "The way she talks, you'd think she's holding the whole city together all by herself... just like you'd expect from a divine champion!" ] [party.has arona |"Damn, I'd like to challenge a holy bitch like that," Arona growls, adjusting her loincloth. "Lookit the way she handles that axe, like it's nothing. Reminds me of me!" ] [party.has azyrran |Azzy bites her lip, watching Calise depart. "A shame we didn't have a woman like her when Kasyrra came to our hive. But then, I'd never have met you if we had!" ]
rows.translation: 你身后，五十对马蹄在铺好的道路上发出震耳欲聋的声响，那声音如此强烈，以至于周围的石头都在震动。你迅速躲到道路旁边，当一队队皇家士兵整齐划一地从你身边走过时，你显得格外渺小——这些经过无数战斗考验的战士正从山腹深域归来。他们的盔甲有些地方被乳状的液体弄脏了，有些地方则因为被腐蚀的魔法而烧成了黑色。你可以看到他们头盔下那疲惫的眼神，以及他们艰难地喘着粗气。 [party.comp brint brienne |真是艰苦的战斗啊，”布林特低声感慨着，注视着那些士兵们列队经过。“以前从未见过军团在胜利归来时不是意气风发、光彩照人的。 |那些可怜的人……”布蕾妮轻声说道，注视着他们缓缓行进的身影。“我记得小时候，曾看到那些军队凯旋而归，个个意气风发。但从没见过这样的情景。 ] 你全神贯注地观察那些伤痕累累的士兵，以至于直到那个女人拍你的肩膀，给了你这条街上唯一的一个微笑，你才注意到她就在他们中间。 “啊，你终于来了。 [pc.name]真是太好了，”卡莉丝说着，把斧头搭在肩上。“情况正在变得越来越危险。今天我们又遇到了一群小妖怪，大概有三百只。对科尔米诺斯的士兵们来说，这个数字还算可以接受……但明天数量可能会增加到五百只，下周的话？可能会有一千只。” “听起来你好像有些失去信心了，”你说道，当她再次伸出手来时，你握住了她的手。面对如此严峻的形势，她的笑容却依然没有消失。 卡莉丝摇了摇头。“并没有。[flags.WC_CLEAR|有你在，还用得着吗？当然不用！就我们两个人，这个充满粗人粗俗之人的城市，已经有两只非常出色的“看门狗”在维护秩序了。|希望，是一件奇妙的东西，我的朋友。当我注视着这座城市里的士兵们时，我看到他们的斗志正在减弱；但当我看着你时，我所看到的却是一道直冲云霄的火焰之柱——那火焰随时准备击溃我们的敌人，只要你能鼓起勇气，为这座城市贡献你的力量[pc.isMage |咒语 |人才 ]。]是吗？”“你似乎对我很有信心。” “这就是圣骑士的本性，”她说道，“就是要看到别人身上最美好的一面。每一个英雄都是从平凡之处成长起来的，就连反派身上也一定存在着可以拯救他们的善良之处。至少，我那位身为骑士的母亲是这么告诉我的。我对你有一种好感[pc.title]。 [flags.WC_CLEAR|我甚至特意为你说好了话，让卫队队长帮你。去跟他谈谈吧，他会给你一个进入城内的通行证。这种东西现在可是非常稀少。不过别谢我，等你看到了我一直在努力保护的东西——世界上最大的城市，至少是我见过的最大的城市——你就会明白我这个忙是值得的。否则，这个世界可能会失去它。|但我仅仅凭这种感觉是无法带你进入城市的。凯尔萨兹国王之所以会担心恶魔的入侵比这些小恶魔更危险，正是因为如此。城市的内部区域已经处于全面隔离状态。只有那些特别重要的人，以及为国王服务的人，才能在没有公民身份证明的情况下通过。 “那我究竟要怎样才能进去？” 卡莉丝的笑容变得更加灿烂了。“啊，问题就在这里，亲爱的[pc.title]国王本人也需要充分的理由，才会承认你为科尔米诺斯带来的价值。但我听说有一个传闻，如果这是真的，那么它可能正是你获得国王接见所需要的。” “什么？” “在里德尔河以北有一座城市——就是那座横贯这片地区、位于这里北部的那座大城市。几个世纪以来，科尔米诺斯的居民们再也没有听到过任何关于它的消息。但是，在战争初期我们俘虏的一个小妖精坚称，那里有一位名叫“艾莉莎”的女性，她即将成为某种恶魔女王。或许，这一切混乱的根源就在她身上！否则，那肯定是一座处于极度危险中的城市。我怀疑，一个被冰川覆盖、几乎与世隔绝的地方，不可能拥有像凯尔萨兹国王那样的军队来抵御入侵。如果你能前往那里并阻止艾莉莎的话，我相信国王一定会认可你的贡献。 [pc.mf |男人 |女性 ]不愧是这座城市的代表。明白吗？ [party.has etheryn |啊……艾莉莎？一个恶魔女王？”小琳惊叫着，捂住了嘴。“哦，卢米娅。不……” 卡莉丝挑了挑眉毛：“怎么了，小南瓜？是认识的人吗？” 小琳叹了口气：“不幸的是，是的。” 看到这位精灵同伴脸上流露出的痛苦神情，卡莉丝立刻走上前，用她强有力的双臂抱住了小琳：“别担心。只要你和你的朋友们尽快赶去，她还是有可能得救的。我对此深信不疑！ ] 卡莉丝向你投去歉意的眼神：“我真希望能亲自去，但眼下这里的事情实在太多，忙不过来。在围城刚开始的那些日子里，霍尔米诺亚的神庙失去了大部分神职人员和圣骑士；也许你在来这里的路上看到了蒂拉的宅邸废墟——那些被腐蚀的黏液破坏了一切，她的所有女祭司也都不在了。…转过身来。我是这座城市里唯一一位还算著名的白魔法师；你可以想象，这样的处境让我有多么忙碌。只要不是在前线打击维伦的敌人，我就一直在照顾那些生病或受伤的人。我可以强装镇定， [pc.name]，但是我不记得上一次一次连续睡上几个小时是什么时候了。” 那么，这次是要去遥远的北方这座城市吗？“你知道我在那里可能会遇到什么吗？” “不知道。据说那边有一群狐妖，还有几个强大的女巫居住在那里；现在那些小妖精们肯定也已经到处都是了。] 我会记住的，”你对那位圣骑士说道，得到了他感激的点头。 “那么，愿维伦保佑你。 [pc.name]只要我的职责允许，只要你需要指引，我就会随时出现在城郊。不过，我们很快就必须去消灭这些小妖的根源了。希望到那时你已经获得了进入城内的许可，能够参加集结行动！” 这位十字军战士重新举起了她的斧头，在那身厚重的盔甲掩护下，她向你做了一个略显笨拙的鞠躬，然后转身，继续跟随她剩下的士兵们前行。 [party.has cait |真是个了不起的女人！”凯特感叹道，“她说话的方式，让人觉得她简直是在独自支撑着整个城市……这可真是符合一位神圣英雄的形象啊！ ] [party.has arona |该死，我真想挑战那样一个厉害的女人，”阿罗娜低吼着，调整着自己的腰布。“看看她使用那把斧头的样子，简直毫不费力，简直让我想起了自己！ ] [party.has azyrran |阿齐咬着嘴唇，目送卡莉丝离去。“真可惜，当卡希拉来到我们的蜂巢时，我们没有这样一位女性。不过，如果当时有她的话，我也永远不会遇到你吧！ ]

rows.original:
"Ah, [pc.name]! What a sight for sore eyes!" Calise smiles, leaving her axe behind and [kas.romantic|giving you a tight, familiar hug. Her body's warm, breath hot on your neck for a brief moment before she steps back, hands on your shoulders.|clasping your hand in a firm warrior's greeting.] "I trust the locals have been welcoming?"
    
    [flags.WC_CLEAR
        |"They have," you confirm. "Why are you still out here and not in the city?"

        Calise gives an airy shrug, playing with a lock of brown hair that's fallen loose from her helm. "I like the country. It reminds me of home. When I was a girl I used to play in the fields, as far from the city walls as I could run before the sun began to set. Well, there's no sun down here in the Undermountain, and the fields are full of fungus and slimes, but the rustic atmosphere fills me with a quiet resolve. I enjoy this place."
        
        She sighs, looking to the city walls. "We still have work to do, you and I, and soon. But for now, I'm content to enjoy what time I have to catch my breath — before the final act begins. That being said, if there's any aid or guidance I can offer on your quest, don't hesitate to ask."
        |"Welcoming everywhere except inside the city," you say. 

        Calise shrugs. "They're right to be cautious. These demons are a growing threat, and Khor'minos's resources are stretched thin. They can't support any more people than they already are... and those they are now will soon be too much to bear. Remember what I said: prove your worth, and they'll make an exception for you. I'll vouch for you myself once you've resolved the disturbance in the north."
        
        "The Winter City, you mean?"
        
        She nods. "The same. If you can save one city, then the two of us together ought to be able to save this one. King Kelsaz will see my point, I'm sure. In the meantime, is there aught I can do to guide you in your quest?"
    ]
rows.translation:
“啊，[pc.name]！真是让人赏心悦目！”卡莉丝微笑着，把她的斧头留在了原地，[kas.romantic|她紧紧地拥抱了你，那种熟悉的感觉让人感到安心。她的身体很温暖，她的呼吸在你的脖子上停留了片刻，随后她退开了，双手搭在你的肩上。|紧紧握住你的手，以战士般的热情致以问候。] “我相信当地人一定都很热情好客吧？”
    
    [flags.WC_CLEAR
        |“他们确实很热情，”你确认道，“那你为什么还留在这里，而不是进城去呢？”

        卡莉丝轻轻耸了耸肩，玩弄着从头盔上垂下来的一缕棕色头发：“我喜欢乡村，这里让我想起家乡。我小时候经常在田野里玩耍，总是拼命跑到离城墙尽可能远的地方，直到太阳开始落山。不过，山腹深域的地底下根本就没有太阳，那些田野里也长满了真菌和史莱姆族，但这种质朴的氛围却让我内心充满了一种平静的决心。我喜欢这个地方。”
        
        她叹了口气，望向城墙：“我们还有事情要做，你和我，而且很快就要开始行动了。但现在，我很满足于享受这段能让我喘口气的时间——在最后一幕开始之前。话虽如此，如果在你的征程上有什么我能提供的帮助或指引，尽管开口。”
        |“除了城里，别的地方都挺欢迎我的，”你说。 

        卡莉丝耸了耸肩：“他们保持警惕也是理所应当的。这些恶魔正逐渐成为一种威胁，而科尔米诺斯的资源已经非常紧张了。他们已经无法再接纳更多人了……而他们现在收容的这些人，很快也会多到无法承受。记住我说过的话：证明你自己的价值，他们就会为你破例。等你解决了北方的骚乱之后，我会亲自为你担保。”
        
        “你是说冬城？”
        
        她点了点头。“正是。如果你能拯救一座城市，那么我们两人联手，应该也能拯救这一座。我相信凯尔萨兹国王会明白我的意思。那么在此期间，有什么我能为你的征程指点一二的吗？”
    ]
rows.raw:
'
    "Ah, [pc.name]! What a sight for sore eyes!" Calise smiles, leaving her axe behind and [kas.romantic|giving you a tight, familiar hug. Her body's warm, breath hot on your neck for a brief moment before she steps back, hands on your shoulders.|clasping your hand in a firm warrior's greeting.] "I trust the locals have been welcoming?"
    
    [flags.WC_CLEAR
        |"They have," you confirm. "Why are you still out here and not in the city?"

        Calise gives an airy shrug, playing with a lock of brown hair that's fallen loose from her helm. "I like the country. It reminds me of home. When I was a girl I used to play in the fields, as far from the city walls as I could run before the sun began to set. Well, there's no sun down here in the Undermountain, and the fields are full of fungus and slimes, but the rustic atmosphere fills me with a quiet resolve. I enjoy this place."
        
        She sighs, looking to the city walls. "We still have work to do, you and I, and soon. But for now, I'm content to enjoy what time I have to catch my breath — before the final act begins. That being said, if there's any aid or guidance I can offer on your quest, don't hesitate to ask."
        |"Welcoming everywhere except inside the city," you say. 

        Calise shrugs. "They're right to be cautious. These demons are a growing threat, and Khor'minos's resources are stretched thin. They can't support any more people than they already are... and those they are now will soon be too much to bear. Remember what I said: prove your worth, and they'll make an exception for you. I'll vouch for you myself once you've resolved the disturbance in the north."
        
        "The Winter City, you mean?"
        
        She nods. "The same. If you can save one city, then the two of us together ought to be able to save this one. King Kelsaz will see my point, I'm sure. In the meantime, is there aught I can do to guide you in your quest?"
    ]'

rows.original:
Calise a human woman, standing about 5'9. She has tanned skin and sharp features framed by a messy mane of rich brown hair that hangs down to her lower back. Her lips are lush and red-painted, complimenting large, friendly green eyes full of warmth and passion. 

    She wears a heroic panoply: a muscled bronze cuirass, bronze greaves and arm guards, and a Belharan-style helm with a great black plume. Beneath her armor is a simple white tunic and a knee-length cloth skirt, while over it she wears a hooded red cloak that spills down to her sandal-clad feet, pinned at the shoulder with a jade symbol of Velun. She wields a minoan labrys, a two-headed axe, on a long haft that demands both hands to wield. 
    
    Beneath all that cloth and armor is a lean, athletic body. She has a pair of supple C-cup breasts and willowy hips, supporting a tight little booty. Calise has a smooth-shaven twat and what must be a virginal asshole between her round cheeks, right where it belongs.
rows.translation:
卡莉丝是一位身材高约5英尺9英寸的女性。她拥有古铜色的皮肤，五官轮廓分明，一头浓密的红棕色长发随意地垂落在腰间。她的嘴唇红润饱满，与那双充满温暖与热情的绿色大眼睛相得益彰。 

    她身着一套英勇的战装：肌肉结实的青铜胸甲、青铜护腿和护臂，头戴一顶带有黑色羽饰的贝尔哈兰式头盔。在铠甲之下，她穿着一件简单的白色长袍和及膝的布裙，外面披着一件红色斗篷，斗篷的边缘垂至她穿着凉鞋的双脚，肩部用一枚象征维伦的翡翠饰品固定着。她手持一把米诺斯式的双头斧，这种长柄武器需要用双手来挥舞。
    
    在层层衣物和盔甲之下，是一副结实而充满运动活力的身躯。她拥有一对柔软的C罩杯乳房和修长的臀部，这些部位为她紧实的小翘臀增添了韵味。卡莉丝那圆润的脸颊之间，长着一颗剃得干干净净的阴囊，以及那处理所应当属于处女的肛门。

我们干脆聊聊吧？”你提议道，靠在附近的墙上。

    卡莉丝也跟着做了同样的动作，双手交叉放在自己紧实的腰间。她那绯红色的嘴唇上浮现出一丝微笑：“聊聊而已？嗯，这样的机会我当然不会拒绝。 [flags.CALISE_TALK|在这些黯淡的时光里，一丝寻常的宁静与美好|即使在这些艰难的时刻，也要努力结交朋友。]那就说吧。

rows.translation: 那么，卡莉丝究竟是如何成为一位神圣冠军的呢？
rows.raw: "So how'd Calise become a divine champion?"

rows.original: Where'd the other human in the legion go after the fight on the bridge?
rows.translation: 在桥上的那场战斗之后，军团里的另一个人去哪里了？
rows.raw: "Where'd the other human in the legion go after the fight on the bridge?"

rows.original: What's Calise's take on the great capital of the kingdom?
rows.translation: 卡莉丝对这座王国的首都有什么看法？
rows.raw: "What's Calise's take on the great capital of the kingdom?"

rows.original: What can Calise tell you about the minoan king?
rows.translation: 卡莉丝能告诉你关于米诺斯国王的哪些事情呢？
rows.raw: "What can Calise tell you about the minoan king?"

rows.original: [pc.isSoulbound|"So how do you end up becoming a god's champion anyway?"|"So how did you end up binding to Velun, Calise?"] Calise chuckles, brushing a lock of dark hair behind an ear. "It's a less interesting story than you'd expect. The path of the paladin is long and hard: I was chosen to be a crusader when I was just a child, following in my father's footsteps. My homeland was wild and untamed, entirely unsettled beyond our lone city. Most of the humans were afraid to venture far afield thanks to the near-endless varieties of beastkin that surrounded our mountainside hold. Me, though? I loved it. I took any chance to range out, meeting the wilderfolk of the foothills and deep woods beyond — even back then, I suppose I had an affinity for minotaurs, and made good friends with a large tribe of hunter-gatherers that lived nearby. What time I spent within the walls of my home was spent mastering martial combat and magic alike; the rest, learning to survive the wilds and how to fight those beastkin that would threaten my home. Eventually, the Oakbound's church granted me knighthood, and again I followed my father's footsteps towards becoming the archknight of the faith. I suppose you could say becoming a divine champion was my birthright, though I like to think I excelled in my skills enough to merit it on my own. The title isn't inherently passed down bloodlines, at least." "So your father was a paladin, too? Where was your mother in all this?" "Ah," Calise says, glancing down at her feet. "She was... a powerful sorceress. I rarely saw her, growing up, for our city's mages were sequestered in a great tower where they worked their spells. As a knight, I saw her more: we were called on to escort magisters when they needed to range out in search of materials for their work, and somehow I was always the one chosen when it was my mother that needed protection. We weren't close, but she took the opportunity to teach me a bit of wizard-lore; I suppose I should thank her for that much. She even introduced me to our princess, though that I shan't thank her for at all: an absolute ruthless, cut-throat bitch of a brat, she was, and made my life hell every second she could sink her claws into me. Made me glad that my devotion was to a deity of nature, and I had ample excuse to spend as little time in the city as I could." You nod along. "So is that what brought you out here? Just getting away from home?" She shakes her head. "Well, yes and no. I came to the Frost Marches to find new lands to explore, but I'd said goodbye to my city long before that. It was... well, not destroyed, but severely reduced by a magical accident while I was afield. Demons attacked us shortly thereafter, overrunning what was left; it was all I could do to protect the fleeing survivors and get them to safety. To this day our great towers stand as a corrupted beacon overlooking the mountains, a testament to the hubris of unchecked magisters." [pc.bg scholar arcanist|A tower of sequestered magisters destroyed by demons? That sounds like Estelore, the great arcane academy from Old Belhar... but that was more than two centuries ago. Could Calise be older than she looks?|That story sounds vaguely familiar — something similar happened during the Godswar, didn't it? Either Calise's way older than she looks, or mages really never learn...] "Mmm. Sorry, I've made myself sad," Calise says, forcing a little laugh. "Gods above, even after all this time, thinking about what happened [silly|gives me conniptions|sends a shiver down my spine]. Anyway, suffice to say that after my homeland was destroyed, I chose to wander and behold Velun's beautiful creation for myself — and if I find an opportunity to cleave through demonkind on my travels, as I have now, then all the better!" [pc.bg acolyte|"Amen to that."]
rows.translation: [pc.isSoulbound|那么，你究竟是怎么成为神的使者的呢？|那么，卡莉丝，你究竟是怎么与维伦绑定在一起的？] 卡莉丝轻笑着，把一缕深色的头发拨到耳后。“这个故事并没有你想象中那么有趣。圣骑士的道路漫长而艰难：我还在小时候就被选中成为十字军战士，要继承我父亲的使命。我的故乡是一片荒野，未受人类影响，除了我们那座孤零零的城市之外，其他地方都完全没有人居住。由于在我们居住的山坡周围有各种各样、几乎数不胜数的野兽，大多数人类都不敢冒险前往远处。不过，我呢？我非常喜欢那里。只要有机会，我就会去那些偏远的地方，去结识山脚下的野人以及森林深处的居民——我想，从那时候起，我就对弥诺陶洛斯有一种特殊的感情，我还和附近的一个大型狩猎采集部落建立了良好的友谊。我在家中度过的每一刻，都被用来钻研武术与魔法；其余的时间，则用来学习如何在野外生存，以及如何对抗那些会威胁到我家园的兽人。最终，橡木之地的教会授予我骑士头衔，于是我再次追随父亲的脚步，踏上了成为这一信仰的首席骑士的道路。我想，可以说成为神圣冠军是我的与生俱来的权利，不过我更愿意认为，是我自己的努力让我的能力足以获得这个称号。至少，这个头衔并不是通过血缘关系传承下来的。 所以你父亲也是一名圣骑士？那你母亲在这件事中扮演了什么角色？” “啊，”卡莉丝低头看着自己的足部说道，“她……是一位强大的女巫。在我成长的过程中，我很少见到她，因为我们城市的法师们都被关在一座巨大的塔里，在那里研究魔法。作为一名骑士，我经常见到她：每当法师们需要外出寻找研究所需的材料时，我们就会被指派负责护送他们。而每当我的母亲需要保护时，被选中的总是我。我们关系并不亲密，但她还是抓住机会向我讲解了一些关于巫师的知识；我想，为此我确实应该感谢她。她甚至还把我引见了我们的公主。那个我根本不会感谢她：她就是个冷酷无情、残忍至极的泼妇，她让我的生活变得糟透了，只要有机会伤害我，她就会不择手段地这么做。正因为我信仰的是自然之神，所以我才有充分的理由尽量少待在城市里。你点了点头，说道：“所以，这就是你来到这里的原因吗？只是为了远离家乡吗？” 她摇了摇头，回答道：“嗯，可以说是一部分原因，也可以说不是。我来霜冻边境，确实是想寻找新的地方去探索，但其实在我来之前，我就已经离开了我的城市。那……嗯，算不上吧。被摧毁但在我外出执行任务时，一场突如其来的魔法事故使这些防御工事遭到了严重破坏。不久之后，恶魔发起了攻击，剩余的防御设施根本无法抵挡它们的攻势；我只能竭尽全力保护那些正在逃亡的幸存者，帮助他们安全撤离。直到今天，我们那些高大的塔楼依然矗立在那里，成为一片被腐蚀的遗迹，俯瞰着群山……这一切，都在见证那些肆无忌惮、滥用魔力的法师们的傲慢与愚蠢。 [pc.bg scholar arcanist|一座被恶魔摧毁的、由隐居的法师们建立的塔楼？这听起来像是老贝尔哈尔时期那座伟大的奥术学院——埃斯特洛尔……但那已经是两个多世纪以前的事了。难道卡莉丝的实际年龄比看上去要大吗？|那个故事听起来有点耳熟——在“神战”期间也发生过类似的事情，对吧？要么是卡莉丝的实际年龄比看上去要大得多，要么就是法师们确实永远都学不会……] 嗯……对不起，我让自己难过了，”卡莉丝强挤出一丝笑意说道，“天啊，即使过了这么久，一想到当时发生的事情[silly|真让我气得够呛。|让我不寒而栗]总之，可以说，在我的故乡被毁之后，我选择了四处游历，亲自欣赏维伦创造的这片美丽世界。而如果在旅途中有机会消灭那些恶魔，就像现在这样，那就再好不过了！ [pc.bg acolyte|阿门，愿如此。]

Either Calise's way older than she looks, or mages really never learn...] "Mmm. Sorry, I've made myself sad," Calise says, forcing a little laugh. "Gods above, even after all this time, thinking about what happened [silly|gives me conniptions|sends a shiver down my spine]. Anyway, suffice to say that after my homeland was destroyed, I chose to wander and behold Velun's beautiful creation for myself — and if I find an opportunity to cleave through demonkind on my travels, as I have now, then all the better!" [pc.bg acolyte|"Amen to that."]'

rows.original:
"So what happened to Isadora?" you ask, glancing at the group of soldiers behind Calise — all minotaur men.

    "Ah, sweet little Isadora," Calise smiles, "she's in the city proper. Her cohort was granted a much-needed leave after our last expedition. I'm sure you can find most of them scattered around the city's brothels and bath houses; if not there, then perhaps she's actually taken my advice and gone to see her parents. She's their only remaining child, you know, so I do try and impress on her that if she insists on accompanying us on combat patrols she must go tell her parents she's alright as soon as we return."
    
    You nod. "Thanks. You seem to know her pretty well."
    
    "Better than anybody else in the city. We human warrior-women must stick together!" Calise laughs. "As soon as the first imp attacks began and I volunteered to help the city, Isadora practically attached herself to me at the hip. Because of her stature, she's not usually allowed to fight on the front lines — she's just too short compared to the minotaurs that would stand beside her in the shield wall, not for any lack of skill — but since I'm here throwing myself head-first into danger anyway, she managed to throw a loud enough fit to finally convince her commander to let her join the patrols. Flying imps make a mess of shield walls anyway, it turns out, and having somebody small enough to weave between the bulls' legs to chop down any that get through has proven useful enough."
    
    Calise sighs, resting a hand on her greataxe. "Besides that? She's a sweet girl. Devoted, passionate, upstanding. Reminds me of myself when I was younger and the world was so fresh and full of wonder. I've done what I can to mentor her while I'm here; what she lacks in experience she makes up for in commitment to her city and her comrades. When I leave or fall in battle, I'll know that Khor'minos is in good hands while she stands."
rows.translation:
那么，伊莎多拉后来怎么样了？”你问道，同时瞥了一眼卡莉丝身后那群士兵——他们全都是弥诺陶洛斯。

    “啊，可爱的小伊莎多拉……”卡莉丝微笑着说道，“她现在在城里。在我们上次远征之后，她的队伍获得了他们迫切需要的休假机会。我敢肯定，这些地方大多分布在城里的妓院和浴场里；如果不在那里，那么也许她真的听从了我的建议，去见了她的父母。你知道的，她是他们唯一剩下的孩子，所以我一直劝她，如果她坚持要和我们一起参加战斗巡逻，那么等我们回来后，她一定要去告诉父母自己安然无恙。"
    
    你点了点头：“谢谢。看来你和她关系相当熟吧。”
    
    “比这个城市里的任何人都熟。我们这些女性战士必须团结在一起！”卡莉丝笑着说，“自从第一次遭遇那些邪魔的攻击，我主动提出要帮助这座城市时，伊莎多拉几乎就一直跟着我。由于她的身高原因，她通常不被允许参加前线战斗——与那些站在她身旁组成盾墙的弥诺陶洛斯相比，她实在太矮了，不过这并不是因为她缺乏战斗能力。但既然我已经决定冒险前往前线，她终于成功地吵闹了一番，让指挥官同意让她加入巡逻队。事实证明，那些会飞的小妖精无论如何都会把盾牌墙弄得一片混乱，而派一些体型足够小、能够从那些巨兽的腿间穿过去来消灭那些突破防线的小妖精，确实是非常有效的办法。
    
    卡莉丝叹了口气，将手放在她那把巨斧上。“除此之外呢？她是个善良的女孩——忠诚、热情、正直。她让我想起了自己年轻时的样子，那时世界还如此新鲜、充满奇迹。在我在这里的这段时间里，我已经尽了自己所能去指导她；她在经验上可能有所欠缺，但她在对城市和同伴的忠诚上弥补了这一不足。当我离开或者战死沙场时，我知道只要她还在，科尔米诺斯就会有人来守护。
