rows.original: [var0 |"So... we should talk about you," you say. "The real you." Calise sighs[party.som | |, and gives your companion a withering look that quickly clears the room for just the two of you |, and gives your companions a withering look that quickly clears the room for just the two of you ]. "I thought this might be coming. I'm afraid I have nothing to say on the matter beyond what we discussed on the palace roof. I am what I am, not by choice but by another's violence. I really am a knight, oathed to protect all that is good and wholesome, but... before I came to this city, I was seized by a demon witch and tortured, violently and intimately, until I lost my mind... and my very soul. What you see now is how I appeared in my past life, as a human, before my humanity was stripped away. I would be lying if I said I found the power I have gained entirely repulsive, however. I have torn through hordes of demons that my old self would never have been able to stand up against. It has given me the strength to protect this city." "How am I supposed to believe you're really on my side?" "Because I despise those other demons! Those feckless imps! Seeing them fills me with utter revulsion and contempt, the same as it ever did! And Tollus worst of all, the damnable traitor!" She pauses, faltering. "And... perhaps I truly do want to protect this city. I don't... I don't rightly know anymore. My thoughts and feelings are confused these days. I did a lot of damage to this world, [pc.name], when I was fully in the grasp of vainglorious demonhood. I won't pretend that I am somehow able to assure you I won't do more in the future. I can only try and prove my sincerity through my actions. I have fought hard to protect Khor'minos... and I will fight even harder to protect you, if it comes to it. That is my truth, no matter what you may believe." |[calise.isKasyrra |"My story?" Kas echoes, pursing her lips. "Well, I do have a favorite story about a cow learning the dangers of magic..." "No," you sigh, "your story. Who really are you?" She tsks her tongue. "I know, dear. Are you going to deprive a girl of all her secrets just like that? Really now! But I suppose you have a right to know who you're dealing with after all this time. Fine, then. The truth of it." Your demonic lover sighs, leaning back into the cushions. "Let's seeeeee. I come from a plane called Mareth. It's... kind of a shithole now. There was a time when it was beautiful and abundant and so full of wonder... but the demons ruined all of that. Turned it into a dumpster that the planes' trash falls into, never to escape. Before I was born, my ancestors used a powerful spell to transport their entire city from their home plane into Mareth. The story goes that they were explorers from a realm abundant and overflowing with magic, charting the cosmos in their enchanted city-ship. Mareth proved too much for them, though. The city crashed into the mountains on the realm's far eastern reaches, causing a great deal of damage to the arcane devices powering the place. It flew no more after that." "Around the time I was born, the gods of Mareth took notice of our presence on their virginal world, and started mutating the animals of the plane into beastkin like minotaurs and lupines and centaurs. Jealous of the human form, I suppose. Oh, and yes, I was human once, appearances aside. All of the city's inhabitants were magicians, though my father was what you'd call a spellblade — a knight who wove magic into his swordfighting. He was the Lord Commander of the Watch, the force our king erected to protect the city from the beastkin and monsters starting to flail cluelessly about beyond our walls. It might surprise you to learn that I followed in his footsteps, rather than those of my mother, an archmage." You glance at her giant axe sitting across the room. "Not really." Kas snorts. "I walked into that, didn't I? Alright, smart ass, let me tell you something else you already know while I'm at it: when I was mortal, my proper form of address was Ser Kasyrra Arellian, Lady Captain of the Watch. I was chosen to be a knight like my father when I was just a little girl. We were pressed on all sides by predatory beastkin just learning to strike fires from flint, while we commanded steel and arch-magic. It wasn't a contest to keep the city safe, but the mages were dreadfully afraid of the world they'd stumbled into all the same, especially the strange new gods within it. Worse, they couldn't leave. Mareth traps anything within it, refusing to allow anything to travel to planes beyond itself. The Watch's main role was protecting mage expeditions out into the wilderlands, down from the mountains into the deep forests and myriad lakes, even to the island palace of the goddess Marae, whence the name of the world itself. That was when I learned most of my black magic: accompanying my rancid bitch of a mother on countless pointless treks to understand the new world better, to try and find some new way of breaching the Veil of Worlds and returning their city whence it came. Mother never cared for me much, thought I was 'a dumb brute' but still, I suppose she considered it a point of pride that no child of hers should have been uneducated in the dark arts." You pause her. "So why did the mages come to Mareth in the first place?" "I don't know," Kas shrugs. "Not really. The murals in the Tower of the Griffon spoke of some terrible darkness unleashed on my ancestors' home world, of a great expedition set forth to chart the cosmos. Of a great and terrible source of magic unlike any they had ever encountered before, which they set out to find. Whether they were searching for a powerful weapon to defend their original world, or sought a new world to escape to, I couldn't tell you. Much of our history was lost in the transit to Mareth; it was a hard landing." |[pc.isSoulbound |"So how do you end up becoming a god's champion anyway?" |"So how did you end up binding to Velun, Calise?" ] Calise chuckles, brushing a lock of dark hair behind an ear. "It's a less interesting story than you'd expect. The path of the paladin is long and hard: I was chosen to be a crusader when I was just a child, following in my father's footsteps. My homeland was wild and untamed, entirely unsettled beyond our lone city. Most of the humans were afraid to venture far afield thanks to the near-endless varieties of beastkin that surrounded our mountainside hold. Me, though? I loved it. I took any chance to range out, meeting the wilderfolk of the foothills and deep woods beyond — even back then, I suppose I had an affinity for minotaurs, and made good friends with a large tribe of hunter-gatherers that lived nearby. What time I spent within the walls of my home was spent mastering martial combat and magic alike; the rest, learning to survive the wilds and how to fight those beastkin that would threaten my home. Eventually, the Oakbound's church granted me knighthood, and again I followed my father's footsteps towards becoming the archknight of the faith. I suppose you could say becoming a divine champion was my birthright, though I like to think I excelled in my skills enough to merit it on my own. The title isn't inherently passed down bloodlines, at least." "So your father was a paladin, too? Where was your mother in all this?" "Ah," Calise says, glancing down at her feet. "She was... a powerful sorceress. I rarely saw her, growing up, for our city's mages were sequestered in a great tower where they worked their spells. As a knight, I saw her more: we were called on to escort magisters when they needed to range out in search of materials for their work, and somehow I was always the one chosen when it was my mother that needed protection. We weren't close, but she took the opportunity to teach me a bit of wizard-lore; I suppose I should thank her for that much. She even introduced me to our princess, though that I shan't thank her for at all: an absolute ruthless, cut-throat bitch of a brat, she was, and made my life hell every second she could sink her claws into me. Made me glad that my devotion was to a deity of nature, and I had ample excuse to spend as little time in the city as I could." You nod along. "So is that what brought you out here? Just getting away from home?" She shakes her head. "Well, yes and no. I came to the Frost Marches to find new lands to explore, but I'd said goodbye to my city long before that. It was... well, not destroyed, but severely reduced by a magical accident while I was afield. Demons attacked us shortly thereafter, overrunning what was left; it was all I could do to protect the fleeing survivors and get them to safety. To this day our great towers stand as a corrupted beacon overlooking the mountains, a testament to the hubris of unchecked magisters." [pc.bg scholar arcanist |A tower of sequestered magisters destroyed by demons? That sounds like Estelore, the great arcane academy from Old Belhar... but that was more than two centuries ago. Could Calise be older than she looks? |That story sounds vaguely familiar — something similar happened during the Godswar, didn't it? Either Calise's way older than she looks, or mages really never learn... ] "Mmm. Sorry, I've made myself sad," Calise says, forcing a little laugh. "Gods above, even after all this time, thinking about what happened [silly |gives me conniptions |sends a shiver down my spine ]. Anyway, suffice to say that after my homeland was destroyed, I chose to wander and behold Velun's beautiful creation for myself — and if I find an opportunity to cleave through demonkind on my travels, as I have now, then all the better!" [pc.bg acolyte |"Amen to that." ] [calise.isDemon |You have to ask though... "So, how did you become a demon?" Calise winces. "I... mm. I was captured while trying to protect some cows, very early in the conflict. Before I was known to this city, even. A powerful demoness tortured me for... for a very long time, used me in the most despicable ways. Her, and the imps she sired on me." The paladin shudders with revulsion. "Eventually I lost my soul, but not the hatred I held for her and her kind. The moment she took my lethicite — my crystalized soul — I used my newfound shapeshifting powers to escape my bonds and kill her. I wandered aimlessly for a while, even helped other demons, but when I arrived in Khor'minos I knew what I had to do. I couldn't let the city fall. I would not see another frightened sanctum burn before demonic corruption." Calise rubs the black ring on her finger and sighs. "I only pray I have strength enough to stop Tollus's plans for this city..." ] ] ]
rows.translation: [var0 |那么……我们应该谈谈这个话题。你是这么说的，”你说，“真正的你。” 卡莉丝叹了口气。[party.som | |然后你向你的同伴投去一个冷冰冰的眼神，这一眼神立刻让房间里其他人都离开了，只剩下你们两个人。 |然后，你向你的同伴们投去一个冷峻的眼神，这一眼神立刻让房间里其他人全都离开了，只剩下你们两个人。 ]我就知道会这样。恐怕关于这件事，我除了在宫殿屋顶上与我们讨论过的内容之外，没有什么其他要说的了。我的现状并非我自己的选择，而是他人暴力造成的。我确实是一名骑士，发誓要保护一切善良美好的事物，但是……在我来到这座城市之前，我被一个恶魔女巫抓住，遭受了残酷而羞辱性的折磨，直到我失去了理智……甚至失去了灵魂。你们现在看到的，就是我前世作为人类时的样子，也就是在我的人性被彻底剥夺之前的样子。不过，如果我说自己完全讨厌这种获得的力量，那肯定是谎言。我曾经击败过无数恶魔，而这些恶魔是我以前的自己根本无法抵抗的。这种力量让我拥有了保护这座城市的实力。我怎么才能相信你真的是站在我这一边的呢？” “因为我鄙视那些其他的恶魔！那些无能的家伙！看到他们，我就感到无比的厌恶和轻蔑，就像过去一样！还有托勒斯，那个该死的叛徒！”她停顿了一下，声音有些颤抖，“或许……我真的想要保护这座城市。但我已经……不再确定自己的想法了。这些天来，我的思绪和情感都变得混乱不堪。我确实给这个世界带来了很多伤害[pc.name]，就在我完全沉溺于那种虚荣的恶魔本性之中的时候。我不敢假装自己能够保证将来不会再做出同样的事。我只能用自己的行动来证明自己的诚意。我曾经为保护科尔米诺斯而奋力战斗……如果需要的话，我也会为保护你们而付出更多的努力。这就是我的真相，无论你们相信与否。 |[calise.isKasyrra |我的故事？”卡丝轻声重复道，嘴唇微微撅起。“嗯，我确实有一个最喜欢的故事，讲的是一头牛如何明白了魔法的危险……” “不，”你叹了口气，你的故事……你究竟是谁呢？” 她吐了吐舌头：“我知道，亲爱的。你真的要就这样剥夺一个女孩的所有秘密吗？真的吗？不过我想，经过这么长时间，你确实有权利知道自己在和谁打交道。好吧，那就告诉你吧……真相就是…… 你那恶魔般的恋人叹了口气，靠在靠垫上说道：“让我想想……我来自一个叫做玛瑞斯的星球。现在那里……已经变成了一片废墟。曾经，那里风景优美，资源丰富，充满神奇与美好……但恶魔们毁了一切。他们将那个地方变成了一个垃圾场，飞机的废弃物都被扔进那里，再也无法逃脱。在我出生之前，我的祖先们使用了一个强大的魔法，将他们的整座城市从他们的母星转移到了玛瑞斯。传说中，他们是来自一个充满魔法、魔法资源极其丰富的世界的探险者，在他们那艘被施了魔法的城市飞船上，他们不断探索宇宙。然而，玛瑞斯对他们来说实在是难以应对。这座城市坠入了王国最东端的山脉中，导致为该地区提供动力的那些神秘装置遭受了严重破坏。从那以后，它再也无法飞行了。 在我出生的那段时间，玛瑞特的神明注意到了我们这些人类存在于他们这个纯净的世界中，于是开始将这个世界的动物变异成半兽人形态，比如米诺陶洛斯、狼人以及半人马。我想，他们是嫉妒人类的外形吧。哦，对了，我就是在那个时候诞生的。人类有一次，抛开外表不谈，这座城市里的所有居民都是魔法师。不过我的父亲属于那种将魔法融入剑术中的骑士——也就是你们所说的“法刃骑士”。他是守卫军的最高指挥官，而我们的国王正是组建这支军队，用来保护城市免受那些在城墙外四处肆虐的野兽和怪物的侵害。你可能会感到惊讶，但我选择追随他的脚步，而不是我那位大魔导师母亲的道路。 你瞥了一眼放在房间另一边的那把巨斧，说道：“其实并不是。” 卡希哼了一声：“不就是我走进了那个地方吗？好吧，自作聪明的家伙，既然我正在说话，那就再告诉你一件你本来就已经知道的事情吧：在我还是凡人的时候，我的正式称呼应该是‘卡希拉·阿雷利安爵士’，也就是‘守卫队的女队长’。在我还是个小女孩的时候，就被选中要像我的父亲一样成为一名骑士。那时，我们四面受敌——那些刚刚学会用打火石生火的掠食性兽人正不断向我们发起攻击，而我们却掌握着钢铁武器与强大的弓箭魔法。这场战斗并不是为了保护城市的安全，但法师们依然对这个世界充满了恐惧，尤其是对其中那些陌生的新神明。更糟糕的是，他们根本无法离开。玛雷斯会将任何进入其范围内的东西都困住，绝不允许任何东西从这里逃往外界。守望者组织的主要职责就是保护那些前往荒野地区的法师探险队——这些探险队会从山脉出发，穿过茂密的森林和众多的湖泊，甚至会前往玛拉女神的岛屿宫殿，而这个世界的名字也正是由此而来的。就是在那个时候，我学会了大部分那些“黑魔法”：陪伴着我那个脾气暴躁、令人讨厌的母亲，参加了一次又一次毫无意义的远足，试图更好地了解这个新世界，寻找某种新的方法来突破“世界之幕”，让他们的城市重新回到原来的地方。母亲从来都不太关心我，认为我是个“愚笨的家伙”，但即便如此，我想她应该也为自己的孩子们都没有在黑暗魔法方面受到教育而感到自豪吧。 你打断了她：“那么，那些法师最初为什么会来到马雷斯呢？” “我不知道，”卡希耸了耸肩，“真的不知道。狮鹫塔里的壁画上记载着一些关于降临在我祖先故乡世界的可怕黑暗力量，还有关于一支为探索宇宙而出发的远征队的事迹。这是一种极其强大且可怕的魔法源泉，是他们迄今为止从未遇到过的。他们开始寻找这种魔法。究竟他们是想找到一件强大的武器来保卫自己的家园，还是想寻找一个新的世界作为避难所，我实在无从知晓。我们在前往马雷斯的途中失去了许多珍贵的历史资料；那真是一次艰难的旅程。 |[pc.isSoulbound |那么，你究竟是怎么成为神的使者的呢？ |那么，卡莉丝，你究竟是怎么与维伦绑定在一起的？ ] 卡莉丝轻笑着，把一缕深色的头发拨到耳后。“这个故事并没有你想象中那么有趣。圣骑士的道路漫长而艰辛：我还在小时候就被选中成为十字军战士，要追随我父亲的脚步。我的故乡是一片荒野，未受人类影响，除了我们那座孤零零的城市之外，其他地方都完全没有人居住。由于在我们居住的山坡周围有各种各样、几乎数不胜数的野兽，大多数人类都不敢冒险前往远处。不过，我呢？我非常喜欢那里。只要有机会，我就会去那些偏远的地方，去结识山脚下的野人以及森林深处的居民——我想，从那时起，我就对弥诺陶洛斯有一种特殊的感情，我还和附近的一个大型狩猎采集部落建立了良好的友谊。我在家中度过的每一刻，都被用来钻研武术与魔法；其余的时间，则用来学习如何在野外生存，以及如何对抗那些会威胁到我家园的兽人。最终，橡树之国的教会授予我骑士头衔，于是我再次追随父亲的脚步，踏上了成为这一信仰的首席骑士的道路。我想，可以说成为神圣冠军是我的与生俱来的权利，不过我更愿意认为，是我自己的努力让我的能力足以获得这个称号。至少，这个头衔并不是通过血缘关系传承下来的。 所以你的父亲也是一名圣骑士？那你的母亲在这件事中扮演了什么角色？” “啊，”卡莉丝低头看着自己的足部说道，“她……是一位强大的女巫。在我成长的过程中，我很少见到她，因为我们城市的法师们都被关在一座巨大的塔里，在那里研究魔法。作为一名骑士，我经常见到她：每当法师们需要外出寻找研究所需的材料时，我们就会被指派负责护送他们。而每当我的母亲需要保护时，被选中的总是我。我们关系并不亲密，但她还是抓住机会向我讲解了一些关于巫师的知识；我想，为此我确实应该感谢她。她甚至还把我引见了我们的公主。那个我根本不会感谢她：她就是一个彻头彻尾、冷酷无情、残忍至极的泼妇，她让我的生活变得苦不堪言，只要有机会伤害我，她就会不择手段地这么做。正因为我的信仰是自然之神，所以我才有充分的理由尽可能少地待在城市里。你点了点头，说道：“所以，这就是你来到这里的原因吗？只是为了离开家而已？” 她摇了摇头，回答道：“嗯，可以说是一部分原因，也可以说不是。我来霜冻边境，确实是想寻找新的地方去探索，但其实在我来之前，我就已经离开了我的城市。那……嗯，算不上吧。被摧毁但在我外出执行任务时，一场突如其来的魔法事故使它的规模大幅缩小。不久之后，恶魔发起了攻击，彻底摧毁了残余的部分；我只能竭尽全力保护那些正在逃亡的幸存者，帮助他们安全撤离。直到今天，我们那些高大的塔楼依然矗立在那里，成为一片被腐蚀的土地上的标志，也印证了那些肆无忌惮、滥用魔力的法师们的傲慢与狂妄。 [pc.bg scholar arcanist |一座被恶魔摧毁的、由隐居的法师们建立的塔楼？这听起来像是老贝尔哈尔时期那座著名的奥术学院——埃斯特洛尔……但那已经是两个多世纪以前的事了。难道卡莉丝的实际年龄比看上去要大吗？ |那个故事听起来有点耳熟——在“神战”期间也发生过类似的事情，对吧？要么是卡莉丝的实际年龄比看上去要大得多，要么就是法师们确实永远都学不会…… ] 嗯……对不起，我让自己难过了，”卡莉丝强挤出一丝笑意说道，“天啊，即使过了这么久，一想到当时发生的事情[silly |真让我气得够呛。 |让我不寒而栗 ]总之，可以这么说：在我的故乡被毁之后，我选择了四处游历，亲自欣赏维伦创造的这片美丽世界。而如果在旅途中有机会消灭那些恶魔，就像现在这样，那就再好不过了！ [pc.bg acolyte |阿门，愿如此。 ] [calise.isDemon |不过你得问问……“那么，你是怎么变成恶魔的呢？” 卡莉丝微微皱起了眉头。“我……嗯，是在冲突刚开始的时候，我在试图保护一些牛的时候被抓走了。甚至在那之前，这个城市还根本不认识我呢。一个强大的女恶魔折磨了我……很长一段时间，用最卑鄙的方式利用我。她，还有她在我身上生下的那些小恶魔们…… 圣骑士不禁感到一阵厌恶，浑身发抖。“最终，我失去了灵魂，但我对她以及她那一类人的仇恨却丝毫未减。当她夺走了我的莱瑟石——那象征着我灵魂结晶的物品——我便立刻运用自己新获得的变形能力挣脱束缚，杀死了她。之后我漫无目的地游荡了一段时间，甚至还帮助过其他恶魔，但当来到科尔米诺斯时，我终于明白了自己必须做什么。我绝不能让这座城市陷落。我绝不能眼睁睁看着另一个充满恐惧的避难所在恶魔的腐蚀下被烧毁。 卡莉丝摩挲着手指上的那枚黑色戒指，叹了口气：“我只希望自己有足够的力量来阻止托勒斯对这个城市的阴谋……" ] ] ]
rows.raw: ' [var0 |"So... we should talk about you," you say. "The real you." Calise sighs[party.som | |, and gives your companion a withering look that quickly clears the room for just the two of you |, and gives your companions a withering look that quickly clears the room for just the two of you ]. "I thought this might be coming. I'm afraid I have nothing to say on the matter beyond what we discussed on the palace roof. I am what I am, not by choice but by another's violence. I really am a knight, oathed to protect all that is good and wholesome, but... before I came to this city, I was seized by a demon witch and tortured, violently and intimately, until I lost my mind... and my very soul. What you see now is how I appeared in my past life, as a human, before my humanity was stripped away. I would be lying if I said I found the power I have gained entirely repulsive, however. I have torn through hordes of demons that my old self would never have been able to stand up against. It has given me the strength to protect this city." "How am I supposed to believe you're really on my side?" "Because I despise those other demons! Those feckless imps! Seeing them fills me with utter revulsion and contempt, the same as it ever did! And Tollus worst of all, the damnable traitor!" She pauses, faltering. "And... perhaps I truly do want to protect this city. I don't... I don't rightly know anymore. My thoughts and feelings are confused these days. I did a lot of damage to this world, [pc.name], when I was fully in the grasp of vainglorious demonhood. I won't pretend that I am somehow able to assure you I won't do more in the future. I can only try and prove my sincerity through my actions. I have fought hard to protect Khor'minos... and I will fight even harder to protect you, if it comes to it. That is my truth, no matter what you may believe." |[calise.isKasyrra |"My story?" Kas echoes, pursing her lips. "Well, I do have a favorite story about a cow learning the dangers of magic..." "No," you sigh, "your story. Who really are you?" She tsks her tongue. "I know, dear. Are you going to deprive a girl of all her secrets just like that? Really now! But I suppose you have a right to know who you're dealing with after all this time. Fine, then. The truth of it." Your demonic lover sighs, leaning back into the cushions. "Let's seeeeee. I come from a plane called Mareth. It's... kind of a shithole now. There was a time when it was beautiful and abundant and so full of wonder... but the demons ruined all of that. Turned it into a dumpster that the planes' trash falls into, never to escape. Before I was born, my ancestors used a powerful spell to transport their entire city from their home plane into Mareth. The story goes that they were explorers from a realm abundant and overflowing with magic, charting the cosmos in their enchanted city-ship. Mareth proved too much for them, though. The city crashed into the mountains on the realm's far eastern reaches, causing a great deal of damage to the arcane devices powering the place. It flew no more after that." "Around the time I was born, the gods of Mareth took notice of our presence on their virginal world, and started mutating the animals of the plane into beastkin like minotaurs and lupines and centaurs. Jealous of the human form, I suppose. Oh, and yes, I was human once, appearances aside. All of the city's inhabitants were magicians, though my father was what you'd call a spellblade — a knight who wove magic into his swordfighting. He was the Lord Commander of the Watch, the force our king erected to protect the city from the beastkin and monsters starting to flail cluelessly about beyond our walls. It might surprise you to learn that I followed in his footsteps, rather than those of my mother, an archmage." You glance at her giant axe sitting across the room. "Not really." Kas snorts. "I walked into that, didn't I? Alright, smart ass, let me tell you something else you already know while I'm at it: when I was mortal, my proper form of address was Ser Kasyrra Arellian, Lady Captain of the Watch. I was chosen to be a knight like my father when I was just a little girl. We were pressed on all sides by predatory beastkin just learning to strike fires from flint, while we commanded steel and arch-magic. It wasn't a contest to keep the city safe, but the mages were dreadfully afraid of the world they'd stumbled into all the same, especially the strange new gods within it. Worse, they couldn't leave. Mareth traps anything within it, refusing to allow anything to travel to planes beyond itself. The Watch's main role was protecting mage expeditions out into the wilderlands, down from the mountains into the deep forests and myriad lakes, even to the island palace of the goddess Marae, whence the name of the world itself. That was when I learned most of my black magic: accompanying my rancid bitch of a mother on countless pointless treks to understand the new world better, to try and find some new way of breaching the Veil of Worlds and returning their city whence it came. Mother never cared for me much, thought I was 'a dumb brute' but still, I suppose she considered it a point of pride that no child of hers should have been uneducated in the dark arts." You pause her. "So why did the mages come to Mareth in the first place?" "I don't know," Kas shrugs. "Not really. The murals in the Tower of the Griffon spoke of some terrible darkness unleashed on my ancestors' home world, of a great expedition set forth to chart the cosmos. Of a great and terrible source of magic unlike any they had ever encountered before, which they set out to find. Whether they were searching for a powerful weapon to defend their original world, or sought a new world to escape to, I couldn't tell you. Much of our history was lost in the transit to Mareth; it was a hard landing." |[pc.isSoulbound |"So how do you end up becoming a god's champion anyway?" |"So how did you end up binding to Velun, Calise?" ] Calise chuckles, brushing a lock of dark hair behind an ear. "It's a less interesting story than you'd expect. The path of the paladin is long and hard: I was chosen to be a crusader when I was just a child, following in my father's footsteps. My homeland was wild and untamed, entirely unsettled beyond our lone city. Most of the humans were afraid to venture far afield thanks to the near-endless varieties of beastkin that surrounded our mountainside hold. Me, though? I loved it. I took any chance to range out, meeting the wilderfolk of the foothills and deep woods beyond — even back then, I suppose I had an affinity for minotaurs, and made good friends with a large tribe of hunter-gatherers that lived nearby. What time I spent within the walls of my home was spent mastering martial combat and magic alike; the rest, learning to survive the wilds and how to fight those beastkin that would threaten my home. Eventually, the Oakbound's church granted me knighthood, and again I followed my father's footsteps towards becoming the archknight of the faith. I suppose you could say becoming a divine champion was my birthright, though I like to think I excelled in my skills enough to merit it on my own. The title isn't inherently passed down bloodlines, at least." "So your father was a paladin, too? Where was your mother in all this?" "Ah," Calise says, glancing down at her feet. "She was... a powerful sorceress. I rarely saw her, growing up, for our city's mages were sequestered in a great tower where they worked their spells. As a knight, I saw her more: we were called on to escort magisters when they needed to range out in search of materials for their work, and somehow I was always the one chosen when it was my mother that needed protection. We weren't close, but she took the opportunity to teach me a bit of wizard-lore; I suppose I should thank her for that much. She even introduced me to our princess, though that I shan't thank her for at all: an absolute ruthless, cut-throat bitch of a brat, she was, and made my life hell every second she could sink her claws into me. Made me glad that my devotion was to a deity of nature, and I had ample excuse to spend as little time in the city as I could." You nod along. "So is that what brought you out here? Just getting away from home?" She shakes her head. "Well, yes and no. I came to the Frost Marches to find new lands to explore, but I'd said goodbye to my city long before that. It was... well, not destroyed, but severely reduced by a magical accident while I was afield. Demons attacked us shortly thereafter, overrunning what was left; it was all I could do to protect the fleeing survivors and get them to safety. To this day our great towers stand as a corrupted beacon overlooking the mountains, a testament to the hubris of unchecked magisters." [pc.bg scholar arcanist |A tower of sequestered magisters destroyed by demons? That sounds like Estelore, the great arcane academy from Old Belhar... but that was more than two centuries ago. Could Calise be older than she looks? |That story sounds vaguely familiar — something similar happened during the Godswar, didn't it? Either Calise's way older than she looks, or mages really never learn... ] "Mmm. Sorry, I've made myself sad," Calise says, forcing a little laugh. "Gods above, even after all this time, thinking about what happened [silly |gives me conniptions |sends a shiver down my spine ]. Anyway, suffice to say that after my homeland was destroyed, I chose to wander and behold Velun's beautiful creation for myself — and if I find an opportunity to cleave through demonkind on my travels, as I have now, then all the better!" [pc.bg acolyte |"Amen to that." ] [calise.isDemon |You have to ask though... "So, how did you become a demon?" Calise winces. "I... mm. I was captured while trying to protect some cows, very early in the conflict. Before I was known to this city, even. A powerful demoness tortured me for... for a very long time, used me in the most despicable ways. Her, and the imps she sired on me." The paladin shudders with revulsion. "Eventually I lost my soul, but not the hatred I held for her and her kind. The moment she took my lethicite — my crystalized soul — I used my newfound shapeshifting powers to escape my bonds and kill her. I wandered aimlessly for a while, even helped other demons, but when I arrived in Khor'minos I knew what I had to do. I couldn't let the city fall. rows.original:
She continues after a pause for more wine. "So, I became a knight, a warrior-witch of the Watch. My training mixed martial and magical studies, much as a Savarran paladin's might. I spent a great deal of time exploring the world, protecting our wayfaring mages in their quests, sometimes even helping the local beastkin to learn what being human really meant. Ah, those sweet little cowgirls in the hills... can you tell, I have a certain affinity for them still?" she teases, cupping a milk-laden boob. "When it all fell apart — when our ancient mages finally overstepped for the last time — they were the ones I went to try and protect, not my own damned people. It was too late for them..."

            "What happened?"
            
            Kasyrra sips her wine again, golden eyes wandering over you for a long moment. "Something terrible. And wonderful. An apotheosis. They made themselves into demons! The ancient cabal, the oldest of our wizards, finally became so desperate that they turned to the forbidden soul arts to try and escape Mareth. They were so miserable in that beautiful, virginal world, so desperate to escape a paradise that they turned their own souls into fuel to try and power a spell strong enough to pierce the Veil of Worlds. One day the archmages all went into the Tower of the Dragon, proclaiming that they'd found the way to breach the Veil. By nightfall the city was overrun with demons, flooding from the tower like a tidal wave of corrupted cum and debauchery. I'd be shocked if fully half the lesser mages managed to escape. Almost none of the Watch did."
            
            "That was about twenty years ago. Our city's princess, Lethice — spoiled bitch of a bully that she was — became the queen of the demons sometime shortly after," Kas says with a sneer. "I never learned what happened to her father, the king. Probably bumped him off. I had been out on patrol when the first turning occurred, and when I saw the corrupted flames burning and the winged figures flocking over the city walls, I turned and ran. Tried to rally the 'survivors' that I found and get them to safety. There were small churches of beastkin protected by holy wards that offered to take us in, but I myself made for the young cities of the west, where most of the non-human population was. I rallied fighters to come and help, to stand against the tide, while the very fabric of our world broke around us."
            
            Kas breathes out, long and weary. "And I failed. Our resistance came too little, too late, and washed away by a flood of demons. I was captured. Tortured. I fell."
            
            "Oh."
rows.translation:
她稍作停顿，又喝了一口酒，继续说道：“后来，我成为了一名骑士，一名属于‘守望者’组织的战士女巫。我的训练结合了近身格斗与魔法学习，就像萨瓦兰圣骑士的训练方式一样。我花了大量时间去探索这个世界，保护那些踏上冒险征程的法师们，有时甚至还会帮助当地的野兽族成员，让他们真正理解‘人类’意味着什么。啊，那些生活在山丘上的可爱小女牛仔……你能看出，我对她们依然有着特殊的感情吧？”她调皮地说道，同时用手托着那颗充满奶水的乳房。“当一切都陷入混乱——当我们的古代法师们最后一次犯下不可饶恕的错误时，我选择去保护的是她们，而不是我自己的同胞。对他们来说，已经为时太晚了……

            发生了什么事？”
            
            卡希拉再次啜饮着她的葡萄酒，金色的眼睛长时间地注视着你。“一些可怕的事情……同时也有些奇妙的事情。那简直是一场神的降临。那些古老的法师们，我们中最古老的巫师们，终于陷入了绝境，他们不得不诉诸那些被禁止的灵魂魔法，试图逃离玛瑞斯。在那个美丽而纯净的世界里，他们感到如此痛苦，如此渴望逃离这个天堂，以至于他们不惜将自己的灵魂作为燃料，试图施展出足以突破“世界之幕”的强大法术。终于有一天，所有的首席法师们一起进入了龙之塔，宣称他们已经找到了突破这道屏障的方法。到了夜幕降临，整座城市都被恶魔淹没了——它们像一股由腐败与堕落构成的潮水一样，从那座高塔中涌了出来。如果有一半的低阶法师能够逃脱，我才会感到惊讶；而那些守卫者，几乎没有一个能够幸存下来。
            
            那是大约二十年前的事了。我们城市的公主莱西丝——那个被宠坏的刁钻丫头——在不久之后成为了恶魔的女王，”卡希冷笑道，“我从来都不知道她的父亲，也就是国王，后来发生了什么。可能是我害死了他。就在第一个转角处，我正在执行巡逻任务，当我看到那些被腐蚀的火焰在燃烧，那些有翅膀的生物在城墙上空飞舞时，我立刻转身逃跑了。我试图召集那些我遇到的“幸存者”，并把他们带到安全的地方。有一些由神圣结界保护着的兽人小教堂愿意收留我们，但我自己却选择了前往西部的那些年轻城市——那里居住着大多数非人类种族。我召集了一些战士前来帮忙，共同抗性这场正在摧毁我们世界的灾难。"
            
            卡斯长长地叹了口气，声音里充满了疲惫。“我失败了。我们的抗性太微弱、太迟了，最终被那股恶魔的洪流彻底吞没。我被俘虏了，遭受了折磨，最终倒下了。”
            
            “哦。

rows.original: "It was my own mother, too. She was always the greatest of the archmages — besides Lethice, anyway — and she used her blood connection to me as the focus for divination magic to track down city after city to destroy. I had no idea I was the cause of the demons' ceaseless advance until I came face to face with the bitch. Too late, then. She broke me herself — introduced me to the idea of a woman with a cock, then to birthing imps; the little snots made themselves self-perpetuating by my body until my soul came tearing free just like Alissa's. At least I lasted a little longer! And rather than slavering over her cock like a lovesick fool, I... I broke her neck the moment she freed me from my restraints. The only human life I've ever taken. That was a quicker death than she deserved." "Oh." "So that's me, then," Kas says evenly, biting her lip when it starts quivering slightly. "That's the story of the great demon queen: a fallen, failed paladin. Lethice scooped me up a while later, put me to work assembling her personal guard. I had nothing better to do. I moved into mother's lab and got to work, learning alchemy and magic and creating my pretty dragon daughters until Lethice's conquest ended, and she... decided to just sit around and bask in the afterglow, I suppose. I was content to be left alone in the Tower of the Griffon until everything came tumbling down again. Couldn't have happened to a nicer queen, so I snuck off with my dragon-girls and some stolen research on portals and decided to try my own veilbreach. That's when I met you. Aside from watching Aileh and the girls growing up, probably the first actually nice thing that's happened to me in two decades." Kas gives you a faltering smile. "Sorry, I don't mean to be a moodkiller. You did ask, though. You deserved to hear the truth. And perhaps now you can see a little more clearly why I'm so very happy to have met you... to find someone who's not a demon that can care for me despite my... my nature." You lean in and give Kasyrra a long, loving kiss. She melts around you, enough that you could swear her human disguise wavers a moment. "A demon's not easy to love, [pc.name]. I know that. For both our sakes... I hope when it's all said and done, I'll be worth it."
rows.translation: “而且那还是我的亲生母亲。她一直都是最伟大的大法师——当然，莱蒂丝除外——她以我们之间的血脉联系为焦点施展占卜魔法，一座又一座城市地追踪我们，将其摧毁。直到与那个贱人面对面以前，我根本不知道恶魔之所以能够不断推进，竟然都是因为我。可那时已经太迟了。她亲手摧毁了我——先让我见识长着阴茎的女人，再让我生下小恶魔；那些小混蛋利用我的身体不断自我繁殖，直到我的灵魂也像阿莉莎那样被硬生生撕出来。至少我坚持得更久一点！而且我没有像痴恋她的蠢货一样对着她的阴茎流口水，我……她刚把我从束缚中释放，我就扭断了她的脖子。那是我唯一夺走过的人类性命。她本该遭受比这更漫长的死亡。” “哦。” “所以，这就是我的一切了。”卡希拉平静地说道；双唇开始微微颤抖时，她咬住了嘴唇。“这就是伟大恶魔女王的故事：一个堕落而失败的圣骑士。莱蒂丝不久后将我收编，让我替她组建私人卫队。我也无事可做。于是我搬进母亲的实验室，开始工作，学习炼金术与魔法，创造出我那些可爱的龙女儿。直到莱蒂丝的征服结束，她……我想，她决定就这样无所事事地享受胜利余韵。我很满足于独自留在狮鹫塔里，直到一切再次天翻地覆。再好不过的女王也配不上这种结局，所以我带着龙女们偷偷离开，又偷走了一些关于传送门的研究，决定尝试制造自己的帷幕裂口。然后我遇见了你。除了看着艾蕾和姑娘们长大，这大概是二十年来发生在我身上的第一件真正美好的事情。” 卡希拉勉强挤出一抹笑容。“抱歉，我不是故意扫兴的。不过，你确实问了我，也有资格知道真相。或许现在你能更清楚地明白，我为什么如此庆幸遇见了你……找到了一个并非恶魔，却依然能不顾我的……本性而关心我的人。” 你俯身给了卡希拉一个绵长而深情的吻。她整个人都融化在你怀里，甚至让你觉得她的人类伪装有一瞬间出现了波动。 “爱上一个恶魔并不容易，[pc.name]。我很清楚。为了我们两个人……我希望等一切尘埃落定，我会值得你付出这一切。”

rows.raw: "Ask [calise.name] to tell you her story. How did she get to this point?"

rows.original: "Do you know anything about the assassin?" you ask. [var0|You weren't there, after all.] "Less than I'd like," Calise admits. "[calise.isHuman |I have heard of a kitsune agent working for the cult's master, but the mountaintop made for my first encounter with her. I wasn't surprised to see Tollus taking a hand in matters personally, trying to prevent [var0|my|our] acquiring the ring, but a master assassin was unexpected. I'm lucky she missed my heart, or I'd have died on the spot, and no gods or magic would have saved me. [var0|Thankfully I managed to get back down the mountain on my own before I collapsed...|I'm luckier still to have had you with me. I'm not sure I'd have been able to make it back down on my own after that injury.]" Calise balls her fist a moment. "I had no idea the cult had such a ferocious swordsman at their disposal. I won't make the mistake of underestimating that faction again." |You may be surprised to hear this, but I don't know the full goings-on of Tollus's operations. He keeps much of what he does from me, and from anyone outside his inner circle of corrupted mortals. I'd seen her with him a few times, but I never really paid her much mind. Another blade at the cult's command was nothing unusual. I clearly underestimated her." She sighs and shakes her head. "She had the measure of me from the get-go though. If my heart wasn't on the wrong side, if it wasn't for that one quirk of birth I'd never bothered to correct even with demonhood, I'd likely have died instantly. She won't make the same mistake again." ] "Do you think we need to worry about her getting into the city?" "I... don't know," [calise.name] says. "She was skilled enough to sneak up on me, so her slipping into the city isn't beyond the realm of possibility. She's no demon, of course, so I don't expect she can shapeshift. Plus with the cult's agents already in the city, and the possibility of high-ranking members of the court having been corrupted, it's only logical to assume that if she wanted to get into the city, she'd be able to. I no longer believe the city's walls are proof against the cult's infiltration, much less any true demon's."

rows.original: Does Calise know anything about that assassin?
rows.translation: 卡莉丝是否知道关于那个刺客的任何信息？
rows.raw: "Does Calise know anything about that assassin?"

rows.original: "You wanted to study the Ring of Fate, right?" you say, producing the artifact. "I did, yes!" Calise says, running her finger over its obsidian-black surface. "Ever since I first heard of it, I've been a bit obsessed with obtaining it; of unlocking the mysteries of its soul-warding. I even braved the sepulcher ruins of the Tiran cathedral in the Undermountain looking for it in their forbidden reliquary. Alas, there were only replicas and imitations made by lesser hands. But now we have the real thing! My theory is that there might just be a way to spread its protection between multiple people, perhaps even an entire battlefield." You blink. "Is it really that powerful?" "Can't you feel it? Yes, it's powerful, forged by a god's own hand centuries ago. In the legends, it was the key to saving the entire Khor'minoan civilization from a plague of madness. Right now, though, it only shields you. And while that is more than enough to give me some peace of mind... it's not enough to win the war." "So what's your plan?" Calise sits back and steeples her fingers. "That'll depend on the ring. I need to run some experiments on it, see if I can coax the power out from inside it. Push it to its limits — don't worry, I won't break it. It's too precious to risk! I've got a workspace set up for this already, and I've requisitioned some equipment from the city's magisters that may prove helpful. [calise.isKasyrra |As you know, darling, I'm quite handy with machines of all kinds. This will be much less complex than a portal, I'm sure. |You'll find I'm quite handy with such devices, as my mother was an archmage of some skill. I learned my fair share from her. ]" You glance around the little apartment, which earns you a hearty laugh from Calise. "Not here, silly. Indeed, for safety reasons, we'll have to leave the city entirely." "Safety reasons?" She nods. "What if something goes wrong? I'd like to think I'm fairly good at what I do, but there's no guarantees when it comes to unfamiliar magic — and the work of unfamiliar gods. If there's going to be a magical mishap, I'd rather it not affect the city from inside. The only problem, of course, is that a surge of magical power outside the walls might just attract unwanted attention from our adversaries. Make sure you're prepared for anything." You will be.
rows.translation: “你想研究命运之戒，对吧？”你取出神器说道。 “没错！”卡莉丝说道，手指抚过它漆黑如黑曜石的表面。“自从第一次听说它，我就有些执着于得到它、解开它保护灵魂的奥秘。我甚至冒险闯进地下山脉的蒂拉教会大教堂墓窟废墟，在禁忌圣物室里寻找它。可惜，那里只有技艺逊色之人制作的复制品和仿制品。但现在，我们有了真品！我认为，或许真有办法将它的保护扩展到多人身上，甚至覆盖整片战场。” 你眨眨眼。“它真的有那么强大吗？” “你感觉不到吗？没错，它十分强大，是数百年前由神明亲手锻造的。传说中，正是它将整个科尔米诺斯文明从一场疯狂瘟疫中拯救出来。不过现在，它只会保护你。虽然这已经足以让我安心不少……但还不足以赢得战争。” “那你的计划是什么？” 卡莉丝向后靠去，双手十指相抵。“这取决于戒指本身。我需要用它进行一些实验，看看能否将内部的力量引导出来，将它推到极限——别担心，我不会弄坏它。这东西太珍贵，不能拿来冒险！我已经为此准备好了工作场所，还向城里的魔导师征用了一些或许有帮助的设备。[calise.isKasyrra |亲爱的，你知道我很擅长摆弄各种机器。我相信这会比传送门简单得多。 |你会发现我很擅长使用这种设备；我的母亲是一名颇有造诣的大法师，我从她那里学到了不少东西。 ]” 你环顾这间小公寓，惹得卡莉丝朗声大笑。“不是这里，傻瓜。事实上，出于安全考虑，我们必须完全离开城市。” “安全考虑？” 她点点头。“要是出了什么问题怎么办？我愿意相信自己相当擅长这些事，但面对陌生的魔法——更别说陌生神明的造物——谁也无法保证万无一失。如果真要发生魔法事故，我宁可它不要从城内波及城市。当然，唯一的问题是，城墙外涌动的魔力或许会引来敌人不必要的注意。一定要为任何情况做好准备。” 你会准备妥当的。
rows.raw: " "You wanted to study the Ring of Fate, right?" you say, producing the artifact. "I did, yes!" Calise says, running her finger over its obsidian-black surface. "Ever since I first heard of it, I've been a bit obsessed with obtaining it; of unlocking the mysteries of its soul-warding. I even braved the sepulcher ruins of the Tiran cathedral in the Undermountain looking for it in their forbidden reliquary. Alas, there were only replicas and imitations made by lesser hands. But now we have the real thing! My theory is that there might just be a way to spread its protection between multiple people, perhaps even an entire battlefield." You blink. "Is it really that powerful?" "Can't you feel it? Yes, it's powerful, forged by a god's own hand centuries ago. In the legends, it was the key to saving the entire Khor'minoan civilization from a plague of madness. Right now, though, it only shields you. And while that is more than enough to give me some peace of mind... it's not enough to win the war." "So what's your plan?" Calise sits back and steeples her fingers. "That'll depend on the ring. I need to run some experiments on it, see if I can coax the power out from inside it. Push it to its limits — don't worry, I won't break it. It's too precious to risk! I've got a workspace set up for this already, and I've requisitioned some equipment from the city's magisters that may prove helpful. [calise.isKasyrra |As you know, darling, I'm quite handy with machines of all kinds. This will be much less complex than a portal, I'm sure. |You'll find I'm quite handy with such devices, as my mother was an archmage of some skill. I learned my fair share from her. ]" You glance around the little apartment, which earns you a hearty laugh from Calise. "Not here, silly. Indeed, for safety reasons, we'll have to leave the city entirely." "Safety reasons?" She nods. "What if something goes wrong? I'd like to think I'm fairly good at what I do, but there's no guarantees when it comes to unfamiliar magic — and the work of unfamiliar gods. If there's going to be a magical mishap, I'd rather it not affect the city from inside. The only problem, of course, is that a surge of magical power outside the walls might just attract unwanted attention from our adversaries. Make sure you're prepared for anything." You will be."

rows.original:
"What can you tell me about the king?" you ask.

        "Plenty, I'm sure," Calise shrugs. "I'm one of the few outlanders allowed access to the palace, by providence of [calise.isKas
            |my disguise as a divine champion
            |my divine calling
        ]. King Kelsaz has enacted even stricter security measures around the inner wards and royal grounds. He's a huge man, even by minotaur standards, but don't mistake that tremendous brawn for a lack of brains: the king is a wise and thoughtful man, given to patronizing the arts and places of learning within the city, and surrounds himself with a council of highly educated women that help to run the city day-to-day. He's been a pleasure to work with from the beginning, and has not hesitated to give me everything I ask in pursuit of the city's protection."
        
        That's certainly a good start. "Does he help in the defense?"
        
        Calise chuckles. "Not personally. The city can't afford for its king to personally go leading soldiers into the tunnels, never to be seen again. Military strategy is, however, an area in which he excels: even before I stepped up to take field command, he ordered the collapse of several tunnels and reorganized the legions into smaller tunnel-fighting cohorts that could take full advantage of funneling the imps into his soldiers. The minotaur craftsmen have been hard at work on new ballistae and arming as many citizens as possible with war bows, for the eventuality that the walls are assaulted by our flying foes. He's even suggested stringing up heavy netting across most of the city's alleys, to protect the homes from direct attack and force the imps to assault heavily-guarded open spaces. Alas, now that we've begun encountering impish mages, that plan's fallen by the wayside..."
        
        "How about the royal family? Are there princes and princesses?"
        
        "The heir to the throne is Crown Prince Vrannus, and the king has several daughters by his royal concubines — though Khor'minoan law ensures inheritance through the male bloodline, so they are mostly destined to academic and priestly vocations, I expect. I've only met one of the royal cows now, First Princess Varena, and she's proven rather prickly towards me. Perhaps daddy's girl is jealous he's showing another girl her age attention! It hardly matters, she's just an artist, nothing more . The crown prince has been very keen on assisting with the city's defense, and I've spent what little time I can spare tutoring him on martial matters. With care and good counsel, he will grow into a fine king someday. And with luck, he'll find a good queen." 
        
        [pc.ra cowgirl
            |Calise gives you a wink and a nudge with her elbow.
        ]
rows.translation:
你能告诉我关于那位国王的些什么吗？”你问道。

        “很多吧，我敢肯定，”卡莉丝耸了耸肩，“由于某些机缘，我是为数不多的被允许进入宫殿的外来者之一。 [calise.isKas
            |我伪装成神圣战士这一身份
            |我命中注定的使命
        ]凯尔萨兹国王在内部区域和皇家领地周围实施了更为严格的安全措施。以弥诺陶洛斯的标准来看，他也是一个身材魁梧的人，但千万不要以为他那强大的体魄意味着他缺乏智慧：这位国王是一位睿智而深思熟虑的统治者，他非常重视城市中的艺术与教育事业，还聘请了一群受过高等教育的女性来协助他管理城市的日常事务。从一开始，与他合作就非常愉快，而且他在帮助我保护这座城市的过程中，从不犹豫地满足我的所有要求。
        
        这确实是个不错的开始。‘他会参与防御工作吗？’”
        
        卡莉丝轻笑了一声：“他不会亲自参与。这座城市可负担不起让国王亲自带领士兵进入地道，然后就再也消失不见的代价。然而，军事战略正是他擅长的领域：甚至在我接任前线指挥之前，他就已经下令摧毁了几条隧道，并将军团重新编组为规模较小的作战小队，这些小队能够充分利用将敌人引入狭窄通道这一战术，从而让士兵们更有效地消灭敌人。弥诺陶洛斯的工匠们一直在努力制造新的投石机，并尽可能地为更多的市民提供战弓，以应对那些会飞来的敌人可能对城墙发动的攻击。他还建议在城市的许多小巷中悬挂重型的网状物，这样既可以保护居民的住宅免受直接攻击，也能迫使那些小妖怪们前往戒备森严的开阔地带发动进攻。唉，既然我们现在开始遇到那些调皮捣蛋的法师了，那个计划也就泡汤了吧……
        
        那王室成员呢？有没有王子和公主？”
        
        “王位继承人是弗兰努斯王储，国王还有几位妃子所生的女儿——不过根据科尔米诺的法律，继承权必须通过男性血脉传递，所以这些女儿们大多会被安排从事学术或神职工作吧。到目前为止，我只见过一位王室成员，那就是瓦蕾娜第一公主，而她对我的态度相当冷淡。也许这个“爸爸的小女儿”是在嫉妒父亲对一个同龄女孩给予了关注吧！不过这也没关系，她不过是个艺术家而已，没什么了不起的。王储一直非常热衷于协助这座城市的防御工作，我也利用自己有限的空闲时间指导他学习武艺。在悉心的照料和正确的指导下，他有朝一日一定会成为一名出色的国王。而如果运气好的话，他还会找到一位贤良的王后。" 
        
        [pc.ra cowgirl
            |卡莉丝向你眨了眨眼，然后用肘部轻轻碰了你一下。
        ]

rows.original: "How about we put that kitchen to use?" you say, nodded towards the door. Calise hops up and claps her hands delightedly. "Oh, that sounds like a welcome change of pace. Come, let's see what Isadora's stocked the pantry with for us!" You follow the lady-champion into the next room and begin rooting around in her cupboards, trying to think of the tastiest things you could turn their contents into... [rand |"We have fresh cheese," Calise says, taking a substantial slab from a cheese wheel out and bouncing it in her hand. "Go figure, there's never a shortage here in Khor'minos. How about I whip you up some of my famous maccy cheese? I think I even have some leftover bacon around here somewhere!" "Famous?" you tease, finding the bacon for her and starting to chop it nice and fine. Calise grins. "Oh, yes, [calise.isKas |on two whole planes, I'll have you know. |just as anyone. Though make sure they know I'll beat them up if they say any different, first. ]" The two of you share a laugh and get cooking. The ingredients for noodles are getting hard to come by in the city, but Calise's saved up her share of rationed flour and eggs for just such an occasion. While Calise's pressing and cutting them up, you get some water boiling over her cookfire and then set about grating cheese — though not without teasing her about using her armor's abs for it first. At the end of the day, it's a simple meal. Still, though, when you sit down to eat there's no denying that the noodles, cheese, bacon, and garnishing herbs come together into something that just tastes like home in a way you can't escape. You've cleared your bowl clean before you know it, though that only makes room for Calise to fill it up again. |"The locals sure love their mushrooms," you muse, hefting a bag of them out of Calise's cupboard. "Oh, that gives me an idea," Calise says. "Isadora's father made a lovely pasta with red wine sauce and mushrooms when I first met them. He wrote the recipe down for me somewhere here... aha!" She takes out a small scrap of paper from a drawer, followed by a bottle of [pc.bg noblescion |Sartanni red — an expensive and rare vintage, too |red cooking wine ]. "See if you can find some garlic and olive oil in the cabinets. I'll get working on the noodles." Calise lays out a pan for you, and in goes some butter and roughly chopped mushrooms with a splash of oil and garlic for good measure. You add in some onions and get to sauteing, while Calise makes the noodles at the counter. The two of you have your backs together through most of the process, but that's no barrier to playful [calise.fucked |teasing |banter ] while you work.[calise.fucked | When you leave the sautee to do its thing, you turn around and get your arms around Calise's middle, watching her cut the noodles into shape over her shoulder. She wiggles her ass into your crotch and snatches a kiss off your cheek. Her hair smells so lovely... ] When she's got the noodles made, Calise gives them a quick boil — just enough to get them al dente — before spooning them, and a healthy amount of starchy water, into the sauce and combining it all together. A garnishing of herbs finishes the meal once its one your plates. "This smells amazing," you say. "Tastes it, too," Calise laughs, already digging in. It really does! So savory and rich... |"Isadora tells me cave fish tastes like old boot," Calise says, rustling around until she finds a paper-wrapped package. "Luckily for us, she also knows one of the fishermen still operating off the coast. This just came in today." She gently slaps what turns out to be a package of various small fish down onto the counter, still smelling fresh from the sea. "Let's get these filletted and grilled," you say, reaching for a knife. "Right. The local Velunites brought a basket of fresh vegetables around, too. And garlic!" Now that sounds like a good combination. You have Calise place a rack over the cookfire and get to work seasoning the fish in butter, herbs, and garlic, and then fill a pan with fresh asparagus and broccoli to cook beside it. A little oil, a little more butter, a little salt and pepper... things are starting to smell delicious in here! Calise watches you go while she slices some bread to go along with your meal. A little of the melty butter over that, and a quick toast in the pan once you've taken the fish out, and you're ready to go. "Nothing's better than the smell of roasting garlic," Calise says, licking her lips. "Well done, [pc.name]. I can't wait another moment to taste it!" The brunette beauty digs in with gusto, making delighted sounds through a mouthful of well-grilled fish. You'd never put cooking high on your list of life skills, but the way Calise reacts to what you've made, maybe you ought to reevaluate. Following her lead, you take a seat and chow down. |"How about something sweet?" you suggest. "I know just the thing!" Calise says, "Honey and oat cookies. My father's favorite. [party.has azzy |You even have your own honeypot sitting outside. Why don't you ask her for some fresh honey?" "I'm sure she won't mind." It turns out she doesn't, though there's going to be a tax paid in cookies for her home-made ingredient. |I think I have some honey around here somewhere.... ah, here we go!" ] Calise pours a generous helping of rolled oats from a jar in her pantry and gets to work making a dough to roll them into. You have a while to just stand around and chat together while it rises — about your preferred arms and armor, favorite sights around the city, plans for the future, anything that comes to mind. The conversation carries on even as Calise is shaping the dough into patties while you come in behind and glaze them with honey and the last of the oats on top. They go into the little oven on a tray, and it's no time at all before the house starts smelling absolutely delicious. "This... really brings me back," Calise sighs, leaning against the counter and clearing it off with the corner of her apron. Her fingers have a lingering coat of flour on them, but she doesn't seem to mind the mess. It makes her look like a regular old homemaker. "Sitting with the old man on our porch, eating these while we watched the sun set over the mountains. Simpler times and all that." "Do you miss your old life?" you ask her. "[calise.hdk |Before you became a Champion |Before... you know... |Kas ]?" Your comrade looks askance. "Some of it. Not many of the people, besides Father. I was always a bit of a loner, I suppose. What do I miss most, though? Hmm. The views from my home most of all, I think. The forests sprawling out across the mountainsides, leaves glistening with rainwater in the evening sun." She shakes her hair out and gives you a far-away look. "There's nothing like it, not even here." The cookies are done before you know it, and Calise insists you take the first one. One bite proves they're as tasty as they smell, sweet and thick[calise.fucked | — just like Calise. Making that comment earns you a lip kiss and a lingering smile. | and too good not to go for a second one. Seeing that puts a smile on Calise's face all over again. ] |"You know, Isadora was just at the fish market this morning. Apparently a friend of hers hauled in something called a 'swordfish,' and a notably large one at that. She brought me a slab of it. Why don't we try it?" Swordfish? Calise is just spoiling you now. You readily agree, and help fish out the paper-wrapped slab from the larder. It's a hefty boy, easily six pounds of deliciousness, and you set about cutting it up into steaks while Calise begins preparing a sauce for it: olive oil, a splash of lemon, salt and pepper, and a hefty helping of oregano. "I feel like I'm practically taking advantage of the city's hospitality," she laughs. "There's a crisis on, but well-to-dos are practically showering me with imported seasoning the moment I mention I like to cook. I can't imagine how expensive a lemon has to be on the market right now..." "Then we'd better enjoy it," you say. You put the fish on her fire, as close to the heat as you can manage, and watch them start to grill up. The whole process is over in just a bit more than five minutes, leaving them smoking and smelling so lovely that your mouth waters just getting them onto a platter. Calise pokes them through with a fork and drizzles the sauce all over them, getting it right into the meat. It's every bit as good as it tastes. You and Calise share a look of contentment as you both dig in, forking apart the sauce-slathered slabs of fish on your plates. "I wonder why they call it a swordfish," Calise murmurs between bites. "It's far too soft..." "Ha!" |You pick a bottle of red cooking wine off her shelf. "Have something we can cook in this?" "I know just the thing," Calise says, going to her larder. "I have some beef here that would go very nicely in that. Put a pot on the fire, would you?" You heft a big one into the cookfire while Calise gets a big slab of beautifully marbled red roast out and starts to season it. A splash of oil in the pot, and she drops the beef right in, letting it sear while you both get to cutting up veggies: mushrooms, onions, and wedges of carrots to add into the meaty juices pooling at the bottom once Calise flips the roast over. She removes the meat pretty shortly after, though, and deglazes the pot with that red wine. The smell that fills the kitchen is overwhelmingly rich, and you take deep breaths of it while your fellow chef stirs and scrapes the pot. Only then does the meat go back in, with a second helping of fresh green seasonings. She covers the pot with a ceramic lid and lifts it further off the heat. "Now we wait." Well, that gives you and Calise a while to just enjoy each others' company. You spend a while chatting about your more recent adventures, the many plights befalling the Frost Marches in these benighted days. The both of you have stories enough to make the braising time seem to fly by, especially once Calise starts sipping the last of that bottle of red. When you finally turn your attentions back to the meat, lifting the pot's top unleashes a cloud of herb-scented steam and reveals meat that's tender enough to crumble when you prod it with a fork. Beautiful. When it's out on a carving board, that beef comes apart with barely a hint of effort, and you and Calise fill your plates with it and the wine-cooked veggies. "Oh, M-! Gods, this is good!" Calise gasps, dabbing away a bit of wine from her lips. "Brilliant idea, [pc.name]." "You did all the work," you chuckle. ]

|我们有新鲜的奶酪，”卡莉丝说着，从奶酪轮上取下一大块，在手中轻轻抛动。“真奇怪，在科尔米诺斯这里从来都不会缺这种东西。要我给你做些我拿手的奶酪通心粉吗？我想我这里应该还剩些培根吧！” “你说的‘拿手’是指什么？”你开玩笑地问着，同时帮她找到了培根，开始把它切成细小的片。 卡莉丝笑了：“哦，当然是我的拿手好菜啦！ [calise.isKas |需要说明的是，这两个方面其实是相互关联的。 |和别人一样。不过得先让他们知道，如果他们敢说别的，我会揍他们的。 ]你们俩相视而笑，然后开始准备食材。在城市里，制作面条所需的材料已经越来越难找了，但卡莉丝早就为这样的场合储备好了她那份配给的面粉和鸡蛋。当卡莉丝在捣碎和切配食材时，你去把水烧开，然后开始磨奶酪——不过在开始之前，你还不忘逗她，让她先用盔甲上的肌肉来帮忙磨奶酪。 归根结底，这只是一顿简单的饭菜。不过，当你坐下来开始用餐时，不得不承认：面条、奶酪、培根以及那些装饰用的香草共同营造出了一种独特的风味，确实让人回味无穷。有一种家的感觉在某种程度上，你根本无法逃避。不知不觉中，你就把碗里的东西全部吃光了，不过这样一来，反而让卡莉丝有机会再次把碗填满。 |当地人真的很喜欢蘑菇啊，”你边说边从卡莉丝的橱柜里拿出一袋蘑菇。 “哦，这个主意真不错，”卡莉丝说道，“我第一次见到伊莎多拉一家的时候，她父亲用红葡萄酒酱和蘑菇做了一道非常美味的意大利面。他把食谱写在了这里某个地方……啊哈！” 她从抽屉里拿出一张小纸条，然后又拿出一瓶[pc.bg noblescion |萨塔尼红款——同样是一种价格昂贵且极为稀有的复古款式。 |红烧酒 ]去看看橱柜里有没有大蒜和橄榄油，我去准备面条。” 卡莉丝为你准备了一个平底锅，往里面倒入一些黄油，再加入切碎的蘑菇，再淋上一点油和大蒜。然后你再加入一些洋葱开始翻炒，而卡莉丝则在操作台前准备面条。在整个过程中，你们俩总是互相配合、齐心协力，不过这种默契并没有妨碍你们之间的轻松玩笑。 [calise.fucked |调侃 |玩笑话 ]在你工作的时候。[calise.fucked | 当你让炒菜的人继续忙她的事时，你转过身，将手臂环绕在卡莉丝的腰间，透过她的肩膀看着她把面条剪成合适的形状。她轻轻扭动臀部，让你的身体与之贴在一起，然后在你脸上偷了一个吻。她的头发散发着迷人的香气…… ] 当卡莉丝把面条煮好后，她会快速将它们煮至恰到好处的熟度——也就是还有些嚼劲的时候——然后把面条和适量的含淀粉的水一起倒入酱汁中，将所有材料混合均匀。最后再撒上一些香草作为装饰，这样一顿饭就准备好了。 “闻起来真香！”你说道。 “你也尝尝看吧，”卡莉丝笑着说，同时已经开始大口吃饭了。 确实非常美味！味道鲜美且浓郁…… |伊莎多拉告诉我，洞穴鱼的味道就像旧靴子一样难吃，”卡莉丝一边说，一边翻找着，最终找到了一个用纸包着的包裹。“幸运的是，她还知道有位渔民仍在沿海地区捕鱼。这个包裹今天刚送到。她轻轻地将那包看起来像是各种小鱼的食材放在柜台上，那些鱼依然散发着海水的新鲜气息。“我们把这些鱼处理一下，然后烤了吃吧，”你说着，伸手去拿刀。 没错，当地的维鲁尼特人也送来了一篮新鲜的蔬菜，还有大蒜！” 这样的搭配听起来确实很不错。你可以让卡莉丝在炉火上方架一个架子，然后开始用黄油、香草和大蒜给鱼调味；同时，还可以在另一个锅里放入新鲜的芦笋和西兰花一起烹煮。加一点油，再放些黄油，撒点盐和胡椒……现在这里的味道已经开始变得香喷喷的了！卡莉丝一边看着你忙碌，一边切着面包准备搭配你的餐点。在鱼上再涂一点融化的黄油，等把鱼取出来后，在平底锅里快速烤一下，那就大功告成了。 没有什么比烤蒜的味道更美妙的了，”卡莉丝舔了舔嘴唇说道，“干得真棒！ [pc.name]我等不及了，马上就要尝到它了！” 这位深色头发的美女兴致勃勃地开始进食，每当咬下一口烤得香喷喷的鱼时，都会发出愉悦的声响。你可能从未将烹饪视为自己重要的生活技能之一，但看到卡莉丝对你做的食物表现出如此高的评价，或许你应该重新考虑这个观点了。在她的带动下，你也坐下来开始大快朵颐起来。 |来点甜的东西怎么样？”你提议道。 “我知道正好有适合的东西！”卡莉丝说，“蜂蜜燕麦饼干。我父亲最喜欢的。 [party.has azzy |你甚至还在外面放了一个“蜜罐”来吸引她。为什么不直接向她要一些呢？新鲜亲爱的？” “我肯定她不会介意的。” 结果她确实没有介意，不过为了换取她提供的这些自制材料，我们还是得用饼干来“支付这笔费用”呢。 |我想我这里应该有些蜂蜜……啊，找到了！ ] 卡莉丝从储藏室的一个罐子里取出了足量的燕麦片，开始动手揉面，准备将这些燕麦片裹成面团。在面团发酵的过程中，你们有足够的时间一起闲聊——谈论你们最喜欢的武器和护甲、城市里最迷人的风景、对未来的规划，或者任何你们想聊的话题。当卡莉丝正在把面团揉成饼状的时候，谈话仍在继续。你走到她身后，用蜂蜜和剩下的燕麦片给这些饼状面团表面撒上糖衣。然后把它们放在托盘上放进小烤箱里，不一会儿，整个房子里就弥漫起了美味的香气。 这……真的让我回忆起了过去，”卡莉丝叹道，她靠在柜台上，用围裙的角把柜台上的东西清理干净。她的手指上还沾着些面粉，但她似乎并不在意这些凌乱的东西。这样的场景让她看起来就像一个普通的家庭主妇。和老人一起坐在门廊上，边吃着这些食物，边看着太阳落在山后。真是简单而美好的时光啊。” “你是不是怀念过去的生活？”你问她。[calise.hdk |在你成为冠军之前 |在……你知道的……那件事发生之前…… |卡希 ]你的同伴侧目看着你，说道：“有一部分吧。除了父亲之外，没多少人知道。我想，我本来就有点孤僻的性格。不过，我最怀念的是什么呢？嗯……我想，最让我怀念的还是我家的景色。森林蔓延在山腰上，树叶在晚阳的照耀下闪烁着雨水的光芒。 她甩了甩头发，然后望向远方，说道：“没有什么地方能比得上那里，就连这里也不行。 饼干很快就烤好了，卡莉丝坚持让你先尝第一个。咬了一口之后，你就会发现它们确实和闻起来一样美味——甜中带着丝丝浓郁的味道。[calise.fucked | — 就像卡莉丝一样。说出这样的评论，你会得到一个轻吻和一个意味深长的微笑。 | 而且质量这么好，当然应该再买一份。想到这里，卡莉丝的脸上又露出了笑容。 ] |你知道吗，伊莎多拉今天早上还在鱼市。她的一个朋友抓到了一条叫做‘剑鱼’的鱼，而且体型相当大。她拿了一块给我，我们为什么不尝尝看呢？” 剑鱼？卡莉丝现在是在宠着你吧。你毫不犹豫地同意了，然后帮忙从储藏室里拿出了用纸包着的那块剑鱼。真是沉重的天哪，足足有六磅这么美味的食物，你开始把它们切成牛排，而卡莉丝则开始准备调味酱：橄榄油、少许柠檬汁、盐和胡椒粉，还有大量的牛至叶。 “我觉得自己简直是在充分利用这座城市的热情好客呢，”她笑着说。现在正好遇到了危机，但只要我一提到自己喜欢做饭，那些条件优越的人就会纷纷送我各种进口调味料。我简直无法想象现在市场上柠檬的价格该有多高……” “那我们就好好享受这些吧，”你说道。你把鱼放在她的火上，尽量让它们靠近热源，然后看着它们开始被烤熟。整个过程只需要五分钟多一点的时间，烤出来的鱼会冒着烟，散发着诱人的香气，以至于你一看到把它们端上盘子，就会忍不住流口水。卡莉丝用叉子把鱼片拨开，然后把酱汁均匀地浇在上面，确保酱汁能渗入鱼肉之中。 这道菜确实和它的味道一样美味。你们两人相视而笑，满足地开始品尝盘中的鱼片——那些被酱汁浸透的鱼片。我想知道他们为什么把它叫做剑鱼，”卡莉丝边吃边低声说道，“它其实软得太多……” “哈！ |你从她的架子上拿了一瓶红葡萄酒。“用这个可以用来做饭吗？” “正好有适合的东西，”卡莉丝说，然后走向她的储藏室。“我这里有一些牛肉，用这种酒来烹饪会非常美味。你能把锅放在火上吗？ 你往炉子里扔了一块大块的肉，而卡莉丝则取出一大块纹理美观的红色烤肉，开始给它调味。她在锅里倒了一点油，然后将牛肉放了进去，让牛肉表面先煎一下。与此同时，你们俩开始切蔬菜：蘑菇、洋葱还有胡萝卜片，等卡莉丝把烤肉翻面后，把这些蔬菜加入锅子里，让它们与肉汁一起炖煮。 不过，她很快就把肉取了出来，然后用那瓶红葡萄酒给锅里的汁液进行收汁处理。厨房里弥漫着的香气浓郁得令人陶醉，你在旁边帮忙搅拌锅里的食材时，也不由得深深地吸了几口这香气。直到这时，她才把肉重新放回锅里，又加入了一些新鲜的绿色调味料。然后她用陶瓷锅盖盖住锅，把它从火上拿开。“现在，我们就等着吧。 这样，你和卡莉丝就有时间一起享受彼此的陪伴了。你们一边聊天，一边分享最近发生的冒险经历，以及这些黑暗时代里霜冻边境所遭遇的种种困境。你们的故事多得让这段相处时光仿佛转瞬即逝，尤其是当卡莉丝开始喝完那瓶红酒的时候。 当你终于将注意力重新转移到这道菜上时，掀开锅盖，顿时有一股弥漫着香草气息的蒸汽扑面而来，而锅里的肉也已经煮得软烂到用叉子一戳就会碎裂。真是太美味了！当把肉切成块放在切菜板上时，它几乎毫不费力就能被分开，你和卡莉丝便将肉以及用葡萄酒烹制的蔬菜一起盛到盘子里。 哦，天啊！太棒了！”卡莉丝惊呼道，一边用纸巾轻轻擦去嘴角残留的酒液。“这个主意真是太绝了[pc.name]所有的工作都是你做的，”你笑着说。 ]
rows.raw: ' "How about we put that kitchen to use?" you say, nodded towards the door. Calise hops up and claps her hands delightedly. "Oh, that sounds like a welcome change of pace. Come, let's see what Isadora's stocked the pantry with for us!" You follow the lady-champion into the next room and begin rooting around in her cupboards, trying to think of the tastiest things you could turn their contents into... [rand |"We have fresh cheese," Calise says, taking a substantial slab from a cheese wheel out and bouncing it in her hand. "Go figure, there's never a shortage here in Khor'minos. How about I whip you up some of my famous maccy cheese? I think I even have some leftover bacon around here somewhere!" "Famous?" you tease, finding the bacon for her and starting to chop it nice and fine. Calise grins. "Oh, yes, [calise.isKas |on two whole planes, I'll have you know. |just as anyone. Though make sure they know I'll beat them up if they say any different, first. ]" The two of you share a laugh and get cooking. The ingredients for noodles are getting hard to come by in the city, but Calise's saved up her share of rationed flour and eggs for just such an occasion. While Calise's pressing and cutting them up, you get some water boiling over her cookfire and then set about grating cheese — though not without teasing her about using her armor's abs for it first. At the end of the day, it's a simple meal. Still, though, when you sit down to eat there's no denying that the noodles, cheese, bacon, and garnishing herbs come together into something that just tastes like home in a way you can't escape. You've cleared your bowl clean before you know it, though that only makes room for Calise to fill it up again. |"The locals sure love their mushrooms," you muse, hefting a bag of them out of Calise's cupboard. "Oh, that gives me an idea," Calise says. "Isadora's father made a lovely pasta with red wine sauce and mushrooms when I first met them. He wrote the recipe down for me somewhere here... aha!" She takes out a small scrap of paper from a drawer, followed by a bottle of [pc.bg noblescion |Sartanni red — an expensive and rare vintage, too |red cooking wine ]. "See if you can find some garlic and olive oil in the cabinets. I'll get working on the noodles." Calise lays out a pan for you, and in goes some butter and roughly chopped mushrooms with a splash of oil and garlic for good measure. You add in some onions and get to sauteing, while Calise makes the noodles at the counter. The two of you have your backs together through most of the process, but that's no barrier to playful [calise.fucked |teasing |banter ] while you work.[calise.fucked | When you leave the sautee to do its thing, you turn around and get your arms around Calise's middle, watching her cut the noodles into shape over her shoulder. She wiggles her ass into your crotch and snatches a kiss off your cheek. Her hair smells so lovely... ] When she's got the noodles made, Calise gives them a quick boil — just enough to get them al dente — before spooning them, and a healthy amount of starchy water, into the sauce and combining it all together. A garnishing of herbs finishes the meal once its one your plates. "This smells amazing," you say. "Tastes it, too," Calise laughs, already digging in. It really does! So savory and rich... |"Isadora tells me cave fish tastes like old boot," Calise says, rustling around until she finds a paper-wrapped package. "Luckily for us, she also knows one of the fishermen still operating off the coast. This just came in today." She gently slaps what turns out to be a package of various small fish down onto the counter, still smelling fresh from the sea. "Let's get these filletted and grilled," you say, reaching for a knife. "Right. The local Velunites brought a basket of fresh vegetables around, too. And garlic!" Now that sounds like a good combination. You have Calise place a rack over the cookfire and get to work seasoning the fish in butter, herbs, and garlic, and then fill a pan with fresh asparagus and broccoli to cook beside it. A little oil, a little more butter, a little salt and pepper... things are starting to smell delicious in here! Calise watches you go while she slices some bread to go along with your meal. A little of the melty butter over that, and a quick toast in the pan once you've taken the fish out, and you're ready to go. "Nothing's better than the smell of roasting garlic," Calise says, licking her lips. "Well done, [pc.name]. I can't wait another moment to taste it!" The brunette beauty digs in with gusto, making delighted sounds through a mouthful of well-grilled fish. You'd never put cooking high on your list of life skills, but the way Calise reacts to what you've made, maybe you ought to reevaluate. Following her lead, you take a seat and chow down. |"How about something sweet?" you suggest. "I know just the thing!" Calise says, "Honey and oat cookies. My father's favorite. [party.has azzy |You even have your own honeypot sitting outside. Why don't you ask her for some fresh honey?" "I'm sure she won't mind." It turns out she doesn't, though there's going to be a tax paid in cookies for her home-made ingredient. |I think I have some honey around here somewhere.... ah, here we go!" ] Calise pours a generous helping of rolled oats from a jar in her pantry and gets to work making a dough to roll them into. You have a while to just stand around and chat together while it rises — about your preferred arms and armor, favorite sights around the city, plans for the future, anything that comes to mind. The conversation carries on even as Calise is shaping the dough into patties while you come in behind and glaze them with honey and the last of the oats on top. They go into the little oven on a tray, and it's no time at all before the house starts smelling absolutely delicious. "This... really brings me back," Calise sighs, leaning against the counter and clearing it off with the corner of her apron. Her fingers have a lingering coat of flour on them, but she doesn't seem to mind the mess. It makes her look like a regular old homemaker. "Sitting with the old man on our porch, eating these while we watched the sun set over the mountains. Simpler times and all that." "Do you miss your old life?" you ask her. "[calise.hdk |Before you became a Champion |Before... you know... |Kas ]?" Your comrade looks askance. "Some of it. Not many of the people, besides Father. I was always a bit of a loner, I suppose. What do I miss most, though? Hmm. The views from my home most of all, I think. The forests sprawling out across the mountainsides, leaves glistening with rainwater in the evening sun." She shakes her hair out and gives you a far-away look. "There's nothing like it, not even here." The cookies are done before you know it, and Calise insists you take the first one. One bite proves they're as tasty as they smell, sweet and thick[calise.fucked | — just like Calise. Making that comment earns you a lip kiss and a lingering smile. | and too good not to go for a second one. Seeing that puts a smile on Calise's face all over again. ] |"You know, Isadora was just at the fish market this morning. Apparently a friend of hers hauled in something called a 'swordfish,' and a notably large one at that. She brought me a slab of it. Why don't we try it?" Swordfish? Calise is just spoiling you now. You readily agree, and help fish out the paper-wrapped slab from the larder. It's a hefty boy, easily six pounds of deliciousness, and you set about cutting it up into steaks while Calise begins preparing a sauce for it: olive oil, a splash of lemon, salt and pepper, and a hefty helping of oregano. "I feel like I'm practically taking advantage of the city's hospitality," she laughs. "There's a crisis on, but well-to-dos are practically showering me with imported seasoning the moment I mention I like to cook. I can't imagine how expensive a lemon has to be on the market right now..." "Then we'd better enjoy it," you say. You put the fish on her fire, as close to the heat as you can manage, and watch them start to grill up. The whole process is over in just a bit more than five minutes, leaving them smoking and smelling so lovely that your mouth waters just getting them onto a platter. Calise pokes them through with a fork and drizzles the sauce all over them, getting it right into the meat. It's every bit as good as it tastes. You and Calise share a look of contentment as you both dig in, forking apart the sauce-slathered slabs of fish on your plates. "I wonder why they call it a swordfish," Calise murmurs between bites. "It's far too soft..." "Ha!" |You pick a bottle of red cooking wine off her shelf. "Have something we can cook in this?" "I know just the thing," Calise says, going to her larder. "I have some beef here that would go very nicely in that. Put a pot on the fire, would you?" You heft a big one into the cookfire while Calise gets a big slab of beautifully marbled red roast out and starts to season it. A splash of oil in the pot, and she drops the beef right in, letting it sear while you both get to cutting up veggies: mushrooms, onions, and wedges of carrots to add into the meaty juices pooling at the bottom once Calise flips the roast over. She removes the meat pretty shortly after, though, and deglazes the pot with that red wine. The smell that fills the kitchen is overwhelmingly rich, and you take deep breaths of it while your fellow chef stirs and scrapes the pot. Only then does the meat go back in, with a second helping of fresh green seasonings. She covers the pot with a ceramic lid and lifts it further off the heat. "Now we wait." Well, that gives you and Calise a while to just enjoy each others' company. You spend a while chatting about your more recent adventures, the many plights befalling the Frost Marches in these benighted days. The both of you have stories enough to make the braising time seem to fly by, especially once Calise starts sipping the last of that bottle of red. When you finally turn your attentions back to the meat, lifting the pot's top unleashes a cloud of herb-scented steam and reveals meat that's tender enough to crumble when you prod it with a fork. Beautiful. When it's out on a carving board, that beef comes apart with barely a hint of effort, and you and Calise fill your plates with it and the wine-cooked veggies. "Oh, M-! Gods, this is good!" Calise gasps, dabbing away a bit of wine from her lips. "Brilliant idea, [pc.name]." "You did all the work," you chuckle. ]'

rows.original:
You and Calise sit around for a while after that, taking your plates to the living room again and enjoying the fruits of your kitchen labors together. "Mmm. We should do this again. Regularly." Your comrade sinks back into her couch with a contented sigh, patting her tummy. "I wonder if I can trade some leftovers to Isadora in exchange for her cleaning up after us..."

It's just a little north of here, but a bit too far from the walls for the legions to protect it — so it was evacuated like the rest of the kingdom. I've repurposed the village's gymnasium and had some of my troops guarding it from concealed positions. We've managed to remain undetected thus far. Few demons want to get quite that close to the city, and those that do... well, Master Tollus doesn't need to ask what happened to them when they don't report back." 
        
        Isadora scratches her chin. "So that's where Ramius and the boys went after the party..."
        
        "Mmhmm! Come along, it's a short walk...""

rows.original:
Your party makes its way from the main street of Khor'minos out into the Outskirts, and from there hugs the city wall north and a little east until you come to another long, wide tunnel that leads deeper into the mountains, one you've never had occasion to explore yourself. Only about a hundred yards down it, shallow enough that you can still see the walls of the great city, you come to a small village of stone and orange bricks. Aside from a few smashed doors and broken fences, it seems no more worse for wear from the war than it might have the day the demonic invasion began, though there are plenty of signs of the hasty evacuation still left behind where they dropped so long ago: fallen clotheslines and rotting food mar the streets, and you see a child's stuffed leothran trampled into the roadstones. 
            
            Near the center of town is a large, domed structure that still has its doors — though not for lack of trying, you can tell. They've been hammered in pretty roughly, splintered in places by hammer blows and blackened by magic, but they proved too heavy for casual demonic looters to crack. Calise makes a sharp whistle, and they're opened from within by a pair of minotaur soldiers from her personal cadre. A third you hadn't even seen appears as if from among the very stones on the roof, lifting a crossbow up onto his shoulder. 
            
            "Champions!" one of the troopers says, waving a hand. He reaches down and ruffles your royal escort's red hair. "Izzy!"
            
            Isadora's pushed down by the man's sheer strength, waving her arms until Calise takes her basket from her to keep it from spilling. "Gah!" 
            
            "Finally ready to tell us what we're guarding here, Lady Calise?" the soldier asks, continuing to casually ravage Isadora's hair while the rest of you pile inside. 
            
            The Champion of Velun gives him a sly look. "The future, Ramius. Let me show [pc.name] here what I've got prepared for us."
rows.translation:
你的队伍从科尔米诺斯主街走向城郊，随后贴着城墙向北、略微向东前进，直到抵达另一条通往山脉更深处的宽阔长隧道——你从未有机会亲自探索这里。深入隧道只有约一百码，离入口近得依然能看见宏伟城市的城墙，你们便来到一个由石材和橙色砖块建成的小村庄。除了几扇被砸坏的门和断裂的篱笆，它受到战争的破坏似乎并不比恶魔入侵之日更加严重；不过，居民当年匆忙撤离时丢下的痕迹仍随处可见：倒塌的晾衣绳和腐烂的食物玷污街道，一只孩子的利奥坦毛绒玩具也被踩进路面石缝。 
            
            镇子中央附近有一座大型圆顶建筑，它的门依然完好——不过你看得出来，这并不是因为没人尝试破坏。门板遭到过粗暴锤击，有些地方已被砸出裂口，也被魔法熏得焦黑；但对于随意劫掠的恶魔而言，它们实在太过沉重，无法轻易攻破。卡莉丝吹出一声尖锐的口哨，两名隶属她私人部队的弥诺陶洛斯士兵从内部打开大门。第三名士兵从屋顶的石块之间现身，仿佛先前一直与石头融为一体；他将弩抬起来扛在肩头，而你之前根本没有发现他的存在。 
            
            “勇者们！”其中一名士兵挥手说道。他伸手揉乱你那位皇家护卫的红发。“小伊！”
            
            伊莎多拉被男子单凭蛮力便压得低下身体，挥舞着双臂；直到卡莉丝接过她的篮子，才没让里面的东西洒出来。“啊！” 
            
            “卡莉丝女士，终于准备好告诉我们，大家在这里守护的究竟是什么了吗？”士兵问道；其他人陆续挤进屋内时，他仍在漫不经心地蹂躏伊莎多拉的头发。 
            
            维伦的勇者狡黠地看了他一眼。“是未来，拉米乌斯。让我向[pc.name]展示，我为大家准备了什么。”

rows.original: Inside the gymnasium, you find a number of copper tubes and spires of arcane origin have been arrayed around a pentagrammic magic circle carved into the floor. Stakes of leananstone have been driven into each point of the star, crackling ominously every time one of the metal-armored troopers gets too close. [party.has cait |Cait cranes her head and purrs, looking enviously at all the occult devices. "Woah..." ] [pc.isMage |You squint at the strange collection of arcane devices, trying to divine their purpose. It's a brain-wracking affair, before you finally settle on proclaiming, "This is an arc magnifier, isn't it? Nobody's seen one of these since the Godswar. Estelore was the only place that made them." [party.has viv |"I was thinking the same thing," Viv says, leaning over one of the copper spires and giving it an inquisitive poke. It crackles. ] Calise grins. "Good eye, [party.has viv |you two |[pc.name] ]! Acquiring it was neither cheap nor easy, especially given the current goings-on in the world, but Crown Prince Vrannus and I were both given very generous stipends for our respective research projects. Behold the fruits of my labor, and the king's coffers." |[party.has viv |Viv whistles, looking everything over. "An arc magnifier? I didn't think any were left after Estelore became a cursed crater." She gives one of the copper pillars an inquisitive poke. It crackles. "Good eye, young lady," Calise says. "Acquiring it was neither cheap nor easy, especially given the current goings-on in the world, but Crown Prince Vrannus and I were both given very generous stipends for our respective research projects. Behold the fruits of my labor, and the king's coffers." |"This," Calise says, sweeping her arm around the room's collection of arcane devices, "is an arc magnifier!" There's a dead-silent beat before she sighs. "This is a very rare and valuable piece of magical amplification technology. Acquiring it was neither cheap nor easy, especially given the current goings-on in the world, but Crown Prince Vrannus and I were both given very generous stipends for our respective research projects. Behold the fruits of my labor, and the king's coffers." ] ] Calise thumps the butt of her axe on the ground, and you feel a surge of power in the air that makes your hairs stand on end. Lightning arcs between the copper towers and the leananstone stakes, bolting around the edges of the magic circle for a split second before dissipating with an audible crack. Even after it's gone, the incandescent lightning stays burned in your eyes for several long seconds until you're able to blink it away. Your fingers buzz with static even longer, until Isadora finally taps you with the guard of her sword to discharge it. [party.has cait |"Such power!" Cait gasps. ] [party.has arona |Arona cheers. "Fuck yeah, lightning! Can we zap somebody with it?" ] [party.has viv |Viviane looks enviously between Calise and the device. ] [party.has agnimitra |"Like Sorra's own wrath was in the room for a second," Agni says, wiping her brow. ] Calise hefts her axe onto her back and laughs. "A fine show, but it's only part of the puzzle. In simple terms, the idea is that this device should draw in ambient energy, the very fabric of the veil between worlds, and supercharge it with... whatever I put into the circle there. The Ring of Fate, in this case. Then we release the energy, and it goes washing across a wide area, affecting everyone in it with the same power it's charged with. The more leananstone I add, the wider the area-of-effect!" The knightess beams at you expectantly.
rows.translation: 在体育馆内，你会发现许多源自神秘力量的铜管和尖塔被排列在地板上刻出的五角星形魔法阵周围。星形的每个顶点上都插着利南石制成的桩柱，每当那些身穿金属铠甲的士兵靠近这些桩柱时，它们就会发出令人不寒而栗的噼啪声。 [party.has cait |凯特歪着头，发出呼噜声，羡慕地望着那些神秘的装置。“哇……” ] [pc.isMage |你眯着眼看着那些奇怪的神秘装置，试图弄清楚它们的用途。这真是一件让人绞尽脑汁的事情，最终你才得出结论：“这是电弧放大器，对吧？自从神战之后，就再也没有人见过这种东西了。只有埃斯托洛尔才会制造这种装置。” [party.has viv |“我也在想同样的事情，”薇芙说道，她凑近其中一根铜制尖塔，好奇地用手指戳了戳它，那铜塔发出了“咔嚓”一声。 ] 卡莉丝咧嘴一笑：“好眼力，[party.has viv |你们两个 |[pc.name] ]！弄到它既不便宜，也不容易，尤其是考虑到当前世界上的种种局势，但弗兰努斯王储和我都为各自的研究项目拿到了非常丰厚的研究经费。看看我辛勤劳作的成果吧，也看看国王的国库。” |[party.has viv |薇芙吹着口哨，仔细地观察着周围的一切。“一个电弧放大器？我本来以为在埃斯托洛尔变成那个被诅咒的陨石坑之后，这种东西应该已经不存在了。”她好奇地用手指戳了戳其中一根铜柱，铜柱发出了“咔嚓”的声响。 “好眼力，小姐。”卡莉丝说道，“弄到它既花费不菲，也相当困难，尤其是考虑到当前世界上发生的种种事情。不过，弗兰努斯王储和我都为各自的研究项目拿到了非常丰厚的研究经费。看看我辛勤劳作的成果吧，也看看国王的国库。” |“这个，”卡莉丝一边说，一边将手臂伸向房间里那些奇异的装置，“就是一台电弧放大器！” 随后是一阵死一般的寂静，她才叹了口气继续说道：“这是一项极其稀有且价值连城的魔法增幅技术。弄到它既花费不菲，也并非易事，尤其是考虑到当前世界上发生的种种事情……不过，弗兰努斯王储和我都为各自的研究项目拿到了非常丰厚的研究经费。看看我辛勤劳作的成果吧，也看看国王的国库。” ] ] 卡莉丝将她的斧头重重地砸在地上，顿时空气中涌起一股强大的力量，令你的毛发都竖了起来。闪电在铜塔与利南石桩之间闪烁，短暂地环绕着魔法阵的边缘，随后伴随着一声清脆的爆裂声消散了。即使那道炽烈的闪电已经消失，它的影像仍会在你的眼中停留数秒，直到你能够眨动眼睛将其驱散。你的手指也会因为静电而持续发麻，直到伊莎多拉最后用剑的护手轻轻碰了你一下，把静电导走。 [party.has cait |“这样的力量！”凯特惊呼道。 ] [party.has arona |阿罗娜欢呼道：“太棒了，闪电！我们能用它电击别人吗？” ] [party.has viv |薇薇安羡慕地看看卡莉丝，又看看那台设备。 ] [party.has agnimitra |“有那么一瞬间，仿佛索拉的愤怒亲自降临到了这个房间里，”阿格尼边说边擦着额头。 ] 卡莉丝把她的斧头背在背上，笑了起来：“表演得不错，但这只是整个谜题的一部分。简单来说，这个装置的原理应该是吸收周围的环境能量——也就是分隔世界的那层帷幕本身——然后给它充入……我放进那个圆阵里的东西。这次就是命运之环。接着我们释放这股能量，它会横扫过一大片区域，让其中所有人都受到同样力量的波及。我加入的利南石越多，影响范围就越广！” 女骑士期待地望着你，脸上洋溢着笑容。
