rows.original:
You set the ring down in the middle of the magic circle and quickly beat feet back out. "Alright. Let's do this."

        Calise claps her hands. "Excellent. Make some space, everyone. I haven't fired this bad boy up yet with an actual magic focus in the circle..."
        
        You take a deep breath and step back behind Calise as she begins to work.
rows.translation:
你将戒指放在魔法圈的中央，然后迅速退到了圈外。“好了，我们开始吧。”

        卡莉丝拍手道：“太好了。大家让开一点空间，我还没试过在真正的魔法阵中使用这个道具呢……”
        
        你深吸一口气，退到卡莉丝身后，等待她开始操作。
rows.raw:
'
        You set the ring down in the middle of the magic circle and quickly beat feet back out. "Alright. Let's do this."

        Calise claps her hands. "Excellent. Make some space, everyone. I haven't fired this bad boy up yet with an actual magic focus in the circle..."
        
        You take a deep breath and step back behind Calise as she begins to work.'

rows.original: Put the ring in the circle and zap it all up.
rows.translation: 把戒指放进圆圈里，然后给它通上电。
rows.raw: "Put the ring in the circle and zap it all up."

rows.translation: 试试你与那枚戒指的力量吧

rows.original:
You close your hand around the ring and step into the magic circle.

        "[pc.name]..." Calise says, then stops herself with a wry chuckle. "You're a psychopath, you know that?"
        
        You flash her a smirk. "So are we doing this?"
        
        "I suppose we are. Though you should probably get naked and leave your gear outside the circle. Having more than just you and the ring in there could contaminate the results."
        
        Isadora giggles and takes a coin out of her beltpouch. "Yeah, take it off, [pc.mascFem
            |good lookin'
            |cutie
        ]!"
        
        Her comrades bellow with laughter as you start to pull your gear off.
rows.translation:
你握紧戒指，踏入了魔法圈。

        “[pc.name]……”卡莉丝说道，随后苦笑着打住了话头，“你知道吗，你是个心理变态。”
        
        你冲她得意地一笑。“那我们开始吗？”
        
        “我想是的。不过你最好把衣服脱了，装备也留在圆圈外面。圆圈里除了你和那枚戒指之外，多出任何东西都可能影响实验结果。”
        
        伊莎多拉咯咯笑着，从腰包里掏出一枚硬币。“对，脱了吧，[pc.mascFem
            |帅哥
            |小可爱
        ]！”
        
        你开始脱下装备，她的战友们爆发出一阵哄笑。

rows.original: You're curious to see what happens if a person AND a relic go in together. What's the worst that could happen?
rows.translation: 你一定很好奇，如果一个人和一件遗物同时进入那个地方，会发生什么。最糟糕的情况会是什么呢？
rows.raw: "You're curious to see what happens if a person AND a relic go in together. What's the worst that could happen?"

rows.original:
"No," you say, and turn away.

        "[pc.name]!" Calise snaps, and you feel her hand on your shoulder — but she doesn't grip down, despite all the strength you know is hidden in that slender frame of hers. You're able to shrug her grasp off and walk away.
        
        Isadora and the other soldiers stay quiet, perhaps a sign they're as uncomfortable with all this arch-magic as you are, and Calise doesn't follow you as you head back towards the city in silence.
rows.translation:
“不。”你说着，转身离去。

        “[pc.name]！”卡莉丝厉声喝道，你感觉到她的手搭在了你的肩上——但尽管你知道她那纤细的身躯里蕴藏着巨大的力量，她却并没有用力抓紧。你甩开了她的手，转身走开。
        
        伊莎多拉和其他士兵都一言不发，或许这表明他们和你一样，对这种高阶魔法感到不安；而当你默默地朝城里走去时，卡莉丝也没有跟上来。
rows.raw:
"
        "No," you say, and turn away.

        "[pc.name]!" Calise snaps, and you feel her hand on your shoulder — but she doesn't grip down, despite all the strength you know is hidden in that slender frame of hers. You're able to shrug her grasp off and walk away.
        
        Isadora and the other soldiers stay quiet, perhaps a sign they're as uncomfortable with all this arch-magic as you are, and Calise doesn't follow you as you head back towards the city in silence."

rows.original: You don't feel comfortable with this. You should leave.
rows.translation: 你对此感到不舒服，应该离开。
rows.raw: "You don't feel comfortable with this. You should leave."

rows.original:
You shake your head and close your hand around the ring. "This seems like a bad idea, Calise."

        The knightess sighs. "Trust me, [pc.name]. There's almost no chance of destroying the ring, I'm sure of it — using magical items was the purpose of this device, and I've ensured it's working correctly already. Believe me when I say I hinge much of my hopes on that ring, and I would not put it through an iota of risk more than is strictly necessary. For now though, just a small shock should be enough to prove my theory that the ring's properties can be extended to multiple people: those of us in this room."
        
        She gives you a soft smile and extends her hand. "The ring, please. Trust me."
rows.translation:
你摇了摇头，将戒指握在手中。“这似乎不是个好主意，卡莉丝。”

        这位女骑士叹了口气：“相信我，[pc.name]。摧毁那枚戒指的可能性微乎其微，我敢肯定——使用魔法物品正是这个装置的用途，而且我已经确认它运作正常。相信我，我的许多希望都寄托在那枚戒指上，我绝不会让它承受超出绝对必要的哪怕一丝风险。不过眼下，只需要一次小小的电击，就足以证明我的理论：这枚戒指的特性可以扩展到多个人身上——也就是这个房间里的我们所有人。”
        
        她温柔地对你笑了笑，伸出手。“请把戒指给我。相信我。”
rows.raw:
'
        You shake your head and close your hand around the ring. "This seems like a bad idea, Calise."

        The knightess sighs. "Trust me, [pc.name]. There's almost no chance of destroying the ring, I'm sure of it — using magical items was the purpose of this device, and I've ensured it's working correctly already. Believe me when I say I hinge much of my hopes on that ring, and I would not put it through an iota of risk more than is strictly necessary. For now though, just a small shock should be enough to prove my theory that the ring's properties can be extended to multiple people: those of us in this room."
        
        She gives you a soft smile and extends her hand. "The ring, please. Trust me."'

rows.original: You aren't so sure about this. Maybe you'd better not risk it.
rows.translation: 你对此并不是那么有把握。或许最好还是不要冒险为妙。
rows.raw: "You aren't so sure about this. Maybe you'd better not risk it."

rows.original: You glance between the ring [pc.itemIsEquipped RingOfFate|on|in] your hand and Calise's contraption. "So how does it actually... work? Do I need to stand in there?" You point to the middle of the circle. "Well..." Calise hums, "the ring needs to be in there, yes. I have no idea if it needs to be on somebody. I don't think it should. But I haven't tested this thing yet. It might turn you to ashes as surely as it empowers the ring." Well that builds so much confidence. The look on your face must speak volumes. Calise laughs and slaps your back. "So we aren't going to try it with you in there first! Maybe not ever, if it works right away. This is science, experimentation! There's going to be some risk, but I won't take any more with you than I absolutely must." [pc.isMage |"Can you at least walk me through the principals behind the thing in more detail?" you ask. "I've heard of these devices, but the details are... sketchy." Calise nods enthusiastically. "Of course! It's effectively a lattice of lightning rods, paired with a set of leananstones that generates magical charge. The copper pylons, once charged, act to suck in ambient energy from the surroundings — the more charge, the wider the area. The energy predominantly comes directly from the veil, but in theory it may also drain magic-users somewhat-" [pc.swornGod nareva |"Like we Astrida do?" "No idea!" Calise shrugs. "I'm not really familiar with an Astrida's powers. But I'm excited to find out!" |"So like one of those mage-eaters from Tychris?" Isadora asks. "The Astrida?" Calise shrugs. "I'm not really familiar." ] "Is that dangerous?" you counter. "Potentially," Calise admits. It shouldn't be, though. Even with a massive charge, the worst that should happen is any spellcasters in the area-effect feeling winded. Still, this is why we're out here, rather than in Khor'minos City. If something does go wrong, the consequences are only on our shoulders." Isadora gulps all the same. The knightess continues on regardless: "Anyway, once the pylons have sucked up all the veil-matter and magical power from the surrounding area, they effectively compress it into whatever foci are placed within the circle — in our case, the Ring of Fate. This, in turn, should super-charge the foci with power far beyond what it could normally hope to draw upon, and in so doing will — and I know I'm using this word a lot, bear with me — charge the condensed energy with the same magic infused natively in the foci. And then when you release the pylons..." She sweeps her arms out wide. "Pow! A blast of magical power, carrying the abilities of the foci!" You scrunch your lips. "That sounds like it could reach a terminal, well, charge pretty quickly. What happens if you don't release the pylons?" There's a glint of mischief in Calise's eyes. "Good question. Artifact compression, perhaps? Or a merging of essences? Perhaps they'd simply explode. Something turned Estelore into a smudge on the map way back when, and we might all go up like a candle today if we screw around. It's impossible to say until we try. For now though, let's follow the instructions as close as we can." |You suppose that'll have to do. You certainly aren't equipped to understand the hows or whys of any of this hoodoo. ]
rows.translation: 你的目光在[pc.itemIsEquipped RingOfFate|手上|手里]的戒指和卡莉丝的那个装置之间来回打量。“那它到底是……怎么运作的？我需要站到那里面去吗？”你指了指圆圈中央。 “嗯……”卡莉丝沉吟道，“那枚戒指确实需要放在里面。我不知道它是否需要戴在某个人身上。我觉得应该不用。不过我还没测试过这个装置。它在强化戒指的同时，也可能把你烧成灰烬。” 这下我可太有信心了。 你脸上的表情一定说明了一切。卡莉丝笑着拍了拍你的背。“所以我们不会先让你站进去试！如果一次就能成功，也许永远都不用试了。这可是科学，是实验！肯定会有一些风险，但我绝不会让你承担超出绝对必要范围的风险。” [pc.isMage |“你能不能至少再详细讲讲这玩意背后的原理？”你问道，“我听说过这类装置，但细节都……很含糊。” 卡莉丝热情地点了点头。“当然可以！它实际上是一个由避雷针组成的网格，搭配上一组能够产生魔法能量的利南石。铜制支柱一旦充能，就会吸取周围环境中的游离能量——充能越多，作用范围就越广。这些能量主要直接来自面纱，但理论上它或许也会稍稍汲取施法者的魔力——” [pc.swornGod nareva |“就像我们阿斯特里达那样？” “完全不知道！”卡莉丝耸了耸肩，“我对阿斯特里达的力量其实并不太了解。不过我很期待能弄清楚！” |“所以就像提克里斯那些吃法师的家伙一样？”伊莎多拉问道，“阿斯特里达？” 卡莉丝耸了耸肩。“我其实不太了解。” ] “那危险吗？”你反问道。 “有可能。”卡莉丝承认道。不过应该不会。即使充能到极致，应该发生的最坏情况也不过是让作用范围内的施法者感到气短。不过，正因为如此，我们才待在这里，而不是在科尔米诺斯城里。如果真的出了什么差错，后果也只能由我们自己承担。 尽管如此，伊莎多拉还是咽了口唾沫。 那位女骑士不管不顾地继续说道：“总之，一旦这些支柱吸尽了周围区域所有的面纱物质和魔法能量，它们就会把这些能量压缩进圆圈内放置的任何焦点之中——在我们这里，就是命运之环。而焦点反过来会被充入远超其平时所能汲取的能量，在此过程中——我知道我这个词用得太多，请见谅——还会用焦点自身固有的魔力去同化这些浓缩的能量。然后，当你释放这些支柱时……” 她双臂大幅一挥。“砰！一道魔法能量冲击波，携带着焦点的能力！” 你抿了抿嘴唇。“听起来它会很快达到一个终点，呃，充能。如果你不释放这些支柱，会发生什么？” 卡莉丝的眼中闪过一丝促狭。“问得好。也许是神器压缩？又或者是精华融合？也可能它们干脆会爆炸。很久以前，有什么东西把埃斯托洛尔变成了地图上的一块污渍；而今天我们要是乱来的话，说不定全都会像蜡烛一样烧起来。不试试就无法确定。不过眼下，我们还是尽可能严格地按照说明来操作吧。” |你想，那也只能这样了。你肯定没本事弄懂这堆巫术的来龙去脉。 ]

rows.original: Is this even safe? What do you actually need to DO to work this contraption?
rows.translation: 这真的安全吗？要操作这个装置，到底需要做些什么呢？
rows.raw: "Is this even safe? What do you actually need to DO to work this contraption?"

rows.original: "[pc.isMage |How in the world did you get an arc magnifier?" you ask. "I thought those all vanished with Estelore..." |So where'd you find this thing?" you ask. "I don't think the king just had this in his treasury." ] Calise chuckles, and flashes you a wink. "Like I said, it was obtained with a great deal of effort. Not everything from the world's past is completely lost, it seems. Some remains hidden, or forgotten." "So where's this one from?" Isadora presses. [party.has viv |"I'd like to know too," Viv says. ] Calise taps the side of her nose. "My sources must be kept secret for their own protection. Definitely not because I found this in an old man's yard sale, making room in his guest house for refugees." "Really?" "No." [pc.presenceRange 90 |You give Calise a long, hard look until she cracks under your overpowering presence. "Ah... in my adventures I've come across the domain of... another wizard, now no longer in this world. I took it as my own, and with it came his belongings. Among them, this. Transporting it safely to the city was expensive and difficult, but the device itself was salvaged by me alone some time ago. Shortly after I came to the Frost Marches, as it happens." "And where is this wizardly domain?" [calise.isKasyrra |This time, Calise gives you a taunting look. "I think you know very well where, my dear. Tread carefully with my secrets." |Calise shrugs. "I won't say. I have safehouses here and there, now, that even you all need not know of. I can't put all my cards on the table. You never know..." ] That seems as much as you're likely to get. |You give Calise a look, but she just smiles. Guess she's not saying... ]
rows.translation: "[pc.isMage |你究竟是怎么得到那个电弧放大器的？”你问道，“我以为那些东西早就和埃斯特洛尔一起消失不见了…… |那你是从哪里找到这个东西的？”你问道，“我觉得国王的宝库里不可能会有这个吧。 ] 卡莉丝轻笑着，朝你眨了眨眼：“就像我说的，这是通过付出很多努力才得到的。真的不是那么容易的。一切看来，关于这个世界的过去，我们已经完全失去了了解。有些遗迹可能还被隐藏着，或者已经被人们遗忘了。” “那么，那些遗迹到底在哪里呢？这个其中一个是谁呢？”伊莎多拉追问道。 [party.has viv |我也想知道，”薇芙说道。 ] 卡莉丝轻敲着自己的鼻子：“为了保护这些消息来源，我必须对他们的身份保密。绝对不是因为我在某个老人的庭院旧货出售活动中发现了这些信息，更不是因为那个老人为了让难民有地方住而腾出了自己招待客人的房子。” “真的吗？” “不是的。 [pc.presenceRange 90 |你紧紧地注视着卡莉丝，直到她在你强大的压迫感下终于屈服了。 “啊……在我的冒险途中，我曾经进入过另一位巫师的领地……不过那位巫师现在已经不在这个世界上了。我把那个领地据为己有，也因此得到了他的所有财产。其中，就是这个。将它安全地运送到城市既昂贵又困难，但这个设备本身其实是不久前由我独自找到的。恰好在我来到霜冻边境之后不久。" “那么，这个充满魔法的领域到底在哪里呢？" [calise.isKasyrra |这一次，卡莉丝给出了你一个充满讥讽的眼神。“我想你很清楚那是在哪里，亲爱的。我的秘密可不容你随意触碰。 |卡莉丝耸了耸肩：“我不会说的。我现在在一些地方设有安全藏身处，就连你们这些人也不必知道这些地方的存在。我不能把所有底牌都摊在桌面上。谁知道会发生什么呢…… ] 这似乎已经是你能得到的最大限度了。 |你看了卡莉丝一眼，但她只是微笑着。看来她并没有什么要说的…… ]

rows.original: So where exactly did Calise get her hands on something so valuable?
rows.translation: 那么，卡莉丝究竟是从哪里得到这么珍贵的东西的呢？
rows.raw: "So where exactly did Calise get her hands on something so valuable?"

rows.original: "So... what could we put in there?" you ask. "Or who?" Calise puts a hand up. "Let's not get ahead of ourselves, dear. The point is to test the Ring of Fate's properties, not the device's." "Humor me." "Fine, fine. From what I understand, the mages of Estelore would use these devices to build up their wizardly towers — to impregnate stone and brick with magical power. They would put something enchanted with protective powers in the arc magnifier, spin it up, and discharge it directly into structures over and over. Gave them longevity, and protected them from direct attack... in theory anyway. But it could also be used to affect people just as well." Calise pauses, glancing at you. "I've even come across accounts of mages using psychoactive substances in the magnifier, directly infusing their own bodies with drugs for a shared experience. 'Transcendental' I've heard it called. Apparently one sorcerer from Tychris was able to use the device to cause several individuals to share a single dream together, an out-of-body experience shared by dozens of individuals connected through the magnifier. Unfortunately what foci that particular use-case centered on wasn't mentioned." "Was there anything about putting people in there?" Calise grimaces. "Not that I found. I don't believe it would be harmful to you — after all, foci can be reused over and over — but I'd rather not have to find out if we can help it. Nor do I know what would actually happen if we did use a person as a foci. Would it distribute your memories and personality to everyone affected, or perhaps it would mutate everyone to look like you? I honestly can't say without experimentation. But let's agree to start with lab rats before people, hmm?" [pc.isMage |You consider that for a moment, then frown. "And what about a demon?" "That... is an excellent question." Calise smirks. "The average succubus is much hardier and, more importantly, much more malleable than a human. I suspect that malleability might allow her to absorb power more safely — in other words, if the pylons' charge wasn't released but entirely condensed inwards, it might directly and permanently affect the demon whereas a normal human would surely burn out like a twig in firestorm." Isadora frowns. "I don't follow. Affect how?" "Depends on the foci in there with her," Calise says. You glance at the Ring of Fate. "What about this?" Calise's eyes practically glow with excitement. "Now you're thinking, [pc.name]. What about it, indeed. What might happen if a succubus and a divine relic that protects against corruption merged together? What might happen if a being born without a soul in the first place did? But we're getting far, far ahead of ourselves aren't we...?" |"Lab rats?" She waves a hand. "An expression, dear. It's safer to experiment on animals than people." ]
rows.translation: “那么……我们能往里面放些什么呢？”你问道，“或者说，放谁进去？” 卡莉丝举起一只手。“亲爱的，别操之过急。重点是要测试命运之环的特性，而不是这台设备的特性。” “迁就我一下嘛。” “好吧，好吧。据我所知，埃斯托洛尔的法师们会用这些设备来建造他们的法师塔——让石头和砖块饱浸魔力。他们会把一件附有防护魔力的物品放进电弧放大器里，让它转起来，然后一次又一次地把能量直接释入建筑之中。这能让它们长久留存，也能保护它们免受直接攻击……至少理论上是这样。不过，它同样可以用来影响人们。”卡莉丝顿了顿，瞥了你一眼。“我甚至读到过一些记载，说有的法师会在放大器里使用精神活性药物，把药物直接注入自己体内，以获得共通的体验。我听说那被称作‘超验’。据说提克里斯的一位巫师曾用这台装置让好几个人共同进入同一个梦境——数十个通过放大器相连的人共享的一场灵魂出窍的体验。遗憾的是，那个用例究竟以什么样的焦点物为核心，记载中并没有提到。” “有没有哪里提到过把人放进去的事？” 卡莉丝皱起脸。“我没找到。我不认为这对你会有害——毕竟焦点物可以反复使用——但能的话，我还是不想去验证这一点。我也不知道，如果我们真的用一个人当焦点物，究竟会发生什么。它会把你的记忆和人格分给所有受影响的人，还是会把所有人都变成你的样子？老实说，不做实验我也说不准。不过，我们还是先约定用小白鼠做实验，再用人，好吗？” [pc.isMage |你思考了片刻，然后皱起眉头。“那恶魔呢？” “这个……问得非常好。”卡莉丝得意地笑了笑。“一般的魅魔比人类要坚韧得多，更重要的是，可塑性也强得多。我怀疑这种可塑性或许能让她更安全地吸收能量——换句话说，如果塔柱中的能量没有被释放出去，而是完全向内凝聚，它可能会直接而永久地影响那个恶魔；而普通人肯定会像火风暴中的枯枝一样被烧尽。” 伊莎多拉皱起眉头。“我不明白。怎么个影响法？” “那得看跟她一起待在里面的焦点物是什么，”卡莉丝说。 你瞥了一眼命运之环。“这个呢？” 卡莉丝的眼睛里几乎闪烁着兴奋的光芒。“这才叫动脑子，[pc.name]。确实，那又会怎样呢。如果一个魅魔和一件能抵御腐化的神圣遗物融为一体，会发生什么？如果一个生来就没有灵魂的存在与之融合，又会发生什么？不过，我们是不是想得太远太远了……？” |“小白鼠？” 她摆了摆手。“只是个说法，亲爱的。在动物身上做实验总比在人身上安全。” ]

rows.original: What if you put something other than the ring in there? What about a person?
rows.translation: 要是你往里面放的不是那枚戒指，而是别的东西呢？那放一个人进去呢？
rows.raw: "What if you put something other than the ring in there? What about a person?"

rows.original: You run a finger over the jade teardrop set into the Ring of Fate. "What about Talsenne?" "Who, dear?" Calise asks. You take a moment to explain what happened after you got the ring from the Grave of Saints: Talsenne appearing in your bed, her allowing you to summon forth her spirit from the ring to aid you in battle. Calise nods along, though her brow furrows deeply. "I see. A good question, then. I'm afraid I don't know the answer. There being a spirit bound to the foci complicates things... but perhaps charging up the ring will empower her? I can't imagine it would harm her, she's just a ghost after all. So long as her spirit remains bound to the ring, there's not much any exterior force could do to dispatch her short of total abjuration." Calise shrugs. "We won't know until we try. I'll go easy on her, I promise."
rows.translation: 你用手指轻轻触摸那颗镶嵌在玉器上的泪滴状装饰物。命运之环那塔尔森呢？” “谁啊，亲爱的？”卡莉丝问道。 你花了一点时间向她解释在从圣徒墓地取得那枚戒指之后发生的事情：塔尔森出现在你的床边，她还允许你通过那枚戒指召唤她的灵魂来帮助你战斗。卡莉丝点了点头，不过她的眉头紧锁着。 “我明白了。这确实是个好问题。可惜，我不知道答案。有灵魂附着在这些焦点上，确实让事情变得复杂了……不过，也许给这个戒指充能，能够帮助她吧？我无法想象这会对她造成伤害，她毕竟只是一具幽灵。只要她的灵魂还附着在这枚戒指上，除了彻底放弃这种联系之外，没有任何外力能够将她驱散。 卡莉丝耸了耸肩。只有尝试过了才能知道结果。我保证会对她手下留情的。

rows.original: The Ring of Fate has a spirit bound to it. Will she be okay?
rows.translation: 命运之戒上附有一种灵魂。她能平安无事吗？
rows.raw: "The Ring of Fate has a spirit bound to it. Will she be okay?"

rows.original:
The Minoan soldiers stand well back as Calise begins circling the arc magnifier, activating the pylons one by one. The air around you electrifies once again, making your heart hammer faster in your chest. Lightning begins to crackle around the leananstone stakes, leaping erratically to the copper spires without catching like the first time — without Calise giving it animus. You try to calm your breathing, but the energy building up around you is palpable, like a weight bearing down on you. 

    Aside from Calise's footsteps and the crackle of lightning, the gymnasium is heavy with silence. Anticipation.
    
    "What do you think is going to happen?" Isadora finally asks.
    
    Calise takes a deep breath, then gives her a thin smile. "If everything goes as I hope? There should be a snap of magical discharge, and then we'll all feel... whatever it is [pc.name] feels when wearing the ring. We'll all be under its aegis, at least temporarily. In fact-"
    
    She never gets to finish the thought.
rows.translation:
米诺斯士兵们远远退开，卡莉丝则开始绕着电弧放大器踱步，逐一激活那些塔柱。你周围的空气再次带上电流，让你胸腔里的心脏擂得更快。闪电开始在利南石桩周围噼啪作响，不规则地跃向铜制尖塔，却不像第一次那样被引燃——因为卡莉丝没有赋予它能量。你试着平复呼吸，但周围积聚的能量却清晰可感，像一股重压压在你身上。 

    除了卡莉丝的脚步声和闪电的噼啪声，体育馆里沉甸甸地充满寂静。还有期待。
    
    “你觉得会发生什么？”伊莎多拉终于问道。
    
    卡莉丝深吸一口气，然后对她露出一个淡淡的微笑。“如果一切都如我所愿？应该会有一声魔法释放的脆响，然后我们都会感觉到……[pc.name]戴着这枚戒指时所感觉到的那种东西。至少在短时间内，我们都会处于它的庇护之下。事实上——”
    
    但她始终没能把这句话说完。

rows.original:
There's a blur of movement in the corner of your eye. Calise whirls, bringing up her axe just in time to deflect an arrow raining down from on high. Splinters shatter into the magic circle now at her back. Her soldiers shout in alarm, drawing blades and forming a wall of shields around her. [party.som
            |
            |Your own companion joins ranks as well, weapon at the ready. 
            |Your own companions join ranks as well, grabbing their own weapons. 
        ]Something massive impacts against the gymnasium's door, and they buckle on their hinges; shadows dart atop the upper stands surrounding the floor where you've gathered. You catch [var0
            |sight of horns and tails
            |a glimpse of dark ears and fluffy tails lunging into the shadows
        ]. 
        
        The air around the circle throbs with arc lightning, running wild in that split second of broken concentration before Calise extends a hand and seizes the spell back under control. [pc.hasPower SummonTalsenne
            |Nevertheless, there's a howl from inside the circle as Talsenne conjures herself in the eye of the storm, body crackling with lightning. Her eyes are aflame with power, but there's a deeply pained look to her now. She looks to you in alarm. "What manner of devilry is this!?"
        ]
        
        The door caves to a second impact, and a score of frothing minotaurs rage into the gym with you, bearing crude cudgels and clad in shattered remnants of Minoan heavy armor. Isadora screams in horror at seeing the mad, corrupted beasts. The other Legion bulls charge past her, slamming their shields into their twisted kinsmen to blunt the charge. Between the battle lines, a tiny goblin with a whip and buckler cackles, lashing at one of the Legionnaires' feet to pull him down. 
        
        "[pc.name]!" Calise yells, though her eyes are focused wholly on the circle. "Hold them off. That arrow — something's wrong! Hold them off!"
        
        You look down, and see the splinters of the deflected shot smoking inside the circle, reeking of ozone and sulfur. You can dwell on that later — battle rages!
rows.translation:
眼角忽然掠过一片模糊的动静。卡莉丝猛地转身，及时扬起战斧，挡开一支从高处射下的箭。破碎的木屑落入此刻位于她身后的魔法阵。她的士兵们惊呼示警，拔出刀剑，在她身边组成一道盾墙。[party.som
            |
            |你的一名同伴也加入队列，武器已准备就绪。 
            |你的同伴们也加入队列，纷纷拿起各自的武器。 
        ]某个庞然大物撞上体育馆的大门，门扇在铰链上弯曲变形；你们聚集的场地四周，上层看台有暗影飞快掠过。你瞥见了[var0
            |尖角和尾巴
            |黑色耳朵与蓬松尾巴扑进阴影的一幕
        ]。 
        
        魔法阵四周的空气因电弧而震颤；注意力中断的短短一瞬，闪电便肆虐起来，直到卡莉丝伸出手，重新将法术牢牢控制。[pc.hasPower SummonTalsenne
            |即便如此，法阵内部依然传来一声嚎叫：塔尔森在风暴眼中凝聚成形，身体上电光四射。她的双眼燃烧着力量，此刻脸上却写满痛苦。她惊恐地望向你。“这是什么邪魔手段！？”
        ]
        
        第二次撞击将大门彻底轰塌，二十多个口吐白沫的弥诺陶洛斯怒吼着冲进体育馆。他们手持粗制棍棒，身上披着弥诺斯重甲残破的遗骸。看见这些疯狂而腐化的怪物，伊莎多拉惊恐地尖叫起来。其他军团牛族士兵从她身旁冲过，将盾牌猛撞向扭曲的同族，抵挡这轮冲锋。两军阵线之间，一个手持短鞭与小圆盾的小个子哥布林放声怪笑，挥鞭缠住一名军团士兵的脚，将他拖倒在地。 
        
        “[pc.name]！”卡莉丝高声喊道，双眼却完全专注于魔法阵。“挡住他们。那支箭——情况不对！挡住他们！”
        
        你低头望去，看见被挡开的箭矢碎片正在法阵内冒烟，散发出臭氧与硫磺的刺鼻气味。稍后再思考其中缘由吧——战斗已经打响！

rows.original: The Ring of Fate's effects are charging the battlefield.
rows.translation: 命运之环的效果正在为战场充能。
rows.raw: "\n \n The Ring of Fate's effects are charging the battlefield."

rows.original: The wall of raging bulls breaks under the ferocity of your counter attack. Isadora's able to grab the fallen member of her unit and help him to his feet, while the other two batter down the last of their corrupted comrades. The goblin squeals on her knees, shrieking about how life isn't fair and how Tollus promised her — something that gets cut off when Isadora flattens her face with the front of her shield. The goblin crumples into a silent heap. "Damn demons. How did they find us?" Isadora groans. "Is everyone... alright?" Calise asks through grit teeth. The spell's still threatening to get away from her, sizzling and crackling as the arrow-shards burn out around her. Whatever magic was woven into them is powerful enough to even have [calise.isKasyrra |the demon queen herself |the Champion of Velun ] on the back foot. "A little help, please!" [var0 |But those dark tails you saw on the sniper — that had to be the same assassin from the mountaintops. [silly |You would never forget prime mofu like that! ]Shit, she can't have gotten far. You might still be able to catch her if you leave now. ]
rows.translation: 在你猛烈的反击之下，那些狂怒的公牛般的敌人终于被击溃了。伊莎多拉及时抓住了她队伍中倒下的同伴，帮助他站了起来，而另外两个人则继续击败那些被腐蚀的敌人，消灭了他们最后的抵抗。那个哥布林跪在地上尖叫，哭诉着生活为何如此不公平，还哭诉着托勒斯曾向她许下什么承诺——然而当伊莎多拉用盾牌的前部猛击她的脸时，她的尖叫声就被戛然而止。那个哥布林顿时瘫软在地，再也没有发出任何声音。 该死的恶魔，他们是怎么找到我们的？”伊莎多拉呻吟道。 “大家都……没事吧？”卡莉丝咬紧牙关问道。那个咒语仍在对她产生威胁，周围的箭矢碎片不断燃烧，发出嘶嘶声和噼啪声。其中蕴含的任何魔法力量，都足以产生惊人的效果。 [calise.isKasyrra |恶魔女王本人 |维伦的冠军 ]处于被动地位。“请帮个忙吧！ [var0 |但是你在狙击手身上看到的那些黑色尾巴——肯定就是那些来自山顶的刺客。 [silly |你绝对不会忘记那样的极品萌物吧！ ]该死，她应该没跑多远。如果你现在出发，还是有可能抓住她的。现在。 ]

rows.original: You take off running the moment the last corrupted bull falls, dashing out of the gym in the same direction the assassin went. Someone screams your name behind you, but you're heedless to it now: the hunt is on. The city around the gymnasium is dead and silent, but there's only one other tunnel leading out of it besides the one you came through, and there's no chance the assassin is heading towards Khor'minos. You just have to beat her to the pass. And so you dash through the streets as fast as your [pc.feet] will carry you, leaping over tumbled carts and banking around alley corners until you arrive at the cave's mouth. And there she is. You realize that you're alone with her.
rows.translation: 就在最后一只被腐蚀的公牛倒下的瞬间，你立刻拔腿狂奔，朝着刺客离开的方向冲出了体育馆。有人在你身后喊着你的名字，但你根本没有理会——这场追逐已经开始了。 体育馆周围的城市一片死寂，但除了你进来时使用的那条通道外，这里只有一条其他的出口通道，而刺客绝对不可能选择那条路离开。朝向科尔米诺斯。你只需要比她更快地到达那个地点即可。于是，你以最快的速度冲过街道[pc.feet]它会带你跃过翻倒的车辆，在胡同的拐角处灵活地转弯，直到你来到洞穴的入口。 然后，你看到了她。 你意识到，此刻只有你和她在一起。

You realize that you're alone with her."

rows.original: The assassin skids to a halt just a few yards from you, throwing aside her bow and drawing the long, silvery-iron blade from her hip. [pc.ra kitsune |"Keros' Champion," she says evenly, bringing her katana into a two-handed grip. "It is good that we meet alone... the Trickster's adopted [pc.mf |son |daughter ] and the discarded bastard. If you think you are fit to challenge me alone, then come. I relish the chance to inflict further loss on that false god." "Who are you?" you ask, drawing your own weapon. The assassin snarls beneath her facemask. "I am a faceless. Cast aside by my kin for my sins. Nothing more, now, than a blade in my master's hand. He took me in when all the world would have me killed. For that, I will kill again, if that is what he asks. And your death will cast all the Dark Queen's plans into disarray. Come then. Let us dance." |"We meet again, Champion. But now you have no followers to shield you from me." She brings the sword up to a two-handed grip over her head. "I was not tasked with killing you today, but I know full well that your death will throw the Dark Queen's plans into disarray. My master will praise me if I bring him your head." "Who are you?" you ask, drawing your own weapon. The assassin snarls beneath her facemask. "I am nothing more than a faceless blade. You needn't know more than that. If you wish to face me, come, learn all you wish from my sword!" ]
rows.translation: 刺客在距离你只有几码的位置滑停，将弓扔到一旁，从腰间抽出一柄修长的银铁刀。 [pc.ra kitsune |“凯洛斯的勇者，”她平静地说道，双手握住武士刀。“我们能够单独见面，再好不过……诡计之神的养[pc.mf |子 |女 ]，还有遭到抛弃的私生子。若你认为自己有资格独自挑战我，那就来吧。我正期待让那个伪神遭受更多损失。” “你到底是谁？”你拔出自己的武器问道。 刺客在面罩下发出低吼。“我是一个无面者，因自己的罪行遭到族人抛弃。现在的我不过是主人手中的一把利刃。全世界都想置我于死地时，是他收留了我。若他开口要求，我会为此再次杀人。而你的死亡将让暗影女王的所有计划陷入混乱。来吧，让我们共舞。” |“我们又见面了，勇者。不过这一次，你身边没有追随者替你挡剑。”她双手举剑，握到头顶上方。“我今天的任务不是杀你，但我非常清楚，你的死会让暗影女王的计划陷入混乱。若把你的头带给主人，他一定会嘉奖我。” “你到底是谁？”你拔出自己的武器问道。 刺客在面罩下发出低吼。“我不过是一柄无名无面的利刃。除此以外，你不必知道。若想与我交手，那就来吧；想知道的一切，都从我的刀刃上寻找！” ]

rows.original: After her, before it's too late!

You rush over to Calise and start pulling at the sizzling shards of the arrows, ripping them out of the magic circle as quick as you can. The knightess grits her teeth and pulls on the strands of lightning arcing from the magnifier, slowly tearing the magic coursing through the machine apart as though it were a physical effort rather than a work of spellcraft. [var0 |Talsenne bends to try and help you, though she's got arcs of lightning flowing across her bare body like strands of fine wire. Whereas Calise struggles, the ghostly cowgirl is practically glowing with power! ] When you finally pull the last shards free, the arcing lightning snaps out of existence, and Calise stumbles back with a gasp. You just manage to catch her before she falls, though in all that armor she's so heavy that you've got little choice but to bear her down to the ground anyway. "Ah, my [calise.fucked |[pc.mf |prince |princess ] charming... |hero ]," she smiles, though it's cut off by a cough so hard that a bit of smoke spills from between her lips. "Ah! That wild magic was a bit much for me, it seems." "My lady!" Isadora gasps, rushing over. "You're... something's not right!" Calise just waves her off. "I'm fine, dear. Nothing a bit of bedrest won't fix. I'm more worried about the magnifier." You all turn to look at the machine, smoking and crackling even still. Calise waves a hand, summoning a gust of wind that blows the worst of that away, leaving just black-scored copper and cracked leananstone behind. [var0 |Talsenne gives you a wave and disappears back into the ring as well, looking relieved to be sent back into the band's dark embrace. The Ring of Fate feels momentarily heavier in your hand[flags.CALISE_RING_PC | | once you pick it back up ]. ] Calise gets to her feet and pats one of the copper pylons. "Doesn't look like anything's broken. And did you all feel that... that aegis around you in the fight, and which drove those bulls mad? I think it worked!" "It definitely did something," Isadora agrees. "I felt all warm and tingly inside. Like mom was hugging me the whole time." One of her fellow soldiers snickers, which earns him a punch in the hip. Calise squeezes the younger girl's shoulder. "Not how I would have phrased it, but I'm glad it worked all the same. Especially given the interference. I can only imagine the power we can wield with the device at full capacity!" She turns to the soldiers. "There's a covered wagon behind the gymnasium. rows.original:
You crumple beneath the Faceless Blade's onslaught, and soon find the tip of her sword beneath your chin, lifting your head up so that you look directly into her blood-red eyes. 

    [pc.ra kitsune
        |"Tsk. Keros' chosen amounts to nothing. I expected more, but yet, I find myself unsurprised. Followers of a treacherous god are doomed by design. Give him my regards."
        |"So this is what the false prophet's champion amounts to: nothing at all. In your death, my master will ascend, and all the world will tremble. Rest now."
    ]
    
    You feel a sharp pain in your throat, and the world goes red.

rows.original: The Faceless Blade stumbles back, snarling and clutching at [lastStanding.resDefeated |her chest |her wounds ]. "You... even alone, you are so very strong. How? How can you defeat me again!? Nyah!" She falls to a knee, barely supporting herself on the blade of her sword. "So weak... even after all these years..." You take a step forward, but the kitsune lunges back to her feet and wards you away with her sword. Her back presses against the cavern stone. "You aren't running this time," you tell her. "Put the sword down." Her red-eyed gaze drills into you. "No. Death before dishonor." In a flash, her blade twists around in her hands, and she lets her knees buckle. Your own breath catches as the [pc.ra kitsune |katana |iron sword ] punches through her chest and out her back. Her eyes go wide for a second, and a gasp of pain escapes her lips... and then she falls to the ground, still as the stone.

rows.original:
A few moments later, Calise[party.som
            | and Isadora
            |, Isadora, and [comp1.name]
            |, Isadora, and your companions
        ] arrive on the scene. They're breathless from the run, and you can see black marks on Calise's breastplate from lightning scoring. Her hair's a mess, spilling out of her helm in gnarled waves of brown. 
        
        "Ah, you're alive!" the paladin pants, skidding to a halt just shy of where the blade lies. "And it looks like you're the only one. Well done. That said, you're a bellend for running off alone." 
        
        She sighs and [calise.fucked
            |gives you a kiss on the cheek
            |claps your shoulder
        ]. "But you're alright, and that's what matters."
        
        "What happened to your device?" you ask her. 
        
        The knightess sighs. "Damaged but not destroyed. I'll need to repair it and make sure every last splinter's removed before we activate it again, but did you see the way those corrupted minotaurs were behaving? Driven mad! And even I felt the ring's aegis on me. I think we have a winner on our hands."
        
        So it worked. Good.
        
        [flags.CALISE_RING_PC
            |
            |"Speaking of which," Calise produces the ring from her pocket and places it back in your hands. "Safe and sound. [pc.hasPower SummonTalsenne
                |Unfortunately your ghostly friend vanished entirely after the fight. Those enchanted shards hurt her quite a bit, I'm sorry. We weren't able to get them out quick enough before she had to discorporate.
                |Take good care of it, please.
            ]"
        ]
        
        "We should get back to the city," you suggest. "We made a lot of noise. More demons could be coming."
        
        "Good idea," Calise nods. "Isadora, boys, there's a covered wagon behind the gym. Load the pylons into it and get them to your barracks. I'll pick them up later."
        
        "Ma'am!" They salute, and jog off. Calise gives you a weary smile and follows them at a more leisurely pace, and you fall in beside her.

        我们应该回城里去，”你建议道，“我们制造了太多动静，可能会吸引更多的恶魔过来。”

rows.original:
You walk up to the house with [bri.name] in tow and knock at the door before entering, surprising yourselves with the emptiness of the lounge. Looks like Rina might be out. It's Cassia who greets you instead, emerging from the kitchen in her toga.

    "Hi, you two," she says, smiling. "Rina's gone to stay with a couple of her girlfriends from her athletics club. They haven't seen each other in a while, I understand. She said to say hi to you, and she'll be back soon."
    
    "That's good," you say. "She was talking about how much she missed them."
    
    Cassia nods. "They've all grown up together, playing sports and running. Hard to find closer friends. Now, then — I was going to celebrate the lack of work and responsibility with some of the wine in my larder. Care to join me?"
    
    Absolutely.

你带着[bri.name]走到屋前，敲过门后走了进去，却惊讶地发现起居室空无一人。看来莉娜或许出门了。前来迎接你们的是卡茜娅；她身穿托加，从厨房里走了出来。

    “嗨，你们两个，”她微笑着说。“莉娜去几个田径俱乐部的女朋友家住了。听说她们已经有一阵子没见面。她让我替她向你们问好，还说很快就会回来。”
    
    “那很好，”你说。“她之前还在说自己有多想念她们。”
    
    卡茜娅点点头。“她们从小一起长大，一起运动、奔跑，很难找到比这更亲密的朋友了。那么——我正打算拿储藏室里的酒，庆祝一下今天既没有工作也没有责任。要一起喝吗？”
    
    当然。

rows.original: It quickly comes to light that you and Cassia had very different ideas about what some of her wine meant. Several bottles of various vintages from her wine rack are polished off one after another while you, [brint.name] and Cassia eat the various meats, produce and nuts laid across the table. The three of you eat and drink until you're satisfied, and the little party only winds down when [brint.name] goes to take a nap in [brint.isBrienne|her|his] room. "Aaahhh, this was nice," Cassia sighs, taking a sip of wine from her half-full glass. "I haven't had a real day off in weeks." "Adventuring is kinda like a day off every day," you say. She laughs. "I suppose it is. The gods know I wasn't up to much good when I was adventuring." "What were your adventuring days like?" you say. "Not too different from yours, I'd imagine," she says. "A lot of fighting and traveling during the day, and a lot of sex during the night. I doubt things have changed much in the last twenty-ish years!" You [pc.mascFem|chuckle|giggle]. "It doesn't sound like they have." "We did get up to some fun," Cassia recalls. "The best times were the ones where we barely escaped with our lives but came away with some treasure." She points to her right ear. "Got these scars when some skeleton wrapped up in animated vines swung a sword at me. Evil druid in a village. Dreadful, when you think about it, but at the time I was a young girl having the time of her life just swinging a hammer around." You raise an eyebrow. [brint.isBrienne|"I think Brienne might take after you more than she knows." "Hahahaha!" Cassia laughs, a big grin settling on her flushed face. "I'll bet she does. She's certainly a lot bigger than I ever was!|"I think Brint might take after you more than he knows." "Hahahaha!" Cassia laughs, a big grin settling on her flushed face. "I'll bet he does. He's always been just like me!] Well, good to know things never change. Except my body," she sighs. "All pudgy now, nothing like my adventurer days."

rows.original: "So, how do you really feel about having more children?" you say. "Sexy talk aside." "I do very much love the process of you putting babies in me," Cassia says, smiling wide. "There, now the sexy talk is aside. Why not? I think it would be lovely. I'm taking care of the house most of the time anyway, and both Rina and [brint.name] are adults. It might get a little chaotic around here but, well, that's life with children, isn't it?" "That's true," you say, nodding. "Okay. I just wanted to see how you felt about it." "We don't have to have more, of course," she says. "But if you did, say, accidentally knock me up late one night after an hour of sweaty fun, I would be fine with that." "I thought you said you were putting sexy talk aside," you say. Cassia smiles, a twinkle in her eye as her tail waves behind her. "It's never too far from my mind when I'm around you. I guess it just slipped out there." You grin. "Fair enough."

rows.original: You start looking around for Cassia. She's not outside, or in the living room. Maybe she's upstairs in her room? Just when you draw close to the door it cracks ajar, and a lightning flash of fur and fuzz streaks out of the opening only to bowl into your shins with an audible thump. "Laura! Don't you go running through the house!" you hear Cassia calling from inside her room, the urgent sound of her hooves drawing closer to the door. She opens it with a stern expression on her face, one that melts away when she sees you. "Hi, [pc.name]. Did you catch our little monster?" You look down at the tiny thing by your [pc.hasToes |feet |hooves ]. [var0] [pc.mf |"Dada!" |"Mama!" ] she chirps, looking very pleased with herself. You smile, bending down to pluck your giggling puffball of a child off the ground and into your arms. "Hello. And what are you doing, hmm?" Cassia smiles as she watches you send Laura into fits of giggles by rubbing your [pc.hasMuzzle |snout against her nose |nose against hers ], hugging her to your chest. "You're very fuzzy," you say to Laura. "Aren't you?" "Fuzzy!" Laura repeats, putting her arms in the air. Cassia laughs. "Cowgirls grow a bit of a coat when they're young. It goes away by the time they're teenagers, but for a little while we look like balls of fur." "You are a ball of fur," you say, smiling at Laura. "Fur!" she says. "Yup," you say. Cassia says something, but you can't quite hear it. The last thing you see is Laura's adorable carefree smile before everything goes black. You awaken with a start, utter confusion filling your head. Looking around, you see the familiar environment of the family house, and your memories begin to slowly file back into place. That's right... you were going to get off the couch and talk to Cassia. It looks like you ended up dozing off instead. Blinking the tiredness out of your eyes, you stretch before peeking into the nursery. There, in one of the cots, sleeping as though she doesn't have a care in the world, is Laura. She's only very young right now, not quite like the girl you saw in the dream, but... "Oh, here you are," you hear from behind you. "I saw you napping on the couch and didn't want to wake you up." You turn and smile. "Hey, babe." Cassia joins you in looking down at Laura, the two of you peering into the cot at your child. "Isn't she cute?" "She's adorable," you say. "Will she grow fur as she gets older?" Cassia nods. "A lot of it. The coat usually comes in around three. Have you seen it before?" "Actually, I had a dream..." you start. Cassia listens to your story and smiles when you finish. "So you saw her all furry, huh? Was she cute?" You nod. "She was. She's going to grow up to be really pretty if the dream is any indication." You look back at Laura. "Though I guess we already knew that what with how beautiful her mother is." "Ha! Charmer," Cassia says, leaning in and smooching you on the cheek. You walk out to the lounge with her before you remember. "Oh, I was going to come and find you," you say. "Oh? Well, you have me," Cassia says with a grin. "What's on your mind?"
rows.translation: 你开始四处寻找卡茜娅。她不在外面，也不在客厅里。也许她在楼上的房间里吧？ 就在你靠近门的时候，门突然被微微打开，一道毛茸茸的影子从门缝中冲了出来，重重地撞在了你的胫骨上，发出清脆的声响。 劳拉！别在房子里乱跑了！”你听到卡茜娅从她的房间里喊道，她急促的脚步声也越来越近了。她打开门时脸上带着严肃的表情，但看到你后，那表情立刻消失了。嗨， [pc.name]你看到我们的小怪物了吗？” 你低头看着自己脚边那个小小的生物[pc.hasToes |脚 |蹄子 ]。 [var0] [pc.mf |达达！ |妈妈！ ]她欢快地叫着，看起来自己非常满意。 你微笑着弯下腰，把那个咯咯笑个不停的小家伙从地上抱起来，放在怀里。“你好，那么你叫什么名字呢？你做什么呢，嗯？” 卡茜娅微笑着看着你用某种动作逗得劳拉咯咯直笑。 [pc.hasMuzzle |鼻子紧贴着她的鼻子 |将鼻子贴在她的鼻子旁边 ]把她抱在怀里。 “你真毛茸茸的，”你对劳拉说，“不是吗？” “毛茸茸的！”劳拉重复道，同时把双臂举到空中。 卡茜娅笑了：“女牛仔在小时候会长出一层毛茸茸的外皮。等她们进入青少年时期，这层毛就会消失，但在这段时间里，我们看起来确实像一团团毛球。” “你是一团毛茸茸的东西，”你对劳拉笑着说。 “毛茸茸的！”她回应道。 “没错，”你说道。 卡茜娅说了些什么，但你听不太清楚。最后你看到的是劳拉那可爱而无忧无虑的笑容，然后一切都陷入了黑暗。 你突然惊醒，满脑子都是混乱。环顾四周，你看到了熟悉的家庭住宅环境，你的记忆也开始慢慢恢复起来。 没错……你本来是要从沙发上起来去和卡茜娅聊天的。结果看来，你反而睡着了。你眨了眨眼睛，驱散眼中的疲惫，伸了个懒腰，然后悄悄地走进婴儿房。在那里，其中一张小床上，劳拉正睡得香甜，仿佛世上没有任何烦恼。她现在还很小，并不完全像你在梦中看到的那个女孩，但是…… 哦，你在这儿呢，”你听到身后有人说道，“我看到你在沙发上小睡，就没想吵醒你。” 你转过身，微笑着说道：“嘿，宝贝。” 卡茜娅也和你一起低头看着劳拉，你们俩一起凝视着婴儿床里的孩子。“她是不是很可爱？ 她太可爱了，”你说，“等她长大后，会长出毛来吗？” 卡茜娅点了点头：“会的，会长很多毛。通常在三岁左右的时候就会开始长毛。你以前见过吗？” “其实，我做过一个梦……”你开始讲述。 卡茜娅认真地听你讲完，听完后笑了起来：“所以你在梦里看到她全身都长满了毛，是吗？她很可爱吧？ 你点了点头。“她确实是。如果这个梦想能够预示未来的话，她长大后一定会非常漂亮。”你又回头看了看劳拉，“不过，考虑到她母亲的美丽，我想我们其实早就知道这一点了。” “哈！真会说话呢，”卡茜娅说着，凑过来亲了亲你的脸颊。你们一起走向休息室，这时你才想起来…… 哦，我本来也是打算来找你的。”你说道。 “哦？那现在你找到我了。”卡茜娅笑着回答，“你在想什么呢？
rows.raw: ' You start looking around for Cassia. She's not outside, or in the living room. Maybe she's upstairs in her room? Just when you draw close to the door it cracks ajar, and a lightning flash of fur and fuzz streaks out of the opening only to bowl into your shins with an audible thump. "Laura! Don't you go running through the house!" you hear Cassia calling from inside her room, the urgent sound of her hooves drawing closer to the door. She opens it with a stern expression on her face, one that melts away when she sees you. "Hi, [pc.name]. Did you catch our little monster?" You look down at the tiny thing by your [pc.hasToes |feet |hooves ]. [var0] [pc.mf |"Dada!" |"Mama!" ] she chirps, looking very pleased with herself. You smile, bending down to pluck your giggling puffball of a child off the ground and into your arms. "Hello. And what are you doing, hmm?" Cassia smiles as she watches you send Laura into fits of giggles by rubbing your [pc.hasMuzzle |snout against her nose |nose against hers ], hugging her to your chest. "You're very fuzzy," you say to Laura. "Aren't you?" "Fuzzy!" Laura repeats, putting her arms in the air. Cassia laughs. "Cowgirls grow a bit of a coat when they're young. It goes away by the time they're teenagers, but for a little while we look like balls of fur." "You are a ball of fur," you say, smiling at Laura. "Fur!" she says. "Yup," you say. Cassia says something, but you can't quite hear it. The last thing you see is Laura's adorable carefree smile before everything goes black. You awaken with a start, utter confusion filling your head. Looking around, you see the familiar environment of the family house, and your memories begin to slowly file back into place. That's right... you were going to get off the couch and talk to Cassia. It looks like you ended up dozing off instead. Blinking the tiredness out of your eyes, you stretch before peeking into the nursery. There, in one of the cots, sleeping as though she doesn't have a care in the world, is Laura. She's only very young right now, not quite like the girl you saw in the dream, but... "Oh, here you are," you hear from behind you. "I saw you napping on the couch and didn't want to wake you up." You turn and smile. "Hey, babe." Cassia joins you in looking down at Laura, the two of you peering into the cot at your child. "Isn't she cute?" "She's adorable," you say. "Will she grow fur as she gets older?" Cassia nods. "A lot of it. The coat usually comes in around three. Have you seen it before?" "Actually, I had a dream..." you start. Cassia listens to your story and smiles when you finish. "So you saw her all furry, huh? Was she cute?" You nod. "She was. She's going to grow up to be really pretty if the dream is any indication." You look back at Laura. "Though I guess we already knew that what with how beautiful her mother is." "Ha! Charmer," Cassia says, leaning in and smooching you on the cheek. You walk out to the lounge with her before you remember. "Oh, I was going to come and find you," you say. "Oh? Well, you have me," Cassia says with a grin. "What's on your mind?"'

rows.original: You think you could use the services of at least one of the four centaur ladies...
rows.translation: 你觉得你至少可以享用这四位半人马女郎其中一位的服务……
rows.raw: "You think you could use the services of at least one of the four centaur ladies..."

rows.original:
"Can I ask you girls some things?" you say.
    
    "Sure!" Tandi says. "Ask away."
rows.translation:
“我能问你们几个问题吗？”你说道。
    
    “当然可以！”坦迪说道，“尽管问吧。”
rows.raw:
'
    "Can I ask you girls some things?" you say.
    
    "Sure!" Tandi says. "Ask away."
    '

rows.translation: 问问她们是如何来到这里的。
询问她们自己村庄的情况。

rows.original: Ask how business has been going. Are they getting by?
rows.translation: 问问她们的生意近况如何，她们是否还能维持生计。
rows.raw: "Ask how business has been going. Are they getting by?"

rows.original: Upbeat they may be, this isn't what the girls had planned when they first came to Khor'minos.
rows.translation: 尽管她们表现得乐观，但当初这些女孩来到科尔米诺斯时，这并不是她们原本的计划。
rows.raw: "Upbeat they may be, this isn't what the girls had planned when they first came to Khor'minos."

rows.original: Talk to the centaurs about relocation.
rows.translation: 与半人马们讨论搬迁的事情吧。

rows.original: "So how did you get here?" you ask, looking over at their horses. "I'm guessing you didn't pull the carriage yourself." "Ha ha!" Tandi laughs, following your gaze with a smile. "Yeah, not quite. We packed the carriage with things to sell, hopped inside, took things out until the four of us could actually fit in it, then set off for Khor'minos. The caves were full of patrols when we came in. Apparently it's not like that so much any more." She shrugs. "Guess it's lucky we got in when we did, in a way." "How far away did you come from, anyway?" you say. "Oh, not that far," she says. "A hundred miles or so? A few days when you've got a carriage. We had to buy it from a passing trader that settled down." "The trader sold their carriage?" you say, raising your eyebrows. Tandi laughs. "A human woman — she became a little enamored with one of the men from our village. A couple of days staying over turned into a week, then two." She smiles fondly. "I think she's expecting her fifth baby soon."
rows.translation: 那么你们是怎么来到这里的？”你问道，同时瞥了一眼他们的马。“我猜你们应该不是自己拉这辆马车的吧。” “哈哈！”坦迪笑着，顺着你的目光看了过去。“没错，确实不是我们自己拉的。我们把要卖的东西都装进马车里，然后坐了进去，不断地把东西拿出来，直到我们四个人都能够适合我们当时就是从那里进入的，然后便向科尔米诺斯进发了。我们进去的时候，那些洞穴里到处都是巡逻队。不过现在情况似乎已经不一样了。”她耸了耸肩，“从某种程度上来说，我们能在这个时候进入那里，也算是运气好的吧。” “你们到底是从多远的地方赶来的呢？你是这么说的吗？” “哦，没那么远，”她回答，“大概一百英里吧。如果有马车的话，几天就能到。我们当时是从一个路过这里并定居下来的商人那里买的马车。” “那个商人把他们的马车卖掉了？”你挑了挑眉毛，问道。 坦迪笑了起来：“有个女人啊，她对我们村里的一个男人产生了好感。本来只是留下来住几天，结果却变成了一个星期，后来又延长到了两个星期。”她满怀深情地笑着说：“我觉得她应该快要生第五个孩子了。"

rows.original: "What's your village like?" you say. "It's great," Tandi says. She gestures to the roadside and further, pointing to the deserted farmland stretching over the hills. "A lot like this but spotted with people all over the landscape." "We all grew up there," Sherine says. "It's very peaceful... I miss it." Mara strokes Sherine's back. "There, there. We'll be back before we know it, and this trip will have been a fun distraction." They nuzzle against each other and you smile. "Looks like you're all good friends." "We did all grow up together," Mell says. "We had our fair share of prancing around back at the village." "You certainly did," Mara sighs. "How many times did I have to pull you out of a bush or some such silliness?" "I don't remember," Mell says. "There is another reason we're all a bit closer now..." Tandi ventures, and all of the girls glance at Mara, who smiles. "I suppose that's natural," she says. [flags.CENT_CARAVAN_VILLAGE |"We do spend a lot of time together these days." "I can imagine," you say. |"There's a little more to me than meets the eye, [pc.name]." "Not too unusual around these parts," you note. Mara nods. "When we set out, four girls, I decided to take a... potion. Let's just say we've all been very pleased with the results." The other girls giggle. "Planning to stick with it, then?" you say. "I don't know, truth be told," Mara says. "I've always been a bit... switchy. You know?" She shrugs. "Maybe I'll take another potion when we go back home — but I can still bear children, so I'm not too worried right now." "Children?" you say. "Is that something the four of you have on your mind at the moment?" "We all take herbal contraceptives," Tandi says. "But, well — maybe for the right [pc.mf |guy |person ]... I wouldn't mind settling down here until things get less, you know, wild." ]
rows.translation: “你们的村庄是什么样的？”你问道。 “非常棒，”坦迪说道。她指了指路旁以及更远处，指向那些一直延伸到山丘之上的荒芜农田。“和这里很像，只是这片土地上到处都散落着人影。” “我们都是在村子里长大的，”谢琳说，“那里非常宁静……我很想念那里。” 玛拉轻抚着谢琳的背。“好了，好了。我们很快就会回去的，这趟旅行就当是一次有趣的消遣吧。” 她们互相蹭了蹭脸，你微微一笑。“看来你们都是很好的朋友啊。” “我们确实是一起长大的，”梅尔说，“在村子里我们可没少一起蹦蹦跳跳。” “你们当然没少干，”玛拉叹了口气，“我都不知道有多少次得把你从灌木丛之类的地方拽出来。” “我不记得了，”梅尔说。 “我们现在关系更亲密了，还有另一个原因……”坦迪试探着说道，所有女孩都看向玛拉，而玛拉只是微笑着。 “我想这很自然吧，”她说。[flags.CENT_CARAVAN_VILLAGE |“这些天我们确实经常待在一起。” “我能想象，”你说道。 |“我可不只是表面看起来这样，[pc.name]。” “在这附近，这种情况倒也不算太稀奇，”你说道。 玛拉点了点头。“我们出发的时候，一共四个女孩，我决定喝下一种……药剂。这么说吧，我们对结果都非常满意。” 其他女孩们都咯咯笑了起来。 “那你打算一直这样下去吗？”你问道。 “说实话，我也不知道，”玛拉说，“我这个人向来有点……摇摆不定。你懂吧？”她耸了耸肩。“也许等我们回家后我会再喝一瓶药剂——不过我仍然能生孩子，所以现在还不算太担心。” “孩子？”你说道，“你们四个人现在都在考虑这件事吗？” “我们都在服用草药避孕药，”坦迪说，“不过，嗯——也许遇上合适的[pc.mf |男人 |人 ]……我倒不介意在这里安定下来，直到情况变得没那么，你知道的，混乱。” ]

"A lot like this but spotted with people all over the landscape." "We all grew up there," Sherine says. "It's very peaceful... I miss it." Mara strokes Sherine's back. "There, there. We'll be back before we know it, and this trip will have been a fun distraction." They nuzzle against each other and you smile. "Looks like you're all good friends." "We did all grow up together," Mell says. "We had our fair share of prancing around back at the village." "You certainly did," Mara sighs. "How many times did I have to pull you out of a bush or some such silliness?" "I don't remember," Mell says. "There is another reason we're all a bit closer now..." Tandi ventures, and all of the girls glance at Mara, who smiles. "I suppose that's natural," she says. [flags.CENT_CARAVAN_VILLAGE |"We do spend a lot of time together these days." "I can imagine," you say. |"There's a little more to me than meets the eye, [pc.name]." "Not too unusual around these parts," you note. Mara nods. "When we set out, four girls, I decided to take a... potion. Let's just say we've all been very pleased with the results." The other girls giggle. "Planning to stick with it, then?" you say. "I don't know, truth be told," Mara says. "I've always been a bit... switchy. You know?" She shrugs. "Maybe I'll take another potion when we go back home — but I can still bear children, so I'm not too worried right now." "Children?" you say. "Is that something the four of you have on your mind at the moment?" "We all take herbal contraceptives," Tandi says. "But, well — maybe for the right [pc.mf |guy |person ]... I wouldn't mind settling down here until things get less, you know, wild." ] '

rows.original: "Are you getting by without anything to trade?" you say. "Aha ha..." Tandi says, glancing at Mell and Mara. "I'd say we're more than just getting by." "I think we've made more money selling our 'goods' than our goods!" Sherine says. "Turns out minotaurs really like centaur women. Not exactly a puzzle why, I guess." "You've managed to turn a disaster into an opportunity," you say. [pc.dcb |"Smart." |"Good thinking." |"Getting paid to fuck must be awesome!" ] "It's been nice," Tandi says, smiling. "Not much of an alternative anyway, but it is fun. There's a lot of pent-up soldiers in the city and outside it." "So business is booming, I take it," you say. "All things considered, it's going great," she says.

rows.original: "Do you want some help?" you say. "What do you mean?" Tandi says. You gesture out at the surroundings. The [party.som |five |six |seven ] of you — plus the two horses — are standing pretty much next to a main road with an almost-empty carriage, close to no belongings except for their coin, and no way of getting home.[flags.KMO_I1| The guard post is up the road, but they can't see what's going on down here.| There aren't even any guards.] "It's not exactly safe out here," you say. "Anything could happen." Tandi looks at her friends, stuck in thought. "We're not really suited for city life... even if we got inside. I don't know. Where else could we set up? We just settled here because it's outside. It's like home, you know? Even if there's no real sky." Where else could they set up?
rows.translation: “你需要帮忙吗？”你问道。 “你是什么意思？”坦迪反问道。 你指了指周围的景象。[party.som |五 |六 |七 ]你们这些人——再加上那两匹马——现在正站在一条主干道旁边，那辆马车几乎空无一物，除了她们身上的那些硬币之外，没有任何其他财物，而且也没有任何办法能够回家。[flags.KMO_I1| 哨所就在这条路前面，但他们看不到下面这里发生了什么。| 这里甚至连守卫都没有。] “这里其实并不安全，”你说，“随时可能发生什么事。” 坦迪望着她的朋友们，陷入了沉思。“我们其实并不适合城市生活……即使我们真的进了城。我不知道，我们还能去哪里安家呢？我们之所以选择这里，只是因为这里在户外。这里就像家一样，你知道吗？即使这里并没有真正的天空。” 他们还能去哪里安家呢？

rows.original:
"There's a farmer who still lives in the outskirts we could go see," you say slowly. "She has a wagon and a horse... and honestly that's about all I know about her. Wears overalls, dark brown skin."
        
        "Are you talking about Nottia?" Mara says.
        
        "That's her!" you say. "Have you met her, then?"
        
        Mara nods. "She passes us by every so often. I think her farm must be closer to the guardpost, a little ways north of here. Her wagon's usually coming from that direction in the mornings."
        
        "Maybe she'll be open to the possibility," you say. "I'll go take a look for her farm and see if I can ask about it."
        
        "Okay," Tandi says, nodding. "Thanks for doing this for us, [pc.name]. Even if it doesn't work out, it's nice of you to offer help."
rows.translation:
“有位农民还住在郊外，我们可以去看看她，”你慢慢说道，“她有一辆马车和一匹马……说实话，关于她我就知道这些了。她穿着工作服，皮肤呈深棕色。”
        
        “你是在说诺蒂娅吗？”玛拉问道。
        
        “就是她！”你说道，“那你见过她吗？”
        
        玛拉点了点头。“她偶尔会从我们身边经过。我想她的农场应该离哨所更近一些，就在这北边不远。每天早上，她的马车通常都是从那个方向过来的。”
        
        “也许她会愿意接受这个安排，”你说，“我去找找她的农场，看看能不能问问这件事。”
        
        “好的，”坦迪点头说道，“谢谢你为我们做这些，[pc.name]。即使最终没有成功，你愿意提供帮助，这也真是太好了。”

rows.original: You ran into that nice cowgirl farmer with her broken wagon right when you first entered the outskirts. Nottia — and she seemed pretty run off her hooves. She could probably use four centaurs around, and maybe the extra horses too.
rows.translation: 你刚一进入郊区，就遇到了那位驾驶着破损马车的善良女牛仔。她叫诺蒂娅，看起来显得非常疲惫。她大概需要四头半人马的帮助，或许还需要一些额外的马匹。
rows.raw: "You ran into that nice cowgirl farmer with her broken wagon right when you first entered the outskirts. Nottia — and she seemed pretty run off her hooves. She could probably use four centaurs around, and maybe the extra horses too."

Even if it doesn't work out, it's nice of you to offer help." ]

rows.original: "Let's get you guys to Nottia," you say, smiling. "Yay!" Tandi says, pouncing forward and hugging you. "Thanks, [pc.name]... you didn't have to do this for us." The other centaurs crowd around and you find yourself the centre of a cuddle puddle, hugged on all sides.[flags.MELL_FUCKED | Even by Mell. ] You embrace them back, petting their equine halves before helping them set the carriage up with the horses. "Been a while since you had anything to do, hm? Lazy lumps," Tandi says, stroking the horse's snout. "Time to work." The carriage trundles along to Nottia's place and down the dirt path, the centaurs hopping out and looking around with curiosity and wonder as they trot alongside the horses. "What's up?" you ask Sherine. "This farm... it looks like it might be bigger than our village," Sherine says, giggling nervously. "I hope we don't mess it up." "I'm sure Nottia'll be happy you're around no matter what," you say, reaching over and rubbing her ear. The centaur hums happily as she walks alongside you, matching the carriage's pace so as to not outrun her petting. When Nottia opens the door her expression goes from curious, to surprised, to delighted in the space of a second. She throws her arms around you in a grateful hug before you help the girls unpack and get them acquainted with the surroundings. No doubt it'll take a bit of time for them to truly settle in, but this is their new home. "Thank you so much for setting this all up, [pc.name]," Nottia says. "You've been a huge help." "No problem. I just wanted to help," you say. "The girls needed a home, and you needed a bit of handiwork. I think it'll work out great." "You can come by any time you want to be shown just how thankful we are," Mara says, giving you a wink and a smile.[flags.MELL_FUCKED | "More like you'd better come by!" Mell says. "Keep me entertained!" ] Sherine smiles. "We'll be here if you want to talk to us, [pc.name]... or, um, to have sex with us. I- I'd be happy to do that too." Tandi squeezes Sherine and the black-haired taur jumps a little, her eyes going wide. "Peep!" Tandi gives you a friendly grin. "You heard her." "We'll have to do a bit of work first," Nottia reminds her. "But after that, well. [pc.name] can visit any time [pc.heShe] likes." "Work, huh?" you say. "Don't you go offering to help out, now," Nottia says. "You've done more 'n enough for us! I'm not gonna have you slavin' away at helpin' us set up, too. Get some rest 'n come back in a few days, a'right?" You smile. "Sure. Thanks, Nottia." You give Tandi a nod. "I'll see you girls in a bit." "Bye, [pc.name]!" she says, the other centaurs joining in and waving. You set off back up the dirt path, taking it a little slower than you otherwise might just to take in the sights the same way the centaurs did. It's a nice place. Hopefully between the five of them and three horses they can get the work to clean it up done...[flags.MELL_FUCKED | Your reverie is interrupted by the sound of hooves lightly beating the ground and before you can turn around, Mell is at your side — slightly out of breath, flushed, and glaring at you. She grabs you and insistently pulls you [pc.isHeight 84 |down |in ] to give you a kiss, pulling back and looking away. "Come back soon?" she says. "I will," you say, smiling at her as she meets your gaze. "See you soon, Mell." She nods and turns around, running away to her friends before you can say anything more.[party.has brienne | "That's adorable," Brienne says, looking after her. "What a good girl." ] ] You're back at the road before too long, looking down the length of it. The centaur girls can now be found on Nottia's farm.

rows.original: "I'm not just going to compete, I'm gonna dominate this place," you tell him. "The whole city's gonna know my name." "Khaak, yeah! That's the spirit!" he says, reaching out to excitedly grip your shoulder. "Not enough rookies like you these days[pc.mf |, man | ]! Lotta people trapped in the city, so to speak." The man shrugs. "Like I said. Could be anyone." "Could even be you," you say. "Ha ha," he says, smiling. "Not for twenty years or so." rows.translation: “我不只是要参赛，我还要统治这里，”你对他说道。“整座城市都会记住我的名字。” “咔——没错！就是这种气势！”他兴奋地伸手抓住你的肩膀。“如今像你这样的新人可不多了[pc.mf |，伙计 | ]！如果想成为冠军，第一件事就是相信自己是冠军。大家根本不明白。”他靠回椅背，摇了摇头。“唉，算了。很高兴你有信心。既然想参赛，每次比赛都需要一张参赛券。它没有日期限制之类的东西——只要有参赛券，就能参加一场项目。在项目开始前两小时内，或开始后的第一个小时内来到赛场，就能进场。” “像我这样报名的人很多吗？”你问。 “参赛者中绝大、绝大多数都来自军队。有一整个军团分队除了训练什么都不做。”他咧嘴一笑。“他们才是你真正的对手。持券参赛的人通常只有几十个。当然，那本身也是一袋乱窜的猫。谁都有可能出现。运气不好的话，甚至可能遇上王家卫队。” “我猜通常不会那么倒霉，”你说道。 他笑了起来。“是啊，通常都是来找乐子，或想一夜成名的人；而且军团士兵大多不会参加角斗。最近倒有不少佣兵参赛，毕竟地下山脉现在是那副模样，他们可不愿独自离开。可以说，很多人都被困在城里。”男子耸耸肩。“就像我说的，谁都有可能。” “甚至可能是你，”你说道。 “哈哈，”他微笑着说道。“大概二十年前还能是我。” 你向他道谢，退到一旁。
rows.raw: ' "I'm not just going to compete, I'm gonna dominate this place," you tell him. "The whole city's gonna know my name." "Khaak, yeah! That's the spirit!" he says, reaching out to excitedly grip your shoulder. "Not enough rookies like you these days[pc.mf |, man | ]! If you're gonna be a champion, the first thing you need is to believe you're a champion. People don't get it." He leans back in his chair, shaking his head. "Ah well. Glad you're confident. You'll be wanting a competitor's ticket whenever you want to compete, then. No date restrictions or anything — as long as you have a ticket, you can enter one event. Show up to the event either two hours before it starts or during the first hour of it starting and you can get in." "Are there a lot of people who sign up like me?" you ask. "The vast, vast majority of people who compete are from the military. There's an entire cohort of legionnaires that do nothing but train for this." He grins. "That's who you're really up against. People who enter with the tickets usually number in the tens. 'Course, that's a whole bag of cats itself. Could be anyone. Could be the Kingsguard, if you're unlucky enough." "I'm guessing it usually isn't," you say. He laughs. "Yeah, it's usually people looking to have fun or get famous quick, not to mention the legionnaires mostly stay out of the gladiator fights. Recently there's been a bunch of mercenaries entering since they're none too keen to leave on their own what with the Undermountain being what it is right now. Lotta people trapped in the city, so to speak." The man shrugs. "Like I said. Could be anyone." "Could even be you," you say. "Ha ha," he says, smiling. "Not for twenty years or so." You thank him and step back.'

rows.original:
You take mental note of the things the attendant tells you.

        The competitor ticket costs 500 EC.
        You can purchase and hold multiple tickets at once.
        One ticket grants entry to one event.
        You can enter the gladiator event once a day.
        Enter the event by showing up on the day with a ticket from 08:00 to 11:00.
        Events have prizes.
        
        "Get all that?" he asks.
        
        You nod.
        
        "Great. Happy to remind you any time," he says.
rows.translation:
你将服务员告诉你的这些信息记在心里。

        选手入场券的价格为500枚琥珀金币。
        你可以一次性购买并持有多张门票。
        每张门票仅允许进入一个活动。
        你每天可以参加一次角斗士活动。
        只需在当天携带门票，在08:00到11:00之间到场即可进入活动。
        所有活动都会设置奖品。
        
        “这些都记住了吗？”他问道。
        
        你点了点头。
        
        “太好了。如果有需要，我随时都可以提醒你。”他说。

rows.original:
You follow the stairs up and down, further into the bowels of the Colosseum itself until you reach where you're meant to be — a dim, sandy room full of sweaty men and women itching for a fight. You stand by a bench, idly looking around at everyone else just like the others. A lean, mean old lupine with an eyepatch emerges from the crowd that's filtered in, and he knocks a stick against a dirty bronze helmet sitting on a bench to draw everyone's attention.

    "Listen up, newcomers. I can see well enough to tell there's a lotta you this time around. The first thing you need to know is that most of you won't make it past your first fight." He stops, glaring at the crowd. "An' I know each and every one of you dumb fuckers is thinking 'I'll be the exception', you stupid shits." He shakes his head. "You wouldn't be here if you didn't. Reason I say 'most of you' is 'cause some of you bastards are gonna get matched up against other newcomers. Those of you that don't, pick one of the Seven and pray."
    
    Some of the older fighters chuckle, trading glances and knowing smiles.
    
    "Experience is what counts in the arena," the lupine continues. "The veterans are bigger, stronger, and tougher than you. Even an unpracticed minotaur is gonna wear himself out against a smaller, smarter opponent." He taps his head. "Game's all about thinking. Use your damn fool heads. But then again, if ya were that smart, ya wouldn'ta come."
    
    The crowd laughs, the undercurrent of tension dissipating among them as the wolf surveys them with a half-smile. He spots you and holds your eye for a moment, his smile disappearing before he goes on. The rest of the talk is about the rules and all that.
    
    Really, though, it's not too complex — fight to win, and buddy up with your friends if you think it'll help. Sounds like it'll be an absolute bloodbath with the amount of people fighting at once...
    
    You check your gear [party.solo
        |one final time
        |with [party.compNames]
    ] before you head into the staging area right before you see the instructor giving you a head nod, heading around a corner. What does he want?
    
    [party.solo
        |You adjust your [pc.armor] before heading over
        |"Be back in a moment," you say, adjusting your [pc.armor] before heading over
    ] and finding the grizzled lupine standing by himself in the corridor. He nods at you.
    
    "You've seen fighting. Whaddya make of my prediction?" he says.
    
    "That most of them won't make it past the first fight?" you say.
    
    He nods.
rows.translation:
你沿着楼梯上下穿梭，不断深入竞技场的内部，最终来到了应该去的地方——一个昏暗、布满沙子的房间，里面到处都是那些渴望战斗的男男女女。你站在一张长凳旁，像其他人一样，闲散地观察着周围的一切。这时，一个戴着眼罩、身材瘦削而凶狠的老人从人群中走了出来，他用一根棍子敲了敲长凳上那个脏兮兮的青铜头盔，以此来吸引所有人的注意。

    听着，新来的人。我看得很清楚，这次来的新人实在太多了。你们首先需要知道的是，你们中的大多数人连第一场战斗都撑不过。”他停顿了一下，瞪视着人群继续说道，“而且我知道，你们这些蠢货，每个人都在想‘我一定会是那个例外’，真是些白痴。他摇了摇头：“如果你们没有这么做，现在就不会在这里了。我之所以说‘大多数人’，是因为其中有些人会被安排与其他新来的人组队。而那些没有被安排组队的人，就请选择七大强者中的一位，然后祈祷吧。"
    
    一些年纪较大的战士们轻声笑了起来，互相交换着眼神，脸上带着心照不宣的微笑。
    
    “在竞技场上，经验才是最重要的，”那位狼族继续说道，“那些老手们比你们体型更大、力量更强，也更加坚韧。即使是一个没有受过训练的弥诺陶洛斯，面对一个体型更小但更聪明的对手，也会很快筋疲力尽。”他敲了敲自己的头，“比赛其实就是一场智慧的较量。好好运用你们的脑子吧。不过话说回来，如果你们真的那么聪明，就不会来这里参加了。
    
    人群中爆发出笑声，那些潜藏的紧张气氛也随之消散了。那只狼带着一丝微笑注视着他们，当它注意到你的时候，它与你的目光对视了片刻，随后它的笑容消失了，继续它的谈话。接下来的讨论内容都是关于规则之类的东西。
    
    说真的，其实并没有那么复杂——只要努力战斗争取胜利，如果觉得和朋友联手会有帮助的话，那就一起合作吧。考虑到会有那么多人同时参与战斗，这场战斗肯定会变得异常激烈……
    
    你检查了一下自己的装备。 [party.solo
        |最后一次
        |与[party.compNames]一起 
    ]在你进入准备区之前，在你看到教练向你点头示意之前，先绕过那个拐角。他到底想干什么？
    
    [party.solo
        |你进行调整。 [pc.armor]在前往之前
        |马上回来，”你边说边调整着自己的姿势。 [pc.armor]在前往之前
    ]然后你看到那只满头灰白的狼独自站在走廊里。它向你点了点头。
    
    “你亲眼看到了那些战斗。你觉得我的预测怎么样？”它说道。
    
    “你认为他们中的大多数人连第一场战斗都熬不过去，对吧？”你回答道。
    
    它再次点了点头。

rows.original: "Of course they won't," you say, half-laughing as you shake your head. "Just a bunch of folk patting themselves on the back for being here." "Aye, you've got the right of it," he says, nodding and looking you over. "And you're here to win it, I s'pose." "And if I am?" you say, smile persisting. "Reckon you've got a chance, kid," he grunts. "Only thing is you haven't seen the black knight, yet. If ya make it to the end, might wanna reevaluate your chances." "I'm not walking out of here without a win," you say. He shakes his head, walking away. "That bonehead confidence o' yours is what'll either kill ya or take ya to the crown, kid. My advice is to not think too hard." "Has anyone beaten the knight before?" you say. "Nope," he says, continuing on without a glance back. So there's someone else strong here. Good. You clench your fist. The victory wouldn't be worth anything if you didn't earn it. Time to fight.
rows.translation: “他们当然不会，”你半笑着摇摇头说，“不过是一群自以为来到这里就很了不起的人罢了。” “没错，你说得对，”他点头同意，同时打量着你。“我想，你是来争取胜利的吧。” “如果我确实想要胜利呢？”你微笑着问道。 “我觉得你还是有机会的，小子，”他低声说道，“不过你还没见到黑骑士呢。如果你能坚持到最后，或许就该重新评估一下自己的机会了。” “我绝不会空手而归，”你说。 他摇了摇头，走开了。“你这种愚蠢的自信要么会害了你，要么会让你登上王座，孩子。我的建议是，别想得太复杂。” “之前有人打败过那个骑士吗？”你问道。 “没有，”他回答道，头也不回地继续前行。 看来这里还有其他人实力不俗啊。好。你握紧了拳头。如果这场胜利不是你自己赢得的，那么它就毫无意义。 是时候战斗了。

rows.original: As if the rabble even understands what they're in for.
rows.translation: 好像那些普通人真的明白自己将会面临什么一样。
rows.raw: "As if the rabble even understands what they're in for."

rows.original:
"Not my problem," you say. "I'm not like them, and they're not like me."
        
        "Aye, can tell that at a glance," he says, looking you over. "Here to try and win it, I s'pose."
        
        "Wouldn't show up if I wasn't," you say.
        
        "Reckon you've got a chance, kid," he grunts. "Only thing is you haven't seen the black knight, yet. If ya make it to the end, might wanna reevaluate your chances."
        
        "The black knight hasn't seen me," you say.
        
        "Heh," he says, cracking an actual smile as he starts to walk away. "Think you're the first one who's told me that. G'luck."
        
        You think better of asking him if anyone's beaten the knight — it doesn't matter. Just one more opponent to defeat.
        
        Time to fight.
rows.translation:
“这不是我的问题，”你说，“我和他们不一样，他们也不像我。”
        
        “嗯，一眼就能看出来，”他打量着你说道，“我想，你是来试着赢下它的吧。”
        
        “如果不想来，我就不会出现了，”你说。
        
        “我觉得你还有机会，小子，”他低声说道，“不过问题是你还没见过黑骑士。如果你能坚持到最后，或许就该重新评估一下自己的胜算了。”
        
        “黑骑士还没见到我呢，”你说。
        
        “呵，”他笑着说，真正露出一个笑容，然后转身走开。“我想你是第一个这么跟我说的人。祝你好运。”
        
        你想想还是没去问他有没有人打败过那个骑士——那不重要。不过又多了一个需要击败的对手罢了。
        
        是时候战斗了。

rows.raw: "Who cares about what happens to the other fighters?"

rows.original:
"Some of them might," you say. "Never know, with beginners."

        "'Course. Can always be wrong, but I'm usually not," he says, looking you over. "You here to try and win?"
        
        "That's the plan," you affirm.
        
        "Huh. You might have an actual chance, kid," he grunts. "Only thing is you haven't seen the black knight, yet. If ya make it to the end, might wanna reevaluate your chances."
        
        "I'll manage," you say. "Thanks for the advice, though."
        
        He waves you off as he walks away. "Good luck."
        
        The black knight certainly sounds like an opponent to look out for. Still, though, given everything that you've handled thus far... you're not too worried about an opponent you face in a sanctioned arena.
        
        Time to fight.

“有些人也许会吧，”你说，“对于初学者来说，谁也说不准。”

        “当然，也有可能猜错，但我通常不会犯这种错，”他打量着你说道，“你是来尝试赢取胜利的吗？”
        
        “没错，我的目标就是赢。”你肯定地回答道。
        
        “哼，孩子，你或许真有机会，”他低声说道，“不过问题是你还没见过那位黑骑士。如果你能坚持到最后，或许就该重新评估一下自己的机会了。”
        
        “我会做到的，”你回答道，“不过还是谢谢你的建议。”
        
        他边走边挥手把你打发走。“祝你好运。”
        
        这位黑骑士听上去确实是个需要警惕的对手。不过话说回来，考虑到你迄今为止所经历的一切……对于在正规竞技场中遇到的对手，你并不太担心。
        
        是时候战斗了。

rows.translation: 你和其他候选角斗士一起等待在拥挤的准备区，头脑清明、全神贯注。四周充满闲聊和虚张声势，你却完全不加理会；你[party.som |的注意力只集中在即将到来的战斗上。 |和[party.compNames]的注意力只集中在即将到来的战斗上。 |和同伴们的注意力只集中在即将到来的战斗上。 ] 随后一声金属铿锵传来，所有人都陷入沉默；空气中的紧张感如同灌入密室的水般节节攀升。你能看见兽族手臂与颈项上的毛发根根竖起，也有几个人脸色苍白；但现在后悔已经太迟。闸门开始上升，外界的光芒从门底涌入封闭空间。几个哥布林冲到你前方，从缝隙下面钻了出去。 光芒与喧嚣一同涌来；你向前迈步，身旁是[party.solo |最先出场的几名参赛者 |[party.compNames] ]，[flags.COLO_ATTS|熟悉的竞技场景象映入眼帘|你第一次从内部感受到竞技场何等宏伟]。高耸的墙壁将你包围，科尔米诺斯市民的咆哮充斥天空中的每一个座位。 其他参赛队伍开始从竞技场四周升起的各道闸门中涌出，你的血液已经沸腾起来。现在才像回事。四周到处有人砰然扣紧头盔，拔出武器时金铁交鸣，参赛者也纷纷举行战前仪式。[party.comp arona atugia azzy brienne brint cait etheryn einin kiyoko quin | “这他妈才像话！”阿罗娜低吼道。“让他们放马过来。” | “哈，熟悉的场面，”阿图吉娅握紧长戟，喃喃说道。 | [azzy.kdb |“躲在我身后，[pc.name]，”阿兹提醒道。“我会保护你。” |“让他们过来！”阿兹握紧长矛说道。 |“哇，好多人啊！”阿兹说道。 ] | “场面马上就会有些疯狂了，”布莉恩咧嘴笑道。 | “这会是一场令人难忘的[silly |比赛 |战斗 ]，”布林特咧嘴笑道。 | “我会掩护你，[pc.name]！”凯特说道。 | [etheryn.lnhConfidence |“哦、哦不……他、他们也太多了！”小琳哀鸣道。 |“我会留意侧翼，”小琳说道。 |“好，我们上吧！”小琳说道。 ] | 艾宁靠近你，双眼左右扫视。 | 绮奴站在你身旁，准备好提供协助。 | “看来我们得把手弄脏了，”昆因说道。 ] 魔法的嗡鸣充斥空气，一道不见其人的声音随即发出号令。 “比赛开始！”
rows.raw: ' You wait in your tightly packed staging area with all of the other prospective gladiators, your mind clean and focused. Idle chatter and posturing goes around but you pay it no heed, you[party.som |r attention solely on the coming battle. | and [party.compNames]'s attention solely on the coming battle. | and your companions' attention solely on the coming battle. ] Then you hear a clank and everyone goes silent, the tension in the air rising like water in a flooding chamber. You can see the fur standing up on the beast races' arms and necks and several people turning pale, but it's too late for regrets now. The gate begins to rise, light from the outside streaming into the enclosed space from underneath it. A couple of goblins dart ahead of you, slipping under the gap. With the light comes noise, and as you step forward with [party.solo |the first few competitors |[party.compNames] ] at your side [flags.COLO_ATTS|you take in the familiar scene of the arena|you take in the enormity of the arena from the inside]. Towering walls encircle you, the roaring citizenry of Khor'minos filling every seat in the sky. Other groups of contestants start to pour out from the various raised gates around the arena, your blood pumping already. Now this is more like it. Everywhere around you helmets are being slammed closed, metal rings out as weapons are drawn, and pre-fight rituals are performed.[party.comp arona atugia azzy brienne brint cait etheryn einin kiyoko quin | "Now we're fuckin' talking!" Arona growls. "Bring 'em on." | "Hah, a familiar scene," Atugia mutters, gripping her halberd. | [azzy.kdb |"Stay behind me, [pc.name]," Azzy cautions. "I'll protect you." |"Let them come!" Azzy says, gripping her lance. |"Oh wow, that's a lot of people!" Azzy says. ] | "This is about to get a little crazy," Brienne says, grinning. | "This is gonna be a [silly |match |fight ] to remember," Brint says, grinning. | "I've got your back, [pc.name]!" Cait says. | [etheryn.lnhConfidence |"O-oh, no... there- there's so many of them!" Ryn moans. |"I'll be watching the flanks," Ryn says. |"Alright, let's go!" Ryn says. ] | Einin draws closer to you, eyes flitting from left to right. | Kiyoko stands at your side, ready to aid you. | "Looks like we'll have to get our hands dirty," Quin says. ] A magical hum fills the air before a disembodied voice makes the call. "LET THE GAMES BEGIN!"'

rows.original: Sink back and focus on taking enemies out the smart way — when they're not looking.
rows.translation: 放松下来，专注于用聪明的方法消灭敌人——在他们没有注意的时候。
rows.raw: "Sink back and focus on taking enemies out the smart way — when they're not looking."

rows.original: There's going to be a hell of a brawl anyway. [party.solo|Crush anyone unlucky enough to get in front of you!|Form up with [party.compNames] and crush anyone unlucky enough to get in front of you!]
rows.translation: 不管怎样，肯定会有一场激烈的争斗发生。 [party.solo|碾压那些不幸挡在你前面的人吧！|与[party.compNames]会合并且碾压那些不幸挡在你前面的家伙！]
rows.raw: "There's going to be a hell of a brawl anyway. [party.solo|Crush anyone unlucky enough to get in front of you!|Form up with [party.compNames] and crush anyone unlucky enough to get in front of you!]"

rows.original: Rally the troops! Attempt to get some of the fighters near you on your side. It's the best damn chance they'll have.
rows.translation: 集结部队！尽力让身边的战士站到你这边来。这是他们能得到的最好的机会了。
rows.raw: "Rally the troops! Attempt to get some of the fighters near you on your side. It's the best damn chance they'll have."

rows.original: You dash forward into the space in the center of the arena, claiming it for yourself! "Come get a piece of this, you cowards!" you roar to the skies, [pc.hasShield|beating your weapon against your shield|brandishing your [pc.weapon]].[party.has brint | Brint follows suit, [brint.hasSet WinterKnightSet|smashing his mace against his crystalline shield and roaring|raising his huge weapons and roaring]. |[party.has brienne | Brienne follows suit, [brienne.hasSet PyromancersCloth|flames jetting from her palms as she roars|raising her weapons and roaring]. | ] ] The crowd howls in support, tens of thousands of feet and hooves beating the ground. Should you come out on top of this, your glory is assured! Already you're being surrounded by those looking to lay you low, opportunists and veterans alike! It's a fight!
rows.translation: 你冲向竞技场中央的空地，将它据为己有！ “胆小鬼们，过来尝尝这个！”你仰天咆哮，[pc.hasShield|用武器敲击盾牌|挥舞着[pc.weapon]]。[party.has brint |布林特也照做了，[brint.hasSet WinterKnightSet|让战锤猛击水晶盾牌并放声怒吼|举起巨大的武器放声怒吼]。 |[party.has brienne |布蕾妮也照做了，[brienne.hasSet PyromancersCloth|掌中喷出烈焰并放声怒吼|举起武器放声怒吼]。 | ] ] 人群高声响应，数以万计的双脚与蹄子猛踏地面。若能在此战中胜出，你必将收获无上荣光！想要把你击倒的人已经围拢过来，其中既有投机之徒，也有身经百战的老手！ 战斗开始！

rows.original: You take your time to scope out a target before striking, knocking them flat in between strikes from another competitor. You're gone before he even realizes your role in the melee, circling around and looking for another opportunity. Taking them one-by-one, you slowly whittle down the opponents around the arena until an unlucky gust of wind clears the cover of swirling dust around you and you're spotted by a particularly paranoid group. "That's the one!" one shouts, pointing you out. "Get [pc.himHer]!" Several people charge towards you at once[party.som | | as you fall back to join [party.compNames] | as you fall back to the safety of your party ]! It's a fight!
rows.translation: 你在攻击前会仔细观察目标，然后在其他竞争者发动攻击的间隙将其击倒。在他们甚至还没意识到你在近战中发挥了什么作用之前，你就已经消失得无影无踪，继续绕圈寻找下一次机会。你一个一个地消灭对手，慢慢地削减竞技场内的敌人数量，直到一阵突如其来的风刮散了周围的尘埃，让你被某个格外多疑的团队发现了。 “就是他！”有人喊道，指着你说道，“抓住[pc.himHer]！” 有几个人同时朝你冲了过来[party.som | | 当你后退以便加入[party.compNames]时 | 当你退回到队伍中寻求安全保障时 ]！ 这是一场激烈的战斗！

rows.original: You take up a defensive position and fight your way through the less fortunate, the experienced fighters having split up to give themselves a better chance. You make short work of more than a dozen incompetent fighters in twos and threes[party.som | well | with [party.compNames] at your side | with your companions ] before you have to fight any veterans. When you finally come upon a group of fighters that looks like they know what they're doing, the split-second indecision costs them. You seize the initiative by [var0 |charging at them[party.randComp arona brint azzy | with Arona | with Brint | with Azyrran | ], taking them by surprise! |attacking before they can figure out a plan! ] It's a fight!
rows.translation: 你采取了防御姿态，与那些运气较差的对手展开激战。那些经验丰富的战士们则分散开来，以便提高自己的胜算。你以二打一、三打一的形式，轻松击败了十几名能力不足的对手。[party.som | 嗯…… | 与[party.compNames]一起在你身边 | 和你的朋友们一起 ]在你们不得不与那些经验丰富的对手交战之前， 当你们终于遇到一群看起来确实懂得如何战斗的对手时，那一瞬间的犹豫却让他们失去了先机。你们迅速抓住了主动权， [var0 |向他们冲去[party.randComp arona brint azzy | 与阿罗娜一同 | 与布林特一起 | 与阿兹兰一同 | ]让他们措手不及！ |在他们还没来得及制定计划之前就发动攻击！ ] 这是一场激烈的战斗！
