rows.original: You whirl to face the fighters from your gate, the uncertain and wary. "Who among you wants a chance at glory?! Join me and I'll take you to the finals, no question." Most of the regulars are already out of the way, having split up upon entry, and the rest look around at each other with mixed expressions. It only takes them a second to figure out that this is the best chance they're going to get, and soon you've got a mixed band with you. You've come to appreciate that the power of numbers is a strength all its own. With such a large group behind you, attracting attention is a matter of course. A group of fighters from another gate seizes their chance, charging towards you! "With me!" you yell, rallying your new fighters. You're a little proud to see them hold their ground against the advance. It's a fight!
rows.translation: 你迅速转身，面对着从大门涌进来的那些战士们，他们既不确定又充满警惕。“在你们当中，有谁想要获得荣耀的机会吗？！跟我一起来吧，我一定会带你们进入决赛的，没有任何疑问。” 大多数常客早已分散开来，他们在进入场地后就各自行动了，而剩下的那些人则面面相觑，脸上带着复杂的表情。他们只需要一秒钟就能意识到，这是他们获得机会的最佳时机，很快，你就会有一个由各种各样的人组成的团队加入你。你逐渐意识到，人数众多所带来的力量本身就是一种巨大的优势。 有了这么庞大的团队支持，吸引人们的注意也就变得理所当然了。另一扇大门处的一群战士抓住了机会，向你们发起了冲锋！ “跟我来！”你大声喊道，激励着你的新战士们。看到他们能够坚守阵地抵抗敌人的进攻，你感到有些自豪。 这是一场激烈的战斗！

You're a little proud to see them hold their ground against the advance. It's a fight!"

rows.original:
In all the chaos of the fighting, you can't make out what exactly hits you. You go tumbling, unable to get back to your [pc.hasToes
        |feet
        |hooves
    ], and you realize this is what losing is like. Beaten and defeated, you crawl and stumble back to the staging area.
    
    The spectators are all in the arena, thankfully, so there's hardly anyone here except the other groups who've fallen out. Everyone's worse for wear, nursing bruises and cuts. There's no prize for losing here – you'll just have to try harder next time. Making your way out of the tunnels, you head back to the city proper.
    
    You could really use some rest after that...
rows.translation:
在激烈的战斗中，你根本无法分辨究竟是什么击中了你。你不断地翻滚着，根本无法重新站起来[pc.hasToes
        |脚
        |蹄子
    ]这时你才真正体会到失败是什么滋味。被击败后，你只能爬行着、跌跌撞撞地回到出发点。
    
    幸运的是，观众们都还在竞技场里，所以这里几乎空无一人，只有那些同样落败的队伍成员。每个人的身上都布满了淤青和伤口，状况都很糟糕。在这里，失败并不会带来任何奖励——你只能在下一次比赛中更加努力。走出隧道后，你便朝着城市的方向走去。
    
    经历了这一切之后，你确实非常需要休息一下……

There's no prize for losing here – you'll just have to try harder next time. Making your way out of the tunnels, you head back to the city proper.

rows.original: With the first fight out of the way you take a short breather, taking stock of your situation. All around you are the sounds of combat and cries of pain and anger, the entire arena seemingly locked into a bitter melee. You can hear the commentary booming above your head. "All eyes are on [flags.COLO_ATTEMPTS |[pc.name]'s |this newcomer's ] party, destroying everyone that dares challenge them! They've started off strong, but can they keep it going?!" [var0 |[flags.COLO_ATTEMPTS |The announcer is going on about you again. |Is he talking about you? ] Good! "COME ON, YOU SCUM!" you howl, picking out another party that's just gotten done fighting. You're on them before they can even lick their wounds. |[flags.COLO_ATTEMPTS |This announcer just doesn't know when to keep his mouth shut. |[pc.mascFem |Shit, is |Is ] he talking about you? That's the last thing you need. ] Already there's another party charging towards you, looking to make their names known. Damn it! |[flags.COLO_ATTEMPTS |The announcer is talking about you again — not a problem, you were going to have to fight anyway |It sounds like the announcer is talking about you ]. You use your time to ensure you have a good position against the next challengers, no doubt looking to topple you from your ephemeral throne. A group approaches you with weapons drawn, their intent plain as the morning sun! |You grin, turning to your compatriots. "Hear that? He's talking about us! Let's show 'em we can keep it going, you lot!" The fighters that have joined you draw a little closer, looking out for potential threats. It's one of them that gets hit first, desperately pushing his crossed swords up against a foe straining to bring his broadsword down on him. You rush to bail him out as more gladiators arrive, eyeing up your crew. ] It's a fight!

rows.original: Fight Alante yourself to take her hand in marriage!
rows.translation: 亲自与阿兰特战斗，才能赢得她的手，与她结婚！
rows.raw: "Fight Alante yourself to take her hand in marriage!"

rows.original: "We'll fight her together," you tell [party.compNames], gripping your [pc.weapon] and advancing. "They're heartless — and smart!" the announcer calls. "They've foregone the challenge entirely! There'll be no wedding bells today, but there will be one hell of a fight!" The crowd boos, having had their hopes for an epic one-on-one battle dashed on the rocks, while Alante raises her spear. There's no friendliness there now, and no room for talk. The entire arena is cheering for the centauress to stomp you out. It's a fight!
rows.translation: “我们会一起和她战斗的，”你对[party.compNames]说道，同时握紧你的[pc.weapon]，向前推进。 “他们既无情又聪明！”解说员喊道，“他们完全放弃了这场挑战！今天不会有婚礼的钟声响起，但一定会有一场激烈的战斗！” 人群发出了嘘声，因为他们原本期待的一场精彩的一对一战斗就这样泡汤了。而阿兰特则举起了她的长矛——此刻，她身上已经没有任何友善的表情，也没有任何谈判的余地。整个竞技场都在为这位半人马女战士加油助威，希望她能彻底击败对手。 这是一场激烈的战斗！

rows.original: You fall to your knees, brought low by the overpowering centaur. "I will be here!" she declares, pointing her spear at you. rows.original:
You offer Alante your hand and she takes it, slowly rising to her hooves and shaking herself off. The crowd cheers as she smiles at you, her long ears perking up as you draw closer.
        
        "Are you going to kiss me?" she murmurs.
        
        "Are you nervous?" you ask.
        
        "Yes. But... I am also looking forward to it." Alante gives you an uncertain smile. "Perhaps I could consider this a type of battle, in that case."
        
        [pc.heightRange 0 60 84 90 93
            |The centauress absolutely towers over you, standing at well over seven feet and perhaps closer to eight owing to her sturdy horse-like body. Bending at the front legs and dipping at the hips she places her hands on your shoulders, giving you the initiative.
            |Now that you're standing so close to her you can see just how tall she is — the centauress stands at well over seven feet, perhaps closer to eight owing to her sturdy horse-like body. She places her hands on your shoulders and bends her forelegs to perfectly match your height, and you take the initiative. 
            |Being that Alante is a few inches taller than you are owing to her sturdy horse-like body, she has to bow her head to give you her lips. She places her hands on your shoulders and dips a little lower to get herself eye-level, and you take the initiative.
            |With some surprise on both your parts, you find that Alante is just about exactly as tall as you are even with her sturdy horse-like body. The centauress places her hands on your shoulders, and you take the initiative.
            |Alante seems a little surprised to find you're taller than her now that you're standing so close, placing her hands on your shoulders and gently rearing up on her hindlegs to put herself at eye-level. With her centauress' front legs folded against your chest, you take the initiative.
        ] You can feel her body tense up as your [pc.mascFem
            |lips
            |[pc.lips]
        ] press against hers, her eyes slowly fluttering closed as she follows your example.
        
        Even the roar of the crowd fades away while you and Alante share a kiss, her taut muscles relaxing under your hands as you guide her through it. When you pull away you can see scarlet blooming across her cheeks, her eyes slightly wide and ears perked all the way up. She takes her helmet and hastily plants it back on her head, hiding her face from the audience as they cheer.
        
        "What was once thought impossible has come to pass, folks," the announcer says as you walk with her, leading [party.solo
            |her
            |your party
        ] back out into the tunnels. "We won't be seeing her in the arena again, but just look at how happy she is under that bronze-plated exterior! Two star-crossed lovers brought together by fate... and their own unyielding strength![pc.hasCock
            |[pc.isImpotent
                |
                | The next generation of arena fighters had better watch their backs!
            ]
        ] Talk about a power couple!"
        
        [pc.heightRange 0 60
            |You tap Alante on the leg and she bends over to hear what you say.
            |Alante squeezes your hand for comfort, and you lean in.
        ]
        
        "Do you want to say goodbye?" you ask.
        
        She pauses, considering your words, and speaks in a hushed voice. "Ah... of course. I'm not returning, am I?"
        
        Alante turns and waves to the crowd, laughing happily as tears begin to streak down her face, the cheers only growing louder as the fans bid her farewell. Turning back towards the tunnel with a sniffle, she walks out with you alongside her.
        
        The announcer's voice follows you out. "... and with that, ladies and gentlemen, the Maiden of the Arena has finally found her home."

        ]她的身体紧贴着你的，她的眼睛缓缓闭上，跟着你的动作行事。
        
        当你们与阿拉特相拥接吻时，就连人群的喧闹声也渐渐消失了。在你的引导下，她紧绷的肌肉逐渐放松下来。当你拉开距离时，可以看到她的脸颊上泛起了绯红，双眼微微睁大，耳朵也竖得高高的。她迅速拿起头盔，重新戴在头上，这样在观众们欢呼声中，她的脸就被遮住了。
        
        那些曾经被认为不可能的事情，如今都已经成为了现实，各位，”当你们与她一同前行时，播音员如此说道。 [party.solo
            |她
            |你的团队
        ]他们退回了隧道中。“我们在竞技场里再也不会见到她了，但看看她那青铜色外壳下隐藏着的幸福吧！命运让这两位命运多舛的恋人走到了一起……还有他们自身不屈不挠的精神力量！[pc.hasCock
            |[pc.isImpotent
                |
                | 下一代竞技场格斗游戏玩家可要小心了！
            ]
        ]真是一对实力派搭档啊！
        
        [pc.heightRange 0 60
            |你轻拍阿拉特的腿，她便弯下身子来听你在说什么。
            |阿兰特紧紧握住你的手，给你带来安慰，于是你也靠了过去。
        ]
        
        你是想道别吗？”你问道。
        
        她停顿了一下，仔细考虑了你的话，然后用低沉的声音说道：“啊……当然。我不会再回来了，对吧？”
        
        阿尔兰特转身向人群挥了挥手，脸上虽然挂着泪水，但仍在开心地笑着。随着粉丝们为她送行，欢呼声也越来越响亮。她抽泣着转身走向隧道，然后与你一起走了出去。
        
        播音员的声音也跟随你们传了出来：“……就这样，女士们、先生们，竞技场的女主角终于找到了属于她的归宿。"

rows.original: Help Alante up, taking her hand and escorting her from the arena.
rows.translation: 帮助阿兰特站起来，握住她的手，陪她离开竞技场。
rows.raw: "Help Alante up, taking her hand and escorting her from the arena."

rows.original: You squeeze Alante's hand but let go, stooping down to grip the surprised centauress around her horse-like body. "[pc.name]?" she says, puzzled. "What would you hav- oh!" You grunt as you get your arms under her and, using your entire body, power her up and across your shoulders while raising yourself into a standing position. The crowd goes wild, and Alante gasps in shock. "Oh! Oh... I am... truly outmatched..." Alante mumbles in embarrassment. "You defeated me so soundly and yet still possess the strength to lift me over your head, [pc.name]. Shame on me for not even having the capacity to realize the divide in power between us was so wide." [pc.dcb |"No shame in being weaker than your [pc.mf |husband |wife ], Alante," you say. |"Don't get yourself down, Alante," you reassure her. "You're very strong in your own right. There's no shame in your loss." |"Aw, don't be silly!" you say, giggling. "It's not 'cuz you're weak, it's 'cuz I'm so strong!" ] "You are right. I should not be ashamed of my own strength, but proud of my [pc.mf |husband |wife ]'s," she says, smiling down at you. "Can you walk?" We're about to find out, you think to yourself. You grit your teeth and take a step forward, feeling every bit like the earth is going to crack beneath your [pc.hasToes |foot |hoof ]. But it doesn't, and you manage to take another step. Then one more, and you find yourself walking [party.solo |towards the tunnel |to the tunnel with [party.compNames] trailing behind you ]. [party.comp brint brienne |"G'damn, [pc.name]," Brint says. "Dunno if I could even do that." You're too focused to give him a witty reply. |"Jeez, [pc.name]," Brienne says. "I knew you were strong, but I didn't know you were this strong..." You're too focused to flirt. ]The moment you untense the wrong muscle at the wrong time you're going to collapse and Alante's going to land on top of you, and that's not going to be pretty for either one of you. You move like a machine, grunting with the effort of working your way over to the tunnel. "What was once thought impossible has come to pass twice over, folks," the announcer says as you walk with her, leading [party.solo |her |your party ] back out into the tunnels. "First Alante was beaten, and then she was lifted off the ground! We won't be seeing her in the arena again, but just look at how happy she is under that bronze-plated exterior! Two star-crossed lovers brought together by fate... and their own unyielding strength![pc.hasCock |[pc.isImpotent | | The next generation of arena fighters had better watch their backs! ] ] Talk about a power couple!" Alante laughs, waving at the crowd with both arms as she's borne away, her cheeks tinged red. You stomp away with several hundred pounds of blushing horsewoman atop your shoulders, leaving inches-deep imprints in the ground on your way into the tunnel. Nobody's going to be forgetting that feat any time soon... least of all Alante[party.has brienne | and Brienne, you suspect ].

rows.original: Lift Alante onto your shoulders and carry your prize out of the arena in a demonstration of strength!
rows.translation: 把阿兰特扛到肩上，用一场力量展示把你的战利品带出竞技场！
rows.raw: "Lift Alante onto your shoulders and carry your prize out of the arena in a demonstration of strength!"

rows.original: You might be strong, but you're not so foolish as to believe you're strong enough to lift a mare onto your shoulders and carry her.
rows.translation: 你可能力气很大，但也不至于蠢到认为自己有足够的力气把一匹母马扛到肩上然后带着它走。
rows.raw: "You might be strong, but you're not so foolish as to believe you're strong enough to lift a mare onto your shoulders and carry her."

rows.original:
Alante collapses, her forelegs folding beneath her as she crashes to the ground. Her spear clatters to the dirt, fingers lacking the strength to keep holding on. It's over.

    "Alante is DOWN! A battle well-fought by the challengers," the commentator announces. "This is the smallest group she's ever been beaten by!"
    
    Alante stabs her spear into the ground and shakily gets to her hooves amid scattered applause. The crowd is excited, but not that excited. They wanted to see one of you fight her alone.
    
    "Well fought[party.som
        |
        |, you two
        |, you three
    ]," Alante says. "The audience may not recognize your efforts, but I do. Each of you is a skilled warrior, and operating in such unison is enviable." She nods. "I admire your strength."

阿兰特倒下了，前腿无力地弯曲在身下，她重重地摔在了地上。她的长矛掉在泥土中，手指因为没有力气而无法继续握住它。一切都结束了。

    “阿兰特倒下了！挑战者们打了一场精彩的战斗，”解说员宣布道，“这是击败过她的规模最小的一支队伍！”
    
    阿兰特将长矛插进地面，在零星的掌声中颤巍巍地站起。人群很兴奋，但没那么兴奋——他们想看到的是你们中的某一个人单独与她交手。
    
    “打得漂亮[party.som
        |
        |，你们两个

    ]，”阿兰特说。“观众也许看不出你们的努力，但我看得出。你们每个人都是技艺高超的战士，能如此默契地协同作战，令人羡慕。”她点点头。“我很敬佩你们的力量。”

"You're strong yourself, Alante," you say. "There's not many people that can fight[party.som
            |
            | the two of us
            | the three of us
        ] on even ground."
        
        "I have been trained to do so as a vanguard of the expeditionary force," Alante says. "Though it appears in the end, it was still not enough. I have to get stronger." She inclines her head. "Thank you for showing me my weakness."
        
        With that, she turns and walks away. You head back to the tunnel, fully intent on resting. The food here is good, at least.

rows.original:
"You'd better clear out of here so the next challenger can take their place," you say.

        Alante nods. "You are correct. I will take my leave."
        
        With that, she turns and walks away — slowly. Looks like you got her pretty good. You head back to the tunnel, fully intent on resting. The food here is good, at least.

rows.raw: ' "Hey!" you call out, striding after the Black Knight. You pursue her into the tunnel, catching up as she stops and turns. "What's the deal?" "Who are you, brat?" she says, voice muffled inside her armor. "The [pc.mf |guy |woman ] you were fighting about a minute ago," you say. "Huh." She lifts her helmet off to take a better look at you. "[pc.mascFem |Handsome |Pretty ] little brat, and you don't fight half-bad. So what the fuck do you want, then?" "What's the hurry?" you say. "No more fighting?" "The hurry is that I've got to get the fuck out of here before anyone tries to come and pick me up," she says. "I'm done with the arena. Wasn't worth the time anyway. Now, I don't have room to swing my sword around in here so I'd really appreciate it if you didn't try and stop me..." "What's your name?" you ask. She glances at you as she puts her helmet back on. "It's Tay. You don't seem so bad, brat. Come find me in the slums if you like." She fastens the straps. "I'll be in the Whore's Bosom." With that, Tay stalks away into the darkness. You still don't know who she really is, but you've got a name and a place.[party.has brienne | "Damn, what a bitch," Brienne says, crossing her arms. "Brat this, brat that. I would've slapped her in the face if you weren't talking to her. [pc.hasCock |She deserves a hard fuck |She deserves a fist ] in the ass until she loses some of the attitude." [pc.dcb |"You're full of good ideas," you say. |"You might be right," you say. |"That sounds fun!" you say. ] "That's why you keep me around, right?" she says, flashing you a smile. "For my smarts." "Speaking of, did you notice?" you say. "I think her body's like yours." Brienne stops. "Oh, shit. I think you're right. I didn't notice 'cause of the armor, but... there's no way she's walking and swinging that greatsword around in that armor unless she's strong as hell under all that plate. Or magically enhanced?" "Hard to tell," you say. "Either way, might be worth checking out." "Yeah, I guess," Brienne says. rows.original: After you make your way back to the front desk for your prize money you wind up getting it — but not the title for winning. Apparently you need to actually fight to earn that, and a forfeit doesn't count. You're not interested in arguing the point and besides, five thousand electrum is a pretty decent consolation prize. The crowd is still very much present in the atrium, and they're all over you when they see you. Congratulations and cheers, claps on the back and recounting of old glories — you're just about finished when one of the older guys shakes his head, opening his mouth. "That Black Knight, though. Whew!" he says. "Had no idea it was her." You stop, interest piqued. "Oh? Who was it?" "Well, if my eyes ain't fooled me... was the firstborn princess all growed up," he says. "Little Octavia." "The princess? Come off it old man," another says, laughing. Most of the crowd joins him, shaking their heads and pointing at the claimant. "Like the princess'd be fighting in the arena!" The older minotaur bristles, glaring at the crowd, but whatever he's going to say gets drowned out by a round of jeering. He walks away into the crowd as you try to keep track of him, but to no avail. "Thanks for the talk, lads, see you again next time," you say, patting one of them on the back before you leave to try and follow the older man. He sounds like he has a bit more of a clue than the rest of them. You get outside but a quick scan of the bustling crowd reveals about as much as you'd expect. Damn it. You'll have to go see Tay in the slums if you want more information.
rows.translation: 当你回到前台去领取奖金时，最终你确实拿到了钱——但却没有获得获胜的称号。显然，你必须通过真正的战斗来赢得那个称号，而放弃比赛是无效的。你并没有兴趣为此争论，而且，除此之外五千埃莱克特伦这已经算是相当不错的安慰奖了。 大厅里仍然挤满了人群，当你出现在他们面前时，他们会围上来祝贺你、为你欢呼、鼓掌，还会回忆起过去的辉煌时光。就在你几乎要结束这一切的时候，其中一个年纪稍长的人却摇了摇头，开口说道…… 不过那个黑衣骑士啊……呼！”他说，“完全没猜到那就是她。” 你停下了脚步，好奇心被激发了：“哦？那是谁啊？” “嗯，如果我的眼睛没有骗我的话……那就是已经长成大人的长女公主，”他说，“小奥克塔维娅。 公主？别开玩笑了，老头。”另一个人笑着说。大多数人群都附和着他的观点，纷纷摇头，指着那个自称是公主的人。“公主怎么可能去竞技场战斗呢！” 那位年长的弥诺陶洛斯怒目而视，瞪着人群，但无论他想说什么，都被一阵嘲笑声淹没了。他走进了人群中，而你试图跟上他的踪迹，却毫无结果。 谢谢大家的谈话，下次再见吧，”你说着，拍了拍其中一个人的背，然后离开去试图跟上那个年纪稍长一些的男子。他看起来似乎比其他人知道得更多一些。 你走到外面，但快速扫视了一下熙熙攘攘的人群后，发现得到的信息其实并不多。该死，如果你想了解更多信息，就只能去贫民区找泰了。

rows.original: What the hell is going on here? Who is that woman that she's causing such consternation, and why isn't she fighting you?
rows.translation: 这里到底发生了什么？那个女人是谁，为什么会引起这么大的骚动？为什么她不跟你动手打架呢？
rows.raw: "What the hell is going on here? Who is that woman that she's causing such consternation, and why isn't she fighting you?"

rows.original: You don't care about whoever this woman is, and you definitely don't care about whatever it is that's going on with her. You came here to win and with her forfeit, you have. The crowd's not cheering and the commentator is strangely silent. You wait it out for a few minutes — until the Black Knight is well and truly gone — without any word from staff or the commentator. The audience is starting to leave. Heading back inside, you sit down and grab some food to give the crowd time to go away before you go out into the atrium and look for your money. Luckily, the attendant has what you need. "Since you didn't win by fighting, we can't give you a title," he says, lifting a bag up onto the desk. "But you did still beat Alante, which is a hell of a feat, so you still get a bunch of money. Five thousand electrum all up." "Well, that's something," you say, grabbing the offered bag of coins. "Thanks. Be back next week for another one of these." The attendant chuckles. "No doubt. We'll be looking forward to it." You head outside, into the streets. A couple of people nod to you in passing, and you've only been there for a few seconds before someone calls out to you. "Nice match!" You give the guy a nod. Looks like you might be making a name for yourself.
rows.translation: 你根本不在乎这个女人是谁，也完全不在乎她出了什么事。你来这里是为了赢，而她弃权，你就赢了。观众没有欢呼，解说员也出奇地沉默。 你等了几分钟——直到那位黑骑士彻底走远——工作人员和解说员都没有任何动静。观众开始陆续离开。你回到场内，坐下来吃了点东西，等人群散去后才走进中庭去找你的钱。幸好，那位工作人员已经准备好了你要的东西。 “既然你不是靠打斗赢的，我们就不能给你头衔，”他说着，把一个袋子提上桌子。“但你毕竟还是打败了阿兰特，这可不是一般的本事，所以你还是能拿到一大笔钱。五千琥珀金币，一共。” “那也不错，”你说着，接过递来的那袋钱币。“谢了。下周再来打一场。” 工作人员轻笑一声。“那当然。我们等着你。” 你走到外面的街上。有几个人路过时向你点头致意，你才站了几秒钟，就有人朝你喊话。 “打得漂亮！” 你朝那家伙点了点头。看来你也许要闯出点名声了。

rows.original:
Both the retiarius and secutor are beaten, picking themselves up from the ground as the crowd cheers for your victory. They each give you a respectful nod. Even now, you don't know which is which... or do they switch roles?

    "Great fight," one says.
    
    "You're too good," the other says.
    
    "Well fought, you two," you say. "Maybe next week."
    
    They grin. "Not likely with the way you've been fighting. Good luck against Eyslaine."
    
    The two of them limp off as you head back towards the tunnels with the commentator singing your praises.
rows.translation:
那名持网剑的战士和那名持长剑的战士都被击败了，他们从地上爬起来，人群则为你的胜利欢呼。两人都恭敬地向你点了点头。即便到现在，你也分不清他们谁是谁……又或者，他们会互换角色？

    “打得漂亮，”一个说道。
    
    “你太强了，”另一个说道。
    
    “两位打得不错，”你说道，“也许下周再打。”
    
    他们咧嘴一笑。“就你这打法，怕是没有下次了。祝你对阵艾丝莱茵队长时好运。”
    
    两人一瘸一拐地离开了，你则朝隧道走去，解说员还在高声赞美你。

rows.original: You stumble back across the sand, falling onto your ass after a heavy blow. Omus – or maybe Reus, you're not sure which is which – lifts his trident, putting it over his shoulder. "Not bad," he says. "Not enough for us, though," Reus – or Omus – says. "Better luck next time." They turn and leave, leaving you in the dust and dirt without a chance to reply. Damn it. "Look at the bright side, you three," the announcer calls. "You won't be buying your own beers at the taverns any time soon! An incredible show, but in the end the twin gladiators win out!" The rest is kind of a drone you don't hear as you slowly head back to the entrance. It's a good thing gladiators are given an alternative exit — you can feel how many pairs of hooves are exiting the arena. Fighting fans aren't sticking around for the aftershow, you suppose. Three thousand electrum for beating up Cedric on top of a bunch of gladiators isn't too bad, though you're not sure any amount of money is worth listening to him in the arena. Still, it's money. Next time...
rows.translation: 你在沙地上踉跄着后退，被重重一击击倒在地。奥穆斯——或者也许是雷乌斯，你分辨不清他们俩谁是谁——举起了他的三叉戟，将其搭在肩上。 “还不错，”他说。 “不过对我们来说还不够，”雷乌斯——或者是奥穆斯——说道。下次好运吧。” 他们转身离开了，留下你独自面对尘土和污垢，根本没有机会回应他们。真该死。 “往好的方面想吧，你们三个，”播音员说道，“短期内你们可没法自己去酒馆买啤酒喝了！这场表演真是精彩绝伦，但最终，那对双胞胎角斗士取得了胜利！” 之后，周围的声音渐渐变得模糊，你慢慢地朝着入口方向走去。幸好角斗士们还有另一条出口——这样你就不用再继续听那些声音了。感受到有多少对蹄子正离开竞技场吧。想必那些热衷于战斗的观众也不会留下来看后续环节吧。 虽然在一群角斗士面前打败塞德里克能得到三千枚琥珀金币，这个报酬还算不错，不过你也不确定，究竟多少钱才值得让人去竞技场听他的演讲。不过，钱就是钱。下次吧……
rows.raw: ' You stumble back across the sand, falling onto your ass after a heavy blow. Omus – or maybe Reus, you're not sure which is which – lifts his trident, putting it over his shoulder. "Not bad," he says. "Not enough for us, though," Reus – or Omus – says. "Better luck next time." They turn and leave, leaving you in the dust and dirt without a chance to reply. Damn it. "Look at the bright side, you three," the announcer calls. "You won't be buying your own beers at the taverns any time soon! An incredible show, but in the end the twin gladiators win out!" The rest is kind of a drone you don't hear as you slowly head back to the entrance. It's a good thing gladiators are given an alternative exit — you can feel how many pairs of hooves are exiting the arena. Fighting fans aren't sticking around for the aftershow, you suppose. Three thousand electrum for beating up Cedric on top of a bunch of gladiators isn't too bad, though you're not sure any amount of money is worth listening to him in the arena. Still, it's money. Next time...'

"They trot this out every time I do anything these days." "At least the fighting's good," you say. [flags.COLO_LEG 2 |"True," the grizzled captain says. "Only ever fought one other person like you before. Let's go." |Eyslaine grunts in amusement. "Show me what you've got." ] |"Back for more," you say. Eyslaine grunts in amusement. "Back for more. The man's expression is resolute as he lifts his sword, and the very ground shakes beneath your feet as the audience roars. There is no room for pleasantries. rows.original:
"Aah, well done," Eyslaine sighs. "I'm getting predictable in my old age."
        
        "Well fought," you say, lowering your weapon.
        
        "They should get you a better training partner," he says with a smile. "Good work."
        
        He turns and walks away, picking up his gladius and sheathing it, and all at once the fatigue of your battle hits you as you breathe out. The crowd roars with approval, having once again been shown the peak of martial prowess, but you admit after beating Eyslaine you're left a little wanting. Another opponent to push you... that would be nice.
        
        You wave to the crowd, playing the occasion up, and head out of the arena to collect your earnings. Ten thousand electrum as well as another foundational block for what you're sure is going to end up being a very tall tale in the telling. [pc.name], the flawless arena fighter. You're not sure how long you'll stay here but by the time you move on, no doubt scribes will have written at length of your dominance.
        
        That doesn't seem so bad.
rows.translation:
啊，干得不错，”艾斯莱恩叹道，“年纪大了，我的反应也变得太容易预测了。”
        
        “战斗得不错，”你说着，放下了武器。
        
        “他们应该给你找个更出色的训练伙伴，”他微笑着说道。干得不错。”
        
        他转身离去，捡起自己的短剑并将其收进鞘中。就在这时，战斗带来的疲惫感突然袭来，当你呼出一口气时，这种疲惫感更加明显了。人群发出热烈的欢呼声，因为他们再次见识到了高超的武艺。但在击败艾斯莱恩之后，你不得不承认，自己还是觉得有些意犹未尽。又有一个对手来挑战你……那可真是太好了。
        
        你向人群挥手致意，借机营造出一种特别的氛围，然后走出了竞技场去领取你的奖励。一万枚琥珀金币，以及另一块基础构建模块——这些无疑都会成为日后被人们津津乐道的故事素材。 [pc.name]，那位无懈可击的竞技场战士啊。你不确定自己还会在这里待多久，但当你离开的时候，毫无疑问，史书上一定会详细记载你的辉煌成就。
        
        这样想来，也并不坏嘛。

rows.original: [var0 |How long has it been? The crowd is silent. Only the clash of blades and screech of metal rings out across the sandy floor of the arena, the intensity of your weapons meeting unsettling dust from the ground as the two of you move back and forth. You're not blinking. You're not even breathing. All you can feel is your weapon arm and all you can see is your opponent. You swing and parry, feint and counter, and every time you meet his blows you grow more certain. [party.som |The closing steps of the dance draw near. |[party.compNames] can't even get close for fear of disrupting the closing steps of the dance. |Your companions can't even get close for fear of disrupting the closing steps of the dance. ] He feints – a movement so slight only you could see it – and swings downwards. His arm moves so fast his sword is a blur, spitting sparks as it flies down the length of your blade. It's over in an instant. With a twist of your wrist his sword goes flying from his hand and you have yours at his throat. He smiles. "Well done." He turns and walks away, picking up his gladius and sheathing it, and all at once the fatigue of your battle hits you as you breathe out, lowering your shaking sword arm. |The crowd is silent as [party.som |the two of you |the three of you |the four of you ] fight, circling each other and looking for any opportunity to end this. The swordsman feints and, with a final exchange, you send his sword flying from his hand, skittering across the ground well out of reach. It's over. He turns and walks away, picking up his gladius and sheathing it, and all at once the fatigue of your battle hits you as you breathe out, lowering your weapon. ] It's only now that you can hear the crowd's howling cheers. "UNBELIEVABLE!" the announcer screams. "I'VE NEVER SEEN A FIGHT LIKE THAT IN MY LIFE!" You've won. It was a hell of a battle to get here, but you've done it. Having bested all that the arena has to offer, you stand at the very peak of martial prowess. The announcer's call heralds the arrival of the newest champion[party.som | |s |s ] of the arena. "TAKE A GOOD LOOK, FOLKS! THIS IS WHAT IT LOOKS LIKE TO BE THE BEST!"
rows.translation: [var0 |过去多久了？观众鸦雀无声。竞技场的沙地上，只剩刀剑碰撞与金属尖鸣不断回响；你们二人来回腾挪，每一次兵刃猛烈交击，都会从地面激起令人不安的尘土。 你一眨不眨，甚至没有呼吸。你只能感到握住武器的手臂，眼中也只剩对手。你挥砍、招架、佯攻、反击；每一次挡住他的攻击，心中的确信便更深一分。[party.som |这支舞即将迎来最后的几步。 |[party.compNames]甚至不敢靠近，唯恐打乱这支舞最后的脚步。 |你的同伴们甚至不敢靠近，唯恐打乱这支舞最后的脚步。 ] 他使出佯攻——动作细微得只有你能够察觉——随即向下劈砍。他的手臂快得令剑刃化作一片残影；它沿着你的兵刃飞速滑下，迸溅出点点火星。一切都在瞬间结束。 你转动手腕，他的长剑顿时脱手飞出；而你的剑刃已经抵住他的喉咙。 他微微一笑。“干得漂亮。” 他转身离开，捡起短剑插回鞘中；你呼出憋住的气息，放下颤抖的持剑手臂，整场战斗积累的疲惫也在这一刻一齐涌上身体。 |观众鸦雀无声；[party.som |你们二人 |你们三人 |你们四人 ]一边战斗，一边彼此环绕，寻找任何能为这一切画上句号的机会。剑士使出佯攻；在最后一轮交锋中，你击飞他手中的长剑，令其远远滑过地面，落到无法企及的地方。战斗结束了。 他转身离开，捡起短剑插回鞘中；你呼出憋住的气息，放下武器，整场战斗积累的疲惫也在这一刻一齐涌上身体。 ] 直到现在，你才听见观众震耳欲聋的欢呼。 “难以置信！”解说员尖声喊道。“我这辈子从没见过这样的战斗！” 你赢了。为了走到这里，你经历了一场无比艰苦的战斗，但你成功了。你击败了竞技场派出的所有对手，站在武艺的绝巅。解说员高声宣布，竞技场最新的冠军[party.som | |们 |们 ]已经诞生。 “大家看清楚了！这就是最强者的模样！”

rows.original:
You hold your hands up and roar as the crowd get up out of their seats to cheer, their excitement reaching fever pitch. They don't stop cheering even when you've left the arena to collect your winnings, passing by other gladiators that congratulate you in turn. You've left your mark on the city, and they won't soon forget it.

        You collect your ten thousand electrum from the attendants and return to the city at large, basking in your newfound fame for a moment. Every time one of the spectators passes you by they congratulate you, often relating a tale of their own arena experience. It's nice, but you do have things to do.
rows.translation:
你举起双手大声呼喊，人群纷纷从座位上站起来欢呼，他们的兴奋之情已经达到了顶点。即使你离开竞技场去领取奖金，他们依然没有停止欢呼，还有其他角斗士路过，纷纷向你表示祝贺。你在这座城市留下了自己的印记，他们很快就不会忘记这一点。

        你从侍从手中领取了那一万枚电银，然后回到了广阔的城市中，暂时享受着自己新获得的名声。每当有观众从你身边经过时，他们都会向你表示祝贺，还会常常讲述自己自己在竞技场中的经历。这挺好的，但你确实还有其他事情要去做。

rows.original:
For starters, and this might be an awkward question, how did she get into this profession in the first place?
    
    "Awkward? Heavens no, you must not be familiar with Khor'minos. I'm here because I love this, and because mistress Feronia is very good at keeping us safe. When I was hired here, my father threw me a feast! He worked in the colosseum for years helping with setup for the games and making sure the buildings remained structurally sound. That I could get a job doing what I loved in a place I could be paid to do so was an absolute boon, honey," she says with a smile. Her tail swooshes back and forth throughout her explanation, and she takes hold of your hands as she continues.
    
    "I hear there are places in the world where my line of work is looked down upon by the public, and I can't imagine how awful that must be for the people who want to share their love like we do. I know the slums here have a bad reputation, but even then I know some of those girls. Most need to operate there because of their, um, tastes... B-but not because they're profession is looked down on or because they have no other option. Just thinking about it makes my heart wilt."
    
    Wow, is sex work really that highly praised in Khor'minos?
    
    "I mean, maybe for members of the King's personal harem, or places in the inner circle. It's not like we're treated like royalty in public, though I have had some royal treatment from guests." She smiles wistfully at the remark, staring off into a memory for a moment before continuing. "Think of it like any other profession. The miners toil for long hours to provide us with jewelry and material for the craftsmen, and the craftsmen toil for long hours to turn those things into the building blocks of our society. Why shouldn't they have a safe, comfortable place to de-stress after their days. A well fucked bull can work twice as hard as one who's pent up and can't think straight. Can you imagine what would happen if a stone worker made the wrong decisions and a whole building fell over?"
    
    [pc.isBimbo
        |That would be just awful! You're glad people like her make sure that doesn't happen
        |[pc.bg scholar noblescion
            |The metaphor might be a little unorthodox, but there's some merit to it
            |When she puts it like that, you can definitely see the point
        ]
    ]. You can tell she enjoys the work.
    
    "Very much so. I try to make sure the other workers are in good spirits as well, though I can only speak for the ones here. We have all kinds, and sometimes you're just feeling down about stuff. It always helps to have so many open arms to help. I'm not really equipped to deal with issues like that, but sometimes just getting hugged and crying it out for a few hours can make all the difference," she says. Her resolution is impressive.
    
    "Oh, that must've sounded sad. Is there anything else you wanted to talk about?"
rows.translation:
首先要问的——虽然这个问题或许有些尴尬——是她当初究竟为何进入这一行。
    
    “尴尬？天哪，当然不会，你一定不熟悉科尔米诺斯。我在这里，是因为我热爱这份工作，也因为费罗妮娅女主人非常善于保障我们的安全。我受雇来到这里时，父亲还替我举办了一场宴会！他在竞技场工作过很多年，负责协助筹备比赛，确保建筑结构依然稳固。我能在一个付钱让我从事热爱工作的地方找到差事，简直是天大的福气，亲爱的，”她微笑着说道。解释期间，她的尾巴一直来回摆动；继续说下去时，她又握住你的双手。
    
    “我听说，世界上有些地方的公众会轻视我所从事的工作。对于那些像我们一样想分享爱意的人，我无法想象那会有多么糟糕。我知道这里的贫民窟名声不好，但即便如此，我也认识其中一些姑娘。大多数人之所以必须在那里经营，是因为她们的，呃，爱好……但、但不是因为她们的职业受人轻视，也不是因为别无选择。光是想想，我的心都要枯萎了。”
    
    哇，性工作在科尔米诺斯真的如此受人赞誉吗？
    
    “我是说，国王私人后宫的成员，或核心城区里的场所，或许确实很受重视。倒不是说我们会在公众面前得到王室成员般的待遇，不过有些客人倒确实让我体验过王室级别的招待。”说到这里，她怀念地微笑起来，沉入某段回忆片刻，随后继续说道。“把它当成任何其他职业就好。矿工长时间辛苦劳作，为我们提供珠宝，也为工匠带来材料；工匠则长时间辛苦劳作，将这些东西化作社会赖以建立的基石。结束一天的工作后，他们为什么不该拥有一个安全舒适的地方释放压力？一头得到充分满足的公牛，工作起来能比满腹欲火、无法清醒思考的公牛努力一倍。你能想象石匠作出错误决定，害得整座建筑倒塌会发生什么吗？”
    
    [pc.isBimbo
        |那也太可怕了！幸好有她这样的人确保事故不会发生
        |[pc.bg scholar noblescion
            |这个比喻或许有些不同寻常，但确实有几分道理
            |听她这么解释，你完全能理解其中道理
        ]
    ]。看得出来，她很享受这份工作。
    
    “非常享受。我也努力确保其他工作人员心情愉快，不过我只能替这里的人说话。我们有各种各样的人，有时候难免会因为某些事情情绪低落。这时，有这么多愿意敞开怀抱提供帮助的人，总能让情况好转。我并没有能力处理那类问题，但有时候，只是被人抱住、花几个小时痛痛快快地哭出来，就足以带来天壤之别，”她说道。她的决心令人赞叹。
    
    “哦，听上去一定很伤感。你还想聊点别的吗？”

rows.original: You aren't sure how deep the client confidentiality goes here, but does she have any particularly interesting or funny requests she remembers. "Ha! We don't have anything like that, but I wouldn't talk down about people having bedroom troubles or anything like that. It would just be rude and bring my mood down. Funny though, hmm," she says. She taps her finger on her chin, leaning back on the sofa and thinking hard. She lights up after a moment, clapping her hands. "Oh! I know! One of my favorite stories is kind of funny I think! I tend to get people who want to make use of my tattoo's magical properties. One time, I had two colosseum athletes, sprinters I think, pay for a threesome, and, hehe." She breaks into laughter before she can finish, trying to calm down enough to talk again but unable to resist bursting into another fit of giggles. "It turns out," she says, finally able to speak again after a minute of calming down. "One of them was a returning customer, and he'd bet his friend that he could fill me up with more milk than the friend could drink." This sounds good already. You take it the drinker lost the bet? "I'll get there, haha, slow down a bit. My regular customer was good, but I get the feeling he was more interested in the challenge because he was trying to cum more than make me feel good. Didn't really matter though, cause his friend was all about me. Even before the milk was on tap he was playing with my nipples and getting me all ready to start. I swear this guy must've starved himself for a week before they came in, cause he was sucking like his life depended on it rather than a bet with a friend," she says. All the while you see her fingers trace a circle around her gold-plated nipples. "So he drinks as I'm filled up, and drinks, and drinks. Poor bull behind me passes out thrusting, and his friend doesn't even notice he's so focused on my teats. He could've won right there! I was so impressed with his tongue work that I wouldn't have said any different. But then he was just as into it, and he drank till he couldn't anymore, then he threw it up in the hall basin. Ferry just about had a fit," she says. She collapses into a fit of giggles soon after, leaning back on the sofa and wiping a tear from her eye. So neither of them won? Maybe they'll work up the nerve to both get serious with me as an apology. So, was that story good enough or do you need something else?" Maybe next time. Then, when you've run dry, she escorts you back to the foyer and you part ways with a chaste kiss on each other's cheeks.

rows.original: You take a short trip through the walls and emerge into the lively, bustling interior of Khor'minos. It's every bit as loud as it was the last time and just as full of people. The inhabitants line the footpaths and most of the roads, condemning carriages to a slow, gradual roll.

rows.original:
The front entrance to the city of Khor'minos is perhaps the most grandiose thing you have ever seen. Gleaming white walls stretch into the sky above, a nigh-impenetrable fortress with a company of guards stationed outside it. 

    The towering gates are closed, though there are smaller entrances to the side. What you presume to be a captain — owing to the big red plume atop his golden helmet — looks you over as you approach, giving you a nod.
    
    "Ay-ah, [party.som|traveler|you two|you lot]," he says. "Welcome to Khor'minos. King Kelsaz has decreed the city closed... except to those who have demonstrable worth. [party.has brint
        |Well, except for you." He nods at Brint. "You're free to come in soon as you like, but I figure you'd like your friends in too."
    
        "I'll take my chances with 'em," Brint says, grinning.
        
        "Good friends are hard to come by, kid. Good on you. Now then," the captain says, waving for one of his soldiers. "Let me check if you're on the list."
        |[party.has brienne
            |Well, except for you." He nods at Brienne. "Guessing you're a one-time citizen. But I imagine you want your friends to come in too."
        
            "I'm not going anywhere without [pc.name]," Brienne says.
            
            "Good on you. Hard to earn that kind of loyalty. Now then," the captain says, waving for one of his soldiers. "Let me check if you're on the list."
            |Luckily we've got ways of figuring that out." He waves for one of his soldiers. "Let me check if you're on the list."
        ]
    ]
    
    "The list?" you ask.
    
    "We've got a list of pre-approved individuals of renown," he says. "Not that all of them are going to be coming here, but might as well make it easy for them if they do. Don't need my soldiers getting busted up in duels..."
    
    He takes a piece of inked parchment from the soldier and sends him back to his post. "Now then. Your name?"
    
    "[pc.name]," you say.
    
    "[pc.name], eh? Hmm," he muses, skimming the list. "Mmmm... oh."
    
    "Am I on there?" you ask.
    
    "Ha ha, not only are you on here, you're in the bit for important people," the captain says with a grin. "[pc.name], the Champion of Winter City. A titled hero, eh? Not too many of those around. According to an elven dignitary you courageously fought off an invasion of foreign elements in defense of the elven stronghold, tipping the scales single handedly." He lets out a low whistle. "Looks like I should be thanking you just for showing up. Here's your tokens."
    
    "What're these?" you say, taking the tokens. Looks like a tag you're meant to wear around your neck.
    
    "Just signals to the guards that you're on the approval list," he says. "They'll let you in once you've got 'em. Head on through."
    
    He nods towards a side entrance that leads into the wall. It doesn't look like they open the gates for much these days — might as well go this way. Stepping through the entryway[party.solo|| with [party.compNames] in tow], you head down a dimly lit corridor through the internals of the stupendous wall. Gods, it feels as wide as it looks tall.
    
    There's a door at the end of the passageway. This must be it?

            “没有[pc.name]，我哪里都不会去，”布莉恩说道。
            
            “做得好。这样的忠诚可不容易赢得。那么，”队长挥手叫来一名士兵。“让我看看名单上有没有你们。”
            |幸好，我们有办法确认这一点。”他挥手叫来一名士兵。“让我看看名单上有没有你们。”
        ]
    ]
    
    “名单？”你问。
    
    “我们有一份预先获准入城的知名人士名单，”他说道。“倒不是说他们全都会来到这里，但若真有人造访，不妨让事情简单一些。总不能让我的士兵在决斗中被打得鼻青脸肿……”
    
    他从士兵手里接过一张写满字迹的羊皮纸，随即让对方返回岗位。“那么，你叫什么名字？”
    
    “[pc.name]，”你说道。
    
    “[pc.name]，是吗？嗯，”他浏览着名单，沉吟道。“嗯……没有，抱歉，我没看到你。不在名单上，就不能进城。事情就这么简单。”
    
    该死。“怎样才能上名单？”
    
    队长耸耸肩。“做出什么声名显赫的事迹，给某个重要人物留下印象。也许卡莉丝女士能想办法，让你证明自己对城市有用。抱歉了，朋友。”
    
    “好吧，”你转身离去。[flags.UM_UNLOCKED 2
        |你不可能在这里重演外面的那场壮举——光是城门附近就有几十名士兵，城内很可能还有几千人。硬闯无异于自杀。
    ]
rows.raw:
'
    The front entrance to the city of Khor'minos is perhaps the most grandiose thing you have ever seen. Gleaming white walls stretch into the sky above, a nigh-impenetrable fortress with a company of guards stationed outside it. 

    The towering gates are closed, though there are smaller entrances to the side. What you presume to be a captain — owing to the big red plume atop his golden helmet — looks you over as you approach, giving you a nod.
    
    "Ay-ah, [party.som|traveler|you two|you lot]," he says. "Welcome to Khor'minos. King Kelsaz has decreed the city closed... except to those who have demonstrable worth. [party.has brint
        |Well, except for you." He nods at Brint. "You're free to come in soon as you like, but I figure you'd like your friends in too."
    
        "I'll take my chances with 'em," Brint says, grinning.
        
        "Good friends are hard to come by, kid. Good on you. Now then," the captain says, waving for one of his soldiers. "Let me check if you're on the list."
        |[party.has brienne
            |Well, except for you." He nods at Brienne. "Guessing you're a one-time citizen. But I imagine you want your friends to come in too."
        
            "I'm not going anywhere without [pc.name]," Brienne says.
            
            "Good on you. Hard to earn that kind of loyalty. Now then," the captain says, waving for one of his soldiers. "Let me check if you're on the list."
            |Luckily we've got ways of figuring that out." He waves for one of his soldiers. "Let me check if you're on the list."
        ]
    ]
    
    "The list?" you ask.
    
    "We've got a list of pre-approved individuals of renown," he says. "Not that all of them are going to be coming here, but might as well make it easy for them if they do. Don't need my soldiers getting busted up in duels..."
    
    He takes a piece of inked parchment from the soldier and sends him back to his post. "Now then. Your name?"
    
    "[pc.name]," you say.
    
    "[pc.name], eh? Hmm," he muses, skimming the list. "Mmmm... no, sorry, I don't see you. Not on the list; not coming in the city. Simple as that."
    
    Shit. "How do I get on the list?"
    
    The captain shrugs. "Do something of great renown. Impress somebody important. Perhaps Lady Calise could find a way for you to make yourself useful to the city. Sorry, friend."
    
    "Yeah," you say, turning to leave. [flags.UM_UNLOCKED 2
        |There's no chance you could pull off a repeat of your stunt outside down here — there's dozens of soldiers just around the gate, and probably thousands more inside. It'd be suicide.
    ]'

rows.original:
You return to the captain triumphant. "I'm [pc.name]," you remind him. "I should be on your list now."

    "That right?" he says, eying you suspiciously. "Let me check, then."
    
    One of his men brings forth the sprawling document, and the captain takes great pains in examining it. "Ahhh, yes, so you are. Recommended by Lady Calise, eh? I see you took my advice."
    
    You nod. "So, can I go in?"
    
    He reaches into a pouch on his belt and produces a wooden chit. "Aye. Here's your token."
    
    "What're these?" you say, taking the tokens. Looks like a tag you're meant to wear around your neck.
    
    "Just signals to the guards that you're on the approval list," he says. "They'll let you in once you've got 'em. Head on through."
    
    He nods towards a side entrance that leads into the wall. It doesn't look like they open the gates for much these days — might as well go this way. Stepping through the entryway[party.solo|| with [party.compNames] in tow], you head down a dimly lit corridor through the internals of the stupendous wall. Gods, it feels as wide as it looks tall.
    
    There's a door at the end of the passageway. This must be it?
rows.translation:
你胜利地回到了船长身边，说道：“我[pc.name]，”你应该把我加到名单上去了，”你提醒他。

    “是吗？”他怀疑地盯着你说道，“那让我先核实一下。”
    
    他的一个手下拿出了那份厚厚的名单，船长仔细地检查了起来。啊，原来如此，是卡莉丝女士推荐的吧？看来你还是听从了我的建议。”
    
    你点了点头，问道：“那么，我可以进去了吗？”
    
    他从腰间的袋子里拿出一张木制的凭证，说道：“可以。这是你的通行令。
    
    这些是什么？”你接过那些标记，看起来像是应该戴在脖子上的标签。
    
    “这只是用来告诉守卫你已经在批准名单上的信号，”他解释道，“只要你有了这些标记，他们就会让你进去。直接往前走。”
    
    他指向一扇通往墙壁内部的侧门。看来这些天他们并不经常打开这扇门——还不如从这边进去。穿过入口[party.solo|| 与[party.compNames]一起跟随在后面]你沿着一条光线昏暗的走廊，穿过那堵巍峨墙壁的内部结构。天啊，它的宽度简直和它的高度一样惊人。
    
    走廊的尽头有一扇门。应该就是这里了吧？

rows.original: You open the door into deafening noise and blinding light, your eyes prickling as they adjust after being in the relative darkness of the wall's entryway. The din of people chattering crowds your ears but you can still pick out the sound of a blacksmith's hammer, shouting from a barracks, and a faint roar from across the city that you can only guess is from the colosseum. The city is full of the sounds of life. You take a look at your surroundings and the first thing you notice is what was blinding you: out of the roadside footpaths sprout long, elegant poles with shallow golden braziers hanging by thin metallic threads from a bar at the top, the gently-curved depression filled with a magical flame. The main road is filled with armored guards and casual citizens alike, minotaurs and cowgirls walking about in what you guess must be their form of casual clothing — a toga wrapped all around their upper bodies that drapes down their legs. There are others wearing more familiar clothing but the city's fashion seems to be almost universal even across races — you can see lupines and humans wearing the robes. There's a lot of non-minotaurs roaming the roads, as you'd expect. Lupines, orcs, some goblins, catfolk, even a couple of leothrans along with plenty of humans. You've never seen so many different races together at once. Buildings line the roads, though where you're standing it's just a military guardpost adjacent to the gate and some kind of barn down the road. Looks like there's an inn just down the way, and it might pay to stop in there to get some rooms for your party — but then there's probably a lot of inns in the city, and maybe you could settle in somewhere else. You'll have to take a look and see. [party.has etheryn |[etheryn.lnhConfidence |"U-uh, [pc.name]," Etheryn starts, catching your attention. "I... I don't think we sent a dignitary here." "Huh? Are you sure?" you ask. "Oh, I... I don't know," she says, flailing. "M-maybe we did..? I must have just... just forgotten. Sorry." You ruffle her hair and leave it alone. Time to explore the city. |"Hey uh, [pc.name]," Etheryn says, tilting her head. "I don't think we sent a dignitary to Khor'minos. You know how that guard captain said that was the source of the information?" "Yeah," you say. "Well... all of our dignitaries are dead," she points out. "Or worse. It's just me and Elthara now, and she wouldn't have come here." "So who was it?" you ask. Etheryn shrugs. "Maybe a bystander or regular citizen...? But I don't see how they'd have gotten here. Could be a rumor spiralling out of control, I guess. Someone comes by and hears some of the details, only gets half of the story, then comes here on a caravan... but that doesn't explain the dignitary bit." She shrugs again. "I'm not sure, it's just weird." "Thanks for pointing it out," you say, ruffling her hair. "I'll think some more about it." Time to explore the city. |"Hey, [pc.name]," Etheryn says. "That guard captain said the account of your heroism was provided by an elven dignitary, presumably from the Winter City." "Right," you say. "But we didn't send a dignitary," she points out. "All of our dignitaries are dead, or worse. The only ones left are me and Elthara, and I think I'd know if either of us had been here before. So who really told that story? And why was it just accepted?" "Hmm," you mutter. Etheryn shrugs. "You'll have to forgive me if I don't believe we have a mysterious benefactor just waiting for us in Khor'minos. That seems too good to be true." "Right, I don't buy that either," you say. "It's just that I'm not sure why even our enemies would want us to get in here. Seems counterproductive at best." "Maybe there's a trap here and they wanted to ensure we got in to spring it?" she suggests. "I don't know, really. I just thought it was worth pointing out to you." "Caw!" screeches Harrick. "Thanks, you two," you say, ruffling Etheryn's hair. "I'll keep an eye out for anything weird. Let's explore the city, shall we?" "Onwards!" your elven companion declares. ] |Alright, time to explore the city. ]
rows.translation: 你推开门，顿时被震耳欲聋的噪音和刺眼的光芒所包围。在墙壁入口处相对昏暗的环境中待了太久，你的眼睛此刻正在适应这些强光。人们嘈杂的谈话声充斥着你的耳朵，但你仍然能够分辨出铁匠挥动铁锤的声音、军营里传来的喊叫声，以及从城市另一端传来的微弱轰鸣声——你只能猜测那应该是竞技场发出的声音。这座城市充满了各种生命的气息和声音。 你环顾四周，首先注意到的是之前让你视线受阻的那些东西：路边的步道上长出了许多修长而优雅的柱子，这些柱子的顶端装有金属杆，细金属丝将浅金色的火盆悬挂在上面，而那些微微弯曲的凹槽里则燃烧着神奇的火焰。主干道上到处都是武装警卫和平民，弥诺陶洛斯以及女牛仔们穿着他们所谓的休闲装在四处走动——那种上半身裹着托加袍，袍子垂到腿部的装扮。 还有其他人穿着更为熟悉的服装，但这座城市的时尚风格似乎在各个种族中都得到了普遍的认同——你会发现狼族和其他人类都穿着同样的长袍。正如你所预料的，道路上有很多非弥诺陶洛斯种族的人在活动。有狼族、兽人、一些哥布林、猫族，甚至还有几只利奥特兰兽，当然还有大量的人类。你从未见过如此多不同的种族同时出现在一处。 道路两旁排列着建筑物，不过在你现在的位置，只有一座军事哨所紧邻大门，道路尽头还有一座谷仓。看起来不远处有一家客栈，你们或许可以考虑在那里预订房间供团队使用——不过这座城市里应该有很多客栈，也许你们也可以选择其他地方入住。总之，还是得亲自去看看才行。 [party.has etheryn |[etheryn.lnhConfidence |呃[pc.name]，伊瑟琳开口说道，吸引了你的注意，‘我……我觉得我们并没有派什么高级官员来这里。’” “哈？你确定吗？”你问道。 “哦，我……我也不确定，”她支支吾吾地回答，“也许我们确实派了……也许我只是忘了而已。对不起。” 你轻轻揉了揉她的头发，然后不再继续追问。是时候去探索这座城市了。 |嘿，呃[pc.name]，伊瑟琳歪着头说道，‘我觉得我们并没有派任何高级官员去科尔米诺斯。你知道那个卫队队长是怎么说的吧？他说那里就是消息的来源。’” “嗯，”你回答道。 “那么……我们所有的贵族都死了，”她指出，“或者更糟。现在就只剩下我和艾尔萨拉了，而她也不会来到这里的。” “那么到底是谁干的？”你问道。 伊瑟琳耸了耸肩：“也许是一个旁观者，或者是一个普通的市民……？但我实在想不通他们是怎么来到这里的。大概只是个失控的谣言吧。有人路过时听到了其中的一些细节，却只了解了一半事情的经过，然后就跟着商队来到了这里……但这也无法解释为什么会有那位高官出现这件事。她又耸了耸肩：“我也不确定，就是觉得有点奇怪。” “谢谢你指出来，”你说道，同时轻轻揉了揉她的头发，“我会再仔细考虑一下的。” 是时候去探索这座城市了。 |嘿， [pc.name]，伊瑟琳说道，‘那个卫队队长说，关于你英勇事迹的描述是由一位精灵高官提供的，应该就是来自冬城的那位。’” “是啊，”你回答道。 “但我们并没有派任何高官去那里，”她指出，“我们所有的精灵高官都已经死了，或者更糟的是现在只剩下我和艾尔萨拉了，我想如果我们当中有谁之前来过这里，我应该能记起来的。那么，究竟是谁讲述了那个故事？又为什么大家会轻易地相信它呢？” “嗯……”你低声说道。 伊瑟琳耸了耸肩：“如果我不相信在科尔米诺斯真的有某个神秘的帮助者在等着我们，你一定要原谅我。这种事情听起来太美好了，简直不像是真的。” “没错，我也不会相信这种说法，”你说，“只是我不太明白，为什么就连我们的敌人也会想要他们让我们进来这里，这最多也只能说是适得其反吧。” “也许这里有个陷阱，他们想确保我们进去之后才会触发它？”她建议道，“其实我也不太确定，只是觉得值得提醒你们。” “哇！”哈里克尖叫起来。 “谢谢你们俩，”你说道，同时轻轻揉了揉伊瑟琳的头发，“我会留意任何可疑的情况的。我们先去探索这座城市吧？” “出发吧！”你的精灵伙伴宣布道。 ] |好了，是时候去探索这座城市了。 ]

rows.original:
You wade over to the portion of the pools where the red-haired twins are splashing and giggling. They don't take notice till you're almost upon them, at which point they gasp and smile excitedly as they make their way over to meet you.
    
    "[pc.name]! Hi!" they both say in unison.
    
    "Did you come to see us?" Linde asks, twirling a finger through a lock of her long hair and teasing it over her rosy pink lips.
    
    "Did you come to play?" Alia asks, rolling her shoulders in a way that presses her cleavage together on the water's surface.
rows.translation:
你涉水走向那对红发双胞胎正在嬉水嬉笑的那片浴池。直到你几乎走到她们跟前，她们才注意到你，随即惊呼一声，兴奋地笑着迎上前来。
    
    “[pc.name]！嗨！”她们俩异口同声地说。
    
    “你是来看我们的吗？”琳德问道，她用手指卷起一缕长发，轻轻撩过自己红润的嘴唇。
    
    “你是来玩的吗？”阿莉亚问道，她转了转肩膀，让双乳在水面上挤在了一起。

rows.original: You're just checking in. Give 'em a smooch to go.
rows.translation: 你只是过来看看。临走前给她们一个吻吧。
rows.raw: "You're just checking in. Give 'em a smooch to go."

rows.original:
You wade even closer, till you're close enough to pull both women into an embrace that leaves their pierced boobs pressed against you. Linde gasps and Alia smiles wide as you grab a handful of ass from each.
    
    "Yay! Come on then, we know exactly which parts of the baths are safe!" Alia says, beginning to guide you by the arm.
    
    "Y-yeah! Where no one will see us," Linde adds, taking your other arm.
    
    The two guide you to one of the smaller baths where the steam hangs heavy in the air. It's remarkably similar to the bath you first met the twins in. Sure enough, Linde relaxes a bit the very moment you're relatively obscured by the haze, and presses against you with an enthusiasm that comes close to matching her sisters. The only difference is that Alia's flush has nothing to do with embarrassment. Once more, they seem content to let you decide what 'play' means.
    
    What do you want out of this?
rows.translation:
你慢慢靠近，直到距离足够近，可以将两位女性都拉进怀里，让她们穿孔的胸部紧贴在你的身上。琳德倒抽了一口气，而阿莉亚则露出了灿烂的笑容，这时你分别抓住了她们的臀部。

"[pc.dcb |Because you wanted to be. You didn't want to see what she was. Neither of us did." |It's not your fault. Don't blame yourself." |Izzy, it's not your fault. rows.original: "So how'd you end up in the Legions?" "Went to a recruiter, same as anybody during peace time," Isadora laughs. "There's men from each legion at posts in the city, usually veterans that've been hurt too bad to fight anymore, or got too old, but don't want to leave. They can lead you through the Oath of Service and send you on to your legion's encampment right then and there." Right, a little more direct, then. "And why did you join up?" "Oh! Well, uh, I wanted to? Ever since I was little, I saw soldiers marching through the village, and thought they were the most amazing things — all that polished armor, the way they all moved in unison, the thunder of marching feet! I knew I wanted to be a part of that. The second I was old enough, I signed up. That was, uh, seven years ago now I wanna say." "Seven years? How much longer are you in for?" Isadora scratches the side of her helm. "Weeeeell, the Oath of Service is for twenty years, or longer if the kingdom needs us. So another thirteen, if rebuilding after this isn't too bad..." "That's a long time to be a soldier," you muse. "Do you enjoy it?" "Yeah! I do. I mean, I hate this," she says, gesturing vaguely around herself. "The war. It's terrible, don't get me wrong. But in a perverse way, it's been great for me. Before now I wasn't allowed to serve on the front lines. Damn hornbrain Legate said for years I was too small, that I wasn't fit to fight. They even wanted to stick me in the Auxiliary, except I'm already a citizen by birth. All I could do for the first seven years of my career was guard duty on the coast. It was bullshit!" She huffs, crossing her arms. "Nobody saw what I could do until Calise came along. [calise.isTraitor |And look how that ended up. If the rest of the legion knew, I'd be branded a traitor because of her! I'll never forgive her. |She gave me a chance to fight when nobody else would. I can't thank her enough for that. ]" "So, you love the legions but hate the work?" "I guess that's a good way to phrase it," Isadora nods. "I wouldn't trade my brothers in arms for anything, and even if the Legate never thought much of me, I know every solder that served beside me has my back. And they made sure I knew it, too." She takes her helmet off and runs her thumbs over its short little horns. "My cohort's armorer made this for me, as a present from the whole unit. They said they didn't want me to feel like I didn't belong." So they gave her little horns, like a cowgirl. "[pc.dcb |Did you moo for them, at least? |Ah, that's adorable. |Awwww that's so sweet! ] There must not be a lot of cowgirls in the Legions, huh?" Isadora [pc.isDK |sticks her tongue out |giggles ]. "Nah. There's plenty of girly mages working for the Navy, or the Auxiliary Corps, but yeah not a lot of us volunteer for the infantry. There's a few gals in the support trains, doing laundry and cooking and stuff, but I'm the only one in my whole legion that even wanted to fight on the front lines." "Is it hard, being the only girl around?" [party.has brint |You glance at Brint |You glance at a heavyset minotaur man walking on the other side of the street. ] "Especially surrounded by big [silly |beeves |bulls ] like him?" "Ha, nah, it's not so bad. It's like having a company of stupid big brothers around all the time. At least, most of the time. Sometimes I gotta remind 'em that being at dick-suckin' height means I'm also at dick-punchin' height!" Isadora cackles and throws a couple of quick punches at the air. "That sets boundaries pretty quick." You bet it does.
rows.translation: “那你是怎么加入军团的？” “去找招募官呗，跟和平时期其他人没什么两样，”伊莎多拉笑着说。“城里各个军团的驻地都有人，通常是那些伤得太重没法再打，或者年纪太大，但又不想离开的老兵。他们会带你完成服役宣誓，然后当场把你送到你所属军团的营地。” 好吧，那问得再直接一点。“那你为什么要参军？” “哦！嗯，就是想吧？从小我就看着士兵们列队穿过村子，觉得他们简直太了不起了——擦得锃亮的护甲，整齐划一的步伐，还有那雷鸣般的脚步声！我就知道自己想成为其中一员。一到够年龄，我就报名了。那大概是，嗯，七年前的事了吧。” “七年？那你还要服役多久？” 伊莎多拉挠了挠头盔侧面。“这个嘛——服役宣誓是二十年，如果王国需要我们还会更长。所以还有十三年，前提是这之后的重建别太糟……” “当兵要这么久啊，”你思索道。“你喜欢这行吗？” “喜欢！我确实喜欢。我是说，我讨厌这个，”她说着含糊地朝四周比了比。“这场战争。它很可怕，别误会。但往歪处想，它对我倒是件好事。以前我根本不被允许上前线。那个长角的蠢货军团长说了好几年我个子太小，不适合打仗。他们甚至想把我塞进辅助部队，可我一出生就是公民。我职业生涯的头七年只能在海边站岗。简直太扯了！” 她哼了一声，双臂抱胸。“在卡莉丝出现之前，没人看到我能做什么。[calise.isTraitor |结果呢。要是军团里其他人知道，我会因为她被扣上叛徒的帽子！我永远不会原谅她。 |在没人肯给我机会的时候，她给了我上阵拼杀的机会。我感激不尽。 ]” “所以，你爱军团却讨厌这份差事？” “我觉得这么说挺准确的，”伊莎多拉点了点头。“我绝不会拿我的战友去换任何东西，就算军团长从没看重过我，我也知道每个和我并肩作战的士兵都挺我。他们还特意让我明白这一点。” 她摘下头盔，用拇指摩挲着头盔上那对短短的小角。“这是我们小队的军械师给我做的，整个小队送的礼物。他们说不想让我觉得自己不属于这里。” 所以他们给她安了小角，跟牛仔姑娘似的。“[pc.dcb |你至少冲他们哞过吗？ |啊，太可爱了。 |哇，这也太贴心了吧！ ]军团里肯定没多少牛仔姑娘吧？” 伊莎多拉[pc.isDK |吐出舌头 |咯咯笑 ]。“才不是呢。海军和辅助部队里有一堆女法师，但自愿进步兵的确实不多。后勤队里也有几个姑娘，洗衣服做饭什么的，但整个军团里想上前线打仗的就我一个。” “周围只有你一个姑娘，会不会很难熬？”[party.has brint |你瞥了布林特一眼 |你瞥了一眼街对面走着的那个体格粗壮的弥诺陶洛斯男人。 ] “尤其是身边全是像他那样的大[silly |公牛 |公牛 ]的时候？” “哈，不会，没那么糟。就像身边老围着一群傻大个哥哥。至少大多数时候是这样。有时候我得提醒他们：我既然矮到能给鸡巴口交，也就矮到能揍鸡巴！”伊莎多拉咯咯大笑，朝空中快速挥了两拳。“这样很快就能划清界限了。” 确实如此。

"Ha, nah, it's not so bad. It's like having a company of stupid big brothers around all the time. At least, most of the time. Sometimes I gotta remind 'em that being at dick-suckin' height means I'm also at dick-punchin' height!" Isadora cackles and throws a couple of quick punches at the air. "That sets boundaries pretty quick." You bet it does.'

rows.original: How'd Isadora get to be a soldier, and how's she enjoying the life?
rows.translation: 伊莎多拉是怎么当上兵的？她喜欢这种生活吗？
rows.raw: "How'd Isadora get to be a soldier, and how's she enjoying the life?"

rows.original: [bk.isChamp|Isadora sighs. "I miss her. I know I didn't know her all that long, but she was more than just a friend[isadora.fuckedCalise| — and I don't mean like that]! She was a mentor, somebody who believed in me. It's hard to believe she's left.|[calise.isTraitor |"Now that you know what Calise was..." Isadora puts a hand up. "I don't want to talk about it. I still can't believe how blind I was. The whole city was. I thought..." She shakes her head and sighs. "No, it doesn't matter. I'm gonna work myself up into a frenzy if I dwell on it. So let's just... not." |"You've fought beside her for a while now — what do you think about Lady Calise?" Isadora's eyes light up. "She's amazing! You and her, you're both like heroes outta the old stories, come to save the kingdom from evil. The way she fights, she's like a force of nature — she fearlessly charges in with the vanguard, hewing imps apart with her axe like they're nothing but chickens! Even if that leaves the rest of us tripping over ourselves to catch up to her and cover her back... Just don't tell her I said she's amazing. I mean, that watching her is — I mean, fuck." You laugh. "I get it. How'd you end up following her, anyway?" "I volunteered! When the war broke out, all the legions got recalled to the city to help with the evacuation. It didn't go well, and we lost a lot of soldiers trying to hold back the imp tide while everyone got behind the walls. Total chaos. Calise showed up right in the middle of that, beating down a demon general right in the middle of the street. It made her a legend overnight. Right after that, the king gave her leave to form her own unit of fighters, to take anybody she wanted who'd volunteer to serve her. I didn't even have to think about it." Isadora smiles fondly. "She gave me a chance. Nobody else in the Legions did. She saw what I could do, that I wasn't useless just because I'm small. I'll never forget the way she smiled and clasped my shoulder when I asked to serve her, and said it'd be her honor to have me!" "And you've been at her side ever since." "Damn right! Except that trip to the Grave of Saints!" Isadora throws a punch at the air between you. "And I'm never going to let anything happen to her again." [calise.hdk | |You wonder how she'd feel if she knew the truth... |You wonder how she'd feel if she knew the truth... ] ]]
rows.translation: [bk.isChamp|伊莎多拉叹了口气：“我想念她。我知道我们相识的时间并不长，但她对我来说，远不止是一个朋友[isadora.fuckedCalise|——我指的不是那种关系]！她是一位导师，是一个相信我的人。真的很难相信她已经离开了。|[calise.isTraitor |既然你现在知道了卡莉丝的真实身份……” 伊莎多拉抬起手。“我不想谈论这个。我至今还是无法相信自己当时竟然如此盲目。整个城市都是如此。我本以为……”她摇摇头，叹了口气，“不，这不重要。要是一直纠结这件事，我会把自己逼疯的。所以，我们就……别再提了。” |“你们已经和她并肩作战了一段时间了——你对卡莉丝女士有什么看法？” 伊莎多拉的眼睛亮了起来：“她太棒了！你和她，简直就像古老故事里的英雄，前来从邪恶手中拯救王国。她战斗的样子就像一股自然之力——她毫无畏惧地随先锋冲锋，用斧头把小恶魔劈成碎片，仿佛它们不过是一群鸡！即便这害得我们其他人只能手忙脚乱地追上她、掩护她的背后……只是别告诉她我说过她很棒。我是说，看她战斗的时候——我是说，妈的。” 你笑了：“我明白了。那你到底是怎么跟了她的呢？” “我是自愿的！战争爆发时，所有军团都被召回城里协助疏散。事情并不顺利，为了挡住小恶魔的狂潮、让所有人撤进城墙后面，我们损失了很多士兵。一片混乱。卡莉丝就在那时出现了，当街打倒了一位恶魔将军，一夜之间成了传奇。紧接着，国王准许她组建自己的战斗部队，可以招募任何自愿为她效力的人。我想都没想就答应了。” 伊莎多拉温柔地笑了。“她给了我一个机会。军团里没有别人给我机会。她看到了我的能力，明白我并不会因为个子小就一无是处。我永远也不会忘记，当我请求为她效力时，她微笑着握住我的肩膀，说能收下我是她的荣幸！” “从那以后，你就一直陪伴在她身边。” “那是当然！除了那次去圣徒墓地的旅行！”伊莎多拉朝你们之间的空气挥出一拳，“我再也不会让任何事发生在她身上了。” [calise.hdk | |你不禁会想，如果她知道了真相，会作何感想…… |你不禁会想，如果她知道了真相，会作何感想…… ] ]]

rows.original: What does Isadora think about Calise[calise.gone|, now that she knows the truth]?
rows.translation: 伊莎多拉对卡莉丝有什么看法[calise.gone|，既然她现在知道了真相]？
rows.raw: "What does Isadora think about Calise[calise.gone|, now that she knows the truth]?"

rows.original:
"So how're the men holding up?"
        
        [calise.isTraitor
            |Isadora sighs. "Not great. They don't understand what happened, or where their lady went. We're not even really sure who's in charge anymore; we had two centurions in the unit and Calise... Kasyrra... never picked an official second. Never needed one."
            
            "Do they disagree on what to do now?"
            
            "Yeah. Irador wants to dissolve the unit, put everyone back to their original postings until Calise... returns... while Vesparius says we should keep striking at demon strongholds while they're off-balance. I hope he wins out, I don't want to go back to doing nothing but sitting on my hands. But I'm honor-bound to do whatever the unit decides. These're men I've shed blood besides, I'm not gonna abandon them no matter what." 
            
            You follow her gaze to the empty windows of Calise's apartment. "So no going off chasing her?"
            
            "I want to. I will! Just... I can't abandon my duty, either. My friends. But the second you find that bitch, you let us know. One way or another, I'll convince them to help."
            |[var0
                |Isadora sighs. "We had it rough in the big battle, but we're recovering. We had no shortage of volunteers to join us after what you and Lady Calise managed to pull off. The centurions are whipping them into shape, teaching them how to fight like we do. I promise we'll be ready to march whenever you and Lady Calise need us again."
                |Isadora punches her palm. "Ready to fight. [var1
                    |We came away clean after that last battle! Thanks to you, t
                    |T
                ]here's been no shortage of volunteers to join us — we're getting stronger every day. You and Calise call on us, and we'll answer with a roar!" 
                
                She's eager for it! [var1
                    |Riding the high of the victory you delivered to the kingdom.
                    |You can only hope she's this ready for battle when it finally comes in earnest.
                ]
            ]
        ]
rows.translation:
“那么，弟兄们现在的状况怎么样？”
        
        [calise.isTraitor
            |伊莎多拉叹了口气：“情况不太好。他们根本不明白发生了什么，也不知道他们的卡莉丝女士去了哪里。我们现在甚至都不确定到底谁在管事；我们这支部队原本有两位百夫长，而卡莉丝……卡希拉……却从未正式指定过副手。从来也不需要。”
            
            “那他们对接下来该怎么做有分歧吗？”
            
            “是的。伊拉多想要解散这支部队，把所有人重新派回原来的岗位，直到卡莉丝……回来……而维斯帕里乌斯则认为，我们应该趁那些恶魔据点阵脚未稳时继续打击它们。我希望他能赢，我可不想再回去干坐着无所事事了。但不管部队做出什么决定，我都有义务遵从。这些都是和我一起流过血的弟兄，无论如何我都不会抛弃他们。” 
            
            你顺着她的目光望向卡莉丝公寓里空荡荡的窗户。“所以不能去追她了吗？”
            
            “我想去。我会去的！只是……我也不能抛下自己的职责，还有我的朋友们。不过你一旦找到那个贱人，就通知我们。不管怎样，我都会说服他们出手帮忙的。”
            |[var0
                |伊莎多拉叹了口气：“那场大战我们打得很艰难，但我们正在恢复。在你和卡莉丝女士干出那样的壮举之后，前来加入我们的人源源不断。百夫长们正在把他们操练成形，教他们像我们一样战斗。我保证，只要你和卡莉丝女士再次需要我们，我们随时都能开拔。”
                |伊莎多拉一拳砸在掌心。“准备好开打了。 [var1
                    |上一场战斗之后我们全身而退，毫发无损！多亏了你，
                    |
                ]自那以后，前来加入我们的人源源不断——我们的队伍一天比一天壮大。你和卡莉丝一声召唤，我们就会以怒吼回应！” 
                
                她对此迫不及待！ [var1
                    |沉浸在你为王国带来的胜利喜悦之中。
                    |你只能希望，当真正的战斗最终来临时，她也能如此蓄势待发。
                ]
            ]
        ]

rows.translation: 他们的特种部队进展如何？

rows.original:
"You're from around here, right?" you ask.
        
        [party.has brint
            |She nods at Brint. "Yeah, from the same village as this big lug.
            |Mmhm! I'm from a village right outside the city walls.
        ] My folks moved there before I was born, up from their tribes' lands back south, so I'm born and bred Minoan, same as [party.has brint
            |Brint here
            |any bull on the streets
        ]."
        
        [party.has brint
            |
            Brint musses her hair. "I've known Izzy since we were kids. She lived a couple of streets away from us, so we'd end up playing together all the time. At least 'till I got so big I'd squish her."
            
            Isadora sticks her tongue out. "I can still take you!"
            
            [pc.isBimbo
                |"In a fight, right?" you ask her.
                |You laugh. "I bet."
            ]
            
            The two of them laugh like old friends. 
            
            "Izzy and my sister even went to the same school. She got high marks from their teachers. For a meathead." 
        ]
        
        She makes no effort to hide how proud that makes her, chin up and chest pushed forward. 
        
        "What do your folks do?"
        
        "Mom's a servant in a rich lady's house," Isadora says, just as proud as before. "My littler sister, too. Dad works in a tailor's shop."
        
        "Just the one little sister?"
        
        [party.has brint
            |You see Brint grimace and shake his head, a little too late.
        ]
        
        Isadora winces a bit. "No, I, uh, I've got a big sister too. Isabela. She's a big gal, head and shoulders taller than me, same red hair and pretty damn strong besides. You ever seen her?"
        
        You shake your head. "I've met a lot of big, buff ladies around these parts, but no Isabela."
        
        "Damn."
        
        You quirk a brow at her. "Is she...?"
        
        "Missing. Has been for about a year now," Izzy says glumly. "She's kind of an adventurer, like you. Even went to Hawkethorne, or was going there, the last we heard from her. Going to explore some old Belharan ruins around the barony. But we haven't heard from her in, well, a year. I took some time off — back before the war started — to go looking for her myself, but nobody in the barony said they'd ever seen her, and I couldn't find any trace of her past the foothills. I burned all my leave time, and most of my money, searching for her but... it's like she just disappeared." 
        
        "Where did anybody see her last?"
        
        Isadora shrugs helplessly. "The king's gate, up to the surface. Some troopers said that they'd seen her go through. I managed to flag down a couple of harpies — that's where the money went — who said they saw her in the hills, headed towards Hawkethorne. But they lost track of her when this gnarly blizzard rolled in."
        
        [party.has cait
            |You and Cait share a look. The pink kitty gives Isadora a sympathetic shoulder squeeze. "We might have something in common then. My sister disappeared around the same place, in a blizzard. Right around a year after yours, I'm betting."
            |"That sounds familiar. I've got a friend whose sister vanished around the same place in similar circumstances..."
        ]
rows.translation:
你是这个地方的吧？”你问道。
        
        [party.has brint
            |她朝布林特点了点头。“没错，我们来自同一个村庄。
            |嗯，我来自城墙外的一个村庄。
        ]在我出生之前，我的父母就从他们所在的部落所在地搬到了那里，从南方搬到了那里，所以我是在那里出生的，也在那里长大的，我是一个地道的米诺斯人，其他人也是如此。 [party.has brint
            |我是布林特
            |街头上的闲言碎语
        ]。”
        
        [party.has brint
            |
            布林特整理着自己的头发，说道：“我们从小时候就认识伊莎朵拉了。她住在我们家几条街之外，所以我们经常一起玩耍。至少在我还小的时候是这样，直到我长得太高，再也不能和她一起玩了。”
            
            伊莎朵拉吐了吐舌头，笑道：“我现在还是能打败你的！
            
            [pc.isBimbo
                |在一场战斗中，对吧？”你问她。
                |你笑了：“我打赌。
            ]
            
            他们两个像老朋友一样哈哈大笑。
            
            “伊兹和我的妹妹甚至还在同一所学校上学。她从老师们那里得到了很高的评价。真是个聪明的女孩。 
        ]
        
        她毫不掩饰自己为此感到多么自豪，下巴微微上扬，胸膛也挺得更加挺拔。
        
        “你的父母是做什么工作的？”
        
        “妈妈在一位富人家里当仆人，”伊莎多拉依然带着同样的自豪说道，“我妹妹也是。爸爸则在一家裁缝店工作。”
        
        “就只有一个妹妹吗？
        
        [party.has brint
            |你看到布林特露出了痛苦的表情，然后摇了摇头，不过这个动作已经有点迟了。
        ]
        
        伊莎多拉微微皱了皱眉：“不，我，呃，我也有一个姐姐。伊莎贝拉。她是个高个子女孩，比我要高很多，头发也是红色的，而且力气也大得惊人。你见过她吗？”
        
        你摇了摇头。在这附近，我见过很多身材高大的女性，但从来没有遇到过伊莎贝拉。”
        
        “该死。”
        
        你挑了挑眉毛，问道：“她……？”
        
        “失踪了。已经有一年左右了。”伊兹沮丧地说道。她有点像你一样，是个喜欢冒险的人。我们最后一次收到她的消息时，她正在前往鹰棘镇，或者说是打算去那里。她说要去探索领地周围那些古老的贝尔哈兰遗迹。不过，从那以后我们已经有一年没有她的消息了。我在战争爆发之前抽了一些时间，亲自去寻找她，但领地里的每个人都声称从未见过她，而在山脚以外，我也找不到关于她的任何线索。我耗尽了所有的休假时间，也花掉了大部分钱，却依然一无所获。……就好像她突然消失了一样。”
        
        “最后有人在哪里看到她吗？”
        
        伊莎多拉无奈地耸了耸肩：“在国王之门，也就是通往地面的地方。有些士兵说他们看到她从那里经过了。我花了一些钱雇了几只鹰身女妖——那些钱就是用来买它们的——它们说在山丘上看到她往鹰棘镇的方向去了。但是，当这场猛烈的暴风雪来袭时，他们失去了她的踪迹。
        
        [party.has cait
            |你和凯特对视了一眼。那只粉色的小猫轻轻拍了拍伊莎多拉的肩膀，表示同情：“那么我们可能有一些共同点吧。我的妹妹也是在类似的场合失踪的，也是在暴风雪中……大概就在你妹妹失踪的一年后吧。
            |这听起来很熟悉。我有个朋友，他的妹妹也是在类似的情况下，在差不多同一个地方失踪的……
        ]

I managed to flag down a couple of harpies — that's where the money went — who said they saw her in the hills, headed towards Hawkethorne. But they lost track of her when this gnarly blizzard rolled in."
        
        [party.has cait
            |You and Cait share a look. The pink kitty gives Isadora a sympathetic shoulder squeeze. "We might have something in common then. My sister disappeared around the same place, in a blizzard. Right around a year after yours, I'm betting."
            |"That sounds familiar. I've got a friend whose sister vanished around the same place in similar circumstances..."
        ]'

rows.original:
Explaining the circumstances of Calla's disappearance does little to lighten Isadora's mood.

            "I hope you're wrong," she says, "but I don't think you are. Another world? I didn't know that existed outside of storybooks! If Isabela's trapped in the same world the demon queen's from..."
            
            [pc.dcb
                |No reason to sugar-coat it. "Yeah, she's probably a slave, or worse."
                
                [party.has cait
                    |Cait gives you a downright horrified look. 
                ]Isadora's lips draw tight. "Shut the fuck up. She's fine! She has to be..."
                |"If she's half as strong as you, I'm sure she's fine," you say, giving her a reassuring smile.
                |"Aw, I'm sure she's fine! You're super tough, and she's your big sister, right? So... she's gotta be extra tough!"
            ]
            
            [pc.isDK
                |"Yeah, whatever you say."
                |Isadora nods. "Y-yeah! Bela's a badass shieldmaiden. She's probably a warrior-queen over there! I bet the demon bitch fled here to get away from her!"
                
                That's the spirit! Even if it's just a brave face, if she can just make herself believe it...
            ]
rows.translation:
解释卡拉失踪的来龙去脉，丝毫没能让伊莎多拉的心情好起来。

            “我希望你是错的，”她说，“但我觉得你并没有错。另一个世界？我根本不知道故事书之外还有这种地方存在！如果伊莎贝拉也被困在恶魔女王来自的那个世界里……”
            
            [pc.dcb
                |没必要粉饰事实。“没错，她很可能成了奴隶，或者更糟。”
                
                [party.has cait
                    |凯特露出了惊恐万状的表情。 
                ]伊莎多拉的嘴唇抿紧了。“你他妈的给我闭嘴。她没事的！她肯定没事……”
                |“如果她的实力有你的一半，我敢肯定她没事，”你说道，同时给了她一个宽慰的微笑。
                |“哎，我肯定她没事的！你这么坚强，而且她又是你的姐姐，对吧？所以……她肯定更坚强！”
            ]
            
            [pc.isDK
                |“嗯，你说什么就是什么吧。”
                |伊莎多拉点了点头。“对……对！贝拉可是个厉害的盾女。她在那边说不定是个战士女王呢！我打赌那个恶魔婊子就是为躲开她才逃到这儿来的！”
                
                就该这样！即便只是强装出来的勇敢，只要她能让自己相信……
            ]

rows.original: Where does this perky tomboy come from, anyway?
rows.translation: 这个活泼开朗的假小子到底是从哪里来的呢？
rows.raw: "Where does this perky tomboy come from, anyway?"

rows.original: "How are things here in the city?" Isadora looks around. "[var0 |With the worst of the demon hordes broken, morale's finally lifting. It'll be a long while before people are able to get out from the walls and resettle the villages, but they know it's coming now thanks to you. You're the hero they needed, and they'll never forget you." |Bad. Patriotism and fear are keeping people from rioting, but food is scarce and hope is scarcer. People need you and Calise to be heroes! Without you, I don't know what we'd do..." ] "You make it sound like the future's riding on me!" "Isn't it?" Isadora laughs. "Believe me, I wish it was on me — I mean, the Royal Legions! But especially now, the whole city's got its eyes on [calise.isTraitor |you. |[bk.isChamp|you!|you and Lady Calise!] ]" You laugh. "Besides the obvious, what's the word on the street? You've got a closer ear to it than me." "There are elections coming up. Even with the war on, the king's promised to carry them out as normal. Nobody knows how it's going to go — or who's going to keep their seats in the senate. Considering how the world's changing, I think a lot of Novitauri are going to win big this year. But it's anybody's guess..." She sighs. "Even with the demon menace, orc raiders are apparently getting more aggressive along the coast. The Navy's freaking out — like we didn't have enough problems! Senator Filius has promised a swift end if he's put in charge of the military, but I don't think that's likely. I really hope not. We need the king and the generals in command, not pompous rich men! Just look at what happened to the Second Legion." "What did happen to them?" "Patricians thought they knew better than warfighters. When the fighting kicked off in undermountain, some jackass from House Junia who'd bought his way into command of them panicked under pressure. He refused to believe the demons were real, kept screaming they were just batfolk or goblins or something, just froze up and couldn't lead when things didn't make sense to him. He couldn't adapt. So a lot of the Second got dragged down, or dragged off, by swarms of imps until a centurion stepped up and seized command. People'll be spitting on that rich chode's grave for a generation... and still other Senators think they know better, that they should be in charge! It makes my blood boil..." Considering the trooper's perspective on things in the city seem to be entirely military, maybe you ought to just change the subject.
rows.translation: “城里的情况怎么样？” 伊莎多拉环顾四周。“[var0 |恶魔大军的主力已经被击溃，士气终于开始回升。人们还要过很久才能走出城墙、重新在村庄里定居；但多亏了你，他们现在知道这一天终会到来。你是他们需要的英雄，他们永远都不会忘记你。 |很糟。爱国心和恐惧阻止了人们发动暴乱，可食物十分匮乏，希望更加稀少。大家需要你和卡莉丝成为英雄！没有你们，我真不知道该怎么办…… ]” “听你这么说，未来仿佛全压在我肩上！” “难道不是吗？”伊莎多拉笑道。“相信我，我也希望未来压在自己——我是说，王家军团的肩上！但尤其是现在，整座城市的目光都集中在[calise.isTraitor |你身上。 |[bk.isChamp|你身上！|你和卡莉丝女士身上！] ]” 你笑了起来。“除了那些显而易见的事，街头最近还有什么消息？你的消息可比我灵通。” “选举就要举行了。即使战争仍在继续，国王也承诺一切会照常进行。没人知道结果会是什么样——也没人知道哪些人能保住元老院的席位。考虑到世界正在发生怎样的变化，我想今年会有很多新牛派大获全胜。不过，谁也说不准……” 她叹了口气。“即使有恶魔威胁，据说兽人袭击者沿海岸线的活动也变得更加猖獗。海军都快疯了——仿佛我们的问题还不够多似的！菲利乌斯元老承诺，只要让他掌管军队，就能迅速终结威胁；不过我觉得这不太可能。我真心希望不会发生这种事。我们需要国王和将军指挥军队，不是那些自命不凡的有钱人！看看第二军团出了什么事就知道了。” “他们发生了什么？” “贵族们自以为比真正的战士更懂战争。地下山脉爆发战斗时，尤妮娅家族有个混蛋花钱买来了军团指挥权，却在压力下彻底慌了神。他拒绝相信恶魔真实存在，不停叫嚷着那些只是蝙蝠族、哥布林之类的东西；事情一旦超出理解，他便僵在原地，根本无法指挥。他完全不会随机应变。于是第二军团有大量士兵被成群的小恶魔拖倒或掳走，直到一名百夫长挺身而出、夺取指挥权。未来整整一代人都会朝那个有钱混蛋的坟墓吐口水……可其他元老仍然自以为更加高明，认为自己应该掌权！一想到这里，我就怒火中烧……” 看来这名士兵对城中局势的看法完全来自军事角度；也许你应该换个话题。
