rows.original: In Isadora's eye, how's the city — and the kingdom at large — faring?
rows.translation: 在伊莎多拉的眼中，这座城市——以及整个王国——目前的状况如何呢？
rows.raw: "In Isadora's eye, how's the city — and the kingdom at large — faring?"

rows.original:
"How about we get some training in?" you suggest.
    
    [isadora.fucked
        |Izzy gets in close and flashes you a grin. "You can give me a workout any time, [pc.name]."
        
        You give her butt a squeeze. "Let's get nice and sweaty first."
        
        "Ha! Fine, let's get out butts to the barracks then. The boys'll be happy to have us around."
        |Isadora grins. "Hell yeah. We can go to the barracks if you want. The boys'll love having you around for the day."
    ]
    
    You nod. "Lead the way."
    
    [calise.isTraitor
        |Isadora straightens her back and marches briskly out of the neighborhood
        |[bk.isChamp|Isadora claps your shoulder and leads you out of the neighborhood.|Isadora pokes her head in the door and shouts to Calise that the pair of you are going to be leaving for the day, before giving you a thumbs up and starting to jog for the main street.]
    ] [party.yall] follow after her, through the heart of the city and then out again, into one of the outer wards on the western side of town. Your destination is a walled section of the city, its gates surrounded by vexilia and banners of the Khor'minoan military, surrounded by a cohort of muscular bulls in heavy armor standing behind planted tower shields. 
    
    "Champion!" the gate guards bellow in unison, rapping knuckles against their breastplates. The gates are hauled open for you, and Isadora leads the way through the heavily guarded front entrance and onto an open training field. The ground is covered in a thick layer of sand, surrounded by human-shaped dummies on one side and an assortment of exercise equipment on the other. A semi-circle of sandstone seats surround the far end, letting older soldiers and officers sit back and watch the young bulls bulking up. 
    
    Isadora shucks her cloak and armor, squats down, and dusts her hands with sand. "Alright. Let's get our blood up, [isadora.fucked
        |babe
        |Champion
    ]!"
rows.translation:
“我们去训练一下怎么样？”你提议道。
    
    [isadora.fucked
        |伊兹凑到你身边，朝你咧嘴一笑。“你随时都可以来锻炼我，[pc.name]。”
        
        你捏了捏她的屁股。“我们先好好出一身汗吧。”
        
        “哈！行，那就去军营活动活动。弟兄们肯定很高兴见到我们。”
        |伊莎多拉咧嘴一笑。“好啊。你想的话，我们可以去军营。弟兄们肯定很高兴有你陪他们一天。”
    ]
    
    你点点头。“带路吧。”
    
    [calise.isTraitor
        |伊莎多拉挺直腰背，迈着利落的步伐走出街区
        |[bk.isChamp|伊莎多拉拍了拍你的肩膀，带你走出街区。|伊莎多拉把头探进门里，朝卡莉丝喊道你们俩今天要出去，随后向你竖起拇指，朝主街小跑而去。]
    ] [party.yall]跟在她身后，穿过城市中心，再次来到城外，进入城市西侧的一处外围城区。你们的目的地是城中一片有围墙环绕的区域，城门四周悬挂着科尔米诺斯军队的军旗与旌旗；一队肌肉发达、身披重甲的公牛战士守在插入地面的塔盾后方。
    
    “勇士！”守门卫兵齐声高呼，用指关节敲击胸甲。大门为你敞开，伊莎多拉带头穿过戒备森严的正门，来到一片开阔的训练场。地面铺着厚厚一层沙子，一侧立着人形假人，另一侧摆放着各种训练器材。远端环绕着半圆形的砂岩座席，年长的士兵与军官可以坐在那里，看年轻的公牛战士们锻炼壮硕的肌肉。
    
    伊莎多拉脱下斗篷和盔甲，蹲下身，用沙子搓了搓双手。“好了，让我们热热身吧，[isadora.fucked
        |宝贝
        |勇士
    ]！”

rows.original: You're still level 1! You haven't even assigned any attribute points yet.
rows.translation: 你还是1级呢！甚至还没有分配任何属性点数。
rows.raw: "You're still level 1! You haven't even assigned any attribute points yet."

rows.original: Re-assign the Attribute points you gained from levelling up. You can't re-assign the points you started with at Level 1, nor any temporary points. Costs 300 Electrum Coins and a day of training time.
rows.translation: 你可以重新分配因升级而获得的属性点数。不过，你无法重新分配在1级时初始拥有的那些点数，也无法重新分配任何临时获得的点数。进行这项操作需要花费300枚琥珀金币，并且还需要消耗一天的训练时间。
rows.raw: "Re-assign the Attribute points you gained from levelling up. You can't re-assign the points you started with at Level 1, nor any temporary points. Costs 300 Electrum Coins and a day of training time."

rows.original: You don't have the 300 EC required to retrain.
rows.translation: 你没有进行重新训练所需的300枚琥珀金币。
rows.raw: "You don't have the 300 EC required to retrain."

rows.original: There are no powers Isadora can teach you.
rows.translation: 伊莎多拉并没有什么能力是可以教给你的。
rows.raw: "There are no powers Isadora can teach you."

rows.original: Strip down so you can get down and dirty with Isadora, and really work up a sweat in the barracks. Whether that's all you do today will depend on you, but there's sure to be a lot of her fellow soldiers enjoying the show regardless.
rows.translation: 脱光衣服，好跟伊莎多拉尽情地滚在一起，在营房里痛痛快快地出一身汗。今天你们是不是只做这些，全看你自己，但无论如何，她的许多战友肯定都会乐呵呵地看着这场表演。
rows.raw: "Strip down so you can get down and dirty with Isadora, and really work up a sweat in the barracks. Whether that's all you do today will depend on you, but there's sure to be a lot of her fellow soldiers enjoying the show regardless."

rows.original: You mimic your partner's action and roll your shoulders. "Let's do this." [pc.bg soldier |It's hardly your first time in a military training ring, and you're able to match Isadora move for more, exercise for exercise — and though it's not easy on either of you, you push each other to work harder. |The rest of the day is spent in grueling training, pushing your body to the limit. Isadora proves to be just as capable a trainer as she is a soldier, finding the perfect balance of encouraging and demanding to get the best out of you hour after hour ]. Other members of the Legion come and go, offering to spar or coach or spot you. There's no shortage of rippling bull-muscle on display out here throughout the day, and Isadora inevitably catches a few ass-slaps and noogies from her comrades. A couple of bulls catch playful punches in the gut back, and they both laugh. All the troops around seem to like her. And you, well, you're the Champion. You're held in a mix of awe[pc.isBimbo | and lust |, curiosity, and [pc.mf |comradery |desire ] ]. You [pc.dcb |make sure to keep them sweating just as hard as you are. If you're going to save their city for them, the least they can do is be ready to fight for it when the time comes. |take heart from their support, trying to push yourself to be the best you can be while the city's brave defenders are watching. |make sure to shake and jiggle enticingly, inviting troopers to get nice and close when they have to show you how the equipment works — and the grappling part of the day is fun for everyone. ] The whole day proceeds like that, surrounded by soldiers tired and tense from fighting, and eager to see what their city's Champion can do. When your muscles finally give out, you and Isadora stagger your way from the training field to the mess hall. True to form, what's slapped down onto your meal tray at day's end is enough to fill the belly of a bull and more besides, thick and rich and almost achieving some sort of flavor. When you've dumped your tray into the washing bucket near the mess door, Isadora gives your shoulder a friendly clap. "Same thing tomorrow?" You just groan.

                    ]把衣服穿回去……不过[party.has brint
                        |布林特按捺不住，非要在你的裤子穿回去之前把你按下去再来最后一发，周围的士兵齐声叫好。
                        |有根手指一直顶在你的肛门里直到最后，想把裤子提上去都难。
                    ]你亲了那头又大又蠢的公牛鼻子一口，尽力一蹦一蹦地朝门口去。
                    
                    这一番折腾之后，伊莎多拉站得不太稳，得有两个男人架着她的肩膀才不至于摇晃。她对此又嘶声抱怨又嘟囔，但你猜她心里其实是乐意有人扶的。等你走到营房外门时，她已经能自己走了……可这也招来临走前最后一场恶作剧。你和伊莎多拉并肩走出大门时，站岗的两个男人各自在你俩屁股上结结实实地拍了一记，把你拍得往前一扑，屁股上的肉颤了好一阵。

rows.raw:
"
                    You lose track of how many times you're used. The same men take their turns in you twice, sometimes thrice, before you're laid out on the waterside like a hollowed-out sleeve, leaking from every orifice. [party.has cait
                        |Cait and Isadora are
                        |Isadora is
                    ] sprawled out beside you, breathing hard and slathered so white you can barely see the [party.has cait
                        |girls
                        |caramel
                    ] underneath. 
                    
                    "This better've been good for morale," Izzy groans. 
                    
                    The way her comrades are grinning at you... and the way their balls are all so empty their sacks seem shriveled... you've got no doubt about that. 
                    
                    A couple of troopers hoist you up and dunk buckets of still-clean water over your heads — talk about foresight to set that aside beforehand. Now that they're satisfied, the boys are more gentle with you, scrubbing the muck out of your hair and then drying you off with towels, though there's still the more than occasional grope, stroke, and kiss during the whole process. When they're done, the men help you [party.has cait
                        |three
                        |both
                    ] redress... though [party.has brint
                        |Brint can't keep himself from bending you over and going for one last round before your bottom's back on, to the cheers of the soldiers all around him.
                        |it's hard to get your bottoms back on with a pair of fingers pushed up your asshole right till the end.
                    ] You give that big dumb bull a kiss on the snout and bounce yourself towards the door as best you can.
                    
                    Isadora's a little less sure on her feet after the ordeal, and a couple of men have to put an arm around her shoulders to keep her steady. She hisses and fusses about it, but you imagine she's happy for the help under all that. By the time you're at the barracks' outer gates, she's able to walk under her own power again... but that just invites one parting bit of mischief. As you and Isadora walk side by side out the gate, the two men standing guard each deliver a hearty slap on your asses, sending you pitching forward with a hell of a lot of bounce in your backside. 
                    
                    A chorus of laughter, and invitations back, follow you onto the road and back towards Calise's apartment."

rows.original: You lean against the wall of Calise's apartment and give Isadora a [pc.mf |[pc.isFemboy |cute little |charming ] |cute little ] smile. "Think you could afford to take some time off with me?" "Time off?" Isadora glances at the window. "Well, Lady Calise does keep telling me to relax. So as long as we don't go too far..." She takes her duty seriously, doesn't she? You suppose that's part of what's gotten you interested in her in the first place — though you're not sure she's picked up that you even are yet. "You're the local," you say. "Why don't you pick a place?" Isadora takes her helmet off and scratches at her messy red hair. "I don't really spend much time in the city," she admits. "I'm a village girl through and through." "Well, is there something you've always wanted to see in the city?" She ponders that a moment, before her eyes suddenly go wide. "The colosseum![var0 | I know you're some kinda big fighting champion there now, but I've still never been myself! | I know it's probably old news to you, but I've never been! | ] I heard a crier shouting a couple days ago that they were gonna fill the whole thing up with water today, and sail two of the navy's triremes in to do battle! That sounds amazing..." That is just up the road, so you reckon that counts for not being too far. You offer Isadora your hand. "Then let's go see it!" Her eyes light up. "You mean it?" Rather than taking your hand, Isadora laughs jubilantly and grabs you into a hug. "Hell yeah! This is gonna be awesome." You get a playful shoulder punch off her and then she's jogging down the street. Grinning, you [party.som |follow after her |bid [comp1.name] goodbye and run after her |bid your companions goodbye and run after her ].
rows.translation: 你靠在卡莉丝公寓的墙上，朝伊莎多拉露出[pc.mf |[pc.isFemboy |可爱的小小 |迷人的 ] |可爱的小小 ]笑容。“你能抽点时间陪我吗？” “休息？”伊莎多拉瞥向窗户。“嗯，卡莉丝女士确实一直叫我放松一下。所以，只要我们别走得太远……” 她确实很认真地看待自己的职责，不是吗？你想，这也是最初吸引你注意她的原因之一——不过，你甚至不确定她有没有察觉到你的心意。“你是本地人，”你说道。“何不挑个地方？” 伊莎多拉摘下头盔，挠了挠凌乱的红发。“我其实没多少时间待在城里，”她坦言。“我是个彻头彻尾的乡下姑娘。” “那么，城里有没有什么你一直想看的东西？” 她思考片刻，双眼忽然睁大。“竞技场！[var0 | 我知道你现在已经成了那里的大战斗冠军什么的，但我自己还从没去过！ | 我知道这对你来说大概已经不新鲜了，但我还从没去过！ | ]几天前，我听见一名传令员高喊，说他们今天要把整个竞技场灌满水，让海军的两艘三列桨战船驶进去交战！听起来太棒了……” 那里就在路上不远处，应该符合不能走得太远的要求。你向伊莎多拉伸出手。“那我们就去看看吧！” 她双眼一亮。“你当真？” 伊莎多拉没有握住你的手，而是欣喜地笑着，一把抱住了你。“太好了！这一定会棒极了。” 她顽皮地捶了捶你的肩膀，随即沿街慢跑起来。你咧嘴一笑，[party.som |跟在她身后 |向[comp1.name]道别后追了上去 |向同伴们道别后追了上去 ]。

rows.original:
It's a straight shot north through the city's side streets from Calise's neighborhood to the colosseum. While the main street's been packed shoulder to shoulder since the day you arrived in the kingdom, Isadora proves a deft hand at finding less-traveled paths through alleys and backways. 

        "I thought I should plan some escape routes!" she says by way of explanation, ducking under a low-hanging laundry line. "In case more assassins came at us someday."
        
        "Did it have to be through an apartment block?" A couple of waist-high child-bulls rush past you, one trying to hit the other with his horns, while their mother shouts at them from a window overhead. 
        
        Isadora laughs. "Most of the city's apartments!" She hops over a small fence between blocks rather than going five paces out of her way to the gate. You [pc.pregStage 2
            |take the long way
            |follow suit
        ], ending up in a more narrow alley than before, with none of the usual windows looking over it. "Though there's a little shrine to Lumia up ahead. Something for local moms to go pray at without going all the way to the Pantheon."
        
        That sounds nice.
        
        At least, until you hear a shrill shriek of terror from up ahead.
rows.translation:
从卡莉丝所在的街区出发，穿过城市的小巷，就能直接向北到达竞技场。虽然自从你来到这个王国以来，主干道上的行人一直密密麻麻、挤得水泄不通，但伊莎多拉却总能巧妙地找到那些人迹罕至的小路和背街。 

        我想我应该准备一些逃生路线才行！”她边说边从一根低垂的晾衣绳下钻了过去，“以防将来还有刺客来找我们麻烦。”
        
        “非得通过公寓楼才能逃生吗？几个齐腰高的小公牛从你身边冲过去，其中一个试图用角去顶另一个，而它们的母亲则从头顶的窗户里大声喊叫着。
        
        伊莎多拉笑了起来：“这座城市里的大多数公寓都是这样的！”她跳过几栋楼之间的小栅栏，而没有绕道去走五步远的门那里。你[pc.pregStage 2
            |绕道而行
            |纷纷效仿
        ]最终，他们进入了一条比之前更狭窄的小巷，周围再也没有那些常见的窗户了。“不过前面有座供奉卢米娅的小神龛，当地妈妈们不用特意去七神，也可以在这里祈祷。”
        
        那听起来还挺不错的。
        
        至少，在你听到前方传来一声尖锐的惊恐尖叫之前，你是这么想的。

rows.original:
Isadora doesn't stop to think when she hears that scream; her body reacts on pure instinct, dashing down the pavement. She draws the gladius from her belt and disappears around a corner, leaving you [pc.pregStage 3
                |waddling
                |running
            ] after her. 
            
            Wedged between the windowless back of an apartment and the steps up to a marble shrine is a dead-end alley. You can see the backs of a pair of salamanders dressed in scraps of black cloth and ragged leather, menacing [flags.RANNA_EMP
                |Ranna — that bunnygirl alchemist from the shop down the street.
                |a bunnygirl who's so heavily pregnant she can barely walk.
            ] A bag of carrots and celery is scattered at the girl's feet, and one of the scaly blackguards is hurriedly gathering it while the other holds their mark at bladepoint. 
            
            You've got a split second before they see you and Isadora coming to spoil their day.
rows.translation:
听到那声尖叫，伊莎多拉没有丝毫犹豫，她的身体完全是出于本能而行动的，她立刻冲下了人行道。她从腰带上拔出短剑，然后消失在转角处，留下了你[pc.pregStage 3
                |摇摇摆摆地行走
                |运行中
            ]在她身后。
            
            在一片没有窗户的公寓背面与通往大理石神龛的台阶之间，有一条死胡同。你可以看到有两个人影，他们穿着破旧的黑色布料和粗糙的皮革，看起来十分吓人。 [flags.RANNA_EMP
                |兰娜——就是街对角那家商店里工作的那位兔女郎炼金师。
                |一只怀孕到了几乎无法行走程度的兔女郎。
            ]一袋胡萝卜和芹菜散落在女孩的脚边，其中一个长满鳞片的恶棍正匆忙地把它们捡起来，而另一个则用刀尖指着他们的目标，紧盯着他们不放。
            
            在他们发现你和伊莎多拉前来破坏他们的计划之前，你只有短短一秒钟的时间。

"Let her go!" Isadora shouts, dropping into a fighting stance between the thugs and their only way out. "Now."

                "Shit!" one of the salamanders spits. A woman under her mask, sounds like. She pushes her dagger under the bunny's throat. "Get out of our way! We don't want to hurt anybody."
                
                Isadora plants her feet. "Then act like it."
                
                The other salamander draws a short blade from a scabbard beneath his cloak. You move to intercept him, but it proves to be a feint: the woman behind him takes the chance to shove [flags.RANNA_EMP|Ranna|the pregnant bunny] straight at Isadora, forcing the soldier to drop her guard and catch her — and giving the pair of thieves a chance to jump on you!

放开她！”伊莎多拉喊道，立刻摆出战斗姿势，挡在了那些暴徒与他们唯一的出路之间。“现在就放开她。”

                    “放开她！”伊莎多拉挡住暴徒唯一的退路，摆出战斗姿势并大声喝道。“立刻。”
                    
                    “该死！”其中一名蝾螈啐道。从声音判断，面具下是名女子。她把匕首抵到兔女郎的喉咙下。“滚开！我们不想伤害任何人。”
                    
                    伊莎多拉站稳脚跟。“那就拿出不想伤人的样子来。”
                    
                    你将这当作出手的信号，在其中一名盗贼拔刀攻击伊莎多拉之前扑向他——但他发现了你，迅速踢中你的腿，让你踉跄不稳；另一名盗贼则将[flags.RANNA_EMP|兰娜|那名怀孕的兔女郎]推到一旁，试图冲向伊莎多拉。
                    
                    该死！
                ]

rows.original: Slip through the shadows and try to take these two by surprise. You'd better be clever or dexterous to take advantage of such a tactic!
rows.translation: 悄悄潜入阴影中，试图出其不意地抓住这两个人。要想利用这种战术，你最好既聪明又灵活！
rows.raw: "Slip through the shadows and try to take these two by surprise. You'd better be clever or dexterous to take advantage of such a tactic!"

rows.original:
You crumple against the side of the alleyway, groaning in pain and confusion. How the hell did this happen to you of all people, just fighting a pair of thieves?
    
    The dagger-wielding thug gives you a resounding kick to the ribs, putting you out of the fight for good while her companion finishes gathering the groceries off the ground. They make a break for it without another word, dashing out of the alley and back into the sprawl of the city's residential district where they can fade away in the crowd.
    
    "Oh, no, are you two okay?" [flags.RANNA_EMP
        |Ranna
        |the bunny-mom
    ] gasps, waddling over to where you and Isadora have fallen. "That was so brave of you..." 
    
    You just groan.
    
    Isadora manages to push herself up to a kneel and grab her sword. "Those bastards. I can't believe they... they!" 
    
    [flags.RANNA_EMP
        |Ranna
        |The bunny
    ] puts a hand on her shoulder to keep her from an ill-conceived attempt to chase the thieves, at least until you regain your feet. Isadora grunts, but doesn't do anything even stupider until she's caught her breath. "Are you okay, miss?"
    
    "Thanks to you two," she says. "I'm a little rattled, though! Who knows what they'd have done."
    
    "I think they just wanted your food," you say. "Things being what they are these days."
    
    Isadora frowns. "That doesn't make it right!"
    
    "Still," the taeleer sighs, "thank you for trying. If it's not asking too much, could I ask the two of you to walk me the rest of the way home. I'm sure it's nothing, but just in case those two come back..." 
    
    "Sure!" Isadora says. "You work at the apothecary's right? Maybe you could patch us up after?"
    
    "I think that's a fair trade."
    
    You glance northward. [pc.isDK
        |So much for the colosseum, but you can tell Isadora's not going to be talked out of this waste of time.
        |This is a lot more important than watching a show at the colosseum.
    ] You give Isadora a shoulder-pat and let her take point.
rows.translation:
你瘫倒在巷子的墙边，痛苦而又困惑地呻吟着。这种事怎么会偏偏落到你头上？你不过是在跟两个盗贼打了一架而已？
    
    那个持匕首的歹徒朝你的肋骨狠狠踢了一脚，让你彻底退出了战斗；她的同伙则把地上的杂货一一捡完。两人二话不说拔腿就跑，冲出小巷，重新消失在城里住宅区那片杂乱的街区中。
    
    “哦，不，你们两个没事吧？”[flags.RANNA_EMP
        |兰娜
        |兔子妈妈
    ]喘着气，摇摇摆摆地走到你和伊莎多拉倒下的地方。“你们真是太勇敢了……” 
    
    你只是呻吟了一声。
    
    伊莎多拉勉强撑起身跪在地上，抓起她的剑。“那些混蛋。我简直不敢相信他们……他们！” 
    
    [flags.RANNA_EMP
        |兰娜
        |那只兔子
    ]把手搭在她的肩上，阻止她一时冲动去追那些盗贼，至少等你重新站起来再说。伊莎多拉哼了一声，但在喘匀气之前没再做更蠢的事。“你没事吧，小姐？”
    
    “多亏了你们两个，”她说，“不过我还是有点心慌！谁知道他们会干出什么事来。”
    
    “我看他们只是想要你的食物，”你说，“毕竟现在世道就是这样。”
    
    伊莎多拉皱起眉头。“那也不能算对！”
    
    “不过，”泰勒族叹了口气，“还是谢谢你出手相助。如果不太冒昧的话，能不能请你们俩陪我走完剩下的回家路？我确定没什么事，只是以防那两个家伙又回来……” 
    
    “当然！”伊莎多拉说，“你在药店工作对吧？也许之后可以帮我们处理一下伤口？”
    
    “我觉得这买卖挺公平。”
    
    你朝北边瞥了一眼。[pc.isDK
        |竞技场的事就先算了，但你看得出来，伊莎多拉是不会被劝住、放弃这趟白费力气的。
        |这可比在竞技场看表演重要多了。
    ]你轻拍伊莎多拉的肩膀，让她来带头。

rows.original: The thieves are both on their asses by the time you're done with them, groaning and cross-eyed from the punishment they've taken. Isadora puts her sword under one of their chins. "Yield!" The two salamanders groan and drop their blades. You grab their wrists and tie them up while Isadora takes a knee and starts helping [flags.RANNA_EMP|Ranna|the bunny-mom] with her dropped bag. She gives you a thankful smile. "You two really saved me. Thank you!" "[pc.isDK |Thank Isadora," you say, nodding towards your companion. |Our pleasure! ] Are you alright?" She nods, cradling her stomach. "Though I'm a little rattled." "We weren't gonna hurt you!" the thief-boy insists. "We're just hungry." Isadora scowls at them. "That doesn't make stealing okay! From a pregnant woman of all people!" That makes them both wince. [flags.RANNA_EMP|Ranna|The bunny-woman] leans over them, sighs, shakes her head. "Poor kids. I'm sorry, but I'm barely scraping by too." She looks at you and Isadora. "I'm sorry to be a bother, but could the two of you walk me the rest of the way home? I can't stop shaking." "Of course!" Isadora says. The girl really doesn't hesitate, does she? "Let's get you home." You glance northward. [pc.isDK |So much for the colosseum, but you can tell Isadora's not going to be talked out of this waste of time. |This is a lot more important than watching a show at the colosseum. ] You give Isadora a shoulder-pat and let her take point. The thieves can wriggle out of their bonds on their own time, if the guards don't pick them up first.
rows.translation: 等你收拾完他们的时候，两个盗贼都已经瘫坐在地上，因为挨了这顿打而呻吟着、眼神都散了。 伊莎多拉把剑架在其中一个人的下巴底下。“投降吧！” 那两个火蜥蜴人呻吟着丢下刀剑。你抓住他们的手腕把他们绑起来，伊莎多拉则单膝跪下，开始帮[flags.RANNA_EMP|兰娜|兔子妈妈]捡起她掉在地上的包。她朝你们露出感激的微笑。“你们真的救了我，谢谢你们！” [pc.isDK |“谢谢伊莎多拉，”你说着朝同伴点了点头。 |“乐意效劳！” ]“你没事吧？” 她点点头，双手护着肚子。“不过我还是有点心慌。” “我们又没打算伤你！”那个少年盗贼坚持道，“我们只是饿了。” 伊莎多拉瞪了他们一眼。“那也不能成为偷东西的理由！而且还是对一个孕妇下手！” 这话让两人都缩了缩。 [flags.RANNA_EMP|兰娜|兔女郎]俯身看着他们，叹了口气，摇了摇头。“可怜的孩子们。抱歉，可我自己也只是勉强糊口。”她看看你和伊莎多拉。“很抱歉给你们添麻烦，但你们两位能陪我走完剩下的回家路吗？我抖得停不下来。” “当然！”伊莎多拉说。这姑娘真是一点都不犹豫，对吧？“我们送你回家。” 你朝北边瞥了一眼。[pc.isDK |竞技场的事就先算了，但你看得出来，伊莎多拉是不会被劝住、放弃这趟白费力气的。 |这可比在竞技场看表演重要多了。 ]你轻拍伊莎多拉的肩膀，让她来带头。那些盗贼尽可以自己找时间挣脱绳子，只要守卫没先抓住他们。

rows.original: [flags.RANNA_EMP |Ranna |The bunny-woman, who introduces herself as Ranna the Alchemist, ] lives on the other side of the main street, and the trip back is only a few minutes.[var0 | [pc.isDK |Isadora offers to carry her bag, |You offer to carry her bag for her, ] which speeds your party up somewhat — though ] Ranna's so heavily pregnant that you still have to moderate your pace to let her keep up. Ranna unlocks the door and ushers you both in when you arrive at her shop, and locks the door again when you're inside. She puts her back to it with a relieved sigh. "I'm sorry to be a bother, really. I don't know what's come over this city, honestly. It used to be so safe and peaceful." "I know," Isadora says, starting to unload the grocery bag for her. "Lady Calise and [pc.name] here are working to fix that!" "We're doing our best," you say. "But we can't solve hunger all on our own.[pc.milkVol 5000 | Though I'm trying!" You heft your milk-laden jugs, to laughter from both women. |" ] Rana gives you both a weary smile. "Well, at least let me make you something to eat for your trouble. [var0 |I'd have lost the whole lot without your help. It's the least I can do. |It will be a little plain without the produce, but it's not like I'm about to starve without it. ]" You wave her off. "[pc.isDK |Keep it |No, thank you ], we were on our way to the colosseum. Isadora wanted to go see the big ship battle." "Yeah!" Any melancholy about the state of her home is immediately forgotten at the prospect. "It's supposed to be the most amazing thing in the kingdom! They flood the whole place and-" "It was spectacular," Ranna says. Her smile droops lopsided. "Yesterday." You watch Isadora's little heart break[silly | in real time ]. "Wha- but he said it'd be on the 16th!" "[pc.isBimbo |Ummm... wasn't that yesterday? |It's the 17th, Izzy. ]" You put a hand on Isadora's shoulder. "Aw sh— shoot!" Ranna gives her an apologetic look. "Well, at least you won't be late on my account." That, at least, makes Isadora laugh. "I guess that means we are staying for dinner." Ranna's ears and cotton-ball tail wiggle excitedly while she heads to the kitchen, leaving you and Isadora alone in the shopfront. Your companion takes her helmet off and slumps against the counter. "Shit. Man. I wanted to see that so bad!" "So much for a first date," you laugh. "At least [pc.isDK |we didn't buy the tickets already. |we helped Ranna. ]" "Yeah, I— wait, date?" Isadora's eyes go wide. A dark flush creeps onto the young soldier's cheeks. "Oh. Oh! Oh, shit." You knew it was coming and it still makes you laugh. You just muss her hair and grin. It takes Isadora a few seconds to recover, before she finally manages to say, "I think [var0 |punching up a couple of scoundrels is a pretty fine first date! |trying to help a pregnant lady's a pretty good first date! Even if I got some bruises out of it. ]" She flashes you a toothy grin. "Way better than watching some ships pretend to thump each other." "Glad to hear it," you say, a little relieved. "Maybe we can catch the show on the second date." "Yeah! I'd like that."
rows.translation: [flags.RANNA_EMP |兰娜 |这位自称“炼金术士兰娜”的兔女郎， ]他住在主街的另一边，回家只需要几分钟的路程。[var0 | [pc.isDK |伊莎多拉主动提出帮她拿包。 |你主动提出帮她拿包。 ]这样确实能让你的团队行动得更快一些——不过…… ]兰娜怀孕已经到了晚期，因此你们走路时还是得放慢速度，好让她能跟上。 当你们来到她的店铺时，兰娜打开了门，将你们俩迎了进去，等你们进去后，她又把门关上了。她松了一口气，说道：“真的很抱歉打扰你们。说实话，我不知道这座城市到底发生了什么变化，以前这里可是安全又宁静的。” “我明白的，”伊莎多拉一边说，一边开始帮她把买来的食品袋卸下来。“卡莉丝女士也是[pc.name]我们正在努力解决这个问题！” “我们已经在尽最大努力了，”你说道，“但仅靠我们自己是无法消除饥饿问题的。[pc.milkVol 5000 | 虽然我在努力啊！”你拎着那些装满牛奶的罐子，引得两位女士都笑了起来。 |" ] 拉娜疲惫地笑了笑，说道：“好吧，至少让我为你们准备些食物，作为对你们辛苦付出的补偿吧。 [var0 |如果没有你的帮助，我就会失去这一切。这是我至少应该做的。 |如果没有这些食材，这道菜就会显得有点单调了，不过我也并不会因此而挨饿啊。 ]你挥手让她走开了。[pc.isDK |保留原样。 |不用了，谢谢。 ]我们当时正在前往竞技场的路上。伊莎多拉特别想去观看那场盛大的舰船大战。 “太棒了！”一想到这个，她对家里现状的忧愁立刻就被抛到九霄云外了。“据说那是整个王国里最精彩的表演了！他们会把整个场地都布置得灯火通明，然后……” “真的吗？是太令人难过了，”兰娜说道，她的笑容有些扭曲。“就在昨天。” 你看着伊莎多拉那小小的心碎了[silly | 实时地 ]什……但他说过是在16号啊！[pc.isBimbo |嗯……那不是昨天发生的事吗？ |今天是17号，伊兹。 ]你把手放在伊莎多拉的肩上。 “哎呀，糟了！” 兰娜露出歉意的表情：“至少不会因为我的缘故而迟到吧。” 至少这个说法让伊莎多拉笑了起来。“这么说来，我们应该是留下来吃晚饭吧。” 兰娜兴奋地摇动着耳朵和棉球尾巴假发，朝着厨房走去，留下你和伊莎多拉独自在店铺里。你的同伴摘下头盔，靠在柜台上说道：“靠，我真太想看到那一幕了！” “第一次约会就这样吧，”你笑着说，“至少[pc.isDK |我们还没有购买门票。 |我们帮助了兰娜。 ]啊，我……等等，约会？”伊莎多拉的眼睛瞪得大大的。 那位年轻士兵的脸上渐渐浮现出一抹红晕。“哦。哦！天啊。” 你早就知道会这样，但还是忍不住笑了起来。你只是轻轻揉了揉她的头发，然后咧嘴笑了。 伊莎多拉过了几秒钟才回过神来，终于开口说道：“我想[var0 |揍几个混蛋出来，简直就是一次非常不错的初次约会！ |试图帮助一位孕妇度过一个非常美好的初次约会！即使因此让我自己有些淤青也没关系。 ]她向你露出了灿烂的笑容，‘这样可比看那些飞船假装互相碰撞有趣多了。’” “听到你这么说，我放心多了，”你说道，“也许下次约会的时候我们就能看这场‘表演’了。” “太好了！我也很希望如此。

rows.original: [pc.dcbc |So, what's a gal like her doing in a dump like this? |So, what's a lady like her doing in Khor'minos? |You like, totally didn't expect to see [flags.AMBRA_MET |another |a ] kitty in a cow town! What's a cutie like her doing here? |You can't help your curiosity; what's a catfolk like her doing in Khor'minos during the quarantine? ] "Pffft. Right to it, huh? Well, I won't beat around the bush, either. To cut a long story short, I dropped by to visit my brother; he's been living here for some time, and I wanted to catch up with him. 'Course, it would be just my luck to get stuck here when things started going south, and now I can't leave." When things went south? What does she mean? "[pc.isBimbo |Not literally south, hon." Katya replies, squinting at your visible confusion. " |Well, ]I would have figured the whole 'mandatory lockdown' thing would have spelled it out for you. It's dangerous out there, and until things settle down, I'm pretty much stuck sitting on my ass, running up a tab on my brother's credit, and trying not to slip into a coma from boredom." [var0 |Katya pauses, thinking for a moment. "'Course, that's what I was doing, anyhow. I guess now I'm just waiting around to see if there's any[var1 |more | ] news about my brother. | ] You see...
rows.translation: [pc.dcbc |像她这样的姑娘，怎么会待在这种破地方？ |像她这样的女士，怎么会来到科尔米诺斯？ |你完全没想到会在牛城里见到[flags.AMBRA_MET |另一只 |一只 ]猫咪！像她这么可爱的姑娘来这里做什么？ |你实在按捺不住好奇：在封锁期间，像她这样的猫族为什么会待在科尔米诺斯？ ] “噗。直接进入正题，是吧？好吧，我也不拐弯抹角。长话短说，我顺道来探望哥哥；他在这里住了一段时间，我想来和他叙叙旧。当然，事情开始恶化时我偏偏被困在这里，现在想走也走不了——这还真符合我的运气。” 事情开始恶化？她是什么意思？ “[pc.isBimbo |亲爱的，我不是说真的往南边走。”卡蒂亚眯起眼睛，看着你脸上明显的困惑说道。“ |嗯， ]我还以为‘强制封锁’这几个字已经足够说明问题了。外面很危险，在事态平息之前，我基本只能坐在这里无所事事，把账记到哥哥头上，同时努力不让自己无聊到昏迷。” [var0 |卡蒂亚停下来思索片刻。“当然，不管怎样，那都是我之前在做的事。现在我大概只是在等，看看有没有[var1 |更多 | ]关于哥哥的消息。” | ] 原来如此……

rows.original: "Me? Well, there's not much to it. I'm about twenty-seven, I grew up in the sticks a little west of Sartanni, I hunt and fish for a living, my parents kicked the bucket a few years back, and [katya.questCompleted|I'm all on my own.|my only family's my little brother.] All in all, I'm [silly |just another brick in the wall |nobody special ]." [pc.dcb |Damn, she's right. That is boring. |Hey, there's no shame in humble origins. After all, [pc.bg noblescion |plenty of peasants have risen to greatness! |you started your journey as a bit of a nobody yourself. ] |D'awww, she shouldn't be so sad! She's got a lot going for her, like, you tooootally love her hair! ] Katya lets out a dry chuckle at that. "[pc.dcb |Right back at ya, dork |Maybe so, but I'm pretty fine where I am. When heavy is the head that wears the crown, maybe mediocrity isn't so bad |Thanks, I keep it short so it's out of the way. Easier to care for, too ]. As I was saying, though, I'm really nothing special. My little brother's the smart one[katya.questCompleted |... Or I guess, was." Katya sighs, taking a slow sip of her drink before continuing. |; my parents shipped him out to Tychris[silly | for being such a friggin' nerd | ] when we were younger, and I guess now he works as a consultant for some mining operation out here. S'why I'm in town; I wanted to catch up with him. Siblings ought to watch out for each other, y'know?" [party.has cait |Maybe it's a good thing Cait's off doing her own thing; that might have hurt to hear... ] ] "Aside from that, not a whole lot else to me. Really all I've done aside from hunting and fishing in recent years was beating up some fat minotaur who tried grabbing me a few years back. I think his name was something like Harold? Wonder what he's up to nowadays." [var0 |Ha! You think you know who she's talking about; Hirrud Grune! |Who's to say? There could be plenty of people matching that description, after all. ] "Anyhow, was there anything else you'd wanted?"
rows.translation: 我吗？其实没什么特别的。我大概二十七岁，在萨塔尼西边的一些偏远地区长大的，以打猎和捕鱼为生。我的父母几年前去世了，然后[katya.questCompleted|我完全是孤身一人。|我唯一的家人就是我的弟弟。]总的来说，我[silly |只是墙上的又一块砖而已 |普通人而已 ]。" [pc.dcb |该死，她说得对。真是这样。是无聊。 |嘿，出身平凡并没有什么可羞愧的。毕竟， [pc.bg noblescion |许多农民最终走上了成功的道路！ |你也是从一无所有开始自己的这段旅程的。 ] |哎呀，她不该这么难过的！她有很多优点啊，你懂的完全地太喜欢她的发型了！ ] 卡蒂亚听到这话，干笑了一声。[pc.dcb |回敬你呢，笨蛋。 |也许吧，但我现在的生活状态也挺不错的。当那些肩负重担的人才是真正拥有权力时，或许平庸其实也没那么糟糕。 |谢谢，我把它写得简短些，这样就不会碍事了。这样也更容易照顾它。 ]不过，正如我所说，我其实并没有什么特别的之处。我弟弟才才是那个聪明的人。[katya.questCompleted |……或者，应该说是曾经吧。”卡蒂亚叹了口气，慢慢喝了一口饮料，然后继续说道。 |我的父母把他送到了提克里斯。[silly | 就因为你是个该死的书呆子…… | ]我们年轻的时候，他现在应该是在这里某个矿业公司担任顾问吧。所以我才来到这个小镇，想见见他。兄弟姐妹之间就应该互相关照，你懂的吧？ [party.has cait |也许凯特去做自己想做的事情反而是件好事；如果她听到了那些话，可能会受到伤害…… ] ] 除此之外，我也没什么别的事情可做了。这几年，除了打猎和钓鱼之外，我真正做的就是把几年前试图抓我的那个胖弥诺陶洛斯揍得屁滚尿流。我记得他的名字好像叫哈罗德吧？不知道他现在在干什么。 [var0 |哈！你以为自己知道她在说谁吧；希鲁德·格鲁恩！ |谁又能说得准呢？毕竟，符合那种描述的人可能有很多吧。 ] 无论如何，还有其他你想要的东西吗？

rows.translation: 你决定直接问出这个问题，于是询问卡蒂亚是否愿意再找一个伴侣来共同享受这段时光。当你提出这个请求时，她的耳朵微微一动，但她的表情似乎表明她对此感兴趣。 “嗯，当然可以。你指的是谁呢？ [katya.nipped |虽然这会很有趣，但我还是想确认他们是否愿意承受一些粗暴的对待呢！ |我得向他们说明一下我的要求，你懂的吧？ ]我可不要那种在我要求他们掐死我的时候就会退缩的人。” 你不确定她是否真的对此充满热情，但你可以直接问她。你找了个借口，把凯特拉到一边，然后询问她是否愿意和第三个人一起在卧室里做一些亲密的事情。她思考了一会儿，然后耸了耸肩，给出了回答。 “当然，我想我不会有意见。你指的是谁呢？” 你把她带回到酒吧的座位旁，然后将那两个猫族介绍给了彼此。凯特，这是卡蒂亚；卡蒂亚，这是凯特。卡蒂亚露出了温柔的微笑，与凯特握了手，凯特也同样回应了她。你让两人互相介绍了一会儿，然后卡蒂亚突然从凳子上站了起来，一边伸伸腰。 好吧，那就这么办吧。你们应该知道我的房间在哪里，”卡蒂亚懒洋洋地摇着尾巴，朝着楼梯走去。 [pc.isDK |天啊，她说话实在太直白了，真让人受不了。 |一如既往地直截了当…… ] 凯特随后也跟了上来，示意你先带路。你走在前面，带着卡蒂亚上了楼梯，朝着她的房间走去，凯特则跟在你身后。进入卡蒂亚的房间后，凯特随手关上了门，几乎没等什么就点击在开始脱衣服之前，先锁好门。卡蒂亚已经开始了同样的动作，而当你还在忙于整理自己的装备时，这两只轻型溜溜的“小猫”就已经开始互相打量起来。真是典型的猫科动物的敏捷表现啊…… 当他们俩站得这么近的时候，你就会不由得想起高大的卡蒂亚就是。 [cait.isLeothran |尽管凯特的身高有所增加，但她仍然比她高出一两英寸。 |卡蒂亚的身高比那个体型较小的猫女高出大约半头，因此她在身高上具有明显的优势。 ]她脸上明显带着得意的笑容，低头看着凯特。然而，从身材比例来看，凯特才是真正的赢家。 [cait.thiccStageRange 0 1 3 |尽管两者的构造有些相似，但凯特的胸部确实比卡蒂亚的要更胜一筹。 |凯特的整体质感明显更加柔软舒适，她拥有更多的素材可以用来进行创作和设计。 |与身材高挑、动作敏捷的卡蒂亚相比，凯特那圆润的身材无疑更具吸引力；她的曲线更加丰满、动人。 ] a[katya.nipped |当你看到她的眼睛在注视着凯特那诱人的身姿时亮了起来，但其中却隐约流露出一丝嫉妒的情绪。 | 当卡蒂亚意识到这一点时，她的眼中似乎闪过了一丝嫉妒的光芒。 ] [pc.isDK |看到她那恼怒的样子，你不禁暗自偷笑起来，她平时那满不在乎的态度在这一刻似乎被打破了。 |也许她对此有点不太自在吧？ ]无论如何，那两个猫族突然停止了对视，然后期待地转向你。 “那么， [pc.name]……”凯特兴奋地摇着尾巴说道，“你有什么打算吗？”卡蒂亚也接上了话，她的尾巴则懒洋洋地卷了起来。

rows.original:
"My brother, huh? Well, it's been about five or so years since I last saw him. When we were kids, he was always looking at rocks; turns out he had some serious brains in that noggin of his. Around when he hit sixteen, our parents decided that it would be a crime to put that to waste; they saved up, sent him out to Tychris to get educated."
    
    [pc.corruptionRange 0 50
        |And how did that turn out?
        |A nerd, huh? [pc.isBimbo
            |Bo-ooo-ring.
            |What a dork.
        ]
    ]
    
    "He ended up moving out this way a few years ago. Turns out miners will pay good money to know what places will net them the most ore. Who'da thought that? He sent me a letter about a month or so back about securing some pretty lucrative contract with a new organization; I figured I should congratulate him."
    
    Katya takes a slow sip of her drink before continuing. "By the time I got here, it turns out he'd already shipped out on a surveying trip. I figured it was fine; I'd rent a room for a bit, wait for him to get back, then give him a noogie or something for old time's sake. So I waited... and then the lockdown came. I figured it was fine; he shouldn't have a problem getting back here. Days went on, but there was still no sign of him. I asked around, about that company he signed up with, and nobody's heard hide nor hair of anyone from there for weeks." Katya's smirk has vanished, replaced by a mix of fear and concern, her ears flat against her head. [katya.questCompleted
        |"And, well, we know how things turned out."
        
        That's quite unfortunate, yes. There's always a chance he could still be out there, though.
        |"I just hope he's alright."
        
        [pc.isDK
            |Pfft. You're sure he's fine. Some dorky surveyor's hardly someone you'd think of as being at risk; he's probably just holed up somewhere.
            |You hope so too. A company of miners should be more than capable of defending themselves against threats, though. 
        ]
    ]
    
    Katya's distress lightens a bit at that. "Yeah, [katya.questCompleted
        |I guess you're right. If you ever happen across him, please let me know. Remember, he looks a lot like me– tall, blonde, green eyes. He's a good fighter, probably would end up talking your ear off about rocks."
        |you're probably right. Say, you mentioned you came here through the caves, right? Is there any chance you saw him? He looks a lot like me; tall, blonde, green eyes. Uses a bow, probably wouldn't shut up about rocks. He's a decent fighter, so he's probably doing fine out there, anyways."
    ]
    
    [var0
        |Uh-oh.
        |
    ]
    
    "Sorry for rambling, hah. Just kinda had to get all that off my chest, y'know?"
rows.translation:
“我哥哥？嗯，我上次见到他大概是五年前了。我们小时候，他总喜欢研究石头；事实证明，他那颗脑袋里装着相当厉害的才智。大概在他十六岁时，父母认定浪费这份天赋简直是种罪过；他们攒下钱，送他去提克里斯接受教育。”
    
    [pc.corruptionRange 0 50
        |后来怎么样了？
        |是个书呆子？[pc.isBimbo
            |无——聊——死了。
            |真是个呆瓜。
        ]
    ]
    
    “几年前，他最后搬到了这一带。原来，矿工们很愿意花大价钱，请人告诉他们哪里能挖出最多矿石。谁能想到呢？大约一个月前，他给我寄了封信，说自己和一个新组织签下了相当赚钱的合同；我想着应该来祝贺他。”
    
    卡蒂亚缓缓啜饮一口，随后继续说道。“等我来到这里时，才知道他已经启程去勘探了。我觉得这没什么；租间房住一阵子，等他回来，再像小时候一样敲敲他的脑袋。所以我等着……然后封城了。我当时觉得也没什么；他回来应该不成问题。日子一天天过去，却始终不见他的踪影。我四处打听他签约的那家公司，可几个星期来，谁都没有听到那里任何人的半点消息。”卡蒂亚脸上的坏笑已经消失，取而代之的是恐惧与担忧；她的双耳紧贴着脑袋。[katya.questCompleted
        |“然后嘛，我们都知道后来发生了什么。”
        
        的确很不幸。不过，他始终有可能仍在外面。
        |“我只希望他平安无事。”
        
        [pc.isDK
            |切。你确信他没事。一个书呆子勘探员怎么会是容易遇险的人；他大概只是躲在某处而已。
            |你也希望如此。不过，一群矿工应该完全有能力保护自己、抵御威胁。
        ]
    ]
    
    听到这些，卡蒂亚的痛苦稍稍缓解了。“嗯，[katya.questCompleted
        |我想你说得对。要是你碰巧遇见他，请一定告诉我。记住，他长得很像我——身材高挑、金发、绿眼。他很能打，多半还会拉着你不停谈论石头。
        |你大概说得对。对了，你提过自己是从洞穴来到这里的，对吧？你有没有可能见过他？他长得很像我；身材高挑、金发、绿眼。用弓，大概会不停谈论石头。他是个不错的战士，所以应该在外面过得挺好。
    ]
    
    [var0
        |糟糕。
        |
    ]
    
    “抱歉，我说个没完，哈。只是得把这些话一吐为快，你懂吧？”

rows.original: [katya.closure |The moment the topic is broached, Katya freezes. Only for a split second — the only outward sign is the bristling of her cat-like tail — there's a hint of pure contempt in her demeanor, before her shoulders slacken, and she slumps in her seat, voice tense with a defensive edge. "What about my family, [pc.name]. Because I don't have one anymore." ...Right. That's probably still a sore su— "A 'sore subject' doesn't really do that justice, you know," Katya interjects, a note of a quiver in her voice. "I figured you'd understand at least that much. I told you already; I'm not going to say I hate you, or even that you made the wrong choice. As far as the city's concerned, you're a gods-damned hero. Don't tell me you saw something — I've been hoping he'd turn up since the siege wound down. Don't deny it, 'cuz I see that look, too. Something's definitely on your mind. rows.translation: 当你坐在卡蒂亚旁边时， [flags.AUREN_KILLED |你的胃里有一种强烈的负罪感，而卡蒂亚与某个恶魔的相似之处丝毫没有减轻这种感觉。你竭力抑制这种令人不适的感觉，但卡蒂亚——作为一名猎手，她的感官异常敏锐——注意到了你脸上那淡淡的苍白，于是关切地转过身来看着你。[pc.name]…你没事吧，伙计？你看起来像见了鬼一样。别这么沮丧，你可是英雄啊！你拯救了整座城市，现在不该感到难过才对。那个是吧？” “其实……问题并不在于这个。她是……你其实不太知道该怎么问这个问题，所以干脆直说吧——她哥哥叫什么名字？” 听到你的问题，卡蒂亚的眼睛微微眯了起来，眉毛也不由自主地挑了起来。“……这个问题有点奇怪，但好吧，如果你觉得这能帮助你进行你的‘侦探工作’的话，我就告诉你吧。我哥哥的名字叫奥伦。他长得和我很像，只是个子比我矮一些。 [katya.gymRat |状态稍差一些 |稍微瘦一些 ]他使用弓箭的技术相当不错，而且总是对石头的话题喋喋不休；我知道那部分内容我已经告诉过你了，那你为什么还要问呢？” 在你还能想出任何回答之前，卡蒂亚的眼睛突然睁得大大的，脸上露出一种充满希望却又令人心疼的表情，接着她说：“你还没有任何线索，对吧？别告诉我你看到了什么——自从围城战结束之后，我就一直希望他能出现。别否认，我也能看出你心里在想什么。你到底在想什么？ |那个身材纤细的猫女转过身来面对你，她平时那种顽皮的笑容此刻已被一种干涩的微笑所取代。 “那么，有只小鸟告诉我，你找到了我那个一无是处的傻弟弟。 [pc.isDK |你会遇到很多一无是处的蠢货；但如果他和她有亲属关系，那么标准肯定要更高才行。真的低。她是怎么想出这个办法的？ |哦？她是怎么得到这个消息的？ ]卡蒂亚[pc.isDK |总会先从侧面推你一下。 |自豪地咧嘴一笑 ]她靠在凳子上，尽力表现出若无其事的样子：“我有我的办法。 [silly |而我所说的“方法”，就是把“寻找Twink”这样的海报贴满整个镇上的每一根电线杆，直到 |但说真的， ]不久前，有个军团士兵来找我，应该是你派他来的吧，他把事情的来龙去脉都告诉了我。我真的欠你一个人情，而且是个大人情。 [var0 |[pc.isDK |她确实欠你一个人情。尤其是那个小混蛋还试图杀了你。 |这是你最起码应该做的。即使那个小混蛋试图杀了你，逮捕他也是正确的选择。 ] |你该庆幸自己坚持了自己的怀疑，对吧，奥伦？确实毕竟，这一切看起来都显得如此熟悉。即使那个小混蛋试图害你，但最终似乎一切还是得到了好的结果。 ] ]

rows.original: As you harden your resolve, the hesitation on your face is evident; Katya's hopeful grin sinks a little as she notices, and the catfolk presses the issue in an appropriately feline manner. "...It's not bad news, is it? If it is, just t—" Her needling is cut short as, unable to stop yourself, you blurt out the truth: her brother is dead. And you were the one who did it. The words leave your mouth carrying the weight of the world off your shoulders; you practically sigh at no longer holding it back — just in time to see them hit Katya exactly as hard. The huntress sits there, utterly speechless for a solid five seconds, before her eyes abruptly sharpen, and her face twists into an expression of contempt. Katya's voice, normally husky, drops dangerously low, becoming little more than a throaty growl as a fist closes around one of the daggers in her brace; staring you down with cruel indignance in those forest-green eyes, she practically hisses out her reply. "You've got about thirty seconds to explain exactly what the fuck you just said, [pc.name]." And explain it you do. While it takes more than thirty seconds — Katya mercifully doesn't make good on her threat — you recount the circumstances behind the outburst. Detailing coming across Auren, now a demon, as well as your battle... and the unfortunate choice you had to make in the aftermath. By the time you've finished, Katya has gone from glaring at you, to burying her head in her hands atop the bar. It's a sad sight, to be certain; instinct is telling you to comfort the poor girl, but knowing Katya, that's not the best idea. Eventually, Katya lifts her head off the bar, and you wince at the sight of tears still wetting her cheeks. Her usual cool demeanor is little more than tattered scraps, yet Katya still clings to them for security; even as her voice quivers, she tries her best to remain composed through reddened eyes. "I... I think I understand, [pc.name]. I just... I think I need a little space right now." [pc.isDK |Even you won't begrudge her that. Still, if she w— |If it's any consolation, you w— ] "Don't! J-just... don't talk to me for a bit. I... Give me a while." With that, Katya stands up from the stool, shaky legs carrying her up the stairs and out of sight, presumably to her room. You do your best to shrink away from the stares of the bar's patrons, before writing the effort off entirely and [party.som |hopping off the stool |slinking back to [party.compNames] |slinking back to your companions ], away from prying eyes, and hoping you haven't ruined your relationship with Katya.
rows.translation: 当你坚定决心时，脸上的迟疑显而易见；卡蒂亚注意到后，满怀希望的笑容稍稍黯淡，这名猫族女子以恰如其分的猫科方式继续逼问。 “……不会是坏消息吧？如果是，就直——” 她的追问戛然而止；你再也无法忍耐，脱口说出真相：她的哥哥死了，而动手的人正是你。话语从口中涌出，卸下了压在肩上的千钧重担；你几乎因终于不必继续隐瞒而叹息——恰好及时看见这些话以同样沉重的力道击中了卡蒂亚。 女猎人呆坐在那里，足足五秒一个字也说不出来；随后，她的目光骤然锐利，面容扭曲成轻蔑的表情。卡蒂亚本来沙哑的嗓音危险地压低，几乎只剩下喉间的低吼；一只拳头紧握住束带上的一把匕首，她以那双森林般碧绿的眼睛带着残酷的愤慨盯住你，近乎嘶嘶吐出回答。 “你大约还有三十秒，来解释清楚你刚才究竟他妈的说了什么，[pc.name]。” 你确实作出了解释。虽然花费的时间不只三十秒——万幸，卡蒂亚没有兑现威胁——你把自己失言背后的情形一一道来。你详细描述如何遇见已经化为恶魔的奥伦、你们之间的战斗……以及事后不得不作出的不幸选择。等你说完，卡蒂亚已经从怒视你变成趴在吧台上、将头埋进双手。毫无疑问，这景象令人心痛；本能催促你安慰这个可怜的姑娘，但以你对卡蒂亚的了解，那并非最佳选择。 最终，卡蒂亚从吧台上抬起头；看见泪水仍在润湿她的脸颊，你不由得皱眉。她平日冷静的仪态只剩支离破碎的残片，卡蒂亚却仍紧紧抓着它们寻求安全感；即使声音颤抖，她仍竭力透过泛红的双眼维持镇定。 “我……我想我明白，[pc.name]。我只是……我觉得现在需要独处一下。” [pc.isDK |即使是你也不会因此责怪她。不过，如果她愿—— |如果这能算些安慰，你愿—— ] “别说！只、只是……暂时别和我说话。我……给我一点时间。” 说罢，卡蒂亚从凳子上站起，双腿颤抖着将她带上楼梯，消失在视野中；她大概回了自己的房间。你尽力躲避酒吧顾客们的注视，最后干脆彻底放弃，转而[party.som |跳下凳子 |悄悄回到[party.compNames]身边 |悄悄回到同伴们身边 ]，避开窥探的目光，只希望自己没有毁掉与卡蒂亚之间的关系。

rows.original: Despite some inkling of recollection nagging at your hindbrain... no, surely it was someone else. Someone who... had the same name. And looked the same. Just an unfortunate coincidence, yes; waving a hand, you tell Katya that it's nothing — you were simply curious. Katya's perplexed expression is evidence she doesn't quite believe your denial; her eyes narrow, and her mouth is a thin, slit-like line as she studies your pokerface for any sign of weakness — but she finds none. With a heavy sigh, the huntress sinks back on her stool, frowning softly. "Hmph. Whatever, then. Don't get my hopes up like that, [pc.name]. If you hear anything, please just let me know, alright?" With that, Katya returns to her drink, and you hold in a sigh of relief. Just an unlucky coincidence, surely...
rows.translation: 尽管你的脑海中隐约浮现出一些记忆的片段……不，肯定不是那个人。那个人……有着相同的名字，外貌也一模一样。只不过是个不幸的巧合罢了。你挥了挥手，告诉卡蒂亚没什么，你只是出于好奇而已。 卡蒂亚那困惑的表情清楚地表明，她并不相信你的解释。相当她试图相信你的否认；她的双眼眯了起来，嘴唇紧闭成一条细长的线，仔细观察你的表情，试图找出任何软弱的迹象——但什么也没有发现。随着一声重型的叹息，这位女猎人重新坐回凳子上，轻轻地皱起了眉头。 “哼，好吧。总之，别让我抱有那样的期望吧。 [pc.name]如果你听到了什么，请一定要告诉我，好吗？” 说完，卡蒂亚又继续喝她的饮料了，而你则松了一口气。肯定只是个不幸的巧合罢了……

rows.original: Try as you might, there's no way you can deny the connection to your own mind. Auren, the demonic geomancer, was Katya's brother... and you ended him. He might have been a demon, but Katya asked that you keep an eye out for him — and now, you're staring her right in the eyes, the same shade of green as her brother's. It's enough to make your stomach churn, but you harden your resolve and — lying through your teeth — tell Katya that the name doesn't ring any bells. Predictably, she doesn't buy it for a second. Eyes narrowed to razor-thin slits, Katya leans forward on the bar, her forest-green stare piercing into your very core. A hand closes around the front of your [pc.armor], pulling you close with deceptive strength, her withering gaze scrutinizing you for any crack in your defenses — and she finds them. "You're hiding something. I can tell. Spill it, [pc.name], 'cuz I don't like being lied to." [party.has cait |Before you can muster a hasty denial, Cait, noticing the conflict, approaches the two of you, face colored by concern. Before you can tell her otherwise, your Mallachite companion puts her hands on Katya's wrists, easing her off of you. "Hey, hey. Easy, Katya. [pc.name], what's going on? Why're the two of you fi—" Before you can respond, Katya interjects, interrupting Cait with an accusatory finger pointed straight at you. "[pc.mf |He |She ]'s hiding something about my brother. I know it. Did you guys see him, or—" Katya's face sinks midsentence as, seeing Cait's expression, realization dawns. Her voice drops an octave, and there's an uncharacteristic edge of fear in it as she continues. "W-what do the two of you know? What were you trying not to tell me?" Cait takes the lead on the difficult matter, placing a hand on Katya's shoulder as she tells the huntress exactly what you were trying to avoid. There's no accusatory tone to it — at least not from Cait — as she details the encounter with Katya's demonified brother, the fight, and... what you had to do afterwards. At that point, Katya roughly shoves Cait away, clearly uninterested in any attempt at comfort. Staring you down with fury in her eyes, Katya's voice drops low as she jabs a finger against your [pc.chest]. "You... you tried lying about that? Y-you think I wouldn't at least try to understand?" [pc.isDK |No, you really don't. You were doing her a favor, trying to— |You were just trying to— ] "Trying to what, [pc.name]?! Weasel out of telling me you killed my little brother? 'Cuz that's... that's the only fucking way I can see this." "Katya, it's not—" Cait interjects, attempting to calm the ranting huntress down. "That isn't what they—" "Oh, I'm real fucking sure it's not, huh? Everything's just a 'big misunderstanding,' isn't it?" Katya carries on, doing a mocking impression of Cait. "Oh, [pc.name] just did what they had to, honest!' Gimme a gods-damned break. At least you had the guts to tell me." You're not able to find a reply to that, avoiding Katya's glare as she stands up, taking a few steps toward the stairway before facing you once more. "Just... give me some fucking space for a bit. I don't wanna see either of your faces for a while." With that, Katya stomps off, leaving you alone under the stares of the bar's patrons — and Cait's unhappy glare. |[pc.willpowerRange 0 60 |Try as you might, you just can't muster the will to lie to her face. With a heavy sigh, you relent under her needling, steadying yourself in your chair as Katya releases you. You're unable to meet her eyes as you recount the story of your encounter with Auren — coming across the demonified catfolk, battling him... and the difficult choice in the aftermath. Over the course of the tale, Katya's expression shifts from suspicion, to shock, to outright contempt; her fists balled, and eyes narrowed with rage as she glares a hole straight through you. "You... you [pc.mf |bastard |bitch ]. You said you'd keep an eye out for him. You even followed the lead I had. And then you fucking killed him, then tried lying about it?!" Katya's voice rises higher than you've ever heard it, vindictive rage twisting her husky tone into a shrill caterwaul. "And you're supposed to be some kind of hero?!" [pc.isDK |Look, you did what you had to do. And at that point, he may as w— |He was a demon! There was no other way t— ] Your reply is cut short as, not waiting to hear your defense, Katya swings a mug at you, clipping your cheek and putting stars in your vision. It's a struggle to keep yourself steady upon the barstool, and by the time you've recovered, you notice Katya stomping away from you, toward the stairs. Cupping your bruised cheek, you meet her eyes, noticing the fresh tears welling in them as she shouts at you. "Don't fucking say a thing. You've done enough. Gimme some fucking space for a while if you really care, Champion." She practically spits that last word out, vitriol and grief staining her voice in equal measure; you're left to wallow in it — not to mention the stares of the bar patrons — as she finishes stomping off, presumably to her room. |As harrowing as it is to be placed in the hot seat like this, you keep your cool; composing yourself, you tell Katya that no, you're not hiding anything. You just thought the name sounded familiar for a moment, nothing more; honest. Katya's scrutinous glare doesn't relent for what feels like hours, roving over your expression for the slightest breach; but through sheer willpower, you remain ice-cold. With a disappointed scoff, the wiry catfolk releases your [pc.armor], slumping back on her stool with a sigh. "Fine, then. Sorry for getting in your face, I just... I'm really worried. The siege is over, but there's still no sign of him. My parents made me promise I'd look out for him, and I..." Katya trails off, fiddling with the bell hanging from her neck. "I really dunno what I'd do if it's just me now." Biting back the screams of your conscience, you try your best to reassure Katya; you'll be sure to tell her anything that comes to your attention, alright? "Th-thanks, [pc.name]. I appreciate it." ] ]
rows.translation: 无论你如何努力，都无法否认自己与这些事情之间的联系。奥伦，那个恶魔地脉师，其实是卡蒂亚的哥哥……而你亲手终结了他。他或许是个恶魔，但卡蒂亚曾请求你照顾他——而现在，你正直视着她的双眼，那双眼睛拥有和她哥哥一样的绿色。这番话足以让你感到胃里翻江倒海，但你还是强忍住情绪，硬着头皮告诉卡蒂亚，这个名字你完全不熟悉。 不出所料，她根本不相信你的话。卡蒂亚的眼睛眯成了一条细缝，身体前倾靠在吧台上，她那森林般的绿色目光仿佛能穿透你的内心。有一只手伸到了你的面前。 [pc.armor]她以看似温柔的力量将你拉近，那双枯萎的目光会仔细审视你，寻找你防御中的任何漏洞——而她总会找到的。 “你在隐瞒什么。我看得出来。快说出来吧[pc.name]，因为我不喜欢被人欺骗。 [party.has cait |还没等你来得及慌忙否认，凯特注意到了你们之间的矛盾，便忧心忡忡地走了过来。还没等你开口解释，你的那位马拉克信徒同伴就已经握住了卡蒂亚的手腕，将她从你身边拉开。 “嘿，嘿，别这样，卡蒂亚。 [pc.name]，发生了什么？你们两个为什么……” 在你来得及回应之前，卡蒂亚插话了，她用手指直指着你，责备地打断了凯特的话。[pc.mf |他 |她 ]她一定在隐瞒关于我哥哥的什么事情。我知道你们见到他了吗？还是……”卡蒂亚的话说到一半突然停住了，看到凯特的表情后，她突然明白了什么。她的声音低了八度，继续说道时，语气中带着一丝不寻常的恐惧，“你们俩到底知道些什么？你们之前是在故意隐瞒什么吗？” 面对这个棘手的问题，凯特主动站了出来，她把手放在卡蒂亚的肩上，然后开始向这位女猎人解释。正是如此这就是你试图避免的事情。凯特在描述与卡蒂亚那个被妖魔化的哥哥的遭遇、那场打斗，以及之后你不得不做的事情时，并没有丝毫指责的肌肉度——至少凯特没有。然而在那一刻，卡蒂亚粗暴地将凯特推到一边，显然她对任何安慰都毫无兴趣。卡蒂亚怒视着你，声音低沉下来，用手指指着你[pc.chest]你……你竟然尝试了撒谎关于那个？你…你以为我至少不会考虑一下吗？尝试一下吧。才能理解吗？ [pc.isDK |不，你真的没有。你其实是在帮她的忙。偏爱，正在尝试—— |你只是想尝试而已…… ] 正在尝试什么， [pc.name]？！就想躲躲躲，不肯告诉我是你杀了我的弟弟？因为在我看来，这就是唯一的解释。” “卡蒂亚，其实不是这样的……”凯特插话道，试图让这个愤怒的女子冷静下来。“他们并不是这个意思……” “哦，我才不信呢真实的绝对不是这样，对吧？一切只不过是‘一场巨大的误会’而已，不是吗？”卡蒂亚模仿着凯特的语气说道，“哦[pc.name]只是做了自己该做的事，真的！拜托，饶了我吧。至少你还有勇气告诉我……” 你找不到任何回应，只能避开卡蒂亚那愤怒的目光，她站起身来，走向楼梯，然后再次转向你。 “就……给我一点空间吧。暂时我不想看到你们任何一个人的脸。” 说完，卡蒂亚气呼呼地走了，留下你独自面对酒吧里其他顾客的目光——以及凯特那不满的眼神。 |[pc.willpowerRange 0 60 |无论你如何努力，就是无法鼓起勇气当面对她撒谎。你重重地叹了口气，在她的追问下终于屈服了。当卡蒂亚放开你时，你稳稳地坐在椅子上，却无法与她对视，只能开始讲述你与奥伦相遇的经过——如何偶然遇到那些被妖魔化的猫人族，如何与他们战斗……以及事后那个艰难的选择。在整个讲述过程中，卡蒂亚的表情不断变化，从怀疑到震惊，最终变成了蔑视她的双拳紧握，双眼因愤怒而眯成一条缝，狠狠地瞪着你。 “你……你[pc.mf |混蛋 |贱人 ]你说过会照看他，甚至还按照我给出的指示行事。可后来你他妈的被击杀然后尝试去联系他。撒谎到底怎么回事？！”卡蒂亚的声音高得你从未听过的那样尖锐，充满复仇的愤怒使她那低沉的嗓音变成了刺耳的尖叫。“而你竟然还自称是什么英雄？！" [pc.isDK |听着，你已经做了你该做的。在那种情况下，他其实也可以…… |他简直就是个恶魔！根本没有其他解释…… ] 你的回答还没说完，卡蒂亚根本没等你解释，就挥着杯子朝你砸过来，杯子击中了你的脸颊，让你眼前一阵发黑。你费了很大劲才在吧台上稳住身体，等恢复过来时，你已经看到卡蒂亚正朝楼梯走去。你捂着受伤的脸颊，与她对视着，看到她的眼中正涌出新的泪水，而她还在对你大喊： “别他妈的说一个字。你就是个混蛋！足够了如果你真在乎我的话，就他妈的给我点空间吧。冠军她几乎是咬牙切齿地说出了最后一个字，声音里既有怨恨也有悲伤；当你还在沉浸在这种情绪中时，酒吧里的其他顾客纷纷投来了注视的目光——更不用说她跺着脚走开后，大概是要回自己的房间去了。 |尽管被置于这样的困境中令人倍感煎熬，你依然保持了冷静；你镇定自若地告诉卡蒂亚，你并没有隐瞒什么，只是有那么一瞬间觉得那个名字听起来很熟悉，仅此而已，绝对没有欺骗她。 卡蒂亚那充满怀疑的目光似乎持续了整整几个小时，她仔细地观察着你的表情，试图找出任何破绽；但凭借着强大的意志力，你依然表现得冷若冰霜。最终，那个身材瘦削的猫族女子失望地嗤笑了一声，然后放开了你。 [pc.armor]她叹了口气，重重地坐回凳子上。 “好吧，那就算了。抱歉打扰你了，我只是……真的很担心。围城已经结束了，但他仍然没有任何踪迹。我的父母让我一定要照顾他，而我…………”卡蒂亚低声说道，同时摆弄着挂在脖子上的铃铛，“如果现在只有我一个人在面对这一切，我真的不知道该怎么办。” 你强压下内心中的不安，尽力安慰卡蒂亚；你一定会把她注意到的任何事情都告诉她的，好吗？ 谢谢[pc.name]我很感激。 ] ]
rows.raw: " Try as you might, there's no way you can deny the connection to your own mind. Auren, the demonic geomancer, was Katya's brother... and you ended him. He might have been a demon, but Katya asked that you keep an eye out for him — and now, you're staring her right in the eyes, the same shade of green as her brother's. It's enough to make your stomach churn, but you harden your resolve and — lying through your teeth — tell Katya that the name doesn't ring any bells. Predictably, she doesn't buy it for a second. Eyes narrowed to razor-thin slits, Katya leans forward on the bar, her forest-green stare piercing into your very core. A hand closes around the front of your [pc.armor], pulling you close with deceptive strength, her withering gaze scrutinizing you for any crack in your defenses — and she finds them. "You're hiding something. I can tell. Spill it, [pc.name], 'cuz I don't like being lied to." [party.has cait |Before you can muster a hasty denial, Cait, noticing the conflict, approaches the two of you, face colored by concern. Before you can tell her otherwise, your Mallachite companion puts her hands on Katya's wrists, easing her off of you. "Hey, hey. Easy, Katya. [pc.name], what's going on? Why're the two of you fi—" Before you can respond, Katya interjects, interrupting Cait with an accusatory finger pointed straight at you. "[pc.mf |He |She ]'s hiding something about my brother. I know it. Did you guys see him, or—" Katya's face sinks midsentence as, seeing Cait's expression, realization dawns. Her voice drops an octave, and there's an uncharacteristic edge of fear in it as she continues. "W-what do the two of you know? What were you trying not to tell me?" Cait takes the lead on the difficult matter, placing a hand on Katya's shoulder as she tells the huntress exactly what you were trying to avoid. There's no accusatory tone to it — at least not from Cait — as she details the encounter with Katya's demonified brother, the fight, and... what you had to do afterwards. At that point, Katya roughly shoves Cait away, clearly uninterested in any attempt at comfort. Staring you down with fury in her eyes, Katya's voice drops low as she jabs a finger against your [pc.chest]. "You... you tried lying about that? Y-you think I wouldn't at least try to understand?" [pc.isDK |No, you really don't. You were doing her a favor, trying to— |You were just trying to— ] "Trying to what, [pc.name]?! Weasel out of telling me you killed my little brother? 'Cuz that's... that's the only fucking way I can see this." "Katya, it's not—" Cait interjects, attempting to calm the ranting huntress down. "That isn't what they—" "Oh, I'm real fucking sure it's not, huh? Everything's just a 'big misunderstanding,' isn't it?" Katya carries on, doing a mocking impression of Cait. "Oh, [pc.name] just did what they had to, honest!' Gimme a gods-damned break. At least you had the guts to tell me." You're not able to find a reply to that, avoiding Katya's glare as she stands up, taking a few steps toward the stairway before facing you once more. "Just... give me some fucking space for a bit. I don't wanna see either of your faces for a while." With that, Katya stomps off, leaving you alone under the stares of the bar's patrons — and Cait's unhappy glare. |[pc.willpowerRange 0 60 |Try as you might, you just can't muster the will to lie to her face. With a heavy sigh, you relent under her needling, steadying yourself in your chair as Katya releases you. You're unable to meet her eyes as you recount the story of your encounter with Auren — coming across the demonified catfolk, battling him... and the difficult choice in the aftermath. Over the course of the tale, Katya's expression shifts from suspicion, to shock, to outright contempt; her fists balled, and eyes narrowed with rage as she glares a hole straight through you. "You... you [pc.mf |bastard |bitch ]. You said you'd keep an eye out for him. You even followed the lead I had. And then you fucking killed him, then tried lying about it?!" Katya's voice rises higher than you've ever heard it, vindictive rage twisting her husky tone into a shrill caterwaul. "And you're supposed to be some kind of hero?!" [pc.isDK |Look, you did what you had to do. And at that point, he may as w— |He was a demon! There was no other way t— ] Your reply is cut short as, not waiting to hear your defense, Katya swings a mug at you, clipping your cheek and putting stars in your vision. It's a struggle to keep yourself steady upon the barstool, and by the time you've recovered, you notice Katya stomping away from you, toward the stairs. Cupping your bruised cheek, you meet her eyes, noticing the fresh tears welling in them as she shouts at you. "Don't fucking say a thing. You've done enough. Gimme some fucking space for a while if you really care, Champion." She practically spits that last word out, vitriol and grief staining her voice in equal measure; you're left to wallow in it — not to mention the stares of the bar patrons — as she finishes stomping off, presumably to her room. |As harrowing as it is to be placed in the hot seat like this, you keep your cool; composing yourself, you tell Katya that no, you're not hiding anything. You just thought the name sounded familiar for a moment, nothing more; honest. Katya's scrutinous glare doesn't relent for what feels like hours, roving over your expression for the slightest breach; but through sheer willpower, you remain ice-cold. With a disappointed scoff, the wiry catfolk releases your [pc.armor], slumping back on her stool with a sigh. "Fine, then. Sorry for getting in your face, I just... I'm really worried. The siege is over, but there's still no sign of him. My parents made me promise I'd look out for him, and I..." Katya trails off, fiddling with the bell hanging from her neck. "I really dunno what I'd do if it's just me now." Biting back the screams of your conscience, you try your best to reassure Katya; you'll be sure to tell her anything that comes to your attention, alright? "Th-thanks, [pc.name]. I appreciate it." ] ] "

rows.original: You're mildly curious as to the origin story of three beautiful elves lying against the marefolk.
rows.translation: 你对那三个躺在马人族女性身边的美丽精灵的起源故事感到些许好奇。
rows.raw: "You're mildly curious as to the origin story of three beautiful elves lying against the marefolk."

rows.original: The two sisters have pale skin but their features are quite different. Rose has long red hair and deep green eyes, while Lily has shorter white hair and light blue eyes. You can see the resemblance in their faces, but only just.
rows.translation: 这两姐妹的皮肤都很白皙，但五官特征却大不相同。萝丝留着一头长长的红发，眼睛是深绿色；莉莉的头发较短，是白色的，眼睛则是浅蓝色。你能在她们的脸上看出相似之处，但也仅此而已。
rows.raw: "The two sisters have pale skin but their features are quite different. Rose has long red hair and deep green eyes, while Lily has shorter white hair and light blue eyes. You can see the resemblance in their faces, but only just."

rows.original: Everna has tanned-brown skin and a larger, bustier body than Lily and Rose. It looks like she might have come from afar.
rows.translation: 埃弗娜的皮肤是棕褐色的，身材也比莉莉和萝丝更丰满。看样子，她可能是从很远的地方来的。
rows.raw: "Everna has tanned-brown skin and a larger, bustier body than Lily and Rose. It looks like she might have come from afar."

rows.original: Seems like there's a harem situation going on here. You could ask about the dynamics a little... if you're interested.
rows.translation: 看来这里发生了一些类似后宫般的状况。如果你感兴趣的话，可以试着了解一下其中的一些复杂关系……
rows.raw: "Seems like there's a harem situation going on here. You could ask about the dynamics a little... if you're interested."

rows.original: Whether intentional or not, these elven women are making a hell of a sales pitch for being one of Klemaia’s lovers. Is it possible she’d accept another?
rows.translation: 不管是有意还是无意，这些精灵女性都在拼命推销成为克莱玛娅情人之一的好处。她有可能再接受一个吗？
rows.raw: "Whether intentional or not, these elven women are making a hell of a sales pitch for being one of Klemaia’s lovers. Is it possible she’d accept another?"

rows.original: You're a part of them, now. This is your place to relax.
rows.translation: 你现在也是她们中的一员了。这里就是你放松身心的地方。
rows.raw: "You're a part of them, now. This is your place to relax."

rows.original: You've been wondering about getting your own symbol of devotion to your big, muscular she-stallion lover...
rows.translation: 你一直在琢磨，要不要也弄一个属于自己的奉献印记，献给你那位魁梧健壮的雌马恋人……
rows.raw: "You've been wondering about getting your own symbol of devotion to your big, muscular she-stallion lover..."

rows.original: You get the sense this isn't the kind of question you should pop lightheartedly. If you're going to devote yourself to her to this degree, you should have a lot of experience in pleasing her.
rows.translation: 你会觉得，这种问题并不适合随便提出来讨论。如果你真的打算如此全心全意地对待她，那么你肯定应该拥有很多让她开心的经验才行。
rows.raw: "You get the sense this isn't the kind of question you should pop lightheartedly. If you're going to devote yourself to her to this degree, you should have a lot of experience in pleasing her."

rows.original:
[flags.KLEMAIA_FUCKED
            |You give Klemaia a kiss. "I can't stay right now, but I'll see you all again soon."
            
            The big marefolk smiles. "See you, [pc.name]. Take care out there."

rows.original:
"How'd you end up in Khor'minos?" you say. "Do you and the girls live here?"
    
    "No, we were passing through when it became too unsafe to leave," Klemaia says, sighing. "Even before the quarantine, the caves were getting dangerous. I should have just taken them out the moment we caught wind of it, but..."
    
    She shrugs, and Rose leans in to kiss the marefolk on the cheek.
    
    "You didn't know," Everna says, patting Klemaia's arm.
    
    "None of us did," Lily assures her.
    
    Klemaia smiles, hugging the elven women a little closer. "Originally, we were planning to leave and maybe settle down in a small town. I thought about returning home but as much as I love my tribe, I don't want to be a big fish in a small pond. Somewhere neutral would be nice... a centaur village on the outskirts of civilization, maybe." She looks at Rose. "We were going to travel from village to village and see what suited us."
    
    "There are a lot of them scattered around Khor'minos," Rose agrees. "It makes sense. Ordinarily, you'd want to be close to the biggest city in the Marches. Of course, when they coop up in their hiding hole and don't come out... the surroundings begin to suffer."
    
    Lily addresses you. "In the past, the Minoans offered protection in exchange for taxes. A deal any sensible chief would take, and they're not unreasonable. The only usual threats were orcish raids, which the military would take care of. The villages were the first to notice the king's reticence. And that came a long time before the official order of quarantine."
    
    Klemaia nods. "The place I was born is a lot further out than the villages around here. We were mostly self-sufficient, trading with tribes in the same situation. That's how most marefolk live, after all."
    
    "I would still like to see it someday," Everna says, smiling up at the marefolk. "The village you were born."
    
    "Maybe we can visit it with all our children someday," Klemaia murmurs, caressing a lock of the woman's sun-kissed hair.
    
    The response prompts affection from the elves, Everna stretching back to put a smooch on her lover's cheek. Reclined between the marefolk's powerful-looking legs, she looks quite comfortable where she is.
rows.translation:
你是怎么来到科尔米诺斯的？”你问道，“你和那些女孩是住在这里吗？”
    
    “不，我们只是路过这里，结果发现离开那里已经太危险了，”克莱玛娅叹了口气说道，“甚至在实施隔离措施之前，那些洞穴就已经变得很危险了。其实我们一听说这种情况就应该立刻带她们离开的，但是……
    
    她耸了耸肩，罗斯便凑上前去，在那位马人女性的脸颊上吻了一下。
    
    “你当时并不知道，”埃弗娜轻拍着克莱玛伊亚的手臂说道。
    
    “我们所有人当时都不知道，”莉莉向她保证道。
    
    克莱玛伊亚微笑着，将那些精灵女性搂得更紧了一些。最初，我们打算离开这里，去某个小镇安顿下来。我也考虑过回家，但尽管我很爱我的部落，我也不想成为‘小池塘里的大鱼’——找一个中立的地方会比较好……也许是在文明边缘的一个半人马村落落庄吧。”她看着罗斯说道，“我们原本打算一个村庄一个村庄地走，看看哪个地方适合我们。
    
    它们分散在科尔米诺斯的许多地方，”罗斯同意道，“这也确实合情合理。通常情况下，人们会选择靠近边境地区最大的城市居住。不过，当它们躲在藏身处里不肯出来时……周围的环境就会开始受到影响。
    
    莉莉对你说：“在过去，米诺斯人会提供保护作为征税的交换条件。任何明智的领袖都会接受这样的交易，而且他们的要求也并不过分。当时最常见的威胁只是兽人的袭击，而军队会负责处理这些威胁。是那些村庄最先注意到国王的犹豫不决的，而这一切都发生在官方宣布隔离令之前很久。
    
    克莱玛娅点了点头：“我出生的地方距离这里的村庄要远得多。我们基本上是自给自足的，会与处境相似的其他部落进行交易。毕竟，大多数马人都是这样生活的。”
    
    “我还是希望有朝一日能去看看那里，”埃弗娜微笑着对这位马人说道，“你出生的那个村庄。
    
    也许有一天，我们可以带着所有的孩子一起去看看它，”克莱玛娅轻声说道，一边抚摸着那位女子被阳光染成金色的头发。
    
    这个回答引发了精灵们的喜爱，埃弗娜伸出手，在恋人的脸颊上轻吻了一下。她依偎在那些马人强壮的双腿之间，显得十分舒适。

rows.original: "So how'd the four of you meet?" you say. "Lily and Rose met her well before I did," Everna says. "I was passing through some remote woods," Klemaia recalls. "Very deep in the forest. I was exhausted and dirty after days of travel, so imagine how happy I was when I found a stream to cleanse myself in." "I can identify with that. That's why I'm here in the baths," you point out. "Ha! True," she says. "We stumbled across her while she was bathing," Lily says. "It was... quite the first impression." "She looked so wonderfully strong," Rose admits, blushing a little. "We were younger, and we'd never seen a woman like her before." She pokes Klemaia's bicep. "So big and tall." "I don't get the fascination myself, but hey," Klemaia says with a grin. "I can't complain about the attention of perishingly beautiful women." "We revealed ourselves to her there, and... well." Rose glances at Lily. "We spent a few weeks together with her in the outskirts of the forest." "We'd been aching for some adventure in our lives, and we found it," Lily says, smiling. "I don't think either of us expected it to come in such a well-put-together form, but life has a way of surprising you like that. So we followed her out of the forest, and ended up staying with her." "I was more surprised than you," Klemaia says, chuckling. "I'd just stripped off a minute before, thinking I would wash the dirt off my ragged body, when two beautiful women called out to me. I'd never seen anything like you, I thought you were princesses. Maybe you are." The elves giggle. "Swept along by the current, huh?" you say with a smile. "If we're measuring currents, Klemaia must be a raging river," Lily says. She glances at the marefolk's loincloth before meeting Everna's eyes, the corners of her mouth quirking upwards a bit. "There's a lot of her to take care of, and she has the appetite to match." Everna laughs softly. "That was how we met, too." "That night," Klemaia says, nodding. "Don't think I'll ever forget that night... we were close to Khor'minos." "Just a few days out, as I recall," Everna says. "Must have been fate you caught my attention, hmm?" She winks at Rose. "You and your healthy lungs." Rose blushes scarlet, casting her gaze down but unable to keep herself from smiling as the other three giggle at her.
rows.translation: 那么你们四个人是怎么认识的呢？”你问道。 “莉莉和罗斯比我早很多就认识她了，”埃弗娜说。 “我当时正在一些偏远的森林里穿行，”克莱玛娅回忆道，“森林深处。经过几天的旅途，我既疲惫又脏兮兮的，所以当我发现有一条小溪可以让我清洗身体时，你们可以想象我有多高兴。” “我完全能理解那种感觉。这就是我现在在这里泡澡的原因，”你说道。 “哈！确实如此，”她笑着说。 “我们是在她洗澡的时候偶然遇见她的，”莉莉说，“当时真是…… 相当第一印象确实很深刻。” “她看起来强壮得令人惊叹，”罗斯略带红晕地承认道，“那时我们还很年轻，从未见过像她这样的女性。她的大臂肌肉那么发达，身材也那么高挑。” “我自己也不太明白为什么人们会对她如此着迷，不过嘛，”克莱玛娅笑着说，“能得到如此美丽的女性的关注，我当然没有意见。 我们在那里向她坦白了身份，然后……嗯，”罗斯瞥了莉莉一眼，“我们和她一起在森林的边缘度过了几周时间。” “我们一直渴望生活中能有一些冒险经历，而这次我们终于找到了，”莉莉微笑着说，“我想我们谁也没预料到，这些冒险会以这样一种精心安排的形式出现，但生活就是会有这样的惊喜。于是我们跟着她走出了森林，最终决定和她一起生活下去。 我比你还要惊讶呢，”克莱玛娅笑着说，“就在刚才我刚脱掉衣服，准备清洗自己那身破旧的衣服时，有两个美丽的女子叫住了我。我从来没见过像你们这样的女子，还以为你们是公主呢……也许你们真的是公主吧。 精灵们咯咯地笑了起来。 “被这股潮流冲走了吧？”你微笑着说道。 “如果用‘潮流’来形容的话，那么克莱玛娅简直就是一条汹涌的河流了，”莉莉说道。她瞥了一眼那位马人女性的缠腰布，然后抬起头与埃弗娜对视，嘴角微微上扬：“她的身材确实很丰满，相应的食欲也是相当旺盛啊。 埃弗娜轻声笑了起来：“我们也是那样相识的。” “就在那个夜晚，”克莱玛娅点头说道，“我永远都不会忘记。那个那天晚上……我们当时已经很接近科尔米诺斯了。” “据我回忆，应该只差几天而已。”埃弗娜说道，“能引起我的注意，想必也是命运的安排吧？”她朝罗斯眨了眨眼，“多亏了你，还有你那健康的肺。” 罗斯的脸瞬间涨得通红，她低下头，但还是忍不住笑了起来，因为其他三个人都在看着她笑。

rows.original: "Are you two wyld elves?" you say, nodding at the sisterly duo. "Yes," Rose says. "We grew up in the forest Klemaia found us in, in a commune. Life was pleasant enough, I suppose, but very monotonous. Neither of us thought much of spending our entire lives in such a manner." Lily nods. "I didn't want to stay in the forest at all, really, putting the actual work of it aside. I suppose I was born with a touch of wanderlust." "I think that's part of what binds us all together," Everna says, leaning her head back against Klemaia. "None of us were content with where we were at the time we met." "I'm quite content these days," Lily says with a little grin. "I suppose life hasn't been very difficult the last six months or so, though." "We are in life-threatening danger," Everna reminds her. "According to the king, anyway..." Lily snorts. "Sure, according to the king. I've heard what the people here say about him... we're probably in more danger of his attention than we are of being invaded." Klemaia runs a hand through Lily's hair, soothing her. "Don't worry about such things, Lily." "It's true this is a relatively blessed lifestyle, though," Rose admits. "And we have Klemaia to thank for it." "You girls make it all worth it," the marefolk says, bending down to plant a gentle kiss on Rose's cheek. "Though I still feel a little bad about plucking you out of your home." "We chose to leave with you," Lily says. "Don't be silly. Our commune's probably still exactly how we left it... which was why we left in the first place." "As long as you're both happy," Klemaia says. "Very happy," Rose says. "I don't think there's a part of our journey I haven't enjoyed." "Me too," Lily says. "I'm very satisfied with my lot in life." "Well, good," Klemaia says. "Keeping you girls happy is my joy, after all."
rows.translation: “你们两个是荒野精灵吗？”你问道，同时朝那对姐妹点了点头。 “是的，”萝丝说道，“我们是在克莱玛娅发现我们的那片森林里、在一个公社中长大的。生活还算不错，不过非常单调。我们俩都不太想一辈子都那样过下去。” 莉莉点了点头。“其实我根本不想待在森林里，先不说实际干活的那部分。我想我天生就带着几分流浪的渴望。” “我觉得这也是把我们所有人联结在一起的部分原因，”埃弗娜说着，把头向后靠在克莱玛娅身上，“我们相遇时，没有一个人对当时的处境感到满意。” “这些天我挺满足的，”莉莉微微一笑说道，“不过，过去这六个月左右，生活确实不算太艰难。” “我们确实身陷危及性命的危险之中，”埃弗娜提醒她，“至少国王是这么说的……” 莉莉嗤之以鼻。“是啊，按国王的说法是这样。我听过这里的人是怎么说他的……比起被人入侵，我们恐怕更容易因为被他注意到而陷入危险。” 克莱玛娅伸手梳过莉莉的头发，安抚着她。“别为这些事担心，莉莉。” “不过，这确实是一种相对幸福的生活，”萝丝承认道，“而这都要感谢克莱玛娅。” “是你们这些女孩让这一切都值得，”那位马人族女性说着，弯下腰在萝丝的脸颊上轻轻印下一吻，“不过，把你们从家里带出来，我还是有点过意不去。” “我们当初是自愿跟你走的，”莉莉说，“别犯傻了。我们的公社大概还是我们离开时的样子……而这正是我们当初离开的原因。” “只要你们俩都开心就好，”克莱玛娅说。 “非常开心，”萝丝说，“我想在这段旅程中，没有哪一部分是我不喜欢的。” “我也是，”莉莉说，“我对自己的生活现状非常满意。” “那就好，”克莱玛娅说，“毕竟，让你们这些女孩开心就是我的快乐。”

rows.original: "How did this all come to be, anyway?" you ask Klemaia. "Where did you start out?" "Well... when I was still living in my village, I would act as a mercenary for traveling caravans," she says. "I came to be known as rather dependable. Apparently mercenaries and guards running away is a matter of course in the caravan business, so I got a lot of return customers just for not leaving them behind. It just didn't feel right when they'd paid me to protect them." "So you're a warrior," you say. She nods. "I'm handy with most weapons. I spent ten years doing that, figured I'd make a life of it. Then I met Rose and Lily while I was wandering." She shakes her head with a smile. "One thing led to another, and suddenly I had two elven lovers following me around." "That was when they found you in the stream," you say. "Mhm," Klemaia says. "That was fun." Lily giggles. "We spent a lot of time getting to grips with her." "Quite," Rose murmurs. "So now we're looking to settle down with the money I earned from bodyguarding, just not in Khor'minos," Klemaia says. "Though it has been hospitable so far." "The baths are to die for," Everna says. You're inclined to agree.

rows.raw: ' [var0 |You open your eyes, blinking the sleep away. There's an odd weight on your thighs... It's Klemaia, her head laid in your lap, lightly snoozing with her arm draped protectively over the bed. She's apparently taken it upon herself to keep you safe even here. You look up when you hear a rustle to see Gwyn passing by the door, her bushy tail wagging as she gives you a smile. It's just you and Klemaia in here, the birds chirping outside as sunlight filters in from outside. You run a hand through her hair, stroking her head until she slowly awakens, then snaps upward with a start. "Good morning," you say. "You're awake," Klemaia says, looking into your face with concern. "The lupine woman said you just needed to rest a while. Are you feeling okay? I can get you some food." "It can wait a little while," you say, drawing her in with your hands. "Come here." You give the marefolk woman a gentle kiss and she slowly relaxes in your arms while you pet her, nuzzling into your neck. "I'm glad you're alright," she murmurs. "Mhm," you say. "Me too. How are the kids?" "They're good, all healthy, thank Lumia," Klemaia sighs. "They're sleeping right now. Or they were, they seem to wake up every twenty minutes for attention." You smile. "Our children will get plenty of attention, don't you worry." You give her another kiss and settle back with the marefolk until Gwyn pops her head in the door a few minutes later. "You have visitors," she announces, walking into the room with three babies in her arms, "and they're hungry." "Oh, hello," you say, taking two of them into your arms as Klemaia gingerly takes the third. "Look at you. There you go." You look over at Klemaia while breastfeeding your daughters to see her staring down at the child, who unblinkingly stares back up at her. It only takes a few seconds for big tears to start welling up in your lover's eyes, spilling over to drip down her chin as she carefully strokes a finger against the baby's cheek. "You're okay," she whispers hoarsely. The baby smiles up at her, wiggling her chubby little fingers, and Klemaia chokes, lip quivering. Mild amusement wars with affection as you watch the muscled she-stallion reduced to a wobbling blob of tears by a creature so tiny it can comfortably fit in her hands. She waves her finger in front of the baby's face, smiling through the tears as your daughter giggles and tries to catch it. "Aren't you precious?" she says, letting the baby grab and cling to her finger. "Her hands are so little." You smile. Like a duck to water. "That's right. Pass her here and you can hold these two." You can hear her cooing to the kids as you put your third child to your breast, gently holding her head up so she can drink. rows.original: [var0 |Despite Klemaia's concerns you're up and about the day after, already feeling a lot better now that you're not weighed down by twenty kids. Alright, it was only [var1], but you could be forgiven for thinking otherwise. You were so knocked up it was a struggle to walk. "Damn," Klemaia sighs, looking back into the nursery. You're standing outside the door with her, clothes freshly washed and put on. "I feel terrible just leaving them." "You get used to it, sadly," you say. "Not that it gets easier. I prefer to think this is what I have to do to get the land back to normal so they can have somewhere to grow up in the first place." Klemaia nods, staying silent for a while. Then she looks at you and speaks. "I think when this is over... we're going to move to Hawkethorne," she says. "I'd like to be here for the children. And so would the [pc.mf |girls |other girls ], especially when they start having children of their own. This seems a lot like what we've been looking for in a community." You smile. "You'd be welcome here any time you came. It's a very nice place, if a little rustic after you've been to Khor'minos. You won't have the fancy baths, for one." "I think I could live without them pretty easily if it means I can see our children," she says. You [pc.mascFem |chuckle. "Fair point. |giggle. "Fair enough. ] There's plenty of room for housing to be built. I'm sure a cottage for a few women and their multitude of little marefolk wouldn't be amiss." Klemaia smiles, really smiles, and gives you a warm hug. "I think that'd be lovely." You and your party escort her back into Khor'minos without incident, stopping at the inn you've been using to rest. "You should get some sleep," Klemaia says, looking into your eyes. "I can hardly believe you made that trek a couple of days after giving birth." "Adventurers are hardy types," you say, smiling at her. "I'll come see you at the baths as soon as I can, okay?" "Okay," she murmurs, giving you a kiss and taking you in her arms. She's blessedly warm. "I'll carry your greetings to the [pc.mf |girls |other girls ]." "Let them know the children are nice and healthy, would you?" you say. "They'll be able to see them the moment we get them out of this place." "Mmm. rows.original:
"Ah, my love, look!" Livrea calls out as you approach. Since last you saw her, she's changed from her normal calf-length tunic to a longer, sheerer garment better suited to her changing body. Beneath it, you can see just how positively gravid she's become: her stomach has now grown past her breasts, so heavy with child that Livrea needs a little help from her friends to get to her hooves and give you a kiss. Her hand guides yours all over her stomach, letting your feel the visceral, undeniable truth of her pregnancy. She's damn near ready to pop. 
    
    "It won't be long now," she says, giving you that radiant smile of hers. "I can't wait to meet our new- oh!"
    
    She gasps, biting her lip. You feel it too: a little kick from inside, just beneath where your hand's resting. "Oh, Lumia. You felt it?" she murmurs, grinning wide. "This little one's been so actively lately. Wants to meet [pc.mf
        |daddy
        |the cooler mommy
    ] too, I think."
    
    You give her another kiss before kneeling down and pressing your face to her tum through the sheer gown, getting as close to your coming child as possible. You feel another little kick, right against your cheek. Gods, the little one's growing strong already! Livrea giggles, putting both hands around her stomach. "Our baby's making it hard to sleep, these days! So active, so eager to come into the world fighting! I have a feeling this one is going to take after you, love."
    
    Liv groans as she sits back on the stoop, resting her harp in her lap. "Ah, I love our baby so much already..."
rows.translation:
“啊，我的爱人，快看！”你走近时，莉维娅高声喊道。自从上次见面，她已经将平日里长至小腿的束腰衣换成一件更加修长、轻薄透视，也更适合变化中身体的衣裳。透过衣服，你能看到她的孕肚究竟已经多么巨大：她的腹部如今甚至突出在乳房之前；孩子沉重到莉维娅需要朋友稍加帮助，才能站起身亲吻你。她牵引你的手抚遍肚皮，让你感受到她怀孕这一事实真切而不容否认。她简直马上就要生了。
    
    “已经不远了，”她带着那灿烂的笑容说道。“我迫不及待想见到我们的新——哦！”
    
    她倒吸一口气，咬住嘴唇。你也感觉到了：腹中轻轻一踢，恰好就在你手掌停留处的下方。“哦，卢米娅。你感觉到了吗？”她咧嘴笑着低声说道。“这个小家伙最近一直很活跃。我想，孩子也想见到[pc.mf
        |爸爸
        |更酷的妈妈
    ]。”
    
    你再次吻了她，随后跪下，隔着轻薄的长袍将脸贴上她的肚子，尽可能靠近即将出生的孩子。你又感觉到轻轻一踢，恰好踢在脸颊上。诸神在上，小家伙已经长得很强壮了！莉维娅咯咯笑着，用双手环抱自己的肚子。“我们的宝宝最近弄得我很难入睡！这么活跃，这么迫不及待想要战斗着降生人世！我有种感觉，这孩子会很像你，亲爱的。”
    
    莉芙呻吟着坐回门阶，将竖琴放在腿上。“啊，我已经这么爱我们的宝宝了……”
