rows.original:
"There you are, my love!"
    
    You're just about barreled over by Livrea coming at you from the side, throwing her arms around your shoulders and planting a kiss on your cheek. When she steps back, you can see her stomach's as flat as the chubby bard's has ever been, and the fetching smile on her rosy lips tells you that it's for all the best of reasons. 
    
    "I've been searching all over for you," she says, taking your hand. "I only just got back on my feet, truth be told, but I didn't want to send a runner. Come with me, and see our beautiful baby!"
    
    Your heart races, only now starting to truly come to terms with the reality you're facing: Livrea's given birth to your child. A new life brought into the world, a new member of your growing lineage. You take the cow-girl's hand eagerly and let her lead you back the way she came, straight for her family home in the heart of the city.
    
    [var0
        |Liv's sister is waiting on the porch for you once again, cradling your newborn in her arms while [livkid.name] sits on her lap, staring in wide-eyed awe at her new sibling. You and your girlfriend hurry over, scooping the little bundle of moo up with excited smiles. It soon becomes apparent you've just had a daughter, another hungry ginger that demands poor Livrea's bosom the moment she's picked the baby up. Mommy's calves, every one of them...
        
        You and Liv finalize a name, earning excited babbles from [livkid.name] and a grin from your newborn's aunt.
        |[livkid.name] is sat out on the porch waiting for you, arms wrapped protectively around her newborn sibling. Livrea scoops the baby up while you give your eldest a big hug, telling her how proud of her you are for taking care of her mom and new sibling while you've been gone. 
        
        "[livkid.ageBKA
            |
            |Yay! I did good, huh?
            |No problem, [pc.mf
                |dad
                |mom
            ]. Happy to help
        ]," she giggles, hopping up and peering into the bundle as it latches to her mom's boob. "she's such a pretty baby..."
        
        Ain't that the truth. You and Liv finalize a name, earning a quiet cheer from [livkid.name] that's cut off when you scoop her into another hug. You've got such a damn beautiful family growing here, it's hard not to join Liv all teared up right out on the porch...
    ]
    
    You spend the next several minutes fussing over the newborn before the two of you head inside to put your bundle of joy to bed. The rest of your day passes in a whirlwind of childcare, affection, and taking some small part of the load off of a very exhausted new mother. When you're finally ready to head back out, you feel like you know your new daughter as well as anybody can know a baby, and at the same time, not at all. You reassure Livrea that you'll be back soon — there's no way you're going to miss watching your new kid grow up!

        确实如此。你和莉芙最终确定了名字，[livkid.name]发出轻声欢呼，却在你把她再次抱进怀中时戛然而止。一个如此美丽的家庭正在这里成长，实在很难不陪着莉芙就在门廊上热泪盈眶……
    ]
    
    接下来几分钟，你们围着新生儿百般宠爱，随后一起进屋，将这团喜悦放上床。余下的一天在照顾孩子、表达爱意，以及替筋疲力尽的新手母亲分担少许压力的忙碌中飞逝。等你终于准备再次出门时，你觉得自己已经像任何人所能做到的那样了解新女儿，却又同时对她一无所知。你安慰莉维娅，自己很快就会回来——你绝不会错过亲眼看着新孩子长大！

"

    [var0

rows.original: "There you are, my love!" You're just about barreled over by Livrea coming at you from the side, throwing her arms around your shoulders and planting a kiss on your cheek. When she steps back, you can see her stomach's as flat as the chubby bard's has ever been, and the fetching smile on her rosy lips tells you that it's for all the best of reasons. "I've been searching all over for you," she says, taking your hand. "I only just got back on my feet, truth be told, but I didn't want to send a runner. Come with me, and see our beautiful baby!" Your heart races, only now starting to truly come to terms with the reality you're facing: Livrea's given birth to your child. A new life brought into the world, a new member of your growing lineage. You take the cow-girl's hand eagerly and let her lead you back the way she came, straight for her family home in the heart of the city. Her sister's waiting on the porch for you, a top-heavy blonde with no shortage of Sorran tattoos peeking out from beneath a sky-blue robe. In her arms is a tiny bundle of blankets with a mop of ginger peeking out one and a red tail-poof drooping out the other. And the little one is howling, letting the world know he or she misses mommy something fierce. Liv all but runs the rest of the way, scooping up your child with a coo of reassurance and unabashedly presenting a boob. Thus, at last, silencing the crying. You draw a little closer, putting one hand on Liv's shoulder and the other on the tiny bundle's brow. It's a girl, that much is obvious: she's got human features save for hair that's a bit darker red than Livrea's, and she has the same dusky, freckled complexion with no fur to be seen save for ears, hoofed legs, and tail. One look is enough to melt [pc.isDK |even ]your heart, and you find yourself affectionately stroking the little moo's head while she drinks her fill. "Beautiful, isn't she?" Liv sighs, favoring you with a smile more radiant than any before it. "My first baby... our baby. Oh, [pc.name]..." "She's going to need a name other than 'baby,' sis," the other cow-girl adds helpfully, straightening out her toga. "Big momma's girl already, she is." Liv laughs. "I was waiting for [pc.name] to get here. [pc.HeShe] gets a vote too, after all. What do you say, my Champion — she looks like a Livia to me!"
rows.translation: “你在这里，我的爱人！” 莉维娅从侧面冲来，险些将你撞倒；她双臂环住你的肩膀，在你脸颊上亲了一口。她退开后，你看见她的肚子已经恢复成这个丰满吟游诗人平时那般平坦；红润双唇上的动人笑容告诉你，这完全是因为最美好的理由。 “我到处都在找你，”她牵起你的手说道。“说实话，我才刚刚恢复行动，但我不想派信使去找你。跟我来，看看我们美丽的宝宝！” 你的心脏狂跳，直到此刻才真正开始接受眼前的现实：莉维娅生下了你的孩子。一个新生命来到世上，你不断壮大的血脉又增添了一名成员。你热切地握住牛女的手，任由她带你沿来路返回，径直前往位于城市中心的家宅。 她的姐姐正在门廊上等你；这是名胸部丰满的金发女子，天蓝色长袍下露出不少索拉风格的纹身。她怀中是一小团襁褓，一头红发从一端露出，一簇红色尾毛从另一端垂下。小家伙正在嚎啕大哭，让全世界都知道自己有多么想念妈妈。莉芙几乎跑完剩下的路，一边柔声安慰，一边抱过你们的孩子，毫不羞怯地递上一只乳房。哭声终于平息。 你又凑近一些，一手放在莉芙肩上，另一只手贴上襁褓中小家伙的额头。显然，这是个女孩：除了头发比莉维娅稍暗一些，她有着人类的五官；她同样生着布满雀斑的深色皮肤，除耳朵、有蹄双腿和尾巴外，浑身看不见毛发。只看一眼便足以融化[pc.isDK |就连 ]你的心；小小的牛女喝饱奶水时，你不由得爱怜地抚摸她的脑袋。 “她很漂亮，对吧？”莉芙叹息着，向你露出一个远胜以往任何时候的灿烂笑容。“我的第一个宝宝……我们的宝宝。哦，[pc.name]……” “姐姐，她总得有个‘宝宝’以外的名字，”另一名牛女整理着托加袍，好心提醒道。“她已经完全是个黏妈妈的姑娘了。” 莉芙笑了起来。“我正等着[pc.name]来到这里。毕竟，[pc.HeShe]也有投票权。你觉得呢，我的勇士——在我看来，她很像一个叫莉维娅的姑娘！”

rows.original:
"Hey there, lover!" Livrea says with a beaming smile, setting her harp aside as you approach and putting a hand on her [livrea.belly]. "Guess what? You-"
    
    "She's soooo pregnant!" several of her friends coo, hugging her from behind and the sides. 
    
    Your girlfriend giggles, all but disappearing into togas and titties, before finally fighting free and onto her hooves. You pull her into a tight embrace, letting a hand be guided onto her stomach while her lips brush across your own. "We're going to be parents[livrea.numKids 1| again]," she murmurs, pressing herself so close that the front of her tunic comes away milk-stained. "Can you believe it?"
    
    "Considering the work we put into making it happen..."
    
    That gets a giggle out of the Pasture girls, and a big ol' blush from Liv. Her voice drops to a whisper, just for you: "It's hardly work if you enjoy it. So I'm definitely up for some overtime."
    
    She steps back, hands resting on yours a moment longer before sitting down to grab her harp. "I hope you're ready for this new adventure, [pc.name]! Cuz it's happening!"
    
    You can't wait.
rows.translation:
“嗨，亲爱的！”你走近时，莉维娅笑容灿烂地将竖琴放到一旁，一手抚上自己的[livrea.belly]。“猜猜怎么了？你——”
    
    “她怀——孕——啦！”她的几个朋友娇声说道，从身后和两侧抱住她。
    
    你的女友咯咯直笑，几乎淹没在托加袍与乳房之间，最后终于挣脱出来，用蹄子站稳。你将她紧紧拥入怀中，任由她引导你的一只手落在腹部，同时她的双唇轻拂过你的嘴唇。“我们要[livrea.numKids 1|再次]成为父母了。”她轻声说道，身体贴得如此之近，以至于束腰外衣前襟都沾上了乳汁。“你敢相信吗？”
    
    “考虑到我们为了让这件事发生所付出的‘努力’……”
    
    这话逗得牧场姑娘们咯咯直笑，也令莉芙羞得满脸通红。她压低声音，只对你耳语道：“如果享受其中，那就根本算不上工作。所以，我绝对愿意再加加班。”
    
    她向后退开，双手仍在你手上多停留了片刻，随后坐下拿起竖琴。“希望你已经准备好迎接这场新冒险了，[pc.name]！因为它真的要来了！”
    
    你已经迫不及待。

rows.original:
"Oh! Hey, love, just the [pc.title] I wanted to see!" Liv says, grinning up at you from her seat. As soon as you're in arms reach, she pulls you down into a kiss and pushes something into your hand at the same time — a package, neatly wrapped up in brown paper and bearing a bright golden bow. "I got you a little something. Considering everything... well it's not exactly a ring, but..."
    
    "[pc.dcb
        |Thanks?" you say,
        |Thank you so much, Liv," you say,
        |Awwwww, Livy, thank you so much!" you squeal,
    ] starting to open it up. The other girls around do their best "ooh"s and "aah"s as you tear the paper wrap away to reveal a beautiful little harp, just like Livrea's, engraved and painted with rolling blue waves. 
    
    The bard grins as you take it in. "But it's a little piece of my heart."
    
    "She's sooooo sweet on you, Champion!" a couple of the girls coo, earning themselves each a vicious noogie from Livrea while you give the harp a few experimental plucks. It has a delightfully airy sound, filling the street with celestial music with barely the faintest effort. [var0|Damn, since when could you play like this?|Even your knowledge of music hardly explains such wondrous effect spilling forth at the slightest effort!]
    
    Liv grins at what must be a startled look on your face. "I asked Nieves to do a little enchanting work on it, too. Something really fit for a hero. Hope you get some use out of it — if only sitting around and jamming with me sometime!"
    
    [pc.isDK
        |And if not, you could always sell it...
        |You return her smile, and bring her in for another kiss. "I'll treasure it, Liv."
    ]
rows.translation:
“哦！嘿，亲爱的，正是我想见的[pc.title]！”莉芙坐在座位上仰望你，咧嘴笑道。你一进入她伸手可及的范围，她就把你拉下来亲吻，同时将某样东西塞进你手里——一个以棕色纸张整齐包裹、系着亮金色蝴蝶结的包裹。“我给你准备了一件小礼物。考虑到这一切……它不完全是戒指，不过……”
    
    “[pc.dcb
        |谢谢？”你说道，
        |太感谢你了，莉芙，”你说道，
        |啊——莉芙，太感谢你了！”你尖叫道，
    ]同时开始拆开包裹。你撕掉包装纸，露出一把和莉维娅那把完全相似的漂亮小竖琴，上面雕刻并绘制着翻滚的蓝色波浪；周围的其他姑娘都尽力发出“哦”和“啊”的惊叹。
    
    当你端详竖琴时，吟游诗人咧嘴笑道。“不过，这是我心灵的一小部分。”
    
    “她对你好——甜啊，勇士！”几个姑娘柔声起哄，引来莉维娅赏给每人一记凶狠的锁颈揉头；你则试着拨动几下琴弦。它的音色轻盈悦耳，几乎无需花费丝毫力气，便让整条街道充满天籁般的音乐。[var0|该死，你从什么时候开始弹得这么好了？|即使你懂得音乐，也很难解释为何轻轻拨动就会涌出如此美妙的效果！]
    
    莉芙看见你脸上想必无比惊讶的神情，咧嘴笑了起来。“我还请妮维丝替它施加了一点魔法。它真正配得上一名英雄。希望你能派上用场——哪怕只是在某个时候坐下来，陪我一起即兴演奏！”
    
    [pc.isDK
        |要是不行，你总可以把它卖掉……
        |你回以微笑，把她拉过来再次亲吻。“我会珍惜它的，莉芙。”
    ]

rows.original: "Oh, hey [pc.mascFem |good-looking |beautiful ]!" Livrea smiles as you saunter over, setting her harp aside and gently lifting the head of one of the Pasture's finest out of her lap. "We were just talking about you." [pc.isDK |"That right?" you say, taking the front of the bard's tunic in hand and pulling her into a kiss. "Maybe I ought to keep your mouth busy more, then." |"Only good things, I hope." The bard smiles and crooks a finger, guiding you in so she can steal a kiss. "What else is there to say?" your bardic lover smiles. ] "She's craaaaaazy about you!" another of the Pasture's girls says. A third adds, "That epic about you she's been starting keeps turning into a love ballad!" Livrea's cheeks darken. "Hey! I thought you girls were all about discretion!" "What happens in the bedroom stays there," the girl who'd been lounging in the bard's lap laughs. "But you sing out here on the porch, Livy. Besiiiides, I've been your friend since we were knee high, and I've neeeeever seen you get like this over someone." The curvy ginger's practically turned into a tomato as the other girls join in the giggling. The second harlot pinches her cheek and leers, pressing her shoulders into Liv's. "Sooooo? When you are two gonna, like, make it official? Huh?" "Everyone needs a bard-wife," another says with a sage nod. "I'd marry her in a heartbeat, if I wasn't married to the Pasture." "Married to a certain senator's cock and coin, anyway," the first says. "She's got a point, though, Livy. You at least ought to ask the Champion out on another date!" The poor strawberry bard groans. rows.original: Passing by the city's prominent public milking stall, you notice a familiar strawberry-haired cow standing outside with a flush on her freckled cheeks and her tail curled pensively around a fuzzy calf. It's hardly like Livrea to look shame-faced about anything, much less something as locally mundane as getting milked. You catch the bard's eye as you walk by, and she gives you a shy smile and two-fingered wave. "Ay-ah, Champion." "[pc.isBimbo |Hiiii Livvy! |Livrea. ] Something the matter?" The bard looks askance a moment, glancing between you and the milking booth. "Ah, nah, just waiting for my sister and cousin to finish up. We were all gonna go get dinner together after, but they're sure taking their time for girls smaller'n I am. And I count fewer guard bulls in here than when I went in." [party.has cait |Cait titters. "I guess they're not the only ones getting milked, huh?" |You quirk an ear to the door, faintly becoming aware of some very throaty mooing and wet flesh-slapping from inside. "I don't think they're coming any time soon." ] "Yeeeeeah," Livrea sighs. "I don't know why I'm bothering to wait, honestly. They do stuff like this all the time." "Without inviting you?" She laughs. "They know I'd just yank their horns. Contrary to the popular image of the amorous meandering minstrel, I don't really go in for nameless paramours I'll never see again. Even the girls at the Pasture — I've known near all of them since we were kids together. My cousin, though, seems like she's set on seeing if she can bear a child by every bull in the city, and my sister's too enamored with her not to go along — even if that means leaving me out here all by myself. Again." Livrea snorts and hooks her thumbs through her swordbelt. [party.has cait |Cait puts a hand on the cow's shoulder. "I can't believe your own sister would be that rude. Maybe [pc.name] and I can cheer you up, though?" ]
rows.translation: 经过城里著名的公共挤奶摊时，你注意到一名熟悉的草莓发牛女站在外面；她布满雀斑的双颊微微泛红，尾巴若有所思地绕着一只毛茸茸的小腿。莉维娅几乎从不为任何事面露羞耻，更别说挤奶这种在当地司空见惯的事情。你走过时与吟游诗人四目相对，她羞涩地微笑，举起两根手指挥了挥。 “哎—哈，勇士。” “[pc.isBimbo |嗨——莉芙！ |莉维娅。 ]出什么事了吗？” 吟游诗人斜眼看了一会儿，目光在你和挤奶棚之间游移。“啊，没什么，只是在等我的姐姐和表亲结束。之后我们本来要一起去吃晚餐，可她们明明比我小，花的时间却可真够长。而且，现在里面的公牛守卫比我进去时少了。” [party.has cait |凯特咯咯笑道。“我猜被榨奶的不只有她们，对吧？” |你侧耳倾听门内的声音，隐约察觉到里面传出喉音浓重的哞叫和湿润肉体拍打声。“我觉得她们一时半会儿不会出来。” ] “对——啊，”莉维娅叹息。“说实话，我都不知道自己为什么还要等。她们总是做这种事。” “还不邀请你？” 她笑了起来。“她们知道我只会拽她们的角。与多情流浪乐师的流行形象相反，我其实不喜欢那些再也不会见面的无名情人。即使牧场里的姑娘——我也几乎全都从小时候就认识。不过，我的表亲似乎决意尝试为城里的每一头公牛生下孩子；我姐姐又太迷恋她，不可能不跟着一起——哪怕这意味着再次把我独自留在外面。” 莉维娅哼了一声，双手拇指勾住剑带。 [party.has cait |凯特将一只手放到牛女肩上。“真不敢相信，你亲姐姐会如此无礼。不过，也许[pc.name]和我可以让你振作起来？” ]

"Well, if your sister and cousin aren't coming, why don't I take you out to dinner?" you offer, extending a hand to the minstrel. 
        
        "Aww, you don't have to," Liv says, but she's already reaching for your hand.
        
        "But I want to," you smile. "Where to?"
        
        Livrea smiles radiantly, letting your fingers slip through hers. "Well, I know a great little seafood-and-wine place down by the east gate. Everything's fresh from the coastal villages. Or was, anyway. C'mon."
        
        The bard leads you off the familiar beaten path of Khor'minos's main thoroughfare, through the neatly-arrayed grid of alleys and side streets on an ever-eastward trek past a mingling of shops, apartments, and villas. The eatery itself stands between a massive gate that reaches all the way to the top of the tunnel it protects and a sprawling artificial pond crossed by stone bridges. Small, frilled fish jump out of the water at intervals, snapping at bits of bread and seed that folk sitting at tables outside the restaurant flick at them. Livrea leads you over one of the bridges, mentioning off-hand something about the pond being in honor of one of her ancestor's naval victories while securing a table by the waterside. She points out a particular local delicacy you're liable to enjoy, and soon enough you're deep in pleasant conversation over a bottle of Khor'minoan red. 
        
        "So yeah, just about everyone in the family's served in the navy," she says after a bit, throwing a scrap of meat at one of the jumping frillfish. "You should see the collection of maps and charts in my parents' study. Dad and his crew have seen every corner of the Sapphire Sea. Wish I could have joined them on some of those voyages..."
        
        "Why didn't you?" 
        
        Liv shrugs, resting her chin in a hand. "I get horribly, violently seasick. Even riding a horse makes me ill, honestly. I got drummed out on my first training exercise, and no amount of family name-slinging or prayers to Sorra were going to fix it. But I've got the same wanderlust as the rest of my kin, soooo..."
        
        "So that's why you became a bard," you finish.
        
        She nods. "Mmmhm! These legs have walked all over the Marches, learned song and saga from Maidenbridge to Tychris. It might not be the whole wide world, but I've seen things none of my ancestors have: Belharan castles and elven bath houses, mountain-top temples and swampland standing stones. And despite what my dad'll tell you, there's just as many fascinating cultures inland as there are across the seas."
        
        [party.has ryn
            |Liv nods to where Etheryn [party.manyCompanions
                |and [comp2.name] are
                |is
            ] sitting a few tables over. "And even some that've been nearly forgotten, lost to time since the Godswar, just waiting to be rediscovered."
        ]
        
        "I'm surprised you're not going mad cooped up in the city for so long."
        
        "You're telling me!" she says, half laughing and half sighing through it. "I don't think I've ever spent this much time in the city at once since I came of age to leave. But what can I say? I'm a patriot at heart — you'd be hard-pressed to find a minotaur who isn't. When I heard the city was under threat, I came running back. I'm too tiny to fight with the legions, but if the demons breach the city me and my sword'll be here to show them why Khor'minos has never fallen!"
        
        Liv's voice has raised enough as she spoke to turn a few heads, and some of the nearby citizens raise their mugs in agreement. An off-duty soldier sitting near the door pounds a fist on his table, which makes the two girls he's dining with swoon. Livrea grins, tail swishing behind her, and says more quietly "Plus having a bard around's good for morale." 
        
        "Not just for the locals, either," you say. 
        
        The [silly
            |musical moo
            |bard
        ]'s cheeks darken just a touch, quickly hidden behind her glass of wine. 
        
        She soon after turns the topic back towards your own adventures, insisting you tell her all about your first meeting with the demon queen, how you saved the Winter City, and whatever tidbits you feel comfortable sharing about your working with Calise. By the time you've caught her up, your meal's long finished, as is the bottle of wine the restaurant owner insisted on giving the [pc.mf
            |hero
            |heroine
        ] of the day. Liv's cheeks are solidly reddened now, smiling radiantly and hanging off your every word. 
        
        [pc.isCunning
            |"You're looking like you've never met the hero of one of your legends before," you note.
            
            "Mmm, full of yourself, aren't ya? But it's true — my kids will certainly be singing your legend alright. The Champion of Frost, Savior of Khor'minos, Conqueror of the Demon Queen!"
            |"In a generation, you're going to be the hottest legend across the Marches, aren't you? Maybe the continent," Liv giggles. "The Champion of Frost, Savior of Khor'minos, Conqueror of the Demon Queen!"
        ]
        
        "Sounds like you're already working on a title," you tease. 
        
        Livrea's ears flick. "Maybe I am, at that. Bards like me dream of getting to see legends unfolding before our eyes, of getting to meet the epic heroes of tomorrow, really dig down and see what made [pc.himHer] the [pc.background] that'll live forever in history. I'm already picking up a few things no late-comer bard would ever know first hand."
        
        "Such as?"
        
        "You're an excellent date, for starters," Livrea smiles, leaning across the table and planting a kiss on your cheek. Her weighty bovine breasts carelessly knock platters aside, nearly spilling your mug over. "Oops. You should... proooobably take me home before I embarrass us." 
        
        You take Livrea's offered hand and help her sway unsteadily onto her hooves. 
        
        She's sobered up quite a bit by the time she's guided you back through the city, to a small town house near the gate to the noble district. The walls are painted sea green, windows draped with blue and gray, giving the place an oceanic aspect that's hard to miss. Liv gives you a toothy grin, saying "This is me. I told you — my family's a bunch of sea dogs. Thanks for this evening, [pc.name]. You're a good bean."
        
        The pink-hued cow glances between you and her home, not yet releasing your hand. "Y'know... my folks are both in their barracks, and my sister's got her own place. I've got the house to myself. Wanna come up?"
rows.translation:
嗯，如果你的姐姐和表妹都不来，那我带你出去吃晚餐吧？”你伸出手，邀请那位吟游诗人。

“哎呀，你不必这样做的，”莉芙说，但她已经伸手来握你的手了。

“但我真的想这么做，”你微笑着说，“去哪里呢？
        
        莉维娅灿烂地笑了，让你的手指穿过她的手指。“嗯，我知道东门附近有一家非常棒的海鲜餐厅，那里用的食材都是从沿海村庄直接采购的。至少以前是这样。来吧，我们一起去吧。”

这位吟游诗人带着你离开了科尔米诺斯主干道那条熟悉的道路，穿过整齐排列的小巷和侧街，一路向东走去，沿途经过了各种商店、公寓和别墅。这家餐馆坐落在一座巨大的拱门之间，这座拱门一直延伸到它所守护的隧道顶端；此外，餐馆周围还有一个广阔的人工池塘，池塘上架设着石桥。每隔一段时间，一些体型小巧、边缘带有褶边的鱼就会跃出水面，争相抢吃那些坐在餐馆外餐桌旁的人们扔向水中的面包屑和种子。莉维娅带你走过其中一座桥，顺便提到这个池塘是为了纪念她的一位祖先在海战中的胜利而修建的。随后，她为你找了一张位于水边的桌子。她还特别推荐了几种当地的美味佳肴，很快你们就一边品尝着科尔米诺的红酒，一边愉快地聊了起来。 
        
        嗯，我们家里几乎每个人都曾在海军服役，”她说道，同时把一块肉扔向那些正在跳跃的褶边鱼。“你真应该去看看我父母书房里的那些地图和海图——爸爸和他的船员们已经走遍了蓝宝石海的每一个角落。真希望自己也能参加他们的一些航行……
        
        你为什么没有去呢？”

莉芙耸了耸肩，用手托着下巴说道：“我会严重地、剧烈地晕船。说实话，就连骑马也会让我感到不适。在第一次训练中，我就被淘汰了，无论家里的人如何为我求情，也不管向索拉祈祷多少次，都无法改变这个事实。不过，我和我的族人一样，内心充满了探索的渴望，所以……
        
        原来这就是你成为吟游诗人的原因啊，”你说道。

她点了点头：“嗯！我的双脚走遍了整个边境地区，从梅登布里奇到提克里斯，我学会了各种歌曲和传说。虽然见过的世界并不算广阔，但我见过一些我的祖先从未见过的东西：贝拉兰的城堡、精灵们的浴场、山顶上的寺庙，还有沼泽地里的石碑。而且，尽管我爸爸可能会跟你说相反的话，但实际上，内陆地区也有和海外一样多令人着迷的文化。
        
        [party.has ryn
            |莉芙朝伊瑟琳所在的方向点了点头。 [party.manyCompanions
                |以及[comp2.name]是
                |是
            ]就在几张桌子之外。“还有一些早已被人们遗忘，自神战之后就被时间所埋没，现在只是等待着被重新发现罢了。
        ]
        
        真没想到你在城里待了这么久居然没有发疯。”

“你也是这么觉得的吧！”她半笑半叹地说，“自从我长大后可以离开家乡，我应该从来没有在城里待这么长时间过。但我又能说什么呢？我内心深处就是一个爱国者——恐怕很难找到一个不是这样的人。当我听说这座城市受到了威胁时，我就立刻赶了回来。我的力量太微弱了，无法与那些军团作战，但如果恶魔真的攻破了这座城市，我和我的剑一定会在那里，让他们明白为什么科尔米诺斯永远不会陷落！当莉芙说话时，她的声音已经足够大，以至于引得周围一些人的注意；一些附近的市民也纷纷举杯表示赞同。坐在门边的一个下班士兵用力敲了敲桌子，这一举动让与他共进晚餐的两个女孩都看得目瞪口呆。莉维娅咧嘴一笑，尾巴在身后摇来摇去，然后小声补充道：“而且有位吟游诗人在场，对提升士气也有帮助。”

“对当地人来说更是如此，”你说道。 [silly
            |充满音乐感的哞声
            |吟游诗人
        ]她的脸颊微微泛红，但很快就被手中的葡萄酒掩盖住了。

不久之后，她又将话题转回到了你的冒险经历上，坚持要你详细讲述你与恶魔女王的初次会面，以及你是如何拯救冬城的，还想知道你在与卡莉丝合作过程中发生的各种趣事。等你把她感兴趣的所有内容都讲完的时候，你的饭菜早已吃完了，而餐厅老板坚持要送给你的那瓶葡萄酒也早已被喝光了。 [pc.mf
            |英雄
            |女主角
        ]当天最引人注目的人非利夫莫属。此刻她的脸颊已经涨得通红，笑容灿烂，仿佛每一句话都在她耳边回响。 
        
        [pc.isCunning
            |你看起来简直就像从来没听说过自己所在传说中的那位英雄一样，”你说道。

“嗯，真是自以为是啊？但事实就是如此——我的孩子们以后肯定会传唱你的传说。霜之冠军，科尔米诺斯的救世主，恶魔女王的征服者！
            |再过一代人的时间，你一定会成为边境地区最著名的传奇人物，对吧？甚至可能是整个大陆上的传奇……‘霜之冠军’、‘科尔米诺斯的救世主’、‘恶魔女王的征服者’！”莉芙笑着说。
        ]
        
        听起来你已经在着手某个项目了，”你开玩笑地说。

莉维娅的耳朵微微一动。“也许吧。像我这样的吟游诗人，总是梦想着能够亲眼见证传奇故事的发生，能够遇见未来的英雄们，真正深入探究那些让这些人物成为英雄的原因。 [pc.himHer]那个[pc.background]这件事将会永远载入史册。我已经了解到一些后来加入的吟游诗人永远也不会亲身体会到的事情。”

“比如什么？”

“首先，你真是个很棒的约会对象。”莉维娅微笑着，倾身越过桌子，在你的脸颊上轻吻了一下。她那沉甸甸的胸部不小心把盘子撞到了一边，差点让你的杯子洒出来。“哎呀，你最好……还是先把我带回家吧，免得让我出丑。” 

你握住莉维娅伸来的手，帮助她稳稳地站到了蹄子上。 
        
        当她带你穿过城市，来到贵族区入口附近的一栋小屋时，她已经清醒了许多。墙壁被漆成了海绿色，窗户上挂着蓝灰色的窗帘，这一切都让这个地方充满了海洋的气息，这种风格非常显眼，让人一眼就能注意到。莉芙露出灿烂的笑容，说道：“这就是我。我就说过吧，我的家人都是些‘海狗’……谢谢你们今晚的陪伴。 [pc.name]你真是个不错的人。”

那只粉红色的奶牛在你和它的家之间来回看了看，仍然没有松开你的手。“你知道吗……我的父母都在营房里，我姐姐也有自己的住处。所以这房子现在只有我一个人住。想上来一起住吗？

"Wanna spend some quality time with your favorite bard, huh?" Livrea says, handing her harp off to one of her friends lounging around nearby. "I'd love to. C'mon, let's hit up Embers!"

    ]. There's a collective "Aww!" from her friends at the show of affection, followed by a mix of goodbyes and catcalls as the two of you head up the street towards your favorite bar. Khor'minos is always warm, but inside Ember's is positively sultry, helped along by roaring cookfire that dominates the center. You and Liv find an empty table a safe distance away, beneath the great heroic frescoes that adorn the side walls on either flank of the stage.

rows.raw: " [flags.LIVREA_TALK_FAM |[var0 |You inevitably bring up both of your favorite topic: "How's [livkid.name] been?" Livrea's lips immediately spread into a warm smile. "[livkid.ageBKA |She's growing so fast! Always hungry, that little one. My sis always said she was amazed by how much we minos drink growing up, but I'd never really realized — always kind of thought she and my friends were being lazy when they asked me to help nurse, but no, she chugs like a gallon every few hours. I can't imagine where she's putting it all! And the little faces she makes, aaaah! Everything's a new and amazing experience for her, and every time I see her going all wide-eyed at something new it just melts my heart. |I just... can't believe she's growing so fast. All kids born around when she was are! It's incredible, getting to watch her come up right in front of my eyes. Part of me is sad about how fast it's gone, but my sister says I should be happy — we just about skipped all the worst parts of having a little baby with her! |You know as well as I do just how amazing she is. Our little girl, all grown up — can you believe it? Already she wants to go out and be an adventurer, just like you, a Champion in her own right some day. At least she got my hair, haha!" Liv sighs, resting her chin in her hands. "It breaks my heart a little, my girl lookin' like she could be my sister already! It feels like it was just yesterday she was a little ball of fuzz in my arms, and now she can damn well heft my off my hooves! Sorra may say to let them go if you love them, but [pc.name]... I just... I can't! Not yet, anyway. ]" You rest a hand on Liv's, giving her your most comforting smile. "I love our family." "Me too," she says, giving you that beautiful smile of hers. "Can't imagine life without you[livrea.numKids 1 |[livrea.numKids 1 2 | and [livkid.name] |and the girls |and our little herd ] ]." |"So how're your parents doing lately?" you ask her. "They're good. Really good," Liv says with an easy smile. "The Crown was most pleased with their report from the island, and for having had a hand in laying low the demon queen. With Queen Etheryn now crowned, perhaps there's hope after all for the northern kingdom and its folk — and for trade along the coast, too." You chuckle. "Makes it sound like they got all the credit!" Liv waves her hands. "No, no no no. It's just tradition for the highest-ranking Khor'minoan military officer to give the Crown a rundown of any missions, even if it's an auxiliary or adventurer that does the work. The Wraith-touched attack on the Vigil certainly got a reaction, though, I'm told. It's rare enough our soldiers have to fight them on land; an attack on a warship's unprecedented. Between that and the demons, you can bet that my folks are going to be busy for the foreseeable future leading patrols up and down the coast and into the fjords. We nearly lost the Undermountain when the demons first attacked; there's no way the city can afford to lose the sea routes too!" |"You know," Livrea says, glancing up at the heroic frescoes on the wall. "My family's been in Khor'minos since the first settlers came down here. We were fishermen up on the surface, back then, and one of my ancestors was the first to chart out the great rivers of Undermountain. Proved that they fed from the River Ridell up north, and out into the Sea of Sapphires. Made river trade viable for the early kingdom." "I guess your kin have always been on the water, huh?" She laughs. "You could say that! My dad is just the latest in a long line of proud naval commanders, and mom's from a pretty well-respected clan of Sorran storm mages, too. They were heroes of our campaigns against the Sailgrave barbarians before I was even born, and they've only won more battle since then. I think dad's up to fifteen enemy warships sunk now, plus lots of smaller boats." Damn. "That's an impressive record." "Isn't it? The great Captain Livernon, slayer of ships, conqueror of warchiefs, protector of the coastlands... also a really, really great dad. A lot of people are taken off-guard by how gentle he is, considering his reputation, but he's a really sweet guy. He's actually the one that got me interested in poetry and the epics! Used to read the Aveniad to me bit by bit every time his crew returned to port. Mom likes to tease him about being the reason I was away from home so much until now — that he filled my little head with adventure and wanderlust. She's just sad I didn't go into wizardry like she did." That makes Liv laugh, leaning back in her chair and resting her hands on her [livrea.belly]. "My mom, Juno, is incredible. One of the greatest magical prodigies in the world since Old Belhar went to dust. She can just snap her fingers to conjure up a tidal wave that'd break a fleet into splinters. Mom definitely was hoping I'd follow in her footsteps, become a storm-mage on some warship — no doubt my future husband's, she'd have thought! Too bad for me, can't stand being on the water... and while she taught me a bit of magic growing up, I prefer to fill my head with history and adventure rather than spell-chants and rituals." "How did your parents take to you not being able to follow in their [pc.isCunning |hoof |foot ]steps, anyway?" "Weeeeell," she says, glancing at the wall. "It's not like it's my fault. We all realized something was wrong when I was pretty young — you try having a navy captain for a dad and see how often he wants to take you boating! rows.original:
"[rand
        |Charger-Captain Fenraus's wife, Ranna, runs a little herbalist's shop here in town. She likes to keep busy, she says, especially with her husband always called up to handle some crisis or another. He's never been deployed this long at once, though, at least that I can remember. And when his wife's expecting, too! Poor woman. [livrea.isPregnant
            |I've been trying to spend some time with her lately, for solidarity's sake. I think she appreciates the company.
            |I go around to cheer her up as much as I can.
        ]"
        
        Liv giggles, flicking her ears. "Ranna's such a sweetheart. Always trying to help other people before herself...
        |Khor'minos produces a lot of adventurers, you know! Comes with living in the Undermountain, where every trek between towns can be life or death, I guess. Most of us sing our swan song pretty early on, but there's always a few that make good and retire — buy a literal farm before the metaphorical one. One of 'em, Cassia, lives just outside the city walls in a little village. Real humble lady, her. You'd hardly know she used to be a badass, swinging a huge hammer around to crush villainy and save towns across the Marches! Made enough to set herself up for life doing it, too. Raised two of the nicest kids you'll ever meet. Shame we never got close growing up — Brint seemed like the kinda guy I'd be best buds with!
        |The centaur knight Alante is one of the most incredible sights I've ever seen in the arena. Not only is she a hero of the legions' auxiliary, but now she's taken to wiping the floor with the gladiators — like they're just training dummies to keep her skills sharp! A lotta newbies are terrified to try and sign up for fights after seeing her — and then there's a grizzled old captain from the legions standing around showing them the door to the recruiter's pavilion. Maybe that's the point? Either way, I'm always excited to see her fighting the best the city can offer. I'm sure a mino will be her eventually — we've got to have somebody skilled enough — but until then, she certainly makes fights quick.
        |There's a caravan of poor centaur traders that got stuck here in the quarantine. I mean, lots of folks got trapped in or out of the city because of the war, but I feel worst for them — the city's really not made to handle quadrupeds, so there's really nowhere for them other than staying in the outskirts. [var0
            |Though I heard a certain Champion actually took time out of [pc.hisHer] adventures to find them a nice home on a farm, at least until the war's over. Isn't that sweet!
            |I wish somebody could help 'em out — the poor girls were real sweet when I talked to them! They certainly deserve better than turning tricks out in the yards; unfortunately the Pasture won't take 'em. No room for their big bodies, I guess.
        ]
        |My friend Isadora's finally gotten her wish: a chance to fight on the front lines with the legions. She joined the military right about the moment she was legally allowed to, but she's human, and nobody but minotaur men are allowed to stand in the shield walls. Poor thing'd been relegated to rear line and patrol duties until Lady Calise came along and put together her volunteer unit. Now she's getting action like one of the boys."
        
        Liv sighs. "It's just a shame she's finally getting deployed in a war right here in the caves. One of the reasons she joined up in the first place was thinking it would be a chance for her to go out and find what happened to her sister, Isabela, but she's never had any luck. Like the woman just up and vanished into thin air on one of her adventures. Tsk. I hope, for Dora's sake, she turns up when this war's done with...
    ]"
rows.translation:
"[rand
        |费诺斯上尉的妻子兰娜在镇上开了一家小药店。她说，自己喜欢保持忙碌的状态，尤其是当她的丈夫总是被召去处理各种紧急事务时。不过，至少以我的记忆所及，他还没有一次被长时间派往外地执行任务。而现在，他的妻子还怀有身孕！真是个可怜的女人。 [livrea.isPregnant
            |最近，为了表示支持她，我一直在努力抽时间陪她在一起。我觉得她很享受有我陪伴的时光。
            |我尽我所能去安慰她。
        ]莉芙咯咯笑着，摇动着耳朵：“兰娜真是个贴心的人，总是先帮助别人，然后再考虑自己……
        |你知道，科尔米诺斯确实孕育出了很多冒险者！毕竟，在山腹深域生活，意味着每次在城镇间穿行都可能意味着生死存亡。我们大多数人都会在较早的阶段就结束自己的冒险生涯，但总会有那么几个人能够成功退休——他们不仅会在现实中购买田地，还会在象征意义上结束自己的冒险生活。其中有一位名叫卡茜娅的女士，她住在城墙外的一个小村庄里。她真是个非常低调的人啊——你根本想不到她曾经是个非常厉害的人物，挥舞着巨大的锤子，消灭邪恶势力，拯救了边境地区的许多城镇呢！她通过这份工作赚到了足够的钱，足以让自己余生都过上舒适的生活。她还养育出了两个非常可爱的孩子——你绝对见不到比他们更乖巧、更可爱的孩子了。可惜我们在成长过程中并没有变得特别亲密……布林特看起来似乎是那种我会成为最好朋友的人啊！
        |半人马骑士阿兰特是我在竞技场里见过的最令人惊叹的战斗选手之一。她不仅是军团辅助部队的英雄，现在更是把那些角斗士们打得落花流水——简直就像把他们当成练习靶子来磨练自己的技艺一样！很多新手在看到她之后，都不敢尝试注册参加战斗了——而那些经验丰富的老队长们则会在一旁把他们引向招募处。也许这就是这样的安排吧？无论如何，每当看到她与这座城市里最优秀的对手进行战斗时，我总是感到非常兴奋。我相信她最终一定会成为一名顶尖的选手——我们肯定需要这样有能力的人——但在那之前，她的战斗表现确实已经非常出色了。
        |有一支由贫穷的半人马商人组成的商队被困在了这里的隔离区里。我的意思是，由于战争的原因，很多人都被困在了城市里或无法离开城市，但对我来说，他们的情况最为糟糕——这座城市其实并不适合这些四足动物生存，所以他们除了待在城郊之外，真的没有其他地方可去。 [var0
            |虽然我听说有某位冠军确实抽出了时间来[pc.hisHer]努力为他们找一个温馨的家，让他们能在农场里生活，至少等到战争结束为止。多贴心啊！
            |我希望有人能帮帮她们——我和那些可怜的女孩们交谈时，发现她们真的非常善良！她们绝对应该得到比在院子里表演把戏更好的待遇；可惜，“牧场”不会接纳她们。我想，那里根本没有足够的空间容纳她们那些庞大的身躯吧。

rows.original: "The future..." Liv echoes. "That's so up in the air these days, isn't it? Between the war, and the return of the boreal elves, and meeting you... it's hard to say what the future holds!" "Well, what do you hope happens?" you ask. The ginger bard blows out a long sigh. "Hmm. Well, obviously I hope the war ends soon. There's no shortage of folks like you winning glory and renown out there, but the average citizens of the kingdom are suffering from the quarantine and being packed into the city where normally they're spread out across dozens of villages. [livrea.isMom |Most importantly, though, I want it to end so our children don't have to grow up without seeing the sun! |I feel so sorry for all the children that can't go out and see the sun anymore. ]" "After that?" she says, "Hard to say! I'm extremely interested in going to see the Kingdom of Njorhaalt in all its glory, now that we've reconnected with the boreal elves. The legends about its palace made of pure glacial ice really excite my inner bard like nothing else. And I've always wanted to see a frost giant in the flesh! Imagine, the titans that challenged the very dragons of legend.[livrea.isMom | Admittedly, my travel plans are going to be a little... delayed, what with our little herd growing, but in a few years perhaps I'll go wandering again! ]" The minstrel [silly |moo |girl ] sighs wistfully. "In the end, though, what matters most to me is that whatever comes next for us after this war, we do it together! I want to visit all the places you've seen in your journeys — and discover a few more together!" You give her a grin. "That does sound nice."

rows.translation: 几分钟后，莉维娅回来了；她刚刚洗净身体，浑身散发香水气味。她一路暗示性地摇摆臀部，走向你等待的床边；她[livrea.bellyPregRange 0 25 |以一吻轻松滑进你的腿间 |小心地将沉重身体挪进你的腿间，亲吻你时，让你感受到硕大肚子压在自己的[pc.belly]上 ]。你用双手托住她的臀部，提供支撑；手指陷入晒成棕色、布满雀斑的臀肉时，你露出微笑。 “再待一阵，”她在亲吻间低声说道。“我们应该——” 楼下传来一扇门砰然打开的声音，令莉芙的调情戛然而止[livrea.numKids 1 |，特别是声音还伴随着[livkid.ageBKA |[livkid.name] |[livkid.name] |你的孩子 ]喜悦的尖叫[livrea.numKids 2 |，以及她的手足[livrea.numKids 3 |们 ] ] ]。“糟糕，”莉芙呻吟着滚下床，寻找自己的束腰衣。“我想我父母回来了。” 你来到楼下，看见一个女儿正坐在利弗农船长腿上；他的妻子已经进了厨房，让新鲜鱼肉落上烤架的香气充满整栋房子。 “哎—哈，勇士！好久不见！”船长微笑着说道，将姑娘从膝上抱开，以便将你和莉维娅一同拥入怀中。“还有我的宝贝女儿，你成了一个多么光彩照人的母亲！” “爸——爸！” 利弗农轻笑起来。“这是真的！以诸神之名，你们俩组成了多么美丽的家庭。” “亲爱的，拜托！我们第一次见到[livkid.name]时，我就哭过了！”朱诺从厨房喊道。“别为了取乐又把我弄哭。” 莉芙亲了亲老父亲的脸颊，悄悄走开去见母亲；你和年老的公牛闲聊了一阵，直到妻子们带着热气腾腾的小吃回来，[livkid.ageBKA |[livkid.name]裹在朱诺的怀中 |[livkid.name]挂在朱诺的尾巴上，嘴里含着一颗蜂蜜糖，小跑跟在旁边 |你的第二个孩子走在最后，端着几碗鱼露 ]。你被拉进了长达一小时的家庭闲聊，听闻王国海军前线的最新消息；作为交换，你也讲述了近期的一切冒险——至少是适合一家人听的版本。等到离开时，你的胃与内心都无比充实。你和莉芙手牵手返回城镇，知道她的父母会在你们离开时照看[livrea.numKids 1|你的女儿|孩子们]，令你们心满意足。

rows.original: "Hey, [livrea.isLover |lover mine |Champion ]!" Livrea smiles as you approach. "I just got a letter from mom saying [var0 |you and my folks had a wonderful time together!" You draw in a sharp breath. "You're not upset, are you?" She giggles. "Should I be? [livrea.fucked |They certainly seem to approve of you now — as though there was any doubt. It's a Khor'minoan thing, don't worry about it. |My folks like to swing, and what's wrong with that? ]" "Good to know." "Besides," she says, "they also said you took down a whole demon castle. That's incredible! |you took down a whole demon castle. That's incredible! ] You've got to tell me all about it!" Liv hurriedly grabs some scratch parchment and a bit of charcoal out of her pack, and begins writing notes as you regale her with [pc.isCunning |a suitably embellished version of ]your exploits on Dracia. It's certainly a whale of a tale now that you hear yourself going through events, from the Wraith-touched ambush to the climactic throne-room battle and [alissa.dead |Alissa's righteous execution |capturing a demonic queen ]. Livrea eats it all up, hanging on your every word — as do the growing crowd of Pasture girls and customers. "Now that's a Champion's tale!" Liv says when you're through, tail flicking from side to side as she concludes her notes. "Don't worry, [pc.name], the whole of Khor'minos will be hearing of your conquests by tomorrow! I'm going to be staying up all night working on this, mark my words. [livrea.fucked |Unless, that is, you give me a very vigorous reasoning not to... but, t |T ]he city could use that kind of morale boost after everything we've been through!" There's a murmur of agreement from the assembled minotaurs, along with several offers to buy you a drink — or something else in the pasture. But it's Livrea that keeps your attention, setting aside her writing to [livrea.fucked |wrap her arms around you and bring you in for a deep, tongue-laden kiss right in front of everyone. |give you a clap on the back, which turns into a hug that has those giant boobs of her squished tight to your chest for a moment. ] "I'm so glad we have you to protect us from these demons," she says. "Your legend is going to live for a thousand years, [pc.name]! I'll make sure of it."
rows.translation: “嘿，[livrea.isLover |我的爱人 |勇士 ]！”你走近时，莉维娅微笑道。“我刚收到母亲的一封信，说[var0 |你和我父母一起度过了一段美妙时光！” 你猛吸一口气。“你没有生气，对吧？” 她咯咯笑起来。“我为什么要生气？[livrea.fucked |他们如今显然非常赞许你——仿佛这件事还有什么疑问。这是科尔米诺斯人的习惯，别担心。 |我父母喜欢交换伴侣，这有什么不好？ ]” “知道这点很好。” “此外，”她说道，“他们还说你摧毁了一整座恶魔城堡。太不可思议了！ |你摧毁了一整座恶魔城堡。太不可思议了！ ]你一定得把详情全都告诉我！” 莉芙匆匆从包中取出几张草稿羊皮纸和一小块木炭；当你讲述[pc.isCunning |经过适当润色的 ]达拉西亚冒险经历时，她开始记笔记。如今亲耳听自己梳理这些事件，你才发现这确实是一段了不得的故事：从幽魂侵染者发动的伏击，到王座厅里的高潮决战，再到[alissa.dead |对艾莉莎执行正义处决 |俘获恶魔女王 ]。莉维娅听得津津有味，紧紧追随你的每一句话——不断聚拢的牧场姑娘与顾客亦是如此。 “这才是属于勇士的故事！”你讲完后，莉芙一边总结笔记，一边左右甩动尾巴说道。“别担心，[pc.name]，到了明天，整个科尔米诺斯都会听说你的征服！相信我，我要熬上整整一夜来创作。[livrea.fucked |除非，你给我一个非常激烈的理由，让我别这么做……不过，这 |这 ]座城市经历了这一切，正需要这种士气鼓舞！” 聚集起来的弥诺陶洛斯发出赞同的低语，几个人还表示要请你喝一杯——或是在牧场里享受些别的。不过，吸引你注意的仍是莉维娅；她放下写作，[livrea.fucked |双臂环抱住你，当着所有人的面将你拉近，与你舌头交缠、深深亲吻。 |拍了拍你的后背，随后将动作转为拥抱，让硕大乳房一时间紧紧挤压你的胸膛。 ]“我很高兴有你保护我们免受恶魔侵害，”她说道。“你的传说将流传千年，[pc.name]！我保证。”

rows.original: [flags.LIVREA_JUNO |"Y'know," Livrea says, leaning her chin on the top of her harp, "mom's sent another invitation to her tower. The girls miss you." "I'm ready," you say, extending a hand. "Let's go see them." Liv beams at you and tucks her harp under an arm, letting you pull her to her feet. She hooks the other arm around yours and strikes out towards the city's east side. "I hope you're ready for this!" You're not sure anything can really prepare you for getting drained dry for a whole day by a herd of cow-witches. Livrea gives you a reassuring smile. "[livrea.isLover |Don't worry, I'll protect you from the evil scary witches that wanna steal all your precious seed! |You're doing a real service to the navy, you know. Mom says the girls are climbing the walls without you there to tend to 'em! ]" A few minutes later and you've arrived at the navy's impressive circular docks, and head to the tower. |"Let's head to the tower, then," you say[juno.lewded |, barely concealing your anticipation ]. "Let's!" Livrea [livrea.pregStage 2 |takes your offered hand and lets you pull her to her feet, tucking her harp under an arm |hops up, tucks her harp under an arm, and takes your hand ]. She [livrea.fucked |tucks herself in close to you, giving you a kiss on the cheek |gives her friends a wave goodbye ] as you start to walk. The pretty[livrea.pregStage 2 |, pregnant ] bard leads you uptown, veering off the main street near the gates of the royal palace and heading east. "The navy's main dockyard is thisaway. Have you seen it before?" "Can't say I have," you admit, weaving through the crowd beside her. "It's a wonder of the world!" Liv says proudly. "Dad's office and mom's tower are in the citadel at the center of it!" You notice a downward slope to the street, bringing you closer to sea level with every step. The closer you get, the more people seem to recognize Livrea, pausing to greet her or even [livrea.pregStage 2 |caress her tummy |pet her hair ] right on the street; many of them are large bulls in the distinctive blue cloaks of the royal navy, older and well-scarred men whose togas cling to masses of muscle earned from manning oars for years upon years. Liv just smiles and swishes her tail, faster and faster as you near a vast walled enclave at the city's eastern end. "You're awfully popular, aren't you?" "My family is," Liv giggles. "Mom and dad are heroes, what I can say? I can sing scores of ballads about their exploits, and grandfather's, and his mother's..." The two of you make it to the gate of the compound, and through it into a tremendous circular structure of a size that would dwarf even the colosseum, or the greatest Belharan palaces. It's dominated by a lock filled with water deep enough to support the two dozen heavy warships floating inside, each moored in its own sheltered pier, where gangs of slaves and sailors tend to their maintenance. In the center of the lock is a squat one-story marble building, supporting on its back a tower that rises up and above the rest of the dock, its highest floor open to the air and shining with a brilliant white radiance like caged lightning. "A little more than just a dock," you say with a whistle, looking out across fleet docked here under the mountain. "How did you all even build all this down here?" Liv flashes you a smug smile. "Khor'minoan engineering at its finest. The mountain's full of underground rivers! It was easy to find one, dam it, and built a fortress around the source on the ocean. The huge docks here were built up during the Godswar to hide the Royal Navy from the demons of yesteryear. Lucky us, it's still able to do just that today! The fort's able to block up the entrance to the river tunnel, so the imps can't fly in that way either — don't worry!" Good to know. That was going to be your next question: how much of a security risk a straight shot to the sea might be. "Sounds like your ancestors thought of everything." "Nobody builds like a minotaur," Liv says, leading you across the bridge to the central structure. You notice the Auroran Vigil moored beside it, and several of the marines on its deck wave at you. You don't see her captain or storm mage aboard, though: they must be inside. "[livrea.isMom |Here, get something nice for the baby. |Buy me a drink sometime and we'll take the house down. ]" Liv just grins. "Will do!" You slip an arm around Cait's waist and continue on your way. '

rows.original: While you stride through the overcrowded streets of the metropolis, something familiar catches your attention, so instantly recognizable that you can't help but smile. You quicken your pace until you see the source of it, that melodious harp-playing accompanied by the cheery singing of a strawberry-haired bard. You find Livrea sitting on the stoop of a building that seems to be getting quite a lot of through-traffic. A dozen or so girls in various states of undress surround her, lounging around with bared bosoms and sipping wine. A tavern, or a cathouse? Hard to say. "And so Cezaron the Healer arrived at the Grey Peak, though after many hours of climb he was left feeble and weak," the minstrel recites as you approach, eyes closed while her fingers play across her harp. You have to admire her poise, holding the instrument steady despite her enormous bosoms threatening to brush the strings with every breath. "They ancient ox beheld the glory of the summit and hugged the rock, a gift from Father Velun, terrified lest he plummet. Yet his quest, his noble venture, would brook no delay. For the sake of his noble wife, heavy with child, Cezaron undertook his dangerous foray." The cowgirl sighs, leaning back into the bosoms of one of the working girls sitting behind her. "Ugh, this sounds terrible in Belharan. Cezaron the Healer is supposed to be alliterative not rhyming, but..." [party.has cait |"It sounds lovely!" Cait chirps, bounding out from behind you and giving the bard's scruffy ginger hair a rub. "Was that your own translation? I've never head that version of the Cezeroniad before." "O-oh! Yeah, it is. It's terrible, but every other one is worse," the minotauress says with a laugh. ] The moment Livrea sees you, she smiles from ear to ear, hopping up and running over to give you a big hug. A herd of scantily-dressed cowgirls she'd been sitting with make confused noises, until Livrea takes your hand and turns to them. [var0 |"This is the [pc.title] I was telling you about! The one that braved the blizzard to save a poor catgirl. Isn't [pc.heShe] a dreamboat?" |"This is the wyrmslayer I told you all about! The one that made sure I made it home safe and sound! Isn't [pc.heShe] fierce!" |"This big softy is the lizard-slapping hero I told you all about. The one that made sure I made it home safe and sound! Isn't [pc.heShe] a dreamboat?" ] The other cows gasp excitedly. One of them croons, "What a hero." You [pc.dcb |groan. Hardly. |blush a little. It's hard to get used to even girls on the street calling you that. |beam at them. Yay, everyone loves you! ] [flags.LQ1_WYRM |Livrea wasn't kidding about singing your praises when she got back, it seems. |It seems the bard's made sure your tales precede you. ] "Glad you made it to the city," Liv says, "though I wish it was when we were at our best. I hear you're a big champion now! Overthrowing tyrants in the far north, cleaving your way through Undermountain, confidant of Velun's own chosen hero. Quite the glow up from when we were slumming it in Hawkethorne, huh?" You have come a long way, haven't you? "Sit a while," Liv offers. "I've got all the gossip in the city on hand to get you up to speed."
rows.translation: 当你穿梭于这座大都市拥挤的街道之中时，某个熟悉的事物吸引了你的注意——它如此容易辨认，以至于你不禁露出了微笑。你加快了脚步，直到找到了它的来源：那悠扬的竖琴声，以及那位拥有草莓色头发的吟游诗人欢快的歌声。 你看到莉维娅坐在一栋似乎人来人往十分频繁的建筑物前的台阶上。大约有十几名穿着各式各样的女孩围在她身边，有的袒露着上身，有的正在喝葡萄酒，悠闲地躺着或坐着。一家酒馆，还是一处妓院？这很难说。 “就这样，被称为‘治愈者’的塞扎隆来到了灰峰，然而在攀登了数小时后，他依然感到虚弱无力，”当你们走近时，这位吟游女闭着眼睛，手指在竖琴上轻轻弹奏着，开始讲述这个故事。你不得不佩服她的镇定自若——尽管她那巨大的胸部几乎在每次呼吸时都会碰到琴弦，但她依然能够稳稳地握住乐器。“那些古老的牛群看到了山顶的辉煌景象，于是紧紧抱住了岩石，这是维伦之神赐予它们的礼物，它们生怕自己会从山上坠落下去。然而，他的追寻，他这一崇高的冒险，容不得任何拖延。为了他那位怀有身孕的尊贵妻子，塞扎隆毅然踏上了这条充满危险的征程。 牛仔姑娘叹了口气，靠在坐在她身后的一位女工的怀里。呃，用贝尔哈兰的语言来说，这句话听起来简直糟透了。治愈者塞扎隆按理说应该是头韵而不是押韵的，但是 [party.has cait |听起来真好听！”凯特欢快地叫道，从你身后跳出来，还揉了揉那位吟游诗人那蓬乱的姜黄色头发。“这是你自己翻译的吗？我从来没听过这个版本…… 塞泽罗尼亚德在那之前……” “哦哦！没错，确实是这样。虽然很糟糕，但其他的情况更糟呢，”牛头女妖笑着说。 ] 莉维娅一看到你，就笑得合不拢嘴，立刻跳起来跑到你跟前，给了你一个热情的拥抱。那些原本和她坐在一起、穿着暴露的牛仔女孩们发出了一阵困惑的声音，直到莉维娅握住你的手，转向她们。 [var0 |这就是[pc.title]就是我之前跟你讲过的那个！那个冒着暴风雪去救一只可怜的猫女的角色，对吧？ [pc.heShe]白马王子吗？ |这就是那个就是那个我给大家讲过的屠龙者啊！就是它让我能够安全无恙地回到家来的！不是吗？ [pc.heShe] 凶猛的！” |这个大软蛋那个就是我之前给大家讲过的那个拍打蜥蜴的英雄吧？就是那个确保我能安全回家的人！不是吗？ [pc.heShe]白马王子吗？ ] 其他奶牛们兴奋地喘着气，其中有一头低声说道：“真是太英雄你[pc.dcb |哼，才不是呢。 |脸有点红吧。就连街上的女孩都这么叫你，确实很难习惯。 |朝他们微笑吧。耶，大家都喜欢你呢！ ] [flags.LQ1_WYRM |看来，莉维娅回来后确实没有夸大其词，她确实是盛赞了你。 |看来那位吟游诗人已经确保你的故事先于你本身而为人所知了。 ] 很高兴你终于来到了这座城市，”莉芙说道，“不过我真希望那是我们在状态最好的时候。听说你现在已经成为一位著名的英雄了！在遥远的北方推翻暴君，穿越山腹深域，甚至成为了维伦亲自挑选的英雄的得力助手。和我们在鹰棘镇那些艰难的日子相比，你的成就确实令人赞叹，不是吗？” 你确实走了很长的一段路，对吧？ “坐下来休息一会儿吧，”莉芙邀请道，“我这里有城里所有的八卦新闻，可以让你快速了解最近发生的事情。

rows.original: "Say, Liv, what would you say to going out with me again?" The cowgirl courtesans lounging around the bard all gasp. One of them covers her mouth and looks between you both. "Again?" Livrea just smiles radiantly, hopping up from the stoop and taking your hand. "And here I was waiting to ask you that! By which I mean, I'd be delighted. It just so happens that I know a great little seafood-and-wine place down by the east gate. Everything's fresh from the coastal villages. Sound good to you?" You nod, and give Livrea's hand a squeeze. "Lead the way." The bard leads you off the familiar beaten path of Khor'minos's main thoroughfare, through the neatly-arrayed grid of alleys and side streets on an ever-eastward trek past a mingling of shops, apartments, and villas. The eatery itself stands between a massive gate that reaches all the way to the top of the tunnel it protects and a sprawling artificial pond crossed by stone bridges. Small, frilled fish jump out of the water at intervals, snapping at bits of bread and seed that folk sitting at tables outside the restaurant flick at them. Livrea leads you over one of the bridges, mentioning off-hand something about the pond being in honor of one of her ancestor's naval victories while securing a table by the waterside. She points out a particular local delicacy you're liable to enjoy, and soon enough you're deep in pleasant conversation over a bottle of Khor'minoan red. "So yeah, just about everyone in the family's served in the navy," she says after a bit, throwing a scrap of meat at one of the jumping frillfish. "You should see the collection of maps and charts in my parents' study. Dad and his crew have seen every corner of the Sapphire Sea. Wish I could have joined them on some of those voyages..." "Why didn't you?" Liv shrugs, resting her chin in a hand. "I get horribly, violently seasick. Even riding a horse makes me ill, honestly. I got drummed out on my first training exercise, and no amount of family name-slinging or prayers to Sorra were going to fix it. But I've got the same wanderlust as the rest of my kin, soooo..." "So that's why you became a bard," you finish. She nods. "Mmmhm! These legs have walked all over the Marches, learned song and saga from Maidenbridge to Tychris. It might not be the whole wide world, but I've seen things none of my ancestors have: Belharan castles and elven bath houses, mountain-top temples and swampland standing stones. And despite what my dad'll tell you, there's just as many fascinating cultures inland as there are across the seas." [party.has ryn |Liv nods to where Etheryn [companion. |and [companion.name] are |is ] sitting a few tables over. "And even some that've been nearly forgotten, lost to time since the Godswar, just waiting to be rediscovered." ] "I'm surprised you're not going mad cooped up in the city again." "You're telling me!" she says, half laughing and half sighing through it. "I don't usually spend much time here in the city, not since I came of age to leave. But now that it's under threat — what can I say? I'm a patriot at heart! You'd be hard-pressed to find a minotaur who isn't. I'm too tiny to fight with the legions, but if the demons breach the city me and my sword'll be here to show them why Khor'minos has never fallen!" Liv's voice has raised enough as she spoke to turn a few heads, and some of the nearby citizens raise their mugs in agreement. An off-duty soldier sitting near the door pounds a fist on his table, which makes the two girls he's dining with swoon. Livrea grins, tail swishing behind her, and says more quietly "Plus having a bard around's good for morale." "Not just for the locals, either," you say. The [silly |musical moo |bard ]'s cheeks darken just a touch, quickly hidden behind her glass of wine. She soon after turns the topic back towards your own adventures, insisting you tell her all about how you saved the Winter City, and whatever tidbits you feel comfortable sharing about your working with Calise. By the time you've caught her up with your exploits since you saw her in Hawkethorne, your meal's long finished, as is the bottle of wine the restaurant owner insisted on giving the [pc.mf |hero |heroine ] of the day. Liv's cheeks are solidly reddened now, smiling radiantly and hanging off your every word. [pc.isCunning |"You're looking like you've never met the hero of one of your legends before," you note. "Mmm, full of yourself, aren't ya? But it's true — my kids will certainly be singing your legend alright. The Champion of Frost, Savior of Khor'minos, Conqueror of the Demon Queen!" |"In a generation, you're going to be the hottest legend across the Marches, aren't you? Maybe the continent," Liv giggles. "The Champion of Frost, Savior of Khor'minos, Conqueror of the Demon Queen!" ] "Sounds like you're already working on a title," you tease. Livrea's ears flick. "Maybe I am, at that. Bards like me dream of getting to see legends unfolding before our eyes, of getting to meet the epic heroes of tomorrow, really dig down and see what made [pc.himHer] the [pc.background] that'll live forever in history. I'm already picking up a few things no late-comer bard would ever know first hand." "Such as?" "You're an excellent date, for starters," Livrea smiles, leaning across the table and planting a kiss on your cheek. Her weighty bovine breasts carelessly knock platters aside, nearly spilling your mug over. "Oops. You should... proooobably take me home before I embarrass us." You take Livrea's offered hand and help her sway unsteadily onto her hooves. She's sobered up quite a bit by the time she's guided you back through the city, to a small town house near the gate to the noble district. The walls are painted sea green, windows draped with blue and gray, giving the place an oceanic aspect that's hard to miss. Liv gives you a toothy grin, saying "This is me. I told you — my family's a bunch of sea dogs. Thanks for this evening, [pc.name]. You're a good bean." The pink-hued cow glances between you and her home, not yet releasing your hand. "Y'know... my folks are both in their barracks, and my sister's got her own place now. I've got the house to myself. Wanna come up?"
rows.translation: 说吧，莉芙，你愿意再和我一起出去吗？” 围在吟游诗人周围的那些女牛仔们全都惊呆了。其中一个人捂住嘴，看着你们俩：“再一起出去？” 莉芙蕾亚只是灿烂地笑了笑，从长凳上站起来，握住了你的手：“其实我一直在等着问你这个问题呢。你太好了！我的意思就是，我会非常高兴的。碰巧我知道东门附近有一家非常棒的海鲜餐厅，那里用的食材都是从沿海村庄直接采购的新鲜食材。你觉得听起来怎么样？” 你点了点头，然后握了握莉维娅的手：“那就请你带路吧。 这位吟游诗人引领你离开了科尔米诺斯主干道那条熟悉的道路，穿过整齐排列的小巷和侧街，一路向东行进，沿途经过各种商店、公寓和别墅。这家餐馆就坐落在一座巨大的大门旁边——这座大门一直延伸到它所守护的隧道顶端；而餐馆前方还有一个广阔的人工池塘，池塘上架设着石桥。那些体型小巧、身上带着褶边的小鱼会不时跃出水面，争抢那些坐在餐厅外围桌子旁的人们扔向水中的面包屑和种子。莉维娅带你走过其中一座桥，顺便提到这个池塘的命名是为了纪念她的一位祖先在海战中的胜利，同时她也在水边找了一处位置坐了下来。她向你推荐了一道当地特别美味的佳肴，很快你们就一边品尝着科尔米诺的红酒，一边愉快地聊了起来。 嗯，我们家里几乎每个人都曾在海军服役，”她说道，同时把一块肉扔向那些正在跳跃的褶边鱼。“你真应该去看看我父母书房里的那些地图和海图——爸爸和他的船员们已经走遍了蓝宝石海的每一个角落。真希望自己也能参加他们的一些航行…… 你为什么没去呢？” 莉芙耸了耸肩，用手托着下巴说：“我会严重地、剧烈地晕船。说实话，就算是骑马也会让我感到不适。在第一次训练中，我就被淘汰了，无论家里的人怎么为我求情，也没办法改变这个事实。不过，我和我的族人一样，内心充满了探索的渴望，所以…… 原来如此，这就是你选择成为吟游诗人的原因啊。”你说道。 她点了点头：“没错！我的双脚走遍了整个边境地区，从梅登布里奇到蒂克里斯，我学会了各种各样的歌曲和故事。虽然见过的世界还不够广阔，但我确实看到了一些我的祖先从未见过的东西：贝拉兰的城堡、精灵们的浴场、山顶上的寺庙，还有那些矗立在沼泽地里的石碑。而且，尽管我爸爸可能会跟你说相反的话，但实际上，内陆地区同样存在着许多令人着迷的文化。 [party.has ryn |莉芙朝伊瑟琳所在的方向点了点头。 [companion. |以及[companion.name]是 |是 ]就在几张桌子之外。“还有一些早已被人们遗忘，自神战之后就被时间所埋没，如今只等着被人重新发现罢了。 ] 真没想到你被关在城里也不会发疯。” “你才说呢！”她半笑半叹地回答，“自从我长大后可以离开这里，我就很少待在城市里了。但现在它陷入了危险之中——我还能说什么呢？我内心深处就是一个爱国者！恐怕很难找到一个不是爱国者的人吧。我的力量太微弱了，无法与那些大军作战，但如果恶魔攻破了这座城市，我和我的剑一定会在这里证明，为什么科尔米诺斯从未被征服过！当莉芙说话时，她的声音已经足够大，以至于吸引了一些人的注意；附近的一些市民也纷纷举起了他们的杯子表示赞同。坐在门边的一个下班士兵用拳头敲打着桌子，这一举动让与他共进晚餐的两个女孩都看得目瞪口呆。莉维娅咧嘴一笑，尾巴在身后摇来摇去，然后小声说道：“而且有位吟游诗人在场，对提升士气也有帮助。” “对当地人来说更是如此，”你补充道。 [silly |充满音乐感的哞声 |吟游诗人 ]她的脸颊微微泛红，但很快就被手中的葡萄酒掩盖住了。 不久之后，她又将话题转回到了你的冒险经历上，坚持要你详细讲述你是如何拯救冬城的，同时也想听听你与卡莉丝共事期间发生的那些趣事。当你把她从你上次在鹰棘镇见到她之后所经历的一切都告诉她时，你的餐食早已结束，而餐厅老板坚持要送给你的那瓶葡萄酒也已经被喝光了。 [pc.mf |英雄 |女主角 ]当天最引人注目的人非利芙莫属。此刻她的脸颊已经涨得通红，笑容灿烂，仿佛每一句话都在她耳边回响。 [pc.isCunning |你看起来简直像是从来没听说过自己所在传说中的那位英雄一样，”你说道。 “嗯，真是自以为是啊？但事实就是如此——我的孩子们以后肯定会传唱你的传说。霜之冠军，科尔米诺斯的救世主，恶魔女王的征服者！ |再过一代人的时间，你一定会成为边境地区最著名的传奇人物，对吧？甚至可能是整个大陆上最著名的……‘霜之冠军’、‘科尔米诺斯的救世主’、‘恶魔女王的征服者’！”莉芙笑着说。 ] 听起来你已经在着手某个项目了，”你开玩笑地说。 莉维娅的耳朵微微一动：“也许吧。像我这样的吟游诗人，总是梦想着能够亲眼见证传奇故事的发生，能够遇见未来的英雄们，真正深入探究那些让这些人物成为英雄的原因。 [pc.himHer]那个[pc.background]这件事将会永远载入史册。我已经了解到一些后来加入的吟游诗人永远也不会亲身体验到的事情。” “比如什么？” “首先，你是个非常不错的约会对象。”莉维娅微笑着，倾身越过桌子，在你的脸颊上轻吻了一下。她那沉甸甸的胸部不小心把盘子撞到了一边，差点让你的杯子洒出来。“哎呀，你最好……还是把我带回家吧，免得让我出丑。” rows.raw: " "Say, Liv, what would you say to going out with me again?" The cowgirl courtesans lounging around the bard all gasp. One of them covers her mouth and looks between you both. "Again?" Livrea just smiles radiantly, hopping up from the stoop and taking your hand. "And here I was waiting to ask you that! By which I mean, I'd be delighted. It just so happens that I know a great little seafood-and-wine place down by the east gate. Everything's fresh from the coastal villages. Sound good to you?" You nod, and give Livrea's hand a squeeze. "Lead the way." The bard leads you off the familiar beaten path of Khor'minos's main thoroughfare, through the neatly-arrayed grid of alleys and side streets on an ever-eastward trek past a mingling of shops, apartments, and villas. The eatery itself stands between a massive gate that reaches all the way to the top of the tunnel it protects and a sprawling artificial pond crossed by stone bridges. Small, frilled fish jump out of the water at intervals, snapping at bits of bread and seed that folk sitting at tables outside the restaurant flick at them. Livrea leads you over one of the bridges, mentioning off-hand something about the pond being in honor of one of her ancestor's naval victories while securing a table by the waterside. She points out a particular local delicacy you're liable to enjoy, and soon enough you're deep in pleasant conversation over a bottle of Khor'minoan red. "So yeah, just about everyone in the family's served in the navy," she says after a bit, throwing a scrap of meat at one of the jumping frillfish. "You should see the collection of maps and charts in my parents' study. Dad and his crew have seen every corner of the Sapphire Sea. Wish I could have joined them on some of those voyages..." "Why didn't you?" Liv shrugs, resting her chin in a hand. "I get horribly, violently seasick. Even riding a horse makes me ill, honestly. I got drummed out on my first training exercise, and no amount of family name-slinging or prayers to Sorra were going to fix it. But I've got the same wanderlust as the rest of my kin, soooo..." "So that's why you became a bard," you finish. She nods. "Mmmhm! These legs have walked all over the Marches, learned song and saga from Maidenbridge to Tychris. It might not be the whole wide world, but I've seen things none of my ancestors have: Belharan castles and elven bath houses, mountain-top temples and swampland standing stones. And despite what my dad'll tell you, there's just as many fascinating cultures inland as there are across the seas." [party.has ryn |Liv nods to where Etheryn [companion. |and [companion.name] are |is ] sitting a few tables over. "And even some that've been nearly forgotten, lost to time since the Godswar, just waiting to be rediscovered." ] "I'm surprised you're not going mad cooped up in the city again." "You're telling me!" she says, half laughing and half sighing through it. "I don't usually spend much time here in the city, not since I came of age to leave. But now that it's under threat — what can I say? I'm a patriot at heart! You'd be hard-pressed to find a minotaur who isn't. I'm too tiny to fight with the legions, but if the demons breach the city me and my sword'll be here to show them why Khor'minos has never fallen!" Liv's voice has raised enough as she spoke to turn a few heads, and some of the nearby citizens raise their mugs in agreement. An off-duty soldier sitting near the door pounds a fist on his table, which makes the two girls he's dining with swoon. Livrea grins, tail swishing behind her, and says more quietly "Plus having a bard around's good for morale." "Not just for the locals, either," you say. The [silly |musical moo |bard ]'s cheeks darken just a touch, quickly hidden behind her glass of wine. She soon after turns the topic back towards your own adventures, insisting you tell her all about how you saved the Winter City, and whatever tidbits you feel comfortable sharing about your working with Calise. By the time you've caught her up with your exploits since you saw her in Hawkethorne, your meal's long finished, as is the bottle of wine the restaurant owner insisted on giving the [pc.mf |hero |heroine ] of the day. Liv's cheeks are solidly reddened now, smiling radiantly and hanging off your every word. [pc.isCunning |"You're looking like you've never met the hero of one of your legends before," you note. "Mmm, full of yourself, aren't ya? But it's true — my kids will certainly be singing your legend alright. The Champion of Frost, Savior of Khor'minos, Conqueror of the Demon Queen!" |"In a generation, you're going to be the hottest legend across the Marches, aren't you? Maybe the continent," Liv giggles. "The Champion of Frost, Savior of Khor'minos, Conqueror of the Demon Queen!" ] "Sounds like you're already working on a title," you tease. Livrea's ears flick. "Maybe I am, at that. Bards like me dream of getting to see legends unfolding before our eyes, of getting to meet the epic heroes of tomorrow, really dig down and see what made [pc.himHer] the [pc.background] that'll live forever in history. I'm already picking up a few things no late-comer bard would ever know first hand." "Such as?" "You're an excellent date, for starters," Livrea smiles, leaning across the table and planting a kiss on your cheek. Her weighty bovine breasts carelessly knock platters aside, nearly spilling your mug over. "Oops. You should... proooobably take me home before I embarrass us." You take Livrea's offered hand and help her sway unsteadily onto her hooves. She's sobered up quite a bit by the time she's guided you back through the city, to a small town house near the gate to the noble district. The walls are painted sea green, windows draped with blue and gray, giving the place an oceanic aspect that's hard to miss. Liv gives you a toothy grin, saying "This is me. I told you — my family's a bunch of sea dogs. Thanks for this evening, [pc.name]. You're a good bean." The pink-hued cow glances between you and her home, not yet releasing your hand. "Y'know... my folks are both in their barracks, and my sister's got her own place now. I've got the house to myself. Wanna come up?""

rows.original:
"Does the name Iavari ring any bells?" you ask the strawberry bard.
    
    Liv flicks her ears. "Sure does. Lord Radmus Iavari's a famous builder. Mostly works on waterways and aqueducts, that sorta thing. His work's earned him a lordly title from the king — even if it's just an honorific, that's a big deal for a man of common blood. His eldest son's an officer in the Legions, and I hear he's won a lot of glory holding the tunnels against the imp hordes. I've never met his daughters, but the two of them are supposed to be real beauties. Envy of all the Novitauri boys."
    
    You nod along as she talks. "I don't suppose you know where I can meet this Lord Radmus?"
    
    "Hmm. Good question." The cowgirl taps her chin. "Radmus himself has really kept a low profile since he came to the city. He didn't even turn up to the king's feast. I'm honestly not sure where he's been staying, but..." 
    
    "But?"
    
    Livrea gives you a pretty smile. "I might know who does, and where to find them. [livrea.isLover
        |Since it's you, I guess I don't mind sharing. Better listen close!"
        |But my memory can be a little hazy sometimes. I might need something to jog it." 
        
        The tip of her tail flicks your coinpurse. Just in case it wasn't obvious.
    ]
rows.translation:
“伊亚瓦里这个名字能让你想起什么吗？”你问那位草莓金发的吟游诗人。
    
    莉芙抖了抖耳朵。“当然。拉德穆斯·伊亚瓦里领主是一位著名的建筑师，主要负责水道、引水渠之类的工程。他凭借自己的工作从国王那里赢得了领主头衔——尽管只是荣誉称号，但对一个平民出身的人而言，这可是了不得的成就。他的长子是军团军官，听说他守卫隧道、抵挡小恶魔大军时立下了赫赫战功。我从没见过他的女儿，不过据说两人都是真正的美人，令所有诺维陶里男孩羡慕不已。”
    
    你听她讲述时连连点头。“你该不会知道我能在哪里见到这位拉德穆斯领主吧？”
    
    “唔，好问题。”牛女轻敲下巴。“拉德穆斯本人进城后一直非常低调。他甚至没有出席国王的宴会。老实说，我不确定他一直住在哪里，不过……”
    
    “不过？”
    
    莉维娅朝你露出甜美的笑容。“我或许知道谁清楚此事，也知道去哪里找那个人。[livrea.isLover
        |既然是你，我想分享一下也无妨。可要仔细听好！”
        |不过我的记忆有时会有些模糊。也许需要某样东西来帮我回想起来。”
        
        她的尾尖轻轻扫过你的钱袋，以免这个暗示还不够明显。
    ]

rows.original: "So," Livrea says, sitting herself back on the brothel's stoop. "Like I said, I don't really know where Lord Iavari is staying, but I know where his son is. Right now, actually." The bard points her thumb down the street, towards the city's main gates. "Ramien's cohort just came back from their deployment this morning. I reckon he's with his mistress, Carebella, out in Telduum Village. She's a minstrel like myself, as a matter of fact. Phenomenal dancer. Her house is the little orange-painted one down at the end of Telduum road. Can't miss it. And if you think you might, just keep your ears open for the one with the loudest bed-rocking coming from inside." [party.has brint |"Wow," Brint laughs. "So Care-bear's bagged herself a rich man's son, huh? I remember when she and I... khaak, lucky guy." ] [party.has brienne |"So Carebella scored herself a centurion, huh? She's a lucky girl," Brienne says. "Almost as lucky as me." ] Varena makes a downright scandalized face, which gets Liv laughing from the belly. "Go on then!" the redheaded cow says, waving you both off. "You'd better hurry if you want to catch them both at home." "I haven't been outside the walls since... since all this started," Varena says nervously. "Dad would be furious if he found out." You [varena.fucked |take her hand and give it a squeeze |give her a reassuring look ]. "I'll be there to [pc.isDK |babysit you, princess." She huffs. "Gee, thanks. |keep you safe." She sighs. "Thanks. It won't keep me from getting the spanking of a lifetime if I get caught, though. ] Tell you what, Livrea, since you're being so helpful..." The bard sighs. "How'd I know I'd end up getting roped into whatever it is you two are up to." She tucks her harp under an arm and gets up, smoothing out her tunic and adjusting her swordbelt. "Alright, alright, I do have some ideas for how to get you out of town undetected, Rena. Just you and me, though. And I hope you don't mind getting your hands dirty." Varena blanches. "Great." Livrea gives you a cheeky grin. "We'll meet you at Telduum, [pc.name]. Don't keep us waiting!" "See you there."
rows.translation: 所以，”莉维娅说着，重新坐回妓院的门阶上，“就像我之前说的，我其实并不知道该去哪里领主贾瓦里会留下，但我知道他会在哪里。儿子就是现在，事实上。” 吟游诗人用拇指指向街道的方向，指向城市的主城门。“拉米恩的同伴们今天早上刚从任务中回来。我想他现在应该和他的情妇卡雷贝拉在泰尔杜姆村里。事实上，她和我一样也是一名吟游诗人，而且她的舞蹈技巧非常出色。她的房子就在泰尔杜姆路尽头那栋涂成橙色的小房子里，绝对不会找错。如果你实在不确定路怎么走，只要留意里面传出来的最吵闹的声音，就能找到那栋房子了。 [party.has brint |哇，”布林特笑着说，“这么说来，小熊妈妈倒是钓到了一个有钱人的儿子，哈？我还记得当初她和我的时候……咳，真是个幸运的家伙。 ] [party.has brienne |所以卡蕾贝拉自己获得了一个‘百夫长’的头衔，是吧？她真是个幸运的女孩，”布蕾妮说道，“几乎和我一样幸运。 ] 瓦蕾娜露出了极其震惊的表情，这让莉芙笑得前仰后合。“那你们快去吧！”红发女孩说着，朝你们俩挥了挥手，“如果想在他们都在家的时候抓住他们，你们最好赶紧行动。” “自从这一切开始之后，我就再也没离开过城墙……如果爸爸知道了，他会发疯的。”瓦蕾娜紧张地说道。 你[varena.fucked |握住她的手，轻轻捏了一下。 |给她一个安心的眼神 ]我会去那里的。 [pc.isDK |我来陪着你吧，公主。” 她哼了一声：“哎呀，谢谢你。 |会保护你的安全。” 她叹了口气：“谢谢。不过，如果被抓到的话，这也阻止不了我受到一顿终生难忘的惩罚。 ]告诉你吧，莉维娅，既然你这么热心帮忙……” 吟游诗人叹了口气：“我怎么会想到自己最终会卷入你们俩正在策划的这件事里呢。”她把竖琴夹在胳膊下站了起来，整理好自己的长袍，调整了一下剑带。“好吧，好吧，我确实有些办法能让你们悄悄离开这座城市，蕾娜。不过只是你和我两个人而已。希望你不会介意稍微动点手。” 瓦蕾娜脸色一变：“太好了。” 莉维娅调皮地笑了笑：“我们会在泰尔杜姆与你会合。 [pc.name]别让我们等太久了！” “到时候见。

You look up and see a cowgirl shaking her fist, and put your hands up to mollify her. What is this woman wearing... "What are your clothes made out of?" you ask, looking her up and down. She's clad in a kind of shiny black material with an almost metallic sheen, enveloping almost her entire body from bottom to top. With her generous curves, it leaves almost nothing to the imagination — despite being technically clothed, her figure seems almost more lewd than if she were standing before you naked. rows.original:
"So why are you still here when everyone else has left their farms behind?" you ask. "Can't you shelter in the city?"

        "A fair amount of my profit comes from selling to businesses in the city. They swing by with a caravan once a week," she says. "It'd be hard to get by if I just took a slime with me and sold clothes to individuals in the city."
        
        "So you're more or less trapped here, then," you say.
        
        "More or less," she echoes, nodding. "It's okay, though. I didn't really want to leave the slimes behind anyway. I'd just feel bad."
rows.translation:
“那为什么在其他人都已经离开农场的时候，你还在这里呢？”你问道，“难道不能去城里躲一躲吗？”

        “我的大部分收入都是靠向城里的商家出售产品赚来的。他们每周会派一支商队来收购我的货物，”她回答说，“如果我只是带着一只史莱姆，然后在城里向人们出售衣服，那肯定是难以维持生计的。”
        
        “那么，你基本上是被困在这里了，对吧？”你说。
        
        “差不多吧，”她点头说道，“不过没关系，我其实也不想把那些史莱姆留在后面。不然我会觉得挺内疚的。”

rows.original: What's she doing here when the rest of the outskirts have been more or less deserted?
rows.translation: 当其他郊区几乎都变得荒无人烟的时候，她为什么还会在这里呢？
rows.raw: "What's she doing here when the rest of the outskirts have been more or less deserted?"

rows.original:
"So is this your farm?" you say.
        
        Marilla nods. "Sure is. No family inheritance here, I bought the land myself. Set up with some slimes and got to work. I first ran into them when I was out adventuring a little, and it seemed like a good idea."
        
        "How exactly did you make the leap from 'I ran into some slimes' and 'I should make a career out of farming slime for clothes', if you don't mind me asking?" you say.
        
        She laughs. "It wasn't a leap, really. What actually happened is that I was injured during a fight, and some slimes helped me recover. It took a few months — still got a scar down my leg — and I spent that time growing closer to them. I originally got the idea when one offered to cover me in herself to protect me, like armor. They'll only do that if they really like you."
        
        "So did you take her up on the offer?" you ask.
        
        "Yes and no," Marilla says. "I wasn't going to keep adventuring. I was never particularly good at it. But I asked if they all wanted to come with me, so I returned home and got some land for them. And here we are."
        
        "How do you keep them happy?" you say.
        
        "Lots of attention. And 'yard work'," she says, smirking.
        
        You've got a pretty good guess at what that implies.
rows.translation:
“那么，这就是你的农场吗？”你说。
        
        玛丽拉点了点头。“没错。这里可没什么家族遗产，这块地是我自己买的。我弄来了一些史莱姆，就这么干起来了。我最初是在外出冒一点险的时候碰上它们的，当时觉得这主意不错。”
        
        “恕我冒昧问一句，你到底是怎么从‘我碰上了一些史莱姆’跳到‘我应该靠养史莱姆做衣服来谋生’的？”你说。
        
        她笑了起来。“其实也算不上什么跳跃。真实情况是，我有一次打斗时受了伤，是一些史莱姆帮我恢复过来的。那花了几个月——我腿上至今还留着一道疤——那段时间我和它们越来越亲近。我最初有这个想法，是因为有一只主动提出用她自己的身体裹住我，就像护甲一样保护我。只有它们真的喜欢你，才会那么做。”
        
        “那你接受她的提议了吗？”你问道。
        
        “算，也不算，”玛丽拉说，“我本来就不打算再冒险了。我从来都不太擅长这个。但我问了问它们是不是都想跟我走，然后就回了家，给它们弄了块地。于是就有了现在这里。”
        
        “你是怎么让它们保持开心的？”你说。
        
        “多给它们关注。还有‘院子里的活儿’，”她说着，坏笑了一下。
        
        你大致能猜到那暗示的是什么。

rows.original:
"So what's up with the clothing?" you say.
        
        "I started off wearing it to advertise. A lot of people who see me ask about the material, where it comes from, how they can get it, all that," Marilla says, running a hand down her front to show it off a bit. "Well, it's actually very comfortable. It's skin-tight, doesn't stick to fur, and it even handles sweat pretty well. It's soft, too, but hardens under pressure. Here, try it."
        
        She holds out her hand and you press your finger to her sleeved forearm, stroking it down to her wrist and then pushing down, dragging it back up. It's true, it does seem to adjust itself to pressure. [party.has cait
            |Cait eagerly takes the opportunity to feel up a little latex herself, giggling as she makes it 'squeak' under her fingers.

rows.original:
"I'd like some..."

        What is it that you'd like to eat? Thinking about food makes your stomach growl like a ravenous beast. 
        
        "Oh, love, you must be starving," the baker says. "Take a seat and I'll serve you something. What would you like? Some cookies? I just baked a new batch."
        
        New rumbles answer the question for you, and you come to the conclusion that it's better if you just sit and wait for those cookies. 
        
        There are only a couple of tables, so you just choose one at random. The scent of fresh bread fills the air, making your mouth watery like a river during spring. Just when you start suspecting that the smell was a big factor in your stomach's spoiled whims, the plate of cookies appears in front of you. 
        
        "I hope they're of your liking," [flags.MILLY_TALK
            |Milly
            |The baker
        ] says with her subtle[milly.corruptionRange 0 60
            | and warm
        ] smile. 
        
        And they're not only of your liking; they're the best you've ever tried.
rows.translation:
“我想要一些……”

        你想吃些什么呢？一想到食物，你的肚子就像饿狼一样开始咕咕叫了。 
        
        “哦，亲爱的，你肯定饿坏了，”面包师说道，“请坐，我马上给你准备一些东西。你想要些什么呢？一些饼干吗？我刚烤了一批新的呢。”
        
        这时，新的震动声为你回答了这个问题，你最终决定，还是坐下来等着那些饼干吧。 
        
        只有几张桌子，所以你可以随便选一张坐下来。空气中弥漫着新鲜面包的香气，让你口水直流，就像春天的溪流一样。就在你开始怀疑这种香气才是导致你肚子“叛变”的真正原因时，一盘饼干出现在了你面前。 
        
        “希望你会喜欢它们，”[flags.MILLY_TALK
            |米莉
            |面包师
        ]用她那含蓄[milly.corruptionRange 0 60
            |而温暖
        ]的微笑说道。 
        
        而且这些不仅会让你喜欢，它们更是你尝过的一切中最棒的。

rows.original:
"[flags.MILLY_TALK
            ||You could tell me your name," you say. "Mine is [pc.name]."

            "Pleased to meet you, [pc.name]. 
        ]It's nice to have visitors who can still spare some time to get to know each other. I'm Milly, and as you can see I'm in charge of baking, cooking, and in general filling every hungry stomach that walks through that door."
        
        [pc.dcb
            |"It doesn't sound easy."
            |"Doing all that can't be easy."
            |"Oh, I see, it sounds hard."
        ]
        
        "It's not hard if you like what you're doing. And I like what I do," she says with her sweet voice. A lock of hair escapes from behind her ear, and she sends it back with a soft caress, unknowingly getting some flour on her cheek. "What about you? What do you do for a living?"
        
        "It's... kinda hard to explain."
        
        "Ah, I see. The adventurer kind," she says with a smile so warm that it could melt all of the snow in the Winter City, and maybe even the Glacial Rift. "You should have said it sooner. I could prepare something to eat, you must be tired from all that fighting and traveling."
        
        "Maybe later."
        
        "Don't push yourself too hard, [pc.name]. Here, take a piece of pie. It's our specialty."
        
        She takes some of it into a little spoon and slowly guides it towards your mouth. 
        
        "C'mon, just one bite," she says.
        
        Okay, why not? It sure does smell delicious. You open up and start feeling a delicate touch of cinnamon as Milly puts the spoon inside your mouth. 
        
        "It's good," you say while still savoring the flavors. No, it's not just good; It's really good. Sweet, but not cloying, with a smooth, creamlike texture and just enough crust to make chewing rewarding.
        
        "Isn't it?" Milly says giving you one of her better smiles. "I'm glad you like it. You can have the rest."
        
        "Really?"
        
        "Yes. It was ordered by a customer, but he's not here to pick it up and it's gonna get cold. I'll just bake a new one if he finds the time to stop by." 
        
        "How much do I owe you?"
        
        "Nothing," she says, renewing her smile. "But you can come and help me with the baking some time. It will be fun."
rows.translation:
“[flags.MILLY_TALK
            ||你可以告诉我你的名字，”你说道。“我叫[pc.name]。”

            “很高兴认识你，[pc.name]。
        ]很高兴访客还能抽出时间相互了解。我叫米莉；你也看得出来，我负责烘焙、烹饪，还有一般而言，填饱每一个走进那扇门的饥饿肚子。”
        
        [pc.dcb
            |“这听起来并不轻松。”
            |“做完所有事情肯定不轻松。”
            |“哦，我明白了，听起来很辛苦。”
        ]
        
        “如果你喜欢自己在做的事情，这就不难。而我很喜欢自己的工作，”她用甜美的声音说道。一缕头发从耳后滑出，她轻柔地将其抚回，不知不觉间在脸颊上沾了些面粉。“你呢？你靠什么谋生？”
        
        “这……有点难以解释。”
        
        “啊，我明白了。是冒险者那类人，”她露出的温暖笑容足以融化冬城的全部积雪，甚至也许能融化冰川裂谷。“你应该早点说。我可以准备些食物；经历了那么多战斗与旅行，你一定很累。”
        
        “也许晚些时候吧。”
        
        “别把自己逼得太紧，[pc.name]。来，吃一块派。这是我们的特色。”
