You wander off the beaten path, following the direction on the posted sign. It leads you to a shack in approximately the middle of nowhere — more exactly, it looks like a farmer's storehouse. There's even another scrawled sign out the front, laid against the door.

    %"Nash's Service"
    
    How delightfully uninformative. Just as you're thinking you should leave, a lupine's head pops around the back of the shack. "Oh! Customers! Hi there."
    
    "Nash, I take it?" you say.
    
    "Correct!" he says, stepping out from behind the building. He's a tall, black-furred man with a spring in his step and a friendly smile, dressed in comfortable-looking clothing. "You must have seen the sign out near the road. Welcome!"
    
    "To...?" you venture.
    
    "To my shop, of course," Nash says, tapping the sign with his foot. "All the goods are downstairs. Want to come in?"
    
    "What do you sell?" you say.
    
    "All sorts of ill-gotten gains. Transformatives, drugs, weapons," he says, spreading his arms. "I guarantee you won't find these anywhere."
rows.translation:
你偏离了常规的道路，沿着路标上指示的方向前行。最终，你来到了一处位于偏远地区的简陋小屋前——更确切地说，那看起来像是一个农家的储藏室。在小屋的前面，还有一张潦草地写着的告示，被贴在门上。

    纳什的服务”
    
    真是太缺乏信息量了……就在你打算离开的时候，一个狼族的脑袋突然从小屋的后方探了出来：“哦！顾客们，欢迎光临！”
    
    “你是纳什吧？”你问道。
    
    答对了！”他说道，从建筑物后面走了出来。他是一个身材高大、毛发呈黑色的男子，步伐轻快，面带友好的微笑，穿着看起来非常舒适的衣服。“你肯定在路边看到了那个标志吧。欢迎光临！”
    
    “来……什么地方？”你问道。
    
    “当然是来我的商店啦，”纳什说着，用脚轻踢了一下招牌，“所有商品都在楼下。想进来看看吗？”
    
    “你们卖什么东西？”你问道。
    
    “各种各样来路不明的东西罢了。变形道具、药物、武器，”他摊开双手说道，“我敢保证，你在其他任何地方都找不到这些东西。

rows.original:
As you approach Nash's shack, you find the proprietor flipping through a bunch of paper parchments while muttering and rubbing his furrowed brow. His ears perk up when he hears the gravel crunch under your [pc.footwear], and the frown turns into a smile in the blink of an eye.
    
    "Ah, if it isn't my favorite customer!" Nash exclaims and puts away his paper stack. "Care to browse my wares?"
    
    That's the plan, and you walk over to his wares and start inspecting the odd-colored eggs and strange-looking herbs. Nash sits patiently and waits for your move with a thumb between the papers. You can sense his golden eyes peering at your [pc.weapon], as the gears turns in the lupine's head.
    
    "Say," Nash says while stroking his chin. "Does an adventurer like yourself know how to traverse the Undermountain?"
    
    "How so?"
    
    "Well, it would seem that I'm in need of some, ah, discreet eyes and ears that can venture past the siege."
    
    You raise an eyebrow and fold your arms – this sounds a bit shady.
    
    "Just hear me out," Nash exclaims while putting up his hands in a defensive pose. "I'm not looking for helpers. I just need some information from a source that can keep their mouth shut. Consider it a bounty; some extra pay while you travel around the mountain."
    
    "Fine. [pc.isDK
        |Out with it.
        |What do you want?
    ]"
    
    "I've lost one of my shipments. It was supposed to arrive a couple of days ago but there's no sign of it. I can't tell... uhm. I can't ask the guards to expend more of their precious manpower. I'm an upstanding citizen after all."
    
    You shrug. It doesn't hurt to keep an eye out, you guess. "Some lost crates shouldn't be too much of a problem. Any idea where to look?"
    
    "The fine gentleman I hired, an orc fellow by the name of Veric, was supposed to deliver them by boat down by the underground lake. Maybe look for him there?"
    
    "I can take a look, but I won't promise anything."
    
    "Of course, of course," Nash chimes while patting you on the back. "No pressure, I won't starve because of this loss. I was just looking forward to trying out some new– ah– wares."
    
    You pretend you didn't hear that last gaff, and go back to browsing Nash's wares.
rows.translation:
你走近纳什的小屋，发现店主一边喃喃自语、揉搓紧皱的眉头，一边翻阅一大叠羊皮纸。听见碎石在你的[pc.footwear]下发出咯吱声，他的双耳顿时竖起；转眼间，皱眉便化作笑容。
    
    “啊，这不是我最喜欢的顾客吗！”纳什大声说道，将纸张收了起来。“想看看我的货物吗？”
    
    你正有此意，于是走向他的货物，开始仔细观察颜色奇异的蛋和外表古怪的药草。纳什拇指夹在纸张中间，耐心坐着，等待你采取行动。你能感觉到他那双金色眼睛正在打量你的[pc.weapon]，狼族脑中的齿轮也随之转动。
    
    “话说，”纳什一边抚摸下巴，一边说道。“像你这样的冒险者，知道如何穿过山腹深域吗？”
    
    “为什么这么问？”
    
    “嗯，看来我需要一些，啊，谨慎的耳目，能够冒险穿过围城地带。”
    
    你挑起眉毛，双臂交叉——这听起来有点可疑。
    
    “先听我说完，”纳什举起双手，摆出防御姿势说道。“我不是在找帮手，只是需要从一个能够守口如瓶的消息来源那里得到些信息。把它当作悬赏吧；你在山中四处旅行时还能多赚点钱。”
    
    “好吧。[pc.isDK
        |说出来。
        |你想要什么？
    ]”
    
    “我丢失了一批货物。它本该在几天前送到，却完全不见踪影。我不能……呃。我不能要求守卫浪费更多宝贵人力。毕竟，我是一名正直的公民。”
    
    你耸耸肩。你想，留心观察也没什么坏处。“几箱丢失的货物应该不算多大麻烦。知道该去哪里找吗？”
    
    “我雇的那位好先生是个叫维瑞克的兽人，他本该乘船将货物送到地下湖。也许可以去那里找他？”
    
    “我可以去看看，但不作任何保证。”
    
    “当然，当然，”纳什一边附和，一边拍了拍你的后背。“不用有压力，我不会因为这次损失挨饿。只是一直很期待尝试些新的——啊——货物。”
    
    你装作没听见最后那次失言，继续查看纳什的商品。

Looking around the muddy slopes next to the jetties, you spot some broken jars and splintered wood, paired with muddy tracks. [pc.bg Hunter
        |Judging by the plethora of feet, and the way they've smudged around in the mud, you come to the conclusion there's been some sort of scuffle, but the lack of blood makes it unclear if there's been combat.

    You also spot some torn clothing and a couple of white puddles, as the tracks lead toward some reeds further down river. [pc.bg Hunter

    Whatever the origin of the tracks is, you assume there's going to be a fight if you follow them. Better be prepared.

rows.original:
As the last of the crimson fiends hit the dirt, you sigh and wipe some sweat from your forehead. Stepping over the groaning imps, you make your way to the crate and inspect the contents: a bunch of bottles with darkened glass. You pick one up and give it a swirl, discovering there's some liquid sloshing inside. Only half a dozen flasks seem to have survived the ordeal, which is convenient for you as they all fit inside your pack.
    
    You start loading them into your bag while keeping an eye out for any more imps. As you slide the last bottle into your pack you hear the orc groan:
    
    "Coooock!"
    
    Right, the unfortunate brute is still around. [pc.isDK
        |Not wanting to let the imps keep their slave
        |Deciding to help the unfortunate courier
    ], you walk over to the orc and check on him. You pause an inch away when you realize he's covered in imp spunk. You take an empty bottle and go down to the lake and fetch some water.
    
    Splashing some of the cold water on the orc's face, you take him out of his dick-drunk state.
    
    "Wuh? Where?" he stutters while spitting out water and cum. His confused rambling turns into a frown as he smacks his lips. "Shit... How long was I..."
    
    His eyes go dark as he mumbles: "...sucking dick?"
    
    "No idea," you respond while looking around for any clothes. There are some torn shirts and pants lying by the crate that probably was a nice set of clothes once, now they barely pass for scraps considering how shredded they are. You pick them up and pour the remaining water over the scraps and start tying them together. "You're telling me that sucking dick isn't how you enjoy spending your evenings?" you ask.
    
    "Hell naw!" the flustered orc shouts. "I don't do guys!"
    
    "Could've fooled me," you say while completing the knots and handing the improvised loincloth to the orc. "It looked like you really enjoyed it."
    
    "I was fucking drugged," the orc mutters and wraps the sticky cloth around his waist. "There's something wrong with that booze. That dogshit vendor should've warned me!"
    
    "You drank the merchandise?"
    
    "Of course. Why should I let some good booze go to waste? Especially when that mutt doesn't pay me enough to slog through these shitty caverns."
    
    You take a sniff from one of the broken vials, it certainly has the smell of alcohol, but there's an underlying tone of corruption.
    
    "Do you just drink anything that smells like spirits?" you ask while giving him a concerned look.
    
    "Booze is booze," the orc protests.
    
    You roll your eyes and toss the broken bottle into the water, hopefully the tiny bit of taint isn't enough to spoil the entire lake. You turn back to the orc.
    
    "So, what's your name, big guy? Or should I call you Gluck-gluck?"
    
    "Fuck you," the orc mutters. "The name's Veric, you [pc.mf
        |dick
        |cunt
    ]."
    
    "Do you need some assistance to get back on the road?"
    
    "No," Veric responds and takes a step, letting out a pained groan while rubbing his butt. "Maybe a little," he says in a defeated voice. "Just to the crossroads and I'll find a way out myself."

        "How did you end up here?" you ask.
        
        "You mean how did an honest lupine like myself end up in some back alley of ill repute?" he fills in, [nash.domSub
            |while scratching the underside of your chin
            |flicking his ears and nuzzling his muzzle against your hand
        ].
        
        "Yes."
        
        "Well, it wasn't my choice. That blame would fall upon my mother. She moved here when I was a pup. She came from a long line of– eh, merchants, and had some well-established connections to start selling some low supply, high demand and highly frowned upon merchandise."
        
        "So she was a smuggler?" you interject.
        
        "That's one way to put it, if you want to stand in the way of prosperity. But the demand doesn't change just because the fine bovines in the marble halls dislike them. I won't complain, that means us daring entrepreneurs get a bigger cut of the cake. Also, I'll tell you a secret: one reason these people prohibit wares is just to make them more luxurious. You wouldn't want peasants running around with demonic jewelry, would you? Those things are for the fine folks at the top. One of the many secrets my mother told me."
        
        "Did she teach you a lot of things?"
        
        "That she did," Nash responds, sounding a bit distant. "Probably would have ended up in the slammer... or destitute if I didn't inherit her wits. And her stock..."
        
        "Where's she now?"
        
        Nash suddenly goes quiet, and you try to change the subject.
        
        "Oh no, I can talk about it," Nash interrupts. "I've mostly gotten over it; there's no profit moping about the past. My mom was seeing one of those aristocrat bulls. Unfortunately, the bull's wife found out. So that one-eyed bitch sent a bonus in one of the payments: a rattlesnake."
        
        You struggle to say something, and an awkward silence falls upon the room. Nash [nash.domSub
            |puts a finger under your chin and looks at you with his golden gaze, before rubbing his muzzle against your neck
            |cups your face and goads you to lean closer. His golden gaze meets yours, before he rubs his muzzle against your neck
        ].
        
        "After a while, the guards heard a rumor that this fine cow was stocking up on highly illegal contraband." You can feel his fangs nudge at your [pc.skinFurScales], as the wolf-man grins. "Last time I saw her, that no-eyed bitch was sucking off drunks down in the slums."
        
        [pc.dcb
            |You can't deny it, that was well played by Nash
            |You shudder, getting on Nash's bad side sounds like a bad idea
            |You didn't really understand it, except that the cow got luckyyy
        ].
        
        He gives your neck a wt lick, before [nash.domSub
            |sitting up
            |laying down
        ]. "So that's how I got started. Some inheritance from my mom and being in the right place at the right time."
        '

"How's business?" you ask. "It can't be easy with this lockdown." 
        
        "Oh, it's better than ever!" Nash responds. "I've been doubling my income thanks to all the extra security."
        
        "Isn't that causing trouble?"
        
        "Yes. Which is why the price of rare goods, especially luxuries, are becoming incredibly expensive. But if you use your head then it's easy to get stock past the toll. Grease the right palm or [nash.domSub
            |take some desk worker for a ride
            |let some guards bend you over

        "Demons?"
        
        "Spot on, [pc.name]. These fiends leave a lot of interesting artifacts in their wake. Artifacts that can get some top coins if you know the right buyer."
        
        You refrain from prodding further, being a hero and all that, it's probably a bad idea to know too much about [nash.domSub

            |your lover
        ]'s demonic dealings.

rows.original: "These prices are absurd," you say, picking up one of the items on display and holding it in front of him. "Four thousand electrum for this?" "You wound me," Nash says, feigning sorrow. "Alas, but the danger involved in procuring these goods more than justifies the prices. They come from the underbelly of the civilized world, after all." "Uh huh. You mean the slums of Khor'minos, you greasy bastard," you say, eyeing him. "Procuring the goods? I bet you just bought these from Jahiq." You can tell you weren't supposed to know about that. Nash recoils like you've slapped him, eyes widening as you press on. "Then you jack the prices up tenfold and sell them to unsuspecting travelers. I should hand you into the guards," you say. "Operation like this, I'm sure there's a bounty on your head already." "Wait! Wait," he says, holding a hand up. "Alright, shit. Look, I'll give you a cut. And- and a discount. I'll sell the goods to you for the price I paid for them. Sounds fair, right?"

He runs a hand through his hair, no doubt mentally calculating how much money you're going to cost him. "At least you're reasonable. A-and [pc.mascFem|handsome|pretty], too!" "The money," you say. "Right," he says. "How's twenty five percent sound?" "Make it thirty five and you have a deal," you say. "Oh come on, this is my life's savings," he whines. "What about thirty?" "Thirty five or nothing," you say firmly. "Damn it," he sighs, turning away to start counting money. "Got me good." Truth be told, he probably thinks he won that little encounter. You could have taken more but pushing him too hard is just going to make him panic and run away the moment you've turned your back, and you actually fancy having him here to buy from. You don't want to have to make the trip to the slums every time you want this kind of stuff. "Here," he says, handing you a sack full of coin. It's heavy. "Should be around seven thousand five hundred electrum." "If it's not..." you start. "It is!" Nash insists. "What would the point of scamming you now be? Business is doing okay right now and I'd like to stick around. The last thing I need is an angry adventurer setting my shack alight while I'm down here." "Pleasure doing business," you say. "Right. If we're done here..." he says hopefully.

"Thirty five or nothing," you say firmly. "Damn it," he sighs, turning away to start counting money. "Got me good." Truth be told, he probably thinks he won that little encounter. You could have taken more but pushing him too hard is just going to make him panic and run away the moment you've turned your back, and you actually fancy having him here to buy from. You don't want to have to make the trip to the slums every time you want this kind of stuff. "Here," he says, handing you a sack full of coin. It's heavy. "Should be around seven thousand five hundred electrum." "If it's not..." you start. "It is!" Nash insists. "What would the point of scamming you now be? Business is doing okay right now and I'd like to stick around. The last thing I need is an angry adventurer setting my shack alight while I'm down here." "Pleasure doing business," you say. "Right. If we're done here..." he says hopefully.'

rows.original: "For god's sake, Nash," you sigh heavily. "You could do better than this." "I can't. I can't," he sobs, ducking his head in shame. "This is all I can do." Your conscience gets the better of you. Taking the majority of his money for yourself, you nonetheless kick the last couple of bags towards him, spilling coins across the floor. "Use that to get a new life started." "A- what? What do you... what do you even want me to do?" he asks, staring dully at the money. "Get out of here and do something more with your life than scamming travelers!" you say angrily. "God damn it, Nash, you're lucky you haven't been killed doing this. Nobody would even find you down here, and do you think anyone is going to come looking? No, they fucking aren't." You crouch down in front of him, looking into the lupine's bleary eyes. "Use the money to start a shop. A real shop. You already know how to run it. Think about it. If you were selling this shit for even just forty, fifty percent markup over what it costs in the slums nobody would even think twice — they'd probably thank you for not having to make the trip. You don't have to scam people to get by." "I have a bounty on my head," he mutters. "Then leave," you say. "Go somewhere else and start a new life. Hell, you could-" Inspiration strikes.
rows.translation: “看在上帝的份上，纳什，”你沉重地叹了口气，“你本可以做得比这更好。” “我不能。我不能，”他啜泣着，羞愧地低下头，“我能做的就只有这些了。” 你的良心占了上风。你拿走了他的大部分钱，却还是把最后几袋钱踢向他，硬币散落一地。“用那些钱去开始新生活吧。” “啊——什么？你……你到底想让我做什么？”他问道，呆呆地望着那些钱。 “滚出这里，去做点比欺骗旅行者更有意义的事！”你愤怒地说道，“该死的，纳什，你干这种事没被杀掉已经算走运了。在下面这种地方根本没人会找到你，你觉得会有人来找你吗？不，他们他妈的根本不会。” 你蹲在他面前，望进那个狼族浑浊的双眼。“用这笔钱开家店。一家真正的店。你早就知道该怎么经营。想想看，就算你只按贫民区的进货价加价四成、五成卖这些东西，也没人会多想——他们大概还会感谢你，让他们不必跑那一趟。你不必靠骗人为生。” “我头上有悬赏，”他嘟囔道。 “那就离开，”你说，“去别的地方开始新生活。见鬼，你完全可以——” 灵感突然降临。

rows.original:
"... You could move to Hawkethorne," you say slowly, as if testing the idea verbally. "Yeah. There's plenty of opportunity in a town like that."

                "Hawkethorne," he mumbles.
                
                "Yeah. I could even help you get on your feet when you're there," you say.
                
                He stares at you for a few seconds. "You come into my shop... rob me blind... tell me to leave my home, and the place you want me to go is where you live?"
                
                "From where I'm sitting, it looks like the best thing you can do," you say, rising to leave.
                
                "And if I don't, and just go back to what I was doing?" Nash says.
                
                "Then I'll feel a bit regretful when I hear you turned up dead," you say over your shoulder. You glance back at him one last time as you climb the staircase and he's still staring at the coins on the hay-strewn floor.
rows.translation:
“……你可以搬去鹰棘镇，”你缓缓说道，像是在用言语试探这个想法。“对。那样的镇子里有很多机会。”

                “鹰棘镇，”他喃喃道。
                
                “对。你到了那里，我甚至可以帮你站稳脚跟，”你说道。
                
                他盯着你看了几秒。“你闯进我的店……把我抢得一干二净……叫我离开家乡，然后要我搬去你住的地方？”
                
                “从我的角度看，这是你最好的选择，”你起身准备离开时说道。
                
                “要是我不走，继续干以前那些事呢？”纳什问道。
                
                “那等我听说你横尸街头时，大概会有点遗憾，”你回头说道。你登上楼梯，最后看了他一眼；他仍然盯着铺满干草的地板上的硬币。

"- easily find another town to live in. Nobody from Khor'minos is going to run you down for whatever your paltry bounty is."

                "Gee, thanks for the lesson," Nash mumbles.
                
                "Be glad this one came cheap," you tell him.
                
                He stays silent, and you rise to leave. You glance back at him on the staircase and he's still staring at the coins on the hay-strewn floor.

“——你很容易就能找到另一个城镇住下。科尔米诺斯的人不会为了你那点微不足道的赏金来追杀你。”

                “哎呀，多谢你的教诲，”纳什嘟囔道。
                
                “庆幸这一课你花的代价不大吧，”你对他说。
                
                他沉默不语，你起身离开。你在楼梯上回头看了他一眼，他仍盯着散落在铺满干草的地上的那些硬币。

rows.original:
"I don't care about your crocodile tears, Nash," you say. "Your story's about as trustworthy as everything else about you. Give me the money."

            "Just take it," he says dully. "I don't care any more."
            
            You put sack after sack of coin into your backpack as Nash watches in silence, stopping only when you've discovered every last bit of wealth he'd had hidden away.
            
            "Hopefully this was a learning experience for you," you muse.
            
            He stares at you balefully. "Get out."
            
            You glance back as you leave by the staircase, and the last you see of Nash is the look of a man utterly defeated — shoulders hunched, staring down at his hands in his lap.[party.has cait|Cait stops and fumbles with a coin pouch at her own waist, cutting it loose and tossing it at his feet before walking past you in tears.|]
rows.translation:
我才不在乎你那些假惺惺的眼泪呢，纳什，”你说，“你的故事跟你说的其他一切一样不可信。把钱给我。”

            “随你拿去吧，”他漠然地说，“我已经无所谓了。
            
            你把一袋又一袋的硬币装进背包，而纳什则默默地注视着你，直到你找出了他藏起来的所有财富，他才停止了注视。
            
            “希望这次经历能让你有所收获吧，”你自言自语道。
            
            他恶狠狠地盯着你，说道：“滚出去。”
            
            当你沿着楼梯离开时，你回头看了一眼，纳什留给你的最后一幕，是一个彻底被击败的男人——他双肩弯曲，低头盯着自己放在膝上的双手。[party.has cait|凯特停了下来，摸索着自己腰间的钱袋，解开它，把钱袋扔到他的脚边，然后含泪从你身边走开了。|]

rows.original: You don't want a cut or care about his discounts. Take all of his money.
rows.translation: 你不要分成，也不在乎他的折扣。拿走他所有的钱。
rows.raw: "You don't want a cut or care about his discounts. Take all of his money."

rows.original:
"I'll take your discount but I don't want a lump sum. Give me a cut of your sales every week and I won't hand you in to the guards," you say.

        "Wh- that's extortion!" Nash says in disbelief. "I can't operate with someone taking a chunk of my earnings every week. I'll go broke!"
        
        "I doubt it. With markups like this you're making ten coins for every one you spend," you say. "Now you'll be making eight. Not so big of a difference, is it?"
        
        "Sometimes I go weeks without selling anything," he says, spreading his arms. "I'm not stupid. Three weeks of no sales and you'll hand me over to the guards, looking for a payday. Look, I'll give you- I'll give you thirty percent of what I've got currently. One time payment. It's a lot of money. Six and a half thousand electrum. A-and you keep the discount. What do you say?"
        
        Hmm. He really doesn't want this hanging over his head.
rows.translation:
我接受你的折扣，但我不希望一次性付清全部款项。每周从我销售额中抽取一部分吧，这样我就不会告发你了。”你说道。

        “这……这简直就是敲诈！”纳什难以置信地说道，“如果有人每周都要从我这里拿走一部分收入，我根本无法继续做生意。我肯定会破产的！”
        
        “我可不这么认为。以这样的利润率，你每花费一枚硬币，就能赚到十枚，对吧？现在你只能赚到八枚而已。差别其实并不大，不是吗？”
        
        “有时候我好几周都卖不出任何东西，”他摊开双手说道。我又不傻。三周都没有任何销售额，你们就打算把我交给守卫，等着拿回你们的报酬吧。听着，我愿意给你们——我愿意把我现在拥有的东西的百分之三十交给你们，一次性付清。那可是很多钱啊，六千五百枚琥珀金币。那么你就可以继续享受这个折扣了。你觉得怎么样？”
        
        “嗯，他确实不想让这件事一直困扰着他。

"Well... fine," Nash says, sighing in mixed relief and dismay. "As long as you don't hound me about it." "The money," you say. "Right," he says. rows.original:
"You know, I could just take all of your money," you say levelly, looking Nash in the eye. "But I think the recurring payment is more sustainable."

            "Yeah, great," Nash grumbles. "Fine. But I'm warning you now, it's not going to be as much as you want."
            
            "Twenty percent a week seems fine," you say.
            
            "Well, this week that's two thousand electrum," he replies, reaching back into the bales of hay behind him and fishing out some pouches full of coins. "Here."
            
            "How do I know this is twenty percent?" you say.
            
            "The same way I know you aren't going to hand me into the guards," Nash says.
            
            "Touché," you say. "Fine, then. If you've made ten thousand this week I don't think this is quite as unsustainable as you say it is."
            
            "If just two more people like you show up I'm broke," he says flatly. "And then nobody gets anything. I have expenses that aren't just purchasing goods. Goodwill costs a lot of money in the slums."
            
            "Especially when you're a scammer by trade," you say. "Cost of doing business, huh?"

rows.translation:
“你知道，我完全可以直接把你的钱全都拿走，”你平心静气地说，直视着纳什的眼睛。“但我觉得定期分成更可持续。”

            “行吧，太好了，”纳什嘟囔道。“好吧。但我现在得提醒你，这笔钱不会像你希望的那样多。”
            
            “每周百分之二十就行，”你说。
            
            “嗯，这周那就是两千枚琥珀金币，”他回答道，伸手到身后的干草捆里摸出几袋满满的硬币。“给。”
            
            “我怎么知道这就是百分之二十？”你说。
            
            “就像我知道你不会把我交给守卫一样，”纳什说。
            
            “说得妙，”你说。“那好吧。如果你这周赚了一万，我倒不觉得这有你说的那么不可持续。”
            
            “只要再来两个像你这样的人我就破产了，”他面无表情地说。“到那时谁也拿不到东西。我的开销可不只是进货。在贫民区，人情往来也是要花不少钱的。”
            
            “尤其是干诈骗这一行的时候，”你说。“这就是做生意的成本，对吧？”
            
            “好。那么，要是这儿没别的事了……”纳什满怀希望地说。

rows.original: [flags.NASH_BROWSE |You don't know why you're back here. There's nothing amongst this peddler's useless wares that you want, and even if there was, it's all absurdly priced – they're all tourist trap baubles and doodads with little practical use. Well... that's not totally true. There's one thing here that you just couldn't get off your mind. |The prices that 'Nash' is demanding for the knicks and knacks he has available are obscene. Even if you did want something here, you'd have better luck looking for cheaper prices elsewhere – or you could just hunt them down yourself. You idly browse his shelves, pretending to be window-shopping, though in reality, you're just trying to make your escape look a little more nonchalant – put in some 'honest' effort in looking through his things, then bowing out later. You don't expect to find anything you actually want. Except... one thing does catch your eye. ] Amongst the herbs and eggs that Nash has available, one thing stands out as being particularly unnoteworthy. Something metal, rusted, and neglected. It has a fairly plain design: the handle is only large enough for your index finger, and the body is wide enough that you could squeeze the whole thing in your hand. It has a flared base to keep it steady when set on a flat surface; the spout has a slight curve upward, ending in an open point for a flame to wick from; and its cap, perhaps its most ornate feature, is a small disc with a number of ornamental carvings and etches strewn about its rim, with a simple, rusted chain going from it to the handle to keep it from getting misplaced. Adorned on top of the cap is a gemstone, but it's been crusted with dirt and mud, hiding whatever value it might truly have. All in all, it's not an impressive thing, and frankly, you wonder what it's doing among Nash's otherwise-consistent set of wares. "Ah, you have quite the discerning eye, my friend!" Nash says jovially, immediately intruding into your personal space. "Though the lamp you hold may not look like much now, my friend, in truth, this christened, fire-forged relic, made of the purest of golds and dressed with the finest of rubies, once sat on the personal nightstand of Chieftain... Kalgraus, a famed and fierce orc warlord! I was merely attempting to cross the plains between the western civilizations and the Undermountain, my friend, when his scouting party intercepted me and brought me to his personal quarters. Chieftain Galkraus, though, he was an affable, reasonable fellow – and rather handsome, if I say so myself – and after a lighthearted exchange, he bid me passage through the remainder of the journey, unmolested. Yet, as I sat in his quarters, I saw the very lamp you hold now, and I asked the chieftain about it. He told me stories of how he would often use its cauldron to hold the finest of aromatic and-or medicinal herbs, to be ensure that he would be granted the finest of rests, or for even the most congested of noses to be cleared before dawn had broken. So, then, you may be asking: 'Nash, my friend, if Chieftain Calqraus was so enamored with this beautiful, and functional, piece of art, then why would he bequeath it to you?' And the answer, my curious friend, is that I had coveted it myself – but the chieftain was a wily one, and he would only part with his beloved lamp for a hefty sum. It cost me all the profits I had made earlier in my trip! Yet, for you, my friend, I am willing to part with this lamp for, nay, but a fraction of the cost!" You tuned out almost immediately. Out of curiosity, you flip open the lid and peer inside – and, as expected, the find charred, blackened ash sitting on the bottom of the cauldron, and a thick, pungent smell of used drugs wafts into your nose. "The price I paid for this lamp was immense, my friend, but for you, I would part with this piece of history for a paltry one-hundred coins." Of course. Still, you have to admit... you're kind of curious. Give it a wash; feed it a wick; give it some oil; and you'd have a half decent night light. It's not worth one-hundred coins – it's barely worth five, and most of that would be from the blackened, dirty ruby sitting on its top – but, well, it's there.
rows.translation: [flags.NASH_BROWSE |你根本不明白自己为什么还会回到这里。这个小贩那些毫无用的商品里，根本没有你想要的东西；就算有，价格也高得离谱——那些不过都是些供游客购买的装饰品和小玩意儿，根本没有什么实际用途。 嗯……其实也不完全是这样。有那么一样东西，让你一直念念不忘。 |纳什”对他手中那些小玩意儿要价高得离谱。就算你确实如果你在这里想找到某样东西，还不如去其他地方寻找更便宜的价格——或者你自己动手去寻找吧。 你漫无目的地浏览着他的货架，假装只是在浏览商品，但实际上，你只是想让自己的离开看起来更随意一些——假装认真地翻看他的商品，然后之后再离开。你本来并不指望能找到真正想要的东西。 不过……有那么一样东西除外。确实吸引你的注意。 ]在纳什手头的各种草药和鸡蛋中，有一样东西尤其显得格外重要。不值得注意的是，这个器具是由金属制成的，已经生锈且被长期忽视使用了。它的设计相当简单：把手的大小仅适合容纳你的食指，容器本身也足够宽，你可以将整个器具握在手中。它的下装呈喇叭状，这样放在平面上时就能保持稳定；壶嘴略微向上弯曲，末端呈开口状，方便火焰从其中燃烧出来；而它的盖子，或许也是这个器具最显眼的部分，是一个小圆盘，边缘上分布着许多装饰性的雕刻和花纹，还有一条简单的生锈链条将盖子与把手连接在一起，防止盖子被弄丢。帽顶上镶嵌着一颗宝石，但它已经被灰尘和污垢覆盖，从而掩盖了它可能拥有的真正价值。 总而言之，这并不是什么令人印象深刻的东西。坦白说，你会不禁疑惑：在纳什那些其他方面都相当出色的作品中，这个东西究竟是用来做什么的。 “啊，我的朋友，你的眼轻型还真不错！”纳什欢快地说道，同时立刻侵入了你的个人空间。虽然你手中的这盏灯现在看起来并不显眼，但我的朋友，事实上，这件经过神圣仪式、经过火炼而成的圣物，是由最纯的金子制成，还镶嵌着最精美的红宝石，它曾经摆在酋长的床头柜上。……卡尔格劳斯，那位声名显赫、凶猛残暴的兽人军阀！我的朋友，我当时只是试图穿越西方文明地区与山腹深域之间的平原，结果他的侦察队截住了我，并将我带到了他的私人居所。不过，加尔克劳斯酋长其实是个友善、通情达理的人——说实话，他还挺英俊的——在轻松地交谈之后，他允许我继续完成剩下的旅程，没有对我造成任何困扰。然而，当我坐在他的住处时，我看到了你现在手中的那盏灯，于是我就向酋长询问了关于它的来历。他给我讲过一些故事：他经常会用那个大锅来泡那些最芳香、最具药用价值的草药，这样就能确保自己能够得到最好的休息；甚至是在黎明到来之前，也能让那些最堵塞的鼻子恢复通畅。那么，你可能会问：“纳什，我的朋友，如果卡尔克劳斯酋长如此喜爱这件既美观又实用的艺术品，那他为什么要把它留给你呢？”而答案是，我本人也很想要它——不过那位酋长可是个精明的人，他只会用一笔丰厚的报酬才愿意放弃他心爱的那盏灯。这让我失去了这次旅行中之前赚到的所有利润！然而，为了你，我的朋友，我愿意以远远低于原价的价格将这盏灯卖给你！ 你几乎立刻就不再关注它了。出于好奇，你掀开盖子往里面看——果然，锅底满是烧焦的黑色灰烬，一股浓重的、刺鼻的药物气味扑鼻而来。 “我的朋友，我为这个灯付出了巨大的代价，但为了你，我愿意用这个具有历史意义的物品来换仅仅一百枚硬币。 当然。 不过，你得承认……你其实还是挺好奇的。把它清洗一下，装上灯芯，再滴些油，就能得到一个还算不错的夜灯了。它根本不值一百枚硬币——顶多值五枚，而其中大部分价值其实都来自于放在顶部的那颗被烧黑、弄脏的红宝石——不过，嗯，它确实就在那里。

rows.original:
... What the hell, you have more money than sense. Sure.

        "Excellent!" Nash says, standing there with his fur on end as he watches you count the money out. Once you count out the one-hundredth coin, he snatches the bag of money from your hands, hefting it once. His mouth curls into a huge, toothy grin as he balances the coin pouch on his palm. "No refunds," he's quick to say.
        
        Well... if nothing else, at least you have a decent conversation piece.
rows.translation:
……搞什么啊，你钱多得都不知道该怎么花了，真是的。

        “太棒了！”纳什站在那里，浑身毛发都竖了起来，看着你数钱。当你数到第一百枚硬币时，他迅速从你手中抢过那袋钱，掂了掂重量。他把钱袋放在手掌上，露出一口满口的牙齿，笑了起来：“没有退钱的可能。”
        
        不过……至少你有了一个不错的聊天话题。

rows.original: As you splash over through the shallows, the sheepgirl stares up at you with big amethyst eyes, looking akin to an animal directly caught in the path of a caravan train. In that moment, you wonder if it's fear, recognition, or wonder that you see in that rounded face of hers, and then she heaves a sigh and clutches at the golden mane of wool about her neck. "O-oh! Hello! Can I help you?" Smiling, you close the distance to the skittish sheepgirl and give her a wave. Nothing much, you thought she was cute and wondered if she wouldn't mind some company. You're [pc.name] — what's her name? "Ah! It's you! It's really you! Here in our baths. You had to be someone since you're clearly not local and came in anyway, but I still can't quite believe it's you!" It's you? She's speaking as if she recognizes you, when most people in the city don't. "Well, I don't know know you, but you're the champion that Calise brought in to help the city fight off the invasion, right? There was quite the speech and debate between the king and senators when she proposed as much! It was rather exciting, even if I never got to see it. Miss Arille doesn't care for watching senate sessions," she says with the tone of voice that suggests %"nerve-wracking" would be a far more appropriate word. "But yes! All the policy-makers in Khor'minos know who you are, [pc.name] — miss Calise was very passionate about bringing a hero[pc.mf | |ine ] like you in to help us push back the demons like you did for the elves. That senate session was supposed to be hush-hush, but there are minutes, records and things." Now that you're within arm's reach of the cute little sheepgirl, you reach out and idly stroke the ruff of golden wool about her neck. She's started toying with it while she's speaking, and bows her head a little in embarrassment when your fingers sink into the soft, soggy stuff. Who knew wool doesn't feel that awful when wet, so long as it's still attached to the sheep? Now, she was saying that anyone who's anyone in the city knows who you are. Does she count herself amongst them? "Me? Oh no, oh no. Uh, let me introduce myself. I'm Noire." That doesn't sound like a Minoan name. "It isn't. It's Baranian. I work here at the bathhouse, you see, but I also help Miss Arille with whatever she needs. As Senator Khel'salak's daughter, she's able to demand a lot with her father's name alone..." her eyes rove about the hot room, [var0 |finally settling on Arille by the deep end of the pool. Thankfully, she doesn't seem to have noticed the both of you. "[flags.ARILLE_MET |Uh, we should probably stop talking about Miss Arille behind her back. You know her, don't you?" You give the skittish sheep a solemn nod. Yes, you probably should if you want to remain on good terms with the senator's daughter |Uh, we should probably stop talking. That's miss Arille over there by the deep end... we shouldn't badmouth her behind her back. It would cause trouble." Trouble for her, that is. But you follow Noire's gaze to the cowgirl lounging by the deep end, you can tell at a glance why she's low-key intimidated by her mistress ] |trying to find somewhere safe to rest that isn't on you. "[flags.ARILLE_MET |You've met miss Arille before, haven't you?" You nod. In this very chamber, even. Quite the woman, if you say so |Have you met Miss Arille? My mistr — I mean, my supervisor?" No, you haven't had the pleasure. "She likes the hot room, too, especially in the middle of the night when there aren't as many people around. I have to work, so I can't stay up too late... but miss Arille can do as she pleases. Her father owns the place, after all, and it's not like she's expected to do any work, title or no. That's my job. I guess if you're into pushy women you can wait a bit until I'm gone, she shows up at eight in the evenings and onward." You'll think about it ] ]. So, she works here, then? "Not as one of the attendants, no! I, uh, balance the books, so to speak. It's very long and boring, you wouldn't want to hear it... that, and like I said, I help miss Arille with anything that she needs." Anything? Noire squirms a bit, looking down at the steamy water, and you're not so sure the red in her cheeks is from the heat alone. "Anything." Ah. Well, this isn't about her employer, this is about her. rows.raw: " As you splash over through the shallows, the sheepgirl stares up at you with big amethyst eyes, looking akin to an animal directly caught in the path of a caravan train. In that moment, you wonder if it's fear, recognition, or wonder that you see in that rounded face of hers, and then she heaves a sigh and clutches at the golden mane of wool about her neck. "O-oh! Hello! Can I help you?" Smiling, you close the distance to the skittish sheepgirl and give her a wave. Nothing much, you thought she was cute and wondered if she wouldn't mind some company. You're [pc.name] — what's her name? "Ah! It's you! It's really you! Here in our baths. You had to be someone since you're clearly not local and came in anyway, but I still can't quite believe it's you!" It's you? She's speaking as if she recognizes you, when most people in the city don't. "Well, I don't know know you, but you're the champion that Calise brought in to help the city fight off the invasion, right? There was quite the speech and debate between the king and senators when she proposed as much! It was rather exciting, even if I never got to see it. Miss Arille doesn't care for watching senate sessions," she says with the tone of voice that suggests %"nerve-wracking" would be a far more appropriate word. "But yes! All the policy-makers in Khor'minos know who you are, [pc.name] — miss Calise was very passionate about bringing a hero[pc.mf | |ine ] like you in to help us push back the demons like you did for the elves. That senate session was supposed to be hush-hush, but there are minutes, records and things." Now that you're within arm's reach of the cute little sheepgirl, you reach out and idly stroke the ruff of golden wool about her neck. She's started toying with it while she's speaking, and bows her head a little in embarrassment when your fingers sink into the soft, soggy stuff. Who knew wool doesn't feel that awful when wet, so long as it's still attached to the sheep? Now, she was saying that anyone who's anyone in the city knows who you are. Does she count herself amongst them? "Me? Oh no, oh no. Uh, let me introduce myself. I'm Noire." That doesn't sound like a Minoan name. "It isn't. It's Baranian. I work here at the bathhouse, you see, but I also help Miss Arille with whatever she needs. As Senator Khel'salak's daughter, she's able to demand a lot with her father's name alone..." her eyes rove about the hot room, [var0 |finally settling on Arille by the deep end of the pool. Thankfully, she doesn't seem to have noticed the both of you. "[flags.ARILLE_MET |Uh, we should probably stop talking about Miss Arille behind her back. You know her, don't you?" You give the skittish sheep a solemn nod. Yes, you probably should if you want to remain on good terms with the senator's daughter |Uh, we should probably stop talking. That's miss Arille over there by the deep end... we shouldn't badmouth her behind her back. It would cause trouble." Trouble for her, that is. But you follow Noire's gaze to the cowgirl lounging by the deep end, you can tell at a glance why she's low-key intimidated by her mistress ] |trying to find somewhere safe to rest that isn't on you. "[flags.ARILLE_MET |You've met miss Arille before, haven't you?" You nod. In this very chamber, even. Quite the woman, if you say so |Have you met Miss Arille? My mistr — I mean, my supervisor?" No, you haven't had the pleasure. "She likes the hot room, too, especially in the middle of the night when there aren't as many people around. I have to work, so I can't stay up too late... but miss Arille can do as she pleases. Her father owns the place, after all, and it's not like she's expected to do any work, title or no. That's my job. I guess if you're into pushy women you can wait a bit until I'm gone, she shows up at eight in the evenings and onward." You'll think about it ] ]. So, she works here, then? "Not as one of the attendants, no! I, uh, balance the books, so to speak. It's very long and boring, you wouldn't want to hear it... that, and like I said, I help miss Arille with anything that she needs." Anything? Noire squirms a bit, looking down at the steamy water, and you're not so sure the red in her cheeks is from the heat alone. "Anything." Ah. Well, this isn't about her employer, this is about her. And by the looks of it, Noire's overshadowed all the time by said employer... sure, the sheepgirl's still skittish, but for a very different reason than when you first arrived on the scene. Maybe she'd like more of your company? "

rows.translation: 听听诺瓦尔对于你让她怀孕这件事有什么要说的吧。
rows.raw: "Listen to what Noire has to say about you knocking her up."

rows.original: You can't ask Noire about her pregnancy if she's not with child at the moment.
rows.translation: 如果诺瓦尔目前并没有怀孕，你就不能问她关于怀孕的事情。
rows.raw: "You can't ask Noire about her pregnancy if she's not with child at the moment."

rows.original: [rand |"It's all right, I guess." Just all right? "Ever since the Godswar, the kings of Khor'minos have ordered a healthy stockpile of just about everything one could need to be put away in the caverns below the city. They learned their lesson from what happened two centuries ago... long story short, even if all of the farms were to lie fallow, which isn't the case, it would take years for the city to work its way through the all the non-perishables that've been put away. No citizen of the city's going to go hungry, because if things really drag out that long the legions would have been defeated." And it's impossible that the legions should face defeat. "Yes." A moment's hesitation. "Like I said, [pc.name], on the chance that they are, then nothing would matter anyway, so. Besides, they've got the likes of you, Calise, and all the other heroes fighting on our side. We'll be fine." She said no citizen of Khor'minos was going to go hungry. What about the non-citizens? Noire looks completely nonplussed at that. "What about them? The slums have always been on the brink of starvation, and nothing's changed in that regard. That place has always been bad, and it's not like any of them pay any taxes to begin with." ...You ought to have known that asking about the war, but perhaps you should change the topic to avoid spoiling the mood. |"The legions are very well treated. You don't see it very often, but there's a private path in the back that we let out for gatherings, events, that kind of thing. Ever since the siege started, miss Arille's father has been kind enough to prepare it for any legions who've just come in from duty. They arrive every two days and get pretty rowdy as legionnaires are wont to do when out of uniform, so it's best to keep them away from everyone. There's a lot of emotion to be worked out, you see." You can imagine. Do they get to bathe for free, then? Like the deal that the public currently has in the run-up to the senate elections? "Yes, but not for the same reason — miss Arille's father has a different contract with the legions. After all, he did serve his time like just about every patrician family out there. At the end of the day, coming back to a bath in welcoming civilization is just about a dream come true for many of them as it was for him in his time. He's even ordered bath salts for the water, which is quite the luxury for a whole pool. I should know — I've seen the numbers while doing the procurement myself." Bath salts for off-duty legions? Noire smiles. "Not quite what you'd expect, but they like it a lot. Good for sore muscles and healing wounds, and the smell really calms one down after days of harrowing demons. I'm not fully sure where they're coming from, but I think they're being dredged out from some of the mineral lakes down in the lower caverns. You'd have to ask miss Arille's father for more details. "But they certainly have a lot of fun in there! Either they bring in their own cows, or there're always a couple of girls in the cold or hot rooms who're willing to have a dalliance with a bunch of strapping young legionnaires. No end of the eager and willing in the city, especially with people pent-up as they are — the circus may be running at full tilt, but it can only do so much! Cleaning up the private baths afterwards might be a bit of a hassle, but anyone pulling that duty is well-paid and certainly isn't complaining." |"You know what they say about conflict — that it brings a people together more easily than anything else." Does she think that's true, then? "I can't speak for the common citizenry, but sitting in with miss Arille during senate sessions and hearing her father debate, it's completely unprecedented that every single senator so far has been in favor of just about all the issues that the king has put forth. There hasn't been a unanimous vote on anything in living history according to the records I was able to get my hands on, but it's not just one bill they've passed unquestioningly, but everything relating to the war." Is it that surprising? The eastern lakeshore is littered with the remains of what used to be a getaway for the wealthy upper class. For once, their estates are threatened; it'd be silly for them to not want to mobilise the legion into protecting them and theirs, even if they hold the common citizenry in contempt. "You'd be surprised," Noire says with a sigh. "Something as sensible as replacing the plumbing that led to their very own homes? Took three whole day-long sessions and many impassioned speeches before it finally passed. Sometimes I think they drag things on for that long just to give the impression that they're actually doing anything productive... which is why the speed with which they're stamping their approval on anything related to this war is still surprising. Like miss Arille says, they couldn't tear their way out of a damp sack from the inside." So if it's not the senators fearing for their own lives and property, what does she think is the real reason behind this sudden show of unity by the senate? A shrug. "I don't know, [pc.name]. Maybe it's a natural sheepish skittishness, but I just don't have a good feeling about it. The senators are usually at each others' throats and some of the power blocs and grudges run deep for generations; it may be the first time since the Godswar that Khor'minos has faced an actual military threat, but seeing them vote unanimously not just on one, but multiple matters rubs me the wrong way." |"Am I concerned about the war? Well, I would be, and I imagine the same would go for just about everyone in the city. But let's be frank about it: the legions make up the strongest standing army in all of the Marches since the Godswar, [pc.name], and they're doing all they can. If they were to lose, what do you think someone like me would be able to do? Everyone running the bathhouse — miss Arille, her father, me, the cleaners, the masseuses — we do what we can for the returning troops, put their minds at ease and keep their morale high before they have to go out into the tunnels again. "But as for the actual fighting, or how things are going down in the caves? That's up to them, and you, and miss Calise, and... well, you get the idea." Do you? Noire leans over on her seat and gives you a little kiss. "People go to the circus to be entertained and forget their troubles, [pc.name]. Me? I just realize that they're not troubles to begin with, that's all. There's nothing I can do about this war... if the demons were to defeat the legion and come all the way to the gates? Well, I suppose I'd just die, or worse." The completely blase way cute little Noire says it is unsettling, to say the least. You run your fingers through the little sheepgirl's floofy golden mane, and she shakes her head and gives you a small smile. "Would it make you feel better if I pretended to panic instead?" No, you'd rather not have that, but... it doesn't feel natural. "I don't have any illusions, [pc.name]. I'm the pampered servant of a young noblewoman from a family who was bought as slaves and brought in for their docility. I've never actually done a single iota of hard labor in my entire life, [noire.numKids 1 |save for... well, the obvious |and wouldn't last a minute anywhere else ]." Maybe... maybe you should change the topic. While you didn't expect sweets and roses talking about the war and ongoing siege, this is turning a little too dark for you, especially when Noire is usually the most adorable thing ever. "I do help miss Arille and her father with senate matters, you know. But if you're that worried about me[noire.numKids 1 | and the kids ], do your best out there, okay? I keep on hearing news about all your achievements in service of the city, so you're making quite the name for yourself." ]
rows.translation: [rand |我想，应该没什么问题吧。” 就只是没什么问题而已？ “自从那场神战之后，科尔米诺斯的国王们就下令在城下的洞穴里储备各种可能需要的物资，数量要充足。他们从两个世纪前发生的事情中吸取了教训……长话短说，即使所有的农场都停止耕作（但实际上并非如此），这座城市也需要花费数年时间才能处理掉那些被储存起来的非易腐食品。这个城市的任何公民都不会挨饿，因为如果事情真的拖得那么久，军团早就被击败了。 而军团被击败的可能性根本不存在。 “没错。稍作犹豫……”正如我所说， [pc.name]，就算他们真的是那样的话，也无所谓了，反正一切都无所谓。而且，还有你、卡莉丝以及所有其他的英雄站在我们这一边，我们一定会没事的。” 她还说，科尔米诺斯的每一个公民都不会挨饿。那些非公民呢？ 诺瓦听到这个问题后显得十分困惑：“他们又怎么样？那些贫民区一直以来都处于饥饿的边缘，这种情况根本没有改变。那个地方本来就很糟糕，而且他们中的大多数人本来就不用缴纳任何税款。……你本来应该知道，问关于战争的事情会破坏气氛的，不过或许你应该换个话题，以免破坏当前的氛围。 |这些军团成员受到了非常好的待遇。虽然不常有人注意到，但在后面有一条私人通道，我们会开放它用来举办聚会或各种活动。自从围城开始以来，阿莉尔小姐的父亲一直非常慷慨，为每一位刚从任务中返回的军团成员准备好了这个通道。他们每两天就会到来一次，而且由于军团成员在脱下军装后往往会变得比较喧闹，所以最好把他们与其他人隔离开来。毕竟，他们有很多情绪需要宣泄，你懂的。 你可以想象，那么他们是不是可以免费洗澡呢？就像目前在参议院选举前夕公众所享有的那种待遇吧？ “是的，但原因不同——阿莉尔小姐的父亲与军团签订了不同的协议。毕竟，他和几乎所有贵族家庭一样，都履行了自己的义务。归根结底，对于他们中的许多人来说，重新回到这个充满文明与关爱的环境中，简直就是美梦成真——就像他当年所经历的那样。他甚至为泳池的水购置了浴盐，对于整个泳池来说，这可真是相当奢侈的做法。我当然知道——因为我自己负责采购时见过相关数据。 给休息中的军团成员准备的浴盐吗？” 诺瓦尔笑了笑：“其实和你们想象的不太一样，但他们非常喜欢。这种浴盐对缓解肌肉酸痛、促进伤口愈合很有效果，而且那种香味在经历了连续几天的艰苦战斗后，确实能让人们放松下来。我不太清楚这些浴盐的具体来源，但我觉得它们应该是从地下洞穴中的某些矿泉湖里提取出来的。更多细节的话，你们还是得去问问阿莉尔小姐的父亲吧。 但他们在那里肯定玩得很开心！要么他们会自带奶牛，要么在那些寒冷或炎热的房间里，总会有几个女孩愿意和一群健壮的年轻军团士兵调情。这座城市里，有无数热心且愿意帮忙的人，尤其是那些长期被压抑的人们——虽然马戏团正在全力以赴地运作，但它所能承受的负担也是有限的！之后清理那些私人浴场可能会有些麻烦，但那些负责这项工作的人报酬丰厚，当然也不会有怨言。" |你知道人们是怎么说冲突的吧——它比任何其他东西都能更有效地让人们团结在一起。” 那么，她是否认为这是真的呢？ “我无法代表普通民众发表意见，但当我和阿莉尔小姐一起参加参议院会议，听她的父亲进行辩论时，我发现一个现象：迄今为止，每一位参议员都对国王提出的几乎所有议题都表示支持，这种情况实在是前所未有。根据我所能获得的资料，在人类历史上，没有任何一项决议是获得全体成员一致通过的。他们并非只是毫无异议地通过了某一项法案，而是与这场战争相关的所有决议都是如此。 这有那么令人惊讶吗？东部的湖岸边散落着那些曾经属于富裕上层阶级的度假胜地的遗迹。这一次，他们的财产面临着威胁；如果他们还不加以重视，那可就太愚蠢了。不是你会感到惊讶的，”诺瓦尔叹息道，“像更换那些通往他们自己家的管道这样简单而明智的事情，他们竟然也会拒绝。经过了整整三天的会议以及许多充满激情的演讲，这项决议终于获得了通过。有时候我觉得，他们把事情拖得那么久，只是为了给人一种他们在真正采取行动的印象罢了…… 这就是为什么他们如此迅速地批准与这场战争有关的任何事情，实在令人惊讶。正如阿莉尔小姐所说，他们简直就像被困在潮湿的袋子里，根本无法逃脱。 那么，如果不是参议员们担心自己的生命和财产安全，她认为原因是什么呢？是参议院之所以突然表现出这种团结一致的态度，真正的原因是什么呢？ “耸了耸肩，说道：‘我不知道。 [pc.name]也许这是一种天生的羞怯和紧张感，但我就是觉得这件事不太对劲。参议员们通常互相争斗不休，一些势力集团之间的恩怨也已经持续了好几代人；虽然自从“神战”以来，科尔米诺斯可能还是第一次面临真正的军事威胁，但看到他们在不止一项议题上都投了赞成票，实在让我觉得有些可疑。 |我是否应该为这场战争感到担忧呢？嗯，我肯定会担心，我想这座城市里的几乎每个人都会这么想。但让我们坦诚一点：自从神战之后，这些军团就已经成为了整个边境地区最强大的常备军了。 [pc.name]，他们正在尽自己所能。如果他们失败了，你觉得像我这样的人能做些什么呢？经营这个澡堂的所有人——阿莉尔小姐、她的父亲、我、清洁工们、按摩师们——我们都在为归来的士兵们尽力，让他们放松心情，保持高昂的士气，这样他们才能再次投入到隧道里的战斗中。 但至于实际的战斗，或者洞穴里发生了什么？那就取决于他们、你，还有卡莉丝小姐……嗯，你应该明白我的意思吧。” 你明白吗？ 诺瓦尔在座位上倾身过来，轻轻吻了你一下。人们去看马戏团，就是为了获得娱乐，忘却自己的烦恼。 [pc.name]我？我只是突然意识到，这些麻烦本来就不是由我引起的，仅此而已。对于这场战争，我无能为力……如果恶魔真的击败了军团，然后一路攻打到城门面前怎么办？嗯，我想我只会死，或者遭遇更糟的事情吧。这位完全不谙世故、可爱至极的小诺瓦尔这样说话，至少可以说，让人感到有些不安。你用手指轻轻抚摸着这位小羊女那蓬松的金色长发，而她则会摇摇头，然后对你露出一个微笑。 如果我假装自己也很慌张，这样会让你感觉好一些吗？” “不，你其实并不希望看到这样的场景，但是……这样做感觉有点不自然。” “我并没有任何幻想， [pc.name]我是那位出身于被买来作为奴隶、因其温顺而受到宠爱的年轻贵族小姐的贴身仆从。实际上，在我的整个人生中，我从未做过半点苦活。 [noire.numKids 1 |为……节省开支，嗯，这个理由大家都能理解吧。 |而在其他任何地方，这种状态都维持不了一分钟。 ]也许……也许你应该换个话题吧。虽然你没料到谈论战争和持续不断的围攻会如此轻松愉快，但现在的氛围确实有点太沉重了，尤其是考虑到诺瓦尔通常都是最可爱、最讨人喜欢的角色。 “我确实会帮阿莉尔小姐和她父亲处理参议院事务，你知道的。不过，如果你真的那么担心我[noire.numKids 1 | 还有孩子们 ]在外面一定要尽力而为，好吗？我不断听到关于你为这座城市所做的种种贡献的报道，你确实为自己赢得了很高的声誉。 ]

rows.original: "Oh! I, uh — " Noire raises a hand to her cheek and blushes, while the other fiddles with her mane of fine wool. "Well, there isn't anything wrong with it, my wool's been growing out by the day of late and it's hard to maintain this style without a lot of clipping and shaving; I do have to look my best while out on business, after all." That, and [noire.pregStage 2 5 |it's going to be hard to reach some places with that big, lamb-filled belly of hers, isn't it? Those little tufts of golden wool that she keeps near her ankles have to be hard to reach; you can tell that she's letting them grow out and get a little messier than what she usually does. "O-oh! It's that noticeable?" Clutching her pregnant belly, Noire hyperventilates on the spot and looks like she's going to have a panic attack before you take the flighty little sheep by the shoulders and shake her gently. "I didn't think it would be that bad, but miss Arille can't help me with the shearing as often as she'd like." The baths are no place to raise a child — the obvious hazards of the pools and furnace aside, you know as well as I do what goes on in the rooms and corridors." Noire coughs, blushing a little. "That, and it's safer in the inner city. We are at war, after all, even if it's the legions who mostly go out to meet it." She does have time to see to the kid, right? "Miss Arille gives me mornings off to tend to that. For some reason, her schedule's gotten a lot more free of late, so I'm usually able to finish up all the work in between noon and evening. She's the kind of mistress who doesn't insist on people hanging around just for the sake of doing so once the job is done, and I'm very thankful for that." Well, if one wants to take a cynical view of things Arille's just securing her investment, but you know that she's got a soft interior under that haughty noblewoman's mask. She wouldn't have allowed this whole thing in the first place if she didn't care for Noire or you, for that matter. "Oh no. My father was allowed to stay on the estate after he was born, and so was I... where else would we go? Even slaves who manage to get married one way or the other have the privilege of having their children housed by their masters, much less to speak of loyal servants. While it wouldn't be forbidden, miss Arille and her family would be looked down upon by the other patricians if she wouldn't take proper care of her household." |"Our child is just such a dear," Noire says a little wistfully, raising a hand to her reddening cheeks. "Waking up in the morning to the sound of soft breathing and mewling... sure, motherhood has its ups and downs, but that's to be expected, anyway." If sheepfolk lambs are anything like the grown-ups, they've got to be extraordinarily docile. That's a plus, right? Noire giggles and squeezes your arm. "Well, I've never actually had to take care of anyone before, so it's a bit scary. But the old nursemaid who used to take care of miss Arille and myself when we were younger has been very helpful in showing me a lot of how things are done. Sure, I would've figured it out for myself in time, but she's made it a lot easier for me. It's important to keep knowledge like that relevant — that sort of stuff doesn't come from books, not that many people can actually read." Or to look at it from another angle, it's nice to have other people help with the child-rearing so that one can get on with much more fun process of child-making. "I wouldn't say it's necessarily more fun, but it's very, very enjoyable. Not that I'd want to do it with anyone but you at this point... it's pretty hard to top a champion working with miss Calise in the glorious defense of the city, isn't it?" Well, there's the city, but here and now, you're considerably more motivated to defend [noire.pregStage 1 |her |her and the baby you put inside of her belly ]. Having a personal touch to things always makes them more important, wouldn't she agree? "Oh, I'm certainly looking forward to feeling a lot more of your personal touch, [pc.name]... when things settle down a bit, first thing I'm doing is taking you to see our child. You can count on that." |"It feels rather strange and amazing at the same time to be able to hold our child and be proud of what we made together. I've gone to all kinds of entertainments with miss Arille, but none of them hold a candle to every morning when I come in to see the little lamb and are greeted with a big smile and a lot of babbling. It's just so cute." Any chance that you might get to hold your kids with her for a bit and share a little in that joy? "Well... the estate isn't just letting anyone in or out, not with a siege going on. Most common people don't act like there's one going on, but the patricians are all keenly aware of it, especially in the inner city. They are all responsible for the legions, after all." So that's a no? "I didn't say that! You shouldn't be deprived of such a thing... I guess I could always take the little tyke out to see you. That should work, I don't think anyone would be against it. You could ask me, and we could spend the evening together for a bit as a family. Wouldn't that be nice?" ] |[rand |"You know, there are some who would say that having children during a siege is irresponsible. Those same people are still going to the circuses and drinking themselves silly while demons are roaming the mountain tunnels and the legion is out there bravely fighting on our behalf. I think what I'm doing is just a bit more important than keeping the naval battles in the colosseum going during what's supposed to be a crisis, so there. People keep on doing what they're going to be doing, circumstances or not, and what I'm doing means that I have hope for the future and that everything will turn out all right. How could it be otherwise, with people like miss Calise and you fighting alongside our brave legions?" Or maybe after having given birth more than once now, she's gotten addicted to bearing children from start to finish and can't stop even if she wanted to. And let's face it, why should she want to? A little dreamy smile crosses Noire's expression, and she raises a finger to her lips. "As miss Arille likes to say, one should embrace the amazing power of 'and', [pc.name]. I can be addicted to having your children... and I can also love you at the same time. Now isn't that reason enough?" It indeed is a reason that you can't quite argue against... |Come to think of it, now that Noire's had more than one child by you, is there any end to this train that she has in mind? Well, more practically speaking, is there any end to this train that Arille has in mind? "I don't want to stop and neither has miss Arille said anything about slowing down." It's just... well. Her mistress is the one who's paying for feeding and clothing her children, as well as putting a roof over their heads. If she's looking to Noire to produce loyal servants for her descendants' households, that also raises the question of how many Arille herself intends to be making. It isn't a bad idea from a utilitarian point of view given how submissive and [silly |breedable |obedient ] sheepfolk are by reputation, but... ...Oh, does it matter? Noire's clearly enjoying herself, and so are you. Might as well take the opportunity to have fun while you can. "Don't worry about it so much," Noire says, cuddling up against you and pressing her thick collar of fluffy golden wool into your side. "I have faith in you, and I'm more than happy to keep on bearing your children as long as you're willing to keep on putting them inside of me. It makes me so happy to be able to spend mornings with them before I have to go off to settle the day's affairs at noon... I've been worrying a lot less about the siege and everything these days, and even miss Arille says I'm looking a lot happier. Trusted servants." Like her. Well, you shouldn't be surprised, given that one of the reasons Khor'minos is such a vast sprawl is because of the virility and fertility of its primary people, it stands to reason that their society should be accommodating of large families, even those of slaves. While it's a little disquieting, perhaps, that Arille didn't set any upper limit on the number of kids she expected Noire to produce for her, you're not one to question how the minotaurs run their society, are you? ] ] "

rows.original:
Taking Noire aside, you ask the sheepgirl if there's any chance you could see your kid[noire.numKids 2|s]. While you understand it's not likely that you'll be allowed free entry into a senator's estate, she can always bring them out to see you, isn't that right?
    
    The petite sheepgirl looks contemplative at that. "W-well... it''ll be a bit late and the little one will mostly be asleep. At the same time, I understand how much you want to see our child[noire.numKids 2|ren] and you shouldn't be disallowed contact with them, even if they're going to be too sleepy to do much. Sure, then!"
    
    You take it she's going to go out into the streets, back to the inner city and fetch [noire.numKids 1|your lamb|one of the lambs]. When she puts it that way... she'll be fine[noire.pregStage 2
        | waddling through the streets
    ], right?
    
    Noire smiles at that. "Khor'minos is large enough that the city never sleeps, [pc.name]. There won't be any problems. I'll be back within the hour."
    
    Blowing you a kiss, Noire breaks away from your side and slips out of the room. You find a seat at the table and make yourself comfortable, hearing the muffled noises of the bathhouse's evening clientele come up to you through the walls — minutes feel like hours as the moments drag on, the corner of your gaze fixed upon the door, waiting for Noire to return any time now... 
    
    ...Which she eventually does, after a little less than an hour's wait. There's a click at the door, and the little sheepgirl slides her way back in, a little wrapped-up bundle [noire.pregStage 2
        |balanced in her arms atop her round pregnant belly. There's something to be said for that much fecundity in one place, a heavily pregnant woman cradling a young child, that makes you want to keep her that way for as long as her body can hold out
        |cradled in her arms. She looks a perfect picture of cuteness and cleanliness, but at the same time looking at her with a baby in her hands just makes you want to put another into her belly
    ]... 
    
    "Sorry to keep you waiting, the streets were crowded even at this time of evening," Noire says with a smile as she settles into the seat beside you. "But look! [noire.numKids 2|One of your children. I'm afraid that's all I could carry out, but the trip was absolutely worth it|Your child]! Isn't he just a dear?"
    
    You peek down at the tiny figure bundled up in Noire's arms, and can't help but smile. The little lamb has his mother's golden wool, the stuff sprouting from his skin in a fine, warm fuzz; a round, chubby face and large amethyst eyes like his mother's complete the set along with a pair of nubby sheep horns. Will they be large, curly things like his mother's, perfect for use as handlebars? Only time will tell, one supposes.
    
    While the kid still looks largely sleepy and uninterested in his surroundings, he nevertheless still makes an effort to grasp your finger when you offer it to him. The warm feel of that tiny finger wrapping about your fingertip... there's that feeling of pride in your heart, similar to, but not the same as the fuzzy goodness that you felt in the same place when you were making this little tyke with his mother... 
    
    You feel Noire's gaze upon you, and raise your eyes to hers. The little sheepgirl's lips are pursed, the poor dear herself trying very hard not to show that they're trembling, but the thumping of her pulse through her veins as you lay your other hand on her arm betrays her emotions as clear as day.
    
    "He may be small, but our son's enormous for a sheepfolk baby," Noire whispers, pride welling up in her voice even as she tries to avoid speaking too directly in front of your child. "I don't think any [pc.ra minotaur
        |other 
    ]minotaur in the city could have done better than you. The way we went at it... you really did knock me up as much as you could, and I'm glad that you didn't hold back in the least."
    
    You don't reply to that, instead focusing on the little lamb in Noire's arms, wiggling your finger this way and that while your kid determinedly holds onto your fingertip with all the might a young baby can muster. Hah, strong indeed... 
    
    Can you hold the kid?
    
    "Sure! [noire.pregStage 2
        |I think his sibling is getting tired of holding him up, anyway
        |It's only right, given that I can hold him all morning every day, but I can't ever be sure when you'll be back
    ]."
    
    You have to admit, the confidence with which Noire hands your child over to you is inspiring. She doesn't caution you to be careful, she doesn't worry about you dropping the baby sheep, she doesn't tell you how to go about handling your son, because she knows full well that you're responsible enough to do all those things on your own, having experienced them first-hand.
    
    Oof. That being said, your kid isn't just big, he's heavy to boot, and Noire toting around the little lamb as if he doesn't weigh much gives you a newfound respect for the sheepgirl. You rock and bounce the lamb in your arms for a while more, then return the little guy to his mother. The ball of wooly fluff whimpers a bit, then grabs for his mother's breast; naturally, Noire is obliged to give your son what he wants. The sheepgirl's simple clothes that she's wearing out of the bath just makes her rack all the more alluring as she bares a breast to nurse your child, putting her rack to the purpose that the gods made it for; [noire.milfRange 3 7 13
        |swollen and milky to the point of turgidity, yet no less sensitive and tender than you remember them being when you were busy making this child together. They seem so full, so proud when on her increasingly motherly body, and she knows it full well
        |heavy and ripe, their expanded size isn't just large for its own sake. Every extra iota of titflesh that Noire's in her swelling tits is packed with milky potential, her mother's body taking to its purpose like a duck to water
        |heavy, turgid and ripe with its milky cargo, they're weighty and shapely enough to match any cowgirl's at the milking barn. Noire's body has expanded so well into every possible aspect of glorious maternity, her chest packed with milk-making potential, that you're not entirely sure that she isn't having to visit the milking barn to have herself drained despite the multiple lambs you've put inside of her baby bag
        |all swollen and milky when compared to their usual already generous size
    ]. Shifting your seat over to Noire's, you wrap an arm about the little sheepgirl and let her feed your son while all three of you enjoy the moment in the dim light, basking in each others' presence.
    
    While this is all very warm and cute, Noire is right: the baths aren't any place in which to raise a child, not with all the murmurs and noises coming to you through the walls. It's good that both she and your lambs have somewhere to go afterwards... this place may be a great place for making children, but not much else.
    
    Does she worry much?
    
    "I'd be lying if I said I didn't fret sometimes," Noire replies as she continues to nurse your son. "But then I realize that there's not much point in doing that, and learned to not be so concerned about the time that is to come to the point where I'm not able to appreciate what's in front of me now."
    
    Pretty deep for a small sheep.
    
    "Hey, even a servant can have her moments. Doubly so when she's sitting right next to someone she loves."
    
    Haha, that's true.
    
    "Mm." At length, Noire finishes tending to your son, covers herself back up, then leans over to give you a quick peck on the cheek. "I think that's enough excitement for today; I've got to get our son back or else he'll be all fussy in the morning. Sorry about that."
    
    Oh no, there's no need to apologize for anything. The whole point of all this was to spend time with the both of them, and you've gotten just that; you weren't expecting anything else out of this whole affair.
    
    "Look, [pc.name]... when this is all over, I'm sure you'll be able to come to the estate and have a proper visit instead of me needing to bring out our children like this. That'll be a goal to work towards, won't it?"
    
    It will, indeed. For now, though... this will do. It'll do. You hold Noire close to you for a little while longer, reluctant to let them go, then finally acquiesce to her departure, keenly feeling the cold, empty space where she and your son had been a moment ago. Noire pauses at the door, blows you another kiss, then slips through and leaves you to ponder the future for a little while more before you yourself have to get a move on...
rows.translation:
把诺瓦尔拉到一边，你问那位牧羊少女，是否有可能见到你的孩子。[noire.numKids 2|]虽然你知道自己不太可能被允许直接进入参议员的宅邸，但她总可以把孩子带出来见你，对吧？”

那个娇小的牧羊女孩若有所思地回答道：“嗯……不过那时候应该已经很晚了，小孩子也大多会睡着了。不过，我理解你非常想见到我们的孩子。[noire.numKids 2|ren]你也不应该被禁止与他们联系，即使他们可能会因为太困而无法做太多事情。当然，没问题！

你的意思是，她会走上街头，回到市中心去把那些东西取回来吧？ [noire.numKids 1|你的宝贝|其中之一]。 当她这么说的时候……她应该就不会有问题了。[noire.pregStage 2
        | 摇摇摆摆地走在街上
    ]对吧？

诺瓦尔听到这话笑了笑，说道：“科尔米诺斯城足够大，以至于这座城市永远不会陷入沉睡。 [pc.name]不会有任何问题的，我一个小时内就会回来。”

诺瓦尔向你飞了一个吻，然后从你身边离开，悄悄走出了房间。你在桌子旁找了个座位坐下，放松下来，耳边传来浴室里晚间顾客们的嘈杂声——时间仿佛在慢慢流逝，几分钟仿佛变成了几小时，你的目光一直盯着门，等待着诺瓦尔的归来。……

终于，在等待了不到一个小时之后，她还是回来了。门被轻轻推开，那个小羊女裹得严严实实地溜了进来。 [noire.pregStage 2
        |她怀抱着年幼的孩子，圆润的孕腹高高隆起。将如此多的生命力集中在一个地方，确实是一件了不起的事情——一位怀孕晚期的妇女能够如此轻松地照顾孩子，真让人希望她的身体能一直保持这种状态。
        |被她抱在怀里。她看起来简直就是可爱与纯洁的化身，但每当看到她怀中抱着婴儿的情景，人们都会忍不住想要让她再怀一个进去。
    ]抱歉让您等待了，即使是傍晚这个时候，街道上也还是非常拥挤，”诺瓦尔微笑着坐在你旁边的座位上说道，“不过看吧！ [noire.numKids 2|你的一个孩子。恐怕这就是我所能做到的全部了，但这次旅行确实非常值得。|你的孩子]他不是个可爱的小家伙吗？”

你低头看着被诺伊尔紧紧抱在怀中的那个小小的身影，不禁露出了微笑。这个小羊羔拥有母亲那金色的羊毛，那些细软温暖的毛茸茸的毛发从它的皮肤上长出来；圆圆的脸蛋、大大的紫水晶般的眼睛，再加上一对短短的羊角，简直和它的母亲一模一样。不过，它的羊角会不会像母亲的那样又大又卷，甚至可以用来当把手呢？这个嘛，只有时间才能告诉我们答案吧。
    
    虽然这个孩子看起来仍然困倦不已，对周围的环境也毫无兴趣，但当你伸出手去时，他还是会努力去抓住你的手指。那颗小小的手指紧紧缠绕在你的指尖上，带来的温暖感觉……这种感觉会让你心中涌起一股自豪感，这种感觉与你在和这个孩子的母亲一起孕育他时所感受到的那种幸福与满足有些相似，却又有所不同。 
    
    你感觉到诺瓦尔正注视着你，于是抬起眼睛与她对视。那个小羊女紧闭着嘴唇，她实在在努力控制自己，不让嘴唇颤抖出来，但当你将另一只手放在她的手臂上时，她脉搏的剧烈跳动清楚地暴露了她的情绪。
    
    他虽然个子小，但对我们这样的羊人家族来说，他已经算是非常大的婴儿了。”诺瓦尔轻声说道，尽管她努力不在你的孩子面前说得太直白，但她的声音里依然充满了自豪之情。“我想，应该没有其他人[pc.ra minotaur
        |其他 
    ]城里的弥诺陶洛斯可能都比你做得更好。我们当时的处理方式……你确实已经竭尽全力了，我很高兴你一点都没有保留实力。

你没有回应这句话，而是把注意力放在诺伊尔怀里的那只小羊羔身上，手指不停地晃动，而你的孩子则用一个婴儿所能使出的全部力气紧紧抓住你的指尖。哈，确实很用力呢……

你能抱抱这个孩子吗？

“当然可以！ [noire.pregStage 2
        |我觉得他的兄弟姐妹们，反正也已经厌倦了一直支持他了。

"
    Taking Noire aside, you ask the sheepgirl if there's any chance you could see your kid[noire.numKids 2|s]. While you understand it's not likely that you'll be allowed free entry into a senator's estate, she can always bring them out to see you, isn't that right?
    
    The petite sheepgirl looks contemplative at that. "W-well... it''ll be a bit late and the little one will mostly be asleep. At the same time, I understand how much you want to see our child[noire.numKids 2|ren] and you shouldn't be disallowed contact with them, even if they're going to be too sleepy to do much. Sure, then!"
    
    You take it she's going to go out into the streets, back to the inner city and fetch [noire.numKids 1|your lamb|one of the lambs]. When she puts it that way... she'll be fine[noire.pregStage 2
        | waddling through the streets
    ], right?
    
    Noire smiles at that. "Khor'minos is large enough that the city never sleeps, [pc.name]. There won't be any problems. I'll be back within the hour."
    
    Blowing you a kiss, Noire breaks away from your side and slips out of the room. You find a seat at the table and make yourself comfortable, hearing the muffled noises of the bathhouse's evening clientele come up to you through the walls — minutes feel like hours as the moments drag on, the corner of your gaze fixed upon the door, waiting for Noire to return any time now... 
    
    ...Which she eventually does, after a little less than an hour's wait. There's a click at the door, and the little sheepgirl slides her way back in, a little wrapped-up bundle [noire.pregStage 2
        |balanced in her arms atop her round pregnant belly. There's something to be said for that much fecundity in one place, a heavily pregnant woman cradling a young child, that makes you want to keep her that way for as long as her body can hold out
        |cradled in her arms. She looks a perfect picture of cuteness and cleanliness, but at the same time looking at her with a baby in her hands just makes you want to put another into her belly
    ]... 
    
    "Sorry to keep you waiting, the streets were crowded even at this time of evening," Noire says with a smile as she settles into the seat beside you. "But look! [noire.numKids 2|One of your children. I'm afraid that's all I could carry out, but the trip was absolutely worth it|Your child]! Isn't he just a dear?"
    
    You peek down at the tiny figure bundled up in Noire's arms, and can't help but smile. The little lamb has his mother's golden wool, the stuff sprouting from his skin in a fine, warm fuzz; a round, chubby face and large amethyst eyes like his mother's complete the set along with a pair of nubby sheep horns. Will they be large, curly things like his mother's, perfect for use as handlebars? Only time will tell, one supposes.
    
    While the kid still looks largely sleepy and uninterested in his surroundings, he nevertheless still makes an effort to grasp your finger when you offer it to him. The warm feel of that tiny finger wrapping about your fingertip... there's that feeling of pride in your heart, similar to, but not the same as the fuzzy goodness that you felt in the same place when you were making this little tyke with his mother... 
    
    You feel Noire's gaze upon you, and raise your eyes to hers. The little sheepgirl's lips are pursed, the poor dear herself trying very hard not to show that they're trembling, but the thumping of her pulse through her veins as you lay your other hand on her arm betrays her emotions as clear as day.
    
    "He may be small, but our son's enormous for a sheepfolk baby," Noire whispers, pride welling up in her voice even as she tries to avoid speaking too directly in front of your child. "I don't think any [pc.ra minotaur
        |other 
    ]minotaur in the city could have done better than you. The way we went at it... you really did knock me up as much as you could, and I'm glad that you didn't hold back in the least."
    
    You don't reply to that, instead focusing on the little lamb in Noire's arms, wiggling your finger this way and that while your kid determinedly holds onto your fingertip with all the might a young baby can muster. Hah, strong indeed... 
    
    Can you hold the kid?
    
    "Sure! [noire.pregStage 2
        |I think his sibling is getting tired of holding him up, anyway
        |It's only right, given that I can hold him all morning every day, but I can't ever be sure when you'll be back
    ]."
    
    You have to admit, the confidence with which Noire hands your child over to you is inspiring. She doesn't caution you to be careful, she doesn't worry about you dropping the baby sheep, she doesn't tell you how to go about handling your son, because she knows full well that you're responsible enough to do all those things on your own, having experienced them first-hand.
    
    Oof. That being said, your kid isn't just big, he's heavy to boot, and Noire toting around the little lamb as if he doesn't weigh much gives you a newfound respect for the sheepgirl. You rock and bounce the lamb in your arms for a while more, then return the little guy to his mother. The ball of wooly fluff whimpers a bit, then grabs for his mother's breast; naturally, Noire is obliged to give your son what he wants. The sheepgirl's simple clothes that she's wearing out of the bath just makes her rack all the more alluring as she bares a breast to nurse your child, putting her rack to the purpose that the gods made it for; [noire.milfRange 3 7 13
        |swollen and milky to the point of turgidity, yet no less sensitive and tender than you remember them being when you were busy making this child together. They seem so full, so proud when on her increasingly motherly body, and she knows it full well
        |heavy and ripe, their expanded size isn't just large for its own sake. Every extra iota of titflesh that Noire's in her swelling tits is packed with milky potential, her mother's body taking to its purpose like a duck to water
        |heavy, turgid and ripe with its milky cargo, they're weighty and shapely enough to match any cowgirl's at the milking barn. Noire's body has expanded so well into every possible aspect of glorious maternity, her chest packed with milk-making potential, that you're not entirely sure that she isn't having to visit the milking barn to have herself drained despite the multiple lambs you've put inside of her baby bag
        |all swollen and milky when compared to their usual already generous size
    ]. Shifting your seat over to Noire's, you wrap an arm about the little sheepgirl and let her feed your son while all three of you enjoy the moment in the dim light, basking in each others' presence.
    
    While this is all very warm and cute, Noire is right: the baths aren't any place in which to raise a child, not with all the murmurs and noises coming to you through the walls. It's good that both she and your lambs have somewhere to go afterwards... this place may be a great place for making children, but not much else.
    
    Does she worry much?
    
    "I'd be lying if I said I didn't fret sometimes," Noire replies as she continues to nurse your son. "But then I realize that there's not much point in doing that, and learned to not be so concerned about the time that is to come to the point where I'm not able to appreciate what's in front of me now."
    
    Pretty deep for a small sheep.
    
    "Hey, even a servant can have her moments. Doubly so when she's sitting right next to someone she loves."
    
    Haha, that's true.
    
    "Mm." At length, Noire finishes tending to your son, covers herself back up, then leans over to give you a quick peck on the cheek. "I think that's enough excitement for today; I've got to get our son back or else he'll be all fussy in the morning. Sorry about that."
    
    Oh no, there's no need to apologize for anything. The whole point of all this was to spend time with the both of them, and you've gotten just that; you weren't expecting anything else out of this whole affair.
    
    "Look, [pc.name]... when this is all over, I'm sure you'll be able to come to the estate and have a proper visit instead of me needing to bring out our children like this. That'll be a goal to work towards, won't it?"
    
    It will, indeed. For now, though... this will do. It'll do. You hold Noire close to you for a little while longer, reluctant to let them go, then finally acquiesce to her departure, keenly feeling the cold, empty space where she and your son had been a moment ago. Noire pauses at the door, blows you another kiss, then slips through and leaves you to ponder the future for a little while more before you yourself have to get a move on...
    "
