rows.original: [rand |"Sheepfolk like me are supposed to be from the city-state of Barania, but I've never actually been there. My grandfather lived near the coast as a port clerk and was kidnapped by Jassiran slavers when helping to inspect a merchant ship a little ways offshore." Oh no, that's horrible. Noire thins her lips. "Sheepfolk are prized by some people because we're so fluffy, small and soft, or that's what he told me anyway. The Jassirans sell their own people, so what's a couple souls taken in coastal raids to them? Anyway, for a while it looked like he was going to be sold to some harem or the other, but miss Arille's family was down in Jassira on business and happened to buy him because he was literate in Belharan and a couple other languages." They were down all the way in Jassira? "Oh, yes. Khor'minos wasn't always in lockdown, you know. Even if they didn't tend to make any formal alliances after the Godswar because of their falling-out with the lupines, it's still good to have a finger in every pie, especially when that's where your bread comes from. Being bought by miss Arille's grandparents was truly a blessing to him — my grandfather would joke that being able to live and work under them made the trouble of being kidnapped and sold at auction worth it. "Not everyone's as kind as miss Arille's family, of course, but my grandfather was well-treated, allowed to marry and have kids, and ate at the table with everyone else even before he managed to buy himself free. He was fond of telling me that working for miss Arille's grandmother was much cushier than being a port clerk back in his youth." |"One of the things about living in Khor'minos as a sheepfolk is getting used to everything being designed for bigger, taller people. And I'm not just talking about the minotaurs and cowgirls, even if they're almost twice as tall as I am — although the city has all kinds of people, most of them aren't very short either unless you count the hobgoblins in the slums. I was born and bred here, so I'm used to it, but all the same having to stand on tiptoe or have miss Arille help me in certain situations is really embarrassing, especially the latter. I'm supposed to be her assistant, she shouldn't be lowering herself to help me with such trivialities!" Well, what does Arille herself think about all this? "She says it's kinda fun to pick up a cute sheep like me and swing me around like a doll..." There's that awkward smile as Noire flushes and breaks her gaze from you; slowly, you keep your eyes trained on her until the fit passes and the diminutive sheepgirl returns to you. "Like I said, I've more or less gotten used to it... even if having to look up to everyone in order to speak to them makes my neck ache by the end of the day. But that's why we have the baths!" Having to hop up onto benches, stand on tiptoe to get at public fountains, climbing steps that are twice as tall than they should be and sitting in oversized seats... and there's always the old terror of getting things down from tall places without having a stepladder around. "You tease." [pc.heightRange 60 |Hey, it's good exercise. That's got to be the reason that she's so sprightly despite being soft on the outside, right? |Hey, you're down on her level, too. If you can't make a self-depreciating joke at your own expense, who can? ] |"I'm glad that miss Arille's in charge of the baths. It can be rather intimidating when some of the minotaur folk try to talk to me and pick me up... I find it very hard to say no to them when they ask me if I'm attached and want to take me out. But when Miss Arille's in the room with me, she either scares them off or takes them for herself, so I can be left to soak in peace. She's such a nice employer." Huh, rejections tire her out, huh... Noire gives you a small smile. "The baths are where city folk come to meet in a relaxed setting, [pc.name]. It's only natural that some people come here to, uh, meet others, right? I know they're not to be blamed and most people already understand that I'm not interested, but every so often you get someone new and we have to go through the whole song and dance again." Well, for you to actually get through after she's rejected so many others... doesn't that make you special? "You are special, [pc.name]. You're a demon-vanquishing champion." A giggle. "I think that gives you a leg up on the approach, don't you think? I suppose I'd have been put in the same spot had a senator's [pc.mf |son |daughter ] come up to me, but miss Arille wants those for herself, so it all works out; why bother with the assistant when the young lady is there and willing, right? You're the first one to have weight to your name and get past her to me, for what it's worth." |You've just noticed — when people speak of sheepfolk, the image that immediately comes to mind is that of wooly puffballs. Yet for all that, there's not that much wool on Noire at all. What gives? "Oh? Well, you're right. Granddad tells me that our line has had a bit less wool than other sheepfolk even to begin with, but that's not much. No, the Undermountain is a lot warmer than Barania, so I shear off all my wool pretty often. It's not just me, most other sheepfolk who've found their way down here chop it all off down to the skin in order to stay cool; I've just left a bit on here — " she gestures to the mane of golden wool about her neck — "and in a couple other places to be fashionable. It makes me look cute, doesn't it?" Ah, you see. Well, as they say, sometimes less is more — a bit of tactfully placed wool produces much better results than just wrapping up. She shears herself a lot, she said? "That's kind of a private question when it comes to sheepfolk... but I'll tell you anyway. Yeah, really often, something like once a week. The more you shear wool, the faster it grows back, so I've fallen into the habit of taking care of it on a regular basis. Sometimes miss Arille deigns to help me reach the places I find troublesome, she says it's kind of fun to take care of a cute pet. I don't take her caring for me for granted, though, it's not done for someone in my position. "But look at me, I bathe so much, spending hours every day in the hot pool. Can you imagine if I were covered in thick wool from neck to feet? I'd spend less time in the baths than actually drying from it, and that would be the most terrible shame! No, shaving it all off is for me, thank you very much." ]

哼，看来被拒绝会让她感到疲惫吧。诺瓦尔微微一笑：“浴场是城里人用来在轻松的氛围中相聚的地方。 [pc.name]有些人来到这里，嗯，这也是很自然的吧。相遇其他人，对吧？我知道他们没有错，而且大多数人也已经明白我对他们不感兴趣，但偶尔还是会遇到新的人，然后我们就不得不重新经历那一整套流程。 不过，能在她拒绝了很多其他人之后，你还是坚持了下来……这难道不说明你很特别吗？ “你是特别的，独特的。 [pc.name]你可是那位击败恶魔的英雄啊。”她轻笑着说道，“我想这一点让你在应对这种局面时占据了优势，不是吗？如果我是那位参议员的女儿，我想我也会处于同样的境地吧。 [pc.mf |儿子 |女儿 ]他们本来想找我，但阿莉尔小姐那些东西她自己想要，所以一切也就都解决了；既然有这位年轻的女士在并且愿意帮忙，那还费心找助理做什么呢，对吧？你是第一个有这种影响力的人。以及如果可以的话，请把她让给我吧。 |你可能已经注意到了——当人们提到“羊人族”时，首先浮现在脑海中的形象往往是那些长满羊毛的圆球状生物。然而，在诺瓦尔这个世界里，羊人族身上其实并没有太多的羊毛。这是为什么呢？ “哦？嗯，你说得对。爷爷告诉我，我们这一族的人，从一开始就比其他羊人族群拥有更少的羊毛，但这个差距其实并不大。不过，地底山确实比巴拉尼亚温暖得多，所以我也经常需要把羊毛剪下来。不只是我，大多数来到这里的羊人都会把毛发剪得只剩下皮肤，这样才能保持凉爽；而我只是在自己脖子上留了那么一点金色的毛发——她指了指自己脖子上的那缕金毛——“还有在其他几个地方也留了一些，只是为了显得更时尚而已。这样打扮的话，我看起来会很可爱，对吧？ 啊，你懂的。就像人们说的，有时候少即是多——巧妙地运用一些方法，往往能取得比直接包扎更好的效果。她说她自己经常给自己剪毛，是吗？ “对于牧羊人来说，这算是个比较私人的问题了。不过我还是想告诉你。是的，真的挺频繁的，差不多每周都会做一次。你剪得越多，羊毛就长得越快，所以我养成了定期护理它的习惯。有时候，阿莉尔小姐还会愿意帮我拿到那些我够不到的地方，她说照顾这么一只可爱的宠物还挺有趣的。不过，我并不会把她对我的关心视为理所当然，因为对于我这样的一个人来说，这样的关心实属难得。 但是你们看看我，我每天都要在热水池里泡上好几个小时。你们能想象吗？如果我从头到脚都裹着厚厚的羊毛，那我泡在热水池里的时间反而会变少，因为我的身体需要更长的时间来把羊毛上的水分弄干啊那个那可真是太遗憾了！不，对我来说，把头发全部剃掉才是最好的选择，真的非常感谢您。 ]
rows.raw: " [rand |"Sheepfolk like me are supposed to be from the city-state of Barania, but I've never actually been there. My grandfather lived near the coast as a port clerk and was kidnapped by Jassiran slavers when helping to inspect a merchant ship a little ways offshore." Oh no, that's horrible. Noire thins her lips. "Sheepfolk are prized by some people because we're so fluffy, small and soft, or that's what he told me anyway. The Jassirans sell their own people, so what's a couple souls taken in coastal raids to them? Anyway, for a while it looked like he was going to be sold to some harem or the other, but miss Arille's family was down in Jassira on business and happened to buy him because he was literate in Belharan and a couple other languages." They were down all the way in Jassira? "Oh, yes. Khor'minos wasn't always in lockdown, you know. Even if they didn't tend to make any formal alliances after the Godswar because of their falling-out with the lupines, it's still good to have a finger in every pie, especially when that's where your bread comes from. Being bought by miss Arille's grandparents was truly a blessing to him — my grandfather would joke that being able to live and work under them made the trouble of being kidnapped and sold at auction worth it. "Not everyone's as kind as miss Arille's family, of course, but my grandfather was well-treated, allowed to marry and have kids, and ate at the table with everyone else even before he managed to buy himself free. He was fond of telling me that working for miss Arille's grandmother was much cushier than being a port clerk back in his youth." |"One of the things about living in Khor'minos as a sheepfolk is getting used to everything being designed for bigger, taller people. And I'm not just talking about the minotaurs and cowgirls, even if they're almost twice as tall as I am — although the city has all kinds of people, most of them aren't very short either unless you count the hobgoblins in the slums. I was born and bred here, so I'm used to it, but all the same having to stand on tiptoe or have miss Arille help me in certain situations is really embarrassing, especially the latter. I'm supposed to be her assistant, she shouldn't be lowering herself to help me with such trivialities!" Well, what does Arille herself think about all this? "She says it's kinda fun to pick up a cute sheep like me and swing me around like a doll..." There's that awkward smile as Noire flushes and breaks her gaze from you; slowly, you keep your eyes trained on her until the fit passes and the diminutive sheepgirl returns to you. "Like I said, I've more or less gotten used to it... even if having to look up to everyone in order to speak to them makes my neck ache by the end of the day. But that's why we have the baths!" Having to hop up onto benches, stand on tiptoe to get at public fountains, climbing steps that are twice as tall than they should be and sitting in oversized seats... and there's always the old terror of getting things down from tall places without having a stepladder around. "You tease." [pc.heightRange 60 |Hey, it's good exercise. That's got to be the reason that she's so sprightly despite being soft on the outside, right? |Hey, you're down on her level, too. If you can't make a self-depreciating joke at your own expense, who can? ] |"I'm glad that miss Arille's in charge of the baths. It can be rather intimidating when some of the minotaur folk try to talk to me and pick me up... I find it very hard to say no to them when they ask me if I'm attached and want to take me out. But when Miss Arille's in the room with me, she either scares them off or takes them for herself, so I can be left to soak in peace. She's such a nice employer." Huh, rejections tire her out, huh... Noire gives you a small smile. "The baths are where city folk come to meet in a relaxed setting, [pc.name]. It's only natural that some people come here to, uh, meet others, right? I know they're not to be blamed and most people already understand that I'm not interested, but every so often you get someone new and we have to go through the whole song and dance again." Well, for you to actually get through after she's rejected so many others... doesn't that make you special? "You are special, [pc.name]. You're a demon-vanquishing champion." A giggle. "I think that gives you a leg up on the approach, don't you think? I suppose I'd have been put in the same spot had a senator's [pc.mf |son |daughter ] come up to me, but miss Arille wants those for herself, so it all works out; why bother with the assistant when the young lady is there and willing, right? You're the first one to have weight to your name and get past her to me, for what it's worth." |You've just noticed — when people speak of sheepfolk, the image that immediately comes to mind is that of wooly puffballs. Yet for all that, there's not that much wool on Noire at all. What gives? "Oh? Well, you're right. Granddad tells me that our line has had a bit less wool than other sheepfolk even to begin with, but that's not much. No, the Undermountain is a lot warmer than Barania, so I shear off all my wool pretty often. It's not just me, most other sheepfolk who've found their way down here chop it all off down to the skin in order to stay cool; I've just left a bit on here — " she gestures to the mane of golden wool about her neck — "and in a couple other places to be fashionable. It makes me look cute, doesn't it?" Ah, you see. Well, as they say, sometimes less is more — a bit of tactfully placed wool produces much better results than just wrapping up. She shears herself a lot, she said? "That's kind of a private question when it comes to sheepfolk... but I'll tell you anyway. Yeah, really often, something like once a week. The more you shear wool, the faster it grows back, so I've fallen into the habit of taking care of it on a regular basis. Sometimes miss Arille deigns to help me reach the places I find troublesome, she says it's kind of fun to take care of a cute pet. I don't take her caring for me for granted, though, it's not done for someone in my position. "But look at me, I bathe so much, spending hours every day in the hot pool. Can you imagine if I were covered in thick wool from neck to feet? I'd spend less time in the baths than actually drying from it, and that would be the most terrible shame! No, shaving it all off is for me, thank you very much." ] "

rows.original: "O-oh, I'm not sure I should be talking about miss Arille behind her back..." [var0 |Noire looks over at her employer at the other end of the pool and indeed, the both of you are talking about her behind her back. "It feels kind of scandalous." ] Well, she doesn't have to badmouth the senator's daughter. You're sure that Arille would be happy if her assistant flattered her on the sly, right? "Well, okay! [rand |Miss Arille is quite the socialite, and she keeps me busy scheduling her meetings and appointments. Usually, that leads people to think she's just a party heifer, but I know better — she's got a sharp mind up in that head of hers. While it's traditional for minoan womenfolk to go into things like engineering and alchemy, a big part of being in the senate is knowing who's who, and she's had a strong start on that. If she can have fun at all those events, all the better for her." Political mingling, then?[pc.bg nobleScion | You remember doing some of that back in your younger days and given your status as a spare instead of the heir, it could've been better. Still, it's good that the young lady is enjoying herself. ] "Mostly. There're some people she does meet for pleasure, but someone who works as hard as she does certainly deserves some time to her own ends! Meeting all those people and putting on a pleasant face for civility's sake takes a lot out of people, I would know." |Miss Arille has been very nice to me for all the time I've been with her. So long as I do my work well, she's perfectly fine with letting me eat at the same table with her when she's out meeting people, and numerous other small privileges like that. Most patricians and other city numinaries aren't so kind to their assistants, even if they don't happen to be slaves." She certainly looks like she eats well. "Isn't that the case?" Noire giggles and pinches her thigh. "Miss Arille is at the age when she can eat just about anything and it isn't a problem — if anything, it just makes her more luscious." And the same goes for her, hmm? "We-ll... there are more privileges to being with Miss Arille than just eating well, you know." |My family has been with miss Arille's for a long while now. Her grandmother — that's Senator Khel'salak's mother — bought my grandfather at one of those slave auctions. He was grateful enough that even after he'd worked himself free, he chose to stay on with her family. We've been with them ever since." No one's ever thought of leaving? "Well, where would we go? Some of my cousins are with miss Arille's relatives, I suppose... it's a cushy job, I've seen enough of the city people to understand as much. I know that what I've got going is a good thing, and it's kept me safe despite all the horrible things I hear that're going on outside of the walls. Most people don't even give the legions a second look when they pass by in the streets... they don't want to see how bedraggled some of them look on their way in. It's nice to shout 'Khor Aeterna!' every now and then, but I'd rather stay comfortable and warm in the baths, thank you very much." |Miss Arille's very insistent on cleanliness, which is one of the reasons why she spends so long at the baths. Our suites up top are perfectly neat, and she insists that I both maintain myself and my quarters to her standards... not that I'm complaining, of course. Having a whole five hours to soak in the baths as part of my job... you can't say the same of most people." You'll say, though, that most employers don't go so far as to intrude into the bathing habits of their workers. While you could see something like that being imposed on a slave, she's a free woman, isn't she? The way she's being treated, it's more like she's a pet than assistant to the young lady. "W-well, I don't mind having so much time to myself in the baths." Put on the spot, Noire positively squirms in place, a cornered animal looking for an escape route. "I only do it because I agree with her, and if I agree with miss Arille, then why should I talk back to her on the matter? There's nothing to be gained from butting heads with her for no reason." You feel like Noire doesn't understand what you're getting at to begin with, but then sheepfolk stereotypes are what they are. Well, so long as she's happy... |That's a cute swimsuit. Where did she get it? "Oh? You know the latex farms that're on the outskirts? Yeah, people make bathing suits out of them for going to the baths with. We run a bit of a side business ordering swimsuits for people — no blue-blooded patrician would be caught out in the outskirts, and everyone in those circles know that people who live there are so desperate, they'd try to cheat you for an extra electrum! But a respectable establishment like the baths..." Yes, you see. But what about her swimsuit? Noire blushes a little and grows antsy. "We-ll... first thing that happened when miss Arille was appointed in charge of the baths' running by her father, she took my measurements and got one for me. I was going to be a walking advertisement for the baths, she said, and it wouldn't do for me to wear something frumpy while I was having a soak." You chuckle a bit at that. Well, it seems to have worked — you're here talking to her, aren't you? Arille might be a bit overbearing to some, but she really takes good care of her pets. ]
rows.translation: 哦，我不确定是否应该在她背后谈论阿莉尔小姐…… [var0 |诺瓦尔望向泳池对岸的雇主，果然，他们两个人正在她背后谈论她。“这种行为感觉有点像丑闻。 ] 嗯，她没必要诋毁那位参议员的女儿。你确定如果阿莉尔的助手暗中讨好她，她一定会高兴的，对吧？ “好吧，那就算了！ [rand |阿莉尔小姐可真是个活跃的社交达人，她总是让我忙个不停，为她安排各种会议和约会。通常人们会认为她只是个喜欢参加派对的人，但我心里清楚——她头脑可是非常敏锐的。虽然米诺斯的女性通常会从事工程和炼金术等领域的工作，但进入参议院的关键在于了解谁是谁，而她在这一点上已经取得了良好的开端。如果她能在这些活动中享受到乐趣，那就更好了。那么，就是政治上的交往了吧？[pc.bg nobleScion | 你记得在自己年轻的时候也做过类似的事情吧？考虑到你只是个旁系成员，而不是继承人，情况本可以更好的。不过，至少这位年轻女士玩得开心，这也算是件好事了。 ] 基本上是的。虽然她也会和一些人见面，只是为了娱乐而已，但像她这样努力工作的人，确实应该有一些属于自己的时间！和那些人见面，为了礼貌而保持愉快的表情，确实会让人耗费很多精力，这一点我是深有体会的。 |在我与阿莉尔小姐共事的这段时间里，她一直对我非常友善。只要我能够认真完成工作，她就会允许我在她与别人会面时与她一起用餐，此外还给了我许多其他的便利。大多数贵族和其他城市显要人物对他们的助手们可没有那么好，即使这些助手并非奴隶。 她看起来确实生活得很优渥。 “不是吗？诺瓦尔轻笑了一声，然后捏了捏自己的大腿。“阿莉尔小姐现在这个年纪，几乎什么食物都可以吃，而且根本不会有什么问题——相反，这样只会让她的身材更加诱人呢。” 嗯，对她来说也是同样的道理，对吧？ 嗯……和阿莉尔小姐在一起，得到的好处可不仅仅是吃得好而已，你知道的。 |我的家人与阿莉尔小姐一家相处了很长时间。她的祖母——也就是凯尔萨拉克参议员的母亲——在某次奴隶拍卖会上买下了我的祖父。我的祖父心怀感激，即使后来他通过自己的努力获得了自由，仍然选择留在她家。从那以后，我们就一直和他们在一起。” 难道从来没有人想过离开吗？ “嗯，我们能去哪里呢？我想，我的一些表亲现在应该和阿莉尔小姐的亲戚们在一起吧……那份工作条件不错，我在城里待了足够长的时间，也明白了这一点。我知道自己所拥有的东西是非常宝贵的，它让我在听到外面发生的那些可怕事情时依然能够保持安全。大多数人在街上经过时，甚至都不会多看那些军团一眼。他们可不想看到有些人进来时那副狼狈不堪的样子。偶尔喊一句“Khor Aeterna！”确实挺不错的，但我还是更喜欢在浴场里享受舒适与温暖，谢谢。 |阿莉尔小姐对清洁要求极为严格，这也是她为什么会在浴场待那么长时间的原因之一。我们楼上的套房总是保持得干干净净，而她也坚持要求我必须将自己以及我的居住环境都维持在她规定的标准之下。当然，我并不是在抱怨。作为工作的一部分，我有整整五个小时的时间可以用来泡澡……不过，对于大多数人来说，这种情况可就不存在了。 不过，你也会说，大多数雇主应该不会干涉员工的洗澡习惯吧。虽然你可能会认为这种待遇更适合奴隶，但她毕竟是一个自由的女性，不是吗？从她目前受到的对待方式来看，她更像是一个宠物，而不是那位年轻女士的助手。 “嗯，其实我并不介意在浴室里有这么多属于自己的时间。被逼到绝境时，诺瓦尔的表现确实非常出色。蠕动着就像一只被逼入绝境、正在寻找逃生之路的动物一样。“我这么做只是因为我同意她的观点，如果我认同阿莉尔小姐的看法，那么为什么还要在这个问题上与她顶嘴呢？无缘无故地与她争执，根本没有任何好处。” 你觉得诺瓦尔从一开始就不明白你在说什么，但毕竟，对于羊人族来说，这些就是固有的刻板印象罢了。嗯，只要她开心就好…… |那条泳衣真可爱，她是从哪里买来的呢？ “哦？你应该知道城郊那些生产乳胶的农场吧？对，人们就是用那些乳胶来制作泳衣，用来去浴场使用的。我们顺便也做点副业，帮别人订购泳衣——那些贵族家庭的人可不会去城郊，而且那些圈子里的所有人都知道，住在城郊的人处境有多艰难，他们甚至会不择手段地骗取多一点的钱！不过体面的人/机构像那些浴场这样的场所……” “是的，您说得对。但那么她泳衣？ 诺瓦尔的脸微微一红，显得有些坐立不安。“嗯……当初阿莉尔小姐被她父亲任命负责管理浴室的事务时，她首先测量了我的尺寸，然后为我买了一条泳衣。她说：“我本来想成为这些浴场的活广告的，如果在泡澡的时候穿着邋遢的衣服，那就太不合适了。” 你听到这里不禁笑了起来。不过，看来这个办法确实有效——你现在不正在和她聊天吗？虽然阿莉尔对某些人来说可能显得有点强势，但她确实非常照顾她的宠物们。 ]

You'll say, though, that most employers don't go so far as to intrude into the bathing habits of their workers. While you could see something like that being imposed on a slave, she's a free woman, isn't she? The way she's being treated, it's more like she's a pet than assistant to the young lady. "W-well, I don't mind having so much time to myself in the baths." Put on the spot, Noire positively squirms in place, a cornered animal looking for an escape route. "I only do it because I agree with her, and if I agree with miss Arille, then why should I talk back to her on the matter? There's nothing to be gained from butting heads with her for no reason." You feel like Noire doesn't understand what you're getting at to begin with, but then sheepfolk stereotypes are what they are. Well, so long as she's happy... |That's a cute swimsuit. Where did she get it? "Oh? You know the latex farms that're on the outskirts? Yeah, people make bathing suits out of them for going to the baths with. We run a bit of a side business ordering swimsuits for people — no blue-blooded patrician would be caught out in the outskirts, and everyone in those circles know that people who live there are so desperate, they'd try to cheat you for an extra electrum! But a respectable establishment like the baths..." Yes, you see. But what about her swimsuit? Noire blushes a little and grows antsy. "We-ll... first thing that happened when miss Arille was appointed in charge of the baths' running by her father, she took my measurements and got one for me. I was going to be a walking advertisement for the baths, she said, and it wouldn't do for me to wear something frumpy while I was having a soak." You chuckle a bit at that. Well, it seems to have worked — you're here talking to her, aren't you? Arille might be a bit overbearing to some, but she really takes good care of her pets. ] "

rows.original: [rand |"Well, my job first and foremost is to balance the baths' books." Aren't the baths free to the public leading up to this senate election? "Yes, but income from paying customers is still part of it. There're the attendants' wages to consider, of course, as well as taxes — senators aren't exempt from having to pay their share to the king. Then there's the cost of heating, maintaining the water flow, other consumables... sometimes, someone forgets a towel or has theirs vanish, and we're happy to provide one. That sort of thing. At the end of the day, it's my job to make sure the electrum is where it needs and ought to be, then send it on its way to the senator's coffers minus miss Arille's salary." It sounds like a lot, the way her mistress lives. "W-well... that's not exactly right to say. Her mother's correct in saying that she needs to learn how to manage a business." But she's dumping the job on little Noire here, isn't she? And if she ever got bored of being the mistress of the baths, she could always head home to her daddy's estate, can't she? "H-hey! Don't talk about her like that!" Haha. For a noble to inspire such loyalty from those in her care... all right, you won't speak of Arille that way in front of her. She's such a cute little sheep that you can't refuse, yes? Noire huffs. "Tsk, now y-you're teasing me." |"I'm glad to be able to be miss Arille's clerical assistant. It has many perks... room and board, for one, in a suite comparable to miss Arille's. That alone would be sufficient remuneration for many people, especially in this time of war, but I get so much more... a free pass to use the baths when I'm not on the job, for one. That, and a little spending money, enough to suit all my needs. I suppose a hero[pc.mf | |ine ] like you might find it stifling, but I'm quite comfortable." She certainly looks comfortable. Nore pinches her plump thigh, then an arm. "I mean, there's no getting around it; I wouldn't be able to do hard labor even if it were the difference between life and death. My body just isn't built for it... and I'm fine with that, adding up numbers and writing on ledgers and scrips suit me just fine, as does taking minutes of senatorial meetings and keeping miss Arille's appointments for her. I like my job and my life with miss Arille. She's very nice to me." |"Setting up miss Arille's schedule for her is a lot of fun! It also gets me to go out and meet people, otherwise I'd spend too much time cooped up in the office away from the moisture of the baths!" How does she go about that, anyway? "Oh, it's simple. Miss Arille tells me she wants to have a social engagement with so-and-so, and I go and find his or her people to see if such is agreeable and if so, set one up after comparing schedules." While that's all well and good, doesn't the person being asked have anything to say in whether he or she wants to show up for said engagement? "Well, the vast majority of people whom miss Arille would want to meet have their own assistants and scribes. You don't get into that kind of position without knowing what your master or mistress is partial to. Many numinaries rely on such for them to be able to keep track of their appointments; it's a trusted position, which is why I'm glad to be able to do this for miss Arille." |So, is bathing this much part of her job, too? "Yes and no! It's certainly a benefit I have, working for miss Arille, and she's very insistent on cleanliness if I'm going to be living up in the suites with her. I follow her out on her social engagements, too, and have to look presentable while doing it; the same goes for walking out and about on the streets given that I'm always representing her in some capacity. "Plus, it feels nice and I don't have to do anything for the entire evening every day, so why not? I know a good thing when I see one, [pc.name]." For a personal assistant, she certainly is very pampered. "Don't I know it. I give thanks to the whole pantheon on my days off for being so lucky." She has off-days? A smile. "Another benefit of working for the rich and powerful... and being fortunate enough to avoid the worst of the pitfalls associated with doing so. Miss Arille and her family's the decent sort, but you hear some of the things other slaves and servants go through." ]
rows.translation: [rand |嗯，我的首要职责就是确保这些浴场的账目平衡。” 那么，在这次元老院选举之前，这些浴场不是应该对公众免费开放吗？ “是的，但是来自付费顾客的收入仍然是账目中不可或缺的一部分。当然，还需要考虑侍从们的工资以及各种税费——参议员们也不例外，他们同样需要向国王缴纳应缴的税款。此外，还有取暖费用、维持水源供应所需的开支，以及其他各种消耗品的费用。有时候，会有人忘记带毛巾，或者他们的毛巾突然不见了，而我们很乐意提供毛巾给他们。就是这类事情。归根结底，我的职责就是确保那些electrum能够被送到该去的地方，然后进入参议员的金库——当然，要扣除Miss 阿莉尔的工资。" 她的主人的生活方式听起来确实挺奢侈的。 “嗯……这么说也不完全准确。她母亲说得对，她确实需要学习如何管理一家企业。” 但是，她把这份工作都推给了小诺瓦尔，对吧？而且如果她厌倦了担任这个“浴场老板”的角色，她随时都可以回到她父亲的庄园去，不是吗？ 喂！别那样谈论她！” 哈哈，一位贵族能够让那些受她照顾的人产生这样的忠诚……好吧，你在她面前就不会再那样谈论阿莉尔了。她可是那么可爱的一只小羊羔，你总不能拒绝她吧？ 诺瓦尔哼了一声：“啧，你现在是在逗我吧。 |能够成为阿莉尔小姐的文书助理，我感到非常荣幸。这份工作有很多好处……首先，我能够享受到与阿莉尔小姐相同的套房，包括食宿。单是这一点，对很多人来说就已经是丰厚的报酬了，尤其是在这个战争年代。不过我得到的远不止这些……比如，在非工作时间可以免费使用浴室，还有少量的零用钱，足以满足我的所有需求。我想，对于一个英雄来说[pc.mf | | ]虽然你可能会觉得这样有点压抑，但我其实觉得挺自在的。” 她确实是这样。看起来挺舒服的。” 诺尔捏了捏自己圆润的大腿，然后又捏了捏手臂。“说实话，这事实在无法改变；即使这是生死攸关的事情，我也无法从事重体力劳动。我的身体就是不适合做这种事情……但我对此并不在意。做账、写记录，或者记录参议院会议的议程、为阿莉尔小姐安排约会，这些工作都很适合我。我喜欢我的工作，也喜欢和阿莉尔小姐一起生活的日子。她对我非常好。 |为阿莉尔小姐安排日程安排真是件有趣的事情！这也让我有机会出门去见见别人，否则我就会把太多时间都待在办公室里，远离浴室的湿润空气了！” 那么，她究竟是怎么做到的呢？ 哦，很简单。阿莉尔小姐告诉我她想和某个人安排一次社交活动，我就去联系那个人的相关人员，看看他们是否同意，如果同意的话，再根据双方的时间安排来安排这次活动。” 不过，这样安排的话，被邀请的人难道就没有发言权吗？他们到底想不想参加这次活动，难道不应该由他们自己来决定吗？ 嗯，那些想念阿莉尔并且希望与她见面的人，大多数都有自己的助手和秘书。要想担任这样的职位，就必须了解自己的上司喜欢什么。许多高级职员都是依靠这些助手来安排自己的日程的；这是一个备受信任的职位，因此能够为阿莉尔小姐担任这个角色，我感到非常荣幸。" |那么，洗澡这件事也是她工作的一部分吗？ “可以说是，也可以说不是！能为阿莉尔小姐工作，确实让我得到了这个便利，而且如果我要和她一起住在那些套房里，她对清洁要求也非常严格。我也会陪她参加各种社交活动，在这些场合我必须保持得体、有礼貌；同样地，当我在街上行走时，也必须时刻代表着她。 “而且，这样做感觉挺好的，每天整个晚上我都不用做任何事情，所以为什么不行呢？我一看到好东西，就能立刻认出来。 [pc.name]对于一个个人助理来说，她确实得到了无微不至的照顾。 “我当然知道这一点。每当我休息的时候，我都会感谢所有的神明，感谢自己这么幸运。” 她确实拥有这样的待遇。休息日一个微笑。“为富人和权贵工作还有另一个好处……那就是有幸能够避开随之而来的那些麻烦。阿莉尔小姐和她的家人都是正派的人，但你也听说过其他奴隶和仆人们所经历的那些事情。 ]

rows.original: There really isn't that much to say. Noire's eyes widen as you grab her by under the arms and [pc.heightRange 54 |hoist her straight off her feet, taking a moment to savor the sight of water dripping off her skin-tight bathing suit and her feet kicking about helplessly in the pool |pull her onto your back without further ado ]. Your fingers dig into the mane of golden wool that she keeps about her neck and shoulders, and that more than enough to subdue the little sheepgirl — or at least, on the outside. Pressed against you, Noire's heart hammers away as you carry her away into the darker corridors of the baths' internals, away from the hustle and bustle of the public areas.[noire.pregStage 2 5 | The little sheepgirl's rounded tummy adds a palpable amount of weight to her, but given all the excited squealing and squirming that she's up to it really isn't that much in the scheme of things. | The little sheepgirl is so heavily pregnant that it's less the added weight and more the sheer roundness of her that poses more of an impediment to you carting her off as you please, but the power of love knows no limits. ] Eventually, you find a nice alcove in which to deposit the both of you away from prying eyes; Noire melts into your touch as as you press fingers into her ample, curvaceous body and toy with the soft wool on her skin. She demurs for a moment, finally sighing with an accompanying shudder of arousal, then cranes her neck upwards to kiss your cheek with a light touch. Looks like everything's just about ready, whether she knows it consciously or not. What are you planning to do to this helpless, innocent little sheep completely at your mercy and disposal?
rows.translation: 其实真的没什么好说的。当你抓住诺瓦尔的胳膊将她拉起来时，她的双眼瞪得大大的[pc.heightRange 54 |他将她整个人举了起来，忍不住仔细欣赏那一幕：她紧身的泳衣上挂着水珠，而她的双脚在泳池中无助地扑腾着。 |毫不迟疑地将她抱到自己背上。 ]你的手指紧紧抓住她环绕在脖子和肩膀上的那缕金色羊毛，这缕羊毛足以制服这个小羊女——至少在表面上是这样。当你把她抱往浴室内部那些较为昏暗的走廊，远离喧闹的公共区域时，诺瓦尔的心脏正在剧烈地跳动着。[noire.pregStage 2 5 | 那个小羊女孩圆滚滚的肚子确实让她显得有点胖乎乎的，但考虑到她总是那么兴奋地叫喊、扭动，其实这也算不了什么吧。 | 那只小羊姑娘怀孕得实在太厉害了，真正让人觉得难受的，与其说是她身上增加的重量，不如说是那种显而易见的变化本身。圆润度正是这一点，才让你在想方设法带她离开时遇到了更多的阻碍……但爱的力量是无穷的。 ] 最终，你找到了一个隐蔽的角落，可以将她带到那里，远离旁人的窥视；当你将手指轻轻触碰她那丰满、曲线优美的身体，抚弄她皮肤上柔软的毛发时，诺瓦尔仿佛在你手中融化了。她先是有些犹豫，最终伴随着一阵兴奋的颤抖，轻轻叹了口气，然后仰起脖子，轻轻吻了吻你的脸颊。 看起来一切都已经准备就绪了，无论她是否意识到了这一点。你打算对这个完全处于你掌控之中、无助而无辜的小羊做些什么呢？

rows.original: When you broach the topic of heading into the back of the bathhouse to have some fun, Noire looks a little bashful, picking at her woolen collar and refusing to meet your eyes. The petite sheepgirl is absolutely terrible at hiding her feelings, and it's a simple matter for you to take her by the cheeks and ask what's going on. "Um..." Come on. You know Noire's naturally shy, but at this point you'd imagine you're not a stranger to her any longer. "Miss Arille would like to talk to you, [pc.name]. As soon as possible." Sure. Is there something in particular that would provoke such urgency from a fine young lady such as her? Noire doesn't say anything, but her cheeks are red and it's not from the heat of the pool. Sighing, you pull yourself out of the water, dry yourself off as best as you can and [var0 |start off towards where Arille is lounging on the other end of the hot room. Noir squeaks and hurries to your side as you make the crossing, clinging to your arm with both hands even as you draw close. At length, Arille looks up from her tablet, eyes you for a second, then beckons you forward with a smile and crooked finger. |wait for Noire to do the same. The petite sheepgirl hurries to wrap a towel about herself, then clings to your arm with both hands and starts leading you away from the hot room. The two of you enter the corridors that snake through the back of the bathhouse until you arrive at [flags.ARILLE_FUCKED |Arille's apartments |a suite of apartments ] on the upper floors. Coughing nervously, Noire knocks on the door once, then steps back until Arille's voice sounds from within. "Come in!" [flags.ARILLE_FUCKED |It feels awkward to be called in to have a serious talk in the very same rooms where you were Arille's pet, but it's just something you'll have to get used to in your role, isn't it? |Entire apartments up in the top of the bathhouse? Sure, you've heard of Arille's living arrangements from Noire, but seeing fully furnished living quarters above someplace so public is nevertheless still a little stunning. ] Arille herself is lounging on the bed, treating herself to a bowl of grapes; she puts away the snack but doesn't rise as the both of you step in, giving you a small nod. ] "Thank you for coming on such short notice, dear [pc.title]. Finding you out in the city would have been troublesome, but you certainly have taken a shine to both the baths and my servant here. I hope you're enjoying yourself?" [pc.isDK |Sure, sure. Enough with the pleasantries — what does she want? |You are, thanks for asking. You get the feeling that this isn't why she asked to speak with you, though. What's up? ] An arched eyebrow. "I just told you. You've taken a shine to both the baths and my servant here, and little Noire has gone so far as to ask for permission to get intimate with you. Isn't that sweet?" Intimate? You were already having sex with Noire in the back of the bathhouse, isn't that intimate enough? That, and she has to ask permission? Isn't she a free woman? Noire's fingers clutch at your arm all the tighter, but Arille defuses the tension by widening her smile. "Ah. Oh. Well, my dear little pet is a free woman, thanks to her grandfather buying his way out of slavery from my grandmother. That being said, I feed her, I clothe her, I house her, and generally take exceedingly good care of someone as loyal as my dear Noire. To do otherwise would be a complete waste of a loyal servant, that much is true. "But you've made an impression on my dear pet, [pc.name]. Enough for her to gather the courage and ask for my permission to get closer to you, even! Do you know how many things little Noire has asked me for ever since we were children?" None? "Exactly. Which is why coming to me like a hopeless schoolgirl fresh out of the lyceum shows me just how much she's enamored with you, [pc.name]. This I find extremely interesting, so I see no reason as to why it shouldn't continue." Noire perks up, eyes brightening and her entire body coming to attention. "Miss Arille! Y-you'd — " "Of course I would, and not just that," Arille chuckles. [var1 |"Why, I'll even give you leave as to get yourself pregnant by [pc.name] here, if that's what you want. Or have [pc.name] impregnate you, if you'd rather frame it that way. Your family has always been loyal servants to mine... and [pc.name] here has proven [pc.himHer]self capable enough in the service of the city. I wouldn't mind my sons and daughters having loyal and capable servants. That is, if [pc.name] is amenable to the idea — I'll leave the two of you to work it out between yourselves if you even want to have a go at it, hmm?" |"You have my leave to get as close to [pc.name] as you'd like, so long as you don't get in my way, nor does it interfere with your usual duties. Your family has always been loyal servants to mine... and [pc.name] here has proven [pc.himHer]self capable enough in the service of the city. It's the least I can do to reward such dogged faithfulness, and to be perfectly honest seeing the girls all in a tizzy over the latest big-name arrival in town showing such favor to a simple servant is mighty amusing. A complete and utter scandal, to be sure, the kind of news that absolutely captivates the small-minded. All the better for you, isn't it?" ] The little sheep looks fit to bust at this point, her face as red as a tomato and constantly fidgeting on the spot; if not for Arille's presence, you're sure she would be running in circles around you until she collapsed from hyperventilation. As things stand, your arm feels like she's fit to tear it off any moment, so hard are her fingers pressing into your [pc.skinFurScalesNoun]. "I... I... thank you, miss Arille, thank you so much!" You don't really have much to add to that, save for thanking Arille as well. Sure, it's all a little awkward, the thought that Arille should have that much say in the private life of someone who's ostensibly just a servant, but on the other hand getting her mistress' blessing clearly means a lot to Noire, and so long as she's happy about it [pc.isDK |you'll put up with the ignominy. That being said, Noire had better make up for it by being a really good fuck... or at least more than she's been up to this point |you're fine with it too. The petite sheepgirl is so cute when she's all excitable like that, and she tends to be a much better fuck when she's full of energy ]. "Take good care of her, [flags.ARILLE_FUCKED |pet |[pc.name] ]," Arille drawls as she waves the both of you off. "The poor dear does mean a lot to me, and she's useful to boot. I'd get quite upset if she were to be damaged, little creature that she is." The moment you lead Noire out of Arille's apartment and shut the door behind you, the petite sheepgirl finally releases your arm from her death grip and collapses into your side.         |You decide to pay a visit to the farm, and set off down the dirt path towards Nottia's place.         Nottia spots you coming down the path and waves before disappearing into the house, inviting you in. You pass a couple of soldiers on the way, returning their friendly nods.

rows.translation: 只是顺便拜访一下而已

rows.original:
"Just came by to see if everything was going okay," you say, smiling.
        
        Nottia smiles. "It is! Why don't you stay for food with the boys and I and we can talk about it?"
        
        She calls the soldiers in for a break and food after cooking, laying food out on the table for everyone to dig in. You get to talking with the [pc.mf
            |boys
            |legionnaires
        ].
        
        "How's the farming?" you say.
        
        "It's fun, man," the soldier says. "I'm learning how to garden and grow crops, ha! Might be useful after, y'know... all this shit going on. Wouldn't mind this kind of life." He considers the food on his plate for a moment and nods. "Yup. S'not too bad."
        
        "The life, or the cooking?" Nottia says, smiling.
        
        "Ha! The life seems nice, the cooking's great," he says.
        
        "Gotta agree, the food's good here," you say. The other soldiers chime in with agreement.
        
        "Thanks, everyone," Nottia says. She looks pleased. "It's just little things I learned to cook to save time every night."
        
        You finish up and relax for a few minutes before the soldiers head back out, giving you a nod and thanking Nottia for the food.
        
        "That was nice," she sighs, settling back in her chair. "It's been a lot less lonely since you sent them over here, [pc.name]. Still don't have anyone warmin' my bed at nights, but at least now I got time to look for someone."
rows.translation:
“只是过来看看一切是否顺利，”你微笑着说道。
        
        诺蒂娅微笑道。“很顺利！为什么不留下来，和我还有弟兄们一起吃饭？我们可以边吃边聊。”
        
        做好饭后，她叫士兵们进来休息、用餐，将食物摆上桌，供所有人享用。你和[pc.mf
            |弟兄们
            |军团士兵们
        ]聊了起来。
        
        “耕作怎么样？”你说道。
        
        “很有意思，伙计，”士兵说道。“我正在学怎么打理花园、种植作物，哈！以后可能用得上，你知道……现在闹着这些破事。我不介意过这种生活。”他端详盘中食物片刻，点了点头。“对，还不算太糟。”
        
        “你说的是生活，还是厨艺？”诺蒂娅微笑着说道。
        
        “哈！生活看起来不错，厨艺更是很棒，”他说道。
        
        “不得不同意，这里的食物很美味，”你说道。其他士兵也纷纷附和。
        
        “谢谢大家，”诺蒂娅说道。她看起来很高兴。“只是些为了每晚节省时间而学会烹制的简单食物。”
        
        你们用完餐，放松几分钟；士兵们随后返回外面，朝你点头，并感谢诺蒂娅准备的食物。
        
        “这样真好，”她向后靠上椅背，叹息道。“自从你把他们派到这里，我就没那么孤独了，[pc.name]。夜里依然没有人温暖我的床铺，不过至少如今有时间找一个了。”

rows.original: "So who's really in charge of the slums?" you say. "Technically, the king. In actuality, the interior is run by the local petty gangs like the Black Claw with the outer perimeters guarded fiercely by the soldiers. There's an excess of 'em since they're all stationed at home now, so even getting in is difficult – let alone getting out. There's guards roving the outside streets, too, and they can tell when they see one," Tay says. "They don't patrol, here. They just guard their posts." "Ruling with an iron fist, huh?" you say. Tay nods. "They're told not to interfere with 'local politics', and they don't. But when someone pisses off the guards... well, there's been fights before. And when I say fights I mean fully armored legionnaires against scrappy, ragtag slum-raised scum." "So, not a fight at all, then," you note. "Right. They have some mercy, though. They don't put them to death," Tay says. "Just send them packing with a lot of bruises and bloody snouts. There are no fights now. The slumrats might be dumb, but not that dumb. Anyway, you can think of it like containment. The outer ring of the slums is wholly controlled by the guards. The inner sector?" She shrugs. "That's the realm of the so-called local politics. Gangs, power struggles, brawls in the street. Usually not deadly because nobody wants to incur the wrath of the soldiers, but you get the odd one out with a shank in his back. S'what happens when no one likes you, I guess." You muse on the situation for a moment. "It doesn't sound like there's much of a way to escape the slums." "Happens every so often, but... yeah, it's pretty rare. Gotta remember this is still a fairly recent development. Back before the quarantine, it was just rows of apartments. Shady and somewhat dangerous? Sure. But now it's practically a field of battle. Except it's everyone against everyone else, and the guards don't want to step in if they don't have to." [pc.isDK |"Amazing how fast everything went to fucking shit in here," you say. |"Amazing how quickly things change," you murmur. ] Tay's face darkens. "Yeah. I wonder about that, sometimes. Is the king still the one giving the orders...?" "Do you have a reason to think otherwise?" you say. She grimaces. "I don't know, I just... it's uncharacteristic, but not that uncharacteristic... maybe I just don't want to think the king would do this." You understand. There's got to be other solutions, but they went with this one. Even the quarantine itself is... well, there's no use dwelling on it now.

rows.original: "How do the soldiers in the slums operate?" you say. "None of them want to be here, obviously," she says. "But they're still faithful soldiers of the kingdom, same as any other... except probably more bitter. Being a soldier is a nice life, you know? Train, keep the peace, protect the local populace from beasts and raiders, be recognized by the people for your efforts, earn some nice money. Everyone likes a border guard." "How much of that is still true?" you say. Tay gives you a mirthless smirk. "Well, they're not getting any recognition. If anything, people are unhappy they have to deal with cooped-up soldiers. No winners in that situation, that's for fuckin' sure. At best they're keeping the peace... by fighting against the citizens in the Slums. Can't imagine any of 'em feel too great about they money they get for doing that." She shrugs. "If they're even getting money at this point." "But they do handle the issue," you say. "Oh yeah. Like I said, still soldiers of the kingdom. Just exposed to the worst of our citizenry every day," she says. "Doubt they feel like heroes. Is it any surprise they want to be hands-off?" You can see her point.
rows.translation: 那些生活在贫民区的士兵们是怎么执行任务的呢？”你问道。 “显然，他们中没有一个人愿意待在这里，”她回答说，“但他们依然是王国的忠诚士兵，和其他人没什么两样……只不过他们的怨恨可能更深吧。你知道，当士兵本来就是一份不错的职业啊。训练士兵，维护和平，保护当地居民免受野兽和掠夺者的侵害，因为你的付出而得到人们的认可，还能赚到一笔不错的钱。毕竟，谁会不喜欢边境卫兵呢？” “不过，这些话现在还有多少是真实的呢？”你问道。 泰露出一个毫无笑意的 smirk，说道：“嗯，他们根本得不到任何认可。事实上，人们都很不满，因为不得不与这些被关在封闭环境中的士兵打交道。这场争斗中，根本没有赢家。那个那种处境，简直糟透了。充其量，他们只是通过与贫民区的居民交战来维持秩序罢了……我无法想象，他们为做这种事而得到的钱，能让他们感到有多开心。”她耸了耸肩，“如果他们真能拿到钱的话。” “但他们毕竟在处理这个问题，”你说。 “哦，是啊。就像我说的，他们依然是王国的士兵。只不过每天都要面对我们社会中最底层的人群罢了。”她说，“我怀疑他们感受就像英雄们一样。他们想要不插手事情的发展，这有什么好奇怪的吗？” 你确实能理解她的观点。
rows.raw: ' "How do the soldiers in the slums operate?" you say. "None of them want to be here, obviously," she says. "But they're still faithful soldiers of the kingdom, same as any other... except probably more bitter. Being a soldier is a nice life, you know? Train, keep the peace, protect the local populace from beasts and raiders, be recognized by the people for your efforts, earn some nice money. Everyone likes a border guard." "How much of that is still true?" you say. Tay gives you a mirthless smirk. "Well, they're not getting any recognition. If anything, people are unhappy they have to deal with cooped-up soldiers. No winners in that situation, that's for fuckin' sure. At best they're keeping the peace... by fighting against the citizens in the Slums. Can't imagine any of 'em feel too great about they money they get for doing that." She shrugs. "If they're even getting money at this point." "But they do handle the issue," you say. "Oh yeah. Like I said, still soldiers of the kingdom. Just exposed to the worst of our citizenry every day," she says. "Doubt they feel like heroes. Is it any surprise they want to be hands-off?" You can see her point. '

rows.original:
"How many gangs are in here, anyway?" you say.
    
    "Plenty, but there's three big ones," Tay says. "There's the Lupertines, run by Madam Khayl. They run the brothel, as well as several other seedy institutions in the crown jewel of our shining city. They're primarily invested in the meat market. Lots of women, lots of men, lots of business with the other two gangs.
    
    The Draskolls handle drugs. All types. I dunno who runs them, and the customers don't care. Plenty of people just want a night with a Lupertine girl and the drugs she offers. Forget your life for a bit.
    
    Then there's the Uglies."
    
    "They call themselves 'The Uglies'?" you ask.
    
    Tay grins. "Perverse point of pride. The longer you spend in their line of work, the uglier you get, see? Ragged ears, scarred faces, missing eyes and fingers. The Uglies work in manpower and weapons. It's mostly the latter that gets them work. And all three of the gangs work together in a wonderful symbiotic relationship akin to a mass of rats stuck together by their tails. Just as likely to hang out in a sewer, too."
    
    [pc.bg slumrat
        |You grimace. "It's like I never left my hometown."
        |"Sounds like this place has been neglected for years," you say.
    ]
    
    "I figure slums are probably the same the world over," Tay says, looking down at her beer. "Just that ours is the biggest. Practically a city of its own."
    
    "How big are the slums, anyway?" you ask.
    
    "Well, probably more than ten thousand people in here. Wouldn't be surprised if it was twenty or thirty," Tay says. "All spread over a few miles of shitty apartments and wooden buildings. There's room for a lot of living and dying even in a place this size, that's for sure."
rows.translation:
“这里到底有多少个帮派？”你问道。
    
    “很多，但主要有三个大帮派，”泰回答说，“有凯尔夫人掌管的卢珀蒂纳帮。他们不仅经营着这家妓院，还掌控着我们这座辉煌城市里其他几处见不得光的场所。他们的生意主要在肉市上。大量的女人、大量的男人，还有与其他两个帮派的密切往来。
    
    德拉斯科尔帮帮做毒品生意，什么类型的都有。我不知道是谁在管事，顾客们也不在乎。很多人只是想跟卢珀蒂纳家的姑娘过上一夜，顺便享用她提供的毒品。暂时把自己的生活忘掉吧。
    
    然后就是‘丑八怪’了。”
    
    “他们自称‘丑八怪’？”你问道。
    
    泰咧嘴笑了。“一种扭曲的自豪感。你在他们这行干得越久，就变得越丑，明白吗？耳朵破烂、满脸伤疤、缺眼少指。‘丑八怪’做的是人力和武器生意，让他们有活干的主要是后者。三个帮派还结成了一种奇妙的共生关系，就像一群尾巴缠在一起的老鼠。也一样可能一起待在下水道里。”
    
    [pc.bg slumrat
        |你皱起了眉头。“感觉就像我从来都没有离开过家乡一样。”
        |“这地方听起来像是被忽视了很多年。”你说道。
    ]
    
    “我猜世界各地的贫民区大概都差不多，”泰低头看着自己的啤酒说道，“只不过我们这里是最大的。几乎算得上是一座独立的城市了。”
    
    “那这个贫民区到底有多大？”你问道。
    
    “嗯，这里大概有一万多人。就算有两三万，我也不会感到惊讶，”泰说道，“全都散布在几英里的破公寓和木屋之间。哪怕是这么个地方，也容得下不少的生生死死，这倒是肯定。”

rows.original: "Who runs this place?" you ask, looking around the tavern. It's a far cry from the Frost Hound, your Hawkethorne haunt. Some of the tables are stained with a faded red-brown you suspect has nothing to do with beer, there are holes in the floor and cobwebs in the corners, dust is everywhere – but dust covering everything seems to be a constant in the slums anyway – and the patrons are the dregs of society. It is, to put it lightly, an unpleasant place. "Got a charm all of its own, doesn't it?" Tay remarks. "Nah, it's a shithole. Run by an old orc named Padlock. So named for the time a patron tried to stab him and he retaliated with a padlock on a chain. Guards showed up appropriately late. Turns out the other patrons don't like it when you try and shank their barkeep, so they took matters into their own hands." [pc.isDK |"Efficient," you note. "It is," Tay agrees, "so long as you never end up on the wrong side of the mob." |"I like this place less by the minute," you say. "Yeah. Just about the only place to get a drink in this hole, though, so it stays," Tay says. ]
rows.translation: 这个地方是谁在经营的？”你环顾着酒馆问道。 答案是远这些酒馆就位于你常去的鹰棘镇地区，那些被寒风呼啸的荒野之中。有些桌子上残留着淡红色的污渍，你怀疑这些污渍与啤酒毫无关系；地板上布满了洞洞，角落里则爬满了蜘蛛网，灰尘到处都是——不过在贫民区，灰尘覆盖一切似乎已经成为一种常态。而这些酒馆的顾客，其实就是社会中最底层的人渣罢了。用轻描淡写的说法，那确实是个糟糕的地方。 “这里也有它独特的‘魅力’，不是吗？”泰评论道，“不，那简直就是个粪坑。由一个叫锁链的老兽人管理着。之所以叫这个名字，是因为有一次有个顾客试图刺他，而他便用一根链子上的锁链进行了反击。保安来得有点晚。原来，其他顾客可不喜欢有人试图谋害他们的酒保，所以他们决定自己处理这件事。 [pc.isDK |效率很高，”你注意到。 “确实如此，”泰同意道，“只要你不惹上那些暴民就好了。 |我越来越不喜欢这个地方了，”你说。 “是啊。不过在这里，这几乎是唯一能喝到东西的地方，所以我还是会来。”泰说。 ]

rows.original: "The way you tell it, it doesn't seem like there's much of anything here," you say. "Surprised?" Tay remarks. "It's a slum." "Just making sure. It's just the inn and the brothel?" you say. "Weeeeell... there are the local petty gang leaders. Only problem is they're not worth a visit," Tay says. "You might be thinking they're institutions of power or something, with channels running out into the wider city... but you're wrong." The cowgirl shakes her head, letting out a sigh. "They'd never let that happen. Even pickpockets and the like get punished so harshly it's not even worth poking your head up out of the fucking sewer. The gangs are strictly a local menace and even then..." She shrugs. "They're pretty powerless." You can't quite tell, but that might be what passes for pity flashing across her face. "So there's nothing for me here." "Believe me, there's nothing of value to be found in here. Well, unless you wanna check out the brothel." She grins. "There's some real interesting selection to be had... so I hear." Noted.
rows.translation: “照你这么一说，这里似乎没什么值得一看的东西。”你说道。 “很意外？”泰说，“这里可是贫民区。” “只是确认一下。这里就只有那家客栈和那家妓院？”你问道。 “嗯……还有那些本地小帮派的头目。唯一的问题是，他们根本不值得去拜访，”泰说道，“你也许会以为他们是什么权力机构，势力一直延伸到外面的城区……但你想错了。”那位女牛仔摇了摇头，叹了口气。“他们绝不会让那种事发生。就连扒手之流受到的惩罚也重到根本不值得你从这他妈的下水道里探出头来。那些帮派终归只是本地的祸害，而且即便如此……”她耸了耸肩，“他们其实没什么势力。” 你分辨不太出来，但她的脸上或许闪过了一丝可以称作怜悯的神色。“所以我在这里什么都找不到。” “相信我，这里根本找不到什么有价值的东西。嗯，除非你想去妓院看看。”她咧嘴一笑，“那儿有些真正有趣的货色……听说是这样。” 记下了。

rows.translation: 她真的是奥克塔维娅公主吗？

rows.original: Ask about the armor that makes Octavia 'the Black Knight'.
rows.translation: 询问一下那种能让奥克塔维娅成为“黑骑士”的盔甲吧。
rows.raw: "Ask about the armor that makes Octavia 'the Black Knight'."

rows.original: What that old man said outside the arena is still fluttering around your mind. Princess Octavia, he said. Tay, Octavia – you can see it. And despite her... candor, there is yet something about her... "Are you really a princess?" you ask. The muscled cowgirl chokes on her beer, half-coughing it back into her mug as she splutters and wipes her mouth. "Gaagghkh, fuck! Who'd you hear that from?" "There was an old man outside the arena after I walked out, part of the crowd there," you say. "He said you looked like 'Princess Octavia' all grown up. None of the others took him seriously, though." "Fuck me," Tay mutters, leaning back in her chair. "Didn't expect random citizenry to know that." "So you are a princess?" you say. Octavia nods. "The first-born, even." She gives you a crooked smile. "To a slave girl." "Ah," you murmur. "Exactly," she sighs. "Damn. I knew some of the nobles would know, which is why I left the arena. Didn't think regular people would. Haven't been back to the palace since I got back here... there's probably a bunch of people looking for me, but they won't come to the slums." "So that's why you're here," you say. She nods. "That, and I always hated the palace. Never felt like I belonged, for obvious reasons. Always used to sneak out to go playfight and nobody ever gave a shit." Her expression softens for a moment. "Except Varena. Little Varena. Hope she's doing okay with the freaks in the palace these days." [flags.KM_FEAST_VARENA |"I've met her," you tell Octavia. "She's great." Octavia grins. "Well, good. Maybe I'll run into her sometime. She's got to be more of a princess than I am with what's between my legs." |"I'll ask if I run into her," you say. Octavia grins. "You do that. She's got to be more of a princess than I am with what's between my legs." ] The big cowgirl throws her beer back and takes a long drink, waving at a server when she's done.
rows.translation: 那个老人在竞技场外说的那些话，至今仍在你的脑海中回荡。他说的是“奥克塔维娅公主”。泰，奥克塔维娅——你能看出其中的联系。尽管她说起话来……很直率，但她身上还是有一种特别的东西…… “你真的是公主吗？”你问道。 那位肌肉结实的牛仔女孩被啤酒呛到了，她半咳着把酒咳回杯里，一边咳一边擦着嘴：“嘎啊，操！你这是从谁那儿听来那个的？” “我走出竞技场后，外面有个老人，就在人群里，”你说道，“他说你看起来就像长大后的‘奥克塔维娅公主’。不过其他人都没把他当回事。” “操，”泰靠在椅背上嘟囔道，“真没想到普通市民也知道这事。” “所以你是个公主？”你问道。 奥克塔维娅点了点头。“还是长女呢。”她冲你露出一个歪歪的笑，“奴隶女孩生的。” “啊，”你低声说道。 “没错，”她叹息道，“该死。我就知道有些贵族会知道，所以才离开了竞技场。没想到普通人也知道。自从回到这里，我就再没回过皇宫……大概有一堆人在找我，但他们不会来贫民区。” “所以你才待在这儿，”你说道。 她点了点头。“是啊，而且我一直都讨厌那座宫殿。出于显而易见的原因，我从来不觉得自己属于那里。以前总偷偷溜出去打闹，谁都不当回事。”她的表情柔和了一瞬，“除了瓦蕾娜。小瓦蕾娜……希望她这些天在宫里那群怪人身边过得还好。” [flags.KM_FEAST_VARENA |“我见过她，”你告诉奥克塔维娅，“她人很不错。” 奥克塔维娅咧嘴一笑。“那敢情好。也许我以后能碰上她。就凭我两腿之间那玩意儿，她肯定比我更像个公主。” |“如果遇到她，我就问问，”你说道。 奥克塔维娅咧嘴一笑。“你去问吧。就凭我两腿之间那玩意儿，她肯定比我更像个公主。” ] 那位高大的女牛仔仰头把啤酒灌下去，喝了一大口，喝完朝服务员招了招手。

rows.original: "What's the story with that armor?" you ask. Plates of black metal adorn Octavia's body, protecting her just about from head to hoof. With her helmet on, she looks like she could be an iron golem. "Well, it's fuckin' cursed, to start with," Tay grumbles. "I found it in some cultist camp years ago while adventuring and thought that there was obviously something wrong with it, but it still looked good. Probably should've guessed what'd happen." "Oh?" you say, your curiosity piqued. "Go on." "Well, first I grew like 2 and a half feet," she says. "The armor grew with me. And I was strong before, but now I'm really fucking strong." "You did seem unnaturally strong in our fight," you note. Tay nods. "Not all of it's me, as much as I'd like to claim that. Anyway, the real interesting change is that now I have a massive fucking dick. It'd look at home on a centaur." She shrugs. "I guess the cult was into that kind of thing." "Can you take the armor off?" you say. "Oh, sure. Couldn't fuck otherwise. Doesn't make the dick go away though," she says. "'n besides, it's damn good armor. Never needed to repair it." "Is that worth it?" you ask. "Well, it's what I've got," she says. "No point worrying about it. I don't really have any complaints about swapping puss for dick. Neither does anyone I fuck. And it didn't change me as a person." Octavia shrugs again, as if to say 'what are you gonna do?' "If it doesn't bother you it's a moot point, but have you thought about alchemy?" you say. rows.translation: 当你凝视着奥克塔维娅那结实有力的背影时，你的眼皮开始慢慢闭合——此时，这位牛仔女孩正坐在床垫边缘，伸展着双臂。天啊，她真是难以置信…… 等她再次瞥向你的时候，你早已在她床上熟睡了。
rows.raw: " Your eyelids begin to flutter closed as you gaze at Octavia's strong, muscular back while the cowgirl sits on the edge of the mattress and stretches her arms. Gods, she is incredible... By the time she glances at you again, you're fast asleep in her bed. "

rows.original:
"Can I ask you about the slums?" you manage to get out.
    
    "Now?" Octavia grunts. "Sure, knock yourself out."
rows.translation:
“我能问你一些关于贫民区的事情吗？”你终于开口问道。
    
    “现在吗？”奥克塔维娅哼了一声，“当然，尽管问吧。”
rows.raw:
'
    "Can I ask you about the slums?" you manage to get out.
    
    "Now?" Octavia grunts. "Sure, knock yourself out."
    '

rows.original: Inquire about who's running the slums – or appears to be, at least.
rows.translation: 去弄清楚到底是谁在管理那些贫民区——或者至少是表面上看起来是在管理。
rows.raw: "Inquire about who's running the slums – or appears to be, at least."

rows.original: Talk about the soldiers guarding the place.
rows.translation: 谈谈那些守卫此地的士兵。
rows.raw: "Talk about the soldiers guarding the place."

rows.translation: 去了解一下当地的帮派情况吧。

rows.original: Ask about the tavern you're in, the Whore's Bosom.
rows.translation: 问问你现在所在的这家酒馆——‘妓女之胸’。
rows.raw: "Ask about the tavern you're in, the Whore's Bosom."

rows.original: It doesn't seem like there's anything of real worth here.
rows.translation: 这里似乎没有什么真正有价值的东西。
rows.raw: "It doesn't seem like there's anything of real worth here."

rows.original: "So who's really in charge of the slums?" you say. "S'posed to be the king. Really, the interior is run by the local petty gangs like the Black Claw with the outer perimeters guarded fiercely by the soldiers. There's an excess of 'em since they're all stationed at home now, so even getting in is difficult – let alone getting out. There's guards roving the outside streets, too, and they can tell when they see one," Octavia says. "They don't patrol, here. They just guard their posts." "Ruling with an iron fist, huh?" you say. Octavia nods. "They're told not to interfere with 'local politics', and they don't. But when someone pisses off the guards... well, there's been fights before. And when I say fights I mean fully armored legionnaires against scrappy, ragtag slum-raised scum." "So, not a fight at all, then," you note. "Right. They have some mercy, though. They don't put them to death," Octavia says. "Just send them packing with a lot of bruises and bloody snouts. There are no fights now. The slumrats might be dumb, but not that dumb. Anyway, you can think of it like containment. The outer ring of the slums is wholly controlled by the guards. The inner sector?" She shrugs. "That's the realm of the so-called local politics. Gangs, power struggles, brawls in the street. Usually not deadly because nobody wants to incur the wrath of the soldiers, but you get the odd one out with a shank in his back. S'what happens when no one likes you, I guess." You muse on the situation for a moment. "It doesn't sound like there's much of a way to escape the slums." "Happens every so often, but... yeah, it's pretty rare. Gotta remember this is still a fairly recent development. Back before the quarantine, it was just rows of apartments. Shady and somewhat dangerous? Sure. But now it's practically a field of battle. Except it's everyone against everyone else, and the guards don't want to step in if they don't have to." [pc.isDK |"Amazing how fast everything went to fucking shit in here," you say. |"Amazing how quickly things change," you murmur. ] Octavia's face darkens. "Yeah. I wonder about that, sometimes. Is the king still the one giving the orders...?" "Do you have a reason to think otherwise?" you say. She grimaces. "I don't know, I just... it's uncharacteristic, but not that uncharacteristic... maybe I just don't want to think the king would do this." You understand. There's got to be other solutions, but they went with this one. Even the quarantine itself is... well, there's no use dwelling on it now.
rows.translation: “那么，到底是谁在真正管着这些贫民区？”你问道。 “按理说应该是国王。实际上，内城区是由‘黑爪’这类当地小帮派把持的，外围则由士兵们严密把守。现在士兵全都驻扎在本土，人手多得用不完，所以连进去都很难——更别说出去了。外面的街道上也有卫兵在游荡，他们一眼就能认出谁不对劲，”奥克塔维娅说道，“他们在这里不巡逻，只是守着各自的岗位。” “用铁腕手段来统治，是吧？”你问道。 奥克塔维娅点了点头。“上头让他们不要插手‘当地政治’，他们也确实没有插手。但要是有人惹恼了守卫……嗯，以前是发生过斗殴的。我说斗殴，指的是全副武装的军团士兵对上贫民区里长大、衣衫褴褛的乌合之众。” “那根本就谈不上是打架嘛。”你说道。 “没错。不过他们还算有点仁慈，不会把人处死，”奥克塔维娅说，“只是把人揍得满身淤青、鼻子淌血，然后赶走了事。现在已经没有斗殴了。贫民窟的老鼠也许蠢，但还没蠢到那个地步。总之，你可以把它当成一种圈禁。贫民区的外环完全由守卫掌控。内区呢？”她耸了耸肩，“那就是所谓‘当地政治’的地盘。帮派、权力斗争、街头斗殴。通常不会闹出人命，因为没人想招来士兵的怒火，但偶尔也会有个倒霉蛋背上挨一刀。我想，这就是没人待见你的下场吧。” 你琢磨了一会儿这里的情况。“听起来，想逃出贫民区可没什么门路。” “偶尔会有人成功，不过……嗯，确实很罕见。别忘了，这一切都还是最近才发生的。隔离之前，这里不过是一排排公寓。阴暗、有点危险？那是当然。但现在，这里几乎成了一片战场。只不过是人人都跟别人为敌，而守卫们除非不得已，否则也不想插手。” [pc.isDK |“真他妈不可思议，这里的一切竟然这么快就变得一团糟了。”你说道。 |“变化真是快得惊人。”你低声说道。 ] 奥克塔维娅的脸色阴沉下来。“是啊。有时候我也会想，下命令的人……还是国王吗？” “你有什么理由认为不是这样吗？”你问道。 她皱起眉头。“我不知道，我只是……这不像他的作风，但也没那么不像……也许我只是不愿意相信国王会做出这种事。” 你明白。肯定还有别的办法，但他们偏偏选了这一个。就连这隔离本身也……唉，现在再纠结这些也没用了。

rows.original: "How do the soldiers in the slums operate?" you say. "None of them want to be here, obviously," she says. "But they're still faithful soldiers of the kingdom, same as any other... except probably more bitter. Being a soldier is a nice life, you know? Train, keep the peace, protect the local populace from beasts and raiders, be recognized by the people for your efforts, earn some nice money. Everyone likes a border guard." "How much of that is still true?" you say. Octavia gives you a mirthless smirk. "Well, they're not getting any recognition. If anything, people are unhappy they have to deal with cooped-up soldiers. No winners in that situation, that's for fuckin' sure. At best they're keeping the peace... by fighting against the citizens in the Slums. Can't imagine any of 'em feel too great about they money they get for doing that." She shrugs. "If they're even getting money at this point." "But they do handle the issue," you say. "Oh yeah. Like I said, still soldiers of the kingdom. Just exposed to the worst of our citizenry every day," she says. "Doubt they feel like heroes. Is it any surprise they want to be hands-off?" You can see her point.
rows.translation: 贫民区的士兵们是如何执行任务的呢？”你问道。 “显然，他们中没有一个人愿意待在这里，”她回答说，“但他们依然是王国的忠诚士兵，和其他士兵没什么两样……只不过他们的怨恨可能更深吧。你知道，当士兵本来就是一份不错的职业啊。负责维护边境秩序，保护当地居民免受野兽和掠夺者的侵害，因为自己的努力而得到人们的认可，还能赚到不错的收入——谁会不喜欢这样的边境卫兵呢？” “不过，现在还有多少内容是真实的呢？”你问道。 奥克塔维娅露出一个毫无笑意的 smirk，说道：“嗯，他们根本得不到任何认可。事实上，人们都很不满，因为不得不应付这些被关在封闭环境中的士兵们。这场争斗中，没有人是赢家。那个那种处境，简直糟透了。充其量，他们只是通过与贫民区的居民交战来维持秩序罢了……我无法想象，他们为做这种事而得到的钱，能让他们感到有多开心。”她耸了耸肩，“如果他们真能因此得到钱的话。” “但他们毕竟在处理这个问题，”你说。 “哦，是啊。就像我说的，他们依然是王国的士兵。只不过每天都要面对我们社会中最底层的人群罢了。”她说，“我怀疑他们感受到就像英雄们一样。他们想要不插手事情的发展，这有什么好奇怪的吗？” 你确实能理解她的观点。

rows.original:
"How many gangs are in here, anyway?" you say.
    
    "Plenty, but there's three big ones," Octavia says. "There's the Lupertines, run by Madam Khayl. They run the brothel, as well as several other seedy institutions in the crown jewel of our shining city. They're primarily invested in the meat market. Lots of women, lots of men, lots of business with the other two gangs.
    
    The Draskolls handle drugs. All types. I dunno who runs them, and the customers don't care. Plenty of people just want a night with a Lupertine girl and the drugs she offers. Forget your life for a bit.
    
    Then there's the Uglies."
    
    "They call themselves 'The Uglies'?" you ask.
    
    Octavia grins. "Perverse point of pride. The longer you spend in their line of work, the uglier you get, see? Ragged ears, scarred faces, missing eyes and fingers. The Uglies work in manpower and weapons. It's mostly the latter that gets them work. And all three of the gangs work together in a wonderful symbiotic relationship akin to a mass of rats stuck together by their tails. Just as likely to hang out in a sewer, too."
    
    [pc.bg slumrat
        |You grimace. "It's like I never left my hometown."
        |"Sounds like this place has been neglected for years," you say.
    ]
    
    "I figure slums are probably the same the world over," Octavia grunts. "Just that ours is the biggest. Practically a city of its own."
    
    "How big are the slums, anyway?" you ask.
    
    "Well, probably more than ten thousand people in here. Wouldn't be surprised if it was twenty or thirty," Octavia says. "All spread over a few miles of shitty apartments and wooden buildings. There's room for a lot of living and dying even in a place this size, that's for sure."
rows.translation:
“这里到底有多少个帮派？”你问道。
    
    “很多，不过大帮派有三个，”奥克塔维娅说，“为首的是卢珀蒂纳帮，由凯尔夫人掌管。他们经营着这家妓院，还有我们这座明珠般的璀璨城市里其他几处见不得光的场所。他们主要做皮肉生意。大量的女人、大量的男人，以及与其他两个帮派的大量交易。
    
    德拉斯科尔帮帮负责毒品，什么种类的都有。我不知道是谁在管他们，顾客们也不在乎。很多人只想和卢珀蒂纳家的姑娘共度一夜，顺带享用她提供的毒品。暂时忘掉自己的人生吧。
    
    然后还有丑八怪。”
    
    “他们自称‘丑八怪’？”你问道。
    
    奥克塔维娅咧嘴一笑。“扭曲的骄傲。干他们那一行越久，你就越丑，明白吗？残缺的耳朵、布满伤疤的脸、缺掉的眼睛和手指。丑八怪干的是人力和武器，主要靠后者接到活。三个帮派彼此合作，共生关系好得很，就像一群尾巴缠在一起的老鼠。也同样可能窝在下水道里。”
    
    [pc.bg slumrat
        |你皱起眉头。“感觉就像我从没离开过家乡。”
        |“听上去这地方已经被人忽视了很多年。”你说道。
    ]
    
    “我觉得世界各地的贫民区大概都一个样，”奥克塔维娅咕哝道，“只不过我们这儿的是最大的。几乎就是一座独立的城市。”
    
    “那这贫民区到底有多大？”你问道。
    
    “嗯，住在这里的人大概有一万多。就算有两三万我也不会惊讶，”奥克塔维娅说，“全都摊在好几英里的破烂公寓和木头房子上。这地方就算这么小，也容得下许多人生活和死去，这一点毫无疑问。”

rows.original: "Who runs this place?" you ask. It's a far cry from the Frost Hound, your Hawkethorne haunt. Some of the tables downstairs are stained with a faded red-brown you suspect has nothing to do with beer, there are holes in the floor and cobwebs in the corners of this room, dust is everywhere – but dust covering everything seems to be a constant in the slums anyway – and the patrons below are the dregs of society. It is, to put it lightly, an unpleasant place. "What, you don't like it, brat?" Octavia chuckles. "Nah, it's a shithole. Run by an old orc named Padlock. So named for the time a patron tried to stab him and he retaliated with a padlock on a chain. Guards showed up appropriately late. Turns out the other patrons don't like it when you try and shank their barkeep, so they took matters into their own hands." [pc.isDK |"Efficient," you note. "It is," Octavia agrees, "so long as you never end up on the wrong side of the mob." |"I like this place less by the minute," you say. "Yeah. Just about the only place to get a drink in this hole, though, so it stays," Octavia says. ]
rows.translation: 这个地方是谁在管理的？”你问道。 答案是远来自“霜犬酒馆”的哀鸣，那是你常去的鹰棘镇酒馆。楼下的几张桌子被一种褪色的红棕色污渍覆盖，你怀疑这些污渍与啤酒毫无关系；地板上布满了洞洞，房间的角落里也爬满了蜘蛛网，灰尘无处不在——不过在贫民区，灰尘覆盖一切似乎已经成为一种常态。而楼下的那些顾客，无非是社会中的渣滓罢了。用轻描淡写的说法，那确实是个糟糕的地方。 “怎么，你不喜欢这里吗，小鬼？”奥克塔维娅轻笑道，“是啊，这里简直就是个垃圾场。由一个叫帕德lock的老兽人管理的。他得到这个名字，是因为有一次有个顾客试图刺他，而他就用一根链子上的挂锁进行了反击。保安们来得有点晚。原来，其他顾客可不喜欢有人试图谋害他们的酒保，所以他们决定自己动手处理这件事。 [pc.isDK |效率很高，”你注意到。 “确实如此，”奥克塔维娅同意道，“只要你不惹上那些暴民就好了。 |我越来越不喜欢这个地方了，”你说。 “是啊。不过在这里，这几乎是唯一能喝到东西的地方，所以我还是会来。”奥克塔维娅说。 ]

rows.original: "The way you tell it, it doesn't seem like there's much of anything here," you say. "Surprised?" Octavia says. "It's a slum." "Just making sure. It's just the inn and the brothel?" you say. "Weeeeell... there are the local petty gang leaders. Only problem is they're not worth a visit," Octavia says. "You might be thinking they're institutions of power or something, with channels running out into the wider city... but you're wrong." The cowgirl shakes her head, letting out a sigh. "They'd never let that happen. Even pickpockets and the like get punished so harshly it's not even worth poking your head up out of the fucking sewer. The gangs are strictly a local menace and even then..." She shrugs. "They're pretty powerless." You can't quite tell, but that might be what passes for pity flashing across her face. rows.original:
"Did you know Varena well?" you ask.
    
    Octavia's face softens again. It's clear there's some affection there. "Sure. She's my little sister, after all. I haven't seen her in... must be ten, fifteen years or so now, but back then she was just a good-natured kid. Smart, too." She laughs. "Smarter than me. We played together sometimes, though that stopped as she got older. Different paths, and all."
    
    You pause for a moment, then decide to ask anyway. "Are you bitter? About the palace?"
    
    Octavia considers the question. "Not towards Varena. She had nothing to do with any of it. I was plenty bitter at the time, of course, but never around her. I don't regret leaving, though, that's for sure. This place fucking sucks." She gestures vaguely. "The city's changed, and I don't like it. And I don't mean it the way those old bastard senators do, I mean there's something weird happening. None of it's right."
    
    "Oh, believe me... I'm aware," you say. "Varena is a bright spot, though."
    
    "I can believe it," Octavia says. "Vrannus was never bad to me, but we didn't have a reason to talk much. The rest of 'em can suck it. Especially the king. I don't know how he let it get this bad so quickly." She shakes her head in disbelief. "I swear everything was different before I left."
    
    "Well, there is a war going on," you say. "But I get it."
    
    "Even the war itself is weird," she says. "If it was as easy as being pointed in a direction and told to chop, I'd fix it. But, of course, it isn't. Whatever."

“你和瓦蕾娜关系很好吗？”你问道。
    
    奥克塔维娅的脸色又变得柔和起来，显然她对瓦蕾娜怀有深厚的感情。“当然了。她毕竟是我的妹妹。我已经有十几年没见到她了……不过那时候，她只是一个性格开朗、聪明伶俐的小女孩。”她笑着说，“甚至比我还聪明呢。我们有时会一起玩耍，不过随着她年龄的增长，这种来往也就渐渐减少了。毕竟，我们走上了不同的道路。”
    
    你停顿了片刻，还是决定问道：“你是在怨恨吗？怨恨皇宫吗？”
    
    奥克塔维娅仔细考虑了这个问题。“不是怨恨瓦蕾娜。她与这一切毫无关系。当然，当时我确实很怨恨，但那些怨恨并不是针对她的。不过，我一点也不后悔离开这里，这一点是肯定的。这地方真他妈的烂透了。”她含糊地挥了挥手，“这座城市已经变了，而我一点也不喜欢这种变化。我这么说并不是像那些老顽固的参议员们那样，我是觉得有些奇怪的事情正在发生，一切都变得不对劲了。”
    
    “哦，相信我……我明白的，”你说，“不过瓦蕾娜确实是个亮点。”
    
    “我当然相信，”奥克塔维娅说，“弗兰努斯对我从来不坏，但我们也没什么机会经常聊天。其他人嘛，让他们滚蛋去吧。尤其是那个国王——真不明白他怎么能让事情发展得这么糟糕。”她难以置信地摇了摇头，“我发誓，在我离开之前，一切都是不一样的。”
    
    “嗯，现在确实正在发生一场战争，”你说，“不过我明白了。”
    
    “就连这场战争本身也很奇怪，”她说道，“如果真像别人指个方向、让你去砍那么简单，我早就把它解决了。可事实当然不是这样。算了。”

rows.original:
"Why do you go by Tay outside?" you ask.
    
    "Not enough people believe in coincidences around here, and walking around like this already draws enough attention," Octavia says. "Having the name of the firstborn princess attached to me in public is just going to be a pain in the ass."
    
    "Surely Octavia isn't an uncommon name?" you say.
    
    "It's one thing to be a normal Octavia walking around," she says. "It's another to be eight foot and clad in black armor and called Octavia. Once you're notable in one way, people start trying to connect dots. Stories get told, facts get twisted, it all gets annoying. So it's just my little way of staying mildly incognito. As much as I can do that, anyway."

rows.original:
When you awaken Octavia is gone. You lie there for a while, blinking back to proper consciousness while you listen to the dull sound of conversation from the bar below. Having spent so many nights above Garth's inn, you can't help but notice the familiar sounds of happiness are absent here.
    
    You dress and make your way downstairs. Octavia's not here, either. You can't imagine she'll be spending too long away from the drinks, though. She'll be back. Nobody gives you a second glance as you make your way out, leaving the slums behind altogether.
rows.translation:
当你醒来时，奥克塔维娅已经不见了。你躺在那里，眨着眼睛试图恢复清醒，同时听着楼下酒吧里传来的沉闷谈话声。因为在加斯的客栈里度过了许多个夜晚，你自然而然地注意到，这里没有那些令人愉悦的声音。
    
    你穿好衣服，下楼去了。奥克塔维娅也不在。不过，你肯定想不到她会离开那些酒水太久——她肯定会回来的。当你离开那里，彻底离开那些贫民区时，根本没有人多看你一眼。

rows.original:
The smell of soot and charcoal wafts across your face as you turn a corner. At the outskirts of Khor'minos, you find what you surmise to be a mining base camp complete with blast furnaces, water powered pulverizers, work-horses and, of course, booze distilleries.
    
    [party.comp brienne brint
        |"I see that a little siege hasn't slowed down the working boys," Brienne muses.
        |"I see that some demons haven't slowed down the miners. Those guys are made of some different stock," Brint muses.
    ]
    
    You watch as the stocky miners toil away and lift trays of ore that would break the back of any normal man. But these bulls look like they were born straight from the mountain rock and carry their burden like a farmer carries his crops.
    
    At a table playing dice, you recognize a trio of miner-bulls that accosted you out in the tunnels. One of them notices you and grins, elbowing his comrade and rising from the table followed by his two companions.
    
    [flags.UM_MINERS_WON
        |"Well, if it isn't the [pc.race]-slut. Want some taste of bull-meat?" the leader of the group goads while grabbing his fat bulge tenting in his pants.
        
        "[pc.dcb
            |Ah, I see you boys have a humiliation kink. Can't wait to have you pussies perform for the camp when I'm done with you,
            |Hey now, I'm not interested in beating your ass in front of all these fine people,
            |Oh my gods yes! Gimme gimme!
        ]" you answer.
        |"Well look at this, fellas! It's our favorite hole!" the intimidating gambler shouts while grabbing the fat bulge in his pants. "Couldn't get enough of this dick, slut?"
        
        You [pc.dcb
            |scowl. You're going to repay the brutes for the humiliation you suffered in the tunnels.
            |back away. You don't want to end up in another scuffle.
            |lick your lips, those tasty cocks need another suck. Now!
        ]
    ]
    
    But before things get out of hand, a deep, grumbling voice shouts:
    
    "Enough!"
    
    A black bull-man emerges from one of the larger huts. Clad in simple miner's garb — a plain flax tunic, simple trousers and a robust leather-apron — he looks just like the others, but with the way the rowdy gamblers shrink as he approaches, you guess this is some sort of big shot.
    
    "Aw c'mon boss! We're just teasing the [pc.mf
        |guy
        |broad
    ]. We didn't mean anything," the loudmouthed gambler answers while nervously scratching his neck.
    
    The foreman walks up to the gang. While half a head shorter than his underlings, the gritty miner makes up for it in width. He crosses his arms, thick trunks that could probably snap the mino-pervert in two, and grumbles: "Right. And my mother is a goblin. If you want to get your dick wet I suggest you save up for a night at the Pasture. Because that charm certainly won't get you anywhere."
    
    "Hey!" The gamblers protest as the foreman knocks over the dice table.
    
    "Break's over! Back to work, or I'll have you binding pitch torches the rest of the week."
    
    The gamblers shamble away towards their tools. Picking up drills, sledges and pickaxes, they prepare for their shift and walk towards the dark mountains, while muttering something inaudible.
    
    The large foreman turns to you, huffing and blowing away some of the curly locks obscuring his face. Despite his rugged demeanor and rough appearance, he looks kind of cute with those blue eyes hiding behind his bangs, paired with the freckle-like burns across his muzzle.
    
    "I hope my boys didn't give you too much trouble."
    
    "[pc.dcb
        |No. Those calves are lucky that you saved them.
        |Nothing I can't handle.
        |Aw, I was so close to be bred!
    ]"
    
    The foreman snorts through his fire-scarred muzzle. You can't tell if it was from amusement or annoyance but he sticks out a massive hand and mutters, "If you're gonna be wandering around my camp, you will give me your name."
    
    [pc.strengthRange 66
        |You grab his hand.
        |Carefully, you stick out your hand.
    ] The foreman wraps his sausage fingers around yours and, to your surprise, gives you a firm but tender handshake. He seems to be in full control of those monsters.
    
    You give him your name and the foreman responds: "Odoacer. I'm the one running the show here. If you need to talk to someone with more than fucking on his mind, talk to me."
    
    "I'll remember that, chief."
    
    "Good. Now sod off. I got work to do," he grumbles and walks off to inspect the furnaces.
    
    You can't help but feel that, despite his hulking size and muscular physique, the foreman has a tenderness about him. One that doesn't match with this brutish environment. Also, the way he appraised you with those blue eyes from behind their black bangs, it's like he's worried you'll start asking uncomfortable questions.
    
    You shrug, figuring you're probably thinking too much, and return to your business.

rows.original:
"So this mining business, is it going well?" you ask the foreman.
    
    "Not great. Not terrible. We're doing what we can despite the demonic vermin laying siege and interrupting our operation," the burly foreman answers while putting a passer over his prospecting maps.
    
    "Yeah I get it. With arms like those I bet you do a lot of demon crushing and tunnel digging."
    
    Odoacer snorts in amusement.
    
    "Although those overgrown bats pissing in my tunnels complicates things; do you think mining is as easy as digging a hole?" the foreman snaps back. Seems like he enjoys talking about his profession, so you play along.
    
    "Isn't it?"
    
    "Hah, if you think gravel is more useful than metal, sure. Come here," he motions to the prospecting maps. 
    
    "In order to mine, you need some ore to mine, right? It's not like the entire mountain is made up of valuable metal, then there would be just a big crater here and this place would be called the Underquarry. No, the ore in this mountain sits like raisins in a sweetbread. And it's my job to find it."
    
    "So that's what all the digging is about."
    
    "Breaking, not digging," the foreman interjects. "Tell me, what happens when you drive a shovel into a rock."
    
    "The shovel breaks."
    
    "Correct. And pickaxes to mountains are no different. You may have noticed that you don't need warm overcoats here, despite being far beneath the mountain."
    
    "Yes..." you ask, realizing that all these tunnels are quite warm.
    
    "That's because there's fire in the mountain. Literally. At the end of a shift we light fires next to the mountain walls, heating up the rock and making it brittle. Then it's possible to break through the brittle walls."
    
    That's... quite ingenious. So how far do they get in a day?
    
    "Four."
    
    "Four feet, that's quite–"
    
    "Four inches."
    
    "What?"
    
    "Impressed?" Odoacer huffs without the slightest hint of irony. "I know manlings only get about 2 inches with these methods. But when there's prime beef behind those pickaxes, you can tunnel 250 feet in a year."
    
    You nod, part impressed and part happy that you decided to hunt demons instead of swinging pickaxes.

“那么这个采矿业务，进展得怎么样？”你问那位工头。
    
    “不算太好，但也不算太糟。尽管那些讨厌的害虫不断干扰我们的作业，我们还是在尽力而为。”那位身材魁梧的工头一边回答，一边把一张勘探图铺在旁边。
    
    “是啊，我明白。有了那样的手臂，你肯定经常能打败那些恶魔，还能挖很多隧道吧。”
    
    奥多亚塞觉得好笑，哼了一声。
    
    “不过那些在我隧道里撒尿的巨型蝙蝠确实让事情变得复杂多了；你以为采矿真的就像挖个洞那么简单吗？”工头反驳道。看来他很喜欢谈论自己的工作，所以你就顺着他的话往下说吧。
    
    “不是吗？”
    
    “哈，如果你认为碎石比金属更有用，那当然可以。过来，”他指着那些勘探地图说道。 
    
    “要想开采矿石，首先得有可开采的矿石，对吧？毕竟整座山不可能都是由有价值的金属构成的，否则这里早就变成一个巨大的坑洞了，而这个地方也会被叫做‘地下矿场’吧。事实上，这座山里的矿石就像葡萄干嵌在甜面包里一样分布得零零散散的。而我的工作，就是找到这些矿石。”
    
    “原来所有的挖掘工作都是为了这个目的啊。”
    
    “是敲碎岩石，而不是挖掘，”工头插话道，“告诉我，当你用铲子去敲击岩石时会发生什么。”
    
    “铲子会断裂。”
    
    “没错。用镐头敲击岩石也是同样的道理。你们可能已经注意到，在这里即使身处山腹深处，也不需要穿厚外套。”
    
    “是的……”你说道，同时注意到这些隧道里确实相当温暖。
    
    “那是因为山里真的有火。没错。每班工作结束后，我们都会在山壁旁边生火，让岩石受热变脆，这样就可以轻易地敲碎那些脆弱的岩壁了。”
    
    这……确实相当巧妙。那么他们一天能挖多远呢？
    
    “四英尺。”
    
    “四英尺，那还真是——”
    
    “四英寸。”
    
    “什么？”
    
    “觉得厉害吧？”奥多亚塞毫不带讽刺地说道，“我知道用这些方法，人类最多只能挖出两英寸的深度。但只要有壮实的肌肉在镐头后面发力，一年之内就能挖出250英尺的隧道。”
    
    你点了点头，既感到有些钦佩，又为自己决定去猎杀恶魔而不是挥动镐头而感到高兴。
