'
    "So this mining business, is it going well?" you ask the foreman.
    
    "Not great. Not terrible. We're doing what we can despite the demonic vermin laying siege and interrupting our operation," the burly foreman answers while putting a passer over his prospecting maps.
    
    "Yeah I get it. With arms like those I bet you do a lot of demon crushing and tunnel digging."
    
    Odoacer snorts in amusement.
    
    "Although those overgrown bats pissing in my tunnels complicates things; do you think mining is as easy as digging a hole?" the foreman snaps back. Seems like he enjoys talking about his profession, so you play along.
    
    "Isn't it?"
    
    "Hah, if you think gravel is more useful than metal, sure. Come here," he motions to the prospecting maps. 
    
    "In order to mine, you need some ore to mine, right? It's not like the entire mountain is made up of valuable metal, then there would be just a big crater here and this place would be called the Underquarry. No, the ore in this mountain sits like raisins in a sweetbread. And it's my job to find it."
    
    "So that's what all the digging is about."
    
    "Breaking, not digging," the foreman interjects. "Tell me, what happens when you drive a shovel into a rock."
    
    "The shovel breaks."
    
    "Correct. And pickaxes to mountains are no different. You may have noticed that you don't need warm overcoats here, despite being far beneath the mountain."
    
    "Yes..." you ask, realizing that all these tunnels are quite warm.
    
    "That's because there's fire in the mountain. Literally. At the end of a shift we light fires next to the mountain walls, heating up the rock and making it brittle. Then it's possible to break through the brittle walls."
    
    That's... quite ingenious. So how far do they get in a day?
    
    "Four."
    
    "Four feet, that's quite–"
    
    "Four inches."
    
    "What?"
    
    "Impressed?" Odoacer huffs without the slightest hint of irony. "I know manlings only get about 2 inches with these methods. But when there's prime beef behind those pickaxes, you can tunnel 250 feet in a year."
    
    You nod, part impressed and part happy that you decided to hunt demons instead of swinging pickaxes.'

"So," you begin while looking at the foreman's strong arms covered in cuddly black fur. "Do you have any preferences in partners?" you ask.

    Odoacer's ears perk up, and make a nervous wiggle. 
    
    "What do you mean?" he asks while fumbling and dropping his ruler.
    
    "[pc.dcb
        |Do you want to ride or be ridden, bull-man?
        |What kind of partners gets wrapped up in those big, strong arms when your shift ends?
        |What do you think, silly bull? Do you want me on top of that big pole or crushed beneath you. I can do both!
    ]"
    
    "I-I don't have time for such things," the foreman stutters. "Let me get back to work."
    
    That's odd. A minotaur-man not interested in fucking. Although, you did notice a stirring behind Odoacer's apron, maybe you need a more hands-on approach.

    “你是什么意思？”他问道，手忙脚乱间把尺子掉在了地上。
    
    “[pc.dcb
        |牛头人，你想骑别人，还是被别人骑？
        |下工以后，什么样的伴侣能被你这双粗壮有力的手臂搂住？
        |你觉得呢，傻公牛？你是想让我骑上那根大肉棒，还是被你压在身下？两种我都行！

    “我、我没时间做这种事，”工头结结巴巴地说。“让我回去工作吧。”

"Well, Passion Pasture was built off of my own back— quite literally, I was a fairly desirable cow back in the day! Well, I still am desirable, but my services aren't purchasable anymore." She ponders for a moment, poof-tipped tail swishing around. "Boys and girls both paid a pretty penny for my touch, and I scrimped and saved until I could get a building on the outskirts... and then a few guard captains took a liking to me, and now, a few years down the line? Mine is the finest establishment." Feronia stands straight and cups her tits. "Our motto is a simple one: head empty, heart full. Lovers must be clean — there are plenty of bathhouses, we don't run that kind of business ourselves — we don't take bribes, and we don't mix work and pleasure." "Work and pleasure?" you ask. Feronia nods, plucking up a black rose and toying with it. "Open relationships are all well and good — encouraged, considering so many of my babies are full of love — but if my girls and boys decide to date, their partners are not allowed to pay for their services. They do that on their own time... the last thing we want is for any man or woman to have power over their lover like that." There's probably a story to go with this rule, but it sounds plenty sensible from the outside at least.

Feronia smiles and tilts her head, gesturing further into the Pasture. "[flags.PASTURE_COURTESANS
        |
        |Not just girls, mind you. 
    ]We cater to all needs here, dear." The gothic cowgirl is still smiling when she lists them off, counting down each finger.
    
    "There is Mimi, a sweet babe of a cow who has been with us a few years now. She has had a few children in her time, and is much loved by customers and visitors alike. Quite a few would-be-suitors have had to be disappointed, however; Mimi has proven unwinnable on any permanent basis." She gives you a wicked grin, looking down the hallway. "It doesn't stop many a bull — and even the occasional lady — from trying to become the apple of her eye, though. She is bubbly, and bright... the epitome of Passion Pasture's motto."
    
    "Oh! And of course there's Nikol — just the cutest little button with a bottom — and originally I wasn't sure what to make of him... the sweetest little virgin, but hung like a prize stallion." The marm chuckles fondly, tapping her fingers on the counter a couple of times. "So I handed him over to Mimi and asked her to 'go easy on him.' Which of course she did! At first... he's very popular with his lady coworkers, but thus far has proven the very image of professionalism, and kept his fraternising off the clock."
    
    "Decima is a sweetheart, and committed enough to the trade to have gotten just the most wonderful tattoo."
    
    "And we also have a visitor from Kitsuhon in right now! Miss Yashiko is prideful as she is pretty, with all the experience she needs to back it up. She's an expert at using her tail to paint you a perfect picture of pleasure, and those horns of hers make exquisite handholds," Feronia says, miming the shape of a huge pair of sweeping horns. "Though, come to think of it, everything about her makes for quite the handhold. At first she was sad to be trapped here by the lockdown, but she's acclimated quite wonderfully, and I'm happy to keep her as long as she's willing to stay."
    
    [party.comp cait
        |Cait hugs your arm and grins, ears twitching. "If we're hanging around, I'm going to spend some time with one of Feronia's cuties myself. Can't not just spread the word of Mallach in such a wonderful home!" 
        
        The perfectly-painted cowgirl smiles and pats the desk. "It would be our pleasure!"
    ]

rows.translation: 你挑了挑眉毛，说道：[party.hasCompanions | 侧目一看[party.compNames]他们的目光中都带着会意的眼神。在你清了清嗓子之后，你…… | ]解释说，在那个维度门户爆炸的时候，你就在它旁边。 哥布林点了点头，然后咧开了嘴——露出了一排尖牙，才开口说道：“这就解释得通了，为什么你的气场会变成……”她停顿了一下，双手在身前挥动，显得有些不知所措。 “……变成那样的。” 是啊。 [pc.isBimbo |你当时简直……完全就是这样。 |在你……的时候 ]在……某人的保护下，才得以免受爆炸最严重的影响…… 啊咳…………[pc.isBimbo | 但是 | ]仍然有足够的能量能够永久性地改变你。 短发女孩再次点了点头，然后托着下巴说道：“让我猜猜，是身体上的不稳定吗？或者，至少是对炼金术有某种反应吧？ [pc.isBimbo |呃……嗯，好吧。 |A ]其实两者都有点关系；食用某些食物确实会引发你身体内的变化，就好像这些食物经过了炼金术的加工一样。 [pc.isMage |具体来说，任何具有神奇共鸣的食物，都会根据其所蕴含的以太能量来改变你的外形。 rows.original:
Sure, you're definitely going to find the time to visit her. This spell she's working on sounds interesting, [pc.isMage|and you're always willing to learn some more magic|despite your lack of magical training]. The 800 electrum doesn't hurt either.

    Your agreement sparks a grateful light in the shortstack's eyes as she starts energetically shifting around again, saying: "Oh thank you so much [pc.name]! That absolutely makes my day. I'll finally have something to do that's not [var0|clearing out straggling|battling] imps and drinking."
    
    Well, it's nice to see she's so excited about boring you with esoteric magical theories for so long.
    
    This little jab gets Rixx to chuckle, as a blush creeps across her face. Once she's done laughing, the shortstack has a hungry look in her eye, instead of the happy one from before.
    
    "If it's going to be so painful for you, then maybe we could alleviate the boredom with something that's actually fun afterwards." She then pauses to give you a wink, before continuing. "But I'm sure Nieves wants us out of her store already. Here let me give you directions to my house..."
    
    The directions she gives are fairly simple. To get there, all you need to do is head north from Nieve's Shop until you reach the colosseum and then head two blocks west into the city's residential area.
    
    "... Mine is the third one on the left. Just knock and I'll come to the door if I'm home."
    
    Seems simple enough. Is there a specific time you should come by?
    
    With a shake of her head, she explains: "Nah, I'm on leave after an expedition, and I'm a hopeless homebody so just show up and I'll probably be there. Now, I'm gonna head over and get my materials ready for the spell. See ya cutie! You too Nieves!"
    
    You and Nieves both say goodbye and give Rixx a wave as she heads for the door, clearly eager to start working on her project. Once she's gone, Nieves turns to you and says: "Thanks for indulging her curiosity, Champion. Now, was there anything you wanted to buy?"
    
    Maybe, could you look at her stock again?
    
    "Sure..." She says, heading behind the counter to her usual spot. "...Just let me know if anything catches your eye."
    
    Can do.
rows.translation:
当然，你肯定会有时间去拜访她的。她正在研究的这个法术听起来很有趣。 [pc.isMage|而且你总是乐于学习更多的魔法。|尽管你没有接受过任何魔法训练]800枚电银也不会造成什么坏处。

    你的同意让那个资金不足的玩家眼中闪烁着感激的光芒，她立刻又开始忙碌地活动起来，说道：“哦，太感谢你了！ [pc.name]！ 这可真是让我高兴极了。终于有事情可以做了，而不是[var0|清理掉掉队的队伍成员|战斗]小鬼和酒……”
    
    嗯，看到她这么乐意用那些深奥的魔法理论来烦你，真是太好了。
    
    这个小小的调侃让里克斯忍不住笑了起来，她的脸上也浮现出一丝红晕。等她笑完之后，那双原本充满快乐的眼睛里，现在却流露出一种渴望的神情。
    
    如果这会让你感到这么痛苦的话，那么或许我们可以在之后用一些真正有趣的事情来缓解这种无聊感吧。”她停顿了一下，然后向你眨了眨眼，接着继续说道：“不过我敢肯定，妮维丝早就希望我们离开她的商店了。来，让我告诉你去我家的路线吧……
    
    她给出的指示相当简单。要到达那里，你只需要从尼维的商店向北走，直到遇到竞技场，然后向西走两个街区，就能进入城市的居民区。
    
    “……我的房子在左边第三个。你只要敲门，如果我在家的话，就会去开门。
    
    看起来挺简单的。有没有什么特定的时间你应该来呢？”
    
    她摇摇头解释道：“不用，我完成这次探险后正在休假，而且我本来就是个喜欢待在家里的人，所以你随便什么时候来吧，我应该都在家。现在我要去准备制作法术所需的材料了。回头见，小可爱！你也是，妮维丝！
    
    你和妮维丝都向里克斯道别，并在她走向门口时向她挥了挥手，显然她已经迫不及待想要开始着手她的项目了。等她离开后，妮维丝转向你对你说：“谢谢你满足了她的好奇心，冠军。现在，你还有什么想买的吗？
    
    也许，你可以再看看她的库存情况吗？”
    
    “当然可以……”她说道，然后走到柜台后面，来到她常待的地方。“……如果有什么异常的地方，一定要告诉我哦。”
    
    没问题。

rows.original:
Unfortunately, you don't really have the time to waste on something like that. You'd love to help, but researching a new spell isn't high on your priority list, so you're probably not going to be showing up any time soon.
    
    As you say this, Rixx looks visibly disappointed for a few seconds, but her face quickly becomes obscured by a mask of indifference. The goblin shortstack then speaks in a controlled tone. "Thanks for telling me straight away, I guess. And thanks for taking the time to hear me out– even if you can't help me." Her shoulders then slump ever-so-slightly, as the mask slips a little.
    
    Nieves notices this and reaches her hand out to pat Rixx on the head again, with a gentleness that's more comforting than last time. This causes the shortstack to turn and lock eyes with Nieves, who says: "I can help you calculate the spell's incantation Rixx. With both of us remembering the aura's details, I'm sure we can figure out the spell's formula together."
    
    This immediately cheers the goblin up, who can't help but to smile at the vixen. "Thanks Nieve's, you're the best... most of the time, at least." She only nods in response– a similar smile to Rixx's painted across her face.
    
    Rixx then turns back to you and says: "Now, if you'll both excuse me, I'm going to go take some notes and find the tomes we'll need for tonight's work. Goodbye Champion, [var0|I hope the rest of your journey goes well|I hope you manage to save the city]."
    
    You give a nod of thanks, and apologize one last time for being unable to help. She simply shrugs and says: "Don't worry about it. A hero's life is a busy one, after all. Besides, making a new spell was mostly just to help with my boredom so don't sweat it."
    
    Rixx then turns back to Nieves with a more enthusiastic tone. "See you later Nieves! Oh, and remember to bring the wine this time! Afterall, being sober isn't conducive to academic work, now is it?" All she gets in response is a snort from Nieves.
    
    But, that seems to be enough for her, for she turns and leaves through the front door with a wave behind her. Nieves returns it, even though Rixx is looking away, before going back behind her counter. 
    
    Once behind it she looks at you, her expression neutral as she says: "The store's still open, and I'm not going to be getting drunk with her till later, so if you find anything you want just let me know."
    
    Can do.
rows.translation:
可惜，你实在没有时间浪费在这种事上。你很愿意帮忙，但研究新法术并不是眼下的要务，所以短期内大概不会再过来。
    
    听你这么说，里克斯明显失望了几秒，不过脸庞很快便被冷漠的面具遮住。矮小丰腴的哥布林用克制的语气说道：“我想，还是谢谢你立刻把话说明白。也谢谢你愿意抽时间听我说——即使你帮不了我。”接着，她的肩膀极轻地垮了下去，那层面具也稍稍松动。
    
    妮维丝注意到这一点，再次伸手拍拍里克斯的头，这次的动作比上次更加温柔安慰。矮小的哥布林于是转过头，与妮维丝四目相对。妮维丝说道：“里克斯，我可以帮你推算法术的咒文。我们都还记得那道光环的细节，肯定能一起算出法术公式。”
    
    这番话立刻让哥布林振作起来，她忍不住朝雌狐微笑。“谢谢你，妮维丝，你最棒了……至少大多数时候是。”妮维丝只是点头回应，脸上也浮现出与里克斯相似的笑容。
    
    随后，里克斯转回身对你说道：“那么，请二位容我先告辞。我得去做些笔记，再找出今晚研究所需的典籍。再见了，勇者，[var0|祝你接下来的旅途顺利|希望你能成功拯救这座城市]。”
    
    你向她点头致谢，最后一次为自己无法相助而道歉。她只是耸耸肩，说道：“别放在心上。毕竟英雄总是很忙。况且，我想创造新法术主要也只是为了排遣无聊，所以不必在意。”
    
    里克斯又以更加热情的语气转向妮维丝。“回头见，妮维丝！哦，还有，这次记得带酒！毕竟，保持清醒可不利于学术研究，对吧？”妮维丝只以一声嗤笑回应。
    
    不过，这对她而言似乎已经足够了；她转身走出前门，同时向身后挥手。尽管里克斯并没有回头，妮维丝依然挥手作别，随后回到柜台后方。 
    
    回到柜台后，她神情平静地看向你，说道：“店还开着，而且我要到晚些时候才会和她一起喝醉。所以看中什么就告诉我。”
    
    没问题。
rows.raw:
"
    Unfortunately, you don't really have the time to waste on something like that. You'd love to help, but researching a new spell isn't high on your priority list, so you're probably not going to be showing up any time soon.
    
    As you say this, Rixx looks visibly disappointed for a few seconds, but her face quickly becomes obscured by a mask of indifference. The goblin shortstack then speaks in a controlled tone. "Thanks for telling me straight away, I guess. And thanks for taking the time to hear me out– even if you can't help me." Her shoulders then slump ever-so-slightly, as the mask slips a little.
    
    Nieves notices this and reaches her hand out to pat Rixx on the head again, with a gentleness that's more comforting than last time. This causes the shortstack to turn and lock eyes with Nieves, who says: "I can help you calculate the spell's incantation Rixx. With both of us remembering the aura's details, I'm sure we can figure out the spell's formula together."
    
    This immediately cheers the goblin up, who can't help but to smile at the vixen. "Thanks Nieve's, you're the best... most of the time, at least." She only nods in response– a similar smile to Rixx's painted across her face.
    
    Rixx then turns back to you and says: "Now, if you'll both excuse me, I'm going to go take some notes and find the tomes we'll need for tonight's work. Goodbye Champion, [var0|I hope the rest of your journey goes well|I hope you manage to save the city]."
    
    You give a nod of thanks, and apologize one last time for being unable to help. She simply shrugs and says: "Don't worry about it. A hero's life is a busy one, after all. Besides, making a new spell was mostly just to help with my boredom so don't sweat it."
    
    Rixx then turns back to Nieves with a more enthusiastic tone. "See you later Nieves! Oh, and remember to bring the wine this time! Afterall, being sober isn't conducive to academic work, now is it?" All she gets in response is a snort from Nieves.
    
    But, that seems to be enough for her, for she turns and leaves through the front door with a wave behind her. Nieves returns it, even though Rixx is looking away, before going back behind her counter. 
    
    Once behind it she looks at you, her expression neutral as she says: "The store's still open, and I'm not going to be getting drunk with her till later, so if you find anything you want just let me know."
    
    Can do.
    "

rows.original:
Well, she's right about you being pretty busy [var0|despite the siege being over|with the siege still going on]. But you're definitely interested in this spell of hers, [pc.isMage
        |given how you're always willing to learn some more magic
        |despite your lack of magical training
    ]. If you manage to find the time, you'll come over to her house.
    
    This tentative confirmation causes her grin to bloom into a full on smile as she bows and says: "That's all I ask." After raising from the bow, she starts shifting from foot to foot with an excited energy once again.
    
    "And uh... thanks for at-least considering my proposal, [pc.name]! Having the chance to work on a new spell is exactly what I needed. It'll finally give me something to do other than [var0|clearing out straggling|battling] imps and drinking."
    
    Well, it's nice to see she's so excited to bore you with esoteric magical theory for so long.
    
    This little jab gets Rixx to chuckle, as a blush creeps across her face. Once she's done laughing, the shortstack has a hungry look in her eye, instead of the happy one from before.
    
    "If it's going to be so painful for you, then maybe we could alleviate the boredom with something that's actually fun afterwards." She then pauses to give you a wink, before continuing. "But I'm sure Nieves wants us out of her store already. Here let me give you directions to my house..."
    
    The directions she gives are fairly simple. To get there, all you need to do is head north from Nieve's Shop until you reach the colosseum and then head two blocks west into the city's residential area.
    
    "... Mine is the third one on the left. Just knock and I'll come to the door if I'm home."
    
    Seems simple enough. Is there a specific time you should come by?
    
    With a shake of her head, she explains: "Nah, I'm on leave after an expedition, and I'm a hopeless homebody, so just show up and I'll probably be there. Now, I'm gonna head over and start researching what I'll need if you come over. See ya cutie! You too Nieves!"
    
    You and Nieves both say goodbye and give Rixx a wave as she heads for the door, clearly eager to start working on her project. Once she's gone, Nieves turns to you and says: "Thanks for indulging her curiosity, Champion. Now, was there anything you wanted to buy?"
    
    Maybe, could you look at her stock again?
    
    "Sure..." She says, heading behind the counter to her usual spot. "...Just let me know if anything catches your eye."
    
    Can do.
rows.translation:
嗯，她说你确实很忙，这一点没错。 [var0|尽管围攻已经结束|在围攻仍在继续的情况下]但你肯定对她这个法术很感兴趣吧。 [pc.isMage
        |考虑到你总是乐于学习更多的魔法知识，
        |尽管你没有接受过任何魔法训练
    ]如果你能抽出时间的话，就来她家吧。”
    
    这个含糊的回应让她原本的微笑变得更加灿烂，她鞠躬说道：“这就是我全部的心愿了。”从鞠躬姿势站起身后，她又重新开始兴奋地来回走动起来。
    
    “还有……至少你考虑了我的提议，真的非常感谢。 [pc.name]能够有机会参与一个新法术的开发工作，正是我所需要的。这样，我就终于有事情可做了，而不再只是无所事事[var0|清理残余部队|战斗]小鬼和酒……”
    
    嗯，看到她这么乐意用那些深奥的魔法理论来烦你，真是太好了。
    
    这个小小的调侃让里克斯忍不住笑了起来，她的脸上也浮现出一丝红晕。等她笑完之后，她的眼神中不再带着之前的愉悦，而是一种渴望的神情。
    
    如果这会让你感到这么痛苦的话，那么或许我们可以在之后用一些真正有趣的事情来缓解这种无聊感吧。”她停顿了一下，冲你眨了眨眼，然后继续说道：“不过我敢肯定，妮维丝早就希望我们离开她的商店了。来，让我告诉你去我家的路线吧……
    
    她给出的指示相当简单。要到达那里，你只需要从尼维的商店向北走，直到遇到竞技场，然后向西走两个街区，就能进入城市的居民区。
    
    “……我的房子在左边第三个。只要敲门，如果我在家的话，就会去开门。
    
    看起来挺简单的。有没有什么特定的时间你建议我来呢？”
    
    她摇摇头解释道：“不用，我刚完成一次探险任务，现在正在休假。而且我本来就是个喜欢待在家里的人，所以你随便什么时候来吧，我应该都在家。现在我要去准备一些你来的时候可能会需要的东西了。回头见啦，小可爱！你也是，妮维丝！
    
    你和妮维丝都向里克斯道别，并在她走向门口时向她挥了挥手，显然她已经迫不及待想要开始着手她的项目了。等她离开后，妮维丝转向你对你说：“谢谢你满足了她的好奇心，冠军。现在，你还有什么想买的吗？
    
    也许，你可以再看看她的库存情况吗？”
    
    “当然可以……”她说道，然后走到柜台后面，来到她常待的地方。“……如果有什么异常的地方，一定要告诉我哦。”
    
    没问题。

Wanting to see Rixx again, you climb her front stoop and give the house's heavy oaken door a few solid knocks. Once again, they reverberate throughout the rooms beyond, until the noise dies away and you're left with only the city's soft buzz.
    
    [rand
        |Immediately, Rixx's sliding viewport snaps open, and you see her stormy gray eyes stare out with a palpable anger behind them. "I'm not going to buy..." Her voice then falters for a moment as she recognizes you. "Oh, It's you, [pc.name]! I thought you were that guy who keeps trying to sell me random crap he thinks are alchemical reagents. Here, let me get the locks and you can come on in."
        |There you wait for a bit, but, eventually, Rixx's viewport snaps open, and you see her stormy gray eyes stare out with a bored indifference. She doesn't immediately say anything, but when her eyes meet yours, they widen as she recognizes you. "Hey [pc.name]! Let me open this door so you can swoop in and rescue me from being vaguely bored!"
        |There you wait... and wait... until you eventually try knocking on the door again. Once again, you're left waiting, until you're about ready to leave and try again later. But, just as you take the first step off of Rixx's stoop, her viewport suddenly snaps open. Through it, you can see her stormy gray eyes recognize you, as she says in an amused tone: "Hey [pc.name]! Sorry about the wait, I had to finish with one of my clients and bundle them out the back before I could let you in. Here, let me get the locks."
    ]
    
    The viewport then snaps shut, and after the rattle of a chain, Rixx's door swings open and you're face to face with the goblin herself. You give her your friendliest smile and ask if she's got the time to entertain [party.hasCompanions
        |[party.yall]
        |you for a bit
    ]. At this, the little goblin's ears perk, and her grin widens into a smile as she gives an enthusiastic nod. [rand
        |"Yep! And thank the Seven for that. Tonight was looking to be pretty boring, but I didn't feel like hanging out with the others down at the barracks. Come on in, let's go talk in the living room."
        |"Yep! I've just finished up one of my experiments, so we've got plenty of time. Come on in, let's go talk in the living room."

    ]
    
    She then turns and starts heading through her house. [party.yall] enter, shut the door behind you, and follow closely behind the little goblin. Soon enough, [party.hasCompanions
        |you're all seated in Rixx's living room, while she's
        |you're on a couch opposite of Rixx, who's
    ] reclining back on a couch of her own– her cock bulging obscenely against the fabric of her robe.
    
    "So, what brings you to my happy little home, hmmm [pc.name]?"

        |没错！我刚刚完成了一个实验，所以我们现在有充足的时间。进来吧，我们去客厅聊吧。
        |没错！我刚从一次野外考察中回来，现在正好想和朋友一起放松一下。进来吧，我们去客厅聊吧。
    ]
    
    然后她转身，开始在房子里走动。 [party.yall]进去吧，把门关上，然后紧跟在小哥布林后面。不久之后，你就会[party.hasCompanions

    “那么，是什么让你来到了我这个快乐的小家呢，嗯[pc.name]？”

rows.original: Wondering what her little experiment is going to entail, you climb the front stoop of Rixx's house and pause at the door. It's a heavy oaken thing that's on sturdy hinges and has a sliding viewport carved into it at the height where a goblin's eye's would be. Yep, this is the place. Wasting no more time, you reach forward and give the door a few solid knocks that reverberate throughout the house beyond. There's then a few moments of nothing but silence and the city's quiet bustle behind you. Eventually though, Rixx's viewport suddenly slides open, and you see those stormy gray eyes staring back out at you. Recognition blooms in her a moment afterwards, and you hear from her side: "Oh, hey [pc.name]! Let me unlock this so you can get your[pc.skinTag wooly furred scaled | wooly | furry | scaly |[pc.buttRange 5 8 12 | tiny | | massive ] ] butt in here." The sliding hole is quickly closed again, and you hear a lock being undone. When the door swings open, you're greeted by Rixx, with her hands on hips and the same robe still on. You greet her cheerfully, and ask how the spell's preparations are going. With a grin she gives a "come on" wave, and starts walking through the house. [party.yall] shut the door behind you before following her as she talks about the spell. "From what I've worked out so far, the main trick with this one is going to be shaping the energy into something self-sustaining. If I were to just gather some aetheric energy into the general shape of your aura and toss it at someone, they'd immediately cum their brains out and that'd be that. But I want to create a stable elemental with the energy– which is proving difficult given how chaotic it is." As she speaks, you're led through a living room and kitchen that's plushly decorated, but looks like it gets little actual use. Eventually, you pass through a hallway and make it to a solid electrum door that has runes carved across the entirety of its face. [pc.isMage |Your magical knowledge helps you understand that those runes are all wards and words of binding. This is definitely the summoning room then, right? |Your limited magical knowledge fails you when it comes to understanding them, so you decide to ask Rixx about them. This has got to be the summoning room, right? ] "Yep!" She says, obviously happy you noticed. "I carved the runes and imbued them myself. They're done in the old Belharan style, so it's pretty easy to pierce the veil in here." She then reaches for the door's handle and casually pulls it open, as if she were going out to a patio instead of a room designed to draw otherworldly creatures into this existence. Immediately, the room's design confirms what it's for, and leaves no room for interpretation. Its walls are featureless gray slabs, void of any markings and as smooth as a dinner plate. The floor, however, is covered in overlapping geometric[pc.isMage | warding | ] patterns that have been carved directly into the stone. A raised circular slab in the room's center is the only thing not touched by them. On its smooth surface, a [pc.isMage |more traditional summoning circle has |completely different set of symbols have ] been drawn in[pc.isMage | |side of a ] chalk[pc.isMage | | circle ]. There's also an alcove dug into the wall opposite of the room's entrance. In it, there are no warding patterns on the floor, a wooden desk with stacks of worn tomes, and a scattering of arcane looking diagrams piled atop it. rows.original:
The next two hours are spent watching Rixx attempt to bring the aetheric energy to life with different incantations and sometimes in quiet conversation with [party.hasCompanions
                |either her, or [party.compNames]
                |the little shortstack
            ].
            
            There are many false starts, where a half formed figure is pulled together for a few moments, only for it to dissolve back into a shapeless mass. But, by the end of it, Rixx's final spell manages to shape the billowing cloud into the figure of a well endowed woman. Its roiling purple mist and arcs of lightning molded into a form that could be described as human, but obviously isn't. With long hair that waves as if underwater, and toned legs that gently float off the ground.
            
            The figure's otherworldliness almost makes you want to reach out and touch it, but that would probably be a bad idea. With a glance over at Rixx, who's studying the creature with her chin in hand, you ask if the spell's complete.
            
            The shortstack gives a single quick nod, and then hesitates a moment as if weighing a thought. "... I think this is a stable configuration. But I'm eager to see what its personality is going to be, given how esoteric I had to get with the incantations. Would you do the honours of talking and interfacing with it while I maintain the spell?"
            
            Oh you can definitely do that. After two hours of waiting around, you're eager to see what this thing's like.
            
            She gives another quick nod and raises her hand back into the stance she uses to cast. You get up from your chair and stride over till you're facing the elemental head-on. As you get in position, you hear Rixx begin the incantation that will bring consciousness to this elemental body.
            
            A few moments go by in eager anticipation, when suddenly, the figure's "eyes" flutter open and lock with yours. In a sultry, feminine voice it coos: "Heeeey there sweetie-pie! You're staring at little ol' me awfully hard. See something you like?" To punctuate the question, she bends forward to show off her impressive cleavage, while pursing her lips for a mock kiss at the same time.
            
            Are you being seduced by an elemental spirit?
            
            More confused than anything, you look over at Rixx as she finishes up her incantation, and she looks just as baffled as you are. The goblin glances at you, clears her throat, and commands in a tone you haven't heard from her before: "Spirit. You are given leave of this binding circle if, and only if, you are bound to my will and shall obey my orders."
            
            The elemental spirit bends back upright and brings a hand to cover her mouth as she gives a bubbly giggle in response. "Oh yeah, you're like, totally my Mistress now– but I'd rather do this talking stuff later. Right now I wanna get my hands on this cutie and make [pc.himHer] feel amazing!" She then nods towards you, as pink lightning sparks across her outstretched hands.
            
            Before you have a chance to react, Rixx's voice suddenly booms with another command: "Spirit! You shall not use your powers unless I direct you to. Am I understood?" The billowing cloud of lustful energy mimics a pout when she hears this, and mumbles "yes Mistress," as she looks down at her feet.
            
            Her acquiescence causes Rixx's demeanour to soften ever so slightly. She then begins speaking again, but this time her voice doesn't have the same harsh edge to it. "Don't worry spirit, you'll get your chance to spread pleasure. I've got an endless horde of little red fucks you can zap into blissful comas– you just need to wait for our next expedition."
            
            Like a puppy hearing someone say "treat," the spirit's mood instantly flips. Suddenly, she's all smiles and giggles again, as she hops up and down, loudly exclaiming: "Yaaaaaay! It's gonna be sooooo much fun, just you wait and see!"
            
            This earns a chuckle from Rixx, who shakes her head and says: "I bet you'll enjoy yourself, at least. But for now it's time for you to go." She then raises her hand and begins [pc.isMage
                |an incantation you recognize as an unsummoning spell
                |another unfamiliar incantation
            ].
            
            Instantly, you see the mist that forms the bubbly spirit's body start to dissipate. And oddly enough, the elementally charged bimbo reacts to this with more curiosity than anything. She takes a moment to watch as her hands begin to fade away– and if she could drool, you'd imagine some would drip out of her mouth at this point. 
            
            Her eyes then suddenly open wide, as she suddenly realizes that she's going away for now. Quickly, she takes her near translucent hand and waves it at you and Rixx– a bubbly smile on her face. "Oke-doke then Mistress, I'll be around the next time you call me! But try to have someone for me to fuck or z..." Whatever she was going to end that sentence with is lost to everyone but her, as she fades back into the aether.
            
            Well, that was certainly something. It looks like the Khor'minos military now has a weapon that'll give those imps a dose of their own medicine. You turn to Rixx and ask, just a little sarcastically, if she got what she wanted out of this.
            
            She stands still for a moment, obviously lost in thought– chewing on her bottom lip as she thinks about what you both just witnessed. Eventually she says: "I didn't get what I expected, but I think this'll be something that's pretty useful. Imagine the look on those imps faces when they swing their cocks at her or try to slap her tits and they get electrocuted by pure pleasure! They'll be sitting ducks for everyone else in the cohort to finish off."
            
            A powerful tool against a foe that has little to no self control. But does she think she'll be able to summon it in the field reliably?
            
            Rixx instantly nods back, beaming with the same pride you saw in Nieve's shop, as she explains: "Now that I've figured out the right incantations, summoning our new spirit should be as simple as any other elemental. And that means you've thoroughly earned your bag of electrum– plus a bonus for staying so long! Here, go make yoursel[party.hasCompanions
                |ves
                |f
            ] comfortable in the living room while I get your reward."
            
            She then strides over to, and opens the door, with an "after you" gesture. You head out, and make your way back to her living room, where you park your [pc.waist] down on a comfy couch.
            
            Soon enough, Rixx pops back into the room with a heavy looking coin purse in her hand. With a double-underhand toss, Rixx calls out: "Think fast!" as she manages to huck the bag at you– despite her tiny size. You, meanwhile, [pc.strengthRange 0 70
                |manage to catch the bag, but stumble from its weight and collapse back into the couch.
                |manage to catch the bag without any effort at all– its weight meaningless next to your strength.
            ]
            
            As you do, Rixx makes her way over to a couch opposite of yours and flops onto it. There she lays on her back with her eyes closed as you weigh the sack in your hands. It definitely feels like 800 electrum plus a bunch of bonus cash.
            
            A few moments go by in silence, as the exhausted little goblin rests. This lasts until you're about to go check and see if she fell asleep, but, just as the thought crosses your mind, her eyes blink open and she gives a big yawn that shows off her sharp teeth and long tongue.
            
            After the yawn, she rolls over onto her side and stares at you with a languid grin. In an equally languorous voice, Rixx says: "Sorry about that, magic can be pretty tiring you know. But I'm still awake enough to do something fun, if you want! Or we could get started on your training if you're still interested. Or we could even chat like we're on guard duty. I'm game for whatever."
            
            Well, now that you've been paid for your time, is there anything else you want to do with the little summoner?

            她静静地站了一会儿，显然陷入了沉思——一边咬着下唇，一边思考你们刚刚所目睹的一切。最终，她说道：“我并没有得到我原本期望的结果，但我觉得这会是一些相当有用的东西。想象一下，当那些小混混们朝她挥动他们的“武器”，或者试图拍打她的胸部，结果却因为极度兴奋而触电身亡时，他们脸上会露出什么样的表情吧！对于团队里的其他成员来说，他们简直就是容易捕捉的猎物，其他人完全可以轻松地将他们解决掉。

            对于那些几乎没有自控能力的敌人来说，这确实是一种强大的武器。但她真的认为自己能够在实战中可靠地使用它吗？

里克斯立刻点了点头，脸上洋溢着与你在尼芙的店里看到的一样的自豪之情，她解释道：“现在我已经掌握了正确的咒语，召唤我们的新精灵应该和其他元素生物一样简单。这意味着你完全配得上那袋电银——更何况你还坚持了这么久！来，拿去吧。[party.hasCompanions
                |
                |f
            ]我在客厅里等着，等你回来领取奖励。”

然后她走过去打开了门，还做了个“你先请”的手势。你走了出去，再次回到了她的客厅，然后在那里停了下来。 [pc.waist]坐在舒适的沙发上。

不久之后，里克斯手部拿一个看起来很重的钱包回到了房间。她用一种特殊的投掷方式，一边喊着“快想吧！”，一边将钱包朝你扔了过来——尽管她的身材非常娇小。而你，就在这个时候[pc.strengthRange 0 70
                |设法抓住了那个包，但却因为它的重量而踉跄了一下，最终又倒回了沙发上。
                |毫不费力地抓住了那个袋子——在你的力量面前，它的重量根本无关紧要。
            ]

            你这么一做的时候，里克斯走到了你对面的一张沙发上，然后扑通一声躺了下去。她仰面躺着，闭着眼睛，而你则把那个袋子拿在手里称了称重量。毫无疑问，这个袋子里装着800枚琥珀金币，还有不少额外的现金。

            片刻的寂静之后，这只精疲力竭的小哥布林终于安静下来休息了。这种宁静一直持续到你准备去看看她是否已经睡着的时候，然而就在你这么想的瞬间，她的眼睛突然睁开了，然后打了一个大大的哈欠，露出了她那锋利的牙齿和长长的舌头。

            打了个哈欠后，她侧过身来，慵懒地笑着盯着你。里克斯用同样慵懒的声音说道：“实在抱歉，你知道的，魔法有时候会让人感到非常疲惫。不过我还没困到无法做些有趣的事情，如果你愿意的话！或者，如果你仍然感兴趣的话，我们可以开始你的训练了。当然，我们也可以像值勤一样闲聊几句，什么方式都行，我都没问题。

嗯，既然你已经得到了相应的报酬，那么对于这个小小的召唤师，你还想做些什么吗？
rows.raw:
"
            The next two hours are spent watching Rixx attempt to bring the aetheric energy to life with different incantations and sometimes in quiet conversation with [party.hasCompanions
                |either her, or [party.compNames]
                |the little shortstack
            ].
            
            There are many false starts, where a half formed figure is pulled together for a few moments, only for it to dissolve back into a shapeless mass. But, by the end of it, Rixx's final spell manages to shape the billowing cloud into the figure of a well endowed woman. Its roiling purple mist and arcs of lightning molded into a form that could be described as human, but obviously isn't. With long hair that waves as if underwater, and toned legs that gently float off the ground.
            
            The figure's otherworldliness almost makes you want to reach out and touch it, but that would probably be a bad idea. With a glance over at Rixx, who's studying the creature with her chin in hand, you ask if the spell's complete.
            
            The shortstack gives a single quick nod, and then hesitates a moment as if weighing a thought. "... I think this is a stable configuration. But I'm eager to see what its personality is going to be, given how esoteric I had to get with the incantations. Would you do the honours of talking and interfacing with it while I maintain the spell?"
            
            Oh you can definitely do that. After two hours of waiting around, you're eager to see what this thing's like.
            
            She gives another quick nod and raises her hand back into the stance she uses to cast. You get up from your chair and stride over till you're facing the elemental head-on. As you get in position, you hear Rixx begin the incantation that will bring consciousness to this elemental body.
            
            A few moments go by in eager anticipation, when suddenly, the figure's "eyes" flutter open and lock with yours. In a sultry, feminine voice it coos: "Heeeey there sweetie-pie! You're staring at little ol' me awfully hard. See something you like?" To punctuate the question, she bends forward to show off her impressive cleavage, while pursing her lips for a mock kiss at the same time.
            
            Are you being seduced by an elemental spirit?
            
            More confused than anything, you look over at Rixx as she finishes up her incantation, and she looks just as baffled as you are. The goblin glances at you, clears her throat, and commands in a tone you haven't heard from her before: "Spirit. You are given leave of this binding circle if, and only if, you are bound to my will and shall obey my orders."
            
            The elemental spirit bends back upright and brings a hand to cover her mouth as she gives a bubbly giggle in response. "Oh yeah, you're like, totally my Mistress now– but I'd rather do this talking stuff later. Right now I wanna get my hands on this cutie and make [pc.himHer] feel amazing!" She then nods towards you, as pink lightning sparks across her outstretched hands.
            
            Before you have a chance to react, Rixx's voice suddenly booms with another command: "Spirit! You shall not use your powers unless I direct you to. Am I understood?" The billowing cloud of lustful energy mimics a pout when she hears this, and mumbles "yes Mistress," as she looks down at her feet.
            
            Her acquiescence causes Rixx's demeanour to soften ever so slightly. She then begins speaking again, but this time her voice doesn't have the same harsh edge to it. "Don't worry spirit, you'll get your chance to spread pleasure. I've got an endless horde of little red fucks you can zap into blissful comas– you just need to wait for our next expedition."
            
            Like a puppy hearing someone say "treat," the spirit's mood instantly flips. Suddenly, she's all smiles and giggles again, as she hops up and down, loudly exclaiming: "Yaaaaaay! It's gonna be sooooo much fun, just you wait and see!"
            
            This earns a chuckle from Rixx, who shakes her head and says: "I bet you'll enjoy yourself, at least. But for now it's time for you to go." She then raises her hand and begins [pc.isMage
                |an incantation you recognize as an unsummoning spell
                |another unfamiliar incantation
            ].
            
            Instantly, you see the mist that forms the bubbly spirit's body start to dissipate. And oddly enough, the elementally charged bimbo reacts to this with more curiosity than anything. She takes a moment to watch as her hands begin to fade away– and if she could drool, you'd imagine some would drip out of her mouth at this point. 
            
            Her eyes then suddenly open wide, as she suddenly realizes that she's going away for now. Quickly, she takes her near translucent hand and waves it at you and Rixx– a bubbly smile on her face. "Oke-doke then Mistress, I'll be around the next time you call me! But try to have someone for me to fuck or z..." Whatever she was going to end that sentence with is lost to everyone but her, as she fades back into the aether.
            
            Well, that was certainly something. It looks like the Khor'minos military now has a weapon that'll give those imps a dose of their own medicine. You turn to Rixx and ask, just a little sarcastically, if she got what she wanted out of this.
            
            She stands still for a moment, obviously lost in thought– chewing on her bottom lip as she thinks about what you both just witnessed. Eventually she says: "I didn't get what I expected, but I think this'll be something that's pretty useful. Imagine the look on those imps faces when they swing their cocks at her or try to slap her tits and they get electrocuted by pure pleasure! They'll be sitting ducks for everyone else in the cohort to finish off."
            
            A powerful tool against a foe that has little to no self control. But does she think she'll be able to summon it in the field reliably?
            
            Rixx instantly nods back, beaming with the same pride you saw in Nieve's shop, as she explains: "Now that I've figured out the right incantations, summoning our new spirit should be as simple as any other elemental. And that means you've thoroughly earned your bag of electrum– plus a bonus for staying so long! Here, go make yoursel[party.hasCompanions
                |ves
                |f
            ] comfortable in the living room while I get your reward."
            
            She then strides over to, and opens the door, with an "after you" gesture. You head out, and make your way back to her living room, where you park your [pc.waist] down on a comfy couch.
            
            Soon enough, Rixx pops back into the room with a heavy looking coin purse in her hand. With a double-underhand toss, Rixx calls out: "Think fast!" as she manages to huck the bag at you– despite her tiny size. You, meanwhile, [pc.strengthRange 0 70
                |manage to catch the bag, but stumble from its weight and collapse back into the couch.
                |manage to catch the bag without any effort at all– its weight meaningless next to your strength.
            ]
            
            As you do, Rixx makes her way over to a couch opposite of yours and flops onto it. There she lays on her back with her eyes closed as you weigh the sack in your hands. It definitely feels like 800 electrum plus a bunch of bonus cash.
            
            A few moments go by in silence, as the exhausted little goblin rests. This lasts until you're about to go check and see if she fell asleep, but, just as the thought crosses your mind, her eyes blink open and she gives a big yawn that shows off her sharp teeth and long tongue.
            
            After the yawn, she rolls over onto her side and stares at you with a languid grin. In an equally languorous voice, Rixx says: "Sorry about that, magic can be pretty tiring you know. But I'm still awake enough to do something fun, if you want! Or we could get started on your training if you're still interested. Or we could even chat like we're on guard duty. I'm game for whatever."
            
            Well, now that you've been paid for your time, is there anything else you want to do with the little summoner?
            "

A smug lilt then begins to creep into her voice as she continues speaking. "It'd let me go around and brag about how the vaunted Champion of Frost is my apprentice. I might even be able to score a few drinks at Vitra's bar if anyone actually believes me!" rows.translation: 那么，她愿意训练你的提议还算数吗？冒险时能迅速召来支援，确实会很有用。 “当然，我还是会教你的！”她继续说着，语调渐渐得意起来。“这样我就能到处吹嘘，大名鼎鼎的冰霜勇士其实是我的学徒了。要真有人信，说不定还能在薇特拉的酒吧里混几杯酒喝！” 那可真遗憾，因为你本来也想靠自称是伟大而强大的里克斯的学徒，去讨免费酒喝！ 小个子的哥布林被你这番回敬逗得咧嘴轻笑，神情轻快愉悦。“嗯……你再这么会说话，说不定训练时我会对你手下留情。” 她真会吗？ “不会。”她靠回椅背，仍笑着看你，只给出了这一个回答。

rows.original:
After counting out Rixx's payment and dropping it onto the table in front of you, she claps her hands together and beams a smile at you. "Now that you've paid me, I've got to get serious and actually teach you something! Come on, let's head to my training pit for some fresh air while I teach you the spell's form. We can move to the summoning room once we're done and see if you can actually control the spell."
    
    She then hops up from her couch and starts heading towards the house's back. You get up [party.hasCompanions
        |and tell [party.compNames] that you'll meet back up at Rose's inn later tonight. By the time you've finished exchanging goodbyes with them, Rixx has reappeared in the doorway with a bundle of scrolls under her arm and is motioning for you to follow.
        |and follow her, as she goes from bookshelf to bookshelf, picking up a few scrolls that catch her eye. By the time she's finished, there's a bundle of them under her arm, and she's motioning for you to follow.
    ]
    
    You do so, letting her lead you through an outside door and into a walled backyard. One look at the space is all you need to realize that this is where Rixx practices her magic. Besides the gladiator style sand-pit in the courtyard's middle, there's also a row of training dummies lined up against a wall that has a couple of scorch marks marring its surface. She also has a couple of benches sitting a few feet back from the sand-pit and a big barrel of water with a ladle hooked onto a jutting nail.
    
    "Step over to the arena's center and get into your casting position." Feeling the sand shift underneath your heels, you move over to the directed spot and drop into a fighting stance. Rixx, meanwhile, goes over to one of the waiting benches and drops the scrolls onto it. Once her hands are free, she comes back over to you and begins eyeing your form. 
    
    The little goblin makes a few minor adjustments to your stance by tapping her foot to the inside of your heel and reaching [pc.isHeight 54
        |up
        |over
    ] to lift your elbow a few degrees. She then studies you for a few more moments, before finally nodding and moving to where you're facing each other. Rixx then pauses, until a wide grin suddenly blossoms across her face.
    
    "I hope you're smart enough to realize that you should use your right hand when I use this one." She then raises her left hand and gives you a little wave with it.
    
    Well duh, you're standing opposite of her, so your perspective is reversed– you can handle that.
    
    "Just checking you haven't had a lobotomy since we last met." Rixx's grin then fades into seriousness, as she drops into her own battle stance. "Repeat the hand gestures I make. You'll be practicing the motions until they're so natural that you can do them in the middle of an earthquake, let alone a battle."
    
    And that's exactly what happens for the next few hours. After memorizing the specific gestures needed for the incantation, Rixx stops demonstrating them and starts joyfully fucking with you as you practice the motions. She throws pebbles, splashes water at you, and eventually ends up conjuring an illusory orgy. It's all very distracting, but you manage to keep your cool with only a few slip ups here and there.
    
    Once it becomes apparent that you've had the motions ingrained in your mind, Rixx switches tact and the two of you begin studying the scrolls she collected. They're full of esoteric explanations and highly technical details on how mages interact with the ether. Your teacher walks you through each of them, while also bolstering the writings with knowledge she's picked up in her own studies.
    
    The process is incredibly mentally draining, but it's manageable with Rixx's guidance and the occasional break. By the day's end, you're able to put all of that new information to work and can successfully cast the spell without blowing yourself up!
    
    Rixx is practically glowing as she watches you cast it the first time– her toothy smile as wide as you've ever seen it. She has you repeat the spell a few times, and when you can, she claps you on the back, saying: "Look at that! If I didn't know any better, I'd say you already knew how to cast that one. Come on, you've gotten as good as you'll get without battle experience. Let's go get some food in the market– I'm starving!"
    
    So, the both of you end up in her dining room, enjoying a [rand
        |stir-fry
        |stew
        |rice-bake
        |casserole
    ] that was bought at the market. The chance to eat a good meal and have pleasantly mundane conversation is nice after a full day spent training.
    
    But, your quiet dinner highlights just how exhausted you are. So, after you're done eating and the conversation slows, you take the opportunity to thank her for the training and say that you're going to go pass-out in your bed.
    
    The little goblin nods at this, still joyfully beaming: "You definitely deserve a rest [pc.name]! Most students need three or four days to get to your level of proficiency, but you managed to do it in one. I wonder who your teacher is, she must be amazing!"
    
    You can't help but smile and roll your eyes as you say your goodbyes. She returns them with a wave of her little fingers and gets up to head into her living room as you make for the front door.
    
    A quick walk through the city later, and you're back[party.hasCompanions
        | with [party.compNames]
        |
    ] at Rose's in the tavern. [party.som
        |With nobody waiting on you, you're free to head up to your room.
        |They can easily tell how tired you are, so they only bother you with a quick hello before letting you head off to your room.
        |Both of them can easily tell how tired you are, so they only bother you with a quick hello before letting you head off to your room.
    ]
    
    You only take the time to strip off your equipment before collapsing into bed– asleep the moment you hit the pillow.
rows.translation:
在清点完里克斯应支付的费用并将钱放在你面前的桌子上后，她拍手一笑，对你说：“既然你已经付钱了，那我就认真起来，真正教你一些东西吧！来吧，我们去我的训练场地呼吸新鲜空气，同时我也会教你这个法术的施展方法。等我们教完，就可以去召唤室，看看你到底能不能真正掌握这个法术。”
    
    说完，她从沙发上跳起来，朝着房子的后部走去。你也站了起来。 [party.hasCompanions
        |并告诉他们[party.compNames]你今晚晚些时候还会在罗斯的客栈再次见面。当你和他们道别完毕时，里克斯已经重新出现在门口，她手臂下夹着一捆卷轴，正在示意你跟她走。
        |她穿梭在书架之间，每当看到吸引她注意的卷轴，就会拿起来。等她走完一圈后，手臂下已经抱着一堆卷轴，然后她示意你也跟着她走。
    ]
    
    你跟着她走，穿过一扇外门，进入了一个有围墙的后院。只需看一眼这个地方，你就会立刻意识到这里就是里克斯练习魔法的地方。后院中央有一个类似角斗场风格的沙坑，而在墙边还有一排训练假人，那些假人的表面有几处被烧焦的痕迹。她还在沙坑后方几英尺的地方摆放了几张长凳，还有一个装满水的大桶，桶上用一根钉子固定着一把勺子。
    
    “走到竞技场的中央，然后摆出你的战斗姿势。”感受到脚下的沙子正在移动，你按照指示走到了指定的位置，然后摆出了战斗姿势。与此同时，里克斯走到其中一张等候长椅旁，将那些卷轴放在上面。等她的手空出来了，她就回到你身边，开始打量你的体型。
    
    那个小哥布林轻轻敲了敲你的脚后跟内侧，然后调整了一下你的站姿，接着继续动手调整。 [pc.isHeight 54
        |向上
        |超过
    ]她将肘部微微抬高了几度，接着又仔细观察了你片刻，最终点了点头，走到了你面前与你面对面站立。这时，里克斯停了下来，突然脸上绽放出了灿烂的笑容。
    
    “希望你足够聪明，能够明白：当我使用这只手部的时候，你应该用你的右手。”她说着，抬起了自己的左手，朝你轻轻挥了挥。
    
    嗯，这还用说吧，你现在站在她的对面，所以你的视角是反着的——这种情况你肯定能应付得来。
    
    “只是想确认一下，自从我们上次见面后，你应该没有接受过脑白质切除手术吧。”里克斯的笑容渐渐消失，变得严肃起来，同时她也摆出了战斗姿势。“模仿我做的这些手势。你需要反复练习，直到这些动作变得如此自然，以至于即使在地震中你也能毫不费力地做出这些动作，更不用说在战斗中了。
    
    在接下来的几个小时里，恰恰发生了这样的事情。在记住了施展法术所需的那些具体动作之后，里克斯不再示范这些动作了，而是开始在你练习的时候故意捣乱——她向你扔小石子，泼水，最后甚至制造出一些虚幻的场景来干扰你。这一切都让人分心，但你也设法保持冷静，只是偶尔会犯一些小错误而已。
    
    当你们意识到这些动作已经深深地印在脑海中时，里克斯改变了策略，你们俩开始研究她收集来的那些卷轴。这些卷轴中充满了深奥的解释以及关于法师们如何与以太能量互动的极其技术性的细节。你的老师会逐一指导你理解这些内容，同时还会结合她自己研究过程中获得的知识来补充这些解释。
    
    这个过程确实会让人感到精神上非常疲惫，但在里克斯的指导下，再加上偶尔的休息，还是可以应付得来的。到了当天结束时，你就能把所有这些新学到的知识应用到实际操作中，从而成功施展那个法术，而不会让自己受到任何伤害！
    
    当她第一次看到你施展这个法术时，里克斯简直兴奋得发亮了——她露出的笑容是你前所未见的那般灿烂。她让你重复这个法术几次，当你终于成功时，她拍着你的背说道：“看吧，你做到了！要不是我太了解你，我还会以为你已经学会如何使用那个技能了呢。说真的，没有战斗经验的话，你已经做得相当不错了。我们去市场买点吃的吧——我饿死了！
    
    于是，你们两个最终来到了她的餐厅，一起享受着美食。 [rand
        |炒制
        |炖煮
        |米饼
        |砂锅菜
    ]那是在市场上买的。在经过一整天的训练之后，能够享用一顿美餐，进行一些轻松愉快的交谈，确实是一件很惬意的事情。
    
    但是，你安静地吃晚餐的样子，恰恰说明你已经疲惫不堪了。所以，在吃完饭、谈话渐渐平静下来之后，你趁机感谢她对你的训练，然后说自己要去床上躺会儿了。
    
    小哥布林听到这些，依然开心地笑着点了点头：“你确实应该休息一下。 [pc.name]大多数学生都需要三到四天的时间才能达到你的水平，但你却只用了一天就做到了。我真想知道你的老师是谁，她一定非常出色吧！”
    
    你忍不住笑了笑，然后翻了个白眼，道了别。她也冲你挥了挥小手指，然后走进了她的客厅，而你则走向了前门。
    
    穿过城市，不久之后，你就回到了家。[party.hasCompanions
        | 与[party.compNames]一起 
        |
    ]在酒馆里的罗斯那里。 [party.som
        |没有人在等你，你可以随时去你的房间了。
        |他们能很容易地看出你有多疲惫，所以他们只会简单地向你问声好，然后让你去自己的房间休息。
        |他们两个人都能很容易地看出你有多累，所以他们只是简单地向你打了个招呼，然后就让你去房间休息了。
    ]
    
    你只花了一点时间脱掉装备，然后就倒在了床上，一碰到枕头就立刻进入了梦乡。
rows.raw:
"
    After counting out Rixx's payment and dropping it onto the table in front of you, she claps her hands together and beams a smile at you. "Now that you've paid me, I've got to get serious and actually teach you something! Come on, let's head to my training pit for some fresh air while I teach you the spell's form. We can move to the summoning room once we're done and see if you can actually control the spell."
    
    She then hops up from her couch and starts heading towards the house's back. You get up [party.hasCompanions
        |and tell [party.compNames] that you'll meet back up at Rose's inn later tonight. By the time you've finished exchanging goodbyes with them, Rixx has reappeared in the doorway with a bundle of scrolls under her arm and is motioning for you to follow.
        |and follow her, as she goes from bookshelf to bookshelf, picking up a few scrolls that catch her eye. By the time she's finished, there's a bundle of them under her arm, and she's motioning for you to follow.
    ]
    
    You do so, letting her lead you through an outside door and into a walled backyard. One look at the space is all you need to realize that this is where Rixx practices her magic. Besides the gladiator style sand-pit in the courtyard's middle, there's also a row of training dummies lined up against a wall that has a couple of scorch marks marring its surface. She also has a couple of benches sitting a few feet back from the sand-pit and a big barrel of water with a ladle hooked onto a jutting nail.
    
    "Step over to the arena's center and get into your casting position." Feeling the sand shift underneath your heels, you move over to the directed spot and drop into a fighting stance. Rixx, meanwhile, goes over to one of the waiting benches and drops the scrolls onto it. Once her hands are free, she comes back over to you and begins eyeing your form. 
    
    The little goblin makes a few minor adjustments to your stance by tapping her foot to the inside of your heel and reaching [pc.isHeight 54
        |up
        |over
    ] to lift your elbow a few degrees. She then studies you for a few more moments, before finally nodding and moving to where you're facing each other. Rixx then pauses, until a wide grin suddenly blossoms across her face.
    
    "I hope you're smart enough to realize that you should use your right hand when I use this one." She then raises her left hand and gives you a little wave with it.
    
    Well duh, you're standing opposite of her, so your perspective is reversed– you can handle that.
    
    "Just checking you haven't had a lobotomy since we last met." Rixx's grin then fades into seriousness, as she drops into her own battle stance. "Repeat the hand gestures I make. You'll be practicing the motions until they're so natural that you can do them in the middle of an earthquake, let alone a battle."
    
    And that's exactly what happens for the next few hours. After memorizing the specific gestures needed for the incantation, Rixx stops demonstrating them and starts joyfully fucking with you as you practice the motions. She throws pebbles, splashes water at you, and eventually ends up conjuring an illusory orgy. It's all very distracting, but you manage to keep your cool with only a few slip ups here and there.
    
    Once it becomes apparent that you've had the motions ingrained in your mind, Rixx switches tact and the two of you begin studying the scrolls she collected. They're full of esoteric explanations and highly technical details on how mages interact with the ether. Your teacher walks you through each of them, while also bolstering the writings with knowledge she's picked up in her own studies.
    
    The process is incredibly mentally draining, but it's manageable with Rixx's guidance and the occasional break. By the day's end, you're able to put all of that new information to work and can successfully cast the spell without blowing yourself up!
    
    Rixx is practically glowing as she watches you cast it the first time– her toothy smile as wide as you've ever seen it. She has you repeat the spell a few times, and when you can, she claps you on the back, saying: "Look at that! If I didn't know any better, I'd say you already knew how to cast that one. Come on, you've gotten as good as you'll get without battle experience. Let's go get some food in the market– I'm starving!"
    
    So, the both of you end up in her dining room, enjoying a [rand
        |stir-fry
        |stew
        |rice-bake
        |casserole
    ] that was bought at the market. The chance to eat a good meal and have pleasantly mundane conversation is nice after a full day spent training.
    
    But, your quiet dinner highlights just how exhausted you are. So, after you're done eating and the conversation slows, you take the opportunity to thank her for the training and say that you're going to go pass-out in your bed.
    
    The little goblin nods at this, still joyfully beaming: "You definitely deserve a rest [pc.name]! Most students need three or four days to get to your level of proficiency, but you managed to do it in one. I wonder who your teacher is, she must be amazing!"
    
    You can't help but smile and roll your eyes as you say your goodbyes. She returns them with a wave of her little fingers and gets up to head into her living room as you make for the front door.
    
    A quick walk through the city later, and you're back[party.hasCompanions
        | with [party.compNames]
        |
    ] at Rose's in the tavern. [party.som
        |With nobody waiting on you, you're free to head up to your room.
        |They can easily tell how tired you are, so they only bother you with a quick hello before letting you head off to your room.
        |Both of them can easily tell how tired you are, so they only bother you with a quick hello before letting you head off to your room.
    ]
    
    You only take the time to strip off your equipment before collapsing into bed– asleep the moment you hit the pillow.
    "

rows.original:
Wondering what happened to Rixx after Kasyrra fully corrupted the city, you climb her stoop and knock on the house's heavy oaken door. After the reverberations of your rasping knuckles die away, there's nothing but silence and the hum of the city behind you.
    
    You wait a long time, knock again, nothing. With a growing sense of apprehension you think about opening the door and calling out– just to make doubly sure she's not home.
    
    Fuck it, she usually has the door locked, so you might as well try to open it.
    
    When you reach out and try the handle, you're surprised when it turns easily and opens the way into Rixx's house. As soon as the door is open, however, you see why it wasn't locked. Her living room is in complete disarray, with couch pillows on the floor, the coffee table flipped on its side, and... ah... there are some scorch marks on the walls.
    
    [party.som
        |You ready your weapon and start creeping through the house– intent on seeing if the attackers, or Rixx for that matter, are still here.
        |With a glance over at [party.compNames], you both ready your weapons and start a sweep through the house– intent on finding out if the attackers, or Rixx for that matter, are still here.
        |With a glance over at [party.compNames], you each ready your weapons and start a sweep through the house– intent on finding out if the attackers, or Rixx for that matter, are still here.
    ] One by one, you check through each of the house's rooms with your weapon raised. Each of them are in just as much disarray as the first, and are just as devoid of living people.
    
    Eventually, you make it to the last room you haven't cleared and open it up to see Rixx's bedroom.
    
    Like the other rooms, there's nobody inside and it's a complete mess, but something catches your eye amongst the wreckage of vandalized clutter. In between a scroll rack and her bed is an impromptu alchemy setup, a bunch of unfurled scrolls, and a glass vial with a little bit of viscous, white liquid at the bottom.
    
    You walk into the room and reach down to pick up the vial, so that you can get a better look at it, but its smell hits you like a speeding carriage as soon as you've brought it up. There's no mistaking the overpoweringly musky scent that now envelops you– this was a vial of imp cum.
    
    After setting the glass back down, you peer over at the laid out scrolls and scan their contents. Most are treatises on alchemy, but a few are specifically about brewing transformations that modify one's skin.
    
    If it was Rixx that did this, why would she use imp cum to brew a demonic transformation like that? Given that she was actively fighting against the demonic siege, you would have guessed that she wasn't the type to enjoy corruption. Plus if she had been captured in battle and was forcibly transformed then a potion like this would hardly be necessary.
    
    [pc.isCunning
        |As you sit there and contemplate the problem, an idea of what could've happened begins forming in your mind. What if she just transformed her skin to give off the appearance of being corrupted without fully losing herself? The disguise probably wouldn't have held up under extended scrutiny, but it might've been enough for her to sneak out of the city. Though, you have no idea if Rixx is clever enough to think of something like that.
        |For a while, you sit there and think about the possibilities, but none of them make much sense to you. Eventually, you give up on trying to develop a concrete explanation for these clues and decide to focus on what you know.
    ]
    
    [pc.isCunning
        |After all you've seen, the only thing that seems certain is that Rixx is gone for good.
        |With how long it's been and the state her house is in, Rixx probably isn't coming back.
    ] Maybe you'll meet her again at some point and get the story of what happened from her, but, for now, she has completely disappeared.
    
    With a shake of your head, you turn away from the alchemy set and start heading back towards the front door, when you're suddenly stopped by a thought. Since she's gone, Rixx isn't going to be able to teach you any more summoning spells. 
    
    If you were the type to do so, now would be the perfect chance to paw through her bookcases and see if there are any tomes that could teach you the stuff she can't now.
rows.translation:
在卡希拉彻底毁掉了这座城市之后，你不禁想知道里克斯的命运如何，于是你走上她的台阶，敲响了那扇厚重的橡木门。当你的指关节敲击门扉发出的声响渐渐消失后，四周只剩下一片寂静，以及身后城市传来的喧嚣声。
    
    你等了很久，又敲了敲门，仍然没有任何反应。随着不安感的加剧，你开始考虑直接打开门去喊她——只是为了再次确认她确实不在家。
    
    算了，她平时都会把门锁上，那还不如直接试着把门打开看看。
    
    当你伸手去拉那个把手时，会惊讶地发现它转动得非常顺畅，门就这样被打开了，你走进了里克斯的家里。然而，门一打开，你就明白了为什么它没有上锁——她的客厅一片混乱：沙发上的靠垫散落在地上，咖啡桌也被翻倒了…………啊……墙面上有些烧焦的痕迹。
    
    [party.som
        |你准备好武器，开始悄悄地在房子里搜寻——目的是确认那些攻击者，或者说里克斯，是否还在这里。
        |瞥了一眼[party.compNames]你们俩都准备好武器，然后开始搜查整个房子——目的是查明那些攻击者，或者说里克斯，是否还在这里。
        |瞥了一眼[party.compNames]你们每个人都拿好了武器，开始搜查整个房子——目的是查明那些攻击者，或者说里克斯，是否还在这里。
    ]你一步步地检查着房子里的每一个房间，手中始终紧握着武器。每个房间的状况都和第一个房间一样混乱，里面同样没有任何人。
    
    最终，你来到了最后一个尚未检查的房间，推开门后，你看到了里克斯的卧室。
    
    和其他房间一样，里面空无一人，一片狼藉，但在那些被破坏后的杂物堆中，有某样东西吸引了你的注意。在书架和她的床之间，有人临时搭建了一个炼金装置：一堆摊开的卷轴，以及一个玻璃瓶，瓶底盛着少量粘稠的白色液体。
    
    你走进房间，伸手去拿那个小瓶子，想仔细看看它，但就在你把它拿起来的瞬间，那浓烈的麝香味就像一列飞驰的马车一样扑面而来。这种浓重的麝香气息再明显不过了——这显然是一个装着男性精液的瓶子。
    
    将玻璃杯放回原位后，你仔细观察那些排列整齐的卷轴，浏览它们的内容。其中大部分都是关于炼金术的论著，但也有几卷专门讨论如何通过某种配方来改变人的外貌。
    
    如果这是里克斯做的，那她为什么要用兽人的精液来制作那种会改变外貌的魔药呢？鉴于她一直在积极抵抗恶魔的围攻，你应该会猜到，她绝不是那种会沉溺于堕落之中的人。更何况，如果她在战斗中被俘虏并被迫发生了变化，那么这样的药剂根本就不是必需的。
    
    [pc.isCunning
        |当你坐在那里思考这个问题时，一个关于可能发生什么的想法开始在你的脑海中形成：如果她只是改变自己的皮肤外观，让自己看起来像是被腐蚀了，但却没有完全失去自我，会怎么样呢？这种伪装可能无法在仔细的检查下维持太久，但或许足以让她悄悄地离开这座城市。不过，你并不知道里克斯是否足够聪明，能够想到这样的办法。
        |你坐在那里，思考着各种可能性，但其中没有一个看起来合理。最终，你放弃了试图为这些线索找到一个明确的解释，决定专注于你所知道的事情。
    ]
    
    [pc.isCunning
        |经历了这一切之后，唯一可以确定的是，里克斯已经永远离开了。
        |考虑到已经过去这么长时间，以及她房子现在的状况，里克斯很可能不会再回来了。
    ]也许在未来的某个时刻，你会再次遇见她，从而从她口中了解到当时发生的事情，但眼下，她已经彻底消失了。
    
    你摇摇头，转身离开了那个炼金装置，开始朝前门走去，就在这时，一个念头突然出现在你的脑海中，让你停下了脚步。自从她离开后，里克斯就再也无法教你那些召唤术了。
    
    如果你有兴趣学习的话，现在正是绝佳的机会——你可以翻翻她的书架，看看是否还有哪些书籍能够教你那些她现在无法传授给你的知识。

rows.original: You would rather take the knowledge for yourself– especially since she isn't coming back.
rows.translation: 你宁愿把这些知识据为己有——更何况她再也不会回来了。
rows.raw: "You would rather take the knowledge for yourself– especially since she isn't coming back."

rows.original: Learning more of Rixx's summoning magic isn't something you're interested in. It would be better to leave it and get out of this house.
rows.translation: 你对了解里克斯的召唤魔法并没有兴趣。最好放弃这个念头，赶紧离开这座房子吧。
rows.raw: "Learning more of Rixx's summoning magic isn't something you're interested in. It would be better to leave it and get out of this house."

rows.original:
At this point, you might as well grab them up before an imp wanders in and finds them first. They would be better used by you, afterall.

    Turning back into her bedroom, you quickly leaf through some of Rixx's scrolls and books, looking for anything that might be useful. After a few minutes spent skimming texts, you find a few spell books that look useful and decide to toss them in your bag.
    
    You can give them a detailed read though once you're in a safer place. For now though, you should probably get out of here before anyone else shows up. Having to explain this whole situation and what you're doing would be a massive inconvenience.
    
    So, with a hustle in your step, [party.yall] leave the bedroom and walk to the front door. After peeking outside to make sure the coast is clear, you simply walk out the front door with your new spellbooks shifting inside your bag.
    
    As you walk down the sidewalk and back into the city proper, you can't help but wonder where Rixx is right now.
    
    Ah well, for now you've got to put that aside and get back to adventuring.
rows.translation:
在这个时候，你最好赶紧把它们拿走，免得某个小恶魔突然出现把它们抢走。毕竟，这些东西对你来说会更有用。

    回到自己的卧室后，你迅速翻阅了里克斯留下的一些卷轴和书籍，试图找到其中可能有用的东西。浏览了几分钟文本后，你找到了几本看起来有用的法术书，于是决定把它们装进包里。
    
    不过，等到了一个更安全的地方，你再仔细阅读这些书也不迟。现在，最好尽快离开这里，以免其他人出现。如果要解释整个情况以及你正在做的事情，那将会带来极大的不便。
    
    于是，[party.yall]加快脚步离开卧室，走向前门。在向外窥探确保周围没有危险之后，你就可以带着装在包里的新法术书走出前门了。
    
    当你沿着人行道走回城市中心时，不禁会想知道里克斯现在在哪里。
    
    不过，眼下你得把这个问题放在一边，继续开始你的冒险之旅了。

    As you walk down the sidewalk and back into the city proper, you can't help but wonder where Rixx is right now.
    
    Ah well, for now you've got to put that aside and get back to adventuring.
    "

rows.original:
Rixx is a 4 foot tall goblin with an athletic build, a feminine face, and grayish-green skin. Her hair, meanwhile, is a raven black, shaggy mess that's just long enough to graze her shoulders.
    
    What really draws your attention, though, are her eyes. They're a stormy gray color, with dashes of pale blue mixed in, giving her a mesmerizing gaze. Looking into them gives you an impression of energy and sass, but there's also an iron will buried behind that. Those are the eyes of a woman who commands, and her creatures follow.
    
    She's currently wearing a loose fitting robe with a deep v-neck that drapes over A-cupped breasts. The robe also hides her lithe physique, but not the massive ass she carries around, or the equally large bulge that shows through the fabric. If you were to compare her to a fruit, she [silly
        |wouldn't be a pear, she'd be a fucking lightbulb
        |would certainly be a pear
    ].
    
    The only other thing of note is the teardrop shaped amethyst that dangles between her petite breasts off a linked silver chain. If you had to guess, that'd be the catalyst she uses to cast spells. It's a practical choice that leaves her hands free for a weapon– good for a battle mage.

里克斯是一名身高四英尺的哥布林，体格健美，面容女性化，皮肤呈灰绿色。她的头发则是一团乌黑蓬乱、刚好长及肩头的乱发。
    
    不过，真正吸引你注意的是她的眼睛。那双眼呈暴风雨般的灰色，其中夹杂着几抹淡蓝，令她的目光摄人心魄。与她对视时，你能感受到活力与泼辣，但其后也埋藏着钢铁般的意志。那是一双属于发号施令者的眼睛，而她的生物会服从命令。
    
    她现在穿着一件宽松的深V领长袍，衣料垂覆在A罩杯乳房之上。长袍也遮住了她轻盈的体态，却掩不住她随身带着的巨硕屁股，以及透过布料凸显出来、同样硕大的鼓包。如果将她比作一种水果，她[silly
        |才不是梨子，根本是个该死的电灯泡
        |肯定会是一颗梨子
    ]。
    
    唯一另一件值得注意的东西，是一颗以银质链环悬在她娇小双乳之间的泪滴形紫水晶。要你猜的话，那应该是她用于施法的触媒。这种选择很实用，能空出双手使用武器——非常适合战斗法师。

rows.original:
Taking some time to chat with her seems like it could be fun.
    
    This comment causes Rixx's face to bloom into a smile, as she regards you with an interested eye. "Yeah, I think it could be. But if we're swapping life stories then I expect some interesting tidbits from your life in return."
    
    You smile and assure her that you'll try to not disappoint. Afterall, you've lived an interesting life ever since that fateful night with the portal.
    
    She simply snorts and says back; "Well, whatever you've got, it's probably better than listening to the boys in the barracks talk about their favorite whore from the Passion Pasture. Either way though, go ahead and ask me something open-ended. I'm just dying to talk your ear off!"
    
    With the smug grin on her face it's hard to tell if she's being serious, but an open-ended question isn't a bad idea– if you want to get your ear talked off, that is.
rows.translation:
花些时间和她聊聊似乎会很有趣。
    
    这句话令里克斯笑逐颜开，她饶有兴趣地打量着你。“嗯，我觉得会很有意思。不过，要是我们准备交换人生故事，我也希望你能拿自己生活里的有趣片段作为回报。”
    
    你微笑着保证会尽量不让她失望。毕竟，自从那个与传送门有关的命运之夜以来，你一直过着精彩的人生。
    
    她只是哼了一声，回答道：“好吧，不管你有什么故事，大概都比听兵营里的男孩们谈论自己最喜欢的激情牧场妓女有趣。总之，随便问我一个开放式问题吧。我简直迫不及待地想在你耳边说个没完！”
    
    她脸上挂着得意的笑容，很难看出究竟是不是认真的；不过，如果你真想听她说个没完，开放式问题倒是个好主意。
