rows.original: You're interested in learning more about her. Would she mind telling you some stories about her past? Rixx's grin fades into a neutral expression as she answers: "Sure, sure, I've got a few interesting tales from back when I was a little guttersnipe." Woah woah, wait a minute, she used to live on the streets? "Yep! When I was little, my family had me running around the market, picking pockets until we had enough cash for the entire family's dinner. My brothers and sister were doing it too, obviously, but I was the oldest, so I had the lion's share of responsibility." Damn, [pc.bg slumrat |you know what it's like to live on the streets, so you're glad she was able to escape them– just like you did. |it sounds like a hard life; you're glad she was able to escape it. ] But how did she end up making the jump from urchin to fully fledged sorceress? The question obviously pleases Rixx, for her grin returns and she gets an excited gleam in her eye as she answers. "Back in the day, I was more ambitious than my siblings when it came to who I was willing to steal from. Most of the time it just got me in trouble, but the exact opposite happened when I tried to steal from a salamander visiting from Tychris." As she continues to recount the story, Rixx begins gesturing with her hands absently, as if her body's on auto-pilot while she's stuck in the past. "When I heard about her, I talked to all the contacts fourteen year old me could muster and eventually found out that she had a pile of spellbooks hidden under the floorboards of her rented room from a maid who worked at the inn." "My mom didn't want me to try and steal them because she thought it was too dangerous, but I wanted to see what was in those fancy books– get a look at some real magic, you know?" Oh you can imagine. The chance to read through a real spell book must've been incredibly tempting for someone in her situation. Rixx simply nods, grinning like a hyena as she says; "Oh you have no idea. I had this grand idea that I was going to become a powerful mage who could do whatever she wanted, whenever she wanted. I even managed to steal the things and hide out with them for a day." "When the guards found me, I was so absorbed with the reading that I didn't even know they were there until I had been pulled to the ground and clasped with chains. Thankfully though, the salamander was brought along so that she could identify her books, which let her notice that I had been reading them instead of preparing them for a fence. When she did, she demanded that they unlock my chains, so that I could be tested on what I had been reading." Did the guards actually do it? "Yep! And you should've seen their faces while they were releasing me. Seven big, strong, muscley minotaurs looking like they're about to jump out of their skin because of wiry, one and a half foot tall, me." Rixx then quietly chuckles at the memory, causing you to smile as well, as you imagine the scene. One thing's bothering you about that story, however. Does she know why they listened to a random mage who was visiting the city? Rixx's grin gets even bigger as she answers, saying: "Well, little did I know at the time, but her black scales meant she was part of the Order Astrida, and all of those poor guardsmen were terrified of refusing the command of a divine champion." Ah, now that puts it all into perspective. No wonder she wanted to see if a street urchin had managed to learn a spell within a day, given that she was part of an order that protected against the misuse of magic. "Exactly," Rixx says, as she nods her head. "And the funny part is that I completely failed to cast the spell! I was able to replicate the incantations and hand gestures from the book, but I had no fucking clue on how to manipulate aether with my will, or what aetheric energy even was!" "Still, memorizing the complexities of a spell without any training impressed her, so she gave me a choice. I could go with her to Tychris as her ward and learn the secrets of magic at the academy, or I could spend some time in jail for thievery before going back to being a urchin..." She then pauses for a moment, her smile still there as she stares into the middle distance. In a voice that's much quieter, she whispers: "...It was an easy choice, even if I did have to leave everything I recognized behind." Rixx then turns quiet– lost in thought as she remembers her past. You decide not to interrupt her with a question and instead stay silent, so she can come back to you on her own. Eventually, she lets out a happy sigh and looks at you wistfully before speaking again. "I couldn't ever be a part of the Order itself, given that you have to be born as a divine champion, but I was taken in as a ward. They directed my teachings at the academy, and when I started specializing as a battle mage they let me accompany the black-scales on missions." So even though she isn't officially part of the Order Astrida, they still let her help out? "Yep! Given how small the number of genuine black-scales there are, they have to maintain a support network of mages and priests who assist them whenever they're stretched too thin. Most of the time we're called wards, but there are a few other names for us." Really? Does she mind sharing any of them? Rixx grins at this and a little blush works its way across her cheeks as she answers. "Well sometimes, if both the paladin and ward like to talk dirty then we can get called 'mana sluts' during a feeding. But uh... don't go telling that to everyone you meet, alright?" With a chuckle, you nod and agree not to tell anyone that. You get the feeling Rixx just accidentally revealed something a bit personal but don't have long to ponder it because she quickly moves the conversation along. "Though, I think that's enough about me and the Order, what about you, huh? What's your past like?" [pc.bgMulti nobleScion hunter soldier barbarian courtesan scholar slumRat acolyte arcanist minstrel |Well, your past is filled with etiquette training, absent minded luxury, and plots that were dreamt up by your older siblings to grab power. You gave it all up for a life of adventure and hardship. |Well, your past is filled with nights spent tracking prey, the quiet crackling of campfires, and long spans of complete solitude. Adventuring isn't too different really, except for the fact that you're not really alone any more. |Well, you suspect your early life isn't too different from her current situation. Yours was the life of a soldier, spent marching, following orders, and in camaraderie with your fellows. But you eventually gave up the discipline of military life for one of adventure, where each day brings something new. |Well, your old life was one spent with your tribe and their old warrior ways. You were eventually driven to the life of an adventurer after your clan was attacked and scattered by a rival tribe. |Well, your past was spent seducing the upper crust of society, living off the money of those who wanted to sleep in your bed for the night. It was a good life, but you were eventually forced into a life of adventuring because of a jealous, and very well connected, spouse. |Well, your past is filled with dusty tomes, ink stains, and suffocating regulations. In fact, it was the regulations of formal academia that led you to a life of adventuring, where you've learned more every single day than any week spent in your musty dorm. |Well, your past is a lot like hers actually. You were a slum rat that survived by any means possible– whether you needed to steal, cheat, or beg to do it. But instead of ending up as a ward to the order Astrida, your tale has you taking up adventuring. |Well, your memories of the past are taken up by religious ceremonies, meditation, and scholarly pursuits. Eventually, the monastery's quiet placidity began to grate, so you set off to the frontier in order to help those who faced hardship on a day-to-day basis. |Well, from your earliest memories you were learning magic from your master. The relationship... didn't really end well, so here you are adventuring instead. |Well, back in your homeland you were quite a well known bard! But things were getting stale and you wanted something new and exciting in your life, so you packed up and headed here to the frontier. ] Rixx peers at you intently, with an interested look painting her face as she says; "really? Well shit, this story sounds like it's gonna be just as lengthy as mine. Let me go and grab a glass of wine before you start– my throat's parched after babbling like a hen for so long..."
rows.translation: 你很想更多地了解她。她会不会愿意告诉你一些关于她过去的故事呢？ 里克斯的笑容渐渐消失，换上了中性的表情，然后回答道：“当然可以，我确实有一些发生在我还是个小孩子的时候的有趣故事。哇哦，等等，她以前还住在街上吗？ “没错！我小时候，家里常常让我在市场上跑来跑去，偷别人的口袋，直到我们赚到足够的钱来买全家人吃的饭。我的兄弟姐妹们也在做同样的事，但我是家里最大的，所以承担的责任也就最多。该死， [pc.bg slumrat |你明白在街头生活的滋味，所以你很高兴她能够摆脱那种生活——就像你曾经做到的那样。 |听起来那是一段非常艰难的生活；你很庆幸她能够摆脱那种处境。 ]但她究竟是如何从一个小海胆变成一名成熟的女巫的呢？ 这个问题显然让里克斯感到很高兴，她重新露出了笑容，眼中也闪烁着兴奋的光芒，开始回答道：“那时候，我在选择‘偷窃对象’时，比我的兄弟姐妹们要大胆得多。大多数时候，这种行为只会给我带来麻烦，但当我去偷窃一只从提克里斯来的蝾螈时，情况却完全相反了。 当她继续讲述这个故事时，里克斯开始心不在焉地用手比划着，仿佛她的身体在自动运转，而她的思绪还停留在过去。“当我听说她的消息后，我联系了当时14岁的我能想到的所有熟人，最终发现，她把一堆魔法书藏在了她租住的房间地板下面——这些书是来自客栈里的一位女仆的。 我妈妈不让我去偷那些书，因为她觉得那样太危险了，但我真的很想看看那些精美的书里到底写了什么——想亲眼见识一下真正的魔法，你懂的吧？” 哦，你可以想象的。对于她来说，有机会阅读真正的魔法书，肯定是一件非常吸引人的事情。里克斯只是点了点头，露出鬣狗般的笑容说道：“哦，你根本想象不到。我当时有个宏伟的计划，那就是要成为一名强大的法师，能够随心所欲地做任何我想做的事情。我甚至成功偷到了那些东西，然后躲藏了一整天。" 当守卫们找到我时，我正全神贯注地读书，以至于他们出现在我身边时，我根本没注意到。直到他们把我拽到地上并用链条锁住我，我才反应过来。不过幸运的是，那条蝾螈也被带了过来，它能够辨认出那些书。因此，它立刻发现是我在读书，而不是在准备把那些书用来建造围栏。当它意识到这一点后要求他们解开了我的锁链，这样我就可以测试自己所学到的知识了。” 那些守卫真的这么做了吗？“当然！你真应该看看他们释放我的时候脸上的表情——七个高大强壮、肌肉发达的弥诺陶洛斯，看到那个身高只有一英尺半、身材瘦小的我，简直吓得差点跳出来。”里克斯回忆起这段经历，轻声笑了起来，你也忍不住会跟着会心一笑，仿佛亲眼看到了那一幕。 然而，关于那个故事，有件事让你感到疑惑：她知道为什么他们会听从一个偶然来到这座城市的法师的命令吗？里克斯笑着回答道：“嗯，当时我并不知道，但她的黑色鳞片说明她属于阿斯特里达教团，而那些可怜的卫兵们根本不敢违抗一位神圣冠军的命令。 啊，现在一切都清楚了。难怪她想看看一个街头流浪儿是否能在一天内学会一个法术——毕竟她所属的团体正是致力于防止魔法被滥用的人。 “没错，”里克斯点头说道，“有趣的是，我完全没能成功施展那个法术！我虽然能复现书中的咒语和手势，但却完全不知道该如何用意志力来操控以太，甚至也不明白以太能量到底是什么东西！ 不过，她没有接受任何训练，却能够记住如此复杂的法术，这一点确实令她印象深刻。因此，她给了我一个选择：要么跟随她去提克里斯，作为她的随从在学院里学习魔法的秘密；要么因为偷窃而坐一段时间牢，之后再重新过回那种苦日子……”她停顿了一下，脸上依然带着微笑，目光望向远方。然后，她用低得几乎听不见的声音说道：“……这个选择其实很简单，尽管我不得不放弃所有我熟悉的东西。 里克斯随后陷入沉思，似乎在回忆自己的过去。你决定不通过提问来打扰她，而是选择保持沉默，让她能够自己重新回到你的身边。 最终，她开心地叹了口气，带着一丝怅惘地看着你，然后才再次开口说话。由于成为神之勇士必须与生俱来，所以我永远无法成为那个组织的一员，但他们收留了我，将我视为他们的弟子。他们在学院里指导我学习，当我开始专攻战斗法师这个职业时，他们允许我跟随黑鳞军团执行任务。" 所以，尽管她并没有正式成为“阿斯特里达组织”的一员，他们还是允许她帮忙吗？ “没错！由于真正的‘黑鳞战士’数量实在太少了，所以他们必须建立一个由法师和牧师组成的支援网络，以便在他们力量不足时提供帮助。大多数时候，我们被称作‘守护者’，不过也有一些其他的称呼。 真的吗？她介意分享其中的一些故事吗？” 里克斯听到这个问题后笑了起来，她的脸颊上浮现出一抹红晕，然后回答道：“嗯，有时候，如果那位圣骑士和我们的守护者都喜欢说些粗话的话，那么在进食的时候我们就会被叫做‘法力荡妇’。不过……千万别把这件事告诉你遇到的每一个人，好吗？ 你轻笑一声，点了点头，表示不会告诉任何人这件事。你感觉里克斯不小心透露了一些关于她个人的事情，但你没有时间去仔细思考，因为她很快就把话题转开了。 |嗯，你的过去充满了礼仪训练、无忧无虑的奢华生活，以及那些由你的哥哥姐姐们为了争夺权力而编造出来的阴谋诡计。而你却放弃了这一切，选择了充满冒险与艰辛的生活。 |嗯，你的过去充满了追逐猎物的夜晚、篝火旁宁静的噼啪声，以及漫长的孤独时光。冒险其实也没什么不同，只不过现在你不再孤单了。 rows.raw: " You're interested in learning more about her. Would she mind telling you some stories about her past? Rixx's grin fades into a neutral expression as she answers: "Sure, sure, I've got a few interesting tales from back when I was a little guttersnipe." Woah woah, wait a minute, she used to live on the streets? "Yep! When I was little, my family had me running around the market, picking pockets until we had enough cash for the entire family's dinner. My brothers and sister were doing it too, obviously, but I was the oldest, so I had the lion's share of responsibility." Damn, [pc.bg slumrat |you know what it's like to live on the streets, so you're glad she was able to escape them– just like you did. |it sounds like a hard life; you're glad she was able to escape it. ] But how did she end up making the jump from urchin to fully fledged sorceress? The question obviously pleases Rixx, for her grin returns and she gets an excited gleam in her eye as she answers. "Back in the day, I was more ambitious than my siblings when it came to who I was willing to steal from. Most of the time it just got me in trouble, but the exact opposite happened when I tried to steal from a salamander visiting from Tychris." As she continues to recount the story, Rixx begins gesturing with her hands absently, as if her body's on auto-pilot while she's stuck in the past. "When I heard about her, I talked to all the contacts fourteen year old me could muster and eventually found out that she had a pile of spellbooks hidden under the floorboards of her rented room from a maid who worked at the inn." "My mom didn't want me to try and steal them because she thought it was too dangerous, but I wanted to see what was in those fancy books– get a look at some real magic, you know?" Oh you can imagine. The chance to read through a real spell book must've been incredibly tempting for someone in her situation. Rixx simply nods, grinning like a hyena as she says; "Oh you have no idea. I had this grand idea that I was going to become a powerful mage who could do whatever she wanted, whenever she wanted. I even managed to steal the things and hide out with them for a day." "When the guards found me, I was so absorbed with the reading that I didn't even know they were there until I had been pulled to the ground and clasped with chains. Thankfully though, the salamander was brought along so that she could identify her books, which let her notice that I had been reading them instead of preparing them for a fence. When she did, she demanded that they unlock my chains, so that I could be tested on what I had been reading." Did the guards actually do it? "Yep! And you should've seen their faces while they were releasing me. Seven big, strong, muscley minotaurs looking like they're about to jump out of their skin because of wiry, one and a half foot tall, me." Rixx then quietly chuckles at the memory, causing you to smile as well, as you imagine the scene. One thing's bothering you about that story, however. Does she know why they listened to a random mage who was visiting the city? Rixx's grin gets even bigger as she answers, saying: "Well, little did I know at the time, but her black scales meant she was part of the Order Astrida, and all of those poor guardsmen were terrified of refusing the command of a divine champion." Ah, now that puts it all into perspective. No wonder she wanted to see if a street urchin had managed to learn a spell within a day, given that she was part of an order that protected against the misuse of magic. "Exactly," Rixx says, as she nods her head. "And the funny part is that I completely failed to cast the spell! I was able to replicate the incantations and hand gestures from the book, but I had no fucking clue on how to manipulate aether with my will, or what aetheric energy even was!" "Still, memorizing the complexities of a spell without any training impressed her, so she gave me a choice. I could go with her to Tychris as her ward and learn the secrets of magic at the academy, or I could spend some time in jail for thievery before going back to being a urchin..." She then pauses for a moment, her smile still there as she stares into the middle distance. In a voice that's much quieter, she whispers: "...It was an easy choice, even if I did have to leave everything I recognized behind." Rixx then turns quiet– lost in thought as she remembers her past. You decide not to interrupt her with a question and instead stay silent, so she can come back to you on her own. Eventually, she lets out a happy sigh and looks at you wistfully before speaking again. "I couldn't ever be a part of the Order itself, given that you have to be born as a divine champion, but I was taken in as a ward. They directed my teachings at the academy, and when I started specializing as a battle mage they let me accompany the black-scales on missions." So even though she isn't officially part of the Order Astrida, they still let her help out? "Yep! Given how small the number of genuine black-scales there are, they have to maintain a support network of mages and priests who assist them whenever they're stretched too thin. Most of the time we're called wards, but there are a few other names for us." Really? Does she mind sharing any of them? Rixx grins at this and a little blush works its way across her cheeks as she answers. "Well sometimes, if both the paladin and ward like to talk dirty then we can get called 'mana sluts' during a feeding. But uh... don't go telling that to everyone you meet, alright?" With a chuckle, you nod and agree not to tell anyone that. You get the feeling Rixx just accidentally revealed something a bit personal but don't have long to ponder it because she quickly moves the conversation along. "Though, I think that's enough about me and the Order, what about you, huh? What's your past like?" [pc.bgMulti nobleScion hunter soldier barbarian courtesan scholar slumRat acolyte arcanist minstrel |Well, your past is filled with etiquette training, absent minded luxury, and plots that were dreamt up by your older siblings to grab power. You gave it all up for a life of adventure and hardship. |Well, your past is filled with nights spent tracking prey, the quiet crackling of campfires, and long spans of complete solitude. Adventuring isn't too different really, except for the fact that you're not really alone any more. |Well, you suspect your early life isn't too different from her current situation. Yours was the life of a soldier, spent marching, following orders, and in camaraderie with your fellows. But you eventually gave up the discipline of military life for one of adventure, where each day brings something new. |Well, your old life was one spent with your tribe and their old warrior ways. You were eventually driven to the life of an adventurer after your clan was attacked and scattered by a rival tribe. |Well, your past was spent seducing the upper crust of society, living off the money of those who wanted to sleep in your bed for the night. It was a good life, but you were eventually forced into a life of adventuring because of a jealous, and very well connected, spouse. |Well, your past is filled with dusty tomes, ink stains, and suffocating regulations. In fact, it was the regulations of formal academia that led you to a life of adventuring, where you've learned more every single day than any week spent in your musty dorm. |Well, your past is a lot like hers actually. You were a slum rat that survived by any means possible– whether you needed to steal, cheat, or beg to do it. But instead of ending up as a ward to the order Astrida, your tale has you taking up adventuring. |Well, your memories of the past are taken up by religious ceremonies, meditation, and scholarly pursuits. Eventually, the monastery's quiet placidity began to grate, so you set off to the frontier in order to help those who faced hardship on a day-to-day basis. |Well, from your earliest memories you were learning magic from your master. The relationship... didn't really end well, so here you are adventuring instead. |Well, back in your homeland you were quite a well known bard! But things were getting stale and you wanted something new and exciting in your life, so you packed up and headed here to the frontier. ] Rixx peers at you intently, with an interested look painting her face as she says; "really? Well shit, this story sounds like it's gonna be just as lengthy as mine. Let me go and grab a glass of wine before you start– my throat's parched after babbling like a hen for so long..." "

rows.original:
Her mastery of conjuration is pretty impressive, especially since she's good enough to come up with her own spells. Would she be interested in telling you more about her magic and where she learned it?
    
    As you ask, Rixx's head tilts to the side, ever so slightly, as she considers you with a grin. "Sure, but you have to give me a re-cap of your recent adventures– deal?"
    
    That shouldn't be too difficult– your escapades have been pretty interesting, afterall.
    
    "Perfect," she says, nodding in acceptance. "I studied my magical skills in Tychris at the academy there and under the Order Astrida's supervision. They were pretty strict, and I got in trouble often, but not the kind of trouble that actually upset anyone."
    
    Does she want to share what kind of mischief she got into?
    
    Your question turns Rixx's light grin into a full blown smile, as her gaze turns distant. "One of the first spells I got taught was a minor prestidigitation that flavored food. My teachers figured that a former street urchin would appreciate that kind of spell. They were completely right, of course, but I quickly realized that the spell could make food taste worse too."
    
    Ah, you can see where this one's going. How long did it take for her to get caught?
    
    She snickers in reply, before saying; "I snuck into the room of the black-scale who found me and made her late night meal taste like dirt three times before she got fed up and used a scrying spell to monitor her dinner as it was cooked. Though, the best part of that escapade was afterwards, when I received my first lecture on using magic responsibly. She flitted between trying not to laugh, and trying to genuinely teach me a lesson."
    
    That's a remarkably even tempered response for someone who had gotten a mouthful of dirt for three nights in a row. Was she always like that?
    
    "Yeah, I think she treated me like her apprentice instead of just another ward, because she knew I'd be a little troublemaker, and she didn't want me getting in trouble with some of the stuffier masters at the academy." Rixx's hand then reaches for the dangling silver necklace and its large amethyst. She palms and fiddles with it as she continues speaking.
    
    "It also helped that I usually ended up displaying a talent and interest in magical experimentation whenever I got into trouble. I was always told that such qualities marked me as being favored by Nareva."
    
    Wait, wait, wait, you were under the impression that the Order Astrida was all about controlling magic and hunting down rogue sorcerers. So why was she considered favored for experimenting and pushing the bounds of magic?
    
    "Oh uh..." Her eyes then widen slightly, as she says: "... I always forget how the Order looks to those who aren't familiar with it. The truth is a bit more complicated than that, but let me see if I can think of a way to explain it."
    
    Rixx then pauses a moment, and begins staring off into the middle distance, as she continues to fiddle with her necklace–obviously deep in thought.
    
    Eventually, she returns to the present and drops the necklace from her hands, so that she can gesture alongside her speech. "Alright, the crux of the issue is the Belharan empire from before the Godswar. Those idiots were dedicated to rampant magical progress, without a care for safety, without a care as to where they were heading, and without a care as to who they hurt by doing so." She then pauses a moment for breath, her usual smile replaced with an unusually serious glare.
    
    "Well... we both know how that situation ended up. The Order wants to make sure that another Godswar never happens again, and to that end, we control the progress of magic, so that it happens at a reasonable and safe rate. And the best way to do that is by encouraging their wards and the academy to be the ones who advance our craft– makes sense, right?"
    
    Yeah, that makes sense. If the Order Astrida is the group pushing progress then they can do it at a pace they deem acceptable. Then the Order's other half can hunt down those who pose a danger to the world by going too far too fast.
    
    As you say this, Rixx's dire expression softens considerably. There's then a few moments of silence, before a slightly pained expression breaks onto her face, and she reaches a hand to rub the back of her head. "Sorry about that [pc.name]. I totally just went on the same kind of rant some of those stuffier masters would have made."
    
    You give her a reassuring smile and shake your head, as you tell her not to worry about it. It was interesting to hear about the Order from an insider's perspective, and it's not like the rant was unprompted. She's obviously quite passionate about the Order and its role in the world.
    
    This assurance causes Rixx's usual grin to return as she nods, saying: "thanks [pc.name], I appreciate it."
    
    Her lecture did bring up another question for you, though. What's a ward of the Order Astrida doing here in the Khor'minos military?
    
    "Now that one's easy to answer. I regularly visit my family here once a year, and when I found out the city was under siege by an otherworldly invasion of corrupted beings, I sent word to the Order of what's happening and immediately signed up with the Auxiliary forces to help defend the city."
    
    So the Order's fine with her staying and assisting with the siege?
    
    Rixx simply shrugs and raises her hands– palms up as she responds; "technically I haven't gotten a response back from them yet. But, as a member in good standing, it's my duty to fight corruption and errant magic whenever I encounter it." Her grin then turns mischievous as she continues.
    
    "Besides, it's not like they're going to complain when I explain just how dire it was here. My bravery might even be personally rewarded by Nareva herself, and I'll finally get to ask her that question I've had for a while now!"
    
    Huh, what kind of question would she have for the goddess of magic herself?
    
    Oddly enough, this causes Rixx to put a hand to her mouth and start giggling. This goes on until she finally manages to contain her amusement and says: "Well... I'm going to ask if we can..." Rixx then makes a circle with her left thumb and pointer finger, before taking her right pointer finger and thrusting it into the hole.
    
    You can't help but suddenly laugh at the crass gesture, and at who she intends it for. This very quickly get's Rixx to start laughing too, and soon enough, you're both stuck in a laughing fit.
    
    Eventually, you both manage to calm down, and you take the opportunity to wish her luck with that question of hers. For what it's worth, you're rooting for her.
    
    "Thanks, [pc.name]," she says, her smile wide and glowing. "But enough about me, and my aspirations for the sweet touch of [silly
        |divine snussy
        |scaly divinity
    ]. I've done plenty of talking by this point, and I think it's about time you shared your recent adventures."
    
    You'd be happy to share the story of your recent adventures! Before though, you take a moment to clear your throat and arrange the memories you'll be retelling. Once you're ready, you begin by recounting that fateful, blizzard choked night at the Frost Hound Tavern...

    正如你所说，里克斯微微歪着头，带着一丝笑容看着你：“当然可以，但你必须先跟我讲讲你最近的冒险经历，怎么样？
    
    这应该不会太难吧——毕竟，你的那些冒险经历已经相当有趣了。”
    
    “太好了，”她点头表示同意，“我在提克里斯的学院里学习魔法技能，也是在阿斯特里达教团的指导下学习的。他们的要求相当严格，我也经常惹上麻烦，但那些麻烦其实并不会真正惹恼任何人。
    
    她是不是想分享一下自己搞了哪些恶作剧呢？
    
    你的问题让里克斯原本淡淡的微笑变成了灿烂的笑容，她的目光也变得若有所思。“我最早学习的法术之一，是一种可以改变食物味道的小型戏法。我的老师们觉得，一个曾经在街头生活的孩子肯定会对这种法术感兴趣。当然，他们完全猜对了，但我很快发现，这种法术有时候也会让食物的味道变差。
    
    啊，你也能猜到这件事会如何发展吧。她花了多长时间才被抓到的？
    
    她轻声笑了几声，然后说道：“我偷偷溜进了那个发现我的黑鳞女子的房间，在她吃晚饭之前，三次把她的晚餐弄得难以下咽，直到她忍无可忍，只好使用占卜咒语来监视自己煮的饭。不过，那次冒险最有趣的部分是在事后，当时我第一次接受了关于如何负责任地使用魔法的教导。她一边努力忍住笑意，一边真心实意地想给我上一课。
    
    对于一个连续三个晚上都被别人说三道四的人来说，这样的反应未免太过冷静了。她一直都是这样的吗？
    
    “是的，我觉得她把我当成了她的学徒来对待，而不仅仅是一个普通的受监护者。因为她知道我可能会惹些麻烦，所以她不希望我因为学院里那些古板严格的导师们而陷入麻烦。”里克斯伸手拿起了那条悬挂在颈间的银项链以及上面那颗巨大的紫水晶，一边摆弄着它，一边继续说道。
    
    而且，每当我遇到麻烦时，我往往会表现出对魔法实验的兴趣和天赋。人们总是告诉我，这样的品质说明我受到了纳雷瓦的青睐。”
    
    等等，等等，你原本以为阿斯特里达教团是专门负责控制魔法、追捕那些叛逆的巫师的吧？那么，为什么拥有这些喜欢进行魔法实验、不断探索魔法极限的品质，反而会被认为受到纳雷瓦的青睐呢？
    
    哦，嗯……”她的目光突然微微瞪大，接着说道：“……我总是忘记，对于那些不熟悉这个组织的人来说，它到底是什么样的。其实事情比这要复杂一些，不过让我想想，看看能不能想出一种办法来解释它。”
    
    随后，里克斯停顿了片刻，开始望着远方，同时继续摆弄着自己的项链——显然她正在深思之中。
    
    最终，她回到了现实，将项链从手中放下，这样就可以在讲话时配合手势来表达自己的意思。“好了，问题的关键在于神战之前的贝尔哈兰帝国。那些人一心只追求魔法技术的飞速发展，完全不顾安全，也不考虑自己的行为会给他人带来什么伤害。”她稍作停顿，喘了口气，原本挂在脸上的笑容此刻被一种异常严肃的神情所取代。
    
    嗯……我们都知道那种局面最终导致了什么后果。教团希望确保不会再发生类似的‘神战’，为此，我们必须控制魔法的发展速度，使其以合理且安全的节奏进行。而实现这一目标的最佳方式，就是鼓励他们的学徒们以及魔法学院来推动我们这项事业的发展——这样想起来，挺合理的吧？
    
    嗯，这样想确实有道理。如果“阿斯特里达秩序”是推动各项进展的组织，那么他们就可以按照自己认为合适的速度来行动；而该秩序的另外一半成员，则可以负责追捕那些行为过于激进、对世界构成威胁的人。
    
    听到你这么说，里克斯原本严肃的表情明显缓和了许多。随后有片刻的沉默，她的脸上浮现出些许痛苦的神情，她伸手揉了揉后脑勺，说道：“抱歉，刚才的话可能让你感到不舒服了。 [pc.name]我刚才说的那些话，其实和那些古板守旧的大师们可能会说出的话没什么两样。”
    
    你给她一个安慰的微笑，然后摇摇头，告诉她不必担心。从内部人士的角度来了解这个组织，确实挺有意思的，而且她这么说也不是无缘无故的。显然，她对这个组织以及它在世界中所扮演的角色充满了热情。
    
    听到你的安慰，里克斯又露出了她那惯常的微笑，点了点头说：“谢谢。 [pc.name]，真的很感谢你。”
    
    不过，她的演讲确实引出了另一个问题：身为阿斯特里达教团的成员，你为什么会来到科尔米诺斯的军队中呢？
    
    “这个答案很简单。我每年都会来这里探望家人，当得知这座城市正遭受外星入侵者的袭击时，我立刻通知了教团，然后立即加入了辅助部队，为保卫这座城市而战。
    
    那么，这个组织允许她留下来协助这次围攻行动吗？
    
    里克斯只是耸了耸肩，然后双手摊开回答道：“严格来说，我还没有收到他们的回复。但是，作为这个组织中声誉良好的成员，每当遇到腐败行为或错误的魔法运用时，我有责任站出来加以制止。”她接着说道，脸上露出调皮的笑容。
    
    再说，当我向他们解释这里的情况有多么糟糕时，他们应该也不会抱怨吧。我的勇敢甚至可能会得到娜瑞瓦女神本人的奖励，到那时我终于可以问她那个我一直想问的问题了！”
    
    嗯，他究竟想问这位魔法女神什么问题呢？
    
    说来也怪，这一幕让里克斯忍不住用手捂住嘴，开始咯咯笑起来。她就这样笑了好一会儿，直到终于忍住笑意，说道：“嗯……我想问一下，我们能不能……”然后里克斯用左手的大拇指和食指画了一个圆圈，接着用右手的食指把那个圆圈里的“洞”给填上了。
    
    看到这个粗俗的举动，以及她想用这个举动针对谁，你不禁突然笑了起来。这一下，里克斯也跟着笑了起来，很快，你们俩就一起陷入了大笑之中。
    
    最终，你们俩都平静了下来，你趁这个机会祝她能在那个问题上取得好成绩。不管结果如何，你都是真心在为她加油的。
    
    谢谢， [pc.name]，”没错，”她笑着说，脸上洋溢着灿烂的笑容，“但关于我本人，以及我对那种美好触感的渴望，就说到这里吧。 [silly
        |神圣的鼻屎
        |有鳞的神明
    ]到现在为止，我已经说了很多了，我觉得是时候让你分享一下你最近的冒险经历了。”
    
    你非常乐意讲述你最近的冒险故事！不过在开始之前，你先花了一点时间清了清嗓子，整理了一下那些你要回忆起来的事情。准备就绪后，你开始讲述那个在寒霜猎犬酒馆里发生的、被暴风雪笼罩的命运之夜……
rows.raw:
"
    Her mastery of conjuration is pretty impressive, especially since she's good enough to come up with her own spells. Would she be interested in telling you more about her magic and where she learned it?
    
    As you ask, Rixx's head tilts to the side, ever so slightly, as she considers you with a grin. "Sure, but you have to give me a re-cap of your recent adventures– deal?"
    
    That shouldn't be too difficult– your escapades have been pretty interesting, afterall.
    
    "Perfect," she says, nodding in acceptance. "I studied my magical skills in Tychris at the academy there and under the Order Astrida's supervision. They were pretty strict, and I got in trouble often, but not the kind of trouble that actually upset anyone."
    
    Does she want to share what kind of mischief she got into?
    
    Your question turns Rixx's light grin into a full blown smile, as her gaze turns distant. "One of the first spells I got taught was a minor prestidigitation that flavored food. My teachers figured that a former street urchin would appreciate that kind of spell. They were completely right, of course, but I quickly realized that the spell could make food taste worse too."
    
    Ah, you can see where this one's going. How long did it take for her to get caught?
    
    She snickers in reply, before saying; "I snuck into the room of the black-scale who found me and made her late night meal taste like dirt three times before she got fed up and used a scrying spell to monitor her dinner as it was cooked. Though, the best part of that escapade was afterwards, when I received my first lecture on using magic responsibly. She flitted between trying not to laugh, and trying to genuinely teach me a lesson."
    
    That's a remarkably even tempered response for someone who had gotten a mouthful of dirt for three nights in a row. Was she always like that?
    
    "Yeah, I think she treated me like her apprentice instead of just another ward, because she knew I'd be a little troublemaker, and she didn't want me getting in trouble with some of the stuffier masters at the academy." Rixx's hand then reaches for the dangling silver necklace and its large amethyst. She palms and fiddles with it as she continues speaking.
    
    "It also helped that I usually ended up displaying a talent and interest in magical experimentation whenever I got into trouble. I was always told that such qualities marked me as being favored by Nareva."
    
    Wait, wait, wait, you were under the impression that the Order Astrida was all about controlling magic and hunting down rogue sorcerers. So why was she considered favored for experimenting and pushing the bounds of magic?
    
    "Oh uh..." Her eyes then widen slightly, as she says: "... I always forget how the Order looks to those who aren't familiar with it. The truth is a bit more complicated than that, but let me see if I can think of a way to explain it."
    
    Rixx then pauses a moment, and begins staring off into the middle distance, as she continues to fiddle with her necklace–obviously deep in thought.
    
    Eventually, she returns to the present and drops the necklace from her hands, so that she can gesture alongside her speech. "Alright, the crux of the issue is the Belharan empire from before the Godswar. Those idiots were dedicated to rampant magical progress, without a care for safety, without a care as to where they were heading, and without a care as to who they hurt by doing so." She then pauses a moment for breath, her usual smile replaced with an unusually serious glare.
    
    "Well... we both know how that situation ended up. The Order wants to make sure that another Godswar never happens again, and to that end, we control the progress of magic, so that it happens at a reasonable and safe rate. And the best way to do that is by encouraging their wards and the academy to be the ones who advance our craft– makes sense, right?"
    
    Yeah, that makes sense. If the Order Astrida is the group pushing progress then they can do it at a pace they deem acceptable. Then the Order's other half can hunt down those who pose a danger to the world by going too far too fast.
    
    As you say this, Rixx's dire expression softens considerably. There's then a few moments of silence, before a slightly pained expression breaks onto her face, and she reaches a hand to rub the back of her head. "Sorry about that [pc.name]. I totally just went on the same kind of rant some of those stuffier masters would have made."
    
    You give her a reassuring smile and shake your head, as you tell her not to worry about it. It was interesting to hear about the Order from an insider's perspective, and it's not like the rant was unprompted. She's obviously quite passionate about the Order and its role in the world.
    
    This assurance causes Rixx's usual grin to return as she nods, saying: "thanks [pc.name], I appreciate it."
    
    Her lecture did bring up another question for you, though. What's a ward of the Order Astrida doing here in the Khor'minos military?
    
    "Now that one's easy to answer. I regularly visit my family here once a year, and when I found out the city was under siege by an otherworldly invasion of corrupted beings, I sent word to the Order of what's happening and immediately signed up with the Auxiliary forces to help defend the city."
    
    So the Order's fine with her staying and assisting with the siege?
    
    Rixx simply shrugs and raises her hands– palms up as she responds; "technically I haven't gotten a response back from them yet. But, as a member in good standing, it's my duty to fight corruption and errant magic whenever I encounter it." Her grin then turns mischievous as she continues.
    
    "Besides, it's not like they're going to complain when I explain just how dire it was here. My bravery might even be personally rewarded by Nareva herself, and I'll finally get to ask her that question I've had for a while now!"
    
    Huh, what kind of question would she have for the goddess of magic herself?
    
    Oddly enough, this causes Rixx to put a hand to her mouth and start giggling. This goes on until she finally manages to contain her amusement and says: "Well... I'm going to ask if we can..." Rixx then makes a circle with her left thumb and pointer finger, before taking her right pointer finger and thrusting it into the hole.
    
    You can't help but suddenly laugh at the crass gesture, and at who she intends it for. This very quickly get's Rixx to start laughing too, and soon enough, you're both stuck in a laughing fit.
    
    Eventually, you both manage to calm down, and you take the opportunity to wish her luck with that question of hers. For what it's worth, you're rooting for her.
    
    "Thanks, [pc.name]," she says, her smile wide and glowing. "But enough about me, and my aspirations for the sweet touch of [silly
        |divine snussy
        |scaly divinity
    ]. I've done plenty of talking by this point, and I think it's about time you shared your recent adventures."
    
    You'd be happy to share the story of your recent adventures! Before though, you take a moment to clear your throat and arrange the memories you'll be retelling. Once you're ready, you begin by recounting that fateful, blizzard choked night at the Frost Hound Tavern...
    "

rows.original:
... And that's how you ended up in Khor'minos– still chasing Kasyrra and still trying to [kas.romantic|"stop"|stop] her corruptive ways.
        
        As your story finishes, Rixx seems to snap out of the spell she'd been under since you told her about Kasyrra. She had been leaning forward with elbows on knees and eyes glued to yours, but now, with the story over, she finally leans back into her couch and rapidly blinks a few times.
        
        There's a moment of silence as Rixx seems to absorb the story, before a sudden smile breaks onto her face. "And here I thought I had interesting stories to tell!" She then brings a hand to her chin and rests her head in it as she continues speaking. "You know, hearing about that kind of stuff makes me want to adventure myself. I wonder if the order would give me leave to do that sort of thing."
        
        While you don't know if the order would let her, you certainly hope they do. It's an interesting lifestyle that can bring great rewards if one's careful. Though, she should always remember to never go at it alone. A party of people she trusts will save her ass more than any power she wields. Plus, they help make the road less lonely and the nights a bit warmer.
        
        [party.hasCompanions
            |As this leaves your mouth, you catch both [party.compNames] grinning in the corner of your eye. Rixx seems to catch this too, and after a quiet chuckle she says:
            |Rixx nods at this and says:
        ] "Thanks for the good advice! If I even do decide to start my own adventuring career, I'll track you down so that I can pick your brain on how to do it. For now though, I'm not going to worry about it, given that I don't even know if the order will give me the leave to do so."
        
        Rixx then gives a large yawn that exposes her razor sharp teeth, as she stretches her arms out above her. Then, all at once, she drops her hands back to her lap and smacks her lips a couple of times before speaking again. "So, got anything else you want to talk about? I might be a little tired after story time, but I've still got enough energy left in me if you want to do something fun."
        
        She pairs that last bit with a wink, and a throb from the bulge under her robes.
rows.translation:
……于是你就这样来到了科尔米诺斯——仍在追寻卡希拉，也仍在试图[kas.romantic|“制止”|制止]她散播腐化。
        
        你的故事讲完后，里克斯似乎终于从自你提起卡希拉时便笼罩着她的魔咒中清醒过来。她方才一直身体前倾，双肘撑膝，双眼紧盯着你；如今故事结束，她总算靠回沙发，飞快地眨了几下眼睛。
        
        里克斯似乎在消化这个故事，片刻沉默之后，她脸上突然绽开笑容。“我还以为自己讲得出不少有趣的故事呢！”她一手托住下巴，将脑袋枕在掌中，继续说道。“知道吗，听到这些事，我也想亲自去冒险了。不知道教团会不会准我为此休假。”
        
        你不知道教团是否会答应，但真心希望他们能够同意。这种生活方式颇为有趣，只要足够谨慎，就能获得丰厚回报。不过她永远都该记住，绝不能独自上路。一支由她信任之人组成的队伍，比她掌握的任何力量都更能救她于危难。更何况，同伴还能让旅途不那么寂寞，也让夜晚稍微温暖一些。
        
        [party.hasCompanions
            |话刚出口，你便从眼角余光看见[party.compNames]都在咧嘴微笑。里克斯似乎也注意到了；她轻笑一声后说道：
            |里克斯点点头，说道：
        ]“谢谢你的好建议！如果我真的决定开始自己的冒险生涯，就会找到你，好好请教该怎么做。不过现在我还不打算操心这件事，毕竟我连教团是否会准假都不知道。”
        
        里克斯接着打了个大大的哈欠，露出剃刀般锋利的牙齿，同时将双臂伸过头顶。然后，她突然把双手放回腿上，咂了几下嘴，再度开口。“那么，还有什么想聊的吗？故事时间过后我是有点累，但如果你想做些有趣的事，我身上还剩着足够的精力。”
        
        说到最后，她朝你眨了眨眼，长袍下方的隆起也随之搏动。

Interested in hearing a local talk about their city, you ask Rixx about what she thinks of its current state. This question [var0
        |makes her smile, as she regards you with warm eyes.
        |causes her face to slightly fall, as she takes a deep breath and sighs.
    ]
    
    [var0
        |"Well, ever since the siege was lifted, things have been looking better and better! There are still imp attacks, especially in the deeper tunnels, but they're nowhere near as frequent as before."
        |"Well, things are quite a bit different from my last visit to the city. A society would be challenged by any one of the problems we have right now, demons, refugees, and martial law to name a few, but with all of those at once? The people are hurting and scared [pc.name]."
    ]
    
    [var0
        |That's great to hear! So things have been getting back to normal around the city?
        |Damn, you were afraid she'd say that. Is it really that bad right now?
    ]
    
    [var0
        |"I wouldn't say 'normal,' but we're trying to head that way. Right now the military is focusing on reclaiming territory on the city's outskirts, rather than the purely defensive strategy we had during the siege."
        |Rixx grins a little when you ask that, but it's a wistful and sad smile that plucks at your heart-strings. "Sorry, it isn't really that bad– I just got a little sad there. Our citizens are feeling the strain of this war, but things aren't so dire that they've given up hope. I think most realize that we're fighting for their souls and are willing to put up with a lot because of it."
    ]
    
    [var0
        |Right, getting the roads safe again and getting people back into their homes.
        |[pc.ptc
            |Feeling your resolve deepen, you give the little goblin a nod and tell her that you're doing all you can to end the siege.
            |Feeling your resolve deepen, you give the little goblin a nod and tell her that you're doing all you can to end the siege.
            |Yeah well, you're definitely going to "end the siege" one way or another.
        ]
    ]
    
    As you say this, [var0
        |Rixx's nods in return, her smile wide as she says: "Yep, pretty much! It's nice to finally feel like we're gaining ground on those little red bastards. Before, it was like there was an infinite sea of them, constantly appearing out of nowhere. But now we actually seem to be thinning out their numbe..."
        |the sadness in Rixx's smile abates a little, and she gives a nod in return, saying: "You and Calise have been doing right by us. Honestly, you've both become beacons of heroism for everyone, from the citizenry to the soldiers!"
    ]
    
    [var0
        |She suddenly stops mid-sentence, as her eyes widen. After a moment's pause, Rixx brings a hand up to her chin and rubs it while making a "hmmm" noise.
        |She then brings a hand up to her mouth and snickers before continuing. "You should hear some of the footsoldiers when they're shooting the shit. I swear, half the conversations are about who would win in a three way fight between you, Calise, and an entire shield-wall."
    ]
    
    [var0
        |Curious about what just occurred to her, you ask the little goblin what's on her mind.
        |Ha! Fighting an entire shield wall by yourself might be mythologizing your abilities a bit, but it's good to know the soldiers are having fun and keeping their morale up with "who would win" scenarios.
    ]
    
    Rixx shrugs in response, her grin [var0
        |returning as she speaks again. "Agh, it isn't anything important. I just realized that my deployment with the Auxiliary forces is going to end soon, and that I can return to my home, Tychris, when it does."
        |still happy as she says: "The rank-and-file soldiers will always act like rank-and-file soldiers if given the chance. But..." She then pauses for a second, with her eyes hazing over like she's deep in thought.

由于你对当地人谈论他们所在城市的内容很感兴趣，于是你询问了里克斯对她所在城市现状的看法。这个问题[var0
        |看到你时，她那温暖的眼神会让她露出微笑。

    ]
    
    [var0
        |嗯，自从围攻解除之后，情况确实越来越好了！虽然仍然会有兽人的袭击，尤其是在那些较深的隧道里，但频率已经远不如以前了。
        |嗯，这次我来这个城市的时候，情况已经和上次大不相同了。任何一种我们目前面临的问题，比如恶魔、难民、戒严令等等，都足以让一个社会陷入困境，但要是这些问题同时出现的话？人们肯定既痛苦又恐惧。 [pc.name]。”
    ]
    
    [var0
        |听到这个消息真是太好了！那么这座城市的秩序已经逐渐恢复正常了吗？
        |该死，你本来就怕她会这么说吧。现在的情况真的有那么糟糕吗？
    ]
    
    [var0

        |当你问起这个问题的时候，里克斯微微一笑，但那是一种充满忧伤与无奈的微笑，让人心里不禁感到一阵酸楚。“抱歉，并没有那么糟糕——我只是有点难过而已。我们的市民确实感受到了这场战争的压力，但情况并没有糟糕到让他们失去希望。我想大多数人都能意识到，我们是在为他们的未来而战，因此他们愿意忍受很多困难。
    ]
    
    [var0

            |感受到自己的决心日益坚定，你向那个小地精点了点头，告诉她你正在尽自己所能来结束这场围攻。
            |嗯，无论如何，你肯定能够“解除这场围困”。
        ]
    ]
    
    你这么一说， [var0
        |里克斯也点了点头，她笑容满面地说：“没错，差不多就是这样！终于感觉到我们正在逐渐压制那些红色的小混蛋了，真是太好了。之前，它们就好像是一片无穷无尽的海洋，总是突然从无处出现。但现在，我们的攻势似乎真的开始让它们的数量减少了……

    ]
    
    [var0
        |她突然在说话途中停了下来，眼睛瞪得大大的。过了一会儿，里克斯把手放在她的下巴上轻轻揉了揉，同时发出“嗯”了一声。
        |然后她把手放到嘴边，轻声笑了几声，接着继续说道：“你真应该听听那些底层士兵们闲聊时说的那些话。我发誓，他们有一半的谈话内容都是在讨论你、卡莉丝，还有那整面护盾墙，三者之间如果打起来谁会赢。

    [var0

        |她依然笑着说：“如果有机会，普通士兵终究还是会表现得像普通士兵。但是……”她停顿了一下，目光似乎陷入了沉思。

        |我的入伍合同规定的义务已经全部履行完毕，围城战也结束了，一切都结束了。但我还是想留下来，帮忙消灭剩下的那些恶魔。不过说实话，只要思乡之情变得太强烈，我可能还是会收拾行李回家。我真的很想念在组织里的朋友们，而我觉得科尔米诺斯的军队应该能够处理好剩下的任务。
        |如果你想了解这个城市的情况，那就看看它的人民是如何继续生活的。士兵们仍在开玩笑，抱怨任务无聊；薇特拉的赞助者们依然快乐地欢聚一堂；而我也可以偶尔在城里休息一段时间，而不是一直在执行任务。所以……我想说的是，虽然我们正处于艰难的时期，但我们仍在继续生活。这样回答你的问题，够吗？ [pc.name]？”
    ]
    
    [var0
        |是的，我明白她的感受。在这种情况下，如果你和你的同伴分离了这么长时间，你可能也会开始想念他们吧。
        |嗯，没错，你明白她的意思吧。说实话，她把鹰棘镇和冬城这些地方发生的事情描述得非常准确。恶魔们造成了严重的破坏，但霜冻边境的人民依然坚持了下来，并继续进行抵抗。
    ]
    
    里克斯只是简单地点了点头作为回应，你们的谈话自然而然地结束了，此时你们都在思考刚才说过的话。不过，最终里克斯将手掌拍在大腿上，这一动作让你从思绪中回过神来，重新关注她。
    
    “那么，还有其他你想聊的事情吗？ [pc.name]？”

rows.original: When you first met, she mentioned some sort of side business that's brought in a lot of coin for her. Then there's the fact that her house is much nicer than someone could afford on a soldier's pay. Does she mind telling you about it? Rixx doesn't immediately answer you, instead she peers at you with a critical eye and pouty lips. A few moments go by like this, when a smile suddenly breaks across her face. "I guess I could let you onto my list of clients. I try to keep it pretty exclusive, given that not everyone can afford my services, but if the Champion of Frost can't afford me then nobody can." Afford her? Is she acting as a courtesan in-between mission outings? "Ha! Nice guess, but no. If someone wants my affections then all they have to do is ask and be ready to serve their mistress." She then gives you a wink, and spreads her legs a bit wider before speaking again. "Instead, I take wealthy patrons who are interested in more... exotic... pleasures and use my magic to conjure something to suit their tastes. I charge a lot, of course, but it's a very exclusive kind of service." Huh, so what kind of exotic pleasures is she talking about here? You imagine there's a whole laundry list of weird things she can conjure, given that she's an expert in summoning and conjuration magic. The little goblin shrugs her shoulders and begins absently playing with a lock of her shaggy, raven, hair, as she says; "Technically that's true, but fucking a fire spirit or something similar isn't what most clients are looking for." As she speaks, you notice her cheeks start to take on a rosy hue, and her ever present bulge begins straining against the robe containing it. "Instead, lonely senator's daughters come in and beg me to..." There's then a pause for dramatic effect, as Rixx's hand drops from her hair to rub her thighs, while the monster under her robes continues to try and get out. "... violate every single one of their holes with countless tentacles, until they can barely think." Well hot damn, that certainly qualifies as exotic pleasures, alright. And from the way she's talking, it's an intense experience too. "Oh, you've got to either try it or see it to really understand. I don't think I can describe just how thoroughly fucked someone is by the end of a session." Rixx then suddenly pauses for a moment and brings a hand to her chin, as she considers something. After a couple of beats, her hand lowers and she locks eyes with you, her gaze defiant as she says; "Actually, if you want to learn, then you're going to have to experience it yourself. My customers value their privacy and I can't let you sit in on one, even if you are a friend." A smile and a nod is what you offer in return for that sentiment. Keeping her client list private makes sense when its full senator's daughters and Khor'minan aristocrats. Though, say you were curious about taking her up on that offer, how much would it cost and how safe is the whole process? Rixx's eyes immediately soften, and the tension in her shoulder bleeds away. "Oh! I usually charge 500 electrum for a single session. And when it comes to safety, there's so many precautions in place that it's probably safer than normal sex!" Really? It's kind of hard to believe that being "violated by countless tentacles" is safer than your average one night stand. The horny little goblin simply shrugs in response, a smile audible in her speech as she says: "That was hyperbole, but it's probably not far from the truth." Rixx then holds up three fingers while she continues speaking. "I have three main precautions in place to prevent any... accidents. The first is that I completely control the tentacles when I summon them. They basically become an extension of my body, like an extra arm or something, rather than an independent creature. My second safeguard is the telepathic contact we'll have. With it, I'll know how you're holding up without needing to ask you, because you definitely won't be able to verbalize anything with a few tentacles shoved down your throat." She rubs her thighs and gives a little snicker as her bulge throbs again. "Finally though, and this is the most important part, if I sense that anything's wrong then I can end the summoning in an instant. I also refrain from... enjoying the spectacle... because I need to stay focused on keeping you safe, and if that's not a commitment to your continued existence then I don't know what is!" Well... that does actually sound pretty safe. You didn't know what safety nets there could even be when getting ravaged by tentacles, but that three tiered protection system does make it seem unlikely that you'll get hurt. At this, Rixx's grin glints with a beam of pride, as she crosses her arms and says; "I haven't had an injury yet! And, if you need any more convincing, I had this little gig going on back in Tychris and the Order themselves signed off on it." Alright, alright, she's convinced you it's safe. If you ever get the urge to be molested by tentacles until you can't walk, then you who to talk to. Rixx, still beaming, gives you a seated bow with the grace of a courtier. While her head is down, you hear her say; "It's the least I can do for 500 electrum." When her head comes back up, she slaps her palms down onto her thighs with a loud smack. "Now, dear [pc.name], let's go ahead and talk about something that's less arousing to my friend here, unless you really want to awaken his hunger." To capitalize her point, she gestures to the tent at her robe's waist. Point taken.
rows.translation: 你们初次见面时，她提到过有一项副业，这项副业为她带来了不少收入。另外，她的房子也远比一个军人的薪水所能负担得起的要好得多。她愿意告诉你关于这些的事情吗？ 里克斯并没有立刻回答你，而是用一种批判的眼神打量着你，嘴唇还微微撅着。这样的气氛持续了好一会儿，直到她脸上突然绽放出笑容：“我想，我可以把你加到我的客户名单里。我尽量让我的服务保持一定的排他性，因为并不是每个人都能负担得起我的服务。但如果连“霜之冠军”都负担不起，那就没人能做到了。 负担得起她的服务？难道她在执行任务间隙是在扮演某种“交际花”的角色吗？ 哈！猜得不错，但错了。如果有人想要的话我的那么，她们所要做的就是提出请求，并且随时准备为自己的‘女主人’服务。”她说着眨了眨眼，然后将双腿分开得更宽一些，继续说道： “而我，则会选择那些对一些更为……奇特……的享受感兴趣的富有的顾客，然后运用我的魔法来为他们创造出符合他们口味的东西。当然，收费也会很高，但这种服务确实是非常高端、私密的。 哈，那么她这里说的到底是哪些奇特的享受呢？考虑到她可是召唤魔法方面的专家，你完全可以想象她能想出各种各样奇怪的事情来。 那个小哥布林耸了耸肩，开始漫不经心地摆弄着自己那一头蓬乱如乌鸦般的头发，然后说道：“从技术上讲，你说的没错，但和火精灵之类的东西发生关系，显然不是大多数客户想要的。 她说话的时候，你可以看到她的脸颊渐渐泛起了红晕，而她身上那处始终存在的凸起部位也开始让包裹它的长袍显得有些吃力。“相反，那些孤独的参议员的女儿们会来到我面前，恳求我……” 接着，为了营造戏剧效果，里克斯的手从她的头发上移开，开始揉搓她的大腿，而她长袍下的那个怪物则仍在试图挣脱束缚。 ……用无数触手侵入它们的每一个角落，直到它们几乎无法思考。” 哇，天哪，这确实可以算得上是一种极其奇特的体验了。从她描述的方式来看，这种体验肯定也非常强烈。 哦，你必须亲自尝试或者亲眼看到，才能真正理解其中的感觉。我想我根本无法形容，在一次游戏体验结束后，一个人会陷入多糟糕的境地。”里克斯突然停顿了一下，然后将手放在下巴上，似乎在思考着什么。过了几秒钟，她的手缓缓放下，与你的目光对视起来。她的眼神中充满了倔强，说道：“其实，如果你真的想学习的话，就必须亲身体验才行。我的顾客非常重视他们的隐私，即使你是我的朋友，我也不能让你旁观他们的私密环节。" Looks like you've finally entered the surrounding suburbs of Khor'minos — before you is a paved road leading north, and a nearby signpost indicates the distance. It's not too far.

        "Finally made it," Brint grunts. "Didn't feel like that long of a walk when I left."
        
        "Heh, y- wait," you say, looking at Brint. "What's happening to you?"
        
        He looks down at himself as the golden armor he put on in the cave begins to shimmer, cracking in several places and falling away from his body. The moment the pieces hit the ground they lose their golden lustre and begin melting into the dirt, disappearing completely. [party.som||You and Brint|The three of you] stand there dumbfounded, staring at where the armor vanished.
        
        "What the hell?" you say.
        
        "Shit," Brint laughs. "Good thing that happened here and not in front of the guards. Damn! At least now I'll be able to get some proper sleep at night... no more weird dreams and all."
        
        You feel a vague sense of unease about the whole thing but there's nothing to be done now — it's not like there's a second set, and Brint probably wouldn't put it on even if there was. You'll just continue on with him.

rows.original:
You approach the statue of the minotaur, drawing forth your waystone charm and holding it up towards his torch. The moment you hold up your own charm, you feel a tension rising in the air, and the atmosphere crackles with power. You grit your teeth and step forward, forcing yourself towards the ancient idol.

        And then, suddenly the pressure breaks, and the wind howls through the streets. The gemstone in the center of the stone torch shines and begins to pulse with inner light... it's awake! You grin and close your fist around the charm, watching as the light fades. The idol is awakened once more...

        就在这时，突然间，那种压迫感消失了，狂风开始在街道上呼啸而过。石制火炬中央的宝石开始发光，那光芒仿佛在内部跳动着。…它醒来了！你露出微笑，将那枚护身符握在拳头中，注视着光芒逐渐消失。这个神像又一次被唤醒了……

rows.original:
"What can you tell me about this place?" you say, gesturing at your surroundings. "Do people live here?"
            
            "Well, not any more," Julia says. "It used to be a residential area — still is, I guess, but without any residents. The boys gambling up the road are about the only people that hang out here any more."
            
            "Everyone moved inside the city proper, huh?" you say.[flags.KM_FARMER| "Seems to be a theme here."]
            
            She nods. "You won't catch too many regular Minoans out here now. Just merchants and the like."
            
            "How about you?" you ask. "Do you live around here?"
            
            "Me? Oh, no," Julia says, shaking her head. "I just came here on a walk. Trying to maintain my youthful figure!" She giggles, patting her tummy. "But I like cake too much."
            
            [party.has brint brienne
                |[brint.isBrienne
                    |"Cake..." Brienne mumbles, ears flopping up and down.
                    
                    "There's a nice bakery in the city," Julia says with a smile. "The Sweetest Pie, it's called."
                    
                    "I'll remember that," you say. Maybe you can buy Brienne a cake.
                    |"Cake?" Brint says, ears perking up.
                    
                    "There's a nice bakery in the city," Julia says with a smile. "The Sweetest Pie, it's called."
                    
                    "I'll remember that," you say. Maybe you can buy Brint a cake, if he's that interested.
                ]
            ]
rows.translation:
“关于这个地方，你能告诉我些什么吗？”你一边说着，一边指向周围的景象。“这里有人居住吗？”
            
            “嗯，现在已经没有人了。”朱莉娅回答道，“这里曾经是一个居民区——我想现在依然算是居民区，只不过已经没有居民了。现在只有那几个在路上赌博的男孩还会偶尔来这里。”
            
            “原来大家都搬进城里去了，是吗？”你说道。[flags.KM_FARMER| “看来这儿都是这个套路。”]
            
            她点了点头：“现在在这里你很难遇到普通的米诺斯人，只有商人们之类的。”
            
            “那你呢？”你问道，“你住在这附近吗？”
            
            “我吗？哦，不，”朱莉娅摇着头说，“我只是出来散散步而已，想保持我这年轻的体态呢！”她咯咯笑着，拍了拍自己的肚子，“不过我实在太喜欢蛋糕了。”
            
            [party.has brint brienne
                |[brint.isBrienne
                    |“蛋糕……”布蕾妮喃喃道，耳朵不停地上下摆动。
                    
                    “城里有一家很不错的面包店，”朱莉娅微笑着说，“叫‘至甜馅饼’。”
                    
                    “我会记下来的，”你说道。或许你可以给布蕾妮买个蛋糕。
                    |“蛋糕？”布林特说着，耳朵立刻竖了起来。
                    
                    “城里有一家很不错的面包店，”朱莉娅微笑着说，“叫‘至甜馅饼’。”
                    
                    “我会记下来的，”你说。如果布林特真的那么感兴趣的话，或许可以给他买一块蛋糕。
                ]
            ]

"
    The closer you get to the crossroads the more you can see of the bustling activity within. It doesn't look like many people are leaving or entering the way you came but there sure are a lot of people walking to the east and west while carriages laden with strange plants and herbs bumpily roll along the cobbled road. [party.has brint
        |[pc.ra cowgirl
            |You can't say you're too surprised the minotaurs don't pay any attention to you — you look like a regular cowgirl and with Brint standing alongside you, the implication is fairly obvious. Still, you expected a bit more interest.
            |[pc.ra minotaur
                |You can't say you're too surprised the minotaurs don't pay any attention to you — you and Brint look just like them, after all.
                |Oddly, the minotaurs seem more interested in Brint's appearance than they do yours — you'd expected them to take a little more note of outsiders.
            ]
        ]
        |[party.has brienne
            |[pc.ra cowgirl
                |You can't say you're too surprised the minotaurs don't pay any attention to you — you look like a regular cowgirl and Brienne is, well, suspiciously large and muscular. Still, you'd expected a little more interest.
                |[pc.ra minotaur
                    |You can't say you're too surprised the minotaurs don't pay much attention to you — you look just like one of them, though Brienne is suspiciously large and muscular for a woman.
                    |Perhaps unsurprisingly, the minotaurs pay more attention to Brienne's appearance than they do yours — though you'd expected them to take a little more note of outsiders.
                ]
            ]
        ]
    ]
    
    The more you watch the ongoing traffic, though, the more you think you understand this place. It's a little like Hawkethorne on a greater scale. There's a party of lupines carrying crates over there, some [var0|mecians|smaller mouse-like people] walking along the edges of the path, elves, and humans all intermingling — though not too much. It seems like everyone's sticking mostly to their own groups.
    
    [party.comp brint brienne
        |"Little busy compared to Hawkethorne, eh?" Brint says, [brint.fucked|patting your back|clapping your shoulder]. "You get used to it."
        |"It's busier compared to Hawkethorne, right?" Brienne says with a smile. "You get used to it after a while."
    ]"

rows.original: [brint.isBrienne |"You know, Brienne, I'm not a total bumpkin," you say, smiling at her. "I have seen a city before." "Aw, I know that!" Brienne says, laughing. "I just thought it might be new to you. There's so much going on n' all! It's proper civilization, not like Hawkethorne." rows.original:
There's an older, muscled minotaur resting against the fence. He looks over as you approach.
    
    "'Ay [pc.mf|buddy|girlie]," he says, giving you a nod. "Guessin' you[party.som|'re a traveler.| two're travelers.| lot're travelers.] Nothing out these parts but grass 'n weeds." He gestures broadly to the fields behind him. You have to admit, it really doesn't look like there's much going on out there. "Don't go fence-jumpin' all at once to see the sights, now."
    
    "I've seen a lot of empty land since I got here, even though it looked like it used to be developed," you note. "What's going on?"
    
    "Ah, well," he says, hesitating, then sighs. "Damn king's really got people riled up with the isolation. Families been moving away from the outskirts and back into the city proper, giving up their land 'n all to be closer to the army. Keeps talkin' 'bout some 'outside threat'." He shakes his head. "Reckon the only threat to the kingdom is the idiot runnin' it. Not many people comin' through those caves."
    
    "Why are you still here, then?" you ask.
    
    He shrugs. "Nowhere to be. Kids are taken care of in the barracks, though they won't stop tellin' me to come join 'em. Khaak, I just don't wanna give up the house 'n all. S'where we all grew up."
rows.translation:
有一头年纪较大、肌肉结实的弥诺陶洛斯靠在围栏上休息。当你走近时，他抬眼看向你。
    
    “‘哎，[pc.mf|老兄|妹子]，”他说着，向你点了点头，“我猜你[party.som|是个旅行者。| 们俩是旅行者。| 们这群人是旅行者。]这一带除了野草和杂草，什么都没有。”他朝身后那片广阔的田野挥了挥手。你得承认，那边看上去确实没什么值得一看的东西。“可别一下子全翻过栅栏去看风景啊。”
    
    “自从我来到这里，我见过很多空地，尽管它们看上去曾经被开发过，”你说道，“这是怎么回事？”
    
    “啊，这个嘛，”他犹豫了一下，然后叹了口气，“那个该死的国王搞的隔离政策，可真把大家惹毛了。家家户户都在从郊外搬回城里，放弃自己的土地，只为了能离军队更近一些。他老是念叨着什么‘外部威胁’。”他摇了摇头，“依我看，这个王国唯一的威胁，就是掌权的那个白痴。没多少人会从那些洞穴里过来。”
    
    “那你为什么还留在这里？”你问道。
    
    他耸了耸肩：“也没别的地方可去。孩子们在营房里有人照看，虽说他们总不停地叫我也过去。唉，我就是舍不得那栋房子。毕竟我们大家都是在那儿长大的。”
rows.raw:
"
    There's an older, muscled minotaur resting against the fence. He looks over as you approach.
    
    "'Ay [pc.mf|buddy|girlie]," he says, giving you a nod. "Guessin' you[party.som|'re a traveler.| two're travelers.| lot're travelers.] Nothing out these parts but grass 'n weeds." He gestures broadly to the fields behind him. You have to admit, it really doesn't look like there's much going on out there. "Don't go fence-jumpin' all at once to see the sights, now."
    
    "I've seen a lot of empty land since I got here, even though it looked like it used to be developed," you note. "What's going on?"
    
    "Ah, well," he says, hesitating, then sighs. "Damn king's really got people riled up with the isolation. Families been moving away from the outskirts and back into the city proper, giving up their land 'n all to be closer to the army. Keeps talkin' 'bout some 'outside threat'." He shakes his head. "Reckon the only threat to the kingdom is the idiot runnin' it. Not many people comin' through those caves."
    
    "Why are you still here, then?" you ask.
    
    He shrugs. "Nowhere to be. Kids are taken care of in the barracks, though they won't stop tellin' me to come join 'em. Khaak, I just don't wanna give up the house 'n all. S'where we all grew up.""

rows.original:
You say your farewells and head back to the road, turning the situation over in your head.

        [party.has brint
            |"Worse here than I thought," Brint mutters, grimacing. "Wondered why all the farms were deserted myself. Seems weird, though, disappearing inwards like that."
        
            "It probably didn't happen all at once," you say, looking out over the unkempt fields. "Just a few at a time until no one was left."
            
            "Guess so," he says.
            |[party.has brienne
                |"It's worse than I thought here," Brienne mutters, grimacing. "I did wonder why all the farms were deserted myself. Didn't expect the answer to be the king."
            
                "It's a weird one," you say, looking out over the unkempt fields. "People up and leaving because the king's worried. I wonder if that was what he told them to do."
                
                "Might be," she says. "Guess we'll find out."
            ]
        ]
rows.translation:
你道了别，重新回到路上，一边走一边在心里琢磨着这件事。

        [party.has brint
            |“这里比我以为的还要糟，”布林特皱着眉头低声说，“我自己也纳闷为什么所有农场都荒废了。不过，像那样一片片往里消失，实在有点怪。”
        
            “这大概不是一下子发生的，”你望着那些杂草丛生的田野说，“一次走几家，直到最后一个人都不剩。”
            
            “大概吧，”他说。
            |[party.has brienne
                |“这里的情况比我以为的还要糟，”布蕾妮皱着眉头低声说，“我自己也纳闷过为什么所有农场都荒废了。没想到答案竟然是国王。”
            
                “这事真够怪的，”你望着那些杂草丛生的田野说，“人们就因为国王的担忧而纷纷搬走。我怀疑这是不是他吩咐他们做的。”
                
                “也许吧，”她说，“不过我们总会知道的。”
            ]
        ]

rows.original: Bid the minotaur man goodbye and be on your way.
rows.translation: 向弥诺陶洛斯人道别，然后继续你的旅程吧。
rows.raw: "Bid the minotaur man goodbye and be on your way."

rows.original: [flags.KMMS_A5 |You follow the road away from the gates and down to the milking barn. The big sign out front is still advertising its services, including the bra-busting illustration of a milky cowgirl. [var0 |The guards outside give you a familiar nod. |Doesn't look like it's open yet, though. You'll have to come back later. ] |You follow the road away from the gates in your curiosity, noting a building resembling a wooden barn amidst a grassy field down the way. Drawing closer you find that not only is the building a barn, it's not for animals — it's for people. Milking Barn! A public service provided for the populace by decree of the King. So declares the sign outside, accompanied by a brazen depiction of a milky cowgirl bursting out of her top. It's pretty well-drawn, actually.[party.has brint | "We're not big on subtlety here," Brint says. "Might be a bit of culture shock, 'n all that." "Yeah, don't worry. Figured that from the moment we met," you say. "No need to thank me," he says, flexing an arm. ][party.has brienne | "We're not real big on subtlety in Khor'minos," Brienne says, glancing at you. "Y'know, in case you hadn't figured that out." "Yeah, no culture shock here. I've learned from the best," you say. "Aww, you're too kind," she says, smiling. ] [var0 |There are a couple of soldiers standing out by the gate, and they give you a nod as you approach. "Hey there. Here for the barn?" "Sure," you say. "How's it work?" "Weeeeelllll, I'd give you the whole spiel but I've been standing here a while now so here's the rundown," the first guard says, nodding back at the building. "Go in and you can milk some of the girls, or get milked yourself. We've got some specially-bred plants that do the job for ya, or you can ask one of the attendants — they're all women. Or one of the guards, if that's how you want it." "We don't mind," the other guard says, nodding. [pc.isBimbo |"That's totally generous of you!" |"How generous," ] you say. "Hey, captain tells me to guard the barn, I guard the barn," the soldier says, shrugging. "Beats the slums. Anyway, you don't have to pay. Like the sign says, it's a public service. Not like it costs us much to have it here, 'n we sell the milk sometimes. Good system." |Looks like it's closed for the night. You'll have to come back later. ] ]
rows.translation: [flags.KMMS_A5 |你沿着道路离开大门，一路走到挤奶棚那边。门前的大招牌仍在宣传它的服务，上面还画着一位奶牛女郎撑破上衣的插图。 [var0 |外面的守卫熟稔地朝你点了点头。 |不过看起来它还没有开放，你得晚些时候再来吧。 ] |出于好奇，你沿着道路继续前行，途中注意到在一片长满草的田野中有一座看起来像木制谷仓的建筑。当你走近一些后，才发现这座建筑不仅确实是一座谷仓，而且它并不是用来养动物的——它的用途其实是给人用的。 挤奶棚！ 这是国王根据法令为民众提供的一项公共服务。 外面的招牌就是这么写的，上面还大胆地描绘了一名奶牛女郎的胸部从上衣中凸了出来。其实，这个画得还挺不错的。[party.has brint | “我们这里可不太讲究委婉，”布林特说，“可能会让你有点文化冲击，之类的吧。” “嗯，别担心。从我们见面的那一刻起，我就看出来了。”你说道。 “不用谢我，”他一边说，一边活动着手臂。 ][party.has brienne | “在科尔米诺斯，我们可不太讲究委婉表达，”布蕾妮说着瞥了你一眼，“以防你还没看出来。” “是啊，这里可没有什么文化冲击——我是向最优秀的人学习的，”你回答道。 “哎呀，你太客气了，”她微笑着说道。 ] [var0 |大门外站着几名士兵，你走近时他们朝你点了点头。“你好啊。是来挤奶棚的吗？” “当然，”你说道，“这里是怎么运作的？” “呃，本来我可以给你从头到尾讲一遍，但我在这儿站了有一会儿了，所以就给你简单说说吧，”第一名守卫说着，回头朝那栋建筑点了点头。“进去之后，你可以给一些姑娘挤奶，也可以让别人给你挤。我们有一些专门培育的植物来干这活儿，或者你可以找服务员——她们都是女人。要是你想的话，找一名守卫也行。” “我们不介意，”另一名守卫点头说道。 [pc.isBimbo |“你真是太大方了！” |“真是慷慨，” ]你说道。 “嘿，队长让我守挤奶棚，我就守挤奶棚，”士兵耸了耸肩说道，“总比待在贫民区强。反正你不用付钱，招牌上说了，这是公共服务。把这设施设在这儿也花不了我们多少钱，而且我们有时候还卖牛奶。这制度不错。” |看来今晚它已经关门了。你得晚些时候再来吧。 ] ]

rows.original: Leave the city behind and head back to the Outskirts, the surrounding territories of Khor'minos.
rows.translation: 离开这座城市，回到科尔米诺斯的周边地区吧。
rows.raw: "Leave the city behind and head back to the Outskirts, the surrounding territories of Khor'minos."

rows.original: Crowds swirl around you in every direction, horned minotaurs traveling this way and that. It looks like all the men are being careful about what their horns might come in contact with.[flags.KMMS_B6 |The struggle of being a [pc.ra minotaur |minotaur. You've come to understand it well — this does feel a bit more like home, now... |tall race with horns. No wonder they like it here with everything built to size. ] |[party.has brint | "Good thing I've hardly got to deal with that any more, eh?" Brint quips. "These buildings are huge," you remark, looking up and down the central street. "That entrance must be twelve feet high." "Yep," he says. "Gotta make allowances for those of us unlucky enough to have horns pointing straight up, y'know. Man, that's underrated. Bumping my head on every doorframe sucked.[pc.heightRange 0 96 | | Prolly gonna be ducking through every door just out of habit for a while. ]" [pc.heightRange 0 96 |"I'll bet," you say, glancing up at him. |"Tell me about it," you grouse. "I'll be glad to not have to duck while I'm here." ] ][party.has brienne | "Haha, good thing I don't have to bother with that any more," Brienne says, smiling. "These buildings are huge," you remark, looking up and down the central street. "That entrance must be twelve feet high." "Oh yeah. If you're unlucky enough that your horns grow straight up you're gonna be bumping your head a lot if you venture outside of Khor'minos. In some places you have to almost crawl through doors," she says, shaking her head.[pc.heightRange 0 96 | | "I'm not even that badly off and I'll probably still be ducking through doorways out of habit for a while." ] [pc.heightRange 0 96 |"I'll bet," you say, glancing up at her. |"Tell me about it," you grouse. "I'll be glad to not have to duck while I'm here." ] ][party.has brint brienne | | You suppose walking around like that must be common. ] ] There's an inn here — "The Wild Stallion." There's a silhouette of the horse's head on the sign. It's seen better days. Actually, the text is pretty close to illegible. [flags.KMINN_ROSE |Maybe you should tell Rose about that sometime. |It does seem loud and lively inside, though. ]
rows.translation: 人群从四面八方涌向你，那些长着角的弥诺陶洛斯也在四处穿梭。看起来，所有的人都在小心翼翼地避免让自己的角碰到什么东西。[flags.KMMS_B6 |成为……所经历的种种挣扎[pc.ra minotaur |弥诺陶洛斯……你已经很好地理解了它——这个确实现在，这里感觉更像家了…… |高大的有角的生物。难怪它们喜欢这里，因为这里的一切都是按照它们的体型来设计的。 ] |[party.has brint | 还好我现在几乎不用再处理那种麻烦事了，对吧？”布林特开玩笑地说。 “这些建筑物真是大得惊人，”你一边说，一边上下打量着中央大街，“那个入口肯定有十二英尺高吧。” “没错，”他说，“毕竟我们当中有些人运气不好，头上长着直直的角，所以这些设计也是不得已而为之的。说真的，这种设计其实被严重低估了——每次撞到门框都真是太难受了。[pc.heightRange 0 96 | | 可能一时还会出于习惯，习惯性地穿过每一扇门吧。 ]" [pc.heightRange 0 96 |我敢打赌，”你说道，同时抬头看着他。 |你说得对，”你抱怨道，“在这里的话，我就不用总是躲来躲去了，真是太好了。 ] ][party.has brienne | 哈哈，幸好我再也不用操心那种事了，”布蕾妮笑着说。 “这些建筑物真是大得惊人，”你一边说着，一边上下打量着中央街道。“那个入口肯定有十二英尺高吧。” “哦，没错。要是你运气不好，角长得笔直向上，那你每次进门的时候肯定都会撞到头很多如果你敢离开科尔米诺斯，有些地方你甚至得爬着才能通过门，”她一边说，一边摇头。[pc.heightRange 0 96 | | 我的经济状况其实也没那么糟糕，不过出于习惯，可能还会有一段时间继续从门缝中挤过去。 ] [pc.heightRange 0 96 |我敢打赌，”你说道，同时抬头看了她一眼。 |你倒是说说看，”你抱怨道，“在这里的话，至少我不用总是躲来躲去，这倒也算是件好事。 ] ][party.has brint brienne | | 你大概觉得，这样四处走动应该是很平常的事吧。 ] ] 这里有家客栈，名叫“野马客栈”。招牌上还有马头的图案，不过现在看起来已经有些破旧了。其实，那些字迹已经几乎无法辨认了。 [flags.KMINN_ROSE |也许你应该找个机会把这件事告诉罗斯。 |不过，里面的确显得很热闹、很充满活力。 ]
