rows.original:
[flags.VIXEN_ARCANE
        |The interior of the Arcane Arsenal is filled to the brim with all manner of occultic esoterica: enchanted gems, staves, wands, spellbooks, and minoan-crafted clothing stitched with magical patterns of warding. Even the walls are patterned with frescos of mystical symbols and wizened mages performing mysterious rites. It's all exactly what you'd expect from a mage's shop in the big city, as much flash as substance.
        
        [km.isCorrupted
            |Nieves grumbles, shoving a cowgirl apprentice out from under her counter as she takes note of you.
            
            "Hey there," she says, awkwardly adjusting her robes. "What can I interest you in today?"
            |Nieves gives you a slight nod. "Let me know if anything piques your interest."
        ]
        |The inside of the mage's emporium is everything you'd expect from a downtown wizard's storefront: it's darkly-lit and covered from the floor to the ceiling in mystical patterns. Frescos of aged sages adorn the walls, depicting all manner of arcane rites. [pc.isMage
            |At a glance, these mostly look like simple wardings: maybe the owner's worried about her shop exploding?
            |How exciting!
        ] There are racks of staves, wands, and other implements of magic, as well as display cases full of enchanted focus-stones and spellbooks, all arranged in a circle leading to the main counter.
        
        Behind the counter stands a tall, well-built woman wearing leather-reinforced robes in the same colors as the Khor'minoan legions. A black-lipped muzzle and perky fox-ears set this lady apart from most of the women in the city, though, and as you take her in you realize that what at a distance seemed like trimming on her armor is very much just a full-body covering of silky red and white fur. 
        
        [party.has kiyoko
            |Your own fox-wife bristles, only for a moment, before subtly recomposing herself. Nobody but you'd likely even notice the slight twitch. Kiyoko whispers softly, "Ah, a vulperine. How quaint. I was under the impression her kind all lived far south of here."
            
            "No, my lady kitsune," the shopkeep says, ears swiveling. "There're tribes of boreal vulperines all across the western Marches, past the Greyvales. But I came from the southern coast, yes."
        ]
        
        "Greetings," she says, inclining her head. The fox-woman's Belharan lilts with a suppressed Heartlander accent. "Welcome to the arsenal. I am Nieves, the proprietrix, former auxiliary war-mage to the Royal Legions. Everything you see here, I've collected over twenty years of service to the crown or made myself. [pc.isMage
            |You seem like a [pc.manWoman] that knows what [pc.heShe]'s looking at. Let me know if there's anything specific you need. There's never been a better time to learn war-magic than when the city's veritably under siege.
            |You don't strike me as a student of the occult, but there's never been a better time to start the road to mastery than now. Or just invest in some armor that's proofed against spells.
        ]"
    ]
rows.translation:
[flags.VIXEN_ARCANE
        |神秘军火库的内部摆满了各种各样神秘的物品：被施了魔法的宝石、法杖、魔杖、咒语书，还有用米诺斯工艺制作的、缝有防护魔法的图案的衣物。就连墙壁上也绘满了神秘符号的壁画，以及那些年迈的法师们正在进行神秘仪式的场景。这一切，都完全符合你对大城市中法师商店的想象——既有华丽的外表，也有实质性的内容。
        
        [km.isCorrupted
            |妮维丝哼了一声，把一位女牛仔学徒从她的柜台下推了出来，同时注意到了你的存在。
            
            “嘿，”她说，有些尴尬地调整着自己的长袍，“今天有什么我可以帮您的吗？
            |妮维丝微微点了点头：“如果有什么让你感兴趣的内容，一定要告诉我。
        ]
        |这位法师的商店内部，完全符合你对市中心巫师店铺的预期：光线昏暗，从地面到天花板都装饰着各种神秘的图案。墙壁上绘有古代贤者的壁画，描绘着各式各样的神秘仪式。 [pc.isMage
            |乍一看，这些似乎都只是简单的防护措施罢了：也许店主是担心自己的店铺会发生爆炸吧？
            |太令人兴奋了！
        ]那里摆满了各种法杖、魔杖以及其他魔法道具，还有一些陈列柜，里面装满了被施了魔法的集中注意力宝石和法术书，所有这些物品都被整齐地排列成一圈，通向主柜台。
        
        在柜台后面，站着一位身材高挑、体格健壮的女性，她穿着与科尔米诺军团相同的颜色、用皮革加固制成的长袍。她那黑色的嘴唇、翘起的狐妖耳让这位女士与城中的大多数女性截然不同。当你仔细观察她时，会发现那些从远处看似乎只是她盔甲上的装饰，实际上却是由丝绒般的红白毛皮制成的全身覆盖物。 
        
        [party.has kiyoko
            |你自己的狐狸妻子只是微微一愣，随即又恢复了平静。除了你，恐怕没人会注意到那细微的颤动。清子轻声说道：“啊，一只狐狸啊……真是有趣。我原以为这种动物都生活在更南边的地方呢。”
            
            “不，我的狐娘子，”店主说道，耳朵不停地转动着，“其实在整个西部边境地区，包括灰谷地带之外，都生活着一些北方狐狸部落。不过我确实来自南部海岸。
        ]
        
        欢迎来到这里，”她微微低头说道。这位狐妖女子的贝尔哈兰口音中带着一丝压抑的赫特兰德腔调。“我是妮薇丝，这里的主人，也曾担任皇家军团的辅助战法师。你们在这里看到的所有东西，都是我在为王室服务了二十年期间收集而来的，或者是我亲手制作出来的。 [pc.isMage
            |你看起来真像[pc.manWoman]谁知道呢[pc.heShe]让我看看有哪些资源可供选择。如果你有特别需要的内容，请告诉我。当城市真正处于被围困的状态时，正是学习战魔法的最佳时机。
            |你给人的感觉并不像是个研究神秘学的人，但现在正是开始掌握这些知识的最佳时机。或者，干脆买一些能够抵御法术的盔甲吧。
        ]"
    ]
rows.raw:
"
    [flags.VIXEN_ARCANE
        |The interior of the Arcane Arsenal is filled to the brim with all manner of occultic esoterica: enchanted gems, staves, wands, spellbooks, and minoan-crafted clothing stitched with magical patterns of warding. Even the walls are patterned with frescos of mystical symbols and wizened mages performing mysterious rites. It's all exactly what you'd expect from a mage's shop in the big city, as much flash as substance.
        
        [km.isCorrupted
            |Nieves grumbles, shoving a cowgirl apprentice out from under her counter as she takes note of you.
            
            "Hey there," she says, awkwardly adjusting her robes. "What can I interest you in today?"
            |Nieves gives you a slight nod. "Let me know if anything piques your interest."
        ]
        |The inside of the mage's emporium is everything you'd expect from a downtown wizard's storefront: it's darkly-lit and covered from the floor to the ceiling in mystical patterns. Frescos of aged sages adorn the walls, depicting all manner of arcane rites. [pc.isMage
            |At a glance, these mostly look like simple wardings: maybe the owner's worried about her shop exploding?
            |How exciting!
        ] There are racks of staves, wands, and other implements of magic, as well as display cases full of enchanted focus-stones and spellbooks, all arranged in a circle leading to the main counter.
        
        Behind the counter stands a tall, well-built woman wearing leather-reinforced robes in the same colors as the Khor'minoan legions. A black-lipped muzzle and perky fox-ears set this lady apart from most of the women in the city, though, and as you take her in you realize that what at a distance seemed like trimming on her armor is very much just a full-body covering of silky red and white fur. 
        
        [party.has kiyoko
            |Your own fox-wife bristles, only for a moment, before subtly recomposing herself. Nobody but you'd likely even notice the slight twitch. Kiyoko whispers softly, "Ah, a vulperine. How quaint. I was under the impression her kind all lived far south of here."
            
            "No, my lady kitsune," the shopkeep says, ears swiveling. "There're tribes of boreal vulperines all across the western Marches, past the Greyvales. But I came from the southern coast, yes."
        ]
        
        "Greetings," she says, inclining her head. The fox-woman's Belharan lilts with a suppressed Heartlander accent. "Welcome to the arsenal. I am Nieves, the proprietrix, former auxiliary war-mage to the Royal Legions. Everything you see here, I've collected over twenty years of service to the crown or made myself. [pc.isMage
            |You seem like a [pc.manWoman] that knows what [pc.heShe]'s looking at. Let me know if there's anything specific you need. There's never been a better time to learn war-magic than when the city's veritably under siege.
            |You don't strike me as a student of the occult, but there's never been a better time to start the road to mastery than now. Or just invest in some armor that's proofed against spells.
        ]"
    ]
    "

rows.original: See what the minotaur minstrel has to stay.
rows.translation: 来看看这个弥诺陶洛斯的吟游诗人要讲述什么故事吧。
rows.raw: "See what the minotaur minstrel has to stay."

rows.original: Step up to the bar and have a chat with it's top-heavy tender.
rows.translation: 走到吧台前，和那位胸部丰满的酒保聊聊天吧。
rows.raw: "Step up to the bar and have a chat with it's top-heavy tender."

rows.original: [serena.met|Serena's [serena.relationshipRange 1 2|always happy to see you|looking as lovely as ever|probably up for spending some more time with you].|The cowgirl with the books seems like she'd love to meet you.]
rows.translation: [serena.met|塞蕾娜的[serena.relationshipRange 1 2|总是很高兴见到你|依然美丽如初|大概很愿意再花一些时间和你在一起吧]。|那个拿着书的牛仔女孩似乎很想见见你。]
rows.raw: "[serena.met|Serena's [serena.relationshipRange 1 2|always happy to see you|looking as lovely as ever|probably up for spending some more time with you].|The cowgirl with the books seems like she'd love to meet you.]"

rows.translation: 请继续关注塞蕾娜的动态吧。

rows.original: Go and talk to the Minoan princess.
rows.translation: 去和米诺斯公主谈谈吧。
rows.raw: "Go and talk to the Minoan princess."

rows.original: Go take a look at the salamander lady.
rows.translation: 去看看那位火蜥蜴人女士吧。
rows.raw: "Go take a look at the salamander lady."

rows.original: Livrea and Varena are probably lurking around here somewhere...
rows.translation: 莉维娅和瓦蕾娜应该就在附近的某个地方……
rows.raw: "Livrea and Varena are probably lurking around here somewhere..."

rows.original: Go over and see if the energetic shortstack is home.
rows.translation: 去看看那个精力充沛的小个子在不在家吧。
rows.raw: "Go over and see if the energetic shortstack is home."

rows.original: Take the long, dark tunnel to the Coastlands.
rows.translation: 穿过那条漫长而暗影的隧道，就能到达海岸之地。
rows.raw: "Take the long, dark tunnel to the Coastlands."

rows.original: Noise fills the air from the moment you enter, raucous soldiers and bar-goers all but outright partying atop the tables. [pc.bg soldier |You do remember the shit your troop would get up to during peacetime back when you were in but it was nothing quite like... well, no, that's not entirely true... |It looks like everyone is getting along smashingly, though there's definitely an incentive to be friendly when you've got a bunch of legionnaires sat inside. Any disturbance is going to be put down posthaste. ]
rows.translation: 你一走进去，空气中就充满了嘈杂的声音——喧闹的士兵们和酒吧里的顾客们几乎都在桌子上开起了派对。 [pc.bg soldier |你确实还记得你们在军队里的时候，和平时期那些士兵们会干出些什么蠢事吧？不过那些跟现在的情况完全没法比……嗯，其实也不完全是这样…… |看起来大家相处得都非常融洽，不过当有一群士兵围在身边时，保持友好态度当然是理所当然的。任何扰乱秩序的行为都会被迅速制止。 ]
rows.raw: " Noise fills the air from the moment you enter, raucous soldiers and bar-goers all but outright partying atop the tables. [pc.bg soldier |You do remember the shit your troop would get up to during peacetime back when you were in but it was nothing quite like... well, no, that's not entirely true... |It looks like everyone is getting along smashingly, though there's definitely an incentive to be friendly when you've got a bunch of legionnaires sat inside. Any disturbance is going to be put down posthaste. ] "

rows.original: Oh wow, there's so many minotaur men! And they're all so fucking hot!
rows.translation: 哦，哇，这里有这么多弥诺陶洛斯男性！而且他们全都他妈的热辣！
rows.raw: "Oh wow, there's so many minotaur men! And they're all so fucking hot!"

rows.original: [flags.KATYA_MET|Go chat with [silly|Kat the cat|Katya].|There's a cute, blonde catgirl sitting alone at the bar. Maybe she's up for a conversation?]
rows.translation: [flags.KATYA_MET|去和[silly|猫咪小卡|卡蒂亚]聊聊。|吧台旁独自坐着一位可爱的金发猫娘。也许她愿意聊聊天？]
rows.raw: "[flags.KATYA_MET|Go chat with [silly|Kat the cat|Katya].|There's a cute, blonde catgirl sitting alone at the bar. Maybe she's up for a conversation?]"

rows.original: Katya's still resting from your last bout. Maybe give her some time to recuperate?
rows.translation: 卡蒂亚还在从你上次的游戏活动中恢复中。或许应该给她一些时间来调养身体吧？
rows.raw: "Katya's still resting from your last bout. Maybe give her some time to recuperate?"

rows.original: Head up to your room and get some shuteye.
rows.translation: 去你的房间休息吧，睡一会儿。
rows.raw: "Head up to your room and get some shuteye."

rows.original: You can't sleep here without buying a room — unless you're in someone else's bed.
rows.translation: 不买一间房，你就不能在这里睡觉——除非你睡在别人的床上。
rows.raw: "You can't sleep here without buying a room — unless you're in someone else's bed."

rows.original:
[flags.KMINN_ROSE
        |"Hey Rose," you say, [var0
            |winking at the cowgirl. "Doing okay?"
            
            "Hi [pc.name]," she says, smiling. "I'm alright."
            |nodding at the cowgirl. "Doing okay?"
            
            "Treading water," she says, giving you a weary smile.
        ]
        |There's a cowgirl at the counter polishing a glass and eyeing the drinks across the tables. She gives you a casual nod as you approach, glancing your way once and then taking more notice.
        
        "Hey there, you an adventurer?" she asks.
        
        "Sure am," you say. "Just walked into town. I'm [pc.name]."
        
        "Great," she says, smiling. "Anything but another soldier. I'm Rose. What can I do for you? We've got rooms and drinks."
    ]
rows.translation:
[flags.KMINN_ROSE
        |“嘿，萝丝，”你说道，[var0
            |对着那位女牛仔眨了眨眼。“最近过得怎么样？”
            
            “嗨，[pc.name]，”她微笑着说，“我挺好的。”
            |朝那位女牛仔点了点头。“最近过得怎么样？”
            
            “还撑得住，”她说着，露出一个疲惫的微笑。
        ]
        |柜台边有个女牛仔正在擦着杯子，目光扫过各桌上的酒水。你走近时，她随意地朝你点了点头，瞥了你一眼，随后便多加了几分留意。
        
        “嘿，你是冒险者吗？”她问道。
        
        “没错，”你说，“我刚进镇子。我叫[pc.name]。”
        
        “太好了，”她微笑着说，“只要别又是士兵就好。我叫萝丝。有什么能为你效劳的吗？我们这儿有房间，也有酒水。”
    ]

rows.original: Rose looks like she isn't too busy.
rows.translation: 萝丝看起来并没有太忙。
rows.raw: "Rose looks like she isn't too busy."

rows.original: Rose looks too busy to talk
rows.translation: 萝丝看起来太忙了，没时间聊天

rows.original: See if Rose needs any more help with her problem.
rows.translation: 看看萝丝在解决她的问题时是否还需要更多的帮助。
rows.raw: "See if Rose needs any more help with her problem."

rows.original: You've taken care of Rose's needs... for the night, at least.
rows.translation: 你已经满足了萝丝的需求……至少是今晚而已。
rows.raw: "You've taken care of Rose's needs... for the night, at least."

rows.original: It's still too busy to possibly pull Rose away from the bar. The late hours of night and early hours of the morning seem to be your best bet...
rows.translation: 现在实在太忙了，根本不可能把萝丝从酒吧里拉出来。晚上晚些时候或者清晨似乎才是最好的时机……
rows.raw: "It's still too busy to possibly pull Rose away from the bar. The late hours of night and early hours of the morning seem to be your best bet..."

rows.original:
"I need a few rooms for me and my companions," you say. "Probably a month long stay, but maybe longer."
    
    "Well, we'll figure the extension out later," Rose says. "Three rooms for a month is 900 EC."
rows.translation:
我需要几间房间，供我和我的同伴使用，”你说，“大概需要住一个月，不过也可能更久。”
    
    “嗯，延长期限的事情我们稍后再商量，”罗斯说，“三间房间住一个月的话，费用是900艾克。
rows.raw:
'
    "I need a few rooms for me and my companions," you say. "Probably a month long stay, but maybe longer."
    
    "Well, we'll figure the extension out later," Rose says. "Three rooms for a month is 900 EC."
    '

rows.original:
"Great," Rose says. "You can have the three down the end. Don't worry about the noise, it doesn't carry much."
        
        You have your doubts, looking over the tables here, but maybe she's right. Ah well, as long as you can get some sleep. You thank her and step away from the bar.
rows.translation:
“太好了，”萝丝说，“靠里那三间房归你了。别担心噪音的问题，这里的声音传得并不远。”
        
        你看着这些桌子，心里还是有些疑虑，但也许她是对的。算了，只要能睡个好觉就行。你向她道了谢，从吧台边走开。
rows.raw:
'
        "Great," Rose says. "You can have the three down the end. Don't worry about the noise, it doesn't carry much."
        
        You have your doubts, looking over the tables here, but maybe she's right. Ah well, as long as you can get some sleep. You thank her and step away from the bar.
        '

rows.original: You don't have that much on you.
rows.translation: 你身上并没有带那么多东西。
rows.raw: "You don't have that much on you."

rows.original:
"Thanks for letting me know. I might shop around the city a bit," you say.
        
        Rose nods. "It might be tough getting a spot depending where you go with the army being cooped up here. Good luck."
        
        You nod and step away from the bar.
rows.translation:
“谢谢你的提醒。我可能会在城里四处逛逛看看。”你说道。
        
        萝丝点了点头：“不过考虑到军队现在都被关在这里，你可能很难找到住处。祝你好运。”
        
        你点了点头，从吧台边走开。
rows.raw:
'
        "Thanks for letting me know. I might shop around the city a bit," you say.
        
        Rose nods. "It might be tough getting a spot depending where you go with the army being cooped up here. Good luck."
        
        You nod and step away from the bar.
        '

rows.original: Maybe you won't go for rooms right now.
rows.translation: 也许你现在还不想考虑租房间的事情。
rows.raw: "Maybe you won't go for rooms right now."

rows.original:
"Isn't that a little steep?" you say.
        
        Rose grimaces. "Well, yeah. The problem is that food prices have gone up during the quarantine... and that we have to house soldiers with promise of a later payment from the king. So that leaves all of our actual customers stuck with the costs." She sighs. "On the bright side, no shortage of people looking to work here... so, want the rooms?"
        
        "Any chance we're going to be kicked out to make room for more soldiers?" you ask.
        
        She shakes her head. "Every soldier is already back in the city, far as I know. Not like there's going to be more of them showing up. They're all spread out in the inns and the barracks. I think the owner'd fight them himself if more came through wanting to switch inns. So no, don't worry about it."
rows.translation:
“这个价格是不是有点太高了？”你说道。
        
        萝丝皱了皱眉头：“嗯，确实是这样。问题在于，在隔离期间食品价格上涨了……而且我们还得为那些士兵提供住宿，而这些士兵的费用则要等国王以后再支付。这样一来，被迫承担这些费用的反倒是我们所有真正的顾客了。”她叹了口气，“不过从好的方面来看，想要在这里工作的人其实很多……那么，这些房间还卖不卖？”
        
        “有没有可能我们会被赶走，以便为更多的士兵腾出空间呢？”你问道。
        
        她摇了摇头：“据我所知，所有士兵都已经回到了城里。应该不会再有新的士兵出现了。他们都被安排在各个客栈和营房里住着。我想，要是再有人想换住处过来，客栈老板自己都会跟他们动手的。所以，别担心这个事情。”
rows.raw:
'
        "Isn't that a little steep?" you say.
        
        Rose grimaces. "Well, yeah. The problem is that food prices have gone up during the quarantine... and that we have to house soldiers with promise of a later payment from the king. So that leaves all of our actual customers stuck with the costs." She sighs. "On the bright side, no shortage of people looking to work here... so, want the rooms?"
        
        "Any chance we're going to be kicked out to make room for more soldiers?" you ask.
        
        She shakes her head. "Every soldier is already back in the city, far as I know. Not like there's going to be more of them showing up. They're all spread out in the inns and the barracks. I think the owner'd fight them himself if more came through wanting to switch inns. So no, don't worry about it."
        '

rows.original: That seems a little expensive for three rooms for a month.
rows.translation: 租一个月要这个价，感觉有点太贵了。
rows.raw: "That seems a little expensive for three rooms for a month."

rows.original:
"What've you got on tap?" you ask.
    
    "Few different meads, a whole bunch of beer and some wines," Rose says. "We've got a few different suppliers. Take your pick."
rows.translation:
“你们准备了些什么饮料？”你问道。
    
    “有几种不同的蜂蜜酒，还有很多啤酒和葡萄酒，”萝丝说，“我们找了几家不同的供应商，你可以随意挑选。”
rows.raw:
'
    "What've you got on tap?" you ask.
    
    "Few different meads, a whole bunch of beer and some wines," Rose says. "We've got a few different suppliers. Take your pick."
    '

rows.original: Get some honeyed alcohol. Sweet and easy, a favored drink among rank-and-file soldiers. Maximizes Cunning.
rows.translation: 弄一些甜酒来吧。这种酒味道甜美，饮用起来也很方便，深受普通士兵的喜爱。 最大限度地发挥机敏与机智。
rows.raw: "Get some honeyed alcohol. Sweet and easy, a favored drink among rank-and-file soldiers.\n\nMaximizes Cunning."

rows.original: The undiscerning adventurer's choice of drink. Served in every inn from here to Yvennes, or so they say. Every region's got their own spin on it. Maximizes Willpower.
rows.translation: 那位缺乏品味的冒险者选择的饮品。据说，从这里到伊薇恩的每一家酒馆都会提供这种饮品。不过，每个地区都会根据自己的风格对它进行一些改良。 最大化意志力。
rows.raw: "The undiscerning adventurer's choice of drink. Served in every inn from here to Yvennes, or so they say. Every region's got their own spin on it.\n\nMaximizes Willpower."

rows.original: Pick a random beer from their selection — there's certainly enough of them. They don't all taste the same, but you've got a pretty good idea of what you'll be getting. Maximizes Strength.

rows.original: It's a long, long time before you rouse yourself from your party bed, noting dimly that it's yawing to one side. You pat the sheets, still damp from the rigors of last night. It did its best. You rejoin the general crowd downstairs, winking at some of the men you recognize from earlier. "Ordinarily I'd bill you for stabbing a spear through the floor... but we made enough money to cover that and then some what with all the drinking during and after the show," Rose says as you approach the bar. She shakes her head and sighs. "Just be careful and don't put it through someone's foot the next time you try that stunt, okay?" "Of course! Stabbing people is mean," you say. "And dumb, if they're friends." "I'm glad you understand that much," she says. You lean in and give her a kiss on the cheek for being cute. "Just don't hurt yourself." "Aw, I wouldn't," you say, smiling. "I'm an adventurer, silly! We only hurt other people." Rose rolls her eyes. "Great. Here's a beer. Stay out of trouble for a few minutes, will you?" "I promise nothing!" you say, drumming your fingers across the bartop until the beer's put in front of you. "Well, maybe I can do a few minutes." "I thought so," Rose says.

rows.original: Oh, those are some stories you know how to tell. With your cowgirl acquaintance's full attention, you briefly sketch some of the adventures that led you into the Frost Marches, then begin your tale of Champions and demons, elves and minotaurs. At this point, you're getting pretty good at it — and pretty good at knowing what to keep in and what to leave out. For her part, Serena seems entranced, asking questions occasionally and expressing sympathy from time to time, but mostly just sitting there and propping her head on her hands as you speak. When you're finished, she sighs, "Wow. It really is still the Age of Heroes, huh? Just like in the classics. That's crazy... I hope you stay safe out there, [pc.name]. At least, stay as safe as you can while you do the, uh, the things you do. I've family in the legion, and I worry about them endlessly; now I've got [party.sizeText] more to worry about, too." [pc.dcb |Eh. You take donations, if that's how she [silly |rolls |does things ]. But honestly, better her than you for the 'stay put and deal with a flock of children' job. |She's sweet to be concerned, but while adventuring's never easy, you imagine handling eleven students isn't, either. |Ohhhh, what a sweetheart! You give the surprised — and delighted — moogirl a big ol' hug. You're sure you'll be fine, but what about her? She's gotta handle a bunch of kids! ] "Oh, they're not much by comparison. I mean, they feel like it sometimes, and gods does this job take so much of your time, but that's not Hero[pc.mf | |ine ] Stuff. All I'm doing is going over things on my day off..." Her eyes widen. "Shit, I think I stayed down here too long. I need to [dayNight |finish up the lesson for |get some rest before ] tomorrow. Look, I have to go, but it was lovely to meet you! And if you want to meet up again, share a drink, chat, whatever, I'll be around tomorrow in the afternoon or evening." [pc.isBimbo |You'll remember for sure! |Fair enough. ] Good luck with the students[pc.isBimbo |! |. ] "Thanks! And good luck with being an adventurer. Take care, okay?" She finishes what's left of her drink, gathers up the scrolls and books with impressive speed, then flashes you a broad smile before making her way upstairs. Sounds like Serena will be around the tavern from 13:00 to midnight, starting tomorrow, if you want to spend time with her again.
rows.translation: 哦，你真会讲故事啊。在你的那位女牛仔朋友的专注聆听下，你简要地讲述了一些让你踏入霜冻荒原的冒险经历，然后开始讲述关于英雄与恶魔、精灵与弥诺陶洛斯的故事。现在，你已经做得相当不错了——也越来越懂得该保留哪些内容，该省略哪些内容。 至于塞蕾娜，她似乎完全被吸引住了，偶尔会提出一些问题，也会时不时表达出同情，但大多数时间里，她只是坐在那里，双手托着头，静静地听你讲话。当你完成后，她叹了口气说道：“哇，果然还是那个英雄的时代啊，就像经典游戏里描述的那样。真是太不可思议了……希望你在外面的世界能够平安无事。 [pc.name]至少，在做那些事情的时候，要尽可能保证自己的安全。我的家人也在军团里，我无时无刻不在为他们担心……现在，我终于可以放心一些了。 [party.sizeText]还有更多需要担心的事情呢。 [pc.dcb |呃，如果你接受捐赠的话，那她也是这么做的吧。 [silly |翻滚 |采取行动 ]但说实话，对于这个“待在原地并照顾一群孩子”的任务来说，她比你更适合。 |她关心别人，这份心意确实很贴心。不过，冒险本来就不是件容易的事，更何况还要照顾十一个学生，这肯定更加不容易吧。 |哦哦哦，真是个贴心的人啊！你给了那个既惊讶又高兴的蘑菇女孩一个大大的拥抱。你觉得自己肯定没问题，但她呢？她可是要照顾一群孩子的啊！ ] 哦，相比之下，它们实在算不上什么。我的意思是，它们感受到有时候我也挺喜欢这样做的，不过天啊，这份工作真的占用了你太多时间……不过，这毕竟不是英雄该做的。[pc.mf | | ]没什么啦。我休息日的时候就是在复习一些东西而已……”她的眼睛突然瞪大了，“该死，我觉得我在这里待得太久了。我得走了[dayNight |完成这一课的学习吧。 |先休息一会儿吧。 ]明天见。听着，我得走了，但能遇见你真是太开心了！如果你想再见面，一起喝点东西、聊聊天什么的，明天下午或晚上我都有空。 [pc.isBimbo |你一定会记住的！ |有道理。 ]祝你在与这些学生的相处中一切顺利。[pc.isBimbo |！ |。 ] 谢谢！祝你在冒险的道路上一切顺利。保重哦？”她喝完了剩下的酒，以惊人的速度收拾起那些卷轴和书籍，然后向你露出了灿烂的笑容，接着便上楼去了。 看来塞蕾娜应该还会经常来这个酒馆吧。从明天开始，每天下午13:00到午夜。如果你想再和她一起度过时光的话。

rows.original:
This time, Serena's not just smiling, but outright beaming as you approach. "Ay-ah, [pc.name]! Good to see you safe and[var0
        | reasonably
        |
    ] healthy!"
    
    [pc.isBimbo
        |Hey, cutie moo! I
        |Well met[pc.isDK
            | and all that
        ]; i
    ]t's nice to see her, too. How's the teaching thing going?
    
    "Oh, you know. Controlled chaos. Keep things too regimented and strict, and the kiddos don't make those wonderful off-script moments that make the day more bearable — and also help them learn so much better. But loosen the reins too much, and you'll never get some of them to learn anything at all." Her long hair sways from side to side as she shakes her head. "But we're getting through the days, we're staying safe, and they're picking things up, which is most of what I can ask for! What about you?"
    
    [pc.dcb
        |Eh. Kind of the same, but chaos is a ladder as far as adventurers are concerned.
        |Not too differently. Controlled chaos isn't too far away from the ideal state of an adventurer, too, come to think of it.
        |Ummm, kinda samesies! There's a lot goin' on and it's suuuper hard to remember it all. But it's also been a lot of fun!
    ]
    
    "I never thought about it that way, but it makes sense. Especially given how often the heroes in all the classics talk about luck and fate's whim — that's why they pray to Tira, after all![pc.isSoulbound
        | Although [pc.patron]'s pretty good at that sort of thing, too, of course.
    ]" Her hand goes right back to the old resting position underneath her chin. "Sorry again for having to leave so suddenly last time."
    
    [pc.dcbc
        |Shit happens. She's not gonna run off again this time, is she?
        
        "Not planning on it!" she laughs. "I'd love to just relax and have a chat, get to know you a little better. What do you say?"
        |No worries. Does she have more time to chat [dayNight
            |today
            |this evening
        ] than she did last time?
        
        "That I do! I'd love to just nurse this drink, relax, maybe trade some stories. Sound like a good time to you?"
        |Aww, that's okay! Is she gonna be able to stay this time?
        
        "I hope so, sweetie," she giggles. "Let's just chat and see where this goes!"
        |Oh, you suppose you can forgive her for that. It wasn't too bad — you found other ways to amoose yourself after she left.
        
        "Oh, gods..." she sighs, laughing that indulgent laugh of someone who's just been [silly
            |got
            |had
        ] and knows it. "A punner."
        
        Hey, you only just arrived in Khor'minos; you have to milk all these jokes for everything they're worth. This is a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity for a surfacer like you, and you're going to take it by the horns.
        
        Serena shakes her head, still laughing despite herself. "Those ones hurt. Actual, physical pain stabbing into me."
        
        Okay, okay, you'll stop. You wouldn't want to let a little beef come between you.
        
        "If you wield weapons half that deadly against the demons, the city's going to be safe in no time," she chuckles. "Why don't we just sit and chat for a while? Hopefully with fewer cow puns."
    ]
    
    Anything in particular you want to ask the cheerful teacher?

这次，当你靠近时，塞蕾娜不仅仅是在微笑，而是满脸灿烂地笑着。“哎呀[pc.name]很高兴看到你平安无事。[var0
        | 合理地

    ]身体健康！
    
    [pc.isBimbo
        |嘿，可爱的小牛！我……
        |幸会。[pc.isDK
            | 等等诸如此类的事情
        ]; i
    ]见到她也很高兴。她的教学工作进展得怎么样？

“哦，你也知道吧，就是那种‘有控制的混乱’。如果教学过程过于刻板严格，孩子们就不会产生那些让一天变得有趣、也能帮助他们更好地学习的即兴时刻了。但是如果放松对他们的约束，那么他们中的一些人就永远学不到任何东西了。”她摇着头，长长的头发随之左右摆动。“不过我们总算一天天熬了过来，也保证了自己的安全，而他们也在逐渐掌握一些东西，这已经是我能要求的全部了！你呢？
    
    [pc.dcb
        |嗯，差不多吧。但对冒险者来说，混乱其实就是一条通往成功的阶梯。
        |其实也没太大区别。仔细想想，这种“受控制的混乱”其实也非常接近冒险者所追求的理想状态。
        |嗯，有点类似吧！发生的事情太多了，真的很难记住所有细节。不过，整个过程也确实非常有趣！
    ]
    
    我以前从未从这个角度思考过，但确实有道理。尤其是考虑到在所有这些经典故事中，英雄们总是频繁地提到运气和命运的捉弄——毕竟，他们才会向蒂拉祈祷啊！[pc.isSoulbound
        | 虽然[pc.patron]当然，他在那种事情上也相当在行。
    ]她的手又回到了原来的位置，放在下巴下面。“上次突然离开，实在很抱歉。
    
    [pc.dcbc
        |世事难料。这次她应该不会再跑掉了吧？

“当然不会！”她笑着说，“我很想放松一下，好好聊聊，更深入地了解你。你觉得怎么样？
        |没关系。她还有时间聊天吗？ [dayNight
            |今天
            |今晚
        ]没错！我真的很想边喝着这杯酒，边放松一下，或许还能互相讲讲故事。你觉得这会是个很愉快的时光吧？
        |哎呀，没关系啦！这次她能留下来吗？

“希望吧，亲爱的，”她笑着说，“我们就慢慢聊着，看看会发展成什么样子吧！
        |哦，你大概觉得可以原谅她吧。其实也没那么糟糕——在她离开后，你找到了其他方式来消磨时间。”

“哦，天啊……”她叹息着，发出那种那种刚刚经历了什么、显得既无奈又觉得好笑的笑声。 [silly
            |得到了
            |拥有过
        ]而且他也知道这一点。“一个喜欢讲双关语的人。”

嘿，你才刚来到科尔米诺斯，所以一定要充分利用这些笑话，把它们发挥到极致。对于你这样的新人来说，这可是千载难逢的机会，你绝对不能错过。
        
        塞蕾娜摇着头，尽管不情愿，还是忍不住笑了起来。“那些话真的太伤人了……那种实实在在的痛苦，就像有东西刺进了我的心里。”

好吧好吧，你该停止这样说了。你总不会想因为一点小矛盾就破坏你们之间的关系吧？
        
        如果你用那些杀伤力只有现在一半的武器来对付那些恶魔，这座城市很快就会变得安全起来，”她笑着说，“我们为什么不坐下来聊一会儿呢？希望这次聊天的时候，不会出现那么多关于‘奶牛’的笑话了。
    ]
    
    有什么特别想问这位热情的老师吗？

rows.original: "Hey there, Champion!" As she greets you, Serena winds her scroll back up and sets it aside; you've got her full and undivided attention. "It's good to see you again!" [pc.dcb |Hello and all that. How's she stay so damn perky all the time? |Hey, ay-ah. Someone's bright-eyed and bushy-tailed. |Aw, hey there, sweetie moo! Gosh, she's almost as happy as you are. ] The cowgirl giggles. "Well, you just seem like a good [pc.isBimbo |bean |egg ], so it's hard not to perk up when you drop by!" [pc.isBimbo |Yesss! Another [pc.mf |person |lady ] who likes happy funtimes. Gosh, she's so perky that it must be a lot of fun to be one of the cuties in her class! |She's got a lot of energy herself. Must be nice to be a student in her class — you can't imagine anyone getting bored, that's for sure. ] "You know, speaking of that..." Oh? "Do you, um..." She purses her lips again before speaking. "Do you mind if I ask you for a favor?" [pc.dcb |No promises you'll actually do it, but you guess an ask doesn't hurt. |Worth an ask, at the very least. What's the favor? |You don't really mind lots of things, hee hee. You'll do your best at whatever the thingy is! ] Serena puts down her drink and leans forward. "It's honestly getting a little tough with the kiddos. Everybody from out in the tunnels is jammed into whatever open space we can find in the lyceum, which isn't anybody's idea of fun. And after all this time, every one of us is thinking of home. It'd be nice to give the girls a little bit of a break — and a little pick-me-up. "What if you[party.som | | and your friend | and your friends ] dropped by to visit the class for an hour or so? At the lyceum, we take time out every day to help put together clothes for the legion; you[pc.isAnyVisible |'d have to put some proper clothes on, but if you did, you ] could come on in, say a few words about who you are and what you do, and relate some news from the outside[var0| — or even tell some stories from the colosseum!|.] We'd provide some food and drink, of course." [pc.dcb |That's a new one on you. |Huh. That's an interesting thought. |Weird. You've never done anything like that before! ] "I just really want to keep the girls engaged. Normally, they're not too bad about paying attention, but we're in an... odd situation and everybody's slipping. Maybe something other than creeping uncertainty would help out. And besides, it might do a hero-[pc.mf |guy |girl ] good to have a reminder of who [pc.heShe]'s fighting for!" [pc.dcb |Not really seeing it. You wouldn't put yourself at the top of anybody's Mis[pc.mf |ter |s ] Inspirational list. |That makes sense. |Well, maybe you can cheer the li'l moos up! ] Still... "[pc.isDK |Give yourself a little credit. That said, y |Y ]ou don't have to give me a no or a yes or anything right now," she continues hurriedly. "I know you've got a lot on your plate, and morale isn't necessarily one of those things! Just, y'know, keep the opportunity in mind. If you've got the inclination, come by the lyceum on Khor'minos' main thoroughfare sometime in the middle of our school day — from half past eight to half past noon or so. "And [pc.name]? If you do, could you, um, [pc.dcbc |sand off some of the edge and be a little less, mmm, harsh? Just while you're talking to the class. You're going to be around children." Yeah, yeah. "I guess that's about as good as I'm going to get," she sighs. "Okay! T |just be yourself? Don't try to put on an act for teenagers, because they'll sniff it out in an instant." Be genuine. You think you can manage that. "You'll do fine. They aren't that bad. At any rate, t |just be a good [pc.boyGirl]? Sweet and happy[silly | and head-empty heart-full ] and all that?" Aw, you would've been a good [pc.boyGirl] anyway — but it's okay that she asked! "Just making sure, sweetie! Either way, t |try to keep the awful wordplay to a minimum?" You guess it makes sense that they wouldn't want you to have deadly weapons around children. Serena sighs. "Yeah, like that." Oof. Minoans are a leather-tough crowd. You can't bull-ieve the kind of response you're getting to some of your best moo-terial. "Gods, they shouldn't let you out in public," she laughs. "Fine, fine. T ]hanks for at least thinking about dropping by. And if you don't have the time or inclination, it's absolutely no problem, like I said. You're a hero[pc.mf | |ine ]; I can't even imagine how busy you are." True, but you'll keep it in mind. Might be fun to take a little time out, and it sounds like it'd really mean a lot to her if you did visit. The way Serena's ears flop down makes her relief crystal clear. "It really would. Anyway, thanks again — you know, for listening. So what can I do for you?"

“你，嗯……”她再次抿了抿嘴唇，然后继续说道：“你介意我请你帮个忙吗？ [pc.dcb |我不能保证你一定会去做，但问问总没坏处吧。 |至少也值得试一试。你想要什么帮助呢？ |你其实并不在意很多事情，嘿嘿。无论面对什么事情，你都会全力以赴的！ ] 塞蕾娜放下手中的饮料，向前倾了倾身子。“说实话，现在带着这些孩子们真的有点麻烦。所有从隧道里出来的人都被挤到了学院里能找到的任何空闲地方，但这根本不是大家想象中的娱乐方式。经历了这么长时间，我们每个人都在思念家乡。如果能让这些女孩们稍微休息一下，给她们一些鼓励，那该多好啊…… “你觉得怎么样[party.som | | 还有你的朋友 | 还有你的朋友们 ]顺道去那个班级待了一个小时左右吧？在文理学院，我们每天都会抽时间帮忙为军团准备衣物；你也是这样做的吧？[pc.isAnyVisible |我得穿上一些像样的衣服才行，不过如果你这么做了的话…… ]你可以进来讲几句，介绍一下自己以及你所从事的工作，再分享一些外界的最新消息。[var0| — 或者甚至可以讲一些关于斗兽场的故事！|。]我们当然会提供一些食物和饮料。 [pc.dcb |你这可真是第一次干这种事啊。 |哈，这个想法挺有意思的。 |奇怪，你以前从来没做过这种事啊！ ] 我真心希望能让这些女孩们保持注意力。通常来说，她们其实还是挺能集中注意力的，但我们现在处于一种……奇怪的处境中，每个人的注意力都在逐渐分散。或许，一些能够打破这种压抑感的因素会更有帮助。而且，这样做说不定还能让某个英雄角色发挥出更大的作用呢[pc.mf |伙计 |女孩 ]有这样的提醒真是太好了，能让人清楚地记住谁是谁。 [pc.heShe]正在为……而战斗！ [pc.dcb |我真不觉得会这样。你肯定不会把自己排在任何人的“最不喜欢名单”之首吧[pc.mf |ter |s ]真是鼓舞人心的清单。 |有道理。 |嗯，也许你可以让这个小家伙高兴起来吧！ ]还是[pc.isDK |稍微表扬一下自己吧。话虽如此，不过…… |Y ]你现在不必立刻给我一个肯定的答复，也不必拒绝，”她急切地继续说道，“我知道你现在有很多事情要处理，而士气问题可能也不是你最关心的事情之一！不过，还是请你把这个机会记在心里吧。如果你有兴趣的话，随时都可以来找我。位于科尔米诺斯主干道上的文理学院在我们上学期间的某个时候——大概是在八点半到中午十二点半还有[pc.name]如果你愿意的话，能不能[pc.dcbc |把边缘磨得平一些，不要那么……嗯，那么尖锐了，好吗？尤其是在你和孩子们说话的时候。你毕竟会和他们在一起的。” “嗯，好的。” “我想我也就只能做到这些了，”她叹了口气，“好吧！那就这样吧。 |做你自己就好。别试图在青少年面前装模作样，因为他们一眼就能看穿。” 要真诚。你觉得自己能做到这一点吧。 “你会没问题的。他们不是那种会被欺骗的人。那个不行。无论如何，都不行。 |只要做好自己就行了。 [pc.boyGirl]？ 甜蜜又幸福[silly | 空虚的外表，充满的内心 ]还有那些东西吗？” “哎，你本来会是个很棒的人的[pc.boyGirl]不管怎样——她提出这样的问题也没关系啊！ “只是想确认一下而已，亲爱的！不管结果如何，都…… |尽量少用那些让人听了难受的双关语吧？” 你想想，他们当然不希望你在孩子们的身边使用致命的武器了。 塞蕾娜叹了口气：“是啊，就是这个意思。” 哎呀，米诺斯人可真是一群坚韧的人啊。对于你那些所谓的‘妙语’，他们的反应简直让人难以置信。 “天啊，他们真不该让你出现在公共场合的，”她笑着说，“好吧，好吧。 ]很感谢你至少考虑过来看看。不过，如果你没有时间或者没有这个意愿，也完全没问题，就像我之前说的——你本来就是个英雄。[pc.mf | | ]我甚至无法想象你有多忙。” 确实很忙，但你会记住我的话的。抽点时间休息一下或许会很不错，而且如果你真的去看看她，对她来说肯定意义重大。 塞蕾娜耳朵耷拉下来的样子，清楚地表达了她的如释重负。“真的会很有意义。总之，再次感谢你——感谢你愿意听我说这些。那么，你现在需要我帮忙什么呢？

rows.original: Your teacher friend leaves her chair as soon as you approach, grinning excitedly. "Hey there, [pc.name]!" [serena.relationshipRange 2 |Ay-ah! You brought something for her. "Oh? Finish your homework?" she giggles. She should see for herself. You [pc.isBimbo |rush over to her, give her a huge squeezly hug, then plant a big ol' smooch right on her lips! She likes it so much that she kissy-kisses back to you, too, which is just the best |[pc.mf |saunter |strut ] over to her and give her a hug and a peck on the cheeks — one she returns immediately, holding you close to make it a little bit longer ]. "I like it." Serena's green eyes glimmer in the flickering firelight of the tavern. "I like it a lot... and, you know, I like you, too." [pc.isBimbo |Oooh! Same! That's so good! "It is, isn't it?" Gosh, she's got such a pretty smile. "You are one of the sweetest [pc.mf |boys |girls ] I've ever met. You care so much, you love so much... I can't think of a more wonderful person." Hee hee... you're gonna get all blushy. It's only fair if you make a cute — mmmnf — sweet — mmmmnnnnfff! — suuuuper smart — mmmmmmmmmNNNNNFFF! — moo blush back! And now she's got one of those faces that's all extra happy and confused and kinda woozy[pc.hasLipstick | aaaaaaand she's got your [pc.lipstickColor] lip-prints all over her face ]! "I — I — [pc.name]..." Uh-huh? "You star..." See, like you said! She's the sweetest. But, um — did she have something else she wanted to talk about? "I... I think I did... okay, I can remember it now." She swallows, then makes sure to look you right in the eye. "I... I know you probably have a lot of love to give to a lot of people, sweetie, and that's okay. I'm not that kind of person, but... but you make me happy, and I want to make you happy. Right now, if you have space in your life for me, that's all I need. Do you know what I mean?" Uh-huh! She wants to be sweet on you, but she's ok if there's other people loving on you too, so long as they don't mind! "Yes. That's... that's a great way to put it. Good." She breathes out slowly. "Good! Okay. I also had another thing I wanted to tell you! |Oh? That sounds pretty serious. "Yeah, well" — and here her gaze flicks down and then up again — "you're a good egg. You care about the students, you care about what I do, and if I had to guess — and I've been guessing lately, hint hint — you look like you fuck like a champion, Champion." Hey, it's hard not to want to put your best foot forward for a clever, beautiful woman who's [pc.isDK |also a sexy, horny cowgirl who looks like she'd be fun in bed |good at what she does and cares about others so much ]. "Well then," she giggles. "I was hoping you'd want something like that. Gosh, this is an amazing way to end a dry spell, right? Flirting back and forth with [pc.swornGod lumia nareva|Lumia's Chosen|Nareva's Chosen|a real-life hero[pc.mf | |ine ]]. I can't believe I get to say this to someone like you, but... if you ever want to get out of here, my room's upstairs. Just say the word." Oh, you'll definitely let her know. Serena gives you a quick, affectionate peck on the cheek, then releases you from the hug. "I don't exp— I mean, I know a Champion like you probably has a lot of love to give to a lot of people, and that's okay. I'm not that kind of person[silly |, and even if I were I wouldn't have the time! How does a player character keep all these lovers satisfied, anyway? You must have superpowers. At any rate, if you're the kind of person who can juggle lots of different lovers, that's fine with me! |, but it wouldn't bother me if you were. ] Right now, no matter if you're seeing other people, you make me happy, and I like making you happy. So as long as nobody else in your life minds, that's all that I need. Oh, and speaking of happy things... ] |Ay-ah[pc.isDK |. |! ] It's good to see her again. "Likewise! Is it okay if I come in for a hug?" [pc.dcb |Does she have to? Serena's grin doesn't diminish, but her hands shift to her hips. "Iiiiiis that a no?" In a very small voice, you reluctantly concede that no, it is not a no. |Absolutely. C'mon in. |Always! You love hugs from cutie moo friendos! ] And when she hugs you, she reminds you why cowgirls do some of the best hugs: warmth, a very lovely smell, and plenty of soft titty. When she [pc.heightRange 65 69 75 |rests her head on yours and holds you close |rests her head on your shoulder and holds you close |rests her head on your chest and lets you hold her close |holds you to her bosom and sighs happily ], everything seems like it's going to be all right. "There," she murmurs. "I can't say enough how much I appreciate you visiting the class." Hey, like you said at the time, it was fun. The kind of thing that's easy for one friend to do for another. "Then I'm lucky to be your friend!" Still smiling, Serena releases you from the hug. "Oh! On a related note... ]"

[pc.name]你星星看，就像你说的那样！她真的是最善良的人。但是，嗯——她是不是还有其他事情想谈的？” rows.translation: 成为一名老师，真是件有趣的事情，”塞蕾娜笑着说，“我原本并没有这个打算，但有时候命运和神明会有其他的安排，这件事就这样发生了！ [pc.isBimbo |哇！这真的太有共鸣了。有时候，有些事情就是会自然而然地发生在你身上。我想她应该是个很随性的人吧？对吧？ |她这话是什么意思呢？看来这种事情似乎需要一些训练才行吧…… ] 算是吧！其实我本来根本就不打算靠近学校。我原本只是打算像我们家族几代人一样，过着平淡无奇的生活。但是，我们村里负责教导高年级学生的老师弗洛拉在一年前突然去世了，我们也没有人能够接替她的位置。”她耸了耸肩。教师和士兵不一样，没有征兵制度，也没有全国性的培训计划。如果你想从事教学工作，通常只需要在科尔米诺斯接受额外的教育，但这需要花费金钱，而我们家并没有这样的经济能力。另外，说实话，我本来也不觉得自己真的想当老师。我以前每天都能开心地出海捕鱼，然后把捕获的鱼带回村子。但当弗洛拉离开后，这一切都变得不再重要了。村子现在真正需要的是别的东西。 嗯……不过[pc.isBimbo |为什么让他们让她来负责教学，而不是其他人呢？ |为什么偏偏是她来填补这个空缺呢？显然，她非常胜任这个工作。现在但由于她没有接受过相关训练…… ] 嗯，当我还在上学的时候，我其实挺……对各种知识都充满了浓厚的兴趣。一切对我来说都显得非常有趣！我喜欢阅读，也喜欢数学、作文、历史以及法律这些学科。虽然当学生并不总是件愉快的事，但那些学习内容确实非常精彩。嗯，其实我比村里大多数女孩都更早完成了学业。而且那时也正是大多数鱼类的繁殖季节。所以当地方官员尤多西亚女士请求我暂时代班一周，好让有人能从科尔米诺斯赶来时，我毫不犹豫地答应了。我只是试着模仿弗洛拉当初教我的方式来表演而已。” 真的有那么简单吗？ 她的笑声听起来有些不像是她的风格，更像是一种刺耳的“哈”声：“哈！天啊，不，其实那真的很可怕。我觉得自己表现得一点都不好……虽然只过了一个星期，但感觉就像过了整整一年一样，更何况那些女孩们对我还算比较友善，因为她们知道我是谁。到最后，我真的已经精疲力竭了，所以当我们的裁判开始和另一个新女孩交谈，让她暂时接替我的工作时，我真是松了一口气——而且这种感觉是多方面的！但是 [pc.isBimbo |嘿嘿。嗯，你是说，她应该是想继续这么做的吧！ |……但她已经迷上了这个游戏。 ] 没错。尤多西亚女士说，反正她更希望村里能有一位当地的老师，所以除非我有其他安排，否则她会出资让我去科尔米诺斯学习几个季度，以便尽快掌握所需的技能。而我确实这么做了！在我在这里工作的这段时间里，他们让我帮忙辅导其中一所文理中学的一些课程，让我在实践中学习知识，还让我复习那些我已经遗忘的内容。因此，当繁殖季节再次来临时，我已经做好了接手工作的准备！剩下的就是历史了。” “我还在写着呢！”她的笑容已经无法抑制了。“你知道吗？我觉得，虽然刚开始的时候我确实有些手忙脚乱，但作为新老师，那最初的经历其实对我帮助很大。因为这样，女孩子们就能看到我是如何解决问题的。她们能够看到我像她们一样在学习的。一位与学生们一起学习的老师。 [pc.mf |他们的 |她 ]学生们可以让学习过程显得更有意义，更加真实。 [pc.dcb |你非常了解以身作则进行教学的重要性。[silly |， 激励他人 ]我想大概就是这样的吧。 |因此，了解相关知识是一回事，以身作则则是另一回事，而这两者都同样重要。 |有道理！老师既可以扮演老师的角色，也可以成为学生的朋友啊！ ] 正是如此。 [pc.isBimbo |那听起来一定会非常有趣！ |对她来说，似乎一切都进行得相当顺利；看起来的确，她的生活状况比一般的渔妇要好一些。 ] 是的。[pc.isBimbo | — 其实，继续从事教师这份工作的原因远不止“这份工作很有趣”这么简单！ |。 ]既然我基本上是为尤多西亚工作的，对于一个乡村女孩来说，我的薪水已经相当不错了。当孩子们和父母一起出去钓鱼的时候，我依然可以继续担任抄写员的工作。这份工作依然很辛苦，也因此我的眼睛已经有点不好了，但薪水方面我确实没有什么可抱怨的！ [serena.relationshipRange 2 |[pc.dcb |呃，这副眼镜确实很合适，不过把它们摘下来的过程也算是其中的一大乐趣吧。 |你以为那些装饰品对她来说只是点缀而已；事实上，她的一切都搭配得非常精妙。正是这些元素让她能够轻松地用自己的魅力吸引路过的英雄们。 |哦哦哦，那些玻璃饰品戴在她身上真的太性感了！ ] 我很高兴你这么认为！打扮得漂亮本身就已经是一种享受了，而得到爱人的关注更是无与伦比的…… |运气与技巧的结合：一种极其强大的力量。 “当然！”她同意道，“我敢打赌[pc.mf |潇洒的 |美丽 ]冠军同样需要它们，甚至可能更加需要。 ]
rows.raw: " "Becoming a teacher's a funny thing," Serena chuckles. "I originally wasn't planning on it, but sometimes fate and the gods have other plans. It just sort of happened!" [pc.isBimbo |Wow! That's totally relatable. Sometimes things just kinda happen for you. You guess she's a really go-with-the-flow sort of moo, isn't she? |How does she mean? Seems like the kind of thing that would require, mmm, training. ] "Kind of! See, I wasn't originally going to go anywhere near a school. What I was going to do was just fish and weave like everybody else in my family had done for generations. But our village's teacher for the older students, Flora, passed away suddenly one year, and we didn't have a replacement." She shrugs. "Teachers aren't like soldiers; there's no conscription or national training. If you want to teach, you usually just do additional schooling in Khor'minos, but that costs money that our family didn't have. And besides, I didn't really think I wanted to teach anyway. I was happy going out on the water and bringing in my haul every day. But when Flora passed, none of that really mattered. The village had a need." Hmm. But [pc.isBimbo |how come they let her do the teaching instead of someone else? |why was she the one to fill it? She's obviously good at it now, but since she didn't have training... ] "Well, when I was still in school, I was kind of a... I paid very close attention. Everything was interesting! I loved reading, and math, and composition, and history, and the law. Being a student wasn't always a good time for me, but the material was great. And, well, I'd been through school more recently than most of the girls in the village, and it was spawning season for most of the fish anyway, so when the magistrate, Lady Eudocia, asked for me to stand in for a week so somebody could come out from Khor'minos, I said yes. And I just tried to act like Flora did when she taught me." It was that easy? Her laugh comes out as an uncharacteristic bark: "Ha! Gods, no. It was terrifying. I don't think I did well at all. It was only a week, but it felt like a year, and that was with the girls being, you know, relatively nice to me because they knew who I was. I was such a wreck by the end of it, so when our magistrate started to talk to a new girl to cover for a while longer I was relieved in more ways than one! But..." [pc.isBimbo |Hee hee. Butt. Uh, you mean, you guess she wanted to keep doing it! |...but she'd been bitten by the bug. ] "That's right. Lady Eudocia said she'd rather have a local teacher in the village anyway, so unless I had other plans she was going to pay for me to go to Khor'minos for a few seasons to get up to speed. And that's what I did! While I was here, they had me help with some of the classes in one of the lycea to learn on the job and made me run through reviews on the material I'd forgotten, so by the time spawning season came around again I was ready to take over!" And the rest is history. "Still writing it!" Her grin's irrepressible now. "And you know what? I think that, even if I was floundering for a little while, being a new teacher for that first little bit really helped. Because then the girls got to see me figure things out. They got to see me learning like they were. A teacher who learns alongside [pc.mf |their |her ] students can make learning seem that much more worthwhile. That much more real." [pc.dcb |You know all about teaching by example[silly |, pour encourager les autres ]. Guess it's kind of like that. |So knowing things is one thing, and leading by example is another, and both are important. |That makes sense! It's like the teacher is a teacher and a friendo at the same time! ] "Exactly." [pc.isBimbo |That sounds like a lot of fun! |Seems like it's worked out pretty well for her; she looks like she gets by a little bit better than the average fisherwoman. ] "Yeah[pc.isBimbo | — although there are more reasons than 'it's fun' to keep working as a teacher! |. ] Since I basically work for Eudocia, I get paid pretty well for a village girl, and when the kiddos are out of school fishing with their parents, I stay employed as a scribe. It's still hard work, which is why my eyes are already going a little bad, but I can't complain about the wages!" [serena.relationshipRange 2 |[pc.dcb |Eh. The glasses are a good fit, even if half the fun is taking them off. |You think the spectacles work for her; in fact, everything about her is very well put-together. Makes it easy to ensnare passing Champions with her wiles. |Ooooh, but the glass thingies look so sexy on her! ] "I'm glad you think so! Dressing nicely is its own reward, but a lover's attention is even better..." |Luck and skill together: a formidable combination. "For sure!" she agrees. "I bet a [pc.mf |dashing |beautiful ] Champion needs them just as much — if not more." ] "

rows.original: [pc.isBimbo |Being a teachy lady must be pretty tiring! Does she ever, like, do fun stuff? "These books and scrolls aren't just for show, sweetie," she says. Gosh, she's a nice moo. "I like to read! Keeping written stuff is pretty expensive, but I'm a lucky girl: my boss is willing to buy a few for the girls to practice from." Huh. Book reading? Wee-eell, stories are all right, especially if they're sexy. What kinds of things does she read? |[pc.isCunning |So, what kinds of things does she do for fun? And before she says 'reading', yeah, you did pick that up — you mean what kinds of books she reads. "I..." She pauses, then laughs. "You got me. That's exactly what I was going to say." See? You knew it. But seriously, what's her favorite sort of book? |So, what kind of things does she do to unwind? You can't imagine that teaching class is her whole life. Serena raises an eyebrow as she holds up her book. "The texts sitting next to me on the table didn't give it away? These things aren't cheap, you know! I'm lucky the magistrate's willing to finance a few for the village school." Reading, huh? Fair enough. You weren't sure if those were just for class or not. What kinds of stories does she mostly go in for? ] ] "Mostly," she says, "I go in for histories, because somehow the stories mean a little bit more when you know that they happened to real people. You know what I mean? It's one thing to read about Derkyllis and Mantinias in the fantastical lands that the Belharans used to think were on the far side of the great Jassiran desert. It's another thing to read about the little fragments of history, about General Polemaios Laskaris and his extremely real bronze-shielded warriors' battle against the Jassirans in the far desert on the edge of the known world. It feels like their struggles matter more, you know?" [pc.isBimbo |You get it! Real is real, right? |You think you understand. It has that sense of tactility and permanence that fiction doesn't often provide. ] "Yeah. That's not to say that the best fictional stories don't do the same thing. But still. History — what we have of it, anyway — is just so much more interesting to me. I could curl up with one of my stories and some nice warm milk for a whole evening." [serena.relationshipRange 1 |[pc.isBimbo |Oooh, wait — are these the same stories that she sings to the students, too? Cause that was really cool! |As you[pc.isDK | | — fondly — ] remember, she doesn't just read the stories to herself, though. ] "Awww! Thanks, [serena.relationshipRange 2 |angel |dear ]! But you're right: like any good scholar, I keep most of the best stories memorized for singing. I think the kiddos like it better that way, and it's much easier for them to learn the stories, too! |[pc.isBimbo |Huh. So she just, like, reads the stories? |So she reads for entertainment and for knowledge, and that's about it? ] "Nope!" Serena chirps. "I also sing them! I have a few of the most important histories and stories for teaching memorized, and when we handle them as a class I sing to keep things interesting for the kiddos. It's important for them to memorize it all, too, and songs are easier than straight text. ] Not everybody wants to get stuck into a dry book or pile of scrolls, after all!" [pc.isBimbo |[pc.isCunning |Sometimes! Scrolls are the one thing that you don't like to get wet, hee hee. |Yeahhhhh that isn't much like you. You don't like to see anyone going around dry! ] |Very true. ] But what about other things? Things that she might be able to do together with someone? [serena.relationshipRange 2 |She winks coquettishly. "Someone in particular? Well, |"Well, ] it's tough. A lot of the things I might normally do are back home in the village. Climb out by the mouth of the river, watch the sunrise or sunset, things like that. What I[silly | might ] could do here... well, you know, I'd love to see more of Khor'minos!" [pc.isBimbo |Wait, but, like, she's a moo! Shouldn't she know all the things about the moo city? |She's been here before, though, hasn't she? Shouldn't she know the city pretty well by now? ] "Gods, no. I don't even think people who do live here know everything about the Urbs. There's at least a quarter of a million souls here normally, and uncounted myriads more since the siege began. The main drag you probably know pretty well, but there's dozens of other big thoroughfares, and hundreds of cute side streets, back alleys, and other places both fun and not-so-fun. There's just so much life, and while I'm here, I want to see as much of it as I can[silly |, like a flâneuse or something ]. The city's huge, [pc.name]; there's always more to discover if you've got the time and if your legs aren't tired."
rows.translation: [pc.isBimbo |做一个爱说教的人肯定很累吧！她有没有做过一些有趣的事情呢？ “这些书和卷轴可不是用来摆设的，亲爱的，”她说道。天哪，她真是个好心人。“我就喜欢读书！保存这些书面资料其实挺花钱的，但我很幸运：我的老板愿意买一些让大家都能用来练习。” 哈？读书？嗯……故事倒还可以，尤其是那些有点情色的故事。她都读些什么书呢？ |[pc.isCunning |那么，她平时会做些什么来消遣呢？在她说“阅读”之前，你确实注意到了——你指的是她会读哪些类型的书。 “我……”她停顿了一下，然后笑了起来。“被你猜中了，我本来就想说的就是这个。” 看吧？你早就知道了。不过说真的，她最喜欢的书类型是什么呢？ |那么，她会做些什么来放松呢？你绝对想象不到，教书竟然就是她生活的全部。 塞蕾娜挑了挑眉，一边举起手中的书说道：“桌子旁边那些书难道没有暴露真相吗？这些书可都不便宜啊！幸好那位法官愿意为村里的学校提供一些资金，否则我就没机会买了。” 阅读啊？这也难怪。你之前也不确定那些书到底是用来上课的，还是别的用途。她平时主要喜欢读些什么类型的书呢？ ] ] 主要是，”她说，“我会去研究那些真实发生过的历史故事，因为当你知道这些故事其实是真实人物经历的时候，它们就会显得更有意义了。你明白我的意思吧？仅仅阅读关于德基利斯和曼蒂尼亚斯的故事，了解贝尔哈兰人曾经认为那些地方位于辽阔的贾西兰沙漠另一边的奇幻世界，那是一回事；但当你知道这些故事其实是真实人物的真实经历时，它们的意义就会完全不同了。阅读那些关于历史片段的故事，关于波莱马奥斯·拉斯卡里斯将军以及他那些身披青铜盾牌的战士们在已知世界边缘的遥远沙漠中与贾西兰人展开的战斗，则是另一回事了。你知道，他们的挣扎似乎显得更加重要，对吧？ [pc.isBimbo |你懂的！现实就是现实，对吧？ |你以为自己理解了。它具备那种触感与持久性，而这些都是虚构作品往往无法提供的。 ] 是的。这并不是说那些最精彩的虚构故事不会达到同样的效果。但无论如何，历史——至少是我们所掌握的那部分历史——对我来说要有趣得多。我可以抱着一本故事书，再喝一些热牛奶，就这样整个晚上都沉浸在故事的世界里。 [serena.relationshipRange 1 |[pc.isBimbo |哦，等等——这些也是她用来给学生讲的故事吗？因为那些故事真的太棒了！ |正如你所说[pc.isDK | | ——充满深情地—— ]记住，她可不只是自己读这些故事而已。 ] 哇哦！谢谢啦， [serena.relationshipRange 2 |天使 |亲爱的 ]但是你说得对：像任何一位优秀的学者一样，我把大多数精彩的故事都记在了心里，以便在需要时能够背诵出来。我觉得孩子们更喜欢这种方式，而且对他们来说，学习这些故事也容易得多！ |[pc.isBimbo |哈，所以她就是读这些故事而已吗？ |所以她阅读是为了娱乐，也是为了获取知识，就仅此而已吗？ ] 不行！”塞蕾娜欢快地回答，“我也会用歌曲来教这些内容！有些非常重要的历史故事，我会把它们背下来，然后在课堂上讲的时候配上歌曲，这样能让孩子们更感兴趣。让他们把这些内容都背下来也很重要，而歌曲比单纯的文字更容易让他们记住。 ]毕竟，并不是每个人都愿意被束缚在枯燥的书本或一堆卷轴之中！ [pc.isBimbo |[pc.isCunning |有时候吧！卷轴可是那种你绝对不希望被弄湿的东西，嘿嘿。 |是啊，这可真不像你啊。你可从来不喜欢看到别人陷入困境吧！ ] |确实如此。 ]但其他事情呢？那些她可以和别人一起做的事情呢？ [serena.relationshipRange 2 |她调皮地眨了眨眼：“有特别喜欢的人吗？嗯， |嗯， ]这确实挺难的。很多我平时会做的事情，在家乡的村庄里都能做——比如爬到河口去观看日出或日落，诸如此类的事情。但我现在[silly | 可能 ]在这里确实可以做得更多……嗯，说实话，我真的很希望看到更多关于科尔米诺斯的内容！ [pc.isBimbo |等等，可是她毕竟是一头牛啊！她难道不应该了解关于“牛之城”的所有事情吗？ |她以前来过这里，对吧？现在应该对这座城市相当熟悉了吧？ ] 天啊，不行。我甚至觉得那些人确实住在这里的人对这座城市了如指掌。平时这里至少有二十五万居民，而自从围城开始以来，还有数不清的更多的人来到了这里。你可能已经对这条主要街道很熟悉了，但实际上还有几十条其他重要的主干道。数百那些充满乐趣的可爱小街、幽暗的后巷，以及各种各样或有趣或不太有趣的地方……实在有太多太多了。生命既然我在这里，那就想尽可能多地看看吧。[silly |就像一个闲逛的女子之类的…… ]这座城市的巨大的， [pc.name]；只要你有时间，而且你的双腿没有感到疲劳，总能发现更多有趣的东西。

rows.original: "The Urbs herself! She's a lot different than Signia, that's for sure," Serena says agreeably. After a few laughs, though, her face falls a bit. "Especially now. It's... been interesting. Did you have something specific in mind?"

rows.original: "It is... really difficult sometimes to keep the girls from ditching class and going to the arena, now that we're in the city. Whose idea was it to have the fights take place during working hours? And whose idea was it to build the lyceum right next door to the arena? Gods, we plan out all the villages in the realm in a precise grid with every public building in its proper space, but we can't manage to do some basic amenities organization in our own capital. Next to the arena — I mean, really!" [pc.isBimbo |Awww. Do the girls wanna cut class and go have fun? |Not just next door, but the fights are during prime teaching time, too, right? ] "Yes," she sighs. "I mean, some days, I'd rather go watch a match than teach, too. And when we have off days — gods know we all need off days in this mess — sometimes I see the girls there. But we can't do that all the time. When else are we supposed to teach the kids, anyway? As hard as it is to control them during the day, it'd be so much harder if we tried to do it at night..." [pc.isBimbo |Yeahhhhh. |You see her point. ] "Still, the moms and I figured some things out. We start a bit earlier and end a bit earlier than we normally would, so the girls can at least see the main events in the midafternoon if they want to. There are still a few tired faces at the beginning of the day, but we've adjusted. And, of course, many of them come in every morning all smiles about what happened in the match the day before. I'll take almost anything I can get if it helps keep our girls' mood up while we're away from home." [var0 |[pc.isBimbo |Oooh, were they there to see you? |You wouldn't suppose [var1 |they've seen any of your matches, have they |they saw you out there during your match, did they ]? ] [var2 |"Are you kidding?" she laughs. "It seems like almost everybody's seen your matches! And for sure everybody's singing the songs that that minstrel Livrea's performing about you. Gods, you're a legend. [serena.relationshipRange 1 |Do you have any idea how much time our girls spend talking about how they've met the arena's greatest hero[pc.mf | |ine ]? They've managed to parlay that into becoming some of the most popular girls at the lyceum, even though they're, you know, from a podunk fishing village. Doesn't matter. Every other girl there — and a lot of the teachers — wants to hear more about you and your friends. Sweet little Licinia's so overwhelmed sometimes... but she's also having the time of her life. She must have recounted your battle against big bad Cedric a hundred times by now... |I've even heard the girls talking about your matches in the mornings before we start. Licinia in particular is a huge fan; she goes into such lavish detail when she describes your moves, and she tells the story of your battle against Cedric with genuine talent. I hold my tongue — it wouldn't be right to name-drop — but just think of how special it would be for them if you came and visited! ]" [pc.isBimbo |Hee hee, [silly |uwu |yeah ]. |哇，这些女孩是不是想逃课去玩玩呢？ |不仅发生在隔壁，而且这些冲突还正好发生在教学时间最紧张的时候，对吧？ ] 是的，”她叹息道，“有时候，确实是这样。我会。还不如去看比赛呢，反正教书也没什么用。而到了休息日——天知道，在这种混乱的情况下，我们所有人都需要休息日——有时候我会在那里看到那些女孩。但我们总不能一直这样吧？不然我们什么时候去教孩子们呢？白天控制他们就已经很困难了，如果晚上还试图去做这件事，那肯定会更加艰难 [pc.isBimbo |耶耶耶耶。 |你明白她的意思了。 ] 不过，我和那些妈妈们想出了一些办法。我们会比平时稍微早开始活动，也会稍微早结束，这样孩子们如果想的话，至少还能在下午看到一些主要的比赛环节。虽然每天刚开始的时候还是会有些孩子显得疲惫，但我们已经调整好了安排。当然，也有很多孩子每天早上都会带着笑容来，他们会跟我们分享前一天比赛中发生的事情。只要能帮助我们的孩子们在远离家的这段时间里保持好心情，我愿意接受任何办法。 [var0 |[pc.isBimbo |哦，他们是专门来见你的吗？ |你绝对想不到。 [var1 |他们有没有见过其中任何一种？你的比赛，它们已经开始了吧 |他们在你比赛的时候看到了你，对吧 ]？ ] [var2 |你在开玩笑吧？”她笑着说，“看起来几乎每个人的看到你们的比赛了！肯定大家都在唱那位吟游诗人莉维娅所创作的关于你们的歌曲。天啊，你们真是传奇人物。 [serena.relationshipRange rows.raw: " "It is... really difficult sometimes to keep the girls from ditching class and going to the arena, now that we're in the city. Whose idea was it to have the fights take place during working hours? And whose idea was it to build the lyceum right next door to the arena? Gods, we plan out all the villages in the realm in a precise grid with every public building in its proper space, but we can't manage to do some basic amenities organization in our own capital. Next to the arena — I mean, really!" [pc.isBimbo |Awww. Do the girls wanna cut class and go have fun? |Not just next door, but the fights are during prime teaching time, too, right? ] "Yes," she sighs. "I mean, some days, I'd rather go watch a match than teach, too. And when we have off days — gods know we all need off days in this mess — sometimes I see the girls there. But we can't do that all the time. When else are we supposed to teach the kids, anyway? As hard as it is to control them during the day, it'd be so much harder if we tried to do it at night..." [pc.isBimbo |Yeahhhhh. |You see her point. ] "Still, the moms and I figured some things out. We start a bit earlier and end a bit earlier than we normally would, so the girls can at least see the main events in the midafternoon if they want to. There are still a few tired faces at the beginning of the day, but we've adjusted. And, of course, many of them come in every morning all smiles about what happened in the match the day before. I'll take almost anything I can get if it helps keep our girls' mood up while we're away from home." rows.original: "People." There's more than a little awestruck wonderment in Serena's voice. "There's just so many people in the city." [pc.isBimbo |Yeah, totally! Why is that? Are cities just places for lots of people to be or something?[pc.isCunning | And just to make sure she gets the joke, you flutter your eyelashes at her cutely. ] |That is kind of what cities are for. ] "Yes — no — I mean... uuuugh." She rolls her eyes at you. "Khor'minos is normally a big city, yeah? But it's much, much bigger right now. I've seen it under normal circumstances, and it's different having all of us country folk in here." Are there really that many of them? "Well, where do you think all of the city's food comes from? Villages like Signia. And how many people does it take to collect enough fish or grow enough lichen or herd enough stock to keep a whole city fed?" Serena spreads her arms. "You're seeing double, triple, quadruple the number of citizens on the streets as you usually do, because so much of the realm is in quarantine. The inns are full. The shantytowns within the walls and around the gates are bustling. That's a loooooot of [silly |bovinity |people ] in one place, and it's pretty overwhelming. It's like the most crowded of all market days, except it lasts for weeks and weeks..." [pc.isBimbo |Awww. Dealing with some [silly |social anxiety |bad thoughts about being around all those people ], sweetie? |You're getting the sense that she doesn't actually enjoy being around so many people. ] "Well, normally it's not a big deal at all! With my tribe, with the herd — being in a big group can be something really special, if you feel like you belong. And citizens really do belong. There are always arguments," she says quickly, "and sometimes people are just di... jerks, but even in rough times like these, we're basically still there for each other. And since everybody's here, everybody's all crammed in doing stuff together! I love to go for strolls and clear my head, and when I do, I see citizens from every corner of the realm rubbing elbows in the streets, sitting to each other to watch the games, and drinking with each other in the taverns. It's a hard time for everybody, but I feel closer to my fellow cows and bulls than I ever have. "But you're right: being closer isn't just a good thing, especially with how long it's been going on. People like me want to go home, and the urban citizens want everybody else to give them some space. Some goods are running short; some people's tempers are running high. It's easier to open your home to someone for a little while than it is to live with them indefinitely." [pc.isBimbo |Mmm, you don't know. Sometimes it's fun to have a party keep going forever, right? "Not everybody feels that way, dear. Sometimes people want the party to be over." Serena puts on a li'l bit of a frowny face. "Also, this isn't as fun as a party. |From what she's saying, it sounds like the hardest part is that there's no end in sight. Serena nods vigorously. "If we had a goal in our heads, it would be easier to handle everything. 'On so-and-so a day, we'll all be able to go back to our homes. We just have to make it until then.' But we don't have that. ] And we don't really have any more guidance from the magistrates: it's just 'sit tight and keep waiting', when we hear from them at all, and we don't hear from them very often. So it sucks." [pc.isBimbo |Yeah that does sound like it sucks. Poor thing. What about the sweet little moos? Are they tired, too? |Is it like that for the students? ] "Yes and no. At first, it wasn't that bad, all things considered. Temporary classes in the city lycea mean that they can make new city friends — you know, so long as the city girls don't get all huffy about the country bumpkins invading. Plus, if it's quarantine, they get to see more boys more often, and some of the older girls get verrry excited about that. Euclia falls in love with a new big strong hunter every day, it seems like." There's a 'but' hanging off the end of what she just said.[pc.isBimbo | Hee hee. Butt. ] "Mmmhmm. New friends and new surroundings are pretty fun, but at this point they're split pretty hard between 'I want to stay here with my new friend[silly |o ] forever' and 'I want to go home.' Sometimes the same girl says both things within a few minutes of each other." She cocks her head. "Maybe I can get them interested in writing letters once we're back home. If we end up going back home." Hopefully sooner rather than later. Serena nods. "Yeah. I mean, class is more or less still the same, and they still get their time off, but there's no way for the girls to go fishing or pearl diving or snail-catching with their parents while we're stuck in the city, and that's half of what they do. Ugh."
rows.translation: 人们……”塞蕾娜的声音里带着一丝难以掩饰的惊叹，“这座城市里的人口实在太多了。 [pc.isBimbo |是啊，完全同意！为什么会这样呢？难道城市只是人们聚集在一起的地方吗？[pc.isCunning | 为了确保她能理解这个玩笑，你还会俏皮地眨眨眼。 ] |那个是这正是城市存在的意义所在。 ] 嗯……不……我是说……呃……”她冲你翻了个白眼。“科尔米诺斯通常是一座很大的城市，对吧？但现在它变得大得多了。我在正常情况下见过它，但当我们这些乡下人全都聚集在这里的时候，情况确实不一样了。真的有那么多人吗？ “嗯，你认为这座城市的所有食物都是从哪里来的呢？当然是像西格尼亚这样的村庄啊。那么，要收集足够的鱼、种植足够的地衣，或者饲养足够的牲畜来养活整个城市，到底需要多少人呢？塞蕾娜张开双臂说道：“你现在看到的街道上的人群数量，其实是平常的两倍、三倍甚至四倍——因为这个王国的大部分地区都处于隔离状态。旅馆们全都住满了人，城墙内以及城门周围的贫民区也热闹非凡。那可真是多得离谱啊[silly |愚蠢的行为 |人们 ]所有这些信息都集中在一个地方，真的让人应接不暇。这就像是市场上最繁忙的日子，只不过这种繁忙状态会持续数周之久 [pc.isBimbo |哎呀，真是有些麻烦事要处理呢[silly |社交焦虑 |一想到要和那些人待在一起，就觉得很不自在。 ]亲爱的，怎么了？ |你会觉得，她其实并不喜欢待在这么多人中间。 ] 嗯，通常来说这根本不是什么大问题！在我的部落里，在我们的群体中，当大家聚在一起时，那种感觉真的非常特别，尤其是当你觉得自己属于这个群体的时候。而这里的居民们确实感觉自己属于这里。虽然总会有一些争论，”她迅速说道，“但有时候人们也只是……虽然有时候会遇到一些麻烦，但即便是在这样的艰难时刻，我们依然会彼此支持。既然大家都在这里，那就一起努力吧！我喜欢去散步，让思绪变得清晰一些，而当我这样做的时候，我会看到来自王国各个角落的市民们在街上一起闲聊，坐在一起观看比赛，或者在酒馆里一起喝酒。对每个人来说，这都是一个艰难的时期，但我感觉自己与那些牛羊伙伴们的关系比以往任何时候都要亲密。 “不过你说得对：关系更加亲密并不一定是件好事，尤其是考虑到这种情况已经持续了这么长时间。像我这样的人想要回家，而城市居民则希望其他人能给他们一些空间。有些商品正在缺货；有些人的脾气也变得暴躁起来。让某人暂时住在自己家里，总比让他们永远和自己住在一起要容易得多吧。 [pc.isBimbo |嗯，你可能不明白。有时候，让一场派对永远持续下去，其实也挺有趣的，对吧？ “不过，并不是每个人都这么想，亲爱的。有时候，人们其实希望派对能够结束。”塞蕾娜微微皱了皱眉头，“而且，这样的派对其实并没有那么有趣。 |从她的话来看，最困难的地方似乎在于这个过程似乎没有尽头。 塞蕾娜用力地点了点头：“如果我们心中有一个明确的目标，处理这一切就会容易很多。‘在某一天，我们都能回到自己的家中。我们只需要坚持到那一天。’但是，我们并没有这样的目标。 ]而我们实际上并没有从法官那里得到任何进一步的指示：他们只是让我们“耐心等待”，不过我们也很少能收到他们的消息。所以这种情况真的挺糟糕的。 [pc.isBimbo |是啊，听起来确实挺糟糕的。可怜的家伙……那些可爱的小奶牛们呢？它们也累了吗？ |对于学生们来说，也是这样吗？ ] 可以说也是，也可以说不是。一开始，考虑到各种因素，情况其实并没有那么糟糕。在城市里的临时班级让孩子们有机会结交新的城市朋友——当然，前提是那些城市女孩不会因为这些来自乡下的孩子而生气。另外，如果实行隔离措施，孩子们就能更经常地见到男生了，有些年纪稍大的女孩对此更是兴奋不已。看来欧克莉亚每天都在爱上一个新的、强壮的猎人呢。” 她的话似乎还藏着某个“但是”。[pc.isBimbo | 嘿嘿。屁股。 ] 嗯，新朋友和新环境确实很有趣，但在这个阶段，我的想法很矛盾——我既想和我的新朋友一起留在这里，又[silly |o ]永远”以及“我想回家”。有时候，同一个女孩会在几分钟之内说出这两句话。”她歪了歪头，“也许等我们回到家后，可以让他们试着写信看看。当然，前提是我们真的能回到家。希望这一切能尽快发生。” 塞蕾娜点了点头：“是啊。课程内容基本上还是老样子，学生们也依然有休息时间，但当我们被困在城里的时候，这些女孩就没法和父母一起去钓鱼、采珍珠或者捉蜗牛了，而这些活动本来可是她们平时最喜欢做的啊。呃……

rows.original: "Several years ago, when I was training at the lyceum, a noblewoman put together a project to educate children from Khor'minos' slums. She made a deal with a few teachers and teachers-to-be, negotiated with the king, and then just went in there to spread literacy to the unlettered." [pc.isBimbo |Wait just a hot second. Aren't teachers just for the moos? Or the sitty thingys, or something? There aren't many moos in the slums[flags.KM_SLUMS|!|, right?] |You thought that there were only teachers for citizens' children. [flags.KM_SLUMS|In your experience|As far as you know], there aren't many citizens in the city's slums. ] "There aren't," she agrees. "This was a display of beneficence. Some of the nobles like to compete: who can endow the most charitable institutions, who can dedicate the most things, and so on. You know how Minoans are: plenty of competition and cooperation in equal measure! So it wasn't beyond the pale... but it was still a very unusual project. The only reason it happened at all is because the lady who tried it had actually grown up in the slums herself, joined the military as an auxiliary, and earned her citizenship that way. She wanted to do something to give back, and she had enough money to get a few girls interested in teaching for her, too." [pc.isBimbo |That sounds really nice of her! Did it all work out? |The way she talks about it makes it sound like the whole thing didn't work out. ] "It didn't." Serena frowns as she contemplates her next words. "Okay. First thing: do you know how much it costs to hire someone like me — a proper Minoan teacher, not some hedge mage charlatan who'll as soon use you as an experiment as teach you?" [party.has viviane |[var0 |From behind you, Viviane snorts. "Ha. That's... that's fair, honestly." [pc.isBimbo |Hee hee |Heh ]. Yeah. |"Ah, yes, the bane of witches like me," says Viviane dolefully. "There are far too many unscrupulous types out there. Perfectly dreadful." [pc.isCunning |She would know about witches who lack scruples, wouldn't she? Viv places her hand to her chest in mock outrage. "The slander coming out of this [pc.manWoman]'s mouth!" Yeah, yeah. |[pc.isBimbo |Wait, what's unsc... unscrew? "Unscrupulous," Vivvy sighs. "Someone who's willing to do anything, even if it hurts other people." So, like, a big meanie! She smiles a little bit. "Not always, but... often." Okie-doke! |You'd imagine, yeah. ] ] ] |[pc.bg arcanist |That's... a pretty fair characterization of a lot of hedge mages, and you've got experience. Good mentors are few and far between. |[pc.isBimbo |[pc.isCunning |Uhhhm, not sure! |You're kinda bad with money... and numbers... and a lot of stuff! So, uh, nuh-uh. ] |Hm. No, you haven't got an idea. ] ] ] So how much, then? "I don't know, either," [party.has Viviane |Serena |the teacher ] chuckles, "but it's not cheap. We're not day laborers. There's a reason my pay comes out of the taxes that our village magistrate assesses. And the thing about non-citizens is that..." [pc.isBimbo |Wait, you can get this! Sitty thingies don't, um... they don't... ... okay, you don't get this. "Non-citizens don't pay most of the taxes that citizens do, dear." Ohhhhh. |... they don't pay most of those taxes.[pc.isCunning | Can't pay a teacher if the money isn't coming in. ] ] "Yep. Hiring a tutor is perfectly normal for a noble who's got kids but hasn't got an educated slave. Hiring several tutors for other people's kids is something else entirely. She tried to get the people in the slums to pay voluntarily, but that didn't work out, and she couldn't tax them, because that's not how, you know, laws work. So she slowly ran down her money until the whole group had to close up. But even before that, things weren't going well." [pc.bg slumrat |[pc.isBimbo |Yeahhh, you bet they weren't! It's kinda dumb to be reading if you need, like, food and stuff. |You imagine so. If they came from the slums, the kids had better things — more important things — to do with their time than learn letters. The numbers helped, sure, but learning to read? Nope. ] Serena nods. "You know what I'm talking about." You lived it. "Well, you're right, of course. Why would anybody leave the corner or the alley, a place where they could make some money and keep themselves fed, and roll the dice by spending time on literacy? Who's going to make sure that they can take the time to learn?" [pc.isBimbo |Yeahhh. It took soooo long for you to learn how to read, and it[pc.isCunning | still isn't super fun when it's not about something lewd |'s still soooo hard to focus on it ]. |It was a hard sell for you, too. ] |[pc.isCunning |Hmm. Is it because they don't have the support they need |W[pc.isBimbo |ait, w ]hy not ]? "[pc.isCunning |Exactly. ]If you're barely scraping by, living day to day, who has the time to learn how to read? You can make money out on the corners or in the alleys or doing all kinds of things. You can't make money by being in class. You can't stay fed. There are a lot of strong forces pushing kids onto the streets in the slums. When you're among citizens, when you've grown up among people who expect school to be a thing, when you've got more of a support system, when the whole village is there to help, the scales balance a little differently. Despite the murex trade, our village still isn't particularly wealthy. Some of my students come from very poor families indeed... but citizens are there for other citizens, and women like Lady Claritia help their families out enough to be able to allow their girls to learn. In the slums, though..." [pc.isBimbo |Huh. That kinda makes sense. |Hm. You can see why it'd be a hard sell. ] ] "Yeah. And for a lot of the kids who still came to learn, well... it's not always very easy for a teacher to connect to someone who's so different from them. A friend of mine, Nina, was with them, and she tried. But you need time to get better at connecting to students like that sometimes, and time wasn't what they had. She managed to find ways to help some of her kiddos — the ones who could stick with it — but not everyone. And then the money ran out." [pc.isBimbo |Aww. That's kinda sad. Could they have done a better job? |So those were the problems, but... was there any way that they could have succeeded? ] Serena sips her drink before speaking again. "I don't know. There are not a lot of people inside or outside Khor'minos' slums who think that it's worthwhile to teach the children there how to read. Too many of the things that reading is useful for don't matter there.[silly | If they were all citizens, if we had ourselves a Constitutio Antoniniana, well, maybe that'd be different. And maybe not. I don't know. Did Caracalla get rid of Rome's poor? Probably not, right? Anyway. ] "When Nina's job ended, I was still in training, and we talked about what personal lessons we could take out of the whole thing. Sure, a lot of things were out of her hands, but what wasn't? What were the things that teachers could control? Nina decided that she would keep striving to find better ways to connect with her students — her new citizen students, anyway, once she got a new job. That's what it is, though. That's our job. Lying awake at night remembering how you tried to work with a child that day, how the connection didn't quite happen, how you might have messed it up, how you could have done better. And there's always something that you can do better as a teacher. That's the reason you're there: to do your best for them." [pc.bg scholar |Reminds you of [pc.isBimbo |back when you were doing book learning yourself! |academia. ] A lot of [pc.boyGirl]s learning magic take tutoring jobs, and the same sort of thing applies there, too. If you want to do well with a pupil, you have to see life from their point of view — like being a [pc.isBimbo |[pc.mf |daddy |mommy ], you know? |parent, in a way. ] |That makes sense. Kind of like being a [pc.isBimbo |[pc.mf |daddy |mommy ] |parent ], in a lot of ways. ] Was there anything else? "Just... I met some of those kids a few times. A couple of 'manders, a human, an orc, some elves. Yes, some of them are pretty rough; yes, the place they live is extremely dangerous. Anyone who goes into the slums expecting sweetness and light is in for a rude awakening. Those kids are [silly |all in the Game |living a life that's nothing like mine was as a girl ], but they're still kids[pc.bg slumrat |, just like you were ]. [flags.KM_SLUMS|When|If] you go there, keep that in mind." [pc.isBimbo |Hee hee. She thinks about kids a lot, huh? |Of course she'd focus on the kids, wouldn't she? ] She laughs and shakes her head. "All I can talk about is what I know, [pc.name]."
