No, you haven't got an idea. ] ] ] So how much, then? "I don't know, either," [party.has Viviane |Serena |the teacher ] chuckles, "but it's not cheap. We're not day laborers. There's a reason my pay comes out of the taxes that our village magistrate assesses. And the thing about non-citizens is that..." [pc.isBimbo |Wait, you can get this! Sitty thingies don't, um... they don't... ... okay, you don't get this. "Non-citizens don't pay most of the taxes that citizens do, dear." Ohhhhh. |... they don't pay most of those taxes.[pc.isCunning | Can't pay a teacher if the money isn't coming in. ] ] "Yep. Hiring a tutor is perfectly normal for a noble who's got kids but hasn't got an educated slave. Hiring several tutors for other people's kids is something else entirely. She tried to get the people in the slums to pay voluntarily, but that didn't work out, and she couldn't tax them, because that's not how, you know, laws work. So she slowly ran down her money until the whole group had to close up. But even before that, things weren't going well." [pc.bg slumrat |[pc.isBimbo |Yeahhh, you bet they weren't! It's kinda dumb to be reading if you need, like, food and stuff. |You imagine so. If they came from the slums, the kids had better things — more important things — to do with their time than learn letters. The numbers helped, sure, but learning to read? Nope. ] Serena nods. "You know what I'm talking about." You lived it. "Well, you're right, of course. Why would anybody leave the corner or the alley, a place where they could make some money and keep themselves fed, and roll the dice by spending time on literacy? Who's going to make sure that they can take the time to learn?" [pc.isBimbo |Yeahhh. It took soooo long for you to learn how to read, and it[pc.isCunning | still isn't super fun when it's not about something lewd |'s still soooo hard to focus on it ]. |It was a hard sell for you, too. ] |[pc.isCunning |Hmm. Is it because they don't have the support they need |W[pc.isBimbo |ait, w ]hy not ]? "[pc.isCunning |Exactly. ]If you're barely scraping by, living day to day, who has the time to learn how to read? You can make money out on the corners or in the alleys or doing all kinds of things. You can't make money by being in class. You can't stay fed. There are a lot of strong forces pushing kids onto the streets in the slums. When you're among citizens, when you've grown up among people who expect school to be a thing, when you've got more of a support system, when the whole village is there to help, the scales balance a little differently. Despite the murex trade, our village still isn't particularly wealthy. Some of my students come from very poor families indeed... but citizens are there for other citizens, and women like Lady Claritia help their families out enough to be able to allow their girls to learn. In the slums, though..." [pc.isBimbo |Huh. That kinda makes sense. |Hm. You can see why it'd be a hard sell. ] ] "Yeah. And for a lot of the kids who still came to learn, well... it's not always very easy for a teacher to connect to someone who's so different from them. A friend of mine, Nina, was with them, and she tried. But you need time to get better at connecting to students like that sometimes, and time wasn't what they had. She managed to find ways to help some of her kiddos — the ones who could stick with it — but not everyone. And then the money ran out." [pc.isBimbo |Aww. That's kinda sad. Could they have done a better job? |So those were the problems, but... was there any way that they could have succeeded? ] Serena sips her drink before speaking again. "I don't know. There are not a lot of people inside or outside Khor'minos' slums who think that it's worthwhile to teach the children there how to read. Too many of the things that reading is useful for don't matter there.[silly | If they were all citizens, if we had ourselves a Constitutio Antoniniana, well, maybe that'd be different. And maybe not. I don't know. Did Caracalla get rid of Rome's poor? Probably not, right? Anyway. ] "When Nina's job ended, I was still in training, and we talked about what personal lessons we could take out of the whole thing. Sure, a lot of things were out of her hands, but what wasn't? What were the things that teachers could control? Nina decided that she would keep striving to find better ways to connect with her students — her new citizen students, anyway, once she got a new job. That's what it is, though. That's our job. Lying awake at night remembering how you tried to work with a child that day, how the connection didn't quite happen, how you might have messed it up, how you could have done better. And there's always something that you can do better as a teacher. That's the reason you're there: to do your best for them." [pc.bg scholar |Reminds you of [pc.isBimbo |back when you were doing book learning yourself! |academia. ] A lot of [pc.boyGirl]s learning magic take tutoring jobs, and the same sort of thing applies there, too. If you want to do well with a pupil, you have to see life from their point of view — like being a [pc.isBimbo |[pc.mf |daddy |mommy ], you know? |parent, in a way. ] |That makes sense. Kind of like being a [pc.isBimbo |[pc.mf |daddy |mommy ] |parent ], in a lot of ways. ] Was there anything else? "Just... I met some of those kids a few times. A couple of 'manders, a human, an orc, some elves. Yes, some of them are pretty rough; yes, the place they live is extremely dangerous. Anyone who goes into the slums expecting sweetness and light is in for a rude awakening. Those kids are [silly |all in the Game |living a life that's nothing like mine was as a girl ], but they're still kids[pc.bg slumrat |, just like you were ]. [flags.KM_SLUMS|When|If] you go there, keep that in mind." [pc.isBimbo |Hee hee. She thinks about kids a lot, huh? |Of course she'd focus on the kids, wouldn't she? ] She laughs and shakes her head. "All I can talk about is what I know, [pc.name]." "

rows.original: The cowgirl grins with approval. "What do I like about the atmosphere? It's laid-back, calm, relaxing. I can lose myself in the entertainment if I like, but it's not so distracting that I can't get work done down here if I want to. That enough for you?" [pc.dcbc |It'll do, you guess. Someplace as easygoing as this would, you'd have thought, made her usual reading outright soporific. |You'd think she wouldn't need much distraction to lose sight of reviewing for class or reading through what her students have written. Those things sound boring at the best of times. |Yeah, that's perfect! It's super cozy here... maybe even a little too cozy, though? Doesn't she get bored just reading and stuff? |Sure, sure. You're just surprised she can stay awake. Calm's one thing, but calm plus reading her students' work sounds downright sleep-inducing. You personally need something stimulating if your mind is going to stay occupied. ] "It's less boring than you'd think," she insists playfully. "Sometimes a little music is the right stuff to set my mind at ease; I can go through some of this material very quickly if the minstrel starts to sing the right song. It just keeps my mind on-task and rolling, you know?" [pc.isBimbo |If she says so! And, um, you guess she does say so! Did say so. Yeah. That. Um, what were you talking about? Serena puts her hand up to her mouth and only partially covers her smile. "The music, sweetie." Oh right! It's nice. |You'll take her word for it on the being focused part, but you will agree that the music is very tasteful. ] "Just like most of the stuff about this place, you know? It's cozy. The patrons are friendly, not pushy. It's pretty great that Vitra's managed to keep the place humming like she has; I know a lot of the quarantine stuff has people worried, but in here, at least, it's easy to stay nice and calm. I don't remember the last time I even saw a bar fight!" [pc.isBimbo |Phew, that's a relief! ]So the only fighty stuff in here is the art? Serena laughs. "That's right! I'd love to meet the artist she hired to paint the walls. Whoever did the job made those 'manders really come alive. Heroic poses and rippling muscles don't go amiss in a time of war, that's for sure!"[serena.relationshipRange 2 | She lowers her head and peers over the top of her glasses at you[pc.toneRange 60 | and your own well-muscled physique. "If, you know, you catch my drift, big [pc.mf |guy |girl ]. You belong there as much as they do..." |, and the corner of her mouth quirks up ever so slightly. "Then again, I like your look even better. Maybe they should paint you on the taphouse walls!" ] He[pc.isBimbo |e hee |h ]. Down, girl. It is good art, though. | You can see the appeal, for sure. ] [pc.isBimbo |Plus the paintings have both moos and manders, like they're all together and stuff! |And the frescos have both Minoan motifs and 'mander ones: a meshing of local tradition and a few friendly imports. ] "Exactly! Everybody's got to celebrate where they came from, and Khor'minos has people from all over the world. That's one of the other nice things about the taphouse: I can just people-watch and see folks of all kinds of races wandering about. [pc.ra minotaur cowgirl |And thanks to you, I've even met a surfacer [pc.mf |bull |cow ] now, too! |Not least of whom is [serena.relationshipRange 1 2 |my good friend [pc.name] |my very own [pc.race] [pc.name] |a certain[pc.dcbc | | valiant | sweet | charming ] [pc.race] ], of course! ]"
rows.translation: 那位女牛仔满意地笑了起来：“我喜欢这种氛围在哪里呢？它轻松自在，宁静而舒适。如果我想的话，可以完全沉浸在娱乐中；但同时，这种环境也不会分散我的注意力，让我无法在需要时继续工作。这样你满意了吗？ [pc.dcbc |应该也差不多吧。在一个如此轻松自在的地方，你可能会认为，她平时读的书应该会让她感到昏昏欲睡才对。 |你可能会认为，她根本不需要什么干扰，就很难专心复习功课或仔细阅读学生们写的东西。这些事情，就算在最好的情况下，也听起来很无聊吧。 |是啊，简直太完美了！这里简直太舒适了……不过，也许有点太舒适了吧？她光是读书之类的活动，不会觉得无聊吗？ |当然，当然。你只是觉得她能保持清醒有点不可思议而已。保持冷静是一回事，但一边保持冷静一边批改学生的作业，这简直会让人昏昏欲睡。如果你想让自己的大脑保持活跃，就需要一些能刺激自己的事物才行。 ] 其实并没有你想象中那么无聊，”她俏皮地坚持说道，“有时候，一点音乐就能让我放松下来；如果有歌手开始唱合适的歌曲，我就能很快地完成这些工作了。这样的环境能让我的注意力更加集中，你知道的吧？ [pc.isBimbo |如果她这么说了，那就这么吧！嗯，你猜她确实这么说了……确实这么说了。对，就是这个……嗯，你刚才在说什么来着？ 塞蕾娜把手放在嘴边，只是部分地遮住了自己的笑容：“音乐啊，亲爱的。” 哦，对啦！音乐确实很棒。 |关于她所说的“游戏内容非常专注”这一点，你或许会相信她的话；但你也必须承认，这些音乐确实非常出色。 ] 就像这个地方的其他方方面面一样，你知道的？这里很舒适，顾客们也很友善，不会强行推销什么。薇特拉能够让这个地方一直运转得这么好，真的非常了不起。我知道很多关于隔离的政策让大家都很担心，但至少在这里，人们可以保持平静和安宁。我甚至都不记得上一次在这里看到酒吧里发生斗殴是什么时候了！ [pc.isBimbo |呼，总算松了一口气！ ]所以这里唯一具有战斗氛围的东西就是这些壁画吗？ 塞蕾娜笑了起来：“没错！我真的很想见见她雇来绘制这些壁画的艺术家。不管是谁做的，这些壁画确实把那些英雄形象表现得栩栩如生。在战争时期，英勇的姿态和隆起的肌肉线条确实非常合适，这一点毫无疑问！[serena.relationshipRange 2 | 她低下头，透过眼镜的镜片看着你。[pc.toneRange 60 | 还有你那结实有力的体魄。“如果你明白我的意思的话，就是说[pc.mf |伙计 |女孩 ]你和他们一样，也属于那里…… |她的嘴角微微上扬，露出一丝笑意：“不过说实话，我更喜欢你的样子。也许他们应该把你画得更漂亮一些。你就贴在酒馆的墙上！ ] 他[pc.isBimbo |嘿嘿 |h ]。 下来吧，姑娘。它是不过，这确实是一件很棒的艺术品。 | 你肯定能看出其中的吸引力所在。 ] [pc.isBimbo |而且这些画作上既有牛叫声，也有吼声，就好像所有这些声音都是同时出现的那样！ |这些壁画既包含了米诺斯文化的元素，也融入了一些外来风格：当地传统与外来影响的完美结合。 ] 正是这样！每个人都应该庆祝自己的家乡，而科尔米诺斯汇聚了来自世界各地的人们。这也是这家酒馆的另一个优点：我可以观察周围的人，看到各种各样种族的人在这里穿梭往来。 [pc.ra minotaur cowgirl |多亏了你，我甚至还认识了一个“表面人物”。 [pc.mf |公牛 |母牛 ]现在也是！ |其中尤其包括[serena.relationshipRange 1 2 |我的好朋友[pc.name] |我自己的[pc.race] [pc.name] |某个[pc.dcbc | | 勇敢的 | 甜美 | 迷人 ] [pc.race] ]当然可以！ ]"

rows.original: "Vitra? She's an absolute sweetheart, and she's made me feel very welcome. I'm glad I was able to find a room here — the atmosphere's very comfy, and the drinks are quite nice!" [pc.isBimbo |She's got two kinds of drinks, right? Which does she like better? |So, does she favor the lager or the rosé? ] "I'm more of a rosé girl, but the lager's still nice! It's got a little citrus in it, I think? I don't know how. Whatever magic she did to make all that happen must be pretty crazy!" She puts down her cup. "I try not to overindulge, and I only drink tea during the school day, but if I'm at the taphouse, it'd be silly not to take a little advantage of a sweet 'mander and her tasty drinks, right?" Right. "Besides," she says[vitra.rel123 | ruefully, "sometimes I need these drinks when I'm reading the girls' compositions." |, "I see you get to empty the tap all on your own! That's got to be a lot of fun — no wonder you keep coming back! Welcome under the mountains, where even the 'manders get milked!" | with a wink, "I hear she's taking advantage of you, too. [vitra.isMom |And it's for the better — the two of you make such a lovely couple, and I bet your little [var1|manderlings are just the cutest things|one is the cutest thing]!" [pc.isDK | |Aww. She's very sweet herself. ]Big fan of adorable children, hmm? "And adorable [pc.mf |parent |mama ]s, of course. You two are going to do great!" She grins. "But yeah, children are fantastic. Why else do you think I enjoy being a teacher so much? Not every teacher likes kids, but I think the ones who don't like them aren't very good at the job!" Maybe you'll have to see if there's some way she can end up teaching your little fireball[var1|s], then[pc.isBimbo |! |. ] Serena sighs happily. "Oh, that's an idea I'll never get out of my head now." |Look at you, making her swoon. She just lights up whenever you walk through those butterfly doors!" [serena.relationshipRange 2 |[pc.isBimbo |Hee hee. You like making pretty ladies |What can you say? You've got a knack for making beautiful women ] very, very happy. "[serena.fucked |You certainly do |Is that right? Maybe you should show me sometime ]," she purrs. |[pc.isBimbo |Yess! You love when she does that. |Hey, you do what you can. ] "Well, keep it up! She deserves someone who can make her happy." ] ] ]
rows.translation: “薇特拉？她真是个甜心，让我感到非常受欢迎。我很庆幸能在这里找到房间——这里气氛很舒适，饮品也很不错！” [pc.isBimbo |她有两种饮料，对吧？她更喜欢哪一种？ |那么，她更喜欢拉格啤酒还是桃红葡萄酒？ ] “我更喜欢桃红葡萄酒，但拉格啤酒也不错！我觉得里面有一点柑橘味？真不知道她怎么办到的。不管她施了什么魔法才弄出这一切，肯定都相当疯狂！”她放下杯子。“我尽量不喝得过量，学校上课的日子也只喝茶；不过既然来到酒馆，不稍微享用一下那位可爱火蜥蜴和她的美味饮品，岂不是很傻？” 没错。 “况且，”她说道[vitra.rel123 |，语气中带着无奈，“有时批阅姑娘们的作文，我确实需要这些酒。” |，“我看你能独自把酒龙头里的东西全都喝光！一定很有趣吧——难怪你总会回来！欢迎来到群山之下，在这里，就连火蜥蜴也会被挤奶！” |，同时朝你眨了眨眼，“我听说她也在占你的便宜。[vitra.isMom |不过这反倒是件好事——你们俩真是可爱的一对，我敢说，你们的小[var1|火蜥蜴宝宝们一定可爱极了|家伙一定可爱极了]！” [pc.isDK | |啊。她自己也很贴心。 ]看来你非常喜欢可爱的孩子，对吧？ “当然也喜欢可爱的[pc.mf |家长 |妈妈 ]。你们俩会做得很棒！”她笑了起来。“不过没错，孩子们很棒。不然你以为我为什么这么喜欢当老师？不是每位老师都喜欢孩子，但我觉得不喜欢孩子的人根本当不好老师！” 或许你得看看，有没有办法让她来教你的小火球[var1|们]呢[pc.isBimbo |！ |。 ] 塞蕾娜幸福地叹了口气。“哦，这个念头现在再也无法从我脑中赶走了。” |瞧瞧你，把她迷得神魂颠倒。每当你穿过那扇蝴蝶门，她整个人都会容光焕发！” [serena.relationshipRange 2 |[pc.isBimbo |嘻嘻。你喜欢让漂亮姑娘们 |你还能说什么？你就是很擅长让美丽的女人 ]变得非常、非常幸福。 “[serena.fucked |你确实很擅长 |是吗？也许哪天该让我见识一下 ]，”她柔声说道。 |[pc.isBimbo |好耶！你喜欢她这样说。 |嘿，你只是尽力而为。 ] “那就继续保持！她值得拥有一个能让她幸福的人。” ] ] ]

rows.original: "You know, Signia's a small village, and most of us just fish... but you'd be surprised how much money passes through anyway." [pc.isBimbo |How come? Do they have, like, special pricey fish or something? |Why's that? Are some of the fish particularly rare and expensive? ] "Well, yes," Serena says, "but also no. We do have a good catch most days — ling, sole, anchovies, sardines, mackerel, cod, tuna, depending on how far out you go — and there are plenty of nice specimens that get bought up by the rural gentry and Khor'minos' well-to-do for a decent price." [pc.isBimbo |Wow. And all of those fishies come from underground? |It's kind of amazing that they can find all that in the underground rivers. ] She winces. "Oh no. Underground fish, at least in our area, taste like candles. Just... nastiness. No, instead of fishing in the Liris, we row out the cavern mouths in small boats and cast nets into the bay. That way, there's plenty to catch and plenty to actually eat — or use for other things. Like how we make our own fish sauce, the garum, from fish intestines. Every village in this part of Savarra has their own garum mixture, because of the different fish that live near each one; I've never tasted most of them, but the fishers all say that out of all the varieties, our garum does an especially good business here in Khor'minos." [party.comp brint brienne |"Damn straight," Brint chuckles. "It's the good stuff." |"It doooooes," sighs Brienne. "Just about the tastiest fish sauce you'll ever have." ] O[pc.isBimbo |ooh! |h? ] What's it go best with? "Well, it's very savory[silly |, basically like MSG ], so it works in a lot of things. Garum makes porridge into something that doesn't taste like sawdust and sadness, for example. But depending on which fish go into it, and how exotically it's prepared, you can get something extremely special fit only for the finest dishes. I've heard of whole feast tables just completely covered by tureens of different kinds of stews, each with its own flavor of garum for character, at the feasts that the richest nobles hold." You might need to see if you can get into one of those parties yourself and let her know if the rumors are true. "I'll hold you to that!" she says cheerfully. "[serena.relationshipRange 1 |And I look forward to living vicariously through you. Give me every last detail! |They're not really for the likes of me, anyway. ] At any rate, anyway, the catch makes for good business, garum and otherwise!" [pc.isBimbo |Okay, s |S ]o, the village is [pc.isBimbo |all right |fairly well-off ], but the whole place smells like fish.[flags.RYN_MARKET | Reminds you of a certain part of the Winter City.[party.has Cait | "An extra-tasty part!" Cait chirps. [pc.isBimbo |Hee hee. She likes fishy dishies! |True enough. ] ] ] Do they do anything else in Signia, or does the daily catch alone keep everybody busy? "[silly |I mean, it's called a fishing village for a reason. That said, t |T ]here's plenty of other bounty in the sea if you know where to look," Serena says with a conspiratorial wink. "A few people try pearl diving, too.[silly | Both kinds of pearl diving, if you know what I mean. ] But what's even more lucrative is... well... in the waters around the mouth of the Liris, you can find these little snails. They don't taste particularly good — I've heard — but if you collect hundreds of them together and, uh, 'milk' them in a special process, you can get a pigment that makes for a very beautiful purple dye. It's so expensive that it's only used by the most ostentatious and wealthy — like some of the nobles, who use it to shade their robes. [var0 |Or, you know, by Champions!" [pc.isBimbo |Oooh, right! The cloak they gave you is such a pretty color. There's lots and lots of money in there! |You're still kind of amazed that such an expensive dye comes from a fishing village on the edge of the realm. ] She snorts gently. "Yeah, that's the main reason we stick around: the money in the pigment trade. Lady Claritia makes a lot of money off dyes and clothes, and you can totally see why. The result was pretty spectacular, right? That perfect, lush shade of purple doesn't come by anywhere in Savarra other than from our murex snails. Even the counterfeiters — and there are a lot of counterfeiters — can't get it exactly right. It's absolutely gorgeous." For sure. "At any rate: yes, we have a few of the great and good living among us in our little village. Lady Claritia's all right. It's definitely a big confidence booster to know that she's happy with the way I teach her daughter. She's got options for how her daughter learns, but I guess she likes me enough to not feel like she needs them! |If you can get yourself one of those purple robes, or maybe a cloak, you're definitely somebody in Khor'minos!" [pc.isBimbo |Wait, p |P ]urple's not that difficult of a dye to find... "It's not just 'purple', it's this particular shade of purple. It's hard to describe without showing you an example, but it's wonderfully lush. See it on someone's clothes in the street, and you know that they're an important person with hawks burning a hole in their purse... maybe even a senator. And that makes the woman who buys all the snails and makes all the dye — Lady Claritia, Marciana's mom — the wealthiest person in Signia. Still lets me teach her daughter, though, instead of sending her to a tutor. Which is a big confidence booster." She grins. [var1 | |Huh. [pc.isBimbo |Well, you do like purple! Maybe if this is a special purple, it would look nice on you. Is there a way for you to get some of that dye? |If there's that much money in purple dye, and if it looks that nice, you might want to have some for yourself. You don't suppose it would be possible for you to get your own hands on some of those snails or their pigment. ] "It'd be tricky! Signia's a long way away, and we all fled for Khor'minos when the fighting started. New supplies of dye haven't been coming in for a long time. Then again, given how many caravans had to be abandoned out in the Undermountain by evacuees, who knows? Tell you what — find anything out in the caverns that looks like it might be the right pigment, and I'll fill you in! I've spent enough time around those snails to know for certain." [var2] ] ]
rows.translation: 你知道，西格尼亚只是一个小村庄，我们大多数人都以捕鱼为生……但你会惊讶于，竟然有这么多钱会流经这个地方。 [pc.isBimbo |怎么会这样？难道他们有什么特别贵重的鱼之类的东西吗？ |为什么呢？是不是有些鱼特别稀有，因此价格也很高？ ] 嗯，可以说吧，”塞蕾娜回答道，“但也不能完全确定。大多数时候，我们的收获确实不错——有鳎鱼、鳎鳎鱼、凤尾鱼、沙丁鱼、鲭鱼、鳕鱼、金枪鱼，具体能捕到什么取决于我们出海的距离。而且，有很多品质上乘的鱼会被乡下的贵族和科尔米诺斯那些有钱人以不错的价格买走。 [pc.isBimbo |哇，那些鱼都是从地下钻出来的吗？ |他们在地下河流中找到了所有那些东西，这真的相当不可思议。 ] 她皱起了眉头：“哦不。在我们这个地区，地下的鱼吃起来简直就像蜡烛一样……太难吃了。所以，我们不会在利里斯河里捕鱼，而是会乘小船驶到洞穴的入口处，然后把网撒进海湾里。这样，我们既能捕到很多鱼，也能吃到足够的食物——或者把鱼用来做其他事情。就像我们用鱼肠来制作自己的鱼露一样，每个萨瓦拉地区的村庄都有自己独特的鱼露配方，因为这些地方生活的鱼类种类各不相同。虽然我大多数时候都没有尝过这些不同的鱼露，但渔民们都说，在整个科尔米诺斯地区，我们制作的鱼露销量尤其好。” [party.comp brint brienne |当然了，”布林特笑着说，“这可是好东西。 |确实如此，”布蕾妮叹息道，“这可能是你尝过最美味的鱼露了。 ] [pc.isBimbo |哦！ |哦？ ]什么食物搭配它最好吃呢？ “嗯，它搭配任何咸味食物都非常美味。[silly |基本上就跟味精一样。 ]因此，它在很多方面都能发挥作用。例如，鱼露能让粥变得不再有锯末般的味道，也不会让人感到沮丧。不过，根据所使用的鱼种以及制作方法的不同，最终得到的调味品可能会变得极其特别，只适合用于最高级的菜肴中。我听说过，在那些最富有的贵族举办的宴会上，整张宴桌都会摆满各式各样的炖菜，每道菜都搭配了不同风味的鱼露，以此来凸显其独特风味。 你或许可以试着参加这样的聚会，然后告诉她这些传言是否属实。 我可要你说到做到哦！”她开心地说道。[serena.relationshipRange 1 |我非常期待能通过你来体验这一切。请把每一个细节都告诉我吧！ |这些东西其实并不适合像我这样的人。 ]无论如何，这种限制反而带来了良好的商业机会，无论是加鲁姆还是其他产品来说都是如此！ [pc.isBimbo |好的，明白了。 |S ]哦，这个村庄真是[pc.isBimbo |好的。 |生活相当富裕 ]不过整个地方都弥漫着鱼腥味。[flags.RYN_MARKET | 这让人不禁联想到冬城的某个场景。[party.has Cait | 还有特别美味的部分哦！”凯特兴奋地说道。 [pc.isBimbo |嘻嘻，她喜欢吃鱼腥味的菜肴呢！ |确实如此。 ] ] ]在西格尼亚，他们还会做其他事情吗？还是仅仅依靠每天的捕捞工作就已经让大家都忙得不可开交了？[silly |我的意思是，它就是被叫做渔村这是有原因的。话虽如此，t |T ]只要你知道去哪里找，海里还有很多其他的宝藏呢，”塞蕾娜眨着眼睛，神秘地说道，“也有不少人尝试去潜水采珍珠呢。[silly | 这两种跳水方式，你应该明白我的意思吧。 ]但更赚钱的是……嗯……在莉里斯河口附近的水域里，你可以找到这些小蜗牛。我听说它们的味道并不是特别好，但如果你收集上百只，然后通过一种特殊的工艺提取它们的汁液，就能得到一种非常漂亮的紫色染料。这种染料价格昂贵，只有那些最奢华、最富有的阶层才会使用——比如一些贵族，他们会用它来给自己的长袍上色。 [var0 |或者，用冠军们的方式来表达吧！ [pc.isBimbo |哦，对啦！他们给你的那件斗篷颜色真漂亮，里面装了好多好多钱呢！ |你仍然感到十分惊讶——如此昂贵的染料，竟然源自这个位于边境偏远渔村的产地。 ] 她轻哼了一声：“没错，这就是我们继续留在这里的主要原因：颜料交易带来的丰厚利润。克拉丽蒂娅夫人从染料和服装生意中赚了很多钱，这一点大家都能看出来。最终得到的成果也确实相当惊人，不是吗？在萨瓦拉地区，除了我们的穆雷克斯蜗牛之外，根本找不到这种完美而浓郁的紫色。就连那些伪造者——而且伪造者非常多——也无法准确地复制出这种颜色。这种紫色实在是美得令人惊叹。当然。 “无论如何，是的，我们这个小村庄里确实有一些品德高尚、值得尊敬的人。克拉丽蒂亚女士就是其中之一。知道她对我教导她女儿的方式感到满意，确实让我感到非常欣慰。她有很多选择来决定女儿的学习方式，但我想她应该挺喜欢我的，所以觉得没有必要使用这些方法吧！ |如果你能弄到一件那样的紫色长袍，或者是一件斗篷，那你在科尔米诺斯绝对会备受重视的！ [pc.isBimbo |等等，p…… |P ]紫色并不适合那个这种颜色真的很难找到……” “不是普通的‘紫色’，而是这种特别的紫色色调。不给你看例子的话真的很难描述，但这种颜色看起来非常浓郁、非常漂亮。只要在街上看到有人穿着这种颜色的衣服，你就会立刻知道这个人一定很有地位，肯定很有钱。……甚至可能成为一名参议员。这样一来，那位收购所有蜗牛并负责制作所有染料的女性——克拉丽蒂娅夫人，也就是马西亚娜的母亲——就成为了西格尼亚最富有的人。不过，她还是允许我教她的女儿，而不是送她去请家教。这确实让人信心大增。”她笑着说。 [var1 | |哈。 [pc.isBimbo |嗯，你确实像紫色一样！也许如果这是一种特别的紫色，它会很适合你。有没有办法让你得到一些这种染料呢？ |如果紫色染料真的能带来这么多好处，而且它的颜色也那么漂亮，那你或许应该考虑自己也弄一些吧。你难道不觉得想办法弄到那些蜗牛或者它们的染料也是可行的吗？ ] 这可真是个麻烦事！西格尼亚离我们这里很远，而且战斗开始时我们都逃到了科尔米诺斯。已经很久没有新的染料供应进来了。不过，考虑到有那么多商队被撤离者在地下山脉中丢弃，谁知道呢？这样吧——如果你在洞穴里找到任何看起来可能是那种染料的物质，我就告诉你全部情况！我在那些地方待了太久，所以很确定。 [var2] ] ]

rows.original: "There's something about teaching that's... umm... addictive." [pc.isBimbo |Wait, they're just kids! "No, dear." Serena shakes her head. "Not dick. Addictive. It's something that can be so fun that it's hard to stop doing it." Oh riiiight. You know all about that. But how does that work with teaching? |How's that? Seems like an awful lot of work to you. Is she just a glutton for punishment? Serena chuckles. "Maybe a little — okay, more than a little. But no, whenever something just clicks for your students it strikes a little spark inside you, and that feels so unbelievably special. Can I give you an example?" By all means. ] "A few months ago, the girls and I were reading through part of 'The Wonders Beyond the Sands' — it's an old Belharan story about the magical lands they imagined lay east of Jassira, on the other side of the shifting dunes and the great salt desert." [pc.bg scholar |[pc.isBimbo |Wait, you think you remember that one! Isn't it the one with the camel monster thingy? Gosh, it was super tricky to remember. It's probably tricky for the girls to remember it too, right? |The adventures of Derkyllis and Mantinias! You remember it well. That's a tricky story to work through, with all of the nested stories and converging plotlines. ] "It is! But I knew that my kiddos could handle it. After all, Mariniana's dreamed up romances twice as twisty between some of her classmates." [pc.isBimbo |That's adorable! |Girl needs to get out more. ] "On that we can agree," Serena laughs. "But anyway, we're reading through it, and we're up to the part where the ancient villain is revealed, the one behind their family being split apart." Master Paapis! The old Jassiran wizard. "Exactly! The one who shows up near the beginning of the story." |[pc.isBimbo |You've never heard that one! Is it about swords and spells and stuff? |You're not familiar with that one. It sounds like a traditional sword-and-sorcery epic. ] "Not exactly. Part of the fun is the wizardry and the duels, but most of it is about romance. Lots of twisty plotlines and love affairs. Plus, there are nested stories, where a character spins a yarn about something that happened to somebody else, and then that somebody else tells their own tale, and so on." The teacher wipes her brow exaggeratedly. "It's honestly a difficult story to read! But I knew that my girls could handle it, even if it stretched their abilities a bit." Huh. So how'd they do with it? "So, I don't want to spoil it for you too much. Let's just say that the villain's identity is a bit of a secret for most of the story — but if you're a careful reader, you can figure it out quickly." ] She puts a judicious finger to her lips. "We'd been working on foreshadowing before, with the usual mix of struggles and successes, and Euclia in particular was having some trouble reading closely enough to interpret all the clues. But right before the big reveal, she stopped me cold and guessed everything completely right! Mari started arguing with her, but this time Euclia was able to lay out most of the facts — and I helped her fill in a few blanks." [pc.isCunning |Oooh, nice. You love doing that with stories, too. Working out the puzzle and all that is some of the most fun you can have standing up. It's awesome that she was able to manage it. |Good for her! That's really very clever. ] "Mmhmm! "Of course, that meant that the girls spent the rest of the week saying that every single new detail in the story was foreshadowing, which... got a little old. But they eventually got things straight." Ah, kids. You gotta love 'em. "You really do."
rows.translation: 教学这件事，有点……嗯……让人上瘾的意味。 [pc.isBimbo |等等，他们毕竟还是孩子啊！” “不，亲爱的。”塞蕾娜摇了摇头，“不是‘恶作剧’，而是‘上瘾’。有些事情会让人觉得非常有趣，以至于让人忍不住一直去做。” 哦，原来如此。你对此倒是很了解嘛。但那么，这和教学又有什么关系呢？ |怎么样？对你来说，这似乎是一项非常繁琐的工作。她是不是就是个喜欢自找麻烦的人呢？ 塞蕾娜轻笑了一声：“也许吧——好吧，其实不止是有点。但是，当你的学生突然对某件事产生兴趣时，你内心也会产生一种共鸣，这种感觉真的非常特别。我可以给你举个例子吗？” 当然可以。 ] 几个月前，我和那些女孩一起读过《沙丘之谜》中的部分内容——那是一个关于贝尔哈兰古老传说的故事，讲述了人们想象中存在于贾西拉以东、那些被流动的沙丘和广阔的盐漠所隔开的神秘之地。 [pc.bg scholar |[pc.isBimbo |等等，你居然记得那个故事！不是那个有骆驼怪物情节的故事吗？天啊，要记住它真的挺难的。对女孩子来说，记住这个游戏应该也挺不容易的吧？ |德基利斯与曼蒂尼亚斯的冒险故事！你一定对它记忆犹新。这个故事结构复杂，充满了层层嵌套的故事与交汇的剧情线，确实读起来相当费神。 ] 确实如此！但我相信我的孩子们能够应付得来。毕竟，马里尼亚娜曾经编过一些情节曲折得多的关于她同学们的故事呢。 [pc.isBimbo |太可爱了！ |女孩应该多出去走走。 ] 在这个问题上我们确实可以达成一致，”塞蕾娜笑着说，“不过无论如何，我们正在仔细阅读这个故事，现在已经读到那个古老的反派角色被揭露出来的部分了——也就是那个导致他们家族分崩离析的幕后黑手。” “帕皮斯大师！那个古老的贾西兰巫师。” “没错！就是那个在故事开头就出现的角色。 |[pc.isBimbo |你从来没听过这样的故事吧！它是关于剑、魔法之类的东西的吗？ |你对那个不太熟悉吧。听起来像是一部传统的剑与魔法史诗。 ] 不完全是。故事的一部分乐趣在于那些魔法与决斗场景，但最重要的是浪漫故事充满了曲折的剧情线和爱情故事。此外，其中还包含了嵌套的故事结构：某个角色会讲述发生在别人身上的事情，然后那个人又会继续讲述自己的故事，以此类推。”老师夸张地擦了擦额头。说实话，这个故事确实有点难以理解……但我相信我的女儿们能够读懂它，即使这个故事超出了她们的理解能力。” “嗯，那她们最终读懂了吗？” “嗯，我也不想太剧透吧…… 可以这么说，在故事的大部分情节中，反派的真实身份其实是个谜——但如果你是个细心的读者，很快就能猜出来。 ]她轻轻地把手指放在嘴唇上：“之前我们一直在尝试设置一些伏笔，过程中既有挫折也有成功，尤其是欧克莉亚，她一度很难仔细分析这些线索并理解其中的意思。但在真相揭晓之前，她突然停下了我，然后准确地猜出了所有答案！玛丽开始和她争论，但这一次欧克莉亚能够说明大部分事实——而我则帮她填补了一些遗漏的部分。 [pc.isCunning |哦，太好了。你也很喜欢在故事中加入这样的元素，解开谜题之类的环节确实是最有趣的部分了。她能够成功完成这些，真是太棒了。 |她真棒！这个主意真是太聪明了。 ] 嗯，我当时感到非常自豪。而且我还觉得，这一点甚至有助于解释之前那个令人困惑的场景。[pc.bg scholar | — 你知道的，就是那个有乌鸦的…… ]两个女孩都惊呼出声：“塞蕾娜小姐，太[silly |砸烂 |疯狂的 ]天啊！”她把手放在胸口，开心地叹了口气。“教学其实就是这样的。很多内容确实需要记忆，这也没关系。但当你教授技能时，你其实并不是在强迫他们去学习，而是在帮助他们自己找到将这些知识整合起来的方法。当她们最终弄明白的时候，真的……简直就像魔法一样。 “当然，这也意味着那些女孩在接下来的一周里一直在说故事里每一个新的细节其实都是伏笔，这……有点让人觉得烦人了。不过最终她们还是把事情弄清楚了。啊，孩子们，你们真的得喜欢它们才行。” “你们确实应该喜欢。
rows.raw: " "There's something about teaching that's... umm... addictive." [pc.isBimbo |Wait, they're just kids! "No, dear." Serena shakes her head. "Not dick. Addictive. It's something that can be so fun that it's hard to stop doing it." Oh riiiight. You know all about that. But how does that work with teaching? |How's that? Seems like an awful lot of work to you. Is she just a glutton for punishment? Serena chuckles. "Maybe a little — okay, more than a little. But no, whenever something just clicks for your students it strikes a little spark inside you, and that feels so unbelievably special. Can I give you an example?" By all means. ] "A few months ago, the girls and I were reading through part of 'The Wonders Beyond the Sands' — it's an old Belharan story about the magical lands they imagined lay east of Jassira, on the other side of the shifting dunes and the great salt desert." [pc.bg scholar |[pc.isBimbo |Wait, you think you remember that one! Isn't it the one with the camel monster thingy? Gosh, it was super tricky to remember. It's probably tricky for the girls to remember it too, right? |The adventures of Derkyllis and Mantinias! You remember it well. That's a tricky story to work through, with all of the nested stories and converging plotlines. ] "It is! But I knew that my kiddos could handle it. After all, Mariniana's dreamed up romances twice as twisty between some of her classmates." [pc.isBimbo |That's adorable! |Girl needs to get out more. ] "On that we can agree," Serena laughs. "But anyway, we're reading through it, and we're up to the part where the ancient villain is revealed, the one behind their family being split apart." Master Paapis! The old Jassiran wizard. "Exactly! The one who shows up near the beginning of the story." |[pc.isBimbo |You've never heard that one! Is it about swords and spells and stuff? |You're not familiar with that one. It sounds like a traditional sword-and-sorcery epic. ] "Not exactly. Part of the fun is the wizardry and the duels, but most of it is about romance. Lots of twisty plotlines and love affairs. Plus, there are nested stories, where a character spins a yarn about something that happened to somebody else, and then that somebody else tells their own tale, and so on." The teacher wipes her brow exaggeratedly. "It's honestly a difficult story to read! But I knew that my girls could handle it, even if it stretched their abilities a bit." Huh. So how'd they do with it? "So, I don't want to spoil it for you too much. Let's just say that the villain's identity is a bit of a secret for most of the story — but if you're a careful reader, you can figure it out quickly." ] She puts a judicious finger to her lips. "We'd been working on foreshadowing before, with the usual mix of struggles and successes, and Euclia in particular was having some trouble reading closely enough to interpret all the clues. But right before the big reveal, she stopped me cold and guessed everything completely right! Mari started arguing with her, but this time Euclia was able to lay out most of the facts — and I helped her fill in a few blanks." [pc.isCunning |Oooh, nice. You love doing that with stories, too. Working out the puzzle and all that is some of the most fun you can have standing up. It's awesome that she was able to manage it. |Good for her! That's really very clever. ] "Mmhmm! I was extremely proud. And then I pointed out that that even helped explain an earlier confusing scene[pc.bg scholar | — you know, the one with the crows — ] and both girls just gasped. 'Miss Serena, that's so [silly |whack |crazy ]!' Gosh." She puts her hand to her chest and sighs happily. "That's the thing about teaching. A lot of it is memorization, and that's fine. But when you're teaching skills, you're not really 'making' them learn. You're just helping them figure out how to put the pieces together on their own. And it's... it's magical when they finally do it. "Of course, that meant that the girls spent the rest of the week saying that every single new detail in the story was foreshadowing, which... got a little old. But they eventually got things straight." Ah, kids. You gotta love 'em. "You really do." "

rows.original: "It didn't feel like it a decade ago when it was happening to me, but... teenage romance is actually pretty adorable," Serena chuckles. "Frustrating, sometimes, when they awkwardly dance around without just saying how they feel[serena.relationshipRange 2 | — not that I ought to be casting the first stone here! |. ] But definitely adorable." [silly |So, what, she ships her older students? |Does she play matchmaker for the older girls, then? ] It'd probably be easy to get some of [pc.isBimbo |her cuties |them ] to pair off. "No!" She turns scarlet. "I... I don't think that that would be right. But, um, I do have to keep their relationships in mind when I do pair them off. And I have to do it a lot!" Wait, why does she have to do that? "Oh! Uh, there are plenty of reasons to have the girls get in small groups." She holds out a fist and, starting with her thumb, flips out her fingers one by one. "I group them to read with each other, to study with each other, to help each other with longer compositions, to make offerings to the Seven — that sort of thing. And nine times out of ten, it's totally innocuous and they just do their work with a little bit of getting-on-each-others'-nerves. But sometimes, when it's just two girls who've been feeling some feelings, sparks that might otherwise get blown out with everything that happens as a whole class can get fanned into full flame. Again, not that I'm actually trying to do that. It's just a thing that happens naturally, whether I want it to or not." [pc.isBimbo |Riiiiight. Hee hee. Does she keep letting girlfriends work together after they become girlfriends? Cause you might get suuuuper distracted if that were you. |Oh, sure, sure. At any rate, once a pair is dating, she stops letting them work together, right? Because of distractions and such? ] Serena gently bobs her head from side to side. "It depends. There's no hard and fast rule. Some girls will still work well together even when they're seeing each other; some won't. And there are a lot of other reasons that go into the choice. 'Are they going to work well together' is the big one, obviously. Are they going to get something special out of the other girls' expertise? Do they need to get some more experience working with the girls they don't know as well? It goes on and on, and just like all the other parts of teaching, it's a judgment call. "Just today, Livilla and Marciana asked to do a composition together, and I had to tell them no because I didn't think they'd give it their full attention. Then Marci got all huffy and pretended that they weren't going to just spend the whole time holding hands and giggling at each other[silly | like the most embarrassing teenage lesbian disasters ever ] and then copy some poem that they think I haven't read before." She shakes her head, more vigorously this time. "They don't know how to pay attention, and they think that I don't either." [pc.isBimbo |Awww. That's not very nice of them. |That part sounds like it would be a bit frustrating, especially if it happens a lot. ] She shrugs. "They're just being teenagers. I kind of expect them to complain when things don't go their way. Just be firm when you say no, and save the 'getting mad' for when they do something that's actually out of line." Is that a parenting tip or a teaching tip? "Six of one, half a dozen of the other!"
rows.translation: 当这种事情发生在我身上时，我当时根本不觉得已经过去十年了……不过，青涩的恋爱感情其实还挺可爱的。”塞蕾娜轻笑着说道，“只不过有时候真的很让人恼火，因为他们总是支支吾吾、拐弯抹角，就是不肯直接说出自己的感受。[serena.relationshipRange 2 | — 其实我也没资格在这里首先指责别人！ |。 ]但确实非常可爱。 [silly |所以，她是把年纪较大的学生送走了吗？ |那么，她是不是也会为那些年纪较大的女孩牵线搭桥呢？ ]获取其中的一些物品应该会相当容易。 [pc.isBimbo |她的可爱们 |他们 ]不行！”她的脸一下子变得通红。“我……我觉得那样做不太合适。但是，嗯，在为他们安排配对关系时，我确实必须考虑他们之间的关系。而且，这种工作我也经常需要做！” 等等，为什么她非得这么做呢？ 哦！嗯，让女生们分成小组是有很多原因的。”她伸出拳头，从拇指开始，逐个掰开手指，“我把她们分成小组，让她们一起阅读、一起学习，互相帮助完成那些较长的写作任务，还有向七神献祭之类的活动。十有八九，这种行为其实完全无害，大家只是会在相处过程中有些互相惹恼、互相干扰而已。但有时候，当只有两个女孩之间产生了某些情感时，那些原本可能会被整个班级的各种活动所掩盖的火花，就有可能被点燃，进而发展成激烈的感情纠葛。再说一次，其实并不是我真的尝试中要做到这一点，其实只是自然而然发生的事情罢了，无论我是否愿意这样。 [pc.isBimbo |好吧吧。呵呵，她是不是总是让女朋友们在一起工作，哪怕她们已经成为情侣了呢？因为如果你处在她的位置，肯定会分心的吧。 |哦，当然。无论如何，一旦一对情侣开始约会，她就会阻止他们继续一起工作，对吧？因为担心他们会分心之类的原因？ ] 塞蕾娜轻轻地将头从一边摇到另一边，说道：“这要看具体情况。并没有什么固定的规则。有些女孩即使在交往中，也能很好地一起工作；而有些则不行。此外，做出这个选择还涉及到很多其他因素。她们能否很好地合作，这才是关键所在。她们能否从其他女孩的专业知识中获得一些帮助？对于那些还不太熟悉的女孩，她们是否还需要积累更多的合作经验呢？这种情况一直持续着，就像教学中的其他各个方面一样，最终都取决于教师的判断。 “就在今天，利维拉和马西阿娜一起请求写一篇作文，但我不得不拒绝她们，因为我觉得她们不会全神贯注地完成这项任务。然后玛西就生气了，假装他们不会一直手拉手、互相傻笑的。[silly | 简直是青少年女同性恋者所能遭遇的最尴尬的灾难了 ]然后他们会抄一些他们认为我以前没读过的诗来给我看。”她这次摇头的动作更加激烈了，“他们根本不懂如何关注细节，也以为我同样不懂。 [pc.isBimbo |哎呀，他们这样做可真不太好。 |那部分内容听起来确实会让人感到有些沮丧，尤其是如果这种情况经常发生的话。 ] 她耸了耸肩：“他们只是处于青春期而已。当事情没有按照他们的意愿发展时，他们抱怨几句也是正常的。只要在拒绝他们的请求时态度坚决就行了，至于‘发怒’，还是等他们真的做了那些其实太过分了。” 这是育儿建议，还是教学建议呢？ “一个两个都一样！

rows.original: "I've only been teaching for a few years, but I've already had some moments with the children where I..." A few tears start to rim her eyes, and she manages to blink them away. "I, um... what I'm saying is that these kiddos are something special." [pc.isBimbo |Really? That's so sweet! Do they do stuff that makes you really happy? |[kiyoko.isFree |If teaching's even a fraction of what you've been through and continue to go through with [kiyoko.numKits 2 3 5 |your two kitsune daughters |your kits |your enormous foxen family |your daughter Kinu ], you know just how she feels. You've given a lot — lost a lot — but every time you see them, every time they do something wonderful either with you or on their own, you feel so unimaginably happy and proud. They've made your life so much better. |[pc.hasKids |None of your children is fully grown yet, but you can easily imagine what she means. |You don't have children of your own[pc.isInfertile | | yet ], but you know plenty of parents who'd probably say the same as she does. ] ] What exactly did she have in mind, though? ] Serena takes a great interest in the wood of the tabletop for several seconds before continuing. "A few of the girls came of age last year: Carina, Aelia, Lucilla. By that time, I'd been their teacher for a few years, and in that time... we went through a lot together. Laughing, crying. They got in trouble sometimes, they made breakthroughs sometimes; they learned a lot and they had at least a little bit of fun. And when you do all that, you... you..." Her voice breaks a little. "Does that... does that come close to making sense?" [pc.isBimbo |Yeah. You understand her just fine. |That's all right. You think you understand. ] "Anyway, it was our last day together, and all of a sudden, during a quiet moment in class, Aelia stood up and told me that she'd like to sing a song for me. Carina brought out some pipes, and Luci got her lyre, and then... they..." She stops again, sniffles, wipes her eyes. "They wrote a song for me, [pc.name]. A whole song. They sang about my favorite words, about the stories we read, about the history they learned. They sang about the rhyme we came up with together for remembering the Tables of Law. They sang about the time I was depressed in class because I'd had a bad date the night before, and they sang about how everybody came to cheer me up. They sang about Carina's jokes, and about how the smell of Luci's lunches always made me wrinkle my nose, and about the time Aelia tried to magically heal a chicken breast. They were so funny and sweet, they remembered everything, and by the end of it every single one of us was crying." [pc.isBimbo |That's... that's so precious... and special, just like she said! |Something like that sounds special indeed. ] She folds her hands and gazes back at you with red-rimmed eyes. "I just... during your first year, they always say that you're just trying to do your best and get the hang of things, and they're right. Sometimes it was super overwhelming, and sometimes, like I said, it got to be too much or I cried or I made mistakes and... to know that even like that, even if I didn't feel like my best was always enough, to know that they loved me and what I did enough to do something so incredibly memorable for me —" She stops, blinks away tears, and swallows. "Kids just... they have so much love in them. Sometimes they aren't the people you want them to be, but sometimes, sometimes they're just so much more than you could ever imagine." [pc.isBimbo |There, there. They sound like some of the bestest little beans. |Does she still get to see those girls? ] Serena nods. "They all still live in the village, and all of them made it to Khor'minos for the quarantine, thank the gods. Aelia is the magistrate's full-time scribe, Luci fishes with her mama, and Carina's an acolyte at the shrine of Lumia. Every so often we eat lunch together, talk about how things are going. Aelia in particular... she's always around, because we both work for Lady Eudocia, and she always asks me for girlfriend advice, which is cute because I think she's been in more steady relationships than I have at this point. I've told her that, and she laughs. I don't think she's used to talking to me as one adult to another yet, even though we have the same boss now. "It is different now, though. They... they're not my kids. And I'm not their mama. I get new students, I lose old ones. Things move on. I just —" She sighs. "I don't know." [pc.isBimbo |Still though! She makes something special with these girls. Maybe even if some of them are gonna be stinky and not be friends with their teacher, other ones will! You think she's doing a great job! |Still, whatever she did with the old ones seems like it was pretty special. And to think that she formed that kind of mentoring relationship when she wasn't her best. Imagine how the current crop of students thinks of her. ] "It's sweet of you to say that. I hope everything turns out so well. I know that I'm not perfect, and that sometimes some of the kiddos don't mesh with me; sometimes that's my fault and sometimes it isn't really something that we can solve. And a lot of the time, I'm not going to transform someone's whole life. For more than a few girls, I'm just the teacher and that's it. They learn, they take what they need to take out of the class, they move on. Even with those limitations, though, knowing that you've touched one life is powerful. More than that... well. I don't know if I have the words." [pc.isBimbo |Words are hard sometimes! You think you get it anyway. |Sometimes you don't need them. ]

|如果教学仅仅只是你曾经经历过以及仍在继续经历的一切中的一小部分的话[kiyoko.numKits 2 3 5 |你的那两个九尾狐女儿 |你的装备 |你那庞大的狐狸家族 |你的女儿小娟 ]你知道她的内心感受。你付出了很多，也失去了很多，但每次看到他们，每次看到他们无论是在你身边还是独自做着一些美好的事情，你都会感到无比的幸福和骄傲。他们让你的生活变得美好了许多。 |[pc.hasKids |你的孩子们都还没有完全长大，但你应该能很容易地理解她的意思。 |你没有自己的孩子。[pc.isInfertile | | 然而 ]不过，你知道，有很多家长可能会说出和她一样的话。 ] ]不过，她究竟有什么打算呢？ ] 塞蕾娜仔细观察了桌面木材几秒钟，然后继续说道：“去年有几位女孩到了成年年龄：卡琳娜、艾莉亚、卢西拉。在那个时候，我已经担任她们的老师有几年时间了。我们一起经历了很多。有欢笑，也有泪水。他们有时会遇到麻烦，有时也会取得突破；他们学到了很多，也至少享受了一些乐趣。而当你经历了这一切之后，你就会……你就会……”她的声音略微颤抖起来。这样……这样真的有点道理吗？ [pc.isBimbo |是的，你完全理解她的意思。 |没关系，你以为自己已经理解了。 ] 总之，那是我们在一起的最后一天，就在课堂上一个安静的时刻，艾莉亚突然站起来，告诉我她想为我唱一首歌。卡丽娜拿出了几支笛子，露西也拿出了她的竖琴，然后……她们……”她再次停了下来，抽泣着，擦了擦眼睛。他们为我写了一首歌。 [pc.name]一首完整的歌曲。他们唱到了我最喜欢的那些词语，唱到了我们共同读过的故事，唱到了他们所学到的历史知识。他们唱到了我们一起编写的那个用来记住律法的顺口溜，唱到了有次我在课堂上因为前一晚约会不顺利而情绪低落的时候，唱到了大家是如何一起来安慰我的。他们讲述了卡丽娜讲的那些笑话，也提到了卢西做的午餐总是让我皱起鼻子，还有艾莉亚试图用魔法治愈一块鸡胸肉的那些趣事。他们讲得如此有趣又温馨，把所有的事情都记得一清二楚，等到故事结束时，我们所有人都已经哭了起来。" [pc.isBimbo |那真是……太珍贵了……也太特别了，就像她说的那样！ |这样的东西听起来确实很特别。 ] 她双手交叠，眼眶泛红地注视着你。“我只是……在你第一年的时候，人们总是说你只是在尽力去适应一切，努力掌握这些技能，而他们确实是这么说的。有时候，这些压力真的让人难以承受；而有时候，就像我刚才说的，压力会变得太大，导致我哭泣或者犯错…………只是为了知道，即便如此，即便我并不总是觉得自己做得已经足够好，也只是为了知道，他们是爱我的，也足够重视我所做的事情，才会为我做出这样一件令人难以忘怀的事情……”她停了下来，眨了眨眼，将泪水忍了回去，然后继续说道。孩子们啊……他们内心充满了如此多的爱。有时候，他们可能并不是你期望成为的那种人，但有时候，他们确实会超出你所有的想象。 [pc.isBimbo |好了好了，他们听起来真是些最棒的小家伙呢。 |她还能见到那些女孩吗？ ] 塞蕾娜点了点头。“他们所有人现在都还住在村里，谢天谢地，他们都成功来到了科尔米诺斯接受隔离。艾莉亚是地方法官的专职书记员，露西和她的妈妈一起钓鱼，而卡丽娜则在卢米娅的神殿里当侍女。我们偶尔会一起吃午饭，聊聊近况。尤其是艾莉亚……她总是出现在我们身边，因为我们都为尤多西亚夫人工作，而且她总是向我请教关于恋爱的建议，这其实挺可爱的，因为我觉得在她这一方面，她的恋爱经历应该比我更加丰富吧。我已经跟她说过这件事了，可她只是笑了笑。我觉得她还没有习惯以成年人之间的方式和我交谈，尽管我们现在都是同一个上司的手下。 “这个是不过，现在情况不一样了。他们……他们已经不是我的孩子了，我也不再是他们的妈妈。我会遇到新的学生，也会失去一些老学生。生活总是在变。我只是——”她叹了口气，“我不知道该怎么办。 [pc.isBimbo |不过，她确实让这些女孩们发生了些变化。也许其中有些人会表现得很糟糕，甚至不会和老师成为朋友，但也会有一些人例外！你认为她做得非常棒！ |不过，她对那些旧物品所做的一切，似乎确实有些特别之处。而且想想看，她在自己状态还不是最好的时候，就已经建立了那种指导关系。可以想象，她后来的表现一定更加出色了。当前的有一部分学生会想起她。 ] 你这么说真是太好了。我希望一切都能顺利发展。我知道自己并不完美，有时候有些孩子和我合不来；有时候这是我的错，有时候则是一些我们无法解决的问题。很多时候，我并不能改变一个人的整个人生。对很多女孩来说，我只不过是一个老师而已。她们学习，从课堂中学到她们需要的知识，然后继续前进。不过，即便有这些限制，知道你曾经对我的生活产生过影响，这也已经足够让我感到欣慰了。一个生命是如此强大。更重要的是……嗯，我也不知道该用什么词语来形容。 [pc.isBimbo |有时候，词语真的很难表达清楚！你总以为自己已经理解了它们的含义。 |有时候，你其实并不需要它们。 ]
rows.raw: " "I've only been teaching for a few years, but I've already had some moments with the children where I..." A few tears start to rim her eyes, and she manages to blink them away. "I, um... what I'm saying is that these kiddos are something special." [pc.isBimbo |Really? That's so sweet! Do they do stuff that makes you really happy? |[kiyoko.isFree |If teaching's even a fraction of what you've been through and continue to go through with [kiyoko.numKits 2 3 5 |your two kitsune daughters |your kits |your enormous foxen family |your daughter Kinu ], you know just how she feels. You've given a lot — lost a lot — but every time you see them, every time they do something wonderful either with you or on their own, you feel so unimaginably happy and proud. They've made your life so much better. |[pc.hasKids |None of your children is fully grown yet, but you can easily imagine what she means. |You don't have children of your own[pc.isInfertile | | yet ], but you know plenty of parents who'd probably say the same as she does. ] ] What exactly did she have in mind, though? ] Serena takes a great interest in the wood of the tabletop for several seconds before continuing. "A few of the girls came of age last year: Carina, Aelia, Lucilla. By that time, I'd been their teacher for a few years, and in that time... we went through a lot together. Laughing, crying. They got in trouble sometimes, they made breakthroughs sometimes; they learned a lot and they had at least a little bit of fun. And when you do all that, you... you..." Her voice breaks a little. "Does that... does that come close to making sense?" [pc.isBimbo |Yeah. You understand her just fine. |That's all right. You think you understand. ] "Anyway, it was our last day together, and all of a sudden, during a quiet moment in class, Aelia stood up and told me that she'd like to sing a song for me. Carina brought out some pipes, and Luci got her lyre, and then... they..." She stops again, sniffles, wipes her eyes. "They wrote a song for me, [pc.name]. A whole song. They sang about my favorite words, about the stories we read, about the history they learned. They sang about the rhyme we came up with together for remembering the Tables of Law. They sang about the time I was depressed in class because I'd had a bad date the night before, and they sang about how everybody came to cheer me up. They sang about Carina's jokes, and about how the smell of Luci's lunches always made me wrinkle my nose, and about the time Aelia tried to magically heal a chicken breast. They were so funny and sweet, they remembered everything, and by the end of it every single one of us was crying." [pc.isBimbo |That's... that's so precious... and special, just like she said! |Something like that sounds special indeed. ] She folds her hands and gazes back at you with red-rimmed eyes. "I just... during your first year, they always say that you're just trying to do your best and get the hang of things, and they're right. Sometimes it was super overwhelming, and sometimes, like I said, it got to be too much or I cried or I made mistakes and... to know that even like that, even if I didn't feel like my best was always enough, to know that they loved me and what I did enough to do something so incredibly memorable for me —" She stops, blinks away tears, and swallows. "Kids just... they have so much love in them. Sometimes they aren't the people you want them to be, but sometimes, sometimes they're just so much more than you could ever imagine." [pc.isBimbo |There, there. They sound like some of the bestest little beans. |Does she still get to see those girls? ] Serena nods. "They all still live in the village, and all of them made it to Khor'minos for the quarantine, thank the gods. Aelia is the magistrate's full-time scribe, Luci fishes with her mama, and Carina's an acolyte at the shrine of Lumia. Every so often we eat lunch together, talk about how things are going. Aelia in particular... she's always around, because we both work for Lady Eudocia, and she always asks me for girlfriend advice, which is cute because I think she's been in more steady relationships than I have at this point. I've told her that, and she laughs. I don't think she's used to talking to me as one adult to another yet, even though we have the same boss now. "It is different now, though. They... they're not my kids. And I'm not their mama. I get new students, I lose old ones. Things move on. I just —" She sighs. "I don't know." [pc.isBimbo |Still though! She makes something special with these girls. Maybe even if some of them are gonna be stinky and not be friends with their teacher, other ones will! You think she's doing a great job! |Still, whatever she did with the old ones seems like it was pretty special. And to think that she formed that kind of mentoring relationship when she wasn't her best. Imagine how the current crop of students thinks of her. ] "It's sweet of you to say that. I hope everything turns out so well. I know that I'm not perfect, and that sometimes some of the kiddos don't mesh with me; sometimes that's my fault and sometimes it isn't really something that we can solve. And a lot of the time, I'm not going to transform someone's whole life. For more than a few girls, I'm just the teacher and that's it. They learn, they take what they need to take out of the class, they move on. Even with those limitations, though, knowing that you've touched one life is powerful. More than that... well. I don't know if I have the words." [pc.isBimbo |Words are hard sometimes! You think you get it anyway. |Sometimes you don't need them. ] "

rows.original: "Acting out?" Serena asks. "I mean, first of all, it doesn't happen that much. These girls are the ones who want... whose parents want them to keep learning. And they've been learning for several years now; they got their basics already with Miss Emma, and most of them have had me for over a year. We just, you know, get each other." [pc.isBimbo |Gosh, that's so nice. You try to be as sweet as you can but sometimes meanies still don't 'get' you. If only you [pc.ra minotaur cowgirl |grew up as |were ] a moo! Don't they still get mad at each other sometimes, though? |Moms and their kids know each other for a lot longer than that, and they still fight sometimes. ] "Definitely. And there are still times when a girl won't be happy with what we do, or just comes in with a bad mood, or has some other bone to pick. Nine times out of ten, though, that stuff burns itself out without much of an actual confrontation or anything." Really? "Really! Look, for the most part, it's about expectations, right? What you think you're going to get compared to what you actually get. And with school, if you don't spring any bad surprises on people, if you're completely honest with the kids and keep jogging their memory so they don't forget things, they usually don't get frustrated too much. They're used to what we do, so they can deal." [pc.isBimbo |That's a neat trick! Could she teach you how to do it? Serena laughs gently, then says, "You already know it, sweet[serena.relationshipRange 2 |heart |ie ]. You say everything that's in your head. Every time we talk, I know exactly what I'm going to get with you." Wow! It's that easy? "With an angel like you it is." Gosh. That's awesome! You never knew. Still and all, don't people have other reasons to get mad? |Huh. Fair enough, but there's plenty of conflicts that come up from things other than the expectations game. ] "That's true, too. And a lot of the rest of that is about noticing potential blow-ups or areas of discomfort early, so you can step on them before they spiral out of control. Let things fester and you're asking for trouble. You can be as nice as you like with the girls, but you have to be firm where it matters." [pc.isBimbo |Awww, you wouldn't be very good at that at all. You can't help but want to be nice to people! |Let them know what they can and can't get away with? ] She [pc.isBimbo |laughs gently and pats your hand. "Sweetie, you might actually be able to manage a classroom with just positive feelings and hugs. I'd love to see it. But the rest of us mere mortals can't quite do it. |frowns. "I guess, but I try not to think about it like that. ] Any relationship you have with someone else has a little bit of 'okay, how much do I really need to care about every little thing they say' in it. The girls are the same. Let them know that, yeah, they need to be on point with their behavior and their studies. Give them a little wiggle room from time to time to let the class breathe. Once you've got that set up, the class can really get going, with few exceptions. We've hit some bumpy spots lately because the quarantine's got everybody on edge, including the kiddos, but it's nothing too egregious." [pc.isBimbo |So does thaaaaat work for everything? Or are there still some ways for students to be stinky? |Still, there's got to be some situations that just can't be solved by reputation alone. ] [party.comp brint brienne |Brint snorts. "[pc.isBimbo |Fewer |Less often ] than you'd think, [pc.name]. Cowgirl teachers don't need to do much heavy lifting at all to keep everybody well behaved and studious. Even the little kids, both boys and girls, are pretty good when they're learning to read — pretty good for kids, anyway." "Certainly. Still, there are a few exceptions. |"I remember learning to read as part of the little-kids group," Brienne says wistfully, "and all of us were pretty well behaved. Boys, girls, everybody. Down here, teachers are pretty good at keeping kids learning without yelling!" "I appreciate that, sweetie. There are still a few exceptions, though! |"Sure. ] Sometimes you have to separate a girl out for a little bit and make sure she understands the consequences of her behavior. That's why it's nice to live where I do. Maybe a girl just gets mad one day, fine, but... it's a small village, and her parents and I know each other very well. My problem becomes her problem very, very quickly." Serena chuckles and takes another sip of her drink. "That's happened, hmm... eh, only about once or twice a season at most, sometimes not at all. It's a village. We're all in each other's business."
rows.translation: 是在装模作样吗？”塞蕾娜问道，“我的意思是，这种事情其实并不经常发生。真正想要这样做的，其实是这些女孩们父母我希望他们能够持续学习。他们已经学习了好几年了；在艾玛老师的指导下，他们已经掌握了基础知识，而其中大多数学生跟我学习也已经有一年多了。我们之间，就是那种互相理解、互相支持的关系。 [pc.isBimbo |天哪，那真是太好了。你总是尽力表现得那么友善，但有时候那些刻薄的人就是无法理解你。要是他们能……就好了。 [pc.ra minotaur cowgirl |在……的环境中长大 |是 ]哞！不过他们有时候还是会互相生气吧？ |妈妈们和自己的孩子相识的时间其实要长得多，不过他们有时候还是会吵架。 ] 当然。不过有时候，女孩子也会对我们做的事情不满意，或者心情不好，又或者有其他不满。但十有八九，这些问题最终都会自行消失，而不会真正引发什么冲突或矛盾。真的吗？” “真的！你看，大多数情况下，问题都出在人们的期望上，对吧？人们认为自己会得到什么，与实际得到的结果之间就会产生差距。而在教育方面，如果你不给孩子们带来任何意外的负面影响，如果你对孩子们完全坦诚相待，不断帮助他们巩固记忆，让他们不会忘记该学的东西，那么他们通常就不会太感到沮丧。他们已经习惯了我们的行事方式，所以他们能够应对得来。 [pc.isBimbo |这个技巧真不错！她能教你怎么做吗？ 塞蕾娜轻声笑了笑，然后说：“你其实已经会了，亲爱的。[serena.relationshipRange 2 |心 |即 ]你总是把心里想的一切都说出来。每次我们聊天，我都能清楚地知道你会说什么。” 哇！原来这么简单啊？ “对于像你这样的天使来说，确实是这样。” 天啊，太棒了！我以前完全不知道这一点。不过，人们生气的时候，难道不会有其他原因吗？ |嗯，也有道理，但很多冲突其实都是由一些与预期无关的因素引起的。 ] 没错，也是这样。而其中很多内容其实都是关于如何及早发现那些可能引发麻烦的苗头或让人感到不适的环节，这样你就可以在问题失控之前及时加以处理。如果让这些问题慢慢恶化，那可就麻烦了。你对那些女孩再友善也好，但是拥有在关键问题上必须坚定立场。 [pc.isBimbo |哎呀，你在这方面可一点都不好呢。你就是忍不住想要对别人好嘛！ |让他们知道哪些事情是可以做的，哪些事情是不能被容忍的吧？ ] 她[pc.isBimbo |她轻声笑着，拍了拍你的手：“亲爱的，也许你真的能够仅凭积极的情绪和拥抱来管理一个班级。我很想看看你是怎么做到的。不过我们这些普通人就做不到啦。 |皱起眉头说道：“我想是的，但我尽量不去这样想。 ]你与任何人建立的关系中，都会存在这样的想法：“好吧，他们说的每一句话，我真的有必要那么在意吗？”女孩子们也是如此。告诉她们，没错，她们确实需要注意自己的行为和学业。偶尔给他们一些灵活处理的空间，让整个学习过程能够稍微放松一些。一旦建立了这样的机制，那么整个学习过程就能顺利地进行下去，几乎不会出现什么问题。最近我们遇到了一些小麻烦，因为隔离措施让所有人都处于紧张状态，包括孩子们，但这些问题并不严重。" [pc.isBimbo |那么，这种方法对所有情况都适用吗？还是说，学生们仍然有一些办法可以让自己陷入麻烦呢？ |不过，肯定有些情况仅仅依靠声誉是无法解决的。 ] [party.comp brint brienne |布林特哼了一声。[pc.isBimbo |更少 |较少见 ]比你想象的要复杂得多。 [pc.name]女牛仔老师根本不需要费太多力气，就能让所有孩子都守规矩、认真学习。就连那些年幼的男孩和女孩，在学习阅读的时候也表现得相当不错——对孩子们来说，已经算是相当不错的成绩了。” “当然，也有一些例外情况。 |我记得自己是在幼儿园的时候开始学习阅读的，”布蕾妮满怀怀念地说，“那时候我们所有人都很乖，无论是男孩还是女孩。在这里，老师们很擅长在不用大声呵斥的情况下让孩子们持续学习！” “我真的很感激这一点，亲爱的。不过，还是有一些例外情况的吧！ |当然可以。 ]有时候，你得把某个女孩单独叫出来，让她明白自己行为的后果。正因如此，住在我现在这样的地方才这么方便。也许某个女孩某天会发脾气，那也没关系……但这里是个小村庄，她的父母和我都很熟。我的问题很快就会变成她的问题。”塞蕾娜轻笑着，又喝了一口饮料。“这种情况大概每个赛季只会发生一两次，有时候甚至根本不会发生。毕竟我们是一个村子，大家的事情都彼此息息相关。"

Let things fester and you're asking for trouble. You can be as nice as you like with the girls, but you have to be firm where it matters." [pc.isBimbo |Awww, you wouldn't be very good at that at all. You can't help but want to be nice to people! |Let them know what they can and can't get away with? ] She [pc.isBimbo |laughs gently and pats your hand. "Sweetie, you might actually be able to manage a classroom with just positive feelings and hugs. I'd love to see it. But the rest of us mere mortals can't quite do it. |frowns. "I guess, but I try not to think about it like that. ] Any relationship you have with someone else has a little bit of 'okay, how much do I really need to care about every little thing they say' in it. The girls are the same. Let them know that, yeah, they need to be on point with their behavior and their studies. Give them a little wiggle room from time to time to let the class breathe. Once you've got that set up, the class can really get going, with few exceptions. We've hit some bumpy spots lately because the quarantine's got everybody on edge, including the kiddos, but it's nothing too egregious." [pc.isBimbo |So does thaaaaat work for everything? Or are there still some ways for students to be stinky? |Still, there's got to be some situations that just can't be solved by reputation alone. ] [party.comp brint brienne |Brint snorts. "[pc.isBimbo |Fewer |Less often ] than you'd think, [pc.name]. Cowgirl teachers don't need to do much heavy lifting at all to keep everybody well behaved and studious. Even the little kids, both boys and girls, are pretty good when they're learning to read — pretty good for kids, anyway." "Certainly. Still, there are a few exceptions. |"I remember learning to read as part of the little-kids group," Brienne says wistfully, "and all of us were pretty well behaved. Boys, girls, everybody. Down here, teachers are pretty good at keeping kids learning without yelling!" "I appreciate that, sweetie. There are still a few exceptions, though! |"Sure. ] Sometimes you have to separate a girl out for a little bit and make sure she understands the consequences of her behavior. That's why it's nice to live where I do. Maybe a girl just gets mad one day, fine, but... it's a small village, and her parents and I know each other very well. My problem becomes her problem very, very quickly." Serena chuckles and takes another sip of her drink. "That's happened, hmm... eh, only about once or twice a season at most, sometimes not at all. It's a village. We're all in each other's business." "

rows.original: "It's not that hard to get the girls to buy into learning their letters," Serena muses. "There's always a story that will get someone hooked, or a bit of history that they find fascinating. Even if they don't go in for the epics or for composition, I don't usually have too much trouble with the basics. Even the ones who don't like reading will usually love stories. It's the numbers that drive half of them up a wall." [pc.isBimbo |[pc.isCunning |Math's not always super fun! Sexy math works best for you — although it doesn't always give the right answer! A lot of people around here make one plus one equal more than just two, hee hee. But sexy math would be bad for her moo students... her moo-dents! How does she make it fun for her moodents? |Ugh, mood. Other than sixty-nine, numbers are stinky. Do her moo students... her moo-dents! Do her moodents not like them either? ] |Math not their strongest suit, then? ] [pc.isBimbo |"Moodents." She raises her hand to her forehead, shakes her head, and smiles. "Oh, that's cute. But, as to your question, it d |"D ]epends on the girl. A lot of them love it! Livilla's a real budding engineer, for one; she grew up with it through both her mom and dad, and she's following right in their hoofprints. She'll talk your ear off all day about drainage and road grades and tunnel buttresses and how she wants to rebuild the whole village. That last is never going to happen, but it's adorable that she wants to try — and besides, if she manages to do a third of what she wants to do, a lot of people's lives will be better off for it." [pc.isBimbo |[pc.isCunning |There you go! A clever mathy moo. |It's good that somebody likes it, you guess. ] But Liv[silly |y ] sounds like she's a little different from the others. |So Livilla's a natural. But her classmates? ] Serena laughs. "Her elder sister Consentia — she's an adult now — absolutely hates math. My predecessor had a heck of a time trying to get her to be able to add and subtract properly. Poor thing. So long as Connie doesn't get taken for a fool by the tax collector or an unscrupulous merchant, though, I think we'll have done our jobs." [pc.isBimbo |You never thought of using math to argue with the tax collector. It's easier to just make them really, really happy. Hee hee hee. So moos argue about their taxes? |The tax collector? You wouldn't have thought Minoans were allowed to argue about their taxes. ] "Of course! It's the right of every citizen to contest claims in court, even if the king's quaestors are on the other side of the argument. And that system only works if every citizen learns the law and learns her numbers as a young girl, so she can check the bill and argue the facts herself. I mean, it doesn't always work that well in practice. But I make sure that I teach them all the same." Oof. [pc.isBimbo |That sounds like it'd be even more boring for most of her students! |If math is only a little bit popular, you can only imagine how much hate she gets for teaching the law. ] She raises an eyebrow. "[pc.isBimbo |That's not what the girls think |Actually, no ]. They love to argue about the law, especially Renata. In fact, they love it so much that I try to spice up some of our other lessons by making them a little bit like arguments before a jury. It's... honestly, it's a lot of fun!"
rows.translation: 让女孩子们愿意学习字母其实并没有那么难，”塞蕾娜沉思道，“总会有某个故事能吸引她们的兴趣，或者是一些她们觉得有趣的历史知识。即使她们对那些长篇故事或写作不感兴趣，学习基础知识通常也不会遇到太大困难。就连那些不喜欢阅读的孩子，通常也会喜欢故事。但就是数字，让其中一半的人感到头疼不已。 [pc.isBimbo |[pc.isCunning |数学并不总是那么有趣！“性感数学”才更适合你——不过它并不总能给出正确的答案呢！这里有很多人会把一加一算成大于二的结果，嘿嘿。不过，“性感数学”对她的那些“学生”们可不太友好……尤其是对他们的牙齿来说！那么，她是怎么让这些“学生”们觉得学习数学变得有趣的呢？ |唉，这些数字真让人烦躁……除了69之外，其他的数字都让人觉得讨厌。她的那些学生……还有她的那些“凹痕”！难道她的那些“情绪符号”也不喜欢它们吗？ ] |那么，数学应该不是他们的强项吧？ ] [pc.isBimbo |Moodents。”她把手放在额头上，摇摇头，然后笑了起来。“哦，真可爱。不过，关于你的问题，嗯…… |D ]这得看那个女孩了。很多女孩都很喜欢它呢！比如说，利维拉就是个真正的有潜力成为工程师的女孩；她的父母都在这个领域工作，她从小就在这种环境中长大，现在也在沿着他们的脚步前进。她会一整天都在跟你谈论排水系统、道路坡度、隧道支护结构，还有她想要如何重建整个村庄。虽然最后那个目标可能永远无法实现，但她的这种热情真的很可爱——而且，如果她能实现自己计划中的三分之一，那么很多人的生活都会因此变得更好。 [pc.isBimbo |[pc.isCunning |瞧！这就是一个充满数学智慧的“哞”声。 |真好。一些我想，大家应该都会喜欢吧。 ]但是，莉芙[silly |y ]听起来她和其他人有点不一样。 |所以利维拉是个天生的游戏爱好者。但她的同学们呢？ ] 塞蕾娜笑了起来：“她的姐姐康森蒂亚——现在她已经成年了——极其讨厌数学。我的前任费了很大劲才让她学会正确的加减法。真可怜……不过，只要康妮不会被税务员或那些不诚实的商人当成傻瓜来对待，我想我们就已经尽到自己的职责了。 [pc.isBimbo |你从来没想过可以使用这个方法。数学和收税员争论实在没有意义，还不如想办法让他们开心起来才对。呵呵呵，所以大家根本就不会去争论自己的税款问题吧？ |那个收税官？你肯定想不到，米诺斯人竟然也有权就自己的税款问题进行争论。 ] 当然！每个公民都有权在法庭上对各种主张提出质疑，即使国王的顾问们站在对方的立场上。而这个制度只有在我们每个公民从小就学习法律、掌握相关知识的前提下，才能真正发挥作用——这样她们才能自行审查各种文件、依据事实进行辩论。当然，实际上这个制度并不总能完美地运作，但我还是会确保所有人都接受这样的教育。” 哎哟[pc.isBimbo |对她的大多数学生来说，那样只会更加无聊吧！ |如果数学还算有点受欢迎的话，你简直无法想象她教授法律这门学科时会招来多少厌恶和批评。 ] 她挑了挑眉毛。[pc.isBimbo |女孩们可不这么想。 |其实，并没有。 ]他们特别喜欢争论法律问题，尤其是雷娜塔。事实上，他们对此乐此不疲，以至于我常常会尝试把我们其他的一些课程内容改编成类似陪审团面前的辩论场景，让教学过程变得更有趣一些。说实话，这真的非常有趣！

rows.original: [pc.isBimbo |So, she seems like a really good teacher moo, and the classroom sounds great! But, like, [pc.isCunning |it sounds like she has the girls learning an awful lot! |reading is hard. ] How close does she get to making sure all of her girls know how to do everything? |It all sounds good, gathering up all the citizens' children and ensuring that they learn things like engineering and literature. But how close does that come to reality? ] "Closer than you'd think, but further away than you'd hope," Serena sighs. "I can't make anyone send their kiddo to school, right? It's a public service, and comes out of their taxes, but if a girl's parents need her to do fishing or weaving or things around the home even outside of spawning season, well, that's their business. There's more than eleven teenage girls in Signia, but there's eleven girls that regularly come to learn from me right now." [pc.isBimbo |Aww. The others are missing out! But the ones who come every day still learn everything, right? |Okay: some children don't even come to class. And the ones who do? ] "[pc.isBimbo |You're asking about retention. |Retention, huh? ]" The cowgirl teacher's mouth twists in a mild grimace, but her tone stays relatively even. "If you want to know whether every person who passes through a village school is going to remember everything she — or he — was taught there, from tunnel excavation to high literature, the answer is no. They don't. Who does? Let's be fair: do you remember everything you've tried to remember in your life?" [pc.isBimbo |[pc.isCunning |Nah, definitely not! Mostly only when it's really really important. A lot of stuff gets, um, lost in the honey, and you kinda wish... well. You're fine with how you are! It's just difficult sometimes. |Uhhhhhhh... "Oh dear. Right." Serena notices your big frowny face and reaches out to pat your hand. "You have a very good memory for some things, sweetie, even if it's difficult for you to remember other stuff. And both of those things are okay. You do a wonderful job of working with what you have." Aww, she's such a nice moo. But, um, yeah, [silly |bwain smoov an' stuff. |you don't think you can... um... what was the question again? ] ] |You'd like to think you remember more than most, but yeah, sometimes not everything sticks.[silly | Sometimes you forget about important plot details in this game because you skim and sometimes — gods forbid — you actually don't even learn them in the first place because you're clicking through words to get to the smut. And sometimes you click through the smut to get to the art. Soooo... yeah. ] ] "Remembering things is hard," she continues[pc.isBimbo | gently ]. "Even when it's your whole job to get people to do it. So no, I don't expect to see all of my girls in their twenties with full recall of the details of the minor heals, the ancient wars, the entire repertoire of Minoan and Belharan epic. And even though I've only been teaching for a few years, I still sometimes see former students in the village with embarrassed looks on their faces when we chat about what I'm teaching the kids that week." [pc.isBimbo |But still! It doesn't seem like she gets down in the dumps or anything. |She doesn't seem very discouraged by that, though. ] Serena flashes you a rueful grin. "Guess you caught me on a good day, then. It can be hard sometimes. But... for the most part, I accept that not everybody is going to remember everything, regardless of what I do, and I focus on the things I can control. Things like making sure I pull out all the stops to make the interesting things stay interesting to the girls: songs, good storytelling, real-life examples. Getting down the memorization skills to make sure that they can retain as much of it as they want to. And making sure that the content is actually useful in some way, because if it's something that they use, they'll remember it whether they want to or not. "And you know what? I go to village meetings and see women who talk about emulating the heroes of literary legend and draw on examples from our past to make their point in an argument. I see former students go on to heal soldiers in the Minoan legion; I see others leading work teams in the tunnels with [silly |blueprints |design scrolls ] in their hands. And I hear songs we sing in class when the boats come in with the catch." [pc.isBimbo |That's so cool! She's really making a difference. |That is a bit more reassuring. ] "I think so, yes." Serena shrugs. "Like I said, all of those things are 'sometimes' things, and 'some people' things. There's room for improvement, and I'm always looking for ways for me to do better for my girls, but... if you don't look at the good you do accomplish with clear eyes, you'll burn out. At the end of the day, I'm doing my part to make sure my students — my people — become good citizens, and that's a good thing."
rows.translation: [pc.isBimbo |所以，她看起来确实是个非常优秀的老师，教室的环境也听起来很棒！不过，就是[pc.isCunning |听起来她让这些女孩学到了很多东西呢！ |阅读真是一件困难的事情。 ]她究竟付出了多大的努力，才确保她的所有下属都能掌握所有工作内容呢？ |这一切听起来不错。好的，把所有市民的子女聚集起来，确保他们学习工程学和文学之类的知识。但这样的做法离现实还有多远呢？ ] 比你想象的要近，但也比你希望的要远，”塞蕾娜叹道，“我没办法强迫别人让自己的孩子去上学，对吧？这是公共服务，费用也是从人们的税款中支出的。但如果一个女孩的父母在非繁殖季节也需要她帮忙捕鱼、织布或者做家务，那这就是他们自己的事情了。在锡尼亚，十几岁的女孩有很多，但现在只有十一个女孩会定期来向我学习。 [pc.isBimbo |哎呀，其他人可就错过这些机会了！不过那些每天都会来的人，还是能学到所有知识的，对吧？ |好吧，有些孩子甚至根本不来上课。而那些来上课的孩子呢？ ] "[pc.isBimbo |你是在询问关于玩家留存率的问题。 |保留，是吗？ ]那位穿着牛仔装的女老师微微皱了皱嘴，但肌肉度依然相当平静。“如果你想知道，每一个经过乡村学校的人，是否都会记住他们在那里所学到的所有知识——从隧道挖掘到高深文学——那么答案是否定的。他们并不会记住的。那么，谁会记住呢？公平地说，你自己，是否还记得你这一生中试图记住的所有事情呢？ [pc.isBimbo |[pc.isCunning |不，绝对不行！只有在一些真正非常重要的情况下才会这么做。很多信息都会被这些“甜言蜜语”给掩盖掉，有时候你会觉得……嗯，其实自己现在的样子就已经很好了！只是有时候会让人觉得有些困难而已。 |哦，天哪……对了。”塞蕾娜注意到你那皱着眉的表情，便伸出手轻轻拍了拍你的手。“有些事情你确实记得非常好，亲爱的，尽管你在记住其他事情方面会有些困难。但这两点都没关系，你能充分利用自己现有的能力，做得已经非常棒了。” 哇，她真是个善良的人……不过，嗯，确实是这样。 [silly |鲍恩·斯穆夫之类的家伙。 |你以为自己做不到……嗯……刚才的问题是什么来着？ ] ] |你总以为自己比大多数人记得更多，但事实上，有时候并不是所有事情都能被记住。[silly | 有时候，在玩这个游戏的时候，你会因为粗略阅读而忽略一些重要的剧情细节；而有时候——但愿这种事情不会发生——你甚至会完全忘记这些细节。根本就不应该去学习它们。因为你是通过点击文字来查看那些色情内容的。而有时候，你点击这些文字也只是为了色情内容为了达到……的目的艺术所以……嗯，是的。 ] ] 记住事情其实很困难，”她继续说道。[pc.isBimbo | 轻轻地 ]即使让人们去做这件事本来就是你的工作职责。所以，我不指望我的所有学生都能在二十多岁的年纪时，依然对那些次要的治疗方法、那些古老的战争，以及米诺斯和贝尔哈兰的所有史诗故事了如指掌。虽然我教书才几年时间，但有时候在村里遇到以前的学生，当我们聊到那周我教给孩子们哪些内容时，他们脸上还是会露出尴尬的表情。 [pc.isBimbo |不过，她似乎并不会因此而情绪低落或陷入沮丧之中。 |不过，她似乎并没有因此而感到非常沮丧。 ] 塞蕾娜露出一丝无奈的微笑：“看来你抓到我状态好的时候了。有时候确实会很难应对……但总的来说，我接受了这样一个事实：无论我怎么做，并不是每个人都能记住所有的事情。所以我把注意力放在那些我能控制的事情上。比如，我会不遗余力地运用各种方法，让那些有趣的内容对女孩子们来说依然保持吸引力：比如播放歌曲、运用生动的故事讲述方式，以及举出现实生活中的例子。同时，我也会教导她们记忆技巧，帮助她们尽可能多地记住这些内容。而且要确保这些内容确实能在某种程度上起到实际作用，因为如果人们真的使用了这些内容，那么无论他们是否愿意，都会记住它们。 “你知道吗？我去参加村里的会议时，经常会看到一些女性讨论如何效仿文学传说中的英雄，还会引用我们过去的例子来支持自己的观点。我看到那些曾经的同学们后来在米诺斯军团中担任医疗工作，为士兵们提供治疗；我也看到他们中的一些人带领着工作小组在隧道里继续进行各项任务。 [silly |蓝图 |设计卷轴 ]在他们手中。而且我还能听到我们在课堂上唱的歌，每当渔船满载而归时，我们就会唱那些歌。 [pc.isBimbo |太酷了！她真的在带来积极的改变。 |那个是让人感觉稍微安心一些。 ] 我想是的，没错。”塞蕾娜耸了耸肩。“就像我之前说的，那些情况都是‘有时候会发生’，而且只是‘某些人’会遇到的事情。还有改进的空间，我也在不断寻找办法，以便能更好地为我的学生们服务……但是……如果你不关注那些积极的一面的话确实如果盲目地追求目标而不看清实际情况，最终只会让自己精疲力竭。归根结底，我只是在尽自己的一份力，以确保我的学生们——我的人们成为优秀的公民，这是一件好事。
