rows.original: Unusually for the minotaur city[var0 |— apart from the pantheon, of course — |, ] the lyceum's most prominent exterior decoration is[pc.swornGod nareva | none other than your own patron goddess ] Nareva, sculpted with her full length winding through the pediment of the temple-like building and depicted offering scroll and lyre to onlookers. But the Dawn Maiden, the Treefather, and even the Lord of Poetry and Song take their places on the facade too; after all, this isn't just a metaphorical temple to knowledge, but a place of safety for children as well. If that second role weren't clear from the lyceum's religious decoration, it would be from the easygoing yet hulking minotaur guards standing outside. The Minoans clearly take their kids' well-being seriously in times of siege. One guard leans on the pommel of his axe and bobs his head at your approach. "Ay-ah, Champion. Nice lady who teaches in one of the villages mentioned that you might drop by. You're[party.hasCompanions |[party.manyCompanions | all |[party.has arona | | both ] ] ] good to go on in[party.has arona |... [party.manyCompanions |well, except |without ] you, Kervus." "Fuckin' what?" Arona growls. "Yeah." The minotaur is calm but firm. "Hey, to the likes of you or me, the shit you Sailgraves raiders do is all a fair fight, but those village women and girls see it a little differently. Lotta people out east have no love for the wolf ink." [arona.isDom |"Whatever. I didn't want to visit your stupid temple anyway." Your alpha turns to you and sneers. "Let me know when you're done in there, beta bitch. I'm gonna go slam some weakass bull beer and find someone else to use as a dicksheath for a while." As Arona turns on her heel, the guard chuckles and waves, offering a "have fun with that" for good measure; she stops, turns, and shoots the pair of you a deadly look before continuing on her way. |"Yeah, but..." [party.comp brint brienne |"Might wanna [silly |take the L here |let this one go ], Arona," Brint says placatingly. "A missing mom or aunt or sister is a hard thing for a girl to move past. It wouldn't be fun for you or the kids." |Next to you both, Brienne folds her arms and glares at the orc. "But what, Arona? You don't think losing family's a good reason to be mad?" |Still leaning on his axe, the guard raises one hand. "But nothin'. Unless you Sailgraves orcs release a whole shitpile of slaves and let some of those easterner kids see their family again, you're not gonna have many friends in there. It ain't worth it." ] The orc's blue eyes flick over to you, then down, and she expels a long, drawn-out sigh. "Dammit, fine. Just... fine. Lemme know when you're done, [pc.name]. I'll go find something to drink." She turns away and lumbers down the street sulkily, braid bobbing in her wake. You[party.manyCompanions |, [var1], ] and the minotaurs watch her go for a little while, long enough to see her pick a little rock up off the street and abruptly hurl it off into the distance in frustration... eliciting a [silly |Wilhelm scream |pained yell ] from someone out of sight. ] "Well, that [silly |happened |was fun ]." The guard shakes his head. "Bit of a first for me, telling off a Kervus orc in the middle of the city, but I guess it's not the weirdest thing that I've had to do in the last month. Anyway! [pc.isAnyVisible |Only other thing left to do is put on some proper clothes. Can't be around kids lookin' like that, you feel me?" [pc.isBimbo |Oh! Duh. You're sorry! |Ah. Right. Of course. ] They just have extra clothing for you to use? "Yeah, we've got freshly laundered spares. We keep some of 'em around in case any of the girls — or teachers — makes a milky mess of whatever she'd normally be wearin'. It's right over there; shrug it on, and we can go find your class." |Like I said, you're good to go. C'mon, I'll show you where the villagers are set up." ] |. [pc.isAnyVisible |Just... before you go in, could you put on some proper clothes? Can't be around kids lookin' like that, you feel me?" [pc.isBimbo |Oh! Duh. You're sorry! |Ah, right. Of course. That makes sense. ] It's a good thing they just have clothes ready for you. "Yeah. We keep clean clothes around in case anyone makes a milky mess of the outfit they came here in. It, ah, happens a lot. No shortage of weavers among cowgirls, thank the gods." He hooks a thumb around the corner. "You'll see a bunch folded in a stack over there; just get presentable, and we can go on in." |C'mon, I'll show you where the villagers are set up." ] ] You leave your weapons with one of the other guards[pc.isAnyVisible |, pull on some more decorous clothing, ] and follow the talkative soldier into the lyceum. [pc.bgMulti acolyte scholar |Despite its external appearance as a temple, one you well recognize from your time in the heartlands, the interior holds no sages or priests, no open space for worship, just relatively small rooms. |Even though it looks like a temple from the outside, it isn't really one on the inside; instead, you could easily compare its series of interior rooms to some of the remaining places of higher learning you visited in the south. |Apart from being very clean, it doesn't look much like any other temple you've been in: instead of an open space for worship, there's a series of interior rooms. ] Each chamber that you pass has several young girls, mostly of similar age and mostly cowgirls, and at least one adult. But apart from that, no two rooms are alike: each is festooned with different decorations, and the different sets of occupants are doing anything from singing to quietly reading to writing things out in stone silence on tablets. It all seems very... crowded, but you guess that makes sense given the city's state of siege. Since you don't want to fall too far behind, you don't spend much time looking in on the rooms, instead maintaining the same brisk pace as your escort.[party.has brienne | Brienne isn't quite so focused, though, and she starts to fall behind, gazing into the rooms with a look of excited wonder[brienne.pregStage 2 | and patting her round baby-belly absently as she waddles along ]. Your [brienne.married |cow-wife |[brienne.fucked |cowgirlfriend |bovine companion ] ] must be very curious about the childhood she didn't quite have. ] The interior of the building is an open courtyard ringed by a columned portico, with a statue of the goddess of knowledge and secrets dominating its center. One half is full of tables, where lines of students chat idly and fold clothes. In the other half, laid out on blankets and the odd cushion, are groups of students, almost all cowgirls with a few humans, orcs, elves, and 'manders mixed in. Each group gathers around a single cowgirl teacher, like in the interior rooms. Unlike the children in the interior rooms, though, they look to be of wildly varying ages, their clothes are mostly rougher and woolier, and there are more in each cluster, ten to twenty each. One such cluster stands around your teacher friend, and from the sound of things, they're... singing? Yes, as you approach, you can hear Serena leading her charges in what sounds like verbal repetition and practice: a few lines' worth from the teacher with just the pitch and tone of wordless vocalization, then repeating it with the students following along a few times, then the teacher going back over it and adding the words to the lines, and again accompanied by the students. [pc.bgMulti scholar minstrel courtesan |As soon as you get closer, you recognize the tune. It's part of one of the Belharan epics, the Tarandaiad: one of the great stories that most young scholars, including yourself, learn to sing. And this segment, Euphrosyne's song, is one of the standout portions, a memory of a normal life and a time before the war widely known for the clever interlocking composition. It starts with a lament, but ends up spinning closer to something just as heartfelt but much more hopeful... and you can easily guess why Serena's leading her students through it. |You don't need to get very close at all to remember what she's singing: a passage from one of the Belharan epics, the Tarandaiad, a particularly heartfelt song in memory of what life was like before the war. While the village schoolteacher doesn't quite hit all of the notes perfectly, she comes pretty close, and she definitely imbues the piece with the emotion it deserves. Not half bad; a few years' worth of voice training and she might make a pretty good bard, if the teaching thing falls through. |The tune's a dimly familiar one to you, and you recognize it before too long: one of the more high-class pieces from your days as an escort, a townswoman's lament from Belharan epic. You weren't exactly classically trained, but you knew enough about the old pieces to be able to make some allusions to the Tarandaiad, especially if your companion of an evening preferred someone who could flaunt their learning and not merely their, mmm, prowess. Serena clearly knows it better than you do, though, and she's got the chops to make the song sound pretty good. |Whatever the song is, it overflows with emotion. The words are old, but the feeling isn't: raw and impassioned in a way that you wouldn't have expected from rote memorization. Serena gives each line body, and even if the students can't quite replicate her spirit they all seem to be following along intently. ] It'd be best not to interrupt them. Instead, [party.yall] walk with the guard to the statue of Nareva and watch and wait and quietly listen to the old words as they swirl around you. It's dazzling, and passionate, and when the girls finish all of their lines individually Serena leads them in a run-through of a whole section of the song and lets all those emotions flow. At some point during the song, Serena notices you, because after she offers some notes of approval and congratulation to her students, she directs them[silly | to put their phones away and go ] back to their impromptu seats, turns to you, and beams with excitement as she gestures for [party.yall] to come on over. At that, the guard chuckles and elbows you. "Told you she was expecting you. Good luck; I'll be over by the door if you need me." A dozen sets of eyes follow [party.yall] as you head up to where Serena is. "Perfect timing!" she chirps, eagerly clapping her hands. "And very appropriate for what we're learning right now, too. You see, I thought Euphrosyne's song would be a good piece to memorize during quarantine. And... Renata, I guess you know why?" "Because it's all romantic and sad," the girl in question pipes up. "And some of us are all about romantic and sad." Half the class dissolves into laughter, and Serena chuckles along with them. "Let's call that an added bonus. The real reason, though... Euclia? You look like you want to try." "Um." This redheaded cowgirl's eyes dart between [party.yall] and Serena before eventually settling on the latter. "It's also about the people, right? And hoping for something better?" The teacher smiles encouragingly and nods. "Oooh. I like where this is going. Better than what, though?" "I guess, like, because it wouldn't be fair — or right — if after everything they'd been through, they lost hope for things turning out okay in the end," Euclia says, stumbling over her words. "If they're going to get through this, they have to have something to believe in." "Yes," agrees Serena. "Yes, they do. I like to think of Euphrosyne and the Tarandans every time we have to quarantine in Khor'minos. This isn't quite as grim as the struggle they faced, but it's been a pretty long one all the same, and remembering how other people handle difficult times never hurts. And speaking of that..."

rows.raw: " Unusually for the minotaur city[var0 |— apart from the pantheon, of course — |, ] the lyceum's most prominent exterior decoration is[pc.swornGod nareva | none other than your own patron goddess ] Nareva, sculpted with her full length winding through the pediment of the temple-like building and depicted offering scroll and lyre to onlookers. But the Dawn Maiden, the Treefather, and even the Lord of Poetry and Song take their places on the facade too; after all, this isn't just a metaphorical temple to knowledge, but a place of safety for children as well. If that second role weren't clear from the lyceum's religious decoration, it would be from the easygoing yet hulking minotaur guards standing outside. The Minoans clearly take their kids' well-being seriously in times of siege. One guard leans on the pommel of his axe and bobs his head at your approach. "Ay-ah, Champion. Nice lady who teaches in one of the villages mentioned that you might drop by. You're[party.hasCompanions |[party.manyCompanions | all |[party.has arona | | both ] ] ] good to go on in[party.has arona |... [party.manyCompanions |well, except |without ] you, Kervus." "Fuckin' what?" Arona growls. "Yeah." The minotaur is calm but firm. "Hey, to the likes of you or me, the shit you Sailgraves raiders do is all a fair fight, but those village women and girls see it a little differently. Lotta people out east have no love for the wolf ink." [arona.isDom |"Whatever. I didn't want to visit your stupid temple anyway." Your alpha turns to you and sneers. "Let me know when you're done in there, beta bitch. I'm gonna go slam some weakass bull beer and find someone else to use as a dicksheath for a while." As Arona turns on her heel, the guard chuckles and waves, offering a "have fun with that" for good measure; she stops, turns, and shoots the pair of you a deadly look before continuing on her way. |"Yeah, but..." [party.comp brint brienne |"Might wanna [silly |take the L here |let this one go ], Arona," Brint says placatingly. "A missing mom or aunt or sister is a hard thing for a girl to move past. It wouldn't be fun for you or the kids." |Next to you both, Brienne folds her arms and glares at the orc. "But what, Arona? You don't think losing family's a good reason to be mad?" |Still leaning on his axe, the guard raises one hand. "But nothin'. Unless you Sailgraves orcs release a whole shitpile of slaves and let some of those easterner kids see their family again, you're not gonna have many friends in there. It ain't worth it." ] The orc's blue eyes flick over to you, then down, and she expels a long, drawn-out sigh. "Dammit, fine. Just... fine. Lemme know when you're done, [pc.name]. I'll go find something to drink." She turns away and lumbers down the street sulkily, braid bobbing in her wake. You[party.manyCompanions |, [var1], ] and the minotaurs watch her go for a little while, long enough to see her pick a little rock up off the street and abruptly hurl it off into the distance in frustration... eliciting a [silly |Wilhelm scream |pained yell ] from someone out of sight. ] "Well, that [silly |happened |was fun ]." The guard shakes his head. "Bit of a first for me, telling off a Kervus orc in the middle of the city, but I guess it's not the weirdest thing that I've had to do in the last month. Anyway! [pc.isAnyVisible |Only other thing left to do is put on some proper clothes. Can't be around kids lookin' like that, you feel me?" [pc.isBimbo |Oh! Duh. You're sorry! |Ah. Right. Of course. ] They just have extra clothing for you to use? "Yeah, we've got freshly laundered spares. We keep some of 'em around in case any of the girls — or teachers — makes a milky mess of whatever she'd normally be wearin'. It's right over there; shrug it on, and we can go find your class." |Like I said, you're good to go. C'mon, I'll show you where the villagers are set up." ] |. [pc.isAnyVisible |Just... before you go in, could you put on some proper clothes? Can't be around kids lookin' like that, you feel me?" [pc.isBimbo |Oh! Duh. You're sorry! |Ah, right. Of course. That makes sense. ] It's a good thing they just have clothes ready for you. "Yeah. We keep clean clothes around in case anyone makes a milky mess of the outfit they came here in. It, ah, happens a lot. No shortage of weavers among cowgirls, thank the gods." He hooks a thumb around the corner. "You'll see a bunch folded in a stack over there; just get presentable, and we can go on in." |C'mon, I'll show you where the villagers are set up." ] ] You leave your weapons with one of the other guards[pc.isAnyVisible |, pull on some more decorous clothing, ] and follow the talkative soldier into the lyceum. [pc.bgMulti acolyte scholar |Despite its external appearance as a temple, one you well recognize from your time in the heartlands, the interior holds no sages or priests, no open space for worship, just relatively small rooms. |Even though it looks like a temple from the outside, it isn't really one on the inside; instead, you could easily compare its series of interior rooms to some of the remaining places of higher learning you visited in the south. |Apart from being very clean, it doesn't look much like any other temple you've been in: instead of an open space for worship, there's a series of interior rooms. ] Each chamber that you pass has several young girls, mostly of similar age and mostly cowgirls, and at least one adult. But apart from that, no two rooms are alike: each is festooned with different decorations, and the different sets of occupants are doing anything from singing to quietly reading to writing things out in stone silence on tablets. It all seems very... crowded, but you guess that makes sense given the city's state of siege. Since you don't want to fall too far behind, you don't spend much time looking in on the rooms, instead maintaining the same brisk pace as your escort.[party.has brienne | Brienne isn't quite so focused, though, and she starts to fall behind, gazing into the rooms with a look of excited wonder[brienne.pregStage 2 | and patting her round baby-belly absently as she waddles along ]. Your [brienne.married |cow-wife |[brienne.fucked |cowgirlfriend |bovine companion ] ] must be very curious about the childhood she didn't quite have. ] The interior of the building is an open courtyard ringed by a columned portico, with a statue of the goddess of knowledge and secrets dominating its center. One half is full of tables, where lines of students chat idly and fold clothes. In the other half, laid out on blankets and the odd cushion, are groups of students, almost all cowgirls with a few humans, orcs, elves, and 'manders mixed in. Each group gathers around a single cowgirl teacher, like in the interior rooms. Unlike the children in the interior rooms, though, they look to be of wildly varying ages, their clothes are mostly rougher and woolier, and there are more in each cluster, ten to twenty each. One such cluster stands around your teacher friend, and from the sound of things, they're... singing? Yes, as you approach, you can hear Serena leading her charges in what sounds like verbal repetition and practice: a few lines' worth from the teacher with just the pitch and tone of wordless vocalization, then repeating it with the students following along a few times, then the teacher going back over it and adding the words to the lines, and again accompanied by the students. [pc.bgMulti scholar minstrel courtesan |As soon as you get closer, you recognize the tune. It's part of one of the Belharan epics, the Tarandaiad: one of the great stories that most young scholars, including yourself, learn to sing. And this segment, Euphrosyne's song, is one of the standout portions, a memory of a normal life and a time before the war widely known for the clever interlocking composition. It starts with a lament, but ends up spinning closer to something just as heartfelt but much more hopeful... and you can easily guess why Serena's leading her students through it. |You don't need to get very close at all to remember what she's singing: a passage from one of the Belharan epics, the Tarandaiad, a particularly heartfelt song in memory of what life was like before the war. While the village schoolteacher doesn't quite hit all of the notes perfectly, she comes pretty close, and she definitely imbues the piece with the emotion it deserves. Not half bad; a few years' worth of voice training and she might make a pretty good bard, if the teaching thing falls through. |The tune's a dimly familiar one to you, and you recognize it before too long: one of the more high-class pieces from your days as an escort, a townswoman's lament from Belharan epic. You weren't exactly classically trained, but you knew enough about the old pieces to be able to make some allusions to the Tarandaiad, especially if your companion of an evening preferred someone who could flaunt their learning and not merely their, mmm, prowess. Serena clearly knows it better than you do, though, and she's got the chops to make the song sound pretty good. |Whatever the song is, it overflows with emotion. The words are old, but the feeling isn't: raw and impassioned in a way that you wouldn't have expected from rote memorization. Serena gives each line body, and even if the students can't quite replicate her spirit they all seem to be following along intently. ] It'd be best not to interrupt them. Instead, [party.yall] walk with the guard to the statue of Nareva and watch and wait and quietly listen to the old words as they swirl around you. It's dazzling, and passionate, and when the girls finish all of their lines individually Serena leads them in a run-through of a whole section of the song and lets all those emotions flow. At some point during the song, Serena notices you, because after she offers some notes of approval and congratulation to her students, she directs them[silly | to put their phones away and go ] back to their impromptu seats, turns to you, and beams with excitement as she gestures for [party.yall] to come on over. At that, the guard chuckles and elbows you. "Told you she was expecting you. Good luck; I'll be over by the door if you need me." A dozen sets of eyes follow [party.yall] as you head up to where Serena is. "Perfect timing!" she chirps, eagerly clapping her hands. "And very appropriate for what we're learning right now, too. You see, I thought Euphrosyne's song would be a good piece to memorize during quarantine. And... Renata, I guess you know why?" "Because it's all romantic and sad," the girl in question pipes up. "And some of us are all about romantic and sad." Half the class dissolves into laughter, and Serena chuckles along with them. "Let's call that an added bonus. The real reason, though... Euclia? You look like you want to try." "Um." This redheaded cowgirl's eyes dart between [party.yall] and Serena before eventually settling on the latter. "It's also about the people, right? And hoping for something better?" The teacher smiles encouragingly and nods. "Oooh. I like where this is going. Better than what, though?" "I guess, like, because it wouldn't be fair — or right — if after everything they'd been through, they lost hope for things turning out okay in the end," Euclia says, stumbling over her words. "If they're going to get through this, they have to have something to believe in." "Yes," agrees Serena. "Yes, they do. I like to think of Euphrosyne and the Tarandans every time we have to quarantine in Khor'minos. This isn't quite as grim as the struggle they faced, but it's been a pretty long one all the same, and remembering how other people handle difficult times never hurts. And speaking of that..." "

But others perk up immediately, drawn[pc.isCunning | not just to your awful jokes but ] to [party.has etheryn kiyoko |your group's grandeur |[pc.swornGod lumia |the near-divine majesty of a Lumian valkyrie |the novelty of a surfacer [pc.race] ] ].[party.has etheryn | Royal company, after all, is kind of a big deal, [etheryn.lnhConfidence |even if Ryn doesn't do the best job of, mmm, inhabiting the role |and Ryn plays the part convincingly enough |and the way Ryn carries herself makes it easy for anyone to tell she's a [etheryn.crowned |queen |princess ] ]. ] [var0|And a few mouths drop open in outright awe to see the hero[pc.mf | |ine ] of the arena; even among village refugees, you've got plenty of fans.|Titles, accomplishments, appearance — you're pretty sure that [party.has brint brienne |even someone as potentially familiar as your minotaur companion isn't like anyone they've ever seen before |they've never seen anyone quite like you before ].] Your teacher-host grins. "[var0 |Well, that name definitely rings a bell, right? [pc.HeShe]'s come down here from the surface as a friend and ally of the Minoan people, and anyone who's seen [pc.himHer] in the arena can guess how good it is to have someone like [pc.himHer] on our side! |I know that the quarantine's been long and difficult to deal with, but now we have allies coming to help us. [pc.name] here is a Champion from the surface and a friend of the Minoan people; [pc.heShe]'s here to fight alongside the legion and help get things safe and normal again. ]" [pc.isBimbo |Uh-huh! |That's right. ] [party.Yall] dropped by to [pc.isDK |show the flag a little |lend a hand and hang out for a bit ]. The girl from before — Renata? the shorter one, with brown hair and very stubby horns — raises her hand, and after exchanging a quick glance with you, Serena nods to her. "You had a question?" It's short, sweet, and to the point: "Are you[var0| also] the person who fought a palace full of demons?" [party.has etheryn |Ryn coughs quietly, but doesn't say anything. ] [pc.dcbc |Kicked their a... butts, more like. |Uh, yeah, something like that. |Weeeeell, kind of! |Not counting all the other demons you dealt with to get here, yeah. ] Did Miss Serena...? "I did," she confirms, smiling at the hushed murmurs of the seated children. "I didn't spoil too much, though. It wouldn't be fair if I didn't give you the chance to play the raconteur! Let's go across the way to the service tables, though, so we can chat as we work." Soon enough, [party.hasCompanions |[party.yall] are |you're ] at a table piled high with simple tunics, military cloaks, and other cleaned-up soldierly accoutrements. As one young girl — Euclia, the redhead from before — shyly explains to you, the task is to make sure every package has one of everything, and that all the gear is checked for wear and tear and, if usable, properly folded and packed for individual soldiers. You soon work out a rhythm for sorting through the clothes; after all, the task is simple enough. So simple, in fact, that you[pc.isBimbo |you're not sure why they're making the teenage moos do it | have a hard time understanding why the Minoans have children doing it ]. One blonde cowgirl, taller than some of the others, shrugs expressively. You get the sense that the most gregarious and friendly kids decided to sit near you, which is fine; Serena probably knows how to best handle the girls who aren't interested anyway. "It's 'cause Miss Serena says so. I think it's kind of silly, too." "It's because we're citizens, Mari!" the lone human girl, Matilda, hisses. "We have duties to the city in hard times, just like what Eulalia sang about in the epics." Mari sighs expressively. "I guess. Right now I mostly just want to go home." "Yeah," Matilda agrees, leading to a chorus of dejected echoing yeahs from your little group. A solemn silence ensues at your area of the table, at least for a little bit. But Serena's moving from group to group, offering smiles and encouragement. She nods at one of the girls next to you, a quiet little thing with jet-black hair, and gives her a friendly 'it's okay' smile. The teenager tries a smile of her own, then looks [pc.heightRange 64 |up |over ] at you and asks quietly, "Could you tell us some adventure stories?" [pc.isBimbo |Sure, sweetie! |Uh, sure. ] What was her name? "Licinia," she whispers. "I... I'd like to hear about something good for a change. Not" — and here she spares a brief glance for Renata — "not another sad story." [pc.dcb |Oh, all right. |All right, you've got one or two. |Awww, you know how that feels. Sure, you can tell a happy story! ] Let's see: how about the time you rescued the princess of the snow elves? "You rescued a princess?"[party.has etheryn | Renata looks cautiously over at the snow elf a few places down the table, who happens to be [etheryn.lnhConfidence |cringing slightly at the attention. [pc.isBimbo |Yipyup! |Yes. ] That princess, as a matter of fact. |gazing demurely at you. "Was she..." "Yes," Ryn says, finally breaking into a little grin. "The princess [pc.heShe] saved was me." |smiling quietly at the exchange. "[pc.HeShe] certainly did." Ryn directs a meaningful grin toward you,[etheryn.married | rubs the ring on her finger, ] then turns back to the girls. "I think it's a pretty good story... and I'll try not to blush too much while [pc.heShe] tells it." [pc.dcb |Challenge accepted. |Is that so? That just means you'll have to work harder to make sure she does. |Aw, but you like making her blush! You'll just have to try extra hard. ] "Oh no!" she giggles. Her cheeks — and, of course, her ears — are already a little rosier than usual. "[silly |Please don't throw me into that briar patch! |Whatever shall I do? ]" ] "Wow..." the students murmur. ] [pc.isBimbo |Hee hee.[party.has etheryn | | You sure did! ] Now, like, this part is super crazy, but you promise promise promise that it really did happen! All of it! So you were at this river, and there was this big dark ruined castle on the other side of the bridge, and you had no idea what was inside! It could have been anything. It could've been super spooky, buuut for you that wasn't such a big deal — if you're friendly enough, you can make any gloomy thing seem nice! So you skipped on in through the gate toward the main hall... |Yep. Now, to set the scene. The ruined wayfort's walls had partially collapsed, and many of the rooms were open to the sky, but what was left of the old keep still towered, dark and foreboding, over the frigid, ice-choked river. Picking your way over fallen masonry and watching carefully for signs of danger from the inky shadows within, you entered the hall... ]"

rows.original: You weave your way through that story, and then through another, and another. It takes a while, but neither you nor the girls mind; at this point, your adventures among[var1 | [silly |horse-girls |centaurs ], [silly |the other horse-girls |marefolk ], ][var2 | [silly |fungi |orcs ], ][var3 | [silly |trash pandas |tanuki ], [silly |floofs |kitsune ], ][var4 | [silly |doggos |lupines ], ][var5 | [silly |fucking wasps |hornets ], ][var6 | [silly |birbs |harpies ], ] cat[silly |tos |folk ], el[silly |fu |ve ]s, and m[silly |oo |inotaur ]s could fill a very entertaining book. In fact, [party.has cait |as Cait points out shortly after your recounting of your adventures in the Winter City, she's in the midst of writing it |you're pretty sure that Cait has already started to write it ].[silly | And at this point, it's longer than almost any fantasy novel series currently in print. ] When you mention that last, Euclia's bovine ears flap up and down. "I kinda wanna read it now. Sounds like it'd be more fun than, uh, [silly |Cicero's |Litoria's ] speech against [silly |Catiline |Scorpius ] like Miss Serena had us learn two months ago." [pc.isBimbo |Gosh. They sound like they have to remember a lot of stuff! |They do a lot of memorization, then? ] "Yeah," answers another student, Marciana, as she packs away another set of clothes. "The things we learn have... good words, I guess? Like they came up with turns of phrase that were really good, and if we imitate them, or write like them, it's like we can get a little bit of their shine on whatever we have to say." Euclia shakes her head. "No, it's about morality. Like, these are the great heroes and heroines of the past, and if you remember what they did, you can act like the good people that they were." "It can be two things!" Marci says hotly. Then she realizes how loud she'd gotten and lowers her head and ears. "Um, s-sorry." "I liked the speech," murmurs Licinia. "Miss Serena picks good stories for us to learn." Euclia chews on her lip. "I mean, she usually does, but I don't remember that one having a story. I thought it was just a speech." "But there was a story," Licinia points out. "With the army and the nobility and the maybe-rebellion. I thought it was very brave of [silly |him |her ] to give the speech, especially when we learned about what was happening at the time. I um... I actually thought about drawing it. You know, the confrontation." "Oooh! I wanna see." The dark-haired cowgirl's cheeks burn. "I said I thought about drawing it. I haven't actually done it yet." "I can't wait for it. You make amazing art, Licinia," Euclia says wistfully. "Just like the lady out on the street. Oh! Did you ask... um... never mind." Every one of the girls goes absolutely stone silent, so you have to speak up:[pc.isBimbo | uuuum, ] ask what? [var7 |Licinia fidgets with the hem of the cloak she's folding. "I... I go to the arena with my family a lot now that we're in the city, and I, um, I kind of draw a lot of the competitors. Y-you know, like Cedric, and Captain Alante, and... I was wondering... I was wondering if I could draw you.[var0 | The god[pc.mf | |dess ] of war... ]" She wants to draw you. Um... wow. "D-doing something [pc.dcbc |cool |heroic |cute |clever ], or... I don't know..." [pc.dcb |Sure, so long as she does a good job. If she does, she'd better share with you when she's done. |Well, that's very flattering; in fact, you'd be very happy if she made art of you. She could do it however she wished — use her artist's instincts and all. Is it all right if you ask her to share something, if she finishes a piece she's happy with? |Oh, that sounds amazing! You'd love to see what she can do. Um... can you see it? If she comes up with something she's happy with, anyway? ] Licinia's eyes go wide. "Y-yes! I mean, yes. I'll try!" "Gods," sighs Matilda, "that's so cool. I can't believe Miss Serena knows you." |Licinia fidgets with the hem of the cloak she's folding. "I... I go to the arena with my family a lot now that we're in the city and I, um, I kind of draw a lot of the competitors. They're so cool: Cedric, and Captain Alante, and the Black Knight. And you... um... I think you could do really well there. Maybe even beat one of the legends." "Are you sure?" Renata's head bounces skeptically from side to side. "I mean, maybe." "Gods, but what if [pc.heShe] — I mean, you — did, though?" Mari squeals. "And we'd have met [pc.himHer]? We could be Team [pc.name] in the stands!" [pc.dcb |Hey, you'll take a fan club if it's coming ready-made and everything. |Well, now you have to enter and win an event. Maybe then Licinia can draw you, too, then. |Ooooh! Yessss. Now you have to go to the arena! ] "I... wow..." the little artist whimpers. "That would be amazing." "It would," sighs Matilda. "I can't believe Miss Serena knows you." ] [pc.dcb |Yeah, you are kind of a big deal. Serena's obviously a good teacher if she managed to get you to come in to see the class, right? |See, that's the thing. You wouldn't have come here if you didn't think Miss Serena was pretty okay. But what about them? What's it like having her as a teacher? |You either! She's so cool. Hmm. Do they think she's cool? ] Renata glances down the table to confirm that Serena's out of earshot helping some other class members, then smiles. "She's all right. She tries really hard." "I like that she cares so much," muses Marci. "She wants us to learn everything, not like that lady who was in for a few weeks a couple of years ago." "Ugh, yeah, she sucked." Matilda wrinkles her nose. "And she didn't like me." "She just let us do whatever, though. Miss Serena makes us do a lot of work." "Yeah, it's a lot of work, but she, um, she sandbags," Matilda points out. "Like, she'll push until you stretch, but she'll usually ease off if everything gets way too tough. Remember when we did the design [silly |module |thing ]?" "She was almost as done with that as we were by the end," laughs Renata. Licinia raises her head again. "What I like is that you can just talk to her about stuff. She cares about what we care about. You know?" "Like with your art?" "Mhm. And your grilled fish." "And cheering Euclia on at the race." [pc.isBimbo |Oooh, a race? And she was in it? That sounds super cool! |Really? You want to hear more about that. ] All eyes turn to Euclia. "Uugh. I don't wanna talk about me." "What a lie," chuckles Marci. "You love talking about you." "Yeah, but I don't wanna do it now." Matilda grins. "Does that mean I get to tell it?" [pc.mf |Hey, if you're making things awkward... |It's okay. You don't want to make things too awkward for her. ] "It's fine! I can't let Tilly tell the story anyway. She's gonna ruin it." Euclia sticks out her tongue at the human girl, then takes a deep breath. "Okay, so last year..."
rows.translation: 你穿梭于一个又一个故事之中，一次又一次地沉浸其中。虽然这个过程需要一些时间，但无论是你还是那些女孩们，都并不在意；在这一点上，你在这些故事中的冒险经历，确实为你们带来了许多乐趣。[var1 | [silly |马娘子们 |半人马 ]， [silly |其他那些女骑手们 |人鱼 ]， ][var2 | [silly |真菌 |兽人 ]， ][var3 | [silly |垃圾熊猫 |狸猫 ]， [silly |毛茸茸的东西 |狐狸 ]， ][var4 | [silly |狗狗们 |羽扇豆 ]， ][var5 | [silly |该死的黄蜂 |黄蜂 ]， ][var6 | [silly |鸟喙 |女妖 ]， ]猫[silly |托斯 |族 ]，埃尔[silly |fu | ]s、和m[silly |哦哦 |伊诺陶尔 ]这些故事完全可以写成一本非常有趣的书。事实上， [party.has cait |正如凯特在你讲述自己在冬城中的冒险经历后不久指出的那样，她目前正在撰写这段经历 |你很确定凯特已经开始写它了 ]。[silly | 到了这个时候，它的长度已经超过了几乎任何一部奇幻小说。系列目前正在印刷中。 ] 每当提到最后那件事时，欧克莉亚那对像牛耳朵一样的耳朵就会上下摆动。“我现在有点想读一读呢。听起来应该会比……呃，其他事情有趣得多吧。 [silly |西塞罗的 |利托里亚的 ]反对发言[silly |卡蒂林 |天蝎座 ]就像塞蕾娜小姐两个月前让我们学习的那样。 [pc.isBimbo |天哪，听起来他们需要记住很多东西啊！ |那么，他们需要进行大量的记忆工作吧？ ] 是的，”另一位学生玛西安娜一边说，一边把另一套衣服收好。“我们学到的那些表达方式……用词都很精妙，我想？他们想出了很多非常棒的句式，如果我们模仿他们，或者用他们的风格来写作，那么我们所说的话也会因此而显得更加生动有力。欧克莉亚摇了摇头。“不，这关乎道德。这些都是过去的伟大英雄们，如果你还记得他们所做过的事，你就会能够成为像他们那样善良的人。 可能是两件事吧！”马西激动地说道。然后她意识到自己说话的声音太大，便低下头，捂住了耳朵：“嗯，对……对不起。” “我喜欢那篇演讲……”莉西尼亚轻声说道，“塞蕾娜小姐总是能挑选一些很有教育意义的故事给我们听。” 欧克莉亚咬着嘴唇思考道：“嗯，她通常都是这样做的，但我不记得那篇演讲里有什么故事啊。我原本以为那只是一篇普通的演讲而已。” “但里面确实有故事啊，”莉西尼亚指出，“关于军队、贵族，还有可能发生的叛乱……我觉得她真是太勇敢了[silly |他 |她 ]要发表那场演讲，尤其是当我们了解到当时发生的事情之后。我……其实我考虑过把它画出来。你知道的，就是那场对峙。” “哦哦！我好想看看。” 那个黑发牛仔女孩的脸颊顿时红了。“我说过我思考关于画那幅画的事……其实我还没开始画呢。” “我真是等不及了。Licinia，你的画作真的太棒了，”Euclia满怀憧憬地说，“就像街上那位女士一样……哦！你有没有问过……嗯……算了，没关系。” 所有的女孩都突然安静得一言不发，于是你只好继续开口说话：[pc.isBimbo | 呃…… ]问什么？ [var7 |莉西尼亚摆弄着她正在折叠的斗篷下摆。“自从我们来到这座城市后，我经常和家人一起去竞技场，而且，嗯，我似乎总是会吸引很多参赛者……比如塞德里克、阿兰特队长，还有……我在想……我能不能也吸引到你呢？[var0 | 那位神明[pc.mf | |dess ]战争的…… ]她想画画。你呃……哇。” “正在做些什么呢[pc.dcbc |很酷 |英勇的 |可爱 |聪明 ]还是……我不知道 [pc.dcb |当然，只要她能把工作做好就行。如果她真的完成了，最好完成之后再和你分享结果。 |嗯，这真是太夸奖我了；事实上，如果她能以我的形象来创作艺术作品，我会非常开心的。她可以按照自己的想法来创作——尽情发挥她的艺术天赋吧。如果她完成了一幅让自己满意的作品，我请求她分享一下，这样应该没什么问题吧？ |哦，那听起来太棒了！你一定会想看看她能做出什么来。嗯……你能看到吗？如果她最终能做出让自己满意的东西的话，当然可以吧？ ] 莉西尼亚的眼睛瞪得大大的。“是、是的！我的意思是，当然会试试的！” “天啊，”玛蒂尔达叹道，“太酷了。我简直不敢相信塞蕾娜小姐认识你。 |莉西尼亚摆弄着她正在折叠的斗篷下摆。“现在我们住在城里了，我经常和家人一起去竞技场，嗯，我觉得有好多参赛者都挺厉害的：塞德里克、阿兰特队长，还有黑骑士。而你……嗯，我觉得你在那里肯定也能取得好成绩，甚至有可能击败那些传奇人物。” “你确定吗？”雷娜塔怀疑地摇着头，“嗯，也许吧。” “天啊，要是真那样该多好啊[pc.heShe]我是说，你……其实也这么做了吧？”玛丽惊叫道，“而且我们本来也会这么做的见过 [pc.himHer]我们完全可以组成一支团队。 [pc.name]在看台上吧！ [pc.dcb |嘿，如果粉丝俱乐部已经准备好了，一切都准备妥当的话，你肯定会接受的吧。 |嗯，现在你拥有参加并赢得这个活动吧。这样，也许莉西尼亚也会抽中你呢。 |哦哦哦！太好了。现在你拥有前往竞技场吧！ ] 我……哇……”小艺术家抽泣着说道，“那简直太棒了。” “确实会很棒，”玛蒂尔达叹息道，“真不敢相信塞蕾娜小姐认识你。 ] [pc.dcb |是啊，你确实挺重要的。如果塞蕾娜能说服你来参加这次课堂活动，那她显然是个很不错的老师，对吧？ |你看，问题就在这里。如果你不认为塞蕾娜小姐挺不错的，你也不会来到这里。但他们呢？让她当老师，感觉怎么样？ |你也是吧！她真的太酷了。嗯，真不错。他们觉得她很酷吗？ ] 雷娜塔低头看了看桌子周围，确认塞蕾娜已经走开了，不在耳边能听到她们谈话，然后笑了笑：“她挺好的，她真的很努力。” “我喜欢她这么关心我们，”马西若有所思地说，“她希望我们都能学到所有的知识，不像几年前那个只来了几周的老师。” “呃，是啊她太糟糕了。”玛蒂尔达皱起了鼻子，“而且她根本不喜欢我。” “不过她也没阻止我们做任何事情。塞蕾娜小姐总是让我们做很多工作。” “是啊，工作量确实很大，但是她……她总是把压力逼到我们不得不屈服的程度，不过一旦情况变得太艰难，她就会放松要求。还记得我们做那个设计的时候吗[silly |模块 |东西 ]到最后的时候，她和我们的进度差不多了，”雷娜塔笑着说。 利西尼亚再次抬起头：“我喜欢的是，你可以和她随便聊聊各种事情。她真的关心我们关心的事情，你懂吗？” “比如你的艺术吗？” “嗯，还有你做的烤鱼。” “还有在比赛中为欧克莉亚加油助威的事情。 [pc.isBimbo |哦，一场比赛？而且她还参加了？听起来太酷了！ |真的吗？你想了解更多关于这件事的细节吗？ ] 所有人的目光都转向了欧克莉娅。“呃，我可不想谈论自己。” “真是个谎言，”马西笑着说，“你其实很喜欢谈论自己啊。” “是啊，但我就是不想谈。现在马蒂尔达笑了起来：“这么说来，这个故事该由我来讲述了？ [pc.mf |嘿，如果你想把气氛弄得尴尬的话…… |没关系。你肯定不想让她感到太尴尬吧。 ] 没关系的！反正我也不能让蒂莉来讲这个故事，她肯定会把事情搞砸的。”欧克莉亚对着那个人类女孩吐了吐舌头，然后深吸了一口气，“好吧，那么去年……

[pc.isBimbo |Gosh. They sound like they have to remember a lot of stuff! |They do a lot of memorization, then? ] "Yeah," answers another student, Marciana, as she packs away another set of clothes. "The things we learn have... good words, I guess? Like they came up with turns of phrase that were really good, and if we imitate them, or write like them, it's like we can get a little bit of their shine on whatever we have to say." Euclia shakes her head. "No, it's about morality. Like, these are the great heroes and heroines of the past, and if you remember what they did, you can act like the good people that they were." "It can be two things!" Marci says hotly. Then she realizes how loud she'd gotten and lowers her head and ears. "Um, s-sorry." "I liked the speech," murmurs Licinia. "Miss Serena picks good stories for us to learn." Euclia chews on her lip. "I mean, she usually does, but I don't remember that one having a story. I thought it was just a speech." "But there was a story," Licinia points out. "With the army and the nobility and the maybe-rebellion. I thought it was very brave of [silly |him |her ] to give the speech, especially when we learned about what was happening at the time. I um... I actually thought about drawing it. You know, the confrontation." "Oooh! I wanna see." The dark-haired cowgirl's cheeks burn. "I said I thought about drawing it. I haven't actually done it yet." "I can't wait for it. You make amazing art, Licinia," Euclia says wistfully. "Just like the lady out on the street. Oh! Did you ask... um... never mind." Every one of the girls goes absolutely stone silent, so you have to speak up:[pc.isBimbo | uuuum, ] ask what? [var7 |Licinia fidgets with the hem of the cloak she's folding. "I... I go to the arena with my family a lot now that we're in the city, and I, um, I kind of draw a lot of the competitors. Y-you know, like Cedric, and Captain Alante, and... I was wondering... I was wondering if I could draw you.[var0 | The god[pc.mf | |dess ] of war... ]" She wants to draw you. Um... wow. "D-doing something [pc.dcbc |cool |heroic |cute |clever ], or... I don't know..." [pc.dcb |Sure, so long as she does a good job. If she does, she'd better share with you when she's done. |Well, that's very flattering; in fact, you'd be very happy if she made art of you. She could do it however she wished — use her artist's instincts and all. Is it all right if you ask her to share something, if she finishes a piece she's happy with? |Oh, that sounds amazing! You'd love to see what she can do. Um... can you see it? If she comes up with something she's happy with, anyway? ] Licinia's eyes go wide. "Y-yes! I mean, yes. I'll try!" "Gods," sighs Matilda, "that's so cool. I can't believe Miss Serena knows you." |Licinia fidgets with the hem of the cloak she's folding. "I... I go to the arena with my family a lot now that we're in the city and I, um, I kind of draw a lot of the competitors. They're so cool: Cedric, and Captain Alante, and the Black Knight. And you... um... I think you could do really well there. Maybe even beat one of the legends." "Are you sure?" Renata's head bounces skeptically from side to side. "I mean, maybe." "Gods, but what if [pc.heShe] — I mean, you — did, though?" Mari squeals. "And we'd have met [pc.himHer]? We could be Team [pc.name] in the stands!" [pc.dcb |Hey, you'll take a fan club if it's coming ready-made and everything. |Well, now you have to enter and win an event. Maybe then Licinia can draw you, too, then. |Ooooh! Yessss. Now you have to go to the arena! ] "I... wow..." the little artist whimpers. "That would be amazing." "It would," sighs Matilda. "I can't believe Miss Serena knows you." ] [pc.dcb |Yeah, you are kind of a big deal. Serena's obviously a good teacher if she managed to get you to come in to see the class, right? |See, that's the thing. You wouldn't have come here if you didn't think Miss Serena was pretty okay. But what about them? What's it like having her as a teacher? |You either! She's so cool. Hmm. Do they think she's cool? ] Renata glances down the table to confirm that Serena's out of earshot helping some other class members, then smiles. "She's all right. She tries really hard." "I like that she cares so much," muses Marci. "She wants us to learn everything, not like that lady who was in for a few weeks a couple of years ago." "Ugh, yeah, she sucked." Matilda wrinkles her nose. "And she didn't like me." "She just let us do whatever, though. Miss Serena makes us do a lot of work." "Yeah, it's a lot of work, but she, um, she sandbags," Matilda points out. "Like, she'll push until you stretch, but she'll usually ease off if everything gets way too tough. Remember when we did the design [silly |module |thing ]?" "She was almost as done with that as we were by the end," laughs Renata. Licinia raises her head again. "What I like is that you can just talk to her about stuff. She cares about what we care about. You know?" "Like with your art?" "Mhm. And your grilled fish." "And cheering Euclia on at the race." [pc.isBimbo |Oooh, a race? And she was in it? That sounds super cool! |Really? You want to hear more about that. ] All eyes turn to Euclia. "Uugh. I don't wanna talk about me." "What a lie," chuckles Marci. "You love talking about you." "Yeah, but I don't wanna do it now." Matilda grins. "Does that mean I get to tell it?" [pc.mf |Hey, if you're making things awkward... |It's okay. You don't want to make things too awkward for her. ] "It's fine! I can't let Tilly tell the story anyway. She's gonna ruin it." Euclia sticks out her tongue at the human girl, then takes a deep breath. "Okay, so last year..." '

rows.original: An hour passes in companionable, chatty work, with more stories from you and the girls alike. They're just as excited to share about their village as they are to hear about your stories[pc.isSoulbound |... [pc.swornGod lumia nareva keros|and they're extremely excited to see you show off your glowing eyes and Lumian ethereal wings, too|and they ooh and aah over the magical tricks you can show them as a sworn member of the Order Astrida|and they're appropriately impressed by the little foxfire tricks you can work, to say nothing of your very fluffy tails] ]. Despite the frequent breaks for storytelling and demonstrations, the work flies by, and when you're done, there's a veritable mountain of neatly-packed soldiers' clothes at the end of your table. As the next class of students gathers for their service project, [party.yall] join Serena's class a short distance away, where a simple meal of bread and thick, hearty meat-and-vegetable stew is being ladled out of a community pot. The girls line up for their food, then spread out into little like-minded knots to chat with each other over the meal. It looks awfully comfy, and you find it easy to relax as you quietly partake of the stew and let your eyes travel over the different groups of people mingling over their food. [party.compPara agnimitra atugia brint brienne azyrran cait einin etheryn quintillus viviane kiyoko |There's a light show going off next to the statue of Nareva, and it's a good one. You shift position for a closer look in time to see gouts of flame roar into the air as Agnimitra preens and prances for a crowd of clapping cowgirls. The legendary immortal phoenix's act is a combination musical performance and firedance, every bit as spectacular as all the other things the showy bard likes to do — and it's a good thing her onlookers are sitting at a safe distance, because the firebird takes the opportunity to really unleash the heat. Flickering pinwheels spin in the air, surge from her fingertips, even fly off her instrument as she rips through a chord progression. Searing, slashing, her music doesn't sound anything like any you've ever [pc.bg minstrel |sung |heard ], but it works, it fits her fiery motif, and more to the point, the teenagers are enthralled. When Agnimitra reaches the climax, they cheer for her... and the cheers get even louder when she finishes the whole thing off by putting her instrument down, soaring high above the courtyard, and carving a burning figure-eight into the cavern air. |A few paces away, the gentle sounds of Atugia's voice emanate from a small gathering of four cowgirls. As you edge a bit closer, you overhear some of the kids chatting about their village, the fishing, the games, the music. Tui absorbs it all, smiling excitedly, then trades some stories of her own, [tui.isBimbo|mostly from your adventures with her. She's bright, bubbly, kind of unfocused, but sticks to recent events and tells the stories with enough heart and happiness that you find yourself smiling. Your dullahan companion might not have the depth of recall that she does when she's not quite so pink, but she's still got a mind for emotional detail, and the cowgirls are captivated by the way she relates the feel of being with you on some of your adventures.|tales of the lands beyond the Undermountain, of places she's visited (some with you, some definitely before you met), and places she's only read about. She has an amazing recall, and as she relates a several-minutes-long book-tale of an oasis in the great salt desert of Jassira you find yourself staying there, just as captivated as the cowgirls are by the way she makes the heat and the romance come to life.] |Your [brint.married |[silly |hus-bull |beloved bovine husband ] |[silly |bara bull-buddy |easygoing bovine companion ] ] is definitely a crowd favorite. He stands amidst a veritable sea of cowgirls, leaning down, letting teenagers try (and fail) to get their hands around his enormous biceps, and giving them (and a few of their blushing teachers) plenty of friendly hugs. Brint's really good with the kids, an amiable uncle laughing and joking with them as if he'd known them for years. Every time a girl tells him her name, he tells her it's a gorgeous one, and his smile puts even the most nervous of them at ease.[var0| Gosh. It gives you all kinds of warm, happy feelings... and plenty of hope for the future. Someday he's going to do this with your [var1|adorable little minochildren| little baby]] If this is what the Minoans are like in a time of peace, that's all the more reason to try to make sure they have one again. |Brienne looks delighted as she chats with several girls who marvel over her ripped physique; giant muscle cows aren't common in Khor'minos or Signia, [brienne.pregStage 2 |to say nothing of ones who're as heavily expectant as she is |and the thought that a cowgirl could also be a buff warrior-babe is something that the teenagers clearly find spectacular ]. She's as gentle and friendly as ever as she talks to them, free with encouragement and hugs. But you notice that as many questions as Brienne fields from the girls, she asks just as many in turn, gazing intently at the teenagers as she tries to etch their words in her head. [brienne.married |Your bovine wife |She ] may not feel like she missed out on being a little girl — she's mentioned before that she wouldn't have had things any other way — but she still wants to know what it's like for them, and as she chatters excitedly with the teenagers her fascinated smile steadily grows.[brienne.numKids 1 | You've already reassured her that she's going to be a great mom, but after seeing her chat with kids like this no one could doubt it. ] |[azyrran.kdb |[party.has brienne |Just like Brienne, Azyrran is very eager to find out about what cowgirls and school are like. Unlike Brienne, she's a lot more self-conscious about the whole thing, more hesitant with the questions she asks, and much more awkward in general — par for the course for the otherwise brave Hive Knight. |Azyrran's smack in the middle of a group of girls, all of whom seem intrigued by her outlandish appearance — there's no flowers, beefolk, or hornets in the Deeprealms, after all. And although Azzy's obviously very excited to ask them questions, the adorably shy Hive Knight's social awkwardness holds her back: every question is hesitant, and every time the cowgirls giggle at something she smiles nervously. ] But some questions and answers set her at ease, and before long the girls have even convinced Azzy to show them how she flies. Soon the soft thrum of hornet wings fills the air... and even if the girls are a little too old to want rides, they still look like they enjoy the show. |Azyrran's got the two tallest girls in tow, and as they all sit down for stew the mighty Hive Knight looks to be teaching them a little assertiveness. Who better to learn how to saunter from than a confident armored warrior? As you watch, Azzy walks them through the walk, the smirk, even the infamous [silly |kabedon |up-against-the-wall maneuver ]: you can easily imagine her doing the same to [var2|you and Lia|Liaden|you|some helpless, delighted bee-maiden]. And while one of her two disciples doesn't quite seem to follow along all that well — mostly spending her time giggling — the other one absorbs every word like a sponge. |One group of girls giggles as Azzy swoops in for lots of[silly | smoothbrained ] love and cheer. With her collar on, the hornet isn't exactly the sharpest of tacks, but she understands one thing very, very well: romance. She zeroes in on any girls she thinks seem lonely and offers plenty of earnest, heartfelt love tips — from what you hear, a lot of them are some variation of "go for it, sweetie!" — and morale-restoring hugs. And after all, isn't a morale boost a big part of the reason you're here? Soon, your love-filled [silly |magical girl |companion ] has a whole swarm of teenagers smiling and putting their fingers to their lips at her uncomplicated sweetness. Sometimes feeling better doesn't need to be overthought! ] |You're not surprised in the slightest to see a gaggle of cowgirls having their stew around Cait; she's amazing with the kids, hitting it off almost immediately with them as she shares all sorts of big-sister advice. From the faint tones of their voices and the surreptitious glances that some of the girls shoot at some of the students in other groups, you can guess that a lot of that advice is romantic... but since Cait's a [var3|matron of Mallach|unofficial passion priestess], it only makes sense.[party.has azyrran |[azyrran.kdb | | Honestly, between her encouragement and that of your dommy hornet companion, you're not sure any of Serena's students will be without a boyfriend or girlfriend by the end of the next week. | Honestly, between her encouragement and that of your love bug, you're not sure any of Serena's students will be without a boyfriend or girlfriend by the end of the next week. ] ] But that's not the only thing Cait has to share, because after a few more minutes of chatting she ropes a teacher into starting up a tune on her lyre while she demonstrates a few Jassiran dances for the girls. While the hooved teenagers can't quite match the nimble kitty move for move, you can see them pick up the rhythm more and more as the songs go on... and more importantly, they're all laughing with Cait and each other as they sway from side to side. |It's a shame Einin ran off to... wherever she ran off to. As you survey the little knots of chattering teenagers, you get the sense that it would've been nice if she'd had the opportunity to grow up with some of these girls. Even in a relatively poor part of Khor'minos, cowgirl citizens have the opportunity to socialize, interact, and learn. And even though the lyceum courtyard isn't exactly the most opulent of places to keep them, at least the kids are safe here despite having to abandon their village. Then again, if wishes were fishes, the kids probably wouldn't have needed to live in Signia in the first place. |[etheryn.lnhConfidence |All the people in the courtyard are a bit too overwhelming for Etheryn, who's taken her stew and her bird[var4|s] and retreated to one of the columns to eat in silence. Unfortunately — or maybe fortunately? — it's to no avail, because three of Serena's students notice, and they all beeline for her with stew bowls in hand. The kids clearly feel like she needs some cheering up, and although at first Ryn mostly looks nervous, the friendly girls manage to get her to open up a tiny bit. The royal elf doesn't exactly smile, but her lips quiver like she wants to... and her long, expressive ears perk up just a tiny bit. |Ryn's relatively quiet, but you're encouraged to see that she's entertaining one little girl off to the side, feeding Harrick[var4|and [etheryn.harrickJrName]|] little scraps of jerky and a bit of the meat from the stew. The good [var4|birds seem|bird seems] to be enjoying the attention, at least, and your still-somewhat-shy [etheryn.crowned |elvenqueen |princess ] is managing about as much social interaction as she reasonably can. She seems to be smiling a fair amount, at least, and the girl she's talking to looks like she's having fun, too, and that's all you can really ask for sometimes. |Not only is Etheryn surrounded by several girls from Serena's class, she's picked up some onlookers from other classes, too. And while the [etheryn.crowned |elvenqueen |princess regent ] doesn't quite revel in the attention, you notice that she's much more at ease than she would've been when you first met. Ryn proudly shows off her hawk[var4|s], teaches cowgirls how to walk like princesses, and even demonstrates some ballroom dance moves[flags.WC_BALL_DANCE_RYN| that you remember very fondly from your dance at the palace]. She smiles and laughs easily, clearly enjoying the children's company, and from time to time [etheryn.fucked |she looks over at you with love in her sapphire eyes |her gaze flicks over to you happily ]. She's not the only one who's enjoying herself, either, because seeing the village girls' eyes light up at the attention of a [etheryn.crowned |queen |princess ] as they attempt curtseys is as heartening as anything you've witnessed so far today. So's the way Harrick[var4| and [etheryn.harrickJrName]] nuzzle against their hands when they gently rub [var4|their heads|his head]. Ryn doesn't quite have the majesty or poise of a monarch down, but she's got plenty of warmth, and for these villagers, that's more than enough. ] |Underneath one of the columns, Quintillus sits quietly, pores through his book, and enjoys the stew. From time to time, you see his ears perk up and his attention shift to one loud group or another, but he doesn't seem annoyed by the distractions — instead, he's got a mild, friendly smile on his face that never seems to want to leave. He's not really there to people-watch, because after a few moments, his gaze generally returns to his book. But he doesn't seem bothered in the slightest by simply hanging out and enjoying the hubbub around him while he goes through his text.[var6| Nor does he seem perturbed when a few teenagers wander up and ask what he's reading. The taeleer grins wider and puts away his book, but keeps up a conversation with the kids all the same, and when you edge close enough to overhear, you can tell that [pc.isCunning |he's deftly shifted the conversation over to what they're reading instead |they seem to be talking about other stories and tales ]. Whatever the subject, soon both Quin and the kids are laughing and joking with ease.] There's a lot to be said for seeing him having a little fun. |[viv.isDemon |A spectral [silly |awoo |whine ] directs your attention to another group of students. Viviane's got her spirit [silly |pupper |wolf ] out and is relaxing off to the side as the girls take turns petting and loving on him. She's also got more than her share of stew, whether as an open exchange with the cowgirls for getting the chance to pet the dog or as the result of just filching it. Whatever the cause, both she and the kids seem to be having a lark. Truth be told, letting the cowgirls oooh and aaah over the [silly |Very Good Boy |very good boy ] is about as wholesome a thing for her to do as you'd reasonably expect. |Off to the side, Viviane and a small knot of girls are embroiled in an intense discussion. She looks far more serious than you normally see her — which means the clever, teasy witch is still grinning and giggling half the time, of course, but let that go. You sidle closer and get within earshot in time to hear her say, "That's great! You see, now that you've actually talked about it with each other, it's going to be so much easier to remember it in the future. Reading isn't enough! If you have to think about something long enough to formulate an argument about it, it's going to get stuck in your head." "So that's why Miss Serena has us do those class discussions?" one of the girls asks. "Exactly," she says proudly. "But you can take it a little further..." ] |[party.has viviane |As for Kiyoko, she's |Kiyoko's ] found a spot on the edge of the portico and is sitting calmly next to a pillar as she has her portion of stew. She's all alone, yet rather than discomfort, there's a very slight smile on her face as she gazes at all the girls in the courtyard[kiyoko.pregStage 2 | and strokes her baby-belly ]. It doesn't take a genius to understand that she's thinking of [kiyoko.numKits 2 3 |a certain pair of young girls |your own children |Kinu ]. She rests comfortably, lost in thought, and from the way she politely but firmly shoos a group of inquisitive cowgirls away, she'd clearly prefer not to have to talk to anyone she doesn't know. You start over as if to join her instead for a little [silly |Beloved Time |bit ], but she catches your eye, smiles, and uses a gentle head-tilt to point you in a different direction. Hmm...? |Most of the students wave to you as you pass by, and all of them smile, but they mostly stick to their own groups. Once everyone has their stew, there's little movement; each group stays more or less in place, with few exceptions. So you just people-watch for a bit and see what you can see. In one corner, Renata explodes with laughter at something Matilda says; in another, Licinia tells an arena story with her hands, no longer nearly as shy as she'd been when talking to you. Next to one of the columns, Marci holds hands with a girl you didn't meet and lets her rest her head on her shoulder, their stews finished. The thrum of [silly |socialization |activity ] is in the air, but it's a little more muted than you'd find on the street or even in the main area of a village... and that makes it genuinely cozy. ] [party.has kiyoko |Following her unspoken directions, |Having finished your stew, ] you turn away, only to see Serena standing by herself next to one of the[party.has kiyoko | other ] columns. She looks at the students pensively as she sips on a little drink, but is otherwise quiet and withdrawn. Since you haven't spoken much with your host since you arrived, it feels [party.has kiyoko |as though your fox[kiyoko.married |-wife |en lover ] was suggesting that you |only fair to ] check in on her and see how she feels about the whole thing. "Mmm? Oh! Ay-ah, [pc.name]." She grins self-consciously and takes another sip of her drink before laying it to the side. "Sorry. It's easy to get lost in thought when I'm watching the girls." [pc.dcb |That better not be how she spends normal classes. |You understand. |You know, right? They're so adorable. ] Thinking about anything in particular? "Just how much fun they seemed to be having. They really loved everything: your stories, getting to meet new people from far away. Actually, this is the happiest I've seen them since the quarantine started. Kids are resilient, but nobody likes to live through gloom and uncertainty forever. I... I really appreciate you[party.hasCompanions | and your friend[party.manyCompanions |s ] ] stopping by. This has been everything I thought it could be and more." [pc.dcb |Well, good, because you weren't planning on a return visit, or at least you hadn't been; if she bribes you with some more of this stew, it might be worth[silly | | it ]. And while you've been watching her class, she's been...? |Oh, sure — and you had a wonderful time, too. Good kids, good food, and some nice, easy, helpful work. What about her? How's she holding up? |Oh that makes you sooo happy! You can't believe you got to do something nice for a sweet moo friendo. And you got to have fun while you did it! All the sweet kiddos and tasty food and stuff has been great. She's been having fun too, right? ] "I'm relaxing. Or trying to, anyway," she says ruefully. "Easier said than done, especially away from home in a city under siege. But this building, crowded as it is, is much bigger and nicer than what we have back home. And getting to watch while a good storyteller keeps the girls' attention was nice. It's been years since I've watched someone else run a class, and you did well." [pc.dcb |They weren't that bad. |It was no trouble at all. She's got a lot of great students. |Hee hee. That's good! You liked talking to the girls — they're almost as sweet as she is! ] "Yeah." Her voice gets soft and quiet. "I'm lucky." [pc.isBimbo |She is! She's a super lucky moo. But, like, good things should happen for friendly moos like her, right? Because she's nice and smart and caring and really loves her students and stuff. She earned some luck! |Sounds like they are, too. From the stories they told, the girls seem to like her a lot. And from the things they remember about what they've learned, a fair amount of that teaching is actually sticking. [pc.isDK |Painfully sappy as it is to say, t |T ]hey've got a good teacher who really cares about them. ] "I... that's sweet of you." Smiling slightly, she takes off her glasses and rubs her nose, then looks [pc.heightRange 69 73 |over |up |down ] at you with her bright green eyes. "I just want to do right by them. I wish I could do more, help make sure they're home safe, but this? This is good. Things are looking up. I know I said this already, but... I'm really glad you're here."
rows.translation: 在一个愉快而轻松的氛围中，大家一边聊天一边工作，一个小时就这样过去了。你和那些女孩们都分享了很多故事。她们既热衷于讲述自己村庄的故事，也同样喜欢听你讲述你的经历。[pc.isSoulbound |…… [pc.swornGod lumia nareva keros|它们是极其也很期待看到你展示你那闪闪发光的眼睛以及卢米安人特有的轻盈翅膀呢。|当他们作为“阿斯特里达骑士团”的正式成员，看到你能为他们表演的那些神奇把戏时，他们一定会惊叹不已的。|它们对你那些巧妙的“狐火把戏”印象深刻，更不用说你那毛茸茸的尾巴了……] ]尽管在讲解和演示过程中经常需要暂停，但工作还是进行得飞快。当完成后，你的桌子上会堆满整齐打包的士兵服装。当下一批学生聚集起来准备开始他们的服务项目时[party.yall]走到不远处，你便加入了塞蕾娜所在的班级。在那里，人们正从一口公共锅里舀取简单的食物——面包以及浓稠美味的肉菜炖菜。女孩们排好队领取食物，然后三五成群地聚在一起边吃饭边聊天。场面看起来非常温馨舒适，你也会不由自主地放松下来，静静地品尝着炖菜，目光随意地扫过那些围坐在一起用餐的人们。
