rows.raw: " An hour passes in companionable, chatty work, with more stories from you and the girls alike. They're just as excited to share about their village as they are to hear about your stories[pc.isSoulbound |... [pc.swornGod lumia nareva keros|and they're extremely excited to see you show off your glowing eyes and Lumian ethereal wings, too|and they ooh and aah over the magical tricks you can show them as a sworn member of the Order Astrida|and they're appropriately impressed by the little foxfire tricks you can work, to say nothing of your very fluffy tails] ]. Despite the frequent breaks for storytelling and demonstrations, the work flies by, and when you're done, there's a veritable mountain of neatly-packed soldiers' clothes at the end of your table. As the next class of students gathers for their service project, [party.yall] join Serena's class a short distance away, where a simple meal of bread and thick, hearty meat-and-vegetable stew is being ladled out of a community pot. The girls line up for their food, then spread out into little like-minded knots to chat with each other over the meal. It looks awfully comfy, and you find it easy to relax as you quietly partake of the stew and let your eyes travel over the different groups of people mingling over their food. [party.compPara agnimitra atugia brint brienne azyrran cait einin etheryn quintillus viviane kiyoko |There's a light show going off next to the statue of Nareva, and it's a good one. You shift position for a closer look in time to see gouts of flame roar into the air as Agnimitra preens and prances for a crowd of clapping cowgirls. The legendary immortal phoenix's act is a combination musical performance and firedance, every bit as spectacular as all the other things the showy bard likes to do — and it's a good thing her onlookers are sitting at a safe distance, because the firebird takes the opportunity to really unleash the heat. Flickering pinwheels spin in the air, surge from her fingertips, even fly off her instrument as she rips through a chord progression. Searing, slashing, her music doesn't sound anything like any you've ever [pc.bg minstrel |sung |heard ], but it works, it fits her fiery motif, and more to the point, the teenagers are enthralled. When Agnimitra reaches the climax, they cheer for her... and the cheers get even louder when she finishes the whole thing off by putting her instrument down, soaring high above the courtyard, and carving a burning figure-eight into the cavern air. |A few paces away, the gentle sounds of Atugia's voice emanate from a small gathering of four cowgirls. As you edge a bit closer, you overhear some of the kids chatting about their village, the fishing, the games, the music. Tui absorbs it all, smiling excitedly, then trades some stories of her own, [tui.isBimbo|mostly from your adventures with her. She's bright, bubbly, kind of unfocused, but sticks to recent events and tells the stories with enough heart and happiness that you find yourself smiling. Your dullahan companion might not have the depth of recall that she does when she's not quite so pink, but she's still got a mind for emotional detail, and the cowgirls are captivated by the way she relates the feel of being with you on some of your adventures.|tales of the lands beyond the Undermountain, of places she's visited (some with you, some definitely before you met), and places she's only read about. She has an amazing recall, and as she relates a several-minutes-long book-tale of an oasis in the great salt desert of Jassira you find yourself staying there, just as captivated as the cowgirls are by the way she makes the heat and the romance come to life.] |Your [brint.married |[silly |hus-bull |beloved bovine husband ] |[silly |bara bull-buddy |easygoing bovine companion ] ] is definitely a crowd favorite. He stands amidst a veritable sea of cowgirls, leaning down, letting teenagers try (and fail) to get their hands around his enormous biceps, and giving them (and a few of their blushing teachers) plenty of friendly hugs. Brint's really good with the kids, an amiable uncle laughing and joking with them as if he'd known them for years. Every time a girl tells him her name, he tells her it's a gorgeous one, and his smile puts even the most nervous of them at ease.[var0| Gosh. It gives you all kinds of warm, happy feelings... and plenty of hope for the future. Someday he's going to do this with your [var1|adorable little minochildren| little baby]] If this is what the Minoans are like in a time of peace, that's all the more reason to try to make sure they have one again. |Brienne looks delighted as she chats with several girls who marvel over her ripped physique; giant muscle cows aren't common in Khor'minos or Signia, [brienne.pregStage 2 |to say nothing of ones who're as heavily expectant as she is |and the thought that a cowgirl could also be a buff warrior-babe is something that the teenagers clearly find spectacular ]. She's as gentle and friendly as ever as she talks to them, free with encouragement and hugs. But you notice that as many questions as Brienne fields from the girls, she asks just as many in turn, gazing intently at the teenagers as she tries to etch their words in her head. [brienne.married |Your bovine wife |She ] may not feel like she missed out on being a little girl — she's mentioned before that she wouldn't have had things any other way — but she still wants to know what it's like for them, and as she chatters excitedly with the teenagers her fascinated smile steadily grows.[brienne.numKids 1 | You've already reassured her that she's going to be a great mom, but after seeing her chat with kids like this no one could doubt it. ] |[azyrran.kdb |[party.has brienne |Just like Brienne, Azyrran is very eager to find out about what cowgirls and school are like. Unlike Brienne, she's a lot more self-conscious about the whole thing, more hesitant with the questions she asks, and much more awkward in general — par for the course for the otherwise brave Hive Knight. |Azyrran's smack in the middle of a group of girls, all of whom seem intrigued by her outlandish appearance — there's no flowers, beefolk, or hornets in the Deeprealms, after all. And although Azzy's obviously very excited to ask them questions, the adorably shy Hive Knight's social awkwardness holds her back: every question is hesitant, and every time the cowgirls giggle at something she smiles nervously. ] But some questions and answers set her at ease, and before long the girls have even convinced Azzy to show them how she flies. Soon the soft thrum of hornet wings fills the air... and even if the girls are a little too old to want rides, they still look like they enjoy the show. |Azyrran's got the two tallest girls in tow, and as they all sit down for stew the mighty Hive Knight looks to be teaching them a little assertiveness. Who better to learn how to saunter from than a confident armored warrior? As you watch, Azzy walks them through the walk, the smirk, even the infamous [silly |kabedon |up-against-the-wall maneuver ]: you can easily imagine her doing the same to [var2|you and Lia|Liaden|you|some helpless, delighted bee-maiden]. And while one of her two disciples doesn't quite seem to follow along all that well — mostly spending her time giggling — the other one absorbs every word like a sponge. |One group of girls giggles as Azzy swoops in for lots of[silly | smoothbrained ] love and cheer. With her collar on, the hornet isn't exactly the sharpest of tacks, but she understands one thing very, very well: romance. She zeroes in on any girls she thinks seem lonely and offers plenty of earnest, heartfelt love tips — from what you hear, a lot of them are some variation of "go for it, sweetie!" — and morale-restoring hugs. And after all, isn't a morale boost a big part of the reason you're here? Soon, your love-filled [silly |magical girl |companion ] has a whole swarm of teenagers smiling and putting their fingers to their lips at her uncomplicated sweetness. Sometimes feeling better doesn't need to be overthought! ] |You're not surprised in the slightest to see a gaggle of cowgirls having their stew around Cait; she's amazing with the kids, hitting it off almost immediately with them as she shares all sorts of big-sister advice. From the faint tones of their voices and the surreptitious glances that some of the girls shoot at some of the students in other groups, you can guess that a lot of that advice is romantic... but since Cait's a [var3|matron of Mallach|unofficial passion priestess], it only makes sense.[party.has azyrran |[azyrran.kdb | | Honestly, between her encouragement and that of your dommy hornet companion, you're not sure any of Serena's students will be without a boyfriend or girlfriend by the end of the next week. | Honestly, between her encouragement and that of your love bug, you're not sure any of Serena's students will be without a boyfriend or girlfriend by the end of the next week. ] ] But that's not the only thing Cait has to share, because after a few more minutes of chatting she ropes a teacher into starting up a tune on her lyre while she demonstrates a few Jassiran dances for the girls. While the hooved teenagers can't quite match the nimble kitty move for move, you can see them pick up the rhythm more and more as the songs go on... and more importantly, they're all laughing with Cait and each other as they sway from side to side. |It's a shame Einin ran off to... wherever she ran off to. As you survey the little knots of chattering teenagers, you get the sense that it would've been nice if she'd had the opportunity to grow up with some of these girls. Even in a relatively poor part of Khor'minos, cowgirl citizens have the opportunity to socialize, interact, and learn. And even though the lyceum courtyard isn't exactly the most opulent of places to keep them, at least the kids are safe here despite having to abandon their village. Then again, if wishes were fishes, the kids probably wouldn't have needed to live in Signia in the first place. |[etheryn.lnhConfidence |All the people in the courtyard are a bit too overwhelming for Etheryn, who's taken her stew and her bird[var4|s] and retreated to one of the columns to eat in silence. Unfortunately — or maybe fortunately? — it's to no avail, because three of Serena's students notice, and they all beeline for her with stew bowls in hand. The kids clearly feel like she needs some cheering up, and although at first Ryn mostly looks nervous, the friendly girls manage to get her to open up a tiny bit. The royal elf doesn't exactly smile, but her lips quiver like she wants to... and her long, expressive ears perk up just a tiny bit. |Ryn's relatively quiet, but you're encouraged to see that she's entertaining one little girl off to the side, feeding Harrick[var4|and [etheryn.harrickJrName]|] little scraps of jerky and a bit of the meat from the stew. The good [var4|birds seem|bird seems] to be enjoying the attention, at least, and your still-somewhat-shy [etheryn.crowned |elvenqueen |princess ] is managing about as much social interaction as she reasonably can. She seems to be smiling a fair amount, at least, and the girl she's talking to looks like she's having fun, too, and that's all you can really ask for sometimes. |Not only is Etheryn surrounded by several girls from Serena's class, she's picked up some onlookers from other classes, too. And while the [etheryn.crowned |elvenqueen |princess regent ] doesn't quite revel in the attention, you notice that she's much more at ease than she would've been when you first met. Ryn proudly shows off her hawk[var4|s], teaches cowgirls how to walk like princesses, and even demonstrates some ballroom dance moves[flags.WC_BALL_DANCE_RYN| that you remember very fondly from your dance at the palace]. She smiles and laughs easily, clearly enjoying the children's company, and from time to time [etheryn.fucked |she looks over at you with love in her sapphire eyes |her gaze flicks over to you happily ]. She's not the only one who's enjoying herself, either, because seeing the village girls' eyes light up at the attention of a [etheryn.crowned |queen |princess ] as they attempt curtseys is as heartening as anything you've witnessed so far today. So's the way Harrick[var4| and [etheryn.harrickJrName]] nuzzle against their hands when they gently rub [var4|their heads|his head]. Ryn doesn't quite have the majesty or poise of a monarch down, but she's got plenty of warmth, and for these villagers, that's more than enough. ] |Underneath one of the columns, Quintillus sits quietly, pores through his book, and enjoys the stew. From time to time, you see his ears perk up and his attention shift to one loud group or another, but he doesn't seem annoyed by the distractions — instead, he's got a mild, friendly smile on his face that never seems to want to leave. He's not really there to people-watch, because after a few moments, his gaze generally returns to his book. But he doesn't seem bothered in the slightest by simply hanging out and enjoying the hubbub around him while he goes through his text.[var6| Nor does he seem perturbed when a few teenagers wander up and ask what he's reading. The taeleer grins wider and puts away his book, but keeps up a conversation with the kids all the same, and when you edge close enough to overhear, you can tell that [pc.isCunning |he's deftly shifted the conversation over to what they're reading instead |they seem to be talking about other stories and tales ]. Whatever the subject, soon both Quin and the kids are laughing and joking with ease.] There's a lot to be said for seeing him having a little fun. |[viv.isDemon |A spectral [silly |awoo |whine ] directs your attention to another group of students. Viviane's got her spirit [silly |pupper |wolf ] out and is relaxing off to the side as the girls take turns petting and loving on him. She's also got more than her share of stew, whether as an open exchange with the cowgirls for getting the chance to pet the dog or as the result of just filching it. Whatever the cause, both she and the kids seem to be having a lark. Truth be told, letting the cowgirls oooh and aaah over the [silly |Very Good Boy |very good boy ] is about as wholesome a thing for her to do as you'd reasonably expect. |Off to the side, Viviane and a small knot of girls are embroiled in an intense discussion. "So that's why Miss Serena has us do those class discussions?" one of the girls asks. "Exactly," she says proudly. "But you can take it a little further..." ] |[party.has viviane |As for Kiyoko, she's |Kiyoko's ] found a spot on the edge of the portico and is sitting calmly next to a pillar as she has her portion of stew. She's all alone, yet rather than discomfort, there's a very slight smile on her face as she gazes at all the girls in the courtyard[kiyoko.pregStage 2 | and strokes her baby-belly ]. It doesn't take a genius to understand that she's thinking of [kiyoko.numKits 2 3 |a certain pair of young girls |your own children |Kinu ]. She rests comfortably, lost in thought, and from the way she politely but firmly shoos a group of inquisitive cowgirls away, she'd clearly prefer not to have to talk to anyone she doesn't know. In one corner, Renata explodes with laughter at something Matilda says; in another, Licinia tells an arena story with her hands, no longer nearly as shy as she'd been when talking to you. Since you haven't spoken much with your host since you arrived, it feels [party.has kiyoko |as though your fox[kiyoko.married |-wife |en lover ] was suggesting that you |only fair to ] check in on her and see how she feels about the whole thing. "Mmm? Oh! Ay-ah, [pc.name]." She grins self-consciously and takes another sip of her drink before laying it to the side. "Sorry. It's easy to get lost in thought when I'm watching the girls." [pc.dcb |That better not be how she spends normal classes. |You understand. |You know, right? They're so adorable. ] Thinking about anything in particular? "Just how much fun they seemed to be having. They really loved everything: your stories, getting to meet new people from far away. Actually, this is the happiest I've seen them since the quarantine started. Kids are resilient, but nobody likes to live through gloom and uncertainty forever. I... I really appreciate you[party.hasCompanions | and your friend[party.manyCompanions |s ] ] stopping by. This has been everything I thought it could be and more." [pc.dcb |Well, good, because you weren't planning on a return visit, or at least you hadn't been; if she bribes you with some more of this stew, it might be worth[silly | | it ]. "Easier said than done, especially away from home in a city under siege. But this building, crowded as it is, is much bigger and nicer than what we have back home. [pc.dcb |They weren't that bad. |It was no trouble at all. She's got a lot of great students. |Hee hee. That's good! You liked talking to the girls — they're almost as sweet as she is! ] "Yeah." [pc.isDK |Painfully sappy as it is to say, t |T ]hey've got a good teacher who really cares about them. ] "I... that's sweet of you." Smiling slightly, she takes off her glasses and rubs her nose, then looks [pc.heightRange 69 73 |over |up |down ] at you with her bright green eyes. "I just want to do right by them. I wish I could do more, help make sure they're home safe, but this? This is good. Things are looking up. I know I said this already, but... I'm really glad you're here." "

rows.original: An easy grin spreads across your face: you're glad to be here, too. Her smile is a bit more lopsided, but equally as genuine. "Well, thank you again anyway. Hey, I know we already fed you and everything, but how do you feel about letting me give you a hug, too? As, uh, payment for services rendered?" [pc.dcbc |If she insists. You've got a reputation to protect, though, so it can't be too much of one. |You'd love a hug, but she shouldn't worry about calling it payment. It's just the sort of thing that friends do. |Ummm you'll definitely take a hug! And if she doesn't give you that hug soon you're gonna give her one yourself! |Huh. That's a hell of a discount. Your rates have really slipped in the past few months. Not that you're saying no, of course. ] "Hee hee. Okay, sweetie." Serena has to turn her head awkwardly to avoid bumping you with her horns, but eventually the two of you manage to work out an appropriate position for a quick, friendly embrace. "[pc.isDK |No matter what you might think about yourself, I say y |Y ]ou're a good one. Don't be a stranger, okay? I'd love to keep seeing you at the tavern to chat." Sure, you'll check in again — you're looking forward to it. "Great! Now it's time to gather everybody up. Back to class... which I'm sure they'll complain about, but [silly |like those little zoomers would say, it do be like that sometimes |it is what it is ]." rows.original: [pc.isBimbo |Mmm, weeeeellll, the students are nice, but you really came here 'cause you liked her. Like... like like her? You know? "You get right to the point!" Oh, that's a happy voice, but then it starts to get lower, like an I-want-you voice, which is suuuuper unf: "I like that." Oooh! Could she say what else she likes? Or is she gonna make you guess? Cause you like guessing games[silly |, except when they're really hard, like that one with all the questions. How many questions was it? It was... uuuuh. Some number. You don't really remember. Anyway, guessing! |. ] Her eyes do this fun little green sparkly thing as she leads you back around into the dark part behind the column, and then she says, "Yes, sweetheart. I want you to guess." Hmmmmmm. Hm hm hm. Oooh! You know! And before she has time to understand what you just said, you lean in, give her a big huge squishy hug, and plant a juicy kiss right on her lips. That's a great way to surprise people and make them happy! But then it, like, doesn't surprise her? Instead she gets this huge smile on her face and a funny happy smart-person look in her eyes and then she grabs your head all of a sudden and pulls it into a big ol' kiss of her own and — wow she's a good kisser — it all makes you want to kiss her back just as hard. And then she kisses and kisses and kisses and kisses you and you do it right back to her every single time and it's just so good and happy and right and you just wanna keep doing it for forever. Which is good! Because it's, like, a forever later when you stop and slowly pull apart. You're still all gooey inside and giggly when she looks at you with that big sweet smile and says, "Good guess." Oooh! You guessed right? "You did," she says happily. "Can we keep giving each other more of those?" Uuuum, yes? Hee hee. Is that even a question? "Just wanted to make sure, love." She gives you another smooch on the cheek that feels just as lovely as the lips ones. "Can you bring them to me at the taphouse in the afternoons and evenings?" Sure, you can do that! ... w-wait, does that mean you have to leave now? Serena smiles one of those smiles that isn't all happy but is kind of a little bit happy. "Well, everybody's finishing their stew, and we still have class time to go before I can let the kids leave. Sooo..." Awww. You understand. Maybe next time you can turn her into a big red to-moo-to! "I'd like that!" You walk out from behind the column and back into the courtyard. There's four little girls down not too far away, and the redheaded one — Euclia — looks up at you with the cheekiest smile. "Hey! Congrats, Miss S.!" "Ha. Yep, you caught us," chuckles Serena. "Good ear, sweetie. Buuuu-ut that also means you heard that it was time to clean up. C'mon, spread the word. We need to thank [pc.name] before [pc.heShe] leaves and we go back to class." "Aww, all right." |Hey, you wouldn't have missed it for the world. But even if the kids were [silly |all right |sweet ], you didn't just come here for them. Seeing her in her element, teaching her students, singing with that lovely voice of hers... it was really special. With her glasses off, you can see light unfiltered by Tychrian lenses flickering in Serena's brilliant green eyes. The noise of the cowgirls and teachers around you recedes to a dull, barely perceptible murmur, a low bass line underneath her soft alto. And in her musical tone you can hear the chords climbing higher with barely-disguised excitement. "I was hoping you were here for me, too." Of course you are. You wouldn't pass up a chance to get to know her better. "How much better," she whispers, "do you want to get to know me?" Fingers with black-painted nails gently close around your arm. By way of answer, you slowly shift backwards, using her hold on your arm to bring her with you, pulling her willingly back around the column into its shadow, and as soon as the two of you disappear from view, you slide a hand under her elegant, glossy hair, and pull her [pc.heightRange 69 73 |over |up |down ] to meet your lips. Soft, inviting, you lose yourself in them for a brief eternity... and when you separate, Serena pulls you back in for another one. It's still tender, gentle, and brief, but it's all the more welcome because she's the one giving it back to you. What you do after the kisses are over could barely be called separating. Not even an inch away from her face, you smile, and she does too, and when she says her next words the little puff of breath blooms against your [pc.hasMuzzle |snout |nose ]. "I like that answer." High marks, then? "Very," she giggles. Then you'll — "Oh... my gods." You and Serena both swivel your heads toward the unexpected noise, just in time to see a student — red hair, bright questions... Euclia — staring at you as she pokes her head around one of the other columns. "Way to go, Miss S.!" "Thank you, dear," Serena says smoothly. "Would you give us a few moments? I'll be right out." "Okay!" Euclia's head disappears back behind the column, and as she walks away the slight thump of her hooves barely masks a quiet "yesssss". Hah. She doesn't miss a beat. Serena chuckles, and as the tension drains away her hands slowly slide down your arms to grasp your wrists. "Teenagers being teenagers. You've gotta take as much of it in stride as you can." Oh sure, sure.[kiyoko.isFree |[kiyoko.numKits 1 | You learned that lesson — or you thought you did — with Kinu. ] ] It's a little bit of a shame, though; feels like the two of you got held up short. "A little. Why don't you finish this one outside of class? You know where to submit your incomplete assignment," she laughs. "I'm open to a flexible deadline; Champions get busy, after all. Just not tooooo flexible..." You do get busier than most, but you'd like to finish this one out sooner rather than later. That way, you can move on to the next project she gives you. "I'm looking forward to it." She gives your hands a meaningful squeeze. ] Within a few minutes, Serena's charges are up and gathered together through the magic of a few claps and not a single iota of yelling.[party.has viviane |[viv.isDemon | | Viv in particular is a big help in collecting the students, keeping up a friendly chat with the once-more-bespectacled cowgirl teacher as she works — and throwing you a big wink as soon as she realizes what you've done. ] ] From Marci to Tilly, the girls all offer you a wave and a smile and a chorus of thank-you-so-much-for-coming-[pc.mf |Mister |Miss ]-[pc.name][var0|e]s... and more than a few giggles, presumably from Euclia's story making the rounds. And after that, it's back to meet the cheerful, talkative mino-guard for the walk outside.

|除非那些题目真的很难，比如那个包含大量问题的题目。一共有多少道题来着？嗯……好像是很多道吧。具体数字已经记不清了。总之，只能靠猜测了！ |。 ] 当她带你绕到柱子后面的暗影区域时，她的眼睛会闪烁着那种有趣的绿色光芒，然后她说：“没错，亲爱的。我想让你猜一猜。” 嗯…… 塞蕾娜露出了那种并不属于她的微笑。所有很高兴，但还有点不太确定……嗯，大家都在吃炖菜，而在孩子们离开之前，我们还得上一段时间课呢。所以……” “啊，你懂我的意思吧。也许下次你可以把她变成一只大大的红色奶牛吧！ “我愿意！” 你从柱子后面走出来，重新回到了院子里。不远处有四个小女孩，其中那个红头发的——欧克莉娅——正用最调皮的笑容看着你。“嘿！恭喜你，S小姐！” ]你来到这里，不仅仅是为了他们。看到她全身心地投入到教学工作中，用她那美妙的嗓音为学生们唱歌……这一切真的非常特别。 This entrance isn't really an entrance, it's a dingy hole the denizens of the slum have evidently dug through the wall of the city. You can feel wooden beams sinking into the dirt as your [pc.feet] bear your weight across them, leading you to wonder just how well-built this place really is. The tunnel isn't exactly perilous but you take care to not set a [pc.hasToes |foot |hoof ] astray, feeling like your patience is finally being rewarded when you see the other side up ahead – time to squeeze through the rest of it. The air gets warmer and warmer as you make your way through. You can hear voices now, muffled though they may be, and that spurs you on a little. You turn a corner and abruptly tumble out into a street, assaulted on all sides by the din of vibrant life. Hooves clatter against the worn, beaten stone as a cloaked rider goes by, swearing at the beggar he almost runs down who in turn raises his walking stick and shouts back, only to be pushed over and trod on by a pair of lupine men who stride past with a sneer. Merchants whose entire shops are a few square feet of space stand in front of their paltry belongings and yell themselves hoarse, advertising all manner of ill-gotten weapons, jewelry and drugs. rows.original: Enter the inn. It's certainly seen better days... well, maybe not. Maybe this is as good as it's ever gotten around here.
rows.translation: 走进这家客栈，它确实已经不再像从前那样繁华了……不过，也许也并非如此。也许现在已经是这里最不错的状态了。
rows.raw: "Enter the inn. It's certainly seen better days... well, maybe not. Maybe this is as good as it's ever gotten around here."

rows.original:
You make your way back out of the dusty, dirt-filled air of the slums, passing through the wall and emerging back into the outskirts.
        
        [flags.KMO_SLUMS_LEAVE
            |The guard glances over and, upon seeing who it is, looks away disinterestedly. At least you can come and go freely.
            |The guard rises, lifting his spear, then sees who it is.
            
            "Hnnh, just you," the guard grunts, sitting back down. "On your way, then."
            
            "What would you have done if it wasn't me?" you ask.
            
            "It's moot," he says, shaking his head. "None of the 'regulars' would be dumb enough to come out here."
        ]
rows.translation:
你穿过贫民窟里充满灰尘和污垢的空气，穿过那堵墙，重新回到了郊区。
        
        [flags.KMO_SLUMS_LEAVE
            |卫兵瞥了一眼，看到来人是谁后，便漠不关心地转开了视线。至少你可以自由进出这里。
            |卫兵站了起来，举起了长矛，然后才看清来者是谁。
            
            “哼，原来是你，”卫兵哼了一声，又坐了回去，“那你就继续你的路吧。”
            
            “如果不是我，你会怎么做？”你问道。
            
            “那也无所谓，”他摇着头说，“那些‘常客’根本不会蠢到跑到这里来。”
        ]

rows.original: Actually, you don't want to delve into the slums right now. You turn back and head towards the fork in the road you came from, intent on exploring other options. No doubt the guard is happy to see the back of you.
rows.translation: 其实，你现在并不想走进贫民区。你转身朝着来时的岔路方向走去，打算探索其他选择。毫无疑问，那个守卫看到你离开一定会很高兴的。
rows.raw: "\n    Actually, you don't want to delve into the slums right now. You turn back and head towards the fork in the road you came from, intent on exploring other options. No doubt the guard is happy to see the back of you.\n    "

rows.translation: 看到如此多原始、狂野的男性气质聚集在同一个地方，这种景象让你变得不止有一点疯狂……
rows.raw: "The sight of so much raw, unbridled masculinity all in one place drives you more than a little wild..."

rows.original: Offer your entire party up to the minotaurs for them to use freely.
rows.translation: 把你整个团队都交给弥诺陶洛斯，让他们随意使用吧。

rows.original: "Would you guys be interested in working for pay?" you say. "There's a farm to the north that could really use some help — there's just one girl taking care of it, and she's in over her head." They all look up, surprised. "There's still someone out here farming? Thought it was just the old man down near the caves." "An' he don't want help," one says. "Know what they say, pride before the fall 'n all that shit," another sighs. He nods at you. "So what's the deal?" You explain the circumstances, though given the obvious situation in the Outskirts it's not exactly complicated. The soldiers nod, shrugging, and one speaks up. "Man, I can't just keep sitting here losing my money to you dickheads every day," he says. "I'll go. Nobody'll even know. Even if they did, we'd be helping the community." He sighs in disgust. "What little's left of it." "How 'bout we rotate?" one suggests. "You and a couple others do it today. Me 'n two others do it tomorrow. Like guard duty but less standing 'round and more working." "Yeah," another says, and a chorus of agreement rings out as five of the minotaurs stand and stretch. "Hup- alright," one says. "Who's going today?" "Gamble you for it," another says before being swiftly punched in the shoulder. They pick three out and the others sit down, mildly disappointed. "Alright. How much do you want for the work?" you say. They shake their heads. "Nah[pc.mf|, man. Y|, y]ou don't need to pay us for this. Just doing our jobs." "Not like we got anything better to do anyway," one says, indicating the card game going on. "'Cept trading coins every so often." "Let's go," the three say, turning to you. "Lead the way?" Seems like you've got a minotaur escort for the trip back to the farm.

"Eeeeeverybody wants to know the story," Vitra says, allowing herself a wry little laugh. "So, short version: I used to be a smith's apprentice with my big brother, Vitruvius. We were poor; it was a really good opportunity he worked hard to get us. I was shit at it, though. Absolutely no talent whatsoever. Our master gave us a test to make an engraved pair of daggers for a hightown noble, and I knew I was gonna fail and make us both look terrible. Maybe ruin my brother's chance at a career. So I decided to cheat."
    
    "How does being a blacksmith lead to alcoholic milk?"
    
    Vitra blows you a raspberry. "I'm getting there! See, I was so absolutely terrible at smithing that I realized the only way I'd get anywhere was magic — so I snuck out one night and stole a spellbook from Nieves, the fox lady that runs the magic shop down the way. Had no idea what I was doing but I knew what transmutation was and I can read runes well enough, so I snatched it, went to the workshop, and tried to cast a spell to transmute raw bronze into a dagger shape. And I decided to make the engraving a bunch of beautiful women serving wine to their minotaur master. Turns out I'm even worse at playing wizard than blacksmith! Must have mispronounced a rune or just let my concentration lapse — I don't know, really — but the next thing I know my brother's picking me up off the floor and I've got these huge knockers hanging off my chest, and there's a puddle of booze on the floor. He barely recognized me all prettied up and buxom!"
    
    The 'mander chuckles, shaking her head. "Didn't even get the dagger out of the deal, just a bunch of scorched bronze. Vit marched me down to Nieves' place and made me explain what happened. Witch batted me around the ears something fierce and said I was lucky this is all that happened — that I should thank Nareva I didn't end up a gelding or turned into a bronze bull statue. Who'd have thought transmutation was so dangerous? Especially with no catalyst or magic circle or anything..."
    
    You're sure Lady Evergreen would have a thing or two to say about that. "So, could she not undo what you did?"
    
    "Oh, probably," Vitra laughs. "But I saw a golden opportunity — at least, after I recovered from the concussion Nieves gave me. See, I'd have struggled just to be a mediocre smith, but now I had something nobody else in all Khor'minos did! So I went to the nearest bar to our house and signed up. Gods, did they love me there! Was the talk of the town for weeks, I was. Wasn't more than a couple years of that before I'd gotten enough coin and favor from wealthy men to open up Ember's on my own. rows.translation: 你叫什么名字？ [pc.isBimbo |她那自以为高人一等的做法 |专业评估 ]薇芙？”你侧过身问道，同时轻轻拍了拍她那被啤酒浸得微微发胀的胸部。如果说有人能知道她发生了什么事，那大概就是薇薇安了。 这位迷人的女术士倾身靠近，距离薇特拉裸露的胸部已经非常近了[km.isCorrupted |让那条假龙的阴茎在半硬的状态下抽搐起来 |使蝾螈的脸颊逐渐泛起红晕 ]薇芙托着下巴，打量着那些展现在眼前的巨大胸部。“说实话？你能走到这一步，我真的挺佩服你的。当初你尝试制作这些东西的时候，根本没有任何关于人工制造技术的学习经验，对吧？薇特拉摇了摇头：“我这辈子从来没施展过任何魔法。” “所以你认为，第一次尝试就应该选择变形术——所有魔法体系中最为困难、也最为危险的那种魔法，而且完全是在没有指导、没有受过训练的情况下尝试的。曼德的脸颊顿时涨红了，她的目光落在了地板上。“嗯，我想是的……” 薇薇安那双红润的嘴唇[viv.isDemon |露出一个渴望而狡黠的笑容 |露出微笑 ]哈！这个我挺喜欢。 [pc.name]虽然他可能更注重行动而非思考，但敢于尝试未知的事物，确实需要真正的智慧和勇气！而且，能够顺利完成这个实验，本身就说明他具备相当的天赋，无论实验结果如何。” “天……赋？我？”薇特拉[km.isCorrupted |嗤笑道：“亲爱的，我唯一真正的才能，都是在那次‘实验’之后才出现的。 |得了吧，没必要取笑人家。 ] 我是认真的，”薇芙坚持说道，“只要付出时间、努力，并得到正确的指导，任何人都能学会使用魔法。但能够在第一次读到某个法术时就释放出足以永久改变自己身体的神秘力量？你拥有娜瑞瓦独有的天赋。” 薇特拉只是摇了摇头：“你当然说到我哥哥，他可真是个聪明人。以及有才华的人啊。而我只不过是个蠢货，竟然绝望到竟然试图用一本偷来的书来念咒语罢了。 [viv.isDemon |别再这种毫无意义的谦虚了，以你的天赋，这种态度实在不合适，”薇薇安嗤笑道，“你明明…… |薇薇安露出得意的笑容：“那个…… ]这正是那位巫师的标志——他的人生轨迹绝不会局限于尘封的图书馆或卑微的职业之中。看看那个失误释放的咒语把你带到了什么地方，嗯？仅仅一次施法，你就彻底改变了自己的人生轨迹。想象一下，你还能取得什么成就[viv.isDemon |变成 |做 ]只要稍加训练，再加上决心去使用它，就一定能成功！” 蝾螈摇了摇头：“你知道在这个城市里获得奖学金需要什么条件吗？这种事情只有贵族家庭才能负担得起，而且那还是在和平时期。我很感谢你的夸奖，小姐……” “薇薇安。” “——薇薇安，不过就算我真的想成为一名女巫，我现在也正在拼命维持这家酒吧的运营。我根本请不起导师。[vitra.isMom | 如果可以的话，我还是会先把那些钱用来为孩子们的教育买单，而不是先满足自己的需求。 ]你的同伴思考了一会儿，然后回答道：“那我想我就得自己处理这件事了。 [viv.isDemon |我实在无法忍受这样的潜力被白白浪费！而且，我以前也从没有收过学徒。能够将一个毫无经验的少女培养成实力几乎能与我自己相媲美的法师，这个想法……嗯，真是太令人兴奋了。非常刺激。 |当然，我的首要任务必须是战胜那些恶魔。 [pc.name]，但是，当[pc.heShe]时如果你们愿意的话，我当然可以来指导你们。我以前从未收过学徒，但让这样的天赋在这里白白浪费，对法师这一职业来说，简直是一种失职。你们根本不知道自己究竟有什么潜力，但我认为，至少你们可以开始尝试发掘自己的能力吧。 ] 薇特拉低声吹着口哨：“我……见鬼，这样的邀请我当然不会拒绝。 [vitra.fucked |尤其是来自一位朋友[pc.name]。 |尤其是来自一位冠军的同伴之口。 ]从没想过自己会成为一名巫师的学徒，哪怕只是兼职而已，但如果你真的想试试，我也很乐意学习。 [pc.isMage |我也会出一份力的，”你说道，“只要我有时间的话。毕竟，两个法师总比一个强。 |我就让你们俩自己忙吧，”你笑着说，“祝你好运，薇特拉，你确实需要运气。 ] 蝾螈的尾巴在她身后兴奋地摆动着。“这次一定会非常有趣……

rows.original:
As you enter the store, you're immediately greeted by the sight of the shop's namesake. A towering cinderscale sala[silly
        |MAN
        |man
    ]der [silly
        |
        |male 
    ]stands in the center of the workshop, hammering a metal sheet along the horn of a small bronze anvil, itself set into a large chunk of wood.[flags.VITRA_BOOB_TALK
        | This must be Vitra's brother, Vitruvius.
    ] As the door shuts behind [party.yall], he glances up from his work just long enough to give you a quick "One moment please," before resuming his work for another minute or so. You're able to take this opportunity to look around the shop at the numerous bronzeworks spread throughout. From blade to armor to tool and beyond, every single item here seems to have been meticulously crafted and inlaid with intricate and loving detail. In the back corner, however, is a display case of weapons and armor a cut above even the finest words in the room.
    
    While he puts the finishing touches on his current project, you inspect the craftsman himself further. The 'mander works shirtless, leaving his toned chest, stomach, and back exposed to the heat—though his natural resistance to such temperatures leaves him largely unfazed. Splotches of soot dot his red-scaled arms and tanned, human-like torso and neck, not to mention the fabric of his toolbelt. Were it not for the color of his trousers, you imagine those, too would be covered in similar dark hand marks. His tail is constantly in use, be it to grab a tool or object from elsewhere or to heat up a part of the metal that he's about to work. 
    
    His muscles flex and relax with each hammer blow, showing off years of hard work spent honing both craft and body. The sweat of exertion glints in the light cast by the lit furnace in the corner and the flickering of his tail-flame. Each movement is accompanied by focused breathing, perfectly in sync to maximize his precision.
    
    When he finally has the sheet metal formed to a point he finds acceptable—from what you can tell, to the basic shape of a breastplate—he sets the bronze aside and puts his hammer back into his belt. As he relaxes, he turns to you and begins to extend a hand before thinking better of it upon realizing how sweaty it still is.
    
    "Greetings. Haven't seen you around here before, [var0
        |though from the look of you, you must be the [pc.man] I've heard so much about from my sister. It's a pleasure to finally meet you.
        |so, welcome to my slice of Khor'minos.
    ] I'm Vitruvius, namesake and proprietor of this here bronze smithery.[var0
        || You may have met my sister at Ember's Taphouse across the way. You can't miss her, really.
    ]"
    
    [var0
        |You are indeed [pc.name].
        |[vitra.met
            |You give a nod and a chuckle as you introduce yourself. [pc.dcb
                |No, you definitely couldn't miss a pair of fat knockers like hers.
                |It's definitely hard to miss a girl like Vitra, to say the least.
                |You definitely couldn't miss her! She has great boobies!
            ]
            |You'll have to keep that in mind, you say after introducing yourself properly.
        ]
    ]
    
    "So, what can I get for you?"

        | 这一定是薇特拉的兄弟维特鲁维乌斯。
    ]门在[party.yall]身后关上时，他只从工作中抬头片刻，匆匆说了句“请稍等”，随后又继续忙碌了大约一分钟。你趁机环顾商店，打量散布各处的众多青铜制品。从刀剑、盔甲到工具乃至其他物件，这里的每一样东西似乎都经过精雕细琢，镶饰着复杂而充满匠心的细节。不过，在后方角落里，一只陈列柜中摆放的武器与盔甲，甚至比屋内最精良的作品还要高出一个档次。
    
    他为当前作品进行最后加工时，你进一步观察这位工匠本人。火蜥蜴赤裸上身工作，让线条分明的胸膛、腹部与后背暴露在热浪中——不过，他天生能够抵御这种温度，基本不受影响。煤灰斑点散布在布满红鳞的手臂、棕褐色的类人躯干与颈部，就连工具带的布料也沾上不少。如果不是裤子的颜色，你猜那里恐怕也会布满类似的黑色手印。他的尾巴始终没有闲着：时而从别处卷来工具或物件，时而为即将加工的金属部位加热。
    
    每次落锤，他的肌肉都会随之绷紧又放松，展示出多年磨练工艺与身体留下的成果。劳作的汗水在角落里燃烧的熔炉和尾焰闪烁的光芒中熠熠生辉。每个动作都伴随着全神贯注的呼吸，节奏完美同步，以便最大限度提高精准度。
    
    他终于把金属板塑造成自己满意的模样——据你判断，那是胸甲的大致形状——随后把青铜放到一旁，将锤子插回腰带。放松下来后，他转向你，正准备伸出手，却发现手上依然满是汗水，于是又打消了念头。
    
    “欢迎。我以前没在这里见过你，[var0
        |不过，看你的模样，你一定就是我妹妹经常提起的那位[pc.man]。很高兴终于见到你。
        |所以，欢迎来到我在科尔米诺斯的一方天地。
    ]我是维特鲁维乌斯，这家青铜工坊以我命名，也归我所有。[var0
        || 你也许在街对面的余烬酒馆见过我妹妹。说真的，你绝不可能认错她。
    ]”
    
    [var0
        |你确实就是[pc.name]。
        |[vitra.met
            |你点头轻笑，介绍了自己。[pc.dcb
                |没错，像她那样的一对丰满巨乳，你绝不可能看漏。
                |至少可以说，薇特拉那样的姑娘确实很难让人忽视。
                |你当然不可能错过她！她的奶子可棒了！
            ]
            |你正式介绍自己后表示，会把这件事记在心里。
        ]
    ]
    
    “那么，有什么是我能为你效劳的？”
rows.raw:
"
    As you enter the store, you're immediately greeted by the sight of the shop's namesake. A towering cinderscale sala[silly
        |MAN
        |man
    ]der [silly
        |
        |male 
    ]stands in the center of the workshop, hammering a metal sheet along the horn of a small bronze anvil, itself set into a large chunk of wood.[flags.VITRA_BOOB_TALK
        | This must be Vitra's brother, Vitruvius.
    ] As the door shuts behind [party.yall], he glances up from his work just long enough to give you a quick "One moment please," before resuming his work for another minute or so. You're able to take this opportunity to look around the shop at the numerous bronzeworks spread throughout. From blade to armor to tool and beyond, every single item here seems to have been meticulously crafted and inlaid with intricate and loving detail. In the back corner, however, is a display case of weapons and armor a cut above even the finest words in the room.
    
    While he puts the finishing touches on his current project, you inspect the craftsman himself further. The 'mander works shirtless, leaving his toned chest, stomach, and back exposed to the heat—though his natural resistance to such temperatures leaves him largely unfazed. Splotches of soot dot his red-scaled arms and tanned, human-like torso and neck, not to mention the fabric of his toolbelt. Were it not for the color of his trousers, you imagine those, too would be covered in similar dark hand marks. His tail is constantly in use, be it to grab a tool or object from elsewhere or to heat up a part of the metal that he's about to work. 
    
    His muscles flex and relax with each hammer blow, showing off years of hard work spent honing both craft and body. The sweat of exertion glints in the light cast by the lit furnace in the corner and the flickering of his tail-flame. Each movement is accompanied by focused breathing, perfectly in sync to maximize his precision.
    
    When he finally has the sheet metal formed to a point he finds acceptable—from what you can tell, to the basic shape of a breastplate—he sets the bronze aside and puts his hammer back into his belt. As he relaxes, he turns to you and begins to extend a hand before thinking better of it upon realizing how sweaty it still is.
    
    "Greetings. Haven't seen you around here before, [var0
        |though from the look of you, you must be the [pc.man] I've heard so much about from my sister. It's a pleasure to finally meet you.
        |so, welcome to my slice of Khor'minos.
    ] I'm Vitruvius, namesake and proprietor of this here bronze smithery.[var0
        || You may have met my sister at Ember's Taphouse across the way. You can't miss her, really.
    ]"
    
    [var0
        |You are indeed [pc.name].
        |[vitra.met
            |You give a nod and a chuckle as you introduce yourself. [pc.dcb
                |No, you definitely couldn't miss a pair of fat knockers like hers.
                |It's definitely hard to miss a girl like Vitra, to say the least.
                |You definitely couldn't miss her! She has great boobies!
            ]
            |You'll have to keep that in mind, you say after introducing yourself properly.
        ]
    ]
    
    "So, what can I get for you?"
    "

rows.original:
"Oh, that?" the bronzesmith says. "That's where I keep my finest works. A masterpiece each, and Nieves was kind enough to enchant them for me—for a price, obviously, but even so."
    
    Are they for sale?
    
    "Yeah, they are. Just out of most folk's price ranges, since I didn't make them to sell so much as to push myself and see what I could make. Typically only happens when I'm [silly
        |taken by a fey mood
        |particularly unhappy with the monotony of my standard work
    ]. Feel free to take a look, and tell me if any of them interest you."
rows.translation:
哦，那个吗？”青铜匠说道，“那些都是我最得意的作品。每一件都是杰作，而妮维丝还慷慨地为我为它们施加了魔法——当然，这也是要付出代价的，但即便如此，我还是觉得非常感激。”
    
    “这些作品是用来出售的吗？”
    
    “是的，当然是用来出售的。只不过，它们的价格超出了大多数人的承受范围。因为我制作这些作品，并不是为了赚钱，而是为了挑战自己，看看自己究竟能创造出什么。通常只有在我[silly

rows.original: You follow Yashiko back to her room, but she abruptly pulls you off to a side room with a thicker door. Once inside she ensures the door is locked and gives you a curious and excited stare. Raising an eyebrow, you cross your arms and wait for her to do something more. "Now then, I don't think I'll be needing this anymore," she says, an almost giddy tinge in her tone as she turns to face you. All at once, her body is engulfed in blue foxfire. It's startling at first, but it's a mad giggle that comes from the fire rather than any kind of screaming. Flecks of illusion peel away like burning paper, revealing a very similar figure, but with much longer ears, a fanged smile, and many more tails. When the fire clears, you get a good look at what is very definitely a kitsune rather than a minotaur. She shares the same coloration as she did before, with dark colors transitioning to a honey yellow, and the same casual smile. Somehow, though, she looks even more proud. "By the prince of passion and the frolicsome emperor, it's good to be out of that shroud." "Bwuh" "Don't get me wrong, these cow ladies are hot, and they really understand the struggle," she continues, hefting her still cow-sized bust. "But one tail just isn't enough to really stretch, ya know?" "You're also a kitsune?" "... Yeah? Are the tails not enough? I'm certainly no mere foxen. Did the spectacle of my illusion burning away sear your eyes?" "N-no, it's just... [pc.dcb |I didn't expect to see another kitsune, |It was a surprise, that's all, |You're, like, even prettier! ]" you say. "[pc.dcb |Of course you didn't. Nobody does, even in places like this with more well-maintained temples to Keros |Of course it was! Nobody expects to see kitsune across the seas, even in places like this with more well-maintained temples to Keros |Aww thank you, you're quite the fetching [pc.heightRange 0 56 |little ] fox yourself ]," she replies[pc.isBimbo |, honking one of your tits. |. ] "I am, however, still in the gainful employ of this wondrous monument to Mallach. If you'd like to change your mind about your choice of compensated worship, I'm oh so good at a great deal of things. Disguise or no, I am a treat. I'll need to put this back on while we walk, but not while we're alone." She flashes another fangy smile, giving you a moment to think as she re-casts her bovine illusion. Would you like to change your mind?
rows.translation: 你跟着雅诗子回到房间，她却突然把你拉进一间房门更加厚实的侧室。进门后，她确认房门已经锁好，又以好奇而兴奋的目光盯着你。你扬起一边眉毛，交叉双臂，等她采取进一步行动。 “那么，我想自己不再需要这个了，”她转身面向你说道，语气中透出近乎欢欣雀跃的意味。 她的身体骤然被蓝色狐火吞没。起初着实吓人，不过火焰中传来的不是任何尖叫，而是狂放的咯咯笑声。幻象碎片像燃烧的纸张一样剥落，显露出非常相似的身影，不过耳朵长了许多，笑容间露出尖牙，还有多得多的尾巴。火焰散去时，你终于看清眼前之人绝对是狐妖，而非弥诺陶洛斯。她的配色和之前相同，由深色渐变为蜜黄色，也带着同样轻松的笑容。不过不知为何，她显得更加自豪。“以激情王子和嬉游帝君之名，终于能摆脱那层伪装，感觉真好。” “呃哇。” “别误会，这些牛姑娘很性感，也真的理解其中的难处，”她继续说道，托起仍如母牛般硕大的胸部。“可只有一条尾巴，连舒展身体都不够，懂吗？” “你也是狐妖？” “……对啊？这些尾巴还不足以说明吗？我当然不是什么普通狐族。难道幻象燃烧剥落的场面灼伤了你的眼睛？” “不、不是，只是……[pc.dcb |我没料到会见到另一名狐妖， |只是有点惊讶，仅此而已， |你、你好像变得更漂亮了！ ]”你说道。 “[pc.dcb |你当然没料到。没人会想到，即使是在这种凯罗斯神殿维护得更加完善的地方 |当然会惊讶！没人料到能在海对岸看到狐妖，即使是在这种凯罗斯神殿维护得更加完善的地方 |啊，谢谢，你自己也是只相当迷人的[pc.heightRange 0 56 |小 ]狐狸 ]，”她回答道[pc.isBimbo |，同时按了按你的一只乳房。 |。 ]“不过，我依然受雇于这座献给马拉赫的奇妙殿堂，并从中获得丰厚酬劳。如果你想改变主意，换一种有偿崇拜服务，我可是很擅长许多事情。无论有没有伪装，我都是绝佳享受。走动时我得重新披上伪装，但独处时就不必了。” 她再次露出尖牙微笑，让你思考片刻，同时重新施放牛族幻象。你想改变主意吗？

rows.original: "So why come to visit Khor'minos? I was under the impression that the old country had a more seclusionary bent," you ask, prompting a grin from the [yashiko.known |disguised fox |gilded cow ]. "Secluded is not the synonym of prison. A number of important folk have graced my chambers back home, but I'm no royal concubine. My leaving and returning is nothing of import," she says, brushing your arm with one hand. "To answer your first question, though, I am here on a pilgrimage." "A pilgrimage? To Khor'minos?" you ask, raising an eyebrow. "Yes, to Khor'minos. That is where we are, is it not?" she replies with a giggle. "Did you know this is one of the few places outside the old country that actively maintain a temple to Keros? Plenty of places have devoted spaces in their omnitheist temples, but the laughing lord's temples, if they exist at all, tend to fall to disrepair in other parts of the world, or so I'm told. Here, though, even his devoted temple is both well-maintained and staffed." "Khor'minos is known for their temples. I suppose I can't be surprised that a temple to Keros is included." "Perhaps you cannot, but I was quite happily surprised. Even more-so that the minotaur priestesses knew the rites and rituals by heart! I am elated to have them for company in my off hours while I'm stuck here. They have made the blockade's delay of my pilgrimage worth every moment. Well, between them and the lovely Feronia allowing me to ply my trade." "Do you have any idea where you'll be going next? After here, I mean." "Hmmm. At first, when I was miserable about the blockade, I just wanted to go home. The splendid Kerosite priestesses, however, showed me some maps of a Kerosite temple ruins in old Izkanti. If I can find a strapping mercenary to guide me, I may attempt a pilgrimage to that site as well. [pc.isKitsune |You're welcome to join me, if you so desire. To see the ancient temples of our god is an exquisite experience. ]" "Wow. You're quite the intrepid explorer. [pc.isKitsune |I don't know if it's in the cards for me, but I've got connections. Perhaps I can help find a 'strapping mercenary' for you. |If I see any aspiring explorers, perhaps I'll send them your way. ]" "Mmmhmhm, please do. Even if they're not the traveling type, I'm sure I can make it worth their while." "Had you been anywhere else before Khor'minos?" you ask. "Is this where your pilgrimage began?" "I might be tempted to say both are true. This is not the first place I came to visit temples, but the first several places I visited were lesser-traveled temples in my homeland. The twin shrine to Keros and Mallach in the island chains closer to Macah is in a sorry state right now. The last few years have been harsh on it during the hurricane season, and the poor priests and priestesses cannot keep up. Waves and storms are not the kind of relentless pounding they are made to withstand." "Grim, but amusing." "Indeed," Yashiko smirks, swishing her tail[yashiko.known |s ]. "But they persist nonetheless. The shrines might be in a constant battle of repair and disrepair, but their miko's are steadfast and dedicated as ever. Kitsune, tanuki, and a fair few oni staff the place during the times the isles are not beset by storms. I was fortunate enough to see it at the peak of the summer seasons. They make it work, even if the bridge between the isles is knocked asunder again and again." "It sounds wondrous, despite the issues." "Indeed, and that was only my first stop. There are numerous lesser-known shrines and temples within easy traveling distance of the capital. After that, however, this has been my first and as yet only stop. I could have made a more difficult trek deeper into Macah along the way, but I decided against it. This has been much more relaxing, and rewarding," she says, brushing a hand over your thigh and then up your side.

rows.original:
"Do you know any of the local kitsune? There's an arcology in the woods to the west."
    
    "I know of the arcology. The Torii gate there was my method of arrival. I do not, however, know any of the kitsune there. The lady priestesses who met me at the gate were quite charming, but I didn't stay for extended conversation. Once I had my feet under me, I left immediately to visit the temples here. I didn't see much of the arcology at all, in fact. Though what I did see was reminiscent of home."
    
    "Interesting. I take it you haven't been back since, with the blockade and all."
    
    "No. First it was the snowstorm locking me here, and then it was the blockade. Beyond that, I'm content to stay here a while regardless. The lady Feronia is quite accommodating, and I do not feel the need to leave in any great hurry. Even if the blockade were to rescind tomorrow, I would be content to remain here till I am otherwise tempted away."
    
    "I'm glad to hear it, if it means I get to keep enjoying your company," you say.
    
    "Flatterer! You better keep on coming back, then."

    “我知道那座生态建筑群。我正是通过那里的鸟居来到此地。不过，我并不认识住在那里的任何狐妖。在门前迎接我的女祭司们相当迷人，但我没有留下来长谈。站稳脚跟后，我便立刻离开，前来拜访这里的神殿。事实上，我几乎没有参观那座建筑群，不过自己看到的部分确实令我想起了故乡。”
    
    “有意思。封锁发生之后，你应该再也没回去过吧。”
    
    “没有。先是一场暴风雪将我困在这里，接着又发生了封锁。除此之外，无论如何，我都愿意在此住上一阵子。菲罗妮娅女士十分善解人意，我并不觉得需要匆忙离开。即使封锁明天便解除，我也乐意继续留在这里，直到别的诱惑将我带走。”
    
    “很高兴听你这么说——如果这意味着我还能继续享受你的陪伴。”你说道。
    
    “马屁精！那你以后可得继续回来。”

rows.original: "So how do you handle meals? Wouldn't that be kind of noticeable? All your clients leaving even more drained than normal?" you ask. "Ha," she snorts, turning up her nose. "You vastly underestimate my clients. I am so well fed here I'd be tempted to say I'm glutted for choice. I'm so content and full that I've gained a tail since arriving in the city! I need not drain a single client to the point of ennervation, and I'll be more full than most kitsune have been since their mothers fed them secondhand essence." "Wow. That good?" "Minotaurs are quite hardy folk. It's like having a buffet of food that never spoils and happily walks to your stomach. I'll be sad to leave here when I eventually do. I might even arrange to come back for a time." "It certainly sounds like it's left an impression on you." "Mmm, It has certainly gotten the chance to. I can't say I would think the same if I hadn't been forced to stay here. I probably would have been much more urgent in my pilgrimage had I not been forced to stay still. But I'm glad I was. I despair just thinking that I could have simply missed such an amazing opportunity," she says, holding the back of her hand to her head in a mockery of feeling faint. "Was it like that from the start?" "Since I got here? Maybe not the first day, but at the very least since the second day I worked here. You could say I'm very good at disguising my feeding as being very good at my job," she says, eyes flashing with mischief. "Fair enough," you say. "I didn't think of it that way." "It was still a good question. I'm glad I could give a satisfying answer."

rows.original:
"What's your job like back in Kitsuhon, similar to here?"
    
    "In some ways, different in others," she says, rubbing her chin. "Most simply, the majority of my clients are non-kitsune. Oni, [yashiko.known
        |
        |other 
    ]minotaurs, humans, take your pick. Tanuki in particular love playing with my assets, I've found. I get my fair share of [yashiko.known
        |fellow 
        |
    ]kitsune, but sleek and small is what's 'in' in the capital right now."
    
    "Do the kitsune tend to [yashiko.known
        |feed during that kind of thing?
        |feed on you?
    ]"
    
    Yashiko pauses overlong while thinking on her answer, till you wonder whether it was ok to ask in the first place. Then, she slowly shakes her head.
    
    "My answer is more complicated than I can probably give in good faith. Condensed to the most simple way I can manage, it is officially not allowed. In some cases, particularly with higher class concubines, feeding without explicit permission is a huge taboo in either direction. In others, 'light snacking' is allowed, as it were. Rarely, the feeding is made the entire purpose of the visit. Usually in places of lesser repute. It's more common for kitsune concubines to be given permission to feed than it is for kitsune patrons."
    
    "It's fine, that's plenty enough of an answer. Did you have one brothel that employed you, or did you move around?"
    
    "I have been all over the isles," she says, smiling once more as her prideful aura returns. "Though recently the Mallachite shrines in the capital have had a monopoly on me. I once spent a week booked in a Velunite grove-shrine as well. That was quite exquisite. Did you know that sufficiently powerful kitsune can feed through the waters of a hotspring? You scarcely notice the draining when you're so relaxed by the waters. Dancing naked with the dryads is also an experience that should not be missed."
    
    "[var0
        |I can imagine,
        |You've got me convinced,
    ]" you laugh.
    
    "I prefer a single shrine or brothel to call home at any given time, but I'm not particularly attached to any specific one permanently. My glory should be exalted in every city I grace, and I wouldn't deny my body to any sufficiently pious soul seeking worship."
    
    "I'm glad this city was among your choices," you say with a grin.
    
    "And I'm glad to find it full of just such sufficiently pious individuals," she says, grinning right back and booping you on the nose.

rows.translation: [flags.AMBRA_MET |来到雕像脚下，你四处寻找安布拉。却不见那只金色的小猫的踪影——她的物品都整齐地摆放在她的垫子上，但安布拉本人却不见踪影，而她那平时总是挂在背上的巨大背包也不见了，取而代之的是三个堆叠在一起的箱子。 [km.isCorrupted |坐在雕像的基座上，双臂交叠的，是一头脾气暴躁的弥诺陶洛斯公牛，它正注视着那些商品。 “喂，他知道安布拉在哪里吗？她的东西就在这里。” 弥诺陶洛斯公牛哼了一声，然后指向垫子后面的一个标志牌上——那些用木头和木炭写成的小字非常整齐： 低价优惠！划算的交易！我现在有点不方便，暂时不能陪大家了，但这并不意味着生意就不能像往常一样继续进行，哈哈！ “请来看看我精心挑选的商品吧——只要你有钱，什么都有，哈哈！每件商品的价格都标注在下方，请将付款放入陶罐中！商品库存每天都会变化，所以请经常回来看看吧！ ——安布拉 如果你见过安布拉的字迹，就会知道这肯定是她的笔迹——反正绝对不可能是任何弥诺陶洛斯的笔迹。这简直太有……猫人风格了，没什么别的可说的了。[pc.ora catfolk |你应该知道的吧 ]好吧，安布拉已经离开了。现在该怎么办呢？他那么，我是来干这个的吧？ 公牛低吼道：“由于最近城里局势动荡，我被雇来照看这些货物。以前，就算没人看管，人们也会诚实地支付他们拿走的东西，但现在情况变了——变化得太快了。” 好吧，那安布拉呢？ 他耸了耸肩。 真是个话多的家伙，不是吗？ “我可没拿钱来闲聊的。 |当你正疑惑她是否只是暂时去了某个地方时，地毯后面的一个标志吸引了你的注意——那些用木头和木炭写成的整洁小字 低价优惠！划算的交易！我现在有点不方便，暂时不能陪大家了，但这并不意味着生意不能像往常一样继续进行，哈哈！ 请来看看我精心挑选的商品吧——只要你有钱，什么都有哦，哈哈！每件商品的价格都标在下面了，请把钱放进陶罐里吧！商品库存每天都在变化，所以请经常来看看哦！ ——安布拉 当你正在为这个问题绞尽脑汁时，旁边经过的一只弥诺陶洛斯竟然弯下腰，拿起了两大壶廉价葡萄酒，然后往罐子里扔了几枚硬币。这真的让人难以置信。 [pc.bg slumrat |尤其是当你体内的每一本能都在告诉你，这个目标是多么容易捕捉的时候。 ]但如果你认为有人能够与科尔米诺斯的市民建立起这种融洽的关系，那肯定就是安布拉了。 ] 嗯，这个系统看起来挺简单的。顾客拿走商品，然后把钱放进罐子里。不过还有很多问题没有得到解答——比如为什么安布拉不能正常工作，这意味着什么，谁来收取这些钱并采购新的商品来摆摊等等。不过至少目前一切还是照常进行，而且安布拉应该也没事，不管她现在在哪里……毕竟最终还是她在维护这个摊位，对吧？ 对吧？ 无论如何，在安布拉回来之前——不管那会是什么时候——我们只能继续做生意了。 |在十字路口挤过人群，你会看到一幅颇为常见的景象——在雕像的基座前铺着一块垫子，上面摆放着各式各样的商品。除了这些展示出来的物品外，旁边还放着几个小盒子，想必是用来在垫子上的商品售罄后补充货物的。 这真是典型的小贩摊位布置啊不然而，更为常见的是[km.isCorrupted |一只脾气暴躁的弥诺陶洛斯公牛坐在雕像的基座上，时刻监视着那些商品。 “这是他的店铺吗？” 它摇了摇头：“不是，不过由于最近城里发生了动乱，我被雇来负责看管这些货物。过去，你可以把这样的东西放在那里，让人们自觉地支付他们拿走的东西，但现在情况已经变了。” 确实变了。那么…… 弥诺陶洛斯低吼着，然后指了指某个方向。看看那个标志吧。价格不是我定的，所以别跟我讨价还价。” 话说回来，这个摊位到底是谁的？肯定是有人雇用了他。 “这种事应该由我来决定，而不是由别人来评价。” 真是个爱说话的家伙，不是吗？ “我拿工资可不是为了说话的。” 你叹了口气，然后将注意力转向垫子后面的招牌。尽管是用木炭在木头上写字的，但字迹却很小且很整齐，甚至还有点可爱： “低价优惠！超值商品！快来看看我精心挑选的商品吧——只要你有钱，什么都有哦，nya-jya！每件商品的价格都标注在下方，请将付款放入陶罐中！商品库存每天都会变化，所以请经常回来看看吧！ |可以说，根本就没有人注意到这家路边的小店。在应该有人坐的地方，挂着一个用漂亮、工整的笔迹写成的小牌子，尽管那些字是用木炭在木板上刻出来的。 低价优惠！划算的交易！快来看看我精心挑选的商品吧——只要你有钱，什么都有哦，nya-jya！每件商品的价格都标在下方了，请把钱放进陶罐里支付吧！商品库存每天都在变化，所以请经常回来看看哦！ 当你还在思考这套安排的新奇之处时，一只路过的弥诺陶洛斯突然弯下腰，拿起了两大壶廉价葡萄酒，然后往罐子里扔了几枚硬币。这…… [pc.bgMulti noblescion scholar acolyte slumrat |你应该还记得你的导师们曾经向你解释过：在古老的贝尔哈尔，即使是乡村地区，也是如此宁静而文明，农民和商贩们会将商品摆在路边，而人们会自觉地支付相应的价格来购买这些商品。在某些情况下，甚至没有任何标明价格的信息，人们只是根据自己认为这些商品应有的价值来支付费用。 而这样的制度能够真正运作，正是因为每一位贝拉兰公民都彼此信任。可以说，这是有记载以来人类文明的巅峰。这一切听起来都如此不可思议……然而，现在这一切却正在你眼前发生。 |你应该还记得读过那些关于古老贝尔哈尔乡村的记载吧——那里曾经如此宁静文明，农民和商贩们会将商品摆在路边，而人们也会自觉地支付相应的价钱。在某些情况下，甚至没有任何标明价格的信息，人们只是根据自己认为这些商品的价值来支付费用。 |作为一名追随者，你应该还记得那些关于古老贝尔哈尔生活的描述：那里被众神庇佑，农民和商贩可以将商品摆在路边，而人们会自觉地支付应有的价格。在某些情况下，甚至没有任何标明的价格，人们只是根据自己认为这些商品应有的价值来支付费用。这种虔诚的精神在帝国中生根发芽，最终演变成了那个时代高尚的公民意识，也正是这种精神使得该帝国具备了战胜所有竞争对手的力量。 There's no sign of the golden kitten — her wares are all laid out on her mat, but there's neither hide nor hair of Ambra herself, and the usual sight of her enormous rucksack's been replaced with that of a trio of boxes stacked atop each other. [km.isCorrupted |Sitting on the statue's plinth with his arms folded is a grumpy minotaur bull, keeping an eye on the wares. Hey, does he know where Ambra is? Her stuff's here. He grunts and points at a sign behind the mat, neat small letters written on wood in charcoal: "Low prices! Great deals! I'm indisposed at the moment and it'll be a while before I can be with you again, but that doesn't mean that business can't go on as usual, nya-jya! "Please take a look at my fine selection — I have wares if you have coin, nya-jya! Prices are noted below every item, please put payment in the clay jar! Stock changes every day, so come back often! " — Ambra" That's Ambra's handwriting if you ever saw it — certainly not any minotaur's, at any rate. It's very... catfolk, if nothing else[pc.ora catfolk |; you'd know ]. Okay, so Ambra's gone. What's he here for, then? The bull grunts. "I've been hired to keep an eye on the goods given the recent unrest in the city. Used to be that you could leave out something like this unattended and have people honestly pay for what they took, but things have changed. So damned quickly, too." All right. And what about Ambra? rows.original: You step forward to inspect the goods on display[km.isCorrupted |, and the minotaur goon eyeing the spread gives you a steady nod. "No funny business, now. I may be just the security, but I'm paid well enough that I'm not about to lose this gig if I can help it." All right, you get it. Time to see what's on sale, then. "Everything's set out by the time I get here to start my shift, selection changes every day. He shrugs. "Take your pick. Want to sell anything, just drop it on the mat and take what you're owed." All right, all right. Time to do business, then. | — while they've been laid out and there's a half-filled money jar on display, no one's watching the shop. It really speaks to the ethos of the city that despite being so recently besieged by demons, the honor system still works. That, and the constant stream of people passing by the outskirts means no end of eyes on anyone intending to get up to funny business. You vaguely wonder at that — surely someone has seen whoever comes to collect the money and restock the mat, right? Surely, right? ...Well. Time to see what's on offer, anyway. ]
rows.translation: 你走上前仔细查看展出的商品。[km.isCorrupted |那个盯着摊位上货品的弥诺陶洛斯打手稳稳地朝你点了点头。“现在可别耍什么花招。我虽然只是个看场子的，但工钱给得够多，我可不想平白丢了这份差事。” 好吧，你明白了。那么，是时候去看看有什么可买的了。 “等我到这儿开始轮班的时候，所有东西都已经摆好了，货色每天都不一样。”他耸了耸肩。“随便挑吧。想卖什么东西，直接放到垫子上，然后拿走你该得的钱就行。” 好吧，好吧。那就来做生意吧。 | — 既然货品都已经摆好，摊上还放着个半满的钱罐，却没人看着这家店。这座城市刚刚才遭到恶魔的围攻，诚信制度却依然行得通，这确实很能说明此地的风气。再加上不断有人从城外经过，任何想动手脚的人都会被无数双眼睛盯着。你不禁有些疑惑——总该有人见过那些来收钱、给垫子补货的家伙吧？总该有人见过吧？ ……好吧。不管怎样，先看看有什么可买的。 ]

rows.translation: [var0 |你从垫子上取走想要的东西[km.isCorrupted |在那个弥诺陶洛斯打手的注视下，把应付的钱放进钱罐里。交换完成后，公牛哼了一声，把注意力从你身上转向下一位顾客——买卖一了结，它的兴致就彻底没了。 |然后把应付的钱放进钱罐里。没有人当面说什么，但你摆弄钱罐时能感觉到好几道目光正盯着你的后腰……大概，这也是另一种让人们守规矩、不偏离正道的手段吧。 ] 没有店主来经营生意，确实会显得有些不便，但在店主真正回来之前，似乎也无计可施……如果他还回得来的话。不过，至少可以肯定的是，这种做法确实是有效的。 |[km.isCorrupted |“什么都不买吗？”弥诺陶洛斯低声说道，“那也没关系，只要你不是想顺手牵羊。我可盯着你呢……其实附近所有人我都盯着，所以没必要这么神经过敏。” |目前垫子上没有任何让你感兴趣的东西，于是你走开了，让其他人去浏览那些展出的商品。这里的氛围并不糟，但就是和有个人在旁边时不一样。无论这种不同是好的还是坏的……嗯，明天会有新的货色。 ] ]
rows.raw: " [var0 |You gather what you want from the mat[km.isCorrupted | under the watchful eyes of the minotaur goon, then drop the amount payable in the money jar. Satisfied with the exchange, the bull grunts and turns his attention from you to the next customer, interest completely gone now that the deal's done. |, then fill the money jar with the amount payable. No one outwardly says anything, but you feel several gazes boring in the small of your back as you handle the money jar... another incentive to keep people on the straight and narrow, one supposes. ] Doing business without a shopkeeper is perhaps rather awkward, but it doesn't look like anything can be done about it until the proprietor actually returns... if ever. Well, one can't doubt as to its efficacy, if nothing else. |[km.isCorrupted |"Not buying anything?" the minotaur grunts. "Fine by me, so long as you're not looking for a five-finger discount. I've got my eyes on you... and everyone nearby, for that matter, so no need to get all fussy about it." |There isn't anything on the mat that interests you at the moment, so you step away and let someone else browse the goods on display. rows.original: [flags.AMBRA_MET |Ambra is here as usual by the foot of the giant minotaur statue, her wares laid out and rucksack by her side; there's no shortage of customers perusing her wares, drawn by her cuteness, her prices, or both. [rand |The golden-furred kitten lights up visibly as you approach, eyes brightening, ears perking up and tail swishing as a big, pleasant smile crosses her lips. "Welcome! Welcome! I have many things for sale today, all of the best quality and at very reasonable prices, nya-jya! Just look at everyone else making off with the deals they found here, happy as can be — don't you want to be counted amongst their number too? I have very good wine and fruit preserves if you're interested in such things. "But no hurry! Please, take your time and you will find something pleasing to your tastes, nya-jya. Such is the way of things in this land after the borders were closed — there is no rush to do anything in the city, since no one is going anywhere!" |As you watch, the golden-furred kitten deftly wraps up several items for her customers and receives payment with deft swiftness, her hands moving so quickly her fingers are a blur. It's when you get to the fore of the crowd that Ambra spots you and smiles, all but vibrating on the spot with excitement — or at least, more excitement than what she was displaying before. "Ah, you're back! You're back!" Well, that's a warm welcome if you ever had one. "That everyone returns to buy things from me is a blessing from the gods themselves, nya-jya! Things are terrible out in the tunnels, or so I hear. Very bad, very bad! But no! You're here, safe and sound, and now have I got many special things on sale just for you today, nya-jya![silly | Bombs, ropes, you want it, I've got it... so long as you've enough rupees, my friend." Really? "No, I was just bullshitting you. But I do have many things for sale! ] Do come and have a look, nya-jya!" |A patrol of minotaur guards comes through the crossroads plaza, gives her a quick look-over, then turn back to their own business, quickly moving on their way. It's as you suspected — the little golden kitten either is too small fry for them to bother with, or they don't see anything wrong with her peddling her wares here. As you approach, Ambra greets you with a little dip of her head and wiggle of her ears and tail. "It's you! It's you! My favorite customer, nya-jya! How are you doing today?" Perfectly fine. Business good? "Good as always! I just saw no less than ten of my favorite customers since I opened up for business this morning, and you can help add to their number, nya-jya! That is a most worthy cause, I would say, and in exchange you can take home any of my amazing wares! How about it?" |As you watch, the golden kitten takes a long swig of something from a canteen, then shivers all over and sighs with palpable relief. Touting her goods all day with such enthusiasm must be thirsty work... "Welcome! Welcome! Another customer, nya-jya!" Ambra positively oozes oppressively adorable energy from every fiber of her being as she waves you over, no doubt already expectant that you'll be willing and able to fork over your hard-earned money in exchange for her wares. "You know what they say — time is money, so I won't take that much of yours, nya-jya! What're you buying today?" ] |You squint hard at the kitten peddler hawking her wares by the street — no, no, she's definitely below five feet, that's for certain. That, and her rich golden hair... possibly too rich to be natural, so probably dyed in the traditional style of catfolk... that, and the bottom-heavy figure she's sporting. [pc.ra kitsune | There's a certain something or the other to this little catfolk peddler, and while you have a sneaking suspicion as to what it might be, the cat ears and tail attached to her tell a different story. Or do they? You've got to know for certain, and if this is really Kohaku she'll have no choice but to comply with someone so much higher up than her in the food chain, or at least that's how you think this works. Barely have your hands closed upon the slender slinkiness of the golden kitten's tail that she whips it out of your grasp, making a pouty face at you. "Hey, hey, hey, [pc.mf|mister|miss]! That's not for sale, nya-jya. My wares are all on the mat, so keep your hands away, okay? You break it, you bought it!" Hmm... on one hand, you think you began feeling something before your fingers actually came in contact with her tail, but on the other hand there's no doubt it was the sleek, slinky furriness of a feline tail instead of the fat fluffiness that you'd half-expected. It's all so confusing. |[flags.ELECTRA_MET| There's a certain something or the other to this little catfolk peddler — that's right, there's a striking similarity to a certain little half-lupine peddler you met in Tychris. Not necessarily physically, what with one being a cat and the other a dog, but the general demeanor, body shape, and bubbly eagerness are all unmistakable. Unthinkingly, you reach for the slender slinkiness of the golden kitten's tail, but she whips it out of your grasp, making a pouty face at you. "Hey, hey, hey, [pc.mf|mister|miss]! That's not for sale, nya-jya. My wares are all on the mat, so keep your hands away, okay? You break it, you bought it!" Sorry. It's just that she reminds you of someone you met in Tychris, that's all. "Tychris? Never been there. I'd like to do business there some day, nya-jya, but it's a long way to walk for a kitten like me, and the roads are getting more dangerous by the day. As famous as the glassware is, I wouldn't make enough to justify the risk and time." But there was that little half-lupine you met — "I wouldn't know, everyone's got to look like someone else. Look, I'm a cat." She points up at her wiggling cat ears. "Definitely and absolutely not a dog, nya-jya. Maybe you should buy something? That'll help clear your mind." [silly |She wouldn't happen to have a sister, would she? Or even many, many sisters? And they all look suspiciously similar, if not outright identical down to their verbal tics? And by the by, wouldn't they all happen to have some variant of the same name? The little golden kitten huffs and plants her hands on her hips. "Don't be ridiculous, nya-jya. My name's not Anna." ] That clears it up, then. Obviously it's just a coincidence that every major city in the Marches just happens to harbor a petite, animal-eared merchant with a penchant for mercantilism. |[flags.FHAUS_STOREHOUSE_ENTERED| There's a certain something or the other to this little catfolk peddler, and while you have a sneaking suspicion as to what it might be, the cat ears and tail attached to her tell a different story. Or do they? Your fingers are itching; you've got to know for certain. Barely have your hands closed upon the slender slinkiness of the golden kitten's tail that she whips it out of your grasp, making a pouty face at you. "Hey, hey, hey, [pc.mf|mister|miss]! That's not for sale, nya-jya. My wares are all on the mat, so keep your hands away, okay? You break it, you bought it!" Hmm... on one hand, you think you began feeling something before your fingers actually came in contact with her tail, but on the other hand there's no doubt it was the sleek, slinky furriness of a feline tail instead of the fat fluffiness that you'd half-expected. It's all so confusing. | It's as if some circumspect deity had gathered together all the cuteness and adorableness he could find, sprinkled it with a generous helping of sex appeal, and set it loose upon the world to effect a terrible campaign of brutal mercantilism and economic ruin. Well, maybe that last is a bit of an exaggeration, but given the brisk business that this little kitten is doing for being a mere roadside peddler she must be making an absolute killing. ] ] ] ]
rows.translation: [flags.AMBRA_MET |安布拉照旧待在那尊巨大的弥诺陶洛斯雕像脚下，货品摆开，行囊就搁在身边；围着她挑选货品的顾客络绎不绝，有人被她可爱的模样吸引，有人冲着她的价钱，或者两者兼有。[rand |那只金毛小猫见你走近，肉眼可见地亮了起来，眼睛放光、耳朵竖起、尾巴轻甩，一个大大的愉快笑容爬上她的嘴唇。 “欢迎！欢迎！今天我可有许多东西要卖，全是上等品质，价钱也非常公道，喵呀！你瞧瞧别人，都带着在这儿淘到的好货心满意足地走了——难道你不想也算上一个吗？要是你有兴趣，我这还有非常好的葡萄酒和水果蜜饯。 “不过不用急！请慢慢挑，你一定能找到合自己口味的东西，喵呀。边境封锁之后这片土地上的规矩就是这样——在城里做什么都不用急，反正谁也去不了别处！” |你看着那只金毛小猫麻利地为顾客包好几件货品，又手脚飞快地收下钱款，双手快得手指都成了残影。等你挤到人群前头，安布拉才看见你，随即笑起来，整个人几乎当场兴奋得发起抖来——或者说，至少比她方才表现出的样子更兴奋。 “啊，你回来了！你回来了！” 那可真算得上热情洋溢的欢迎。 “大家都回来找我买东西，这简直是神明亲自赐下的祝福，喵呀！听说隧道那边的情况糟透了，非常糟，非常糟！可你不一样！你好好地、平安地站在这儿，而我今天正好为你准备了许多特别的东西在特卖，喵呀！[silly | 炸弹、绳索，你想要什么我都有……只要你的卢比够多，我的朋友。” 真的假的？ “不，我刚才是跟你瞎扯的。不过我确实有许多东西要卖！ ]快来瞧一瞧吧，喵呀！” |一队弥诺陶洛斯卫兵穿过十字路口的广场，匆匆瞥了她一眼，随后便转头去办自己的事，快步走开了。这跟你猜想的一样——要么这只金色小猫太小角色，不值得他们费心，要么他们根本不觉得她在这儿摆摊有什么问题。你走近时，安布拉微微颔首、抖了抖耳朵和尾巴，向你致意。 “是你！是你！我最喜欢的客人，喵呀！今天过得怎么样？” 挺好的。生意如何？ “跟往常一样好！我今天早上开张到现在，见到的老主顾至少就有十个，而你可以帮我把这个数字再加一，喵呀！依我看，这是最值得投身的事业，作为回报，你可以把我那些了不起的货品随便挑一件带回家！怎么样？” |你看着那只金色小猫从水壶里长长地灌了一口，然后浑身一颤，带着显而易见地舒畅叹了口气。一整天这么热情洋溢地叫卖，想必很费嗓子…… “欢迎！欢迎！又来一位客人，喵呀！”安布拉浑身上下每一根毛发都在往外渗着那种让人招架不住的可爱劲儿，她朝你招手，显然已经笃定你愿意也有能力掏出辛苦挣来的钱换她的货。“俗话说得好——时间就是金钱，所以我不会占用你太多时间，喵呀！今天打算买点什么？” ] |你眯起眼仔细打量这个在街边叫卖的小猫商人——不对，不对，她绝对不到五英尺高，这一点可以肯定。再加上她那头浓艳的金发……艳得简直不像天生的，多半是按猫族的传统风格染的……还有她那上轻下重的身段。[pc.ra kitsune | 这个小猫族商人身上总有那么点说不清道不明的东西，你隐约猜到那可能是什么，可她头上那对猫耳和身后那条猫尾却在讲述另一个版本的故事。 真是这样吗？ 你非得弄个明白不可，而如果她真是琥珀，那面对食物链上高她这么多的存在，她只能乖乖顺从——至少你以为规矩是这样的。你的手才刚握住那只金色小猫纤细柔滑的尾巴，她就一把抽了回去，冲你做了个气鼓鼓的鬼脸。 “喂，喂，喂，[pc.mf|先生|小姐]！那玩意儿不卖，喵呀。我的货都摆在垫子上，手别乱伸，行吗？碰坏了你可是要赔的！” 嗯……一方面，你觉得在手指真正碰到她尾巴之前就已经感觉到了什么；可另一方面，那手感毫无疑问是猫科尾巴那种顺滑柔软的毛感，而不是你隐约以为的肥厚蓬松。 真是让人一头雾水。 |[flags.ELECTRA_MET| 这个小猫族商人身上总有那么点说不清道不明的东西——没错，她和你曾在提克里斯遇到的那个半狼族小商人有几分惊人的相似。倒不一定是外貌，毕竟一个是猫一个是狗，但那份神态、体型和活泼热络的劲头，都是一模一样的。 你不假思索地伸手去抓那只金色小猫纤细柔滑的尾巴，她却一把抽了回去，冲你做了个气鼓鼓的鬼脸。 “喂，喂，喂，[pc.mf|先生|小姐]！那玩意儿不卖，喵呀。我的货都摆在垫子上，手别乱伸，行吗？碰坏了你可是要赔的！” 抱歉。只是她让你想起了在提克里斯遇到的一个人，仅此而已。 “提克里斯？我从没去过那儿。我倒想哪天去那边做生意，喵呀，可对我这样的小猫来说路太远了，而且路上的危险一天比一天多。那儿的玻璃器皿再有名，我也赚不到足够弥补风险和时间的钱。” 可你确实遇到过那样一个半狼族小丫头—— “我不知道，谁都得长得像谁嘛。你看，我是只猫。”她抬手指了指自己抖动的猫耳。“绝对不是、百分之一百不是狗，喵呀。也许你该买点什么？那能帮你清醒清醒。” [silly |她会不会正好有个姐妹？或者很多很多个姐妹？而且她们长得都像得可疑，甚至一模一样，连口头禅都不差？顺便一问，她们的名字会不会碰巧都是同一个名字的变体？ 那只金色小猫哼了一声，双手叉腰。“别胡说八道了，喵呀。我才不叫安娜。” ] 那就清楚了。显然，边境地区每一座大城都恰好藏着一个娇小、长着兽耳、热爱做买卖的商人，纯属巧合。 |[flags.FHAUS_STOREHOUSE_ENTERED| 这个小猫族商人身上总有那么点说不清道不明的东西，你隐约猜到那可能是什么，可她头上那对猫耳和身后那条猫尾却在讲述另一个版本的故事。 真是这样吗？ 你的手指发痒，你非得弄个明白不可。你的手才刚握住那只金色小猫纤细柔滑的尾巴，她就一把抽了回去，冲你做了个气鼓鼓的鬼脸。 “喂，喂，喂，[pc.mf|先生|小姐]！那玩意儿不卖，喵呀。我的货都摆在垫子上，手别乱伸，行吗？碰坏了你可是要赔的！” 嗯……一方面，你觉得在手指真正碰到她尾巴之前就已经感觉到了什么；可另一方面，那手感毫无疑问是猫科尾巴那种顺滑柔软的毛感，而不是你隐约以为的肥厚蓬松。 真是让人一头雾水。 | 就好像某位谨慎小心的神明把世上能找到的可爱与讨喜全都收集起来，又慷慨地洒上一大把性感，然后把它放进世间，发动一场残酷的商业征战与经济浩劫。好吧，最后那句也许有点夸张，可看看这只小猫身为一个路边摊贩却有如此红火的生意，她一定赚得盆满钵满。 ] ] ] ]

And by the by, wouldn't they all happen to have some variant of the same name? The little golden kitten huffs and plants her hands on her hips. "Don't be ridiculous, nya-jya. My name's not Anna." ] That clears it up, then. Obviously it's just a coincidence that every major city in the Marches just happens to harbor a petite, animal-eared merchant with a penchant for mercantilism. |[flags.FHAUS_STOREHOUSE_ENTERED| There's a certain something or the other to this little catfolk peddler, and while you have a sneaking suspicion as to what it might be, the cat ears and tail attached to her tell a different story. Or do they? Your fingers are itching; you've got to know for certain. Barely have your hands closed upon the slender slinkiness of the golden kitten's tail that she whips it out of your grasp, making a pouty face at you. "Hey, hey, hey, [pc.mf|mister|miss]! Hmm... on one hand, you think you began feeling something before your fingers actually came in contact with her tail, but on the other hand there's no doubt it was the sleek, slinky furriness of a feline tail instead of the fat fluffiness that you'd half-expected. It's all so confusing. | It's as if some circumspect deity had gathered together all the cuteness and adorableness he could find, sprinkled it with a generous helping of sex appeal, and set it loose upon the world to effect a terrible campaign of brutal mercantilism and economic ruin.
