rows.original: As soon as you turn towards where Varena's sitting, the dubiously-incognito princess gives you a friendly wave and beckons you over. Nobody else in the bar is paying her any mind, you note, as though she's just any other traveling mage. It makes sense, you suppose, that the average common-salt wouldn't actually know what their first princess looks like. You haven't exactly seen any statues of her around the main street. "You got my note!" she says when you sit down. When you do, [flags.KM_FEAST_VARENA |there's a familiar muting of the sounds around you. She's got her silencing spell up already. |there's an odd quietus that falls over the bar, like the sounds are suddenly a mile away. Varena gives you a wink and pats her staff. ] "Good. I've never done anything like this before, I wasn't sure it would work. I'm not normally one for subterfuge." Looking Varena over, you're inclined to believe her. "So what brought this on?" you ask. [var0 |"Something happened after the party ended," she says glumly. "Not long after, my father came to me and said that the war council was changing their policy; that I'm no longer welcome to sit in. And then I hear that Calise's taken custody of some of my documents, right out of my bedchambers!" Varena sighs. "Somebody's trying to cut me out. I think it's Calise. She's had it out for me since she got to this city, and now she's poisoned the court against me. Even my own father trusts her council more than mine..." You shrug. "Do you need to be involved?" The princess crosses her arms. "Yes, of course I do! This is my city, my home... and there's something rotten in its heart. My father and brother, the war council, they're all too focused on the threats outside the walls to see it. You were there at the party, right? It doesn't take a sleuth to realize things there were off." "The way everyone was dressed?" you ask, inclining your head to the bust almost spilling out of her corset. "That's part of it," she says. "[flags.KM_FEAST_STATUE_CLEANED | |Then I found our family's private altar to Tira had been desecrated. Someone... defiled it. Carnally. ]Then there's Calise's behavior. The way she just wrapped Father around her finger, it's unnatural. How easy it was for her to shut me out. She must have found out..." "Found out what?" Varena scrunches her lips. "I've been... investigating things, here in the city. Trying to root out the darkness nesting in it. Now somebody's protecting it from inside the court." Yeah, somebody. |The princess gives you a little smile and clasps her hands together on the table. Her voice, though, is humorless as it can be. "I've been investigating something. I'm sure you noticed it too, how... how off the feast was?" "The way people were dressed? The way they all acted?" She nods. "That and more.[flags.KM_FEAST_STATUE_CLEANED | | After the party, I found that my family's private altar to Tira had been defiled. Carnally! ][var1 | Someone managed to infiltrate the party, even through the Chargers, and make off with my possessions! ] Father and the council, they're all so focused on the threats outside the walls, I'm starting to fear they're blind to what may already be inside. Something in the city is changing, [pc.name]. Its very heart is darkening. I've done all I can do to help, but I no longer think this is just stress and overcrowding getting the better of people. Something's unnatural about it all, and now..." "Now?" The princess takes a deep breath. "Now I'm starting to think somebody knows that I know. I've caught glimpses of somebody following me every time I leave the palace, unless I use the secret tunnels. So it's somebody outside the family and our immediate confidants, but... but it's someone with high enough access to keep tabs on me without the Chargers getting suspicious." ]
rows.translation: 你一转身朝瓦蕾娜坐的方向看去，这位伪装得并不高明的公主便友好地向你挥了挥手，示意你过去。你注意到，酒吧里没有其他人注意她，她就像另一个普通的旅居法师一样。你想，对于普通的民众来说，他们确实不知道自己的第一公主长什么样子，这也情有可原——在主街上，你也没看到过她的雕像。 “你拿到我的便条了！”当你坐下来时，她说道。 [flags.KM_FEAST_VARENA |你周围的声音突然消失了，那种熟悉的寂静出现了——她已经使用了沉默咒语。 |酒吧里突然陷入了一种奇怪的寂静，仿佛所有的声音都突然远去了。瓦蕾娜向你眨了眨眼，然后轻拍了一下她的法杖。 ]好吧。我以前从未做过这样的事情，也不确定这样做是否有效。我通常并不擅长使用这些诡计。” 看着瓦蕾娜，你很愿意相信她的话。“那么，是什么促使你采取了这样的行动呢？”你问道。 [var0 |派对结束后发生了一些事情，”她沮丧地说道，“没过多久，我父亲就来找我，告诉我战争委员会改变了他们的政策，不再允许我参加他们的会议了。后来我又听说，卡莉丝竟然把我的一些文件拿走了，那些文件本来就在我的卧室里啊！瓦蕾娜叹了口气：“有人在试图排挤我。我觉得是卡莉丝。自从她来到这座城市，她就一直对我怀有敌意，现在她还在宫廷里散布对我的不利言论。就连我的父亲，也更信任她的建议，而不是我的。……” 你耸了耸肩：“你有必要参与其中吗？” 公主双臂交叉：“当然有必要了！这是我的城市，我的家……但它的内部出了问题。我的父亲、我的哥哥，还有战争委员会，他们全都把注意力集中在城墙外的威胁上，根本没注意到这些问题。你当时也在那个派对上，对吧？不用费什么劲就能看出那里有些不对劲。 “就是大家的穿着打扮？”你问道，同时歪着头看着她那几乎要从束腰外露出来的胸部。 这也是其中的一部分，”她说。[flags.KM_FEAST_STATUE_CLEANED | |然后我发现我们家为提拉设立的私人祭坛被亵渎了。有人……以极其淫秽的方式玷污了它。 ]还有卡莉丝的行为。她把父亲完全掌控在自己手中，这种做法太不自然了。她竟然那么轻易地就将我排除在外……她肯定已经发现了什么…… “发现了什么？” 瓦蕾娜皱了皱嘴唇：“我一直在城里调查一些事情，试图铲除潜藏在这座城市中的黑暗势力。现在有人是从法庭内部来保护它的。” 是啊，肯定是有人这么做的。 |公主对你微微一笑，然后将双手放在桌子上交叠在一起。然而，她的声音却毫无幽默感可言：“我一直在调查一些事情。我相信你也注意到了，就是……就是那种情况。关闭那场盛宴是怎样的呢？” “人们的穿着打扮？他们的行为举止？” 她点了点头。“不仅仅是这些，还有更多。[flags.KM_FEAST_STATUE_CLEANED | | 派对结束后，我发现我们家专门供奉蒂拉的神龛被亵渎了。而且是以极其淫秽的方式！ ][var1 | 有人竟然设法混入了派对，甚至通过了那些负责安保的人的审查，然后偷走了我的东西！ ]父亲和议会里的那些人，他们全都把注意力集中在城墙外的威胁上，我开始担心他们根本忽视了城内可能已经发生的变化。这座城市里有些事情正在发生改变。 [pc.name]它的核心正在逐渐变得黑暗。我已经尽了自己所能去帮忙，但我不再认为这只是压力和过度拥挤在影响人们。有些事情不自然关于这一切，现在……” “现在？” 公主深吸一口气：“现在我开始怀疑，有人知道我知道这件事。每次我离开宫殿时，我都隐约感觉到有人在跟踪我，除非我使用那些秘密通道。所以，这个人一定不是家族成员或我们的亲信，但是……这个人一定拥有足够的权限，能够暗中监视我，同时又不会引起‘充电器’们的怀疑。 ]

rows.original: "So where do I come in?" you ask her. "I... need your help looking into things. This is all so new to me, and I don't know who I can trust. You and Calise are the only out-of-towners in the court's graces, and you've at least got the credentials of having saved the Winter City!" Varena takes a deep breath. "I'm a decent mage, you know. Physically, I'm more fit than I look. I'm well read, too. But I've never been in a fight; I've never had to investigate something. It's what Father's men should be for, but I can't be sure they're all still of sound mind. I don't know which of them would spill secrets to Father's pet Velunite, or just to the wrong servant. Khor'minoans aren't a subtle people at the best of times." She shakes her head glumly. "But even... even if you aren't willing to stick your neck out because a spoiled rich girl has a hunch, [flags.KM_FEAST_VARENA_FLIRT |I still enjoyed your company at the party. It would be nice to have someone to talk to, just to distract myself from how terrifying this all is. I don't exactly have a lot of friends, especially ones I can share this burden with. |at least you'll know what I was up to, in case something happens to me. ]"

rows.original: [varena.fucked|Take the princess somewhere private and [varena.isDom|let this pent-up bovine show you just how strong she really is|have your way with her].|Make a pass at Varena. here at Ember's, away from the eyes of the court, it might just be able to go somewhere.]
rows.translation: [varena.fucked|把公主带到私密的地方去，[varena.isDom|让这头憋坏了的母牛向你展示她究竟有多强壮|对你为所欲为]。|试着勾搭一下瓦蕾娜。就在余烬酒馆这儿，远离宫廷的眼线，说不定真能有点进展。]
rows.raw: "[varena.fucked|Take the princess somewhere private and [varena.isDom|let this pent-up bovine show you just how strong she really is|have your way with her].|Make a pass at Varena. here at Ember's, away from the eyes of the court, it might just be able to go somewhere.]"

rows.original: Perhaps now that things have calmed down a little in the city, you could convince the princess to accompany you on a more exotic date.
rows.translation: 或许现在城里的局势已经有所缓和，你可以说服公主陪你去参加一次更加别具一格的约会吧。
rows.raw: "Perhaps now that things have calmed down a little in the city, you could convince the princess to accompany you on a more exotic date."

rows.original: You want to take Varena out on a date OUTSIDE the stifling cave walls. While you COULD walk the princess all the way through the Undermountain, you're not sure Varena would survive — more the walk than the monsters. You should really investigate some sort of way to fast-travel before you ask her out again.
rows.translation: 你想带瓦蕾娜去那些令人窒息的洞壁之外约会。虽然你完全可以带着公主一路穿过山腹深域，但你不确定瓦蕾娜能否挺过来——比起那些怪物，路途本身可能才是更大的挑战。在再次邀请她约会之前，你真的应该想办法研究一下快速旅行的方法。
rows.raw: "You want to take Varena out on a date OUTSIDE the stifling cave walls. While you COULD walk the princess all the way through the Undermountain, you're not sure Varena would survive — more the walk than the monsters. You should really investigate some sort of way to fast-travel before you ask her out again."

rows.original: Of course you're going to help a princess in distress!
rows.translation: 你当然会帮助一位处于困境中的公主了！
rows.raw: "Of course you're going to help a princess in distress!"

rows.original: Varena said she had a mission in mind for the two of you. Follow up on her next objective.
rows.translation: 瓦蕾娜说，她为你们两人准备了一个任务。去完成她的下一个目标吧。
rows.raw: "Varena said she had a mission in mind for the two of you. Follow up on her next objective."

rows.original: You know who's been spying on Varena. Now the question is, what are you going to do about it?
rows.translation: 你知道是谁一直在监视瓦蕾娜吧。现在的问题是，你打算怎么做呢？
rows.raw: "You know who's been spying on Varena. Now the question is, what are you going to do about it?"

rows.original: Your investigation into the Iavari clan is now complete. What comes next?
rows.translation: 你对伊亚瓦里家族的调查已经结束。接下来该做什么呢？
rows.raw: "Your investigation into the Iavari clan is now complete. What comes next?"

rows.original: [flags.KM_SIEGE_DUCT_INTRO|It's time to take the fight to the demons.|Talk to Varena about attacking up the aqueducts into the demons' fortress. If this works out, it could be the end of the Siege of Khor'minos!]
rows.translation: [flags.KM_SIEGE_DUCT_INTRO|是时候与那些恶魔展开战斗了。|与瓦蕾娜商量一下，从引水渠入手进攻恶魔的堡垒吧。如果这个计划成功，那么科尔米诺斯围城战或许就能就此结束！]
rows.raw: "[flags.KM_SIEGE_DUCT_INTRO|It's time to take the fight to the demons.|Talk to Varena about attacking up the aqueducts into the demons' fortress. If this works out, it could be the end of the Siege of Khor'minos!]"

rows.translation: 邀请瓦蕾娜加入荒废驿堡。

rows.original: Varena's not going to be able to leave home unless it's into the house of landed nobility. An unfortunate reality of being royalty.
rows.translation: 瓦蕾娜除非嫁入贵族家庭，否则根本无法离开家。这就是身为王室成员所不得不面对的不幸现实。
rows.raw: "Varena's not going to be able to leave home unless it's into the house of landed nobility. An unfortunate reality of being royalty."

rows.original:
"Have time to talk?" you ask.
    
    [varena.lnhTrust
        |"These days it feels like all I do is talk!" Varena laughs. "Go on. What's on your mind?"
        |"Sure," she smiles. "What's on your mind?"
        |"Of course," Varena says, giving you a pretty smile. "Tell me what's on your mind, [pc.name]."
    ]
rows.translation:
“有时间聊聊吗？”你问道。
    
    [varena.lnhTrust
        |“这些天，感觉我一直在说个不停！”瓦蕾娜笑着说，“说吧，你心里在想什么？”
        |“当然可以，”她微笑着说，“你有什么想聊的吗？”
        |“当然，”瓦蕾娜微笑着说道，“告诉我你在想什么吧，[pc.name]。”
    ]

'
    "Have time to talk?" you ask.
    
    [varena.lnhTrust
        |"These days it feels like all I do is talk!" Varena laughs. "Go on. What's on your mind?"
        |"Sure," she smiles. "What's on your mind?"
        |"Of course," Varena says, giving you a pretty smile. "Tell me what's on your mind, [pc.name]."
    ]

rows.original: Ask Varena about her family, now that they're all out of earshot.
rows.translation: 现在他们都已经听不到了，去问问瓦蕾娜关于她家人的事情吧。
rows.raw: "Ask Varena about her family, now that they're all out of earshot."

rows.original: Does Varena have any other siblings, besides her twin brother?
rows.translation: 瓦蕾娜除了她的双胞胎兄弟之外，还有其他的兄弟姐妹吗？
rows.raw: "Does Varena have any other siblings, besides her twin brother?"

rows.original: Varena's brought a wizard's staff with her out of the palace, and looks every bit the part of a traveling mage. What's the story behind her and her spellcasting?
rows.translation: 瓦蕾娜从宫殿中带出了一根巫师法杖，看起来完全就是一位游历各地的法师。她与魔法之间的故事究竟是什么呢？
rows.raw: "Varena's brought a wizard's staff with her out of the palace, and looks every bit the part of a traveling mage. What's the story behind her and her spellcasting?"

rows.original: Varena's an artist of some renown. What does that mean to her?
rows.translation: 瓦蕾娜是一位颇有名气的艺术家。这对她来说意味着什么？
rows.raw: "Varena's an artist of some renown. What does that mean to her?"

rows.original: [varena.livreaFucked|Now that Liv and Varena have slept together, how does she feel about the strawberry bard?|Livrea and Varena know each other pretty well. How well?]
rows.translation: [varena.livreaFucked|现在利芙和瓦蕾娜已经发生了关系，那么她对那个“草莓诗人”又有什么感觉呢？|莉维娅和瓦蕾娜彼此非常熟悉。到底有多熟悉呢？]
rows.raw: "[varena.livreaFucked|Now that Liv and Varena have slept together, how does she feel about the strawberry bard?|Livrea and Varena know each other pretty well. How well?]"

rows.original: How does Varena believe Khor'minos is faring now?
rows.translation: 瓦蕾娜认为，目前科尔米诺斯的情况如何呢？
rows.raw: "How does Varena believe Khor'minos is faring now?"

rows.original: You two should talk about Calise
rows.translation: 你们两个应该好好谈谈卡莉丝的事情
那么，瓦蕾娜究竟有什么建议呢……？

rows.original: What's Varena's vision of the future like?
rows.translation: 瓦蕾娜对未来的设想是怎样的？
rows.raw: "What's Varena's vision of the future like?"

rows.original: "My family... this might shock you, but we're kind of a big deal in this city," Varena giggles. "I'm sure you can ask Livrea[livrea.met | | — that bard across the street — ] for what the people think of us. But you want to know what I think." You nod. Varena puffs up her chest a little. "This may be controversial, but I think we're pretty great. Ever since Keldoran, the first king from House Moratia, took power, things have gotten better and better for the kingdom. My ancestors took power in a really, really hard time for Khor'minos, right after the Godswar, and they rebuilt what we'd lost and then some. I'm proud of my family's accomplishments: reviving trade across the coast, funding scholars and artists, passing laws to protect farmers from patrician abuses. My father's very big on supporting trade and scholarship, especially. I remember following him all over the region when I was little, watching him meet with other heads of state, high priests, and magisters. He'd travel halfway across the Marches in person just to get a book he was interested in!" There's a fond smile on the princess's face now. "My father's a good man, [pc.name]. An even better dad. I'm glad he's our king." "And what about the rest of your family? Your mother wasn't at the feast..." "It would be unusual if she was," Varena shrugs. "Tradition, you know; the king's women should be for his eyes only. It's only the Novitauri — the newly wealthy, self-made men of my father's generation — that usually bring their wives. Most of them owe their success to their ladies anyway, so it's only fair. And anyway, Mom's been busy nonstop since the war began, helping refugees from her family's province. "Tell me about her?" "My mother's name is Lunera, of House Hestra. They're from one of the Undermountain towns south of here; you'd usually need to take a boat from the under-lakes to get there. Grandma is a Tiran priestess, and Grandpa was the provincial governor, though that's passed down to my uncle Lunis now. Mom's the only girl, and the youngest, after four boys. I guess you could say I got my tomboy streak from her. She's a real powerhouse, the kind of woman who girds her loins and does what's necessary no matter what. She also looooves to bake. [varena.fucked |You can thank her for my figure." Varena jiggles her tummy beneath her struggling corset, which does some damn impressive things to her tits as well. |I got so chubby as a kid because of her just filling the palace with treats." ] "What happened to your brother, then?" you ask. "He's a stick." Varena throws her head back and laughs. "He really is! Vranny eats like a bird, just pecking at fruits and bits of bread like it's an imposition that he has to feed himself, while I pack down turkey legs and make off with whole cakes. But that just goes to show you, despite being twins we really couldn't be more different." She sighs. "Until the war started, my brother was... well, he both loves to be the center of attention and keep the party waiting for him. A born dramatist. I wouldn't go so far as to call him a troublemaker — he's too small to actually cause any even if he wanted to — he does love his games. Plus Vranny's the only person who can get Daddy worked up enough to yell. You should have seen him after my brother and his friends streaked naked through the Colosseum. Oh, he was livid!" "I can imagine. That's got to be embarrassing for the future king..." "Ha, hardly." Varena waves a hand. "I think being such a rogue has only made my brother more popular. At least with the ladies. All the noble girls my age fawn over him. He could have his pick of them, if he were the type. That's at least one good mark for his character: he's never been a womanizer." [flags.KM_FEAST_MIDDLE_DOOR |You might say he's a confirmed bachelor. ]
rows.translation: 我的家人……这可能会让你感到惊讶，但实际上我们在这个城市里算是个有影响力的人家。”瓦蕾娜轻笑着说道，“我相信你可以去问问莉维娅[livrea.met | | — 那位街对面的吟游诗人 — ]究竟是为了什么人们请想想我们。但你想知道我的想法是什么。” 你点了点头。 瓦蕾娜微微挺了挺胸：“这可能会引起争议，但我认为我们相当不错。自从莫拉蒂亚家族的第一位国王凯尔多兰掌权以来，这个王国的状况一直在不断改善。我的祖先在科尔米诺斯遭遇极其艰难的时期掌权，就在神战之后。他们不仅重建了我们失去的一切，还取得了更多的成就。我为我的家族所取得的成绩感到自豪：他们恢复了沿海地区的贸易往来，资助学者和艺术家，还制定了法律来保护农民免受贵族的压迫。我父亲非常重视支持贸易与学术事业。我记得小时候经常跟着他走遍整个地区，看着他与其他国家元首、高级祭司以及学者们会面。他甚至会专程穿越半个边境地区，只为了获取他感兴趣的书籍！现在，公主的脸上露出了温暖的笑容。“我的父亲是个好人[pc.name]一个更出色的父亲。我很高兴他是我们的国王。” “那你的其他家人呢？你的母亲并没有参加这次宴会……” “如果她去了，反倒会显得不寻常。”瓦蕾娜耸了耸肩，“你知道的，这是传统规定——国王的女性应该只属于他一个人。通常只有那些新近发家、白手起家的父亲那一代人会带着他们的妻子参加这类活动。反正他们中的大多数人的成功都与他们的妻子们息息相关，所以这样做也算是公平的。而且，自从战争开始以来，妈妈就一直在忙个不停，帮助她家乡的难民们。 跟我讲讲她吧？” “我妈妈的名字叫卢内拉，来自赫斯特拉家族。他们住在离这里不远的山腹深域南部的某个小镇上；通常需要乘坐船只才能到达那里。奶奶是一名蒂拉教的女祭司，而爷爷曾经是那个地区的省长，不过这个职位现在由我的叔叔卢尼斯继承了。妈妈是家里唯一的女孩，也是四个儿子中最小的一个。我想，我的那种假小子性格应该就是遗传自她的。她真是个了不起的女性，那种无论遇到什么困难都会挺身而出、去做该做的事情的人。而且，她也非常喜欢烘焙。 [varena.fucked |要感谢她，才能有我现在这样的身材。”瓦蕾娜在紧身胸衣的束缚下扭动着肚子，而那紧身胸衣对她的胸部也产生了相当显著的效果。 |我小时候因为她总在宫里准备各种美食，所以变得胖乎乎的。 ] 那你哥哥后来怎么样了？”你问道，“他现在成什么样子了？” “他啊，简直就像根棍子一样！”瓦蕾娜仰头大笑，“真的啊！弗拉尼吃东西就像鸟儿一样，只是随便啄点水果和面包屑，好像吃东西对他来说是一种负担似的；而我呢，总是把火鸡腿都吃掉，还会把整块蛋糕都据为己有。但这恰恰说明了，尽管我们是双胞胎，我们的性格却截然不同。” 她叹了口气：“在战争爆发之前，我哥哥总是……嗯，他既喜欢成为众人关注的焦点，也总喜欢让别人等着他。天生的戏剧家啊。我不敢说他是个爱惹麻烦的人——他年纪太小了，就算想惹麻烦也根本做不到；他确实非常热爱自己的游戏。而且，只有Vranny才能把爸爸惹得如此生气，以至于他会大喊大叫。你真该看看我哥哥和他的朋友们在竞技场里光着身子乱跑的样子……哦，他当时气得暴跳如雷！” “我能想象。对未来的国王来说，那肯定是一件非常尴尬的事情……” “哈，才不是呢。”瓦蕾娜摆了摆手。我觉得，他这样的性格反而让我的哥哥更受欢迎了。至少在女性们中间是这样。所有和我同龄的贵族小姐们都很迷恋他。如果他是那种喜欢追逐女色的人的话，完全可以随意选择其中任何一个。不过，他的这个性格特点倒也是值得肯定的：他从来都不是个花花公子。" [flags.KM_FEAST_MIDDLE_DOOR |可以说，他确实是个老光棍。 ]

rows.original: "Do you have any other siblings?" you ask. "A few," Varena nods. "Two younger sisters, and a much younger brother. None of them are old enough to make their debuts to the city elite yet. I've got a few more siblings on the way, too, now that the royal harem's suddenly gotten so much bigger! Oh! Daddy also has a bastard, from before he married Mom, so technically his firstborn. Princess Octavia!" [var0 |"Are you happy to have Octavia back in town?" Varena nods enthusiastically. "Yeah I am! It's... I've been trying to keep in touch with her, now that I know we're alright with each other, but it's not easy. She tries to keep a low profile, and the places she hangs out are... not places I feel safe in. I wish she'd come up to the inner wards, or visit the palace, but she's made it clear she's not interested in the royal life. That's a shame, but what can I do? Tay is Tay, immovable as the stone." She shrugs. "Still, I'm just happy to have my sister back where I don't have to worry about her. I'm trying to see if we can set up regular get-togethers in the outskirts, y'know, just to spend some time together, but she's a grouch about doing anything girly like brunches or shopping, so we're looking for a gym we can both go to at least. I'll get through to her eventually, I'm sure of it." |"I met her, actually," you say. "In the arena." "I heard someone who looked like her lost a fight to you!" Varena says. "Tira knows I haven't seen Tay in years though. Not since I was small. I hope she's doing okay; I know she hates to lose." "She's fine," you assure her. "Why haven't you gone to see her?" The princess gives you a noncommittal little shrug. "It's been so long, and, well, she knows where I am. She's the one that left. I figure, if she wanted to catch up, she'd come to us. Tay was my friend when we were little, but her mother was a slave girl; the older we got, the bigger the differences between us felt. I think she resented it. Maybe me? Eventually she and Daddy had a one-sided yelling match, and then she was gone the next day. I don't want to open an old wound if she's not ready for it." "Does the king know she's back? "I'm sure he does," Varena smiles. "It's a father's job to know where his daughters are, isn't it? I know he's had people watching her from the shadows ever since she left, keeping her out of trouble. Daddy would have been the first one to know she was back in town, though he didn't mention it to me. I guess he feels the same way as I do about old wounds." |"Tell me about her?" Varena smiles softly. "Her mom was a slave girl but that didn't matter to me. Tay was Tay: my friend, my big sister. I looked up to her, especially when she started getting strong. And she was fierce too, but never hurtful... more like a [silly |knight in shining armor, but with the shinies replaced by grumpy and angst |champion, though that was tempered by a whole lot of angst growing up ]. Mom didn't like me spending too much time with her, but I loved playing with her more than Vrannus even, and she was the only one in the palace that didn't treat me like I was made of glass when I was young. She'd fight me if I pushed her, and I loved that about her." The princess sighs. "I miss her." "What happened to her?" "It's... nothing, really. She and Daddy fell out, I guess. A part of me's always been afraid it was because of me and Vranny; because she resented us being the heirs and not her. That we weren't equal, not really. One day she was just gone. I heard she was adventuring down south, but I don't exactly have my own spy network. Daddy always said he was keeping tabs on her, though, and not to worry. I trust him on that. I'm sure he's had people following her, making sure she's safe, ever since she left home. He loves her just as much as any of us, even if he had a harder time showing that to her." ]
rows.translation: 你还有其他兄弟姐妹吗？”你问道。 “有几个，”瓦蕾娜点了点头，“两个妹妹，还有一个年纪更小的弟弟。他们还都太小，还没到可以进入城市上层社会的行列。现在王室后宫的人突然增多了，我应该还会再有几个兄弟姐妹出生呢！哦！我爸爸在娶妈妈之前还有一个私生子，所以严格来说，那个孩子才是他的长子——奥克塔维娅公主！ [var0 |你很高兴奥克塔维娅回到了城里吧？” 瓦蕾娜热情地点了点头：“是的，我真的很高兴！其实……自从我知道我们之间的关系已经恢复正常后，我就一直在努力和她保持联系，但真的不容易。她总是尽量保持低调，她常去的地方……让我觉得不太安全。我希望她能来内城区逛逛，或者去皇宫看看，但她已经明确表示对皇室生活没有兴趣。真遗憾，但我又能怎么办呢？泰就是泰，坚如磐石，根本不会改变。” 她耸了耸肩：“不过，能让我妹妹回到我身边，让我不再为她担心，我已经很开心了。我正在想办法让我们能在郊外定期见面，一起度过一些时光，但是她对那些像早午餐或者购物这样的女性活动总是很不感兴趣，所以我们现在至少在寻找一家我们可以一起去的健身房。我肯定会最终联系上她的。 |其实我见过她，”你说，“在竞技场里。” “我听说有个和她长得很像的人被你打败了！”瓦蕾娜说，“不过蒂拉知道，我已经很多年没有见过泰了。从我小时候起就再没见过她。希望她现在过得还好吧；我知道她很讨厌失败。她没事的，”你安慰她，“你为什么还没去看看她呢？” 公主漫不经心地耸了耸肩：“已经过去这么久了，而且，她知道我在哪里。其实是她自己离开的。我想，如果她想跟上来，应该会来找我们。泰小时候是我的朋友，但她的母亲是个奴隶女孩；随着我们年龄的增长，我们之间的差距似乎也越来越大了。我觉得她对此感到不满，也许也是对我不满吧？最终，她和爸爸激烈地争吵了一番，第二天她就离开了。如果她还没有准备好面对这些，我可不想揭开那些旧伤疤。 “国王知道她回来了吗？” “我敢肯定他知道，”瓦蕾娜微笑着说。作为父亲，知道自己的女儿们在哪里应该是理所当然的吧？我知道，自从她离开后，他就派人暗中监视她，确保她不会惹上麻烦。如果她真的回到了城里，爸爸肯定会是第一个知道的人，只不过他并没有告诉我。我想，他对那些旧伤的看法和我是一样的。 |跟我讲讲她吧？” 瓦蕾娜轻轻一笑：“她的母亲原本是个奴隶女孩，但这对我来说并不重要。泰就是泰——我的朋友，我的姐姐。我非常敬重她，尤其是当她开始强大而且，她就是那个人。凶猛的也是，但从来不会伤人……更像是[silly |那位身着闪亮铠甲的骑士，只不过那些闪亮的部分被愤怒与烦恼所取代罢了。 |虽然在这一过程中，我也经历了许多焦虑和困扰，但最终还是成为了冠军。 ]妈妈不喜欢我花太多时间陪她，但我喜欢和她一起玩耍，甚至比喜欢和弗兰努斯在一起还要开心。在宫殿里，只有她在我小时候不会把我当成玻璃一样小心翼翼地对待我。如果我推她，她还会和我打闹，而我恰恰喜欢她这样的性格。公主叹了口气：“我想念她。” “她发生了什么事？” “其实……没什么。我想她和爸爸闹翻了。我内心一直担心，这可能是因为我和Vranny的关系；因为她嫉妒我们成为了继承人，而不是她。我们其实并不平等。有一天，她突然离开了。我听说她去了南方冒险，但我并没有自己的情报网络来核实这些消息。不过爸爸总是说他在关注她的动向，让我不要担心。在这方面，我是信任他的。我敢肯定，自从她离开家后，他一定派人跟着她，确保她的安全。他爱她的程度，和我们任何人一样深，只不过他可能更难将这种爱表达出来罢了。 ]
rows.raw: " "Do you have any other siblings?" you ask. "A few," Varena nods. "Two younger sisters, and a much younger brother. None of them are old enough to make their debuts to the city elite yet. I've got a few more siblings on the way, too, now that the royal harem's suddenly gotten so much bigger! Oh! Daddy also has a bastard, from before he married Mom, so technically his firstborn. Princess Octavia!" [var0 |"Are you happy to have Octavia back in town?" Varena nods enthusiastically. "Yeah I am! It's... I've been trying to keep in touch with her, now that I know we're alright with each other, but it's not easy. She tries to keep a low profile, and the places she hangs out are... not places I feel safe in. I wish she'd come up to the inner wards, or visit the palace, but she's made it clear she's not interested in the royal life. That's a shame, but what can I do? Tay is Tay, immovable as the stone." She shrugs. "Still, I'm just happy to have my sister back where I don't have to worry about her. I'm trying to see if we can set up regular get-togethers in the outskirts, y'know, just to spend some time together, but she's a grouch about doing anything girly like brunches or shopping, so we're looking for a gym we can both go to at least. I'll get through to her eventually, I'm sure of it." |"I met her, actually," you say. "In the arena." "I heard someone who looked like her lost a fight to you!" Varena says. "Tira knows I haven't seen Tay in years though. Not since I was small. I hope she's doing okay; I know she hates to lose." "She's fine," you assure her. "Why haven't you gone to see her?" The princess gives you a noncommittal little shrug. "It's been so long, and, well, she knows where I am. She's the one that left. I figure, if she wanted to catch up, she'd come to us. Tay was my friend when we were little, but her mother was a slave girl; the older we got, the bigger the differences between us felt. I think she resented it. Maybe me? Eventually she and Daddy had a one-sided yelling match, and then she was gone the next day. I don't want to open an old wound if she's not ready for it." "Does the king know she's back? "I'm sure he does," Varena smiles. "It's a father's job to know where his daughters are, isn't it? I know he's had people watching her from the shadows ever since she left, keeping her out of trouble. Daddy would have been the first one to know she was back in town, though he didn't mention it to me. I guess he feels the same way as I do about old wounds." |"Tell me about her?" Varena smiles softly. "Her mom was a slave girl but that didn't matter to me. Tay was Tay: my friend, my big sister. I looked up to her, especially when she started getting strong. And she was fierce too, but never hurtful... more like a [silly |knight in shining armor, but with the shinies replaced by grumpy and angst |champion, though that was tempered by a whole lot of angst growing up ]. Mom didn't like me spending too much time with her, but I loved playing with her more than Vrannus even, and she was the only one in the palace that didn't treat me like I was made of glass when I was young. She'd fight me if I pushed her, and I loved that about her." The princess sighs. "I miss her." "What happened to her?" "It's... nothing, really. She and Daddy fell out, I guess. A part of me's always been afraid it was because of me and Vranny; because she resented us being the heirs and not her. That we weren't equal, not really. One day she was just gone. I heard she was adventuring down south, but I don't exactly have my own spy network. Daddy always said he was keeping tabs on her, though, and not to worry. I trust him on that. I'm sure he's had people following her, making sure she's safe, ever since she left home. He loves her just as much as any of us, even if he had a harder time showing that to her." ] "

rows.original: "I've always had a talent for magic," Varena admits with a wiggle of her fingers. "When I was little, Senator Juno sat me down one day and showed me some of her spells. Just simple cantrips, really; she'd only meant to entertain me while my parents were busy. But somehow I mimicked them right back at her, and cast a spell all on my own just from watching her a single time. She couldn't believe it, and went running to my dad asking what he was thinking having me learn magic at my age... and still didn't believe when he insisted he hadn't! Long story short, Daddy ended up hiring Juno to tutor me personally after that. She's one of the strongest magisters around and patrician blooded too, so she was a natural pick! Turned out she was a great teacher, too." "What kind of magic do you do?" you ask. Varena gives you a sly grin. "Mostly manipulating sound, like this silence bubble we're sitting in. I wouldn't call myself a specialist, more like a dabbler in all sorts of different magic, but sonic spells have always come natural to me. Juno's called the Storm Witch, and Khor'minos has always been favored by Sorra just as much as Tira, so I guess it makes sense. I can cast a hell of a thunderclap!" [pc.isDK |"Every time you jump, right?" Varena knits her brow and blows a raspberry at you. |[varena.fucked |"I've seen the way you clap alright," you tease. "It's a hell of a show." Varena blushes and blows a raspberry at you. |"I bet," you murmur, looking at her abundant curves. ] ] The princess clears her throat. "Other than thaaaat, I wouldn't call myself a magister really. Not a professional anyway, as much as Juno and even my parents keep encouraging me to really commit to it. I'm good at magic, but I don't love it, if that makes sense. It's not what I want to dedicate my life to. I enjoy learning magic well enough, and it's always exciting when I can master a new spell, or somebody gives me a spellbook I've never seen before, but it just doesn't compare to my art."
rows.translation: “我天生就对魔法有着天赋，”瓦蕾娜一边说，一边晃动着手指。“小时候，朱诺参议员有一次让我坐下来，向我展示了一些她的法术。其实都是些简单的戏法而已；她只是想在我父母忙碌的时候让我开心一下罢了。但不知怎么的，我竟然模仿她的动作，仅仅通过看她一次，就自己施展出了一个魔法。她简直不敢相信，于是跑去问我爸爸，他究竟是怎么想的，才会让我在这个年纪学习魔法。可当他坚称自己并没有这样做时，她还是不肯相信！长话短说，之后爸爸还是雇了朱诺来亲自辅导我。她可是周围最强大的法师之一，而且还是贵族出身，所以她当然是最合适的人选！结果发现，她也是一位非常优秀的老师。” “你会使用什么样的魔法呢？”你问道。 瓦蕾娜狡黠地笑了笑：“主要是运用声音来施展魔法，就像我们现在所处的这个‘寂静气泡’一样。我不会称自己为专家，更愿意认为自己只是对各种魔法略知一二的人罢了，但音波魔法对我来说，总是显得格外容易上手。朱诺被称为‘风暴女巫’，而科尔米诺斯一直以来都深受索拉的喜爱，就像蒂拉一样……所以，我想这也很合理吧。我可是能召唤出极其强大的雷电的！” [pc.isDK |“每次你跳跃的时候，对吧？” 瓦蕾娜皱起眉头，然后对你吐了个舌头。 |[varena.fucked |“我可看清你鼓掌的样子了，”你开玩笑地说，“那场面真是够精彩的。” 瓦蕾娜脸红了，然后朝你吐了吐舌头。 |“我打赌，”你低声说道，目光落在她那丰满诱人的曲线上。 ] ] 公主清了清嗓子，说道：“除了那件事之外，我其实并不认为自己真的算得上是一位法师。至少算不上是专业人士吧，尽管朱诺、甚至我的父母都一直鼓励我认真投身于此。我在魔法方面很擅长，但我并不热爱它，如果这说得通的话。这并不是我想用一生去追求的东西。我确实很喜欢学习魔法，每当掌握一门新的法术，或者有人送给我一本从未见过的魔法书时，我都会感到非常兴奋，但这一切，都比不上我的艺术。”

rows.original: Varena glances up at the heroic frescos on the walls here in the taphouse, the sprawling image of salamander heroes doing battle with monsters and villains of old. "I made all these, you know! Vitra was nice enough to commission me after she saw me doodling at the bar one day." "How long have you been coming here, Princess?" She laughs. "Since it opened. I'm not a perv, honest, but when I heard what the taps in Ember's Taphouse were I just had to see for myself. It just so happened that Vitra opened the place right when I was first starting to sneak out of the palace on my own, anyway. This was the first bar I ever went to. She didn't know who I was at the time, just saw that I was drawing big monsters and oiled-up champions and thought I'd do a good job making her walls look nice. I'm pretty proud of my work still." She ought to be. The work's a league above what most taverns could hope for. It wouldn't be out of place in a church, or even a palace. "How'd you get started with art?" "I... hm, honestly? I don't remember. I guess I've always liked drawing," Varena shrugs. "Mom does a little painting, too, and she encouraged me to learn with her when I was little. For her, it was just a hobby she'd taken up to impress Daddy. For me? The moment I first held a brush in my hand, it was like an awakening. I fell in love with it, and once I did, there was no stopping me from putting paint on every surface I could find. Even my brother sometimes! I remember chasing his skinny butt around the palace with a wet brush until our grandfather, the king back then, caught me by the scruff in the audience hall." The princess laughs at the memory, tail swishing behind her in her seat. "Still, my whole family encouraged me. Even Vranny. Mom found me tutors who taught me the old masters' styles, but from there I really developed on my own through my teens. I don't really care about somber portraits and pretty landscapes. I like this." She taps the wall adorned of heroes and beasts. "Stories speak to me. Characters. Something larger than life, beyond the mundane." "Maybe you should have been a bard." "Ha, maybe. I grew up around one of the city's best and brightest bards — Livrea — but no matter how much she tried to get me excited for what she was learning, it just never rubbed off. Unfortunately I've got no ear for music at all. I can write, I can paint, I can do magic that's all about manipulating sound, but I can't play anything to save my life. Daddy had to pay Livy to come and play my ancestor's harp for the crowds! My brother's the only one of us not tone-deaf, but he's way too lazy to actually get good enough to play for a crowd." Varena shakes her head. "No, I'd make a poor bard. But I respect [pc.cl charmer |your |their ] art quite a lot. But I do want to focus on mine more." "Oh?" She nods enthusiastically. "My last big project was painting the murals in the palace. Fine work, if I do say so myself, but that's not something the people of the city are going to see! I want to do something more like what I did here again, something the whole city can see and enjoy. I'm not sure what exactly yet, or where. Probably something to memorialize the war, and all the heroes who fought in it. If I can make that my crowning achievement in the arts, I think I could retire happily..."
rows.translation: 瓦蕾娜抬头望向这家酒馆墙上那些描绘英雄事迹的壁画——那些巨大的画面中，火蜥蜴英雄们正在与古老的怪物和反派进行战斗。“你知道吗，这些壁画都是我画的！有一天，薇特拉看到我在酒吧里涂鸦，便好心委托我来完成这些画作。 公主，您来这里已经有多久了？” 她笑了起来：“从这家店开业的时候就开始来了。说实话，我并不是什么变态，但当我听到‘Ember’s Taphouse’里的那些音乐描述时，我就忍不住要去亲自看看。而且，正好在我刚开始偷偷离开宫殿的时候，薇特拉也开了这家店。这是我第一次去的酒吧。当时她并不认识我，只是看到我在画那些巨大的怪物和那些涂满油彩的英雄形象，便觉得我一定能把她的墙壁装饰得非常漂亮。直到现在，我仍然为自己的作品感到非常自豪。" 她确实应该如此。这份工作的水准远超大多数酒馆所能期望的。这样的作品放在教堂里甚至宫殿里也毫不逊色。 “你是怎么开始接触艺术的呢？” “我……嗯，说实话？我都不记得了。我想我从小就喜欢画画了，”瓦蕾娜耸了耸肩说道。“妈妈也会画一些画，我小时候她鼓励我跟她一起学习。对她来说，这只是为了取悦爸爸而培养的一个爱好而已。但对我来说呢？从我第一次拿起画笔的那一刻起，那种感觉就像是一场觉醒。我彻底爱上了这种感觉，一旦陷进去，就再也无法阻止自己把颜料涂在能找到的每一个表面上。就连我哥哥也常常成为我的目标！我记得有一次，我拿着湿刷子在宫殿里追着他跑，直到当时的国王——也就是我们的祖父，在观众厅里抓住了我的衣领。" 公主回想起这些，坐在椅子上，尾巴在身后摇来摇去，不禁笑了起来。“不过，我的整个家庭都鼓励我。就连弗拉尼也是。妈妈为我找来了老师，让我学习那些古代大师的绘画风格，但在青少年时期，我真正开始依靠自己的努力不断进步。其实，我并不喜欢那些阴郁的肖像画和美丽的风景画。我喜欢的是这个。”她轻轻敲了敲墙上那些描绘英雄和野兽的图案。“故事，还有那些角色——它们比现实生活更加丰富多彩，超越了平凡的一切，这才是我真正喜欢的。 也许你本应该成为一名吟游诗人。” “哈，也许吧。我在这座城市中最优秀、最才华横溢的吟游诗人之一——莉维娅身边长大，但她再怎么努力让我对那些事情产生兴趣，我也她我曾经尝试学习过，但那些知识始终没能掌握。可惜，我对音乐完全没有任何天赋。我能够写作，能够绘画，也能做其他事情魔法这一切都是关于如何操控声音的，但我实在什么都不会弹奏。爸爸甚至不得不花钱请莉薇来为观众演奏我祖先留下的竖琴！我们兄弟中只有我弟弟不是音盲，但他太懒了，根本不愿意花时间去练习，以至于连为观众表演的能力都没有。”瓦蕾娜摇着头说道：“不，我当吟游诗人肯定不行……不过我还是很佩服他们的。 [pc.cl charmer |你的 |他们的 ]我确实花了很多时间在艺术创作上。但我确实想把重点放在我的还有更多。” “哦？” 她热情地点了点头：“我上一个重要的项目是在宫殿里绘制壁画。说实话，我的作品确实很出色，但那些壁画只有宫殿里的人才能看到！我想再做一些类似的事情——一些整个城市的人都能看到并欣赏到的作品。我还不确定具体会是什么，也不知道会在哪里举行。大概是为了纪念这场战争以及所有参与其中的英雄们吧。如果我能将这个项目作为自己在艺术领域的巅峰成就，我想我就可以开心地退休了……

rows.original: "The city's been better, but it's holding," Varena says. "[var0 |With the demons' fortress destroyed, things are finally looking up, but it's not a garden of roses just yet. The siege isn't as intense as it was, but it'll take months, maybe years, for the legions to fully root out the monsters from the Undermountain. People are going to be afraid to walk the roads, to let their children out of the villages, for a generation. But we're a strong people, [pc.name]. We'll get through this, and we'll recover stronger than ever." She sighs. "I just hope things can go back to the way they were..." "How so?" "The people are changed. You saw it at the feast. It hasn't stopped. It may never stop. I still see noble women with their tits out in public, letting their men grope them in open view. The men are walking around with pavilion tents in their togas without shame. I even heard the Chargers brought a Mallachite priestess to their barracks and... and used her as a unit for a whole day before letting her go!" [party.has cait |You glance over to where Cait's flirting with an off-duty soldier at the bar. One wonders who that might have been... ] "The worst part," she continues, "is that the people affected seem to have no idea anything's wrong. That they've changed. I've tried talking to some of the affected nobles, and they just brush it off. One called me a prude. Another actually invited me to pick any, or all, of his sons and 'prove their dedication to the throne.' Yuck!" Varena shakes her head, vigorously enough to make her chest quake. "But it's not all bad! Far from it; you did an incredible thing for this city, and for every person that's still got some corruption lingering in their loins there's a hundred who're still clinging to their values and ready to rebuild what they lost. I've talked to so many people from the provinces who're eager to get back out of the walls as soon as it's safe and start resettling the villages. Farmers are eager to get back to their mushrooms, and every laborer is committed to rolling up his sleeves and getting to work on new walls that'll stretch up to the cavern roofs around every town." |Between you and me?" Varena speaks quietly, even with the dampening bubble around you. "Things are dire. We're not on the brink of collapsing into anarchy or anything, but it's bad. The city's full to bursting with refugees, the Royal Legions are losing ground, and I fear what may have slipped into the city without our knowing. Evil things, evil beings. My brother tells me that these demons are shapeshifters. If that's true, and we've admitted tens of thousands of provincials into the city with open arms..." Varena shakes her head. "But I won't scapegoat them for whatever may come. For every misbegotten we've let through, there's surely a thousand frightened citizens just looking for safety. Still, I'm afraid for this city, [pc.name]." She tightens a fist. "But that just means I need to do everything in my power to help. Even if it's just giving aid to the refugees, or trying to inspire them — to help them keep hope. I refuse to just sit back and let this city fall to pieces, no matter what the demons throw at us!" There's a small huff in her voice as she adds, "It's times like this, I almost wish I'd been born a boy. Things would be easier if I could just pick up a sword and charge bravely at my enemies with a legion of loyal soldiers at my back! But even at my size, there's all sorts of things I can do. That I will do." You [pc.dcb |give her a slight nod |squeeze her shoulder |lean over the table and give her a big hug ]. ] "Are there any big problems in the kingdom aside from the war?" Varena groans. "You know, the reason I leave the palace is to not have to think about politics. Ugh. There's always problems. Tensions between the newly-made men, the Novitauri, and the wealthy old patricians. The senate trying to exert influence beyond their remit. Conflict with the Sailgraves. But nothing we haven't weathered before. If we can come out the other side of this conflict with the demons, I think Khor'minos will stand strong for another thousand years."
rows.translation: 这座城市已经变得更好了，但发展速度还算平稳，”瓦蕾娜说道。[var0 |随着恶魔堡垒的被摧毁，局势终于开始好转，但前方依然充满挑战。虽然围剿行动的强度已经减弱，但要彻底消灭山腹深域中的怪物，仍然需要数月甚至数年的时间。在这段时间里，人们会害怕在道路上行走，也会不敢让孩子们离开村庄——这种恐惧可能会持续整整一代人。不过，我们是一个强大的民族，一定能够战胜这一切困难。 [pc.name]我们会度过这个难关的，而且会比以前更加坚强地重新站起来。” 她叹了口气：“我只是希望一切能恢复到从前的样子……” “为什么呢？” “因为人们改变了你在宴会上看到了那一幕。那种现象从未停止过，也许永远也不会停止。至今我仍然能看到那些贵族妇女在公共场合袒露胸部，任由她们的男人在众目睽睽之下触碰她们。男人他们穿着托加袍，顶着帐篷在四处走动，却毫无羞耻之心。我甚至听说，那些“冲锋者”把一位马拉克信徒女祭司带到了他们的营房里……真是令人难以置信。被玩弄把她关在一个地方一整天，然后再放她走！ [party.has cait |你瞥了一眼，看到凯特在酒吧里正在和一名下班后的士兵调情。人们不禁会好奇，那到底会是谁呢…… ] 最糟糕的是，”她继续说道，“那些受到影响的人似乎根本不知道自己出了什么问题，也没有意识到自己已经发生了变化。我试着和一些受影响的贵族交谈，但他们都对我的话不屑一顾。甚至有一个人称我为古板守旧的人。还有一个人竟然邀请我挑选他所有的儿子，或者其中的一些，来‘证明他们对于王位的忠诚’。真恶心！” 瓦蕾娜用力地摇了摇头，以至于她的胸部都在震动。“不过，事情也并非全坏！远非如此；你为这座城市，为每一个仍然怀有腐败思想的人，都做了了不起的事情。而还有更多的人，他们依然坚守着自己的价值观，愿意重建那些失去的东西。我遇到了很多来自各省的人，他们都非常渴望在安全的情况下尽快走出那些封闭的环境，开始重新建设村庄。农民们急切地想要回到自己的蘑菇种植地，而每一位劳动者也都决心卷起袖子，投入到新建城墙的工作中去——这些城墙将会延伸到每个城镇周围的洞穴顶部。" |就我们两个人知道吧？”瓦蕾娜轻声说道，即便周围有着那层抑制声音的屏障。“情况很糟糕。我们虽然还没有陷入混乱或类似的境地，但情况确实很不妙。城市里挤满了难民，皇家军团也在节节败退，而我担心，有些邪恶的东西可能在我们不知情的情况下潜入了这座城市……邪恶的东西。生物我哥哥告诉我，这些恶魔都是变形者。如果真是这样，而我们却敞开大门让成千上万的外地人进入了这座城市…… 瓦蕾娜摇了摇头：“但我不会让他们成为即将发生的一切的替罪羊。对于每一个我们放任进入这座城市的坏人，肯定也有成千上万的市民正在寻求安全。不过，我还是为这座城市感到担忧。 [pc.name]她握紧了拳头。“但这只意味着我必须尽我所能去提供帮助。哪怕只是为难民提供援助，或是努力激励他们——帮助他们保持希望。我绝不会坐视不理，任由这座城市分崩离析，无论那些敌人会使出什么手段！她的语气中带着一丝不满，接着说道：“在这种时候，我真希望自己生的是个男孩。如果我能拿起剑，身后有一群忠诚的士兵支持我，勇敢地冲向敌人，事情就会简单多了！不过，即便以我的体型，我仍有许多事可以做，而且我一定会去做。 [pc.dcb |轻轻地向她点了点头 |轻拍她的肩膀 |凑近桌子，给了她一个紧紧的拥抱 ]。 ] 除了战争之外，这个王国还有其他严重的问题吗？” 瓦蕾娜叹了口气：“你知道，我离开宫殿的原因就是不想再操心政治事务。唉，问题总是层出不穷——新晋贵族与诺维托里人之间矛盾不断，而那些富有的老贵族们也一直在制造麻烦。元老院试图超越其职权范围来施加影响，这与“航海家族”发生了冲突。但这些都是我们以前曾经应对过的困难。只要我们能够成功解决这次与恶魔的冲突，我相信科尔米诺斯将会再次繁荣昌盛一千年。"
rows.raw: " "The city's been better, but it's holding," Varena says. "[var0 |With the demons' fortress destroyed, things are finally looking up, but it's not a garden of roses just yet. The siege isn't as intense as it was, but it'll take months, maybe years, for the legions to fully root out the monsters from the Undermountain. People are going to be afraid to walk the roads, to let their children out of the villages, for a generation. But we're a strong people, [pc.name]. We'll get through this, and we'll recover stronger than ever." She sighs. "I just hope things can go back to the way they were..." "How so?" "The people are changed. You saw it at the feast. It hasn't stopped. It may never stop. I still see noble women with their tits out in public, letting their men grope them in open view. The men are walking around with pavilion tents in their togas without shame. I even heard the Chargers brought a Mallachite priestess to their barracks and... and used her as a unit for a whole day before letting her go!" [party.has cait |You glance over to where Cait's flirting with an off-duty soldier at the bar. One wonders who that might have been... ] "The worst part," she continues, "is that the people affected seem to have no idea anything's wrong. That they've changed. I've tried talking to some of the affected nobles, and they just brush it off. One called me a prude. Another actually invited me to pick any, or all, of his sons and 'prove their dedication to the throne.' Yuck!" Varena shakes her head, vigorously enough to make her chest quake. "But it's not all bad! Far from it; you did an incredible thing for this city, and for every person that's still got some corruption lingering in their loins there's a hundred who're still clinging to their values and ready to rebuild what they lost. I've talked to so many people from the provinces who're eager to get back out of the walls as soon as it's safe and start resettling the villages. Farmers are eager to get back to their mushrooms, and every laborer is committed to rolling up his sleeves and getting to work on new walls that'll stretch up to the cavern roofs around every town." |Between you and me?" Varena speaks quietly, even with the dampening bubble around you. "Things are dire. We're not on the brink of collapsing into anarchy or anything, but it's bad. The city's full to bursting with refugees, the Royal Legions are losing ground, and I fear what may have slipped into the city without our knowing. Evil things, evil beings. My brother tells me that these demons are shapeshifters. If that's true, and we've admitted tens of thousands of provincials into the city with open arms..." Varena shakes her head. "But I won't scapegoat them for whatever may come. For every misbegotten we've let through, there's surely a thousand frightened citizens just looking for safety. Still, I'm afraid for this city, [pc.name]." She tightens a fist. "But that just means I need to do everything in my power to help. Even if it's just giving aid to the refugees, or trying to inspire them — to help them keep hope. I refuse to just sit back and let this city fall to pieces, no matter what the demons throw at us!" There's a small huff in her voice as she adds, "It's times like this, I almost wish I'd been born a boy. Things would be easier if I could just pick up a sword and charge bravely at my enemies with a legion of loyal soldiers at my back! But even at my size, there's all sorts of things I can do. That I will do." You [pc.dcb |give her a slight nod |squeeze her shoulder |lean over the table and give her a big hug ]. ] "Are there any big problems in the kingdom aside from the war?" Varena groans. "You know, the reason I leave the palace is to not have to think about politics. Ugh. There's always problems. Tensions between the newly-made men, the Novitauri, and the wealthy old patricians. The senate trying to exert influence beyond their remit. Conflict with the Sailgraves. But nothing we haven't weathered before. If we can come out the other side of this conflict with the demons, I think Khor'minos will stand strong for another thousand years." "

I don't know what exactly she's planning, but even if she's helping us now, I'm sure that following her lead will only play into her hand. There must be some greater plot at play!"

rows.original: You don't think Calise's that bad...
rows.translation: 你不会认为卡莉丝有那么糟糕吧……

rows.original: Without evidence to turn the court against Calise, you could take things into your own hands...
rows.translation: 由于没有证据能让法庭站在卡莉丝的对立面，你或许可以自己采取行动……
rows.raw: "Without evidence to turn the court against Calise, you could take things into your own hands..."

rows.original: You have to bring this to the king. Surely Varena can make him believe you?
rows.translation: 你必须将这个呈交给国王。想必瓦蕾娜能够让他相信你的话吧？
rows.raw: "You have to bring this to the king. Surely Varena can make him believe you?"

rows.original: There has to be a way to get Calise to reveal herself where the city's elite can see it.
rows.translation: 一定有办法让卡莉丝在城市的精英们都能看到的地方现身。
rows.raw: "There has to be a way to get Calise to reveal herself where the city's elite can see it."

rows.original: What's Calise's story, and why does Varena seem to hate her so much?
rows.translation: 卡莉丝的故事究竟是什么？为什么瓦蕾娜似乎如此恨她？
rows.raw: "What's Calise's story, and why does Varena seem to hate her so much?"

rows.original: You don't think Calise's that bad...
rows.translation: 你不会认为卡莉丝有那么糟糕吧……

rows.original: You think something's wrong with Calise.
rows.translation: 你认为卡莉丝有些不对劲。

rows.original: You know the truth about Calise: she's a demon in disguise.
rows.translation: 你知道关于卡莉丝的真相：她其实是个伪装成人类的恶魔。
rows.raw: "You know the truth about Calise: she's a demon in disguise."

rows.original: You know the truth about Kasyrra's presence in the Undermountain: she's been the false Champion of Velun all along.
rows.translation: 你知道关于卡希拉出现在山腹深域背后的真相：她从一开始就是维伦的假冠军罢了。
rows.raw: "You know the truth about Kasyrra's presence in the Undermountain: she's been the false Champion of Velun all along."

rows.original: "I don't... I don't hate her," Varena says. "But I think there's something fishy about her. Something just doesn't feel right." "How do you mean?" "I've looked into her, you know. Calise. She's a Valgar woman, but she doesn't have the accent. I can't place her accent at all, in fact. She's also supposedly part marefolk, and the stories about her paint her to be a mountain of barbarian muscle, but she's so... she makes me look big! And the Champion of Velun, the god of trees and forests, just so happens to be here under the mountains right when the war breaks out?" Varena shakes her head. "Something's off." You wave her off. "Start from the beginning. Who is she supposed to be?" "Right, right." Varena sighs. "Of course. From what I know, Calise is a woman from the Valgar lands, way down south near Zhenna. She became the Champion of Velun by killing a bunch of lumberjacks that had cut down a dryad's tree, or something like that. Just went on an absolute rampage over it! I don't know what she did before that. I can only assume she was a paladin before that, but she must not have had much renown before becoming a divine champion." "And after that?" The princess shrugs. "I've found a few stories about her slaying monsters, mostly Wraith-touched, between here and Zhenna. They all paint the picture of a brutal warrior, one step above an orc reaver, hacking and burning through creatures that would make even a valkyrie shudder. Ruthless." Varena steeples her fingers. "Nothing about her legends make it seem she'd be a well-spoken lady-knight that fits in so well at court." "It's just strange," she says. "Everything I have heard makes her seem like a completely different woman to the one fighting alongside us. And yet..." "Yet?" "At least I can say, this Calise has helped us. It's undeniable. She's saved countless soldiers from the clutches of the demons. Nobody can deny she's cut down hundreds of imps with her axe. The troops love her for it. The court loves her because the troops love her. Daddy's not wrong saying that this war would have gone much worse without her." She doesn't sound very convinced.
rows.translation: “我不……我不讨厌她，”瓦蕾娜说道，“但我觉得她有些可疑。有些地方就是让人感觉不对劲。” “你是什么意思？” “我调查过她，你知道的。卡莉丝。她虽然是瓦尔加人，却没有那种口音。事实上，我完全听不出她带哪里的口音。据说她还有部分马人族血统，而那些关于她的传说总把她描绘成一座肌肉堆成的野蛮人，可她的体型……她居然衬得我像个大块头！还有维伦——那位树木与森林之神的冠军，偏偏就在战争爆发的时候出现在这片大山之下？”瓦蕾娜摇了摇头，“有些事情不对劲。” 你摆了摆手。“从头讲起。她本该是谁？” “对，对。”瓦蕾娜叹了口气，“当然。据我所知，卡莉丝是来自瓦尔加地区的女人，那地方在遥远的南方，靠近詹娜。她因为杀了一批砍倒树精之树的伐木工而成为维伦的冠军，大概是这么回事。她为此简直是大开杀戒！我不知道她在那之前做过什么，只能推测她此前是名圣骑士，但在成为神圣冠军之前，她的名声想必并不显赫。” “那之后呢？” 公主耸了耸肩。“我找到了一些关于她斩杀怪物的故事，那些怪物大多是幽灵化的，发生地就在此地与詹娜之间。故事都把她描绘成一名残暴的战士，比兽人掠夺者还高一等，一路劈砍焚烧着那些连女武神都会战栗的生物。冷酷无情。”瓦蕾娜十指交叉。“她的传说里没有任何一点表明，她会是一位谈吐得体、能在宫廷中左右逢源的淑女骑士。” “就是觉得奇怪，”她说，“我听到的所有说法，都让她看起来与和我们并肩作战的那个女人完全不同。然而……” “然而？” “至少我可以肯定，这个卡莉丝帮过我们。这是不可否认的。她从恶魔的魔爪下救出了无数士兵。没有人能否认她用斧头砍倒了成百上千的小恶魔。军队因此爱戴她，宫廷又因为军队爱戴她而宠爱她。爸爸说得没错，如果没有她，这场战争会糟糕得多。” 她听起来并不是很信服。

rows.original:
The princess gasps softly. "It's worse than I feared. Are you sure about this?"
    
    "She admitted it to me on the roof," you tell her. Even as you're conversing, you're still obligated to keep dancing, to keep up appearances lest the demoness know something is amiss. 
    
    "I believe you," Varena assures you, making the same effort to seem at-ease despite the revelation. "Something's always seemed off about her, but I was hoping beyond hope it wasn't... that. That she would just be a spy from another kingdom, or a charlatan pretending to be a divine champion. How could a demon fool the court so easily? Even the priests!"
    
    The royal cow shakes her head. "It doesn't matter. The question is what we do about this demon in our midsts. I don't know what exactly she's planning, but even if she's helping us now, I'm sure that following her lead will only play into her hand. There must be some greater plot at play!"
rows.translation:
公主轻轻倒吸一口气。“情况比我想象的还要糟糕。你确定吗？”
    
    “她在屋顶上向我承认了这件事，”你告诉她。尽管你们正在交谈，你仍然必须继续跳舞，维持表面的常态，以免那个女恶魔察觉到有什么不对劲。 
    
    “我相信你，”瓦蕾娜向你保证，尽管得知了这个真相，她依然努力让自己显得若无其事。“她身上总有些地方显得不对劲，但我一直抱着一线希望，希望那并不是……那种事。希望她只是来自另一个王国的间谍，或者是个冒充神圣冠军的骗子。一个恶魔怎么可能如此轻易地欺骗整个宫廷？就连祭司们也上当了！”
    
    这位皇家奶牛摇了摇头。“这不重要。问题是我们该如何应对这个潜伏在我们中间的恶魔。我不知道她究竟在策划什么，但即便她现在是在帮助我们，我敢肯定，跟随她的指引行事只会正中她的下怀。背后肯定有更大的阴谋！”

rows.original: The princess blinks. "She... she what?" "She's Kasyrra," you reiterate. "She confessed as much." "How... why... why would she confess to that? That doesn't make any sense! Are you sure she wasn't joking?" "I'm sure." Varena plants her face in her hands. "Gods! I knew something was wrong, but that... that's so far beyond the pale. How are we supposed to win this war if the Demon Queen is already lording it up in the palace? We might as well just admit defeat." She slams a fist down on the table, hard enough to make you jump. "No! That's bullshit. We have to do something! I have to tell [var0 |... no, Daddy won't believe me now. He knows I don't get on with Calise, and after the party... he'll just think I'm being petty. Fuck! |Daddy! Gods, will he even believe me? ]" "We need evidence!" Varena says, furrowing her brow. "We have to find proof of who and what she is. Not just testimony. Daddy trusts that witch." "Do you have any ideas?" you ask. She shakes her head. "For right now? No. I don't know what to do. But if she's willing to admit that to you, she clearly trusts you. Just... just follow her, watch her. She has to slip up sometime. You've got to be there and ready to pounce on it!"

rows.original: "The future feels like it's so far out of sight right now," Varena laughs. "It's hard for me to think about it when the present [var0 |only just got rescued from the clutches of demonic armageddon! |is so thoroughly screwed up. ] Mostly the future looks like helping people put their lives back together after this." "Humor me," you say. "Think about when all this is behind us." The princess sighs and rests her chin in her hands. "I don't know. Probably a lot of art. I've only ever done murals here in the capital." She taps the painted wall behind her. "I've always wanted to do more across the kingdom, at least one good wall in every town and village. Mom says I should try painting a church — maybe when they rebuild the Cathedral of Tira, I'll be able to do the inside of it. I've always liked painting moons." She gestures to the tavern wall near to the stage, where a salamander in heroic panoply clashes against a slavering sea monster on the deck of a ship under the light of a full moon. "I don't know if my style will get the priests on board, though. They tend to really like hyper-realism, and I'm a stylizing kinda girl." "Anything aside from your art come to mind?" Varena whistles. "Working out! I haven't paid nearly enough penance at the [silly |church of gains |altar of strength ] lately. I want to set a new bench-press record! Daddy broke his best right before the war, and I'm falling behind." She pumps her fists excitedly. "Gotta get back on that wagon and hit the gym until all this stress weight turns into muscle!" "Y'know," she continues, flexing her thick biceps, "I know it's not exactly princess-y behavior, but I've thought about opening my own gym. Or at least sponsoring one of my trainers from the Chargers to, once he retires next year. Oh! I could paint the inside of it myself, too. Just nothing but ripped-as-heck, oiled-up cowgirls on every wall with their heroic honkers hanging out. Maybe I could even invent my own enchanted weight-lifting gear!" The excited cowgirl beams from ear to ear. "Yeah, that's what I'm gonna do! Varena's Gymnasium. And I'll make it free for all the kids in the lower city, too!"         "We have to find incontrovertible proof that she isn't who and what she says she is. That means you have to follow her. Invent something for the two of you to do together if you have to. She has to slip up eventually."
        
        "What would count as 'hard proof,' anyway?" you ask. 
        
        Varena shrugs. "Correspondence with the city's enemies, demonic artifacts, books of strange spells — things she shouldn't have. But... proving they came from Calise would be its own problem. It's still just our testimony unless you have witnesses. A confession from one of her associates would be perfect, but good luck with that! I don't know, I'm not good at subterfuge like this."

rows.original:
Varena stuffing her pretty face leaves you time to talk about this and that. At her request, you keep to the lighter parts of your adventures rather than the war itself — the funny, and more often than not sexy, escapades — and even your own personal interests. You take the opportunity to reach across the table and wipe away a little sauce that's gotten on her chin, which makes her blush all over again. 
    
    Time seems to fly by while the two of you chat, and eat, and chat, and eat. 
    
    Varena makes some cute, pleased noises while she packs it down, and never stops heaping well-earned praises on the chef, just loud enough to make sure he can hear it through the door. She does, at least, manage to insist to the waiter that she doesn't need another plate full, though she doesn't say no to another bread platter. Your own meal leaves you completely stuffed, and soon enough you're sitting back patting your [pc.belly]. 
    
    "We should do... something!" Varena says, stretching out in her seat. "Something fun!" 
    
    "You looked like you were already having fun," you tease, poking the princess's belly under the table. 
    
    She giggles and kicks her hooves. "Yeah, exactly. I don't want it to be over. I don't get to go out like this... well, ever. Just me and one other person. Especially one so [pc.dcb
        |dark and mysterious
        |gallant and charming
        |sweet and bubbly
    ]. Oh, I know! Let's go dancing!"
    
    "Where?"
    
    "Back at Ember's. Livy's playing tonight! Come on."
rows.translation:
瓦蕾娜忙着往那张漂亮脸蛋里塞食物，正好给了你东拉西扯的时间。应她的要求，你只讲冒险中比较轻松的部分，而不是战争本身——那些好笑的、而且往往还挺香艳的奇遇——甚至还包括你个人的兴趣爱好。你趁机伸手越过桌子，擦掉了她下巴上沾的一点酱汁，这让她又羞红了脸。 
    
    你们俩边吃边聊，聊了又吃、吃了又聊，时间仿佛飞逝。 
    
    瓦蕾娜一边大快朵颐，一边发出可爱而满足的哼声，还不停地把应得的赞美堆到厨师头上，声音大得刚好能让他隔着门也听得见。至少她还是坚持告诉服务员自己不需要再来一整盘，不过对于再上一盘面包倒没有拒绝。你那份饭菜也让你吃得饱饱的，很快你就靠回椅背，拍着自己的[pc.belly]。 
    
    “我们该做点……什么！”瓦蕾娜说着，在座位上伸了个懒腰。“做点好玩的事！” 
    
    “你看起来已经玩得很开心了嘛，”你打趣道，在桌子底下戳了戳公主的肚子。 
    
    她咯咯笑着，踢了踢蹄子：“对，就是这样。我不想让这一切结束。我从来没机会像这样出门……嗯，从来没有过。只有我和另一个人。尤其是像你这么[pc.dcb
        |黑暗又神秘
        |英勇又迷人
        |甜美又活泼
    ]。哦，我知道了！我们去跳舞吧！”
    
    “去哪儿？”
    
    “回余烬酒馆吧。今晚莉薇有演出！来吧。”

rows.original:
Varena snatches up your hand again, only pausing to dig a couple of electrum coins out from her cleavage and leave them on the table before dragging you right back the way you came. She's excited now, hooves clattering rapid-fire on the stone streets and bubble-butt bouncing under her skirts. 
    
    It's gotten late enough now that the crowds packed into the city are thinning out, giving the two of you the space to walk side by side once you're out of the side streets. The princess slips her arms around one of yours and squishes herself up against you, tail swishing gaily. When you finally make it all the way back to Ember's Taphouse, the sound of music is already pouring out from the doors, accompanied by the rhythmic thud of hooves on the floor. 
    
    Varena gives you an eager squeeze. "Just in time!"
    
    The big tables inside Ember's have all been pushed up against the wall, making room for two dozen couples to [silly
        |rock the dance floor
        |dance
    ]. [livrea.met
        |Livrea
        |The red-headed bard you saw playing at the feast
    ] is sitting up on the stage with a fiddle tucked under her chin. She's the only one to take note of your arrival, and gives the two of you a wink before immediately launching into a brisk new number. 
    
    Varena practically bounces in excitement and bounds into the middle of the crowd. You take the princess in your arms and pull her tight against yourself, feeling the softness of her body beneath your hands. She gives you a pretty smile and [var0
        |squeezes your ass
        |nuzzles in
    ], waiting for you to take the lead.

rows.translation: 一股极其有力的推力将那头精疲力尽的牛的头推到了旁边，转眼间，你就直视着它那双漂亮的蓝眼睛。这位女牛仔已经累得连感到尴尬都来不及了，更不可能在发现有人正在偷看她的窗户时表现出丝毫惊讶。她只是懒洋洋地朝你挥了挥手。 那只红毛弥诺陶洛斯将布满血丝的眼睛转向窗户，剧烈地哼了一声，然后将头从那位吟游诗女胸前移开。 在你还没来得及喊出“哦，糟了”之前，这个巨大的野兽就已经朝你扑了过来。你用尽全力往窗台外推，试图躲开他的攻击范围，但那个该死的弥诺陶洛斯根本不在乎这些琐碎的事情墙这个家伙有八英尺高，身上堆满了比战马还要结实的肌肉，他以惊人的力量冲破了障碍，来到了户外，发出的吼声比熊的叫声还要响亮。 [pc.hasWings |你猛地后退，才躲过了对方试图掐住你喉咙的动作。 |瓦蕾娜在你身下尖叫着，猛地将她的法杖拉到一边，及时将你从他的掌控中解脱出来，从而躲过了他伸向你喉咙的手。 ]公牛在空气中翻滚着，但它立刻收拢双腿，用后腿踢向巷子的另一侧墙壁，随着一声怒吼重重摔在了地上。 [silly |哦耶耶耶！！！ ] 哦，该死……”瓦蕾娜惊呼着，后退了几步，将法杖紧紧抱在胸前。 莉维娅从腰带上拔出剑，走到她面前：“退后！拉米恩·贾瓦里！冷静一点！” 那头公牛看起来根本无法平静下来，因为它被打扰了，愤怒得几乎要吐出白沫来。 “我觉得它根本听不见我们的话，”你说道，走到女孩们身边，也拔出了武器。“我们只能强行让它停下来。
rows.raw: ' A particularly powerful thrust rolls the exhausted cow's head to the side, and all of a sudden you're staring straight into her pretty blue eyes. The cowgirl's too exhausted to be embarrassed, or even show a hint of shock at seeing a peeper in her window. She just gives you a lazy little wave. The red-furred minotaur cuts his bloodshot eyes towards the window. He snorts violently, lifting his head from the bard-girl's breast. You've got just enough time to yelp "Oh, shit," before the titanic brute is lunging towards you. You push back from the windowsill as hard as you can, trying to get out his reach, but the damned minotaur doesn't care about such mundane things as the wall; at eight feet tall and packed with more muscle than a warhorse, he barrels straight through it and into the open air, bellowing louder than bear. [pc.hasWings |You flap back, just dodging a grab at your throat. |Varena shrieks under you and yanks her staff to the side, pulling you out of his grasp just in time to evade his hand going for your throat. ] The bull tumbles through the air, but he pulls his legs back and kicks off the opposite wall in the alleyway, falling to the ground with a roar. Ramien Iavari! Calm yourself!" The bull looks anything but calm, practically frothing at the mouth in his rage at being disturbed. "I don't think he's listening," you say, landing beside the girls and drawing your weapon. "We'll have to make him." '

rows.original:
Under the weight of blade and spell, the raging bull is sent stumbling back, crashing into the wall of the house. He tries to push himself back up, snorting and trashing like a wild animal, but the sheer mass of all that muscle weighs him down. 
    
    "Let's sleep it off, buddy," Livrea says. She plucks a few notes on her harp and chants a spell, directing the music into Ramien's ears. The bull slumps back with a mighty yawn, eyes rolling closed. "Theeeere we go. Nighty-night." 
    
    "Um, excuse me?" a voice chirps from above. You glance up to see the bard, Carebella, peering down at you with a bedsheet wrapped around herself. "What... what are you doing to my boyfriend? And — wait, Livrea? Is that you?"
    
    Liv waves. "Hey, Care-bear. Long time no see. I think your man's had one too many today."
    
    The bard shakes her head. Pretty brown hair cascades around her. "The only thing that's been in his mouth today's come out of me. I don't know what got into him! He came home, ripped my toga off without a word, and laid into me like a beast!" She blushes a little. "I wasn't complaining, mind, at least at first... but we've been at it all day. Hours and hours. Then he saw your friend and..."
    
    You glance back at the now-slumbering bull. He barely seemed to know where he was, just a ball of instincts firing off randomly. Hardly a heroic soldier. "Can we come up and talk?"
    
    "Y-yeah," Carebella says. "The back door's open. I'll meet you as soon as I, um, find some clothes."
rows.translation:
在刀刃与法术的重压下，那头狂怒的公牛被逼得连连后退，最终撞在了房屋的墙壁上。它试图挣扎着重新站起来，发出野兽般的哼吼与挣扎声，但那些厚实的肌肉实在让它无法动弹。
    
    “我们先睡一觉吧，伙计。”莉薇娅说道。她用竖琴弹奏了几声，然后念出一道法术，让这些音乐传入拉米恩的耳中。公牛打着哈欠瘫软在地，双眼缓缓闭上了。“好了，现在可以睡觉了。晚安。 
    
    嗯，打扰一下？”一个声音从上方传来。你抬头一看，只见吟游诗人Carebella裹着床单正往下看着你。“你……你在对我的男朋友做什么？等等，莉维娅？是你吗？”
    
    莉芙挥了挥手：“嘿，Care-bear，好久不见啊。我看你男朋友今天大概是喝多了吧。
    
    那位吟游诗人摇了摇头，棕色的长发飘洒在身周。“今天他嘴里说的所有话，其实都出自我的口中。我真的不知道他到底怎么了！他回到家，二话不说就扯掉了我的长袍，然后像野兽一样扑向我……”她微微红了脸，“其实我一开始并没有抱怨……但我们就这样持续了好几个小时。后来他看到了你的朋友，然后……
    
    你回头看了一眼那头此刻正在沉睡的公牛。它似乎根本不知道自己身在何处，只是一堆本能在无序地发挥作用罢了。它根本算不上是一头英勇的战士。“我们能上去聊聊吗？”
    
    “嗯……可以，”卡雷贝拉说道，“后门是开着的。等我找好衣服后，就会去找你。

rows.original: Livrea and Varena are slapped away, crumpling under the furor of Ramien's rage, before the bull finally turns his full attention to you. He stalks forward, fists clenching and unclenching. There's murder in this bull's eyes, and you're helpless to stop him. You scrabble back across the cold stone of the alley, until your back is pressed against the wall. Oh, gods, here it comes. You raise your hands in one last defiant attempt to fend off sure death... Rather than a mortal blow, there's a loud, discordant bong from behind Ramien. The bull staggers forward, wobbles on his hooves, and then flops over with a weight that makes the remaining shutters on the house shake. Behind him is standing a very naked, still quite bloated-looking brunette bard, holding a lute around its neck in two hands like a club. She's breathing hard, almost as unsure on her feet as her bull was. "Are... are you okay?" "I'll live. Thanks to you." You push yourself up off the ground. Livrea groans, face down and ass up on the ground; Varena's leaning against a wall with her eyes closed, mouth agape. You grab both girls horns and give them a shake, trying to rouse them. Glancing at the naked bard, you ask, "What was his problem?" Carebella shrugs, and slumps against the wall to catch her breath. "I don't know. He came home, ripped my toga off without a word, and laid into me like a beast. I wasn't complaining, mind, at least at first... but we'd been at it all day. Hours and hours." "Came home from where?" you ask. "The war. His legion rotated back this morning. Honestly, I don't know what came over him. I'm sorry." "[pc.dcb |He almost fucking killed us," you grumble. |It's not your fault," you assure her. |Aw, it's okay. Nobody died," you say. ] Varena comes to with a gasp, looks up at Carebella, and covers her eyes right back up. Carebella bashfully covers herself with her hands. "Ah. I'm just... going to go inside and find something to wear." "We need to talk," you tell her, catching her hand before she goes. She gives you a flirty smile over her shoulder. "Easy, tiger. We can chat when I'm not freezing in the breeze."
rows.translation: 莉维娅和瓦蕾娜被一掌扇开，在拉米恩的狂怒下瘫倒在地；随后，公牛终于将全部注意力转向你。他大步逼近，双拳不断握紧又松开。这头公牛眼中透出杀意，而你根本无力阻止他。 你手脚并用，在冰冷巷道石面上向后退去，直到后背抵住墙壁。哦，诸神啊，要来了。你举起双手，作出最后一次挑衅般的尝试，想要抵挡必然到来的死亡…… 迎来的并非致命一击，而是拉米恩身后响起一声刺耳而不和谐的咣。公牛向前踉跄，牛蹄左右摇摆，随即沉重地扑倒在地，震得房屋仅剩的百叶窗都颤动起来。 他身后站着一名全身赤裸、看起来依然颇为臃肿的棕发吟游诗人，双手握住琉特琴的琴颈，像使用棍棒一样举着。她呼吸急促，双腿几乎和自家公牛一样站立不稳。“你……你没事吧？” “死不了。多亏了你。”你撑着身体从地面起身。莉维娅呻吟着，脸朝下、屁股朝上地趴在地上；瓦蕾娜靠着墙壁，双眼紧闭，嘴巴大张。你分别抓住两个姑娘的牛角，摇晃着试图唤醒她们。你瞥向赤裸的吟游诗人，问道：“他到底怎么回事？” 卡雷贝拉耸耸肩，瘫靠在墙上喘息。“不知道。他回到家，二话不说就撕掉我的托加袍，像野兽一样扑上来操我。先说好，至少一开始，我可没有抱怨……不过我们做了一整天。好几个小时又好几个小时。” “从哪里回来？”你问道。 “战场。他的军团今早轮换回来。老实说，我不知道他到底怎么了。很抱歉。” “[pc.dcb |他他妈差点杀了我们，”你抱怨道。 |这不是你的错，”你向她保证。 |啊，没关系。没人死掉，”你说道。 ] 瓦蕾娜惊喘着恢复意识，抬头看向卡雷贝拉，又立刻重新捂住眼睛。卡雷贝拉羞涩地用双手遮住身体。“啊。我只是……进去找件衣服穿。” “我们得谈谈，”你在她离开前抓住她的手，说道。 她回头向你露出挑逗般的微笑。“别急，小老虎。等我不再迎风受冻时再谈。”

rows.original: You glance at the two extra-curvy cowgirls following you. Stealth isn't exactly either of their strong suits, is it? You can hear their milky voluptuousness over your shoulders just walking around. "Stay here. I'm going to try and get inside." They exchange a look, and Varena puts a hand on your shoulder. "Be careful." Livrea pouts a little. "Don't leave us waiting." "I won't," you assure them, before slipping into the alley beside the house alone. There's a back door to the place, protected only by a waist-high stone fence that's covered in glowing moss. It's just a bit of flourish to separate the clotheslines and mushroom planters out back from the neighbors', and it proves no obstacle to you. Nor does the door, it turns out; it's not even locked. You gingerly work the handle and let yourself inside.
rows.translation: 你瞥了一眼跟在你后面的那两个身材曲线十分优美的女牛仔。隐秘行动显然不是她们的强项，对吧？你完全可以听到她们那乳白色的身躯紧贴着你的肩膀，就这样一起走着。“待在这里吧，我试着进去看看。” 她们互相对视了一眼，然后瓦蕾娜把手放在你的肩膀上：“小心点。” 莉维娅则微微撅起了嘴。别让我们干等。” “我不会让你们等的，”你向他们保证，然后独自溜进了房子旁边的小巷。 那个地方有一扇后门，只用一堵齐腰高的石墙围着，墙上长满了发光的苔藓。这只是为了将后院的晾衣绳和蘑菇种植箱与邻居们的东西区分开来而已，这对你来说根本不是什么障碍。事实证明，那扇门也没什么问题，甚至都没有上锁。你小心翼翼地转动门把手，然后走了进去。
